name: Morning wash-up and preparation
description: On the morning of the New Year, Lu Mingqiang woke up early, full of energy. He quietly washed up, then went to the kitchen to boil water. He picked up his phone and browsed the "Electrical Technology" forum, saving a shared post about troubleshooting IGBT module faults in frequency converters, to prepare for studying in the evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: New Year's Day deep clean at home
description: While the family was still resting, Lu Mingqiang changed into his old work clothes and started a thorough cleaning. He carefully vacuumed the living room floor and baseboards, and wiped the coffee table, TV cabinet, and the bedroom dresser with a cloth. After mopping the floor, he felt refreshed looking at the tidy home. Just then, his wife Wang Lijuan came out carrying their youngest son Lu Zihan, who had just woken up. Lu Zihan wished his father a happy New Year in a childish voice, and the family began a warm day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Maintaining the electrical repair toolbox
description: After finishing the big cleaning, Lu Mingqiang took out his treasured electrical repair toolbox from the balcony storage cabinet, laid a cloth on the balcony floor, and arranged the tools one by one: multimeter, test pen, screwdrivers, wire strippers, socket wrenches, etc. He carefully wiped and inspected them with a cotton cloth. He particularly hefted the old screwdriver that had been used for many years; its wooden handle had been polished smooth by grip and felt very comfortable to use. After confirming all the tools were in good condition, he carefully put them back in place, fully prepared for the upcoming work.
location: Balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy gifts for visiting relatives and prepare to depart
description: Lu Mingqiang changed his clothes, told his wife, and went downstairs to the Heyuan Convenience Store at the entrance of the residential community. He carefully selected a barrel of peanut oil, two bottles of coconut juice, a pack of sugar-free cookies, and a box of milk as gifts for visiting relatives. Then he walked home and called the family to get ready. His wife Wang Lijuan and two sons Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan were very happy to hear they were going to Grandpa and Grandma's house. The family took the gifts and set off from Jinmao Middle Road in the car.
location: Haikou Longhua Heyuan Convenience Store and Banshan Garden Residential Area, 18 Mingzhu Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to his parents' home and had lunch together.
description: The family drove from Longhua District to the parents' home in Meilan District. The festive atmosphere along the way was strong. Lu Mingqiang drove steadily while his wife in the passenger seat reminded the children to be polite. After arriving, his father Lu Jianguo was already waiting downstairs. As soon as they entered, his mother Chen Xiuying was busy at the stove, and the whole house was filled with the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice. The lunch was plentiful, with white cut chicken, braised mackerel, stir-fried winged beans, and mixed fish clay pot. At the dinner table, Lu Mingqiang mentioned to his father his idea of taking the advanced technician exam. His father encouraged him by adding food to his plate, which made him feel very warm. After the meal, the children played with their grandparents for a while. Because they needed to do homework in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to his parents.
location: No. 42 Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District community.

name: Return Trip and Noon Break
description: On the way back from his parents' home, the youngest son Lu Zihan fell asleep. After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife settle the children, then lay down in the master bedroom to rest for half an hour and recover his energy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Write down the annual goals.
description: After the lunch break, refreshed, Lu Mingqiang walked to the dining table, took out the brand-new 2025 desk calendar, tore off the old page, and solemnly wrote down two annual goals in the blank space for January 1 with a pen: qualify as a senior technician and help his eldest son Lu Zixuan improve his math scores. After writing, he placed the calendar in a prominent spot on the living room TV cabinet to remind himself to work hard in the new year.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Purchasing daily necessities at the supermarket
description: Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan walked to the nearby Wanghao Supermarket in Friendship Sunshine City. Despite the New Year's Day crowds, they went straight to business. Wang Lijuan picked out vegetables, fruit, and daily necessities, while Lu Mingqiang was in charge of pushing the cart and carrying items. He also grabbed the milk and cookies the boys loved, plus a bottle of Lao Gan Ma. The checkout came to over three hundred yuan, and they returned fully loaded, replenishing the family refrigerator with ample supplies.
location: Wanghao Supermarket, B1, Friendship Sunshine City, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time: tutoring homework and playing with building blocks.
description: After returning home from the supermarket, Lu Mingqiang asked his wife to put away the items, and he himself accompanied the two sons. He tutored his eldest son Lu Zixuan on his winter vacation math homework, patiently guiding him to understand division word problems by circling and annotating key words. Meanwhile, his younger son Lu Zihan was building a castle with LEGO blocks on the play mat. Lu Mingqiang turned back from time to time to encourage and gently correct his building mistakes. The living room was filled with a warm parent-child atmosphere.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Kitchen helper
description: After tutoring homework, Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen to help his wife prepare dinner. He tied on an apron, chopped and plated the white cut chicken brought back from his parents' home, and washed the newly bought greens. The couple chatted and cooperated harmoniously amid the clatter of pots and pans.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was simple and appetizing, with white cut chicken, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. The family of four sat around the table, eating and chatting. Wang Lijuan talked about her parents' family, and Lu Mingqiang mentioned that he had to submit his year-end summary at work tomorrow. Under the soft light, the family enjoyed a quiet, stable moment of happiness.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening leisure reading
description: After dinner, the family members each did their own activities. Lu Mingqiang leaned on the living room sofa, opened his phone to browse the WeChat official account "Electrician Master", and read several articles introducing the basics of PLC, building an initial impression for later professional study and using fragmented time to "recharge".
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Focused on studying electrical technology
description: Lu Mingqiang went into the study, turned on the desktop computer, and logged into the "Electrical Engineering Technology" forum, where he carefully read an original post about solving the problem of inaccurate servo motor positioning, and thought deeply about similar situations he had encountered at work. Then he opened his WeChat favorites and reviewed the document "Ten Methods for Reading Circuit Diagrams." This half hour of focused study made him feel very fulfilled.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and planning.
description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony for some fresh air, then took a hot shower to wash away his fatigue. While washing up, he discussed the next day's plans with his wife Wang Lijuan in the bedroom, mentioning that he might go to the old Haima Automobile Factory plant for emergency repairs and was not sure whether he would be home for dinner. Lying in bed, he briefly listed a few tasks for the next day in his phone notes, then said "Happy New Year" to his wife. Reviewing the fulfilling day, he felt a sense of certainty.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Fell asleep peacefully
description: Lu Mingqiang fell asleep on time. In his mind flashed his father's encouragement, his wife's smile, and his son's playful laughter, as well as the desk calendar with goals written on it. Wrapped in the warmth of family and the satisfaction of self-striving, he drifted into a dream.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Got up, washed up, had breakfast, and prepared to go out.
description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang got up on time to wash up, and his wife Wang Lijuan prepared Hainan rice noodles for breakfast. During the meal, he gave her 50 yuan and asked her to buy two packs of sugar-free digestive biscuits for his parents on the way to the market. After breakfast, he checked his work badge and car keys, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove to first take his son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, telling him not to be nervous about the Chinese dictation. Then he turned around and took his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District. Hanhan took the initiative to greet the teacher.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and preparing before the morning meeting
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang drove along Haixiu Expressway to the company. He arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, at 8:02. After parking, he walked quickly into the workshop to meet his coworker Chen Jianguo and prepare for the morning meeting.
location: Workshop, 1st Floor, Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Received the task at the morning meeting.
description: Team Leader Zhang assigned tasks at the morning meeting, requiring the assembly of the new heavy-duty distribution box for Warehouse 3 and a test run in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were the main workers, with apprentice Zhao Qiang following to learn. Because Lu Mingqiang's waist felt uncomfortable after helping with homework at home over New Year's Day, he quietly asked Chen Jianguo to pay attention to using his lower body strength when exerting force.
location: Ground-floor morning meeting area of the workshop, Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Suffered a lower back strain at work
description: When they were lifting a 200-jin distribution box together in the warehouse, Lu Mingqiang sprained the right side of his lower back the moment he stood up, and the severe pain made it impossible to straighten up. Chen Jianguo immediately supported him, and Zhao Qiang poured warm water. After resting for more than ten minutes, he gritted his teeth and stood up, cinched a tool belt around his waist for support, and switched to directing and fastening screws, while Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang did the main lifting. The task was finally completed. His waist injury ached dully throughout the morning.
location: Warehouse area on the first floor of Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch to replenish energy
description: Because of back pain and not wanting to go far, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang went to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant next to the company. He ordered the signature braised pork trotter rice with a marinated egg for extra nutrition. While eating, Zhao Qiang mentioned he had brought cured meat from his hometown in Hunan. Lu Mingqiang asked him to bring some next time to try and promised to help him review the circuit diagram in the afternoon.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest to relieve lower back pressure
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang went back to the company break room. Instead of napping hunched over the desk, he lay down on a bench with a thin blanket under his lower back to relax his muscles. He dozed off for half an hour to the sound of workshop machinery, and felt the soreness in his lower back ease a bit.
location: Rest room, 2nd floor, Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Afternoon work and helping new colleagues
description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang sat on a low stool checking the wiring diagram inside the distribution box and tightening the terminal screws. When he bent over, his lower back still ached. After finishing, he sat down beside his apprentice Zhao Qiang’s workstation and noticed that a signal wire in his control cabinet had been connected to the wrong common terminal. Using the schematic diagram, he analyzed the problem step by step and guided Zhao Qiang in correcting it, reminding him to be meticulous and study the drawings more.
location: Distribution Box Assembly Area, First Floor, Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up Hanhan and go home after work.
description: At 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang placed a cushion on the back seat to relieve pressure on his lower back, then drove to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Lu Zihan. Hanhan ran out holding up a drawing of a big crane and showed it happily. When they got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up Lu Zixuan, and the aroma of cooking wafted from the kitchen.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then returned to Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Start work case recording.
description: After changing out of his work clothes and washing up, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and wrote on the flyleaf of a brand-new hardcover notebook: “Technical workers should also have writing skills.” Then, enduring the lower back pain, he recalled and recorded the case from the previous day’s emergency repair of a transformer fault: the equipment model was S11-M-800/10, and the output voltage fluctuated abnormally. Using a multimeter to measure the winding resistance, he finally found that the tap changer had poor contact. After polishing the contacts, it returned to normal. He recorded for about 40 minutes and felt very grounded.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The family ate dinner together.
description: Dinner included stir-fried sweet potato leaves, stir-fried pork with chili peppers, and tomato and egg soup. Lu Mingqiang asked Lu Zixuan about his Chinese dictation and was very happy to learn he had gotten everything right and had been praised. Hanhan performed a new nursery rhyme he had learned at kindergarten, and the whole family laughed. Although his lower back hurt, the warmth of the family made Lu Mingqiang feel very happy.
location: Restaurant, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help Zixuan with homework and tutor math
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa and, enduring lower back pain, tutored Lu Zixuan in math division word problems. He guided Zixuan to analyze the keyword of equal sharing, taught him to use division to solve the problems, and encouraged the child to think independently.
location: Living room of Apartment 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening electrical technology study
description: After helping the children finish their homework, Wang Lijuan applied a hot water bottle to Lu Mingqiang's waist. He half-leaned against the chair in the study, turned on the computer, and browsed the Electrician Technology forum, focusing on learning to read complex circuit diagrams and PLC-controlled multi-relay circuits. He took screenshots of several fault analysis cases and wrote down the analysis ideas. Although his waist hurt, he persisted in studying for 35 minutes and deepened his understanding.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and chit-chat with family
description: After Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower, his wife helped him rub red flower oil on his lower back and apply a medicated patch to relieve the pain. Afterwards, he leaned against the headboard and scrolled through news on his phone, chatted on WeChat with his elder brother Lu Minghua in Shenzhen, and reminded him to take care as the temperature was dropping. The couple chatted for a while and then got ready to rest.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: At 10:30 PM, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone and carefully adjusted his side-sleeping position to avoid pressure on his lower back. Listening to the sound of the night wind outside the window, thinking about the sense of achievement from starting the work log that day and helping Zhao Qiang solve a problem, he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family preparation
description: After the alarm rang, Lu Mingqiang slowly sat up, feeling soreness in his lower back, and carefully got out of bed. After washing up, he tore off the old medicated patch and applied a new one; the cool feeling eased the discomfort. He prepared breakfast for the family, cooking congee and steaming char siu bao. His wife Wang Lijuan also got up. He reminded her to leave work early to pick up their elder son Xuanxuan, while he would pick up their younger son Hanhan, and then they would go to his parents' house together.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang helped Hanhan put on his backpack and drove first to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, arriving at about 7:20. He handed Hanhan to the teacher and told him to be good. Then he turned around and headed to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, arriving around 7:45. Xuanxuan got out of the car by himself, and he told Xuanxuan to go home with Mom after school, watched his son walk through the school gate, and then drove to work.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Work check-in and communication
description: At 8 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang arrived at the company. After changing into his work clothes, he first went to find Team Leader Zhang and truthfully explained that he had strained his lower back yesterday while moving a distribution box, saying that today's heavy work might be a bit slower but would not hold up progress. Zhang told him to be careful and let Jianguo and Xiao Zhao share more of the heavy work. When he returned to his workstation, colleagues Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang had already started sorting out the tools.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Worked in the morning despite injury.
description: The morning task was to finish assembling the distribution box. Lu Mingqiang checked the cable routing and terminal block numbers against the drawings and tightened all screws with a screwdriver. When moving the heavy enclosure, he directed Jianguo and Xiao Zhao to lift it together while he guided from the side. During the work break, he went to the break room for water and asked Jianguo whether the hardware store had lumbar support belts; Jianguo said he would go with him in the evening to look. After that, he continued working with focus.
location: Repair Workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang walked with Jianguo and Xiao Zhao to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. He ordered pork trotters rice to replenish his energy. While waiting for the food, he asked about the hardware store's opening hours. Jianguo said they could go any time before 8 p.m. He also reminded Xiao Zhao to pay attention to safety during the afternoon work, especially to cut off the power before wiring.
location: No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province: Yangtianhe Pharmacy 110, Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company. In the rest area of the maintenance workshop, he found a chair against the wall, put his safety helmet behind his lower back as a cushion, and half-reclined with his eyes closed to rest. The soreness in his lower back made him afraid to lie on his stomach, so he could only relax this way. He dozed off for 20 minutes, mentally planning the afternoon's work and the evening trip to his parents' home.
location: Rest area of the maintenance workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work while injured.
description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang continued the unfinished distribution box from the morning, mainly checking circuits and tightening screws. In the middle, Foreman Zhang assigned a new task: go to the warehouse to verify the quantity of the newly arrived KBO-45C control and protective switch device and record the serial numbers. He finished in half an hour and returned the form. Meanwhile, he sent a WeChat message to Lao Chen, the owner of the hardware store, to reserve a lumbar support belt, and Lao Chen replied it was in stock. Then he went back to his workstation to finish the remaining work.
location: Repair Workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up my youngest son after work.
description: After getting off work at 17:00, Lu Mingqiang drove to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. The road was slightly congested, and he arrived at about 17:25. After picking up his younger son Hanhan, he asked his son how he had behaved during the day and told him they would go to grandma and grandpa's house for dinner in the evening. Hanhan was very happy. He helped Hanhan fasten the child safety seat belt and then set off.
location: Guomao Third Horizontal Road [] Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up my wife and children and buy a lumbar support belt
description: Lu Mingqiang first drove back to Banshan Garden to pick up his wife Wang Lijuan and his eldest son Xuanxuan, then navigated to Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store (Jianguo Hardware Store) on Yusha Road. He had his wife and son wait in the car while he went inside. Old Chen brought out several back support belts. After asking carefully, Lu Mingqiang chose one with steel plate support and paid 35 yuan. After the purchase, the whole family drove to his parents' home in Meilan District.
location: Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Friday family dinner
description: Around 18:30, arrived at his parents' home. His mother Chen Xiuying had prepared Hainanese chicken rice and white cut chicken, and his father Lu Jianguo was greeting the children in the living room. At the dinner table, his mother kept putting food onto Lu Mingqiang's plate. His father noticed his stiff movements and asked about his back injury. He explained truthfully, and his father said he would teach him rehabilitation exercises. After dinner, he helped his wife clear the dishes, while his father played with the grandchildren.
location: Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province [] Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Zone Residential Community

name: Family time and rehabilitation guidance
description: After dinner, the family chatted in the living room. The father took out his phone and demonstrated rehabilitation exercises such as the swallow exercise and five-point support via a video, reminding them to move slowly. Lu Mingqiang followed along seriously, while his wife recorded videos on the side. His mother brought out cut mangoes, and Xuanxuan and Hanhan played nearby, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Living room, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Zone, Dayingshan East First Street [], Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return trip and inner dialogue
description: Around 21:00, they left his parents' home; the children were asleep in the back seat. Lu Mingqiang drove and chatted with his wife about the newly bought lumbar support belt and the rehabilitation exercises taught by his father. He said seriously that this year he must pass the senior technician certificate exam, so he could stop making his father worry and set an example for the children. His wife squeezed his hand, expressed support, and told him to study with peace of mind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Settling the child down and evening study
description: After returning home, the couple divided the work to help the children wash up and change into pajamas. Around 21:20 the children went to bed. Lu Mingqiang went into the study, turned on the desk lamp, and used his phone to browse the "Electrical Technology" forum and WeChat group materials, focusing on circuit diagram reading and fault analysis cases, especially a popular post about analyzing common frequency converter fault codes. In his notebook, he recorded troubleshooting key points such as checking motor insulation first for overcurrent faults, and persisted in studying for 30 minutes.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, rehabilitation, and bedtime.
description: Around 22:00, Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower. The hot water relieved the discomfort in his lower back. Afterwards, on the yoga mat in the bedroom, he did two sets each of the superman exercise and the five-point support exercise that his father had taught him to stretch his lower back muscles. When he finished, he felt relaxed. He then got into bed. His wife was already sleepy, and after turning off the light, he soon fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Early rising, breakfast, and returning home
description: Waking up in the early morning, the soreness in his lower back had eased. He got up quietly, washed up, moved his waist around a bit, put on his lumbar support belt, and soaked his dirty work clothes in laundry detergent. Then he walked about 45 minutes to Datie Laoba Tea House, ordered a pot of Tieguanyin, a pineapple bun, and soft-boiled eggs, and listened to the tea customers chatting about the Seven Star Lottery while eating. After the meal, he paid the bill and walked home. On the way he met an old woman selling vegetables, and arrived home at nearly 8:45.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Datie Laoba Tea House on Binya Road

name: Walked with my wife to the lecture venue
description: After arriving home and having a brief rest, he met up with his wife Wang Lijuan, who had already prepared breakfast for the children. The two went out together, locked the door, and walked to the Jinmao Street Community Health Service Center. On the way, they greeted the security guard, Old Wu, and he deliberately slowed his pace to match his wife's. After about a 22-minute walk, they arrived at the meeting room on the second floor.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center.

name: Attend the public lecture "How to Communicate with Adolescent Children"
description: The lecture was held in the conference room on the second floor of the community health service center, and the room was full of parents. The expert explained adolescent psychology with accessible cases, emphasized the communication skill of 'listen first, speak second,' and gave examples of how parents should react when their child gets a low score. Both were deeply moved. Wang Lijuan carefully took down the key points, and Lu Mingqiang silently remembered the idea of 'listen to the child first.'
location: Conference Room, 2nd Floor, Community Health Service Center, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The whole family went to Wanlv Garden to fly kites and ran into a friend.
description: After the lecture, the two walked home to pick up the two children, then drove to Evergreen Park. On the large lawn, Lu Mingqiang handed the big sand-swallow kite to his son Xuanxuan, and the kite quickly caught the wind and flew steadily. Hanhan ran and played on the grass. Since his waist had not healed, he could only stand to the side and direct. During this time, they happened to meet an old friend, A Jie, who had also brought his daughter to the park. The two chatted briefly; A Jie invited him to play squash, but Lu Mingqiang politely declined, citing his waist injury as a reason to recover.
location: The big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch near Wanlv Park.
description: After the children played until they were tired and hungry, the family drove to the small shop “Awen Hainan Noodles” opposite the west gate of Wanlv Park. Each ordered a bowl of Hainan rice noodles with sea snail soup, and Wang Lijuan added a braised egg to share with the children. During the meal, they talked about Ajie's invitation to play ball, and his wife reminded him to focus on letting his back recover first.
location: Awen Hainan Noodles Shop, opposite the west gate of Wanlv Garden, Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Stop for shopping on the way home
description: After the meal, remembering that the cooking wine and salt at home were almost used up, he drove to the Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store near the Haixiu Expressway. Wang Lijuan took the children to buy snacks nearby, while Lu Mingqiang quickly went into the store and bought two bottles of Haitian cooking wine and a bag of salt. Afterward, the family returned to their home in Banshan Garden, and the children each went to bed for their afternoon nap.

The two worked together to cut off the damaged wire, strip and crimp it, tighten it, and carefully wrap three layers of insulating tape. After testing the insulation and load and finding them normal, they closed the switch at 11:00 to restore power to the whole building. They then observed for more than ten minutes to confirm stability, briefed Director Wang on follow-up precautions, and left a business card. The task was successfully completed.
