name: Morning equipment inspection and skill exchange
description: After arriving at my post, I changed into work clothes. Team leader Zhang Tou assigned me to inspect the box transformer on the east side of the industrial park and the underground cables. I led apprentice Zhao Qiang for on-site teaching, explaining how to check for hot spots on the busbar. During the break, I discussed the reliability of the electrician certification question bank with colleague Chen Jianguo by the water dispenser. Chen Jianguo suggested asking my father for the latest official textbook. During work, I used my phone to take a photo of the nameplate on the power distribution cabinet for study in the evening.
location: Electrical distribution room and office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: After work, he walked with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant outside the park. Chen Jianguo recommended the signature braised beef brisket rice. During the meal, he mentioned that his relative works at the Provincial Technician College and could help find out details about the senior electrician certificate practical exam. Lu Mingqiang kept this in mind.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and discussing evening plans with his wife
description: Returned to the company lounge and took a half-hour nap on the folding bed. After waking up, he sent a WeChat message to his wife Wang Lijuan to confirm the plan to take the children to his parents' home for dinner that evening, asked her to buy fruit, and arranged that he would pick up the children and go straight to his parents' home.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon work and electricity meter verification
description: In the afternoon, as arranged by team leader Zhang, I inspected the high-voltage distribution room on the west side and assisted the monitoring room in checking meter data. I led Zhao Qiang to record item by item, corrected his recording errors, and emphasized carefulness. Before knocking off, I called my wife to confirm picking up the kids and to make sure the eldest son brought all his homework so Grandpa wouldn't ask.
location: Power distribution room and monitoring room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the child and head to the parents' home.
description: After work, he drove immediately, first picking up his second son Lu Zihan at Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then going to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his eldest son Lu Zixuan. On the way, he told Zixuan to be polite at grandpa's house and not to play with his phone. The two legs of the trip took about 22 minutes in total, then he drove about 18 minutes to his parents' home in Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Area. The children carried the fruit their wife had bought and went upstairs first.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Had dinner and family talk at his parents' home.
description: As soon as he entered, his mother Chen Xiuying came up to take his things, and his father brought out winter melon and pork bone soup. At the table, his father Lu Jianguo stressed the importance of obtaining the senior technician certification and had prepared the latest electronic version of the question bank. Lu Mingqiang drank two bowls of soup and listened attentively. His eldest son Lu Zixuan shared the good news of getting an A in math, and his grandfather happily put a chicken leg on his plate. The second son Lu Zihan also ate obediently. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang helped clean up. In the study, his father copied the question bank to a USB drive and urged him to read at least two chapters every week.
location: Parents' home in the South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan residential complex, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Return to his own home
description: Said goodbye to his parents, and the whole family drove back to Banshan Garden. The second son, Lu Zihan, fell asleep in the car seat. His wife, Wang Lijuan, softly urged Lu Mingqiang to take the certification exam seriously. They arrived after about an 18-minute drive.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening parent-child time and family reading
description: After arriving home, his wife took their second son Lu Zihan to bathe, while Lu Mingqiang urged their oldest son Lu Zixuan to pack his schoolbag for the next day. After Zihan finished bathing, Lu Mingqiang accompanied him in evening parent-child reading. They read the picture book Guess How Much I Love You together, acting out the movements while reading aloud, and Zihan happily imitated. Lu Mingqiang recorded a short video and posted it to the class group as a check-in, capturing a warm moment.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Evening rehabilitation exercises and recording.
description: After the children fell asleep, he laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 20 reps each of evening superman exercises and glute bridges. The movements were easy, and he felt almost no discomfort in his waist. After the workout, he noted in his notebook that the first phase of rehabilitation had officially concluded, and wrote down the plan for next week: add 5 minutes of dynamic stretching and increase the volume to 25 reps each, then marked it with an asterisk and the date.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Studied relay protection setting calculation by himself.
description: After washing up, he went into the study, plugged the USB drive his father had given him into the computer, opened the question bank, and studied relay protection setting calculation alongside the textbook. He derived the distance protection setting process step by step, filled a page of scratch paper, and tried the exercises at the end of the lesson. He calculated the first problem three times before he understood how the coefficient value was obtained. The second problem was solved smoothly. After checking the answers and finding them all correct, he felt a strong sense of achievement.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and couple communication.
description: I closed the textbook, washed up briefly, and returned to the bedroom, where I discussed the next day's Saturday plans with my wife Wang Lijuan: in the morning I would help the property management inspect the public lighting circuits, and my wife would take our second son to the vegetable market. After confirming everything, I turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Getting up and morning relaxation
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, the light coming through the curtain gap woke me up. It looked a bit gloomy outside, but it wasn't raining; it felt around 16 or 17 degrees. I didn't do rehabilitation last night, but my lower back felt okay, without that stiff soreness. I lay in bed for a while out of habit, hearing Juanzi in the living room talking to Hanhan, and from Xuanxuan's room the quiet sound of memorizing English words. I stretched, felt pretty energetic, got up, and put on a long-sleeved T-shirt and casual pants.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and weekend chit-chat.
description: After washing up, I went to the dining room. Juanzi had already set out breakfast: steaming Hainan rice noodles topped with pickled vegetables, peanuts, and garlic oil, with a poached egg on top — delicious. Xuanxuan said while eating that he was almost done reviewing math, and wanted to write the weekend homework first and play in the afternoon. Hanhan was using her little spoon to poke at the noodles in her bowl, muttering, "The crocodile is scared, the dentist is scared," which made me laugh. I said to Xuanxuan, "Alright, you finish your math homework first; this afternoon the three of us will go for a walk in Wanlu Garden." Juanzi chimed in, "Then I'll take them to Jinlong Road vegetable market to buy some food, and make you steamed fish tonight."
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare tools and go to the property management office
description: After breakfast, he helped put the dishes away in the kitchen, then went back to the bedroom and changed into his work uniform, which was somewhat faded from washing. He went through the multimeter, electrical tape, Phillips screwdriver, and pliers in his tool bag to make sure everything was there. He called out to Juanzi, 'I'm going to the property management office to help Director Wang check the wiring. I'll be back soon.' He went downstairs, strolled along the tree-lined path in the residential compound, and reached the property management office in five minutes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the Banshan Garden Community Property Management Office.

name: Volunteered to help the property management inspect and repair wiring.
description: When I got to the property management office, Director Wang was already waiting at the door, a cup of tea in hand. I waved my hand and said, 'Let's get to work first; we'll have tea after we finish.' He led me to Building 7, saying the hallway lights had been flickering on and off these past few days. I opened the hallway distribution box and first measured the incoming and outgoing line voltages with a multimeter, finding that the voltage on one phase line was low. Looking more closely, the terminal was oxidized and blackened, and there was a loose connection. I asked Director Wang to turn off the main breaker, then set to work: I tightened the terminal with a screwdriver, re-stripped the wires, crimped them, and wrapped them with several turns of electrical tape. After that, I proactively checked the public distribution boxes in the two adjacent units as well, found a loose ground wire, and tightened it while I was at it. In total, I worked for almost fifty minutes. Director Wang thanked me repeatedly and insisted on giving me a pack of Furongwang cigarettes. I declined a few times, but seeing how sincere he was, I accepted. I felt quite good—helping with a small favor, and others remember your kindness.
location: Distribution box in the hallway, Building 7, Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Going home and talking with family
description: After returning home, Juanzi and the children were about to go out to buy groceries. I put the pack of cigarettes Director Wang had given me on the table. Juanzi glanced at it and said with a smile, "Oh, another 'favor fee'?" I chuckled and said, "Just helping a neighbor out; they were being polite." Hanhan ran over and hugged my leg, refusing to let me leave. I bent down, picked him up, spun him around, and said to Xuanxuan, "Do your homework properly at home. I'll take you out for some fresh air this afternoon." I watched them out the door, and the house suddenly became quiet.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal Study and Organizing Materials
description: In the study, I turned on the computer and first logged into the power technology forum to browse. I read several posts about zero-sequence current protection; the technical points were quite deep, and I pondered them for a long time. Then I remembered the USB drive my dad gave me last night. I plugged it in and looked at it. The folders inside were clearly organized: "Safety Regulations," "Basics," and "Electrical Tests," with all the question bank files in them. I plan to start from next week, spending an hour a day systematically going through the material, and strive to get the senior technician certificate this year. I also went through the questions I hadn't understood from last night's relay protection notes, highlighted them, and planned to post them on the forum in the evening to ask the experts for advice.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go out to buy qingbuliang.
description: After sitting in the study for an hour, he felt a bit thirsty. Remembering that he was going to Evergreen Park in the afternoon, he thought he could bring two bowls of qingbuliang to drink. He changed into sneakers, left the residential complex, strolled along Jinlong Road for about ten minutes, and found the sweet soup stall at Old Chen's that he often went to. He bought three bowls of qingbuliang with coconut milk and taro, packed them separately: one for Juanzi, one for himself in the afternoon, and one for Xuanxuan to try. He picked up the bag and walked home slowly.
location: Roadside sweet soup stall on Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped prepare lunch and interacted with family
description: When I got home, Juanzi and the others had also come back from buying groceries. I washed my hands, went into the kitchen, and helped trim the water spinach and clean the shrimp. Juanzi said lunch would be simple: blanched shrimp, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and lean pork stir-fried with pickled mustard. Xuanxuan was putting together his block battleship in the living room, while Hanhan was "making trouble" beside him, placing a little figure on the battleship. I put the Qingbuliang in the fridge and said to Juanzi, "We'll take this to Evergreen Park this afternoon."
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: The four of us sat around the table for lunch. I picked a big shrimp for Xuanxuan; while eating, he explained how he solved his math homework from the morning. I listened and praised his clear logic. Hanhan scooped rice with a spoon and made a mess everywhere. Juanzi and I looked at each other and laughed. Juanzi asked whether we should go to her parents' house tomorrow, Sunday. I said yes, and I could take the opportunity to report on my learning progress from the USB drive her dad gave me. After the meal, Hanhan followed Juanzi around like a little tail while she cleared the dishes.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: Returned to the bedroom and set an alarm for 13:40. Lay down and rested with eyes closed; my lower back felt okay. The weekend nap was sound. When the alarm went off, I got up feeling fully refreshed.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handle the kite repair.
description: I remembered that the butterfly kite we flew at Wanlu Garden last time had a few broken bamboo struts that had never been fixed. I took it out of the storage cabinet and looked carefully: three bamboo struts were snapped, and another had a crack. I crouched down, thinking I would try to carve a new bamboo strip to replace it, but I had only been bent over for less than two minutes when a dull ache spread across my lower back. I quickly straightened up and thought, forget it, don't be stubborn — my back had just recovered, and I shouldn't make it worse. I took close-up photos of the damaged parts with my phone and sent them to the Haikou kite enthusiasts' WeChat group with the message: "A Jie, everyone, the bamboo struts on my kite are broken. Is there a good way to fix it without bending over?" Within five minutes, A Jie replied with a voice message saying hot glue sticks would work, and he also recommended the hardware store model. I replied, "Got it, thanks bro," and decided to wait until my back was completely fine next week before repairing it.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing by the lake at Wanlv Park
description: I took the qingbuliang out of the fridge, grabbed my folding chair and that old fishing rod (mainly as a prop). Went downstairs and drove, along Binhai Avenue for about fifteen minutes until I reached Wanlv Park. There were quite a few people in the park today — some flying kites, some running around with kids. I found a shady lawn by the lake, set up the folding chair, put the qingbuliang beside me, and sat down, staring blankly at the sparkling lake. A gentle breeze blew by — really pleasant. In the middle of that, Juanzi sent a WeChat message saying Xuanxuan was almost done with his homework, and I replied, “Great, have him finish and then we'll head out.” I sat for an hour and a half, finished the qingbuliang, and felt calm inside. I was thinking that next week I could add a bit more to the rehabilitation training, and Xuanxuan's review plan also needed to be refined a bit.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going home and helping prepare dinner
description: Packed up the folding chairs and fishing rods, and drove home. Parked the car after arriving, and went upstairs. Juanzi was already busy in the kitchen. I washed my hands, saw two tilapia in the sink, rolled up my sleeves, scaled and gutted them, and cleaned them thoroughly. Then I sat in the living room watching Hanhan play with building blocks while Xuanxuan read an extracurricular book nearby, waiting for dinner.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reading with the second son and checking in on the eldest son's review
description: I sat on the play mat and helped Hanhan build a little block train. He was so happy that he ran around the room holding it, going "chugga-chugga." Then I went into the study, where Xuanxuan was staring blankly at his math workbook. I asked him what was wrong, and he said he was still confused about "equal sharing" in division word problems. I pulled up a small stool and sat next to him, using the blocks he had just played with as an example. I took eight blocks and asked him to share them between two little figures—how many would each get? After that demonstration, his eyes lit up and he said, "I get it, it's four!" I gave him a few more similar problems and he solved them smoothly. I patted him on the shoulder and said, "Good job. After dinner, do two more problems to reinforce it."
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner time
description: Dinner was plentiful. Juanzi had made steamed tilapia, stir-fried pork with peppers, and tomato and egg soup. I picked up a piece of fish with my chopsticks; it was tender and fresh, and I couldn't help praising Juanzi for getting better and better at cooking. Xuanxuan was also busy picking food for his mother. With rice in her mouth, Hanhan imitated the way I drank coconut at Evergreen Park, tilting her head back and going 'glug, glug', which made the whole family laugh. After dinner, I took out the qingbuliang I had bought in the afternoon from the fridge, one bowl for each person. Hanhan ate while saying, 'The one Dad bought is delicious!'
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Walking and relaxing
description: After dinner and tidying up, Juanzi said she was stuffed and needed to go downstairs for a walk to digest. The two of us strolled slowly around the neighborhood, chatting about watching people fly kites in Wanlv Park that afternoon, as well as my study plans and the arrangements to go to my parents' house tomorrow. I said I wanted to bring some fruit and nutritional products over, and Juanzi said okay, we'd buy them at the market tomorrow morning. After walking for about half an hour, it was getting dark, so we went home.
location: Internal road of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Power technology forum discussion and collection trading.
description: After returning home, I went into my study. I first opened the electrical power technology forum, organized the questions I had been mulling over about zero-sequence current protection into a post, and published a new thread in the "Relay Protection" section, titled "Questions on the Influence of Load Current on Zero-Sequence Compensation in Zero-Sequence Current Protection." After posting, I browsed the "Newbie Help Zone" and saw someone ask, "What should I do if the outlet at home trips whenever a high-power appliance is used?" I replied in detail with the possible causes (overload, short circuit, leakage) and troubleshooting steps. Then I switched to the liquor bottle collecting forum and saw that "Haikou Lao Chen" had just listed that 1990s Haikou Daqu liquor bottle. It was in good condition, so I immediately left a message to negotiate the price. Lao Chen quickly replied, saying the minimum price was 360 yuan. I readily agreed, and we arranged to meet in person next Saturday afternoon at the Datie Laoba Tea Shop. With that coveted item settled, I was in a great mood. I browsed a few more posts and admired several old liquor bottles.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-Child Reading and Check-In
description: After washing up, Hanhan was already sitting on the bed holding the book The Crocodile and the Dentist. I leaned against the headboard and read to him in an exaggerated tone, imitating the inner monologues of the crocodile and the dentist: “The crocodile thought, ‘Do I really have to go see the dentist?’ The dentist thought, ‘Do I really have to treat this crocodile?’” Hanhan laughed so hard he rocked back and forth, and he repeated “scared, scared” along with me. I recorded a 1-minute video and sent it to the kindergarten class group to check in, with the caption: “Hanhan’s favorite bedtime story, Day 6.” After hearing it twice, he still didn't want to sleep, so I played a finger game with him for a while, then kissed his forehead and turned off the light.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Chat with wife and preliminary plan for tomorrow
description: Back in the master bedroom, Juanzi was already lying down looking at her phone. I told her about successfully acquiring the liquor bottle. She smiled and said, "Spent another few hundred yuan on an 'old antique'—are you planning to make it a family heirloom?" I said, "Put it on top of the bookshelf; it's also a keepsake." Then we talked about going to my parents' place tomorrow and decided to leave at 9 a.m., first going to the market to buy some fruit and supplements, then driving straight to the parents' home in Meilan District. I also mentioned that I would start increasing the amount of rehabilitation training next week. Juanzi advised, "Then don't push yourself these days. Take care and don't throw your back out again." Before turning off the light, I looked out the window—the wind had eased, so tomorrow should be a nice day.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and going to bed
description: He took a quick rinse and lay back in bed. He scrolled through his phone for a while, checked the replies to new forum posts, and then looked at messages in his son's kindergarten class group. Before long, drowsiness set in, and he turned off the light at 22:45. Today was quite fulfilling—he helped the neighbors, secured a treasured item for his collection, played with the kids in the evening, and took a walk with his wife. Helping others is helping yourself, and he felt at ease. Tomorrow would be another new day.
location: Room 203, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early rising and morning run
description: Woke up naturally at 6 in the morning and moved his waist in bed, feeling recovery was good. Got up quietly without waking his sleeping wife Juanzi. After washing up, changed into sportswear and old running shoes, sent a WeChat message to running partner Chen Bin to meet up, then drank warm water and prepared for the morning run. At 6:30, met Chen Bin at the entrance of Baishamen Park. Chen Bin led a thorough dynamic warm-up before the run, especially targeting the waist and abdomen. Then they jogged along the park trail, keeping the pace at around 6:30 per kilometer, with Chen Bin encouraging him from time to time. After finishing the 5-kilometer run, his body felt relaxed. After the run, Chen Bin taught him two new stretching exercises and suggested replacing the worn running shoes to protect his lower back and knees. Lu Mingqiang promised to buy new shoes in a couple of days.
location: Baishamen Park, No. 68 Renmin Avenue, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; before the morning run, departed from and returned home at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Going home, taking a shower, and having breakfast
description: Just after 8, he came home from a run, forehead sweaty. He took a shower in the bathroom and changed into a clean set of loungewear. By the time he came out, his wife Juanzi had prepared breakfast: lean pork congee, fried eggs, and pineapple buns. The family sat down to eat. He peeled an egg for Hanhan, and Xuanxuan showed off the painting he had made last night. At the table, Lu Mingqiang told Juanzi that he would go have tea with Chen Jianguo in the afternoon to talk about the certificate exam, then go straight to his parents' place, and asked her to have herself and the kids ready before 5.
location: At home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning chores and study
description: After the meal, he cleared the dishes, then went to the balcony to repair the Calabash Brothers kite that had been interrupted last week due to his back injury. He sanded the bamboo joints, re-bound and fixed them with fishing line, and reinforced weak points with waterproof tape. After more than half an hour of work, the kite frame looked brand new. Then he returned to the study, tidied the cluttered desk, and sorted the relay protection setting calculation exercises and the mistake notebook. Next, he opened the textbook “Advanced Electrical Technology” and used a highlighter to mark key points in the chapters “Electrical Safety Regulations” and “Common Fault Analysis” to prepare for the evening's systematic review.
location: Balcony and study at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: Juanzi made his favorite white-poached shrimp and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The family ate and chatted. Xuanxuan mentioned he was a bit nervous about next week's final exams. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him, saying the questions were all things he had learned before; for example, his good math score last time came from solid review. He also told him to listen to his mother and review carefully while Dad was away in the afternoon. Hanhan wanted to hear "The Little Black Fish," and Lu Mingqiang promised to tell it when he came back in the evening.
location: Dining room at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: Feeling drowsy after the meal, I went into the bedroom, set my phone alarm to 14:10, lay down, and slept for 45 minutes. The peaceful Sunday afternoon let my body fully relax.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and head to the tea shop after the midday rest
description: The alarm went off. He got up, washed his face, and felt much more refreshed. He changed into going-out clothes and packed the test-question USB drive his father had given him and his notebook into a canvas bag. At 14:10, he put on his helmet and rode his electric bike from Banshan Garden, turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Binya Road, and arrived at the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road, Longhua District, after about 15 minutes.
location: Datie Old Man's Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province — en route cycling here from home at Half Mountain Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Drank tea with workmates and formed an exam preparation alliance.
description: At 3 p.m., met co-worker Chen Jianguo at a tea shop. The shop was lively, so the two found a corner seat and each ordered a pot of black tea and two servings of coconut cakes. Lu Mingqiang took out his exam prep notes, and Chen Jianguo shared the key points from when he got his certificate and his experience with the practical exam, noting that the old question bank was outdated but the core principles had not changed, and wrote down a few key points in the notebook. The two agreed to set aside time every Sunday to exchange ideas and keep each other motivated, forming a study alliance. The two-plus hours of discussion were very rewarding.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the family and head to my parents' home.
description: After leaving the tea shop, he first cycled home to pick up Juanzi and the two children, who were already ready. Then they all got into their own car and drove along North Longkun Road toward his parents' house. On the way, Hanhan asked where they were going, and Lu Mingqiang said they were going to Grandma's house, and Grandma had made lots of delicious food.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Area, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; on the way, after picking someone up from home at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, drove here.

name: Visiting parents and family dinner
description: Arrived at his parents' home. His mother, Chen Xiuying, was busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice hit him as soon as he entered; his father, Lu Jianguo, was sitting on the sofa drinking tea and reading the newspaper, beaming when he saw his grandson. After sitting down, Lu Mingqiang told his father that this morning's 5 km run left his waist completely pain-free; his father was pleased and reminded him to build up gradually. During the meal, he told his father about forming an exam-prep alliance with Jianguo; his father was very happy, immediately sent the electronic link to the latest advanced electrician exam question bank, and urged him to exchange ideas with experienced people, focusing on fault analysis and practical questions. The family laughed and talked, spending a warm evening together.
location: At parents' home, South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Returning home and evening preparations
description: At 19:30, he said goodbye to his parents, and the family of four drove home. After getting home, Juanzi washed the children's hands and changed their clothes, while Lu Mingqiang backed up the question bank his father gave him to the computer and tidied the desk in the study to prepare for the evening review.
location: At home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening electrical theory review.
description: Sit down at the desk and brew a cup of tea. Open the question bank sent by his father, first systematically browse the table of contents, then focus on studying the two major chapters "Electrical Safety Specifications" and "Common Fault Analysis" against the textbook. He used pens of different colors to mark and annotate in the notebook, especially pondering the key points combining practice and theory such as "Troubleshooting Common Transformer Faults" and "High-Voltage Cabinet Operating Specifications", and wrote down his own understanding.
location: Home study, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child reading time
description: The alarm clock in the study rang; Lu Mingqiang closed his book and walked into Hanhan's room. Hanhan had already bathed and was lying in bed smelling fresh, holding up Swimmy. Leaning against the headboard, Lu Mingqiang told the story vividly in Mandarin with a Hainanese accent. When he reached the part where Swimmy organized all the little fish into one giant fish, Hanhan's eyes went wide and he said, Dad, they are so amazing! After finishing, Lu Mingqiang kissed Hanhan on the forehead, took a photo of father and son reading together with his phone, and uploaded it as required in the class group, completing the seventh day of the reading check-in.
location: Hanhan's room, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and casual chat.
description: After coming out of Hanhan's room, he went to the bathroom to wash up. Juanzi had just finished the housework, and the two lay in bed. Lu Mingqiang briefly shared what he had gained today from getting the question bank from his father and from exchanging with Jianguo. Juanzi said it was easier to keep going when two people studied together. They also chatted a bit about Hanhan's upcoming birthday. The day felt fulfilling and solid.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: He turned off his phone and set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning. Today he had done everything well—exercise, meeting friends, visiting relatives, and studying—so he felt especially happy. He turned to his side, said goodnight to Juanzi, closed his eyes, and slowly fell asleep feeling content and at peace.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning wake-up
description: The alarm went off on time. Mingqiang turned over and got up, first doing some simple activities by the bedside to loosen his lower back, and it felt good. While washing up, he heard his wife Juanzi preparing breakfast in the kitchen. While brushing his teeth, he quickly browsed two wiring diagrams from the advanced electrician hands-on group chat that he hadn't finished reading last night, and mentally went through the process.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking care of children, breakfast, and family time.
description: Mingqiang woke Xuanxuan and Hanhan and urged them to wash up and change clothes. At the dining table, his wife Juanzi served steaming white congee, fried eggs, milk, and barbecue pork buns. Hearing Xuanxuan say that the school would select civilized little role models today, Mingqiang said a few words of encouragement. Hanhan played with his spoon while drinking milk, and Mingqiang wiped him clean. The family enjoyed a warm breakfast together.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, home dining room

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: After packing the kids' schoolbags, Mingqiang left on time by car at 7:15. First he took Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School and watched him walk through the school gate; then he turned around and took Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. On the way, he looped an audio from the Xinde Electrician Forum in the car, heard a case about PLC fault troubleshooting, found it very useful, and planned to write it down in the evening.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, first go to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City.

name: Commute and preparation for work
description: After dropping off the children, Mingqiang drove west along Binhai Avenue and arrived at the company's Hainan Elevator Accessory Industrial Park in about 18 minutes. He parked the electric bike, signed in at the guard room, picked up the day's work plan and safety helmet, and walked into the workshop where he saw his coworker Jianguo already checking tools.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: power distribution cabinet inspection and safety course study.
description: Team leader Zhang arranged a routine inspection and maintenance of the three high-voltage distribution cabinets on the east side of the factory area. Mingqiang led his co-worker Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang through the process, checking busbar temperature, switch operation, and instrument parameters. During the work break, Mingqiang used the 15-minute water break to open the safety production training app on his phone, tapped on the video about safety standards for working at heights, put on earphones, and noted key points such as safety harness anchor points and ladder anti-slip measures in his notebook.
location: Power distribution room in the company factory area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and discussion about exam preparation
description: Mingqiang and Jianguo went to the usual place, Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, for lunch. He ordered spicy soup rice, and Jianguo ordered dry-fried beef river noodles. While eating, Mingqiang pulled up the question bank his father had given him and, while chewing, quickly went through 30 multiple-choice questions. When he came across a question about relay setting that he was uncertain about, he immediately asked Jianguo. Jianguo took his phone and explained the thinking behind it, helping him sort out the problem.
location: Yangtianhe Pharmacy No. 110, 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant)

name: Lunch break and online question bank practice.
description: After eating, he returned to the company break room. Mingqiang lay down on the folding bed, first opened his phone and carefully worked through the 10 wrong questions he had just marked. Seeing the screen show he had answered them correctly, he felt much more at ease. Later, feeling sleepy, he set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, closed his eyes, and rested for about 40 minutes.
location: Company break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: emergency repair and continued safety course
description: Just after starting work in the afternoon, Boss Zhang notified that the main switch in the area of his parents' home kept tripping and needed support. Mingqiang, Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang immediately brought their tools and drove to the South Section of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan. After arriving, Mingqiang found the distribution room as if familiar with the place, used a multimeter to check each circuit, and found that a leakage protector in one household was broken. After replacing it, the fault was eliminated. On the way back to the company, he watched another 15 minutes of work safety videos in the car and completed the first chapter.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After work, went home and bought qingbuliang on the way
description: After clocking out, Mingqiang rode his electric bike and took a detour along Haisheng Road to find the Qingbuliang shop called Coconut Water that he had found earlier. The shop was small, with tables and chairs set outside. He parked, ordered four portions to go. The owner cheerfully put plenty of coconut water, red beans, Job's tears, watermelon, and taro balls into the bag. Mingqiang rode home carrying the heavy bag in a good mood.
location: Coconut Water Qingbuliang, 2-11 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and sharing with family
description: When Mingqiang arrived home, his wife Juanzi had already picked up Xuanxuan and Hanhan. For dinner, Juanzi made sweet-and-sour pork ribs, which Xuanxuan loved, and steamed egg custard, which Hanhan loved. Mingqiang served the qingbuliang to everyone, saying it was a surprise he tried on the way home from work today. The children cheered. Juanzi tasted it and praised it as authentic. The family chatted about fresh stories from school and work, and the atmosphere was relaxed and happy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, home dining room

name: Quality time with the kids: helping with homework and reading together
description: After dinner, Mingqiang first checked Xuanxuan's math homework. When he found that Xuanxuan was stuck on the approach to a word problem, he used the line-segment drawing method his father had taught him to guide him step by step, and Xuanxuan quickly understood it. Then he led Hanhan to the living room sofa and read Grandpa Always Has a Way to her. When the grandfather turned the old blanket into a coat, a vest, and a tie, Hanhan's eyes widened. Finally, imitating the story, she said, "Grandpa has a way!" Mingqiang recorded a video and completed the Day 8 check-in on the Class Little Steward app.
location: Living room/study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening personal study: reviewing key points for the practical exam
description: While the children were washing up and Juanzi was tidying up the house, Mingqiang returned to the study, opened the question bank software his father had given him, and focused on the practical part. He chose a simulation exercise on "Wiring a forward-reverse control circuit for a three-phase asynchronous motor." The software's 3D wiring panel let him select contactors, thermal relays, and buttons step by step on the screen, and tap the terminals with his finger to complete the connections. The system automatically scored it afterward. This process was more intuitive than just looking at drawings, and it also made him realize a small misunderstanding he had about self-locking circuits, which he quickly noted down.
location: Home study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Washing up, relaxing, and chatting as a couple.
description: Feeling a bit tired from studying, Mingqiang got up to stretch his limbs and took a hot shower to relieve the day's fatigue. When he returned to the bedroom, Juanzi was already lying down. While drying his hair, he told her about the taste of tonight's qingbuliang and also talked about Xuanxuan wanting to be a Little Pacesetter. Juanzi said that tomorrow the community would be conducting a door-to-door survey and she might be late picking up the children. Mingqiang said no problem—he would pick up Hanhan first after work.
location: At home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After exchanging goodnights with Juanzi, Mingqiang turned off the light and lay down. Before going to sleep, he went over in his mind the practical operation points he had reviewed today and the key points from the safety production lesson, confirming that he had completed all of today's goals. Looking at the night view of Haikou outside the window, he felt very calm, set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: At 6 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. Lu Mingqiang turned off the alarm and lay in bed for half a minute to fully wake up, then got out of bed gently without waking his sleeping wife and children. He went into the bathroom, washed his face with cold water to refresh himself, and looked in the mirror. It was overcast today, 15-20 degrees Celsius, so he decided to wear a long-sleeved work uniform.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; home master bedroom and bathroom

name: Prepare breakfast for the family.
description: After changing into his work clothes, Lu Mingqiang entered the kitchen. He set the rice cooker to cook plain congee on a timer, took out the barbecue pork buns bought yesterday from the refrigerator and put them in the steamer, then took half a bag of pickled mustard tubers from the storage cabinet, cut them, and put them on a plate. This way, when his wife Wang Lijuan got up, she only needed to heat the buns and scoop the congee, and could have breakfast with the children. Lu Mingqiang himself was used to eating Hainan noodles on the way, so he did not eat at home.
location: Home kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the second son to kindergarten
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the second bedroom to wake up his second son Lu Zihan and helped him put on his coat and shoes. Zihan was a little reluctant to get up, so Lu Mingqiang coaxed him, saying, 'If you don't get up now, the little kitten at the kindergarten gate will run away.' Only then did Zihan dawdle out the door with him. He got on his electric scooter and arrived at Jinmao Center Kindergarten in about five minutes, handed Zihan to the teacher, and only left after confirming that the child had entered the kindergarten.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou.

name: Take the eldest son to school.
description: When he got home after taking his younger son to school, his elder son Lu Zixuan had already washed up, put on his backpack, and was waiting at the door. Today Zixuan was on duty at school, so he urged his father to hurry. Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike with Zixuan straight to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, a ride of about 10 minutes. On the way he told Zixuan: “Don't be lazy with your duty today. Sweep the floor clean.” When they arrived at the school gate, he watched Zixuan run into school with his classmates, then turned the bike around to buy his own breakfast.
location: From near Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten in Longhua District, Haikou, return to Banshan Garden residential area to pick up the eldest son, then go to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou.

name: Buying breakfast and commuting
description: On his usual route to the company, Lu Mingqiang stopped at the familiar “A Jie Hainan Noodles” stall. The proprietress recognized him. He ordered a serving of mixed rice noodles with an egg to take away and paid 8 yuan. He hung the Hainan noodles on the handlebars of his e-bike, continued riding for about 10 minutes, and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:38, where he parked and locked the bike.
location: Starting from Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, passing by the “Aje Hainan Rice Noodles” breakfast stall near the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and Guomao Avenue, then heading to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou.

name: Pre-shift preparation and morning meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the company changing room, put on his full work uniform, and checked his safety helmet and tool belt. At 7:45, Squad Leader Zhang called a morning meeting and announced the day's task: go to the newly built Chenhui Garden Community on Yehai Avenue and install eight distribution boxes in Buildings 3 and 6. The squad leader assigned Lu Mingqiang to lead Chen Jianguo and Xiao Zhao, and emphasized that safety belts must be securely hooked at both ends during high-altitude work. Lu Mingqiang accepted the order and began planning the installation sequence in his mind.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; the company's workwear room and meeting room.

name: Morning electrical distribution box installation work
description: The three people carried tools and materials to the construction site at Chenhui Garden Residential Area. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were on the roof, responsible for fixing the brackets and installing the distribution box enclosure, while Xiao Zhao below passed up materials and embedded the grounding wire. While waiting for materials during a work break, Lu Mingqiang took out his phone and quickly flipped through the lecture notes on temporary electricity safety in the “Safety Production Remote Training” APP, focusing on the key knowledge of “three-level power distribution and two-level protection.”
location: Construction site of Buildings 3 and 6, Chenhui Garden Residential Community, Yehai Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to lunch spot
description: They finished the morning's work early, so Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo rode their e-bikes directly to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road, a ride of about 15 minutes. On the way, Lu Mingqiang talked about last night's advanced electrician mock exam, complaining that his accuracy on relay protection setting calculations was only 60 percent. Chen Jianguo comforted him with his own practical experience and suggested memorizing the commonly used coefficients and plugging them into the formulas, which made Lu Mingqiang's thinking a bit clearer.
location: From Chenhui Garden Residential Community, Yedai Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, to the Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City.

name: Lunch and studying the work safety course.
description: The two each ordered a signature spicy soup rice with Chinese sausage. While eating, Lu Mingqiang propped his phone on the table, put on Bluetooth earphones, and continued watching the video of Chapter 2, "Safety of Temporary Electricity Use on Construction Sites," of the Work Safety course. The content covered the TN-S system principle and the selection of residual current devices. His colleague Chen Jianguo did not disturb him. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang directly took the after-class quiz, got 2 out of 10 questions wrong, and felt he had basically mastered the knowledge points.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou (First floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road).

name: Midday nap and return to the company.
description: After the meal, he returned to the company employee lounge, a drive of about 15 minutes. Lu Mingqiang leaned back in the seat and rested with his eyes closed for about ten minutes, mentally reviewing the afternoon work plan: complete the wiring of the distribution box in Building 6 and check the grounding resistance. Then he thought about the wrong questions he would review that evening, and gradually drifted into a restful state.
location: From Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant to the employee rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon work (installation finishing and inspection)
description: The construction continued at Chenhui Garden Community in the afternoon. As planned, the team completed the internal wiring of Building No. 6 and the last two distribution boxes. Lu Mingqiang used a multimeter to test the insulation resistance and ground resistance of each outgoing circuit one by one, ensuring the data were within safe ranges. At about 3 p.m., he found time to call Foreman Zhang, asking to leave five minutes early to go to the telecom business office on Jinmao Road to renew his broadband. The foreman agreed.
location: Construction site of Buildings 6 and 3, Chenhui Garden Community, Yehai Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Finished work early and commuted.
description: At 16:50, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to his colleagues, packed up his tools, and rode his electric bike away from the construction site. He rode along Yehai Avenue and Longkun South Road toward Jinmao Road, a ride of about 30 minutes. There was some traffic on the way, but he estimated that the business hall closed at 5:30, so there was still enough time.
location: From Chenhui Garden Residential Area, Yehai Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, to China Telecom Business Hall, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou.

name: Handle broadband contract renewal
description: After parking the car, he walked into the service hall, where there were not many people. Lu Mingqiang went straight to the counter, showed the agent the package screenshot on his phone, and said he wanted to upgrade to the gigabit converged package and get a gigabit router. The agent took his ID card, processed the transaction in the system, and after confirming the rates and contract period, Lu Mingqiang signed to confirm. The whole process took less than fifteen minutes, and he walked out with the new router box.
location: China Telecom Business Hall, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home to rest
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike for about 10 minutes back to his home in Banshan Garden. Upstairs, as he opened the door, he smelled the aroma of stir-fried pork with garlic; his wife Wang Lijuan was busy in the kitchen. He put the router on the coffee table, changed out of his work uniform into a home T-shirt and shorts, then went to the kitchen to help bring out bowls and chopsticks and set the table.
location: Starting from the China Telecom business hall on Jinmao Middle Road, return to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family interaction and dinner preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang was in the kitchen helping his wife. Wang Lijuan was stir-frying garlicky water spinach and making pork rib and lotus root soup. He asked his wife how her housekeeping work went today. She replied that it was okay, but cleaning the windows was tiring. Then the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, came home from school saying he was hungry, and the second son, Lu Zihan, was brought home by his grandfather. As soon as he entered, he wanted to perform the newly learned children's song Little Swallow. Lu Mingqiang picked up Zihan and told him to wait until Mom finished cooking before performing.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, kitchen and dining room

name: Dinner
description: During dinner, the family sat around the table. The eldest son, Zixuan, complained that the 400-meter run in P.E. class was too tiring. The second son, Zihan, wanted to perform 'Little Swallow' at the dinner table, but his mother persuaded him to eat first. Lu Mingqiang served himself some pork rib soup and told his wife about watching a work safety course video and taking a short quiz at noon. His wife encouraged him to continue reviewing at night. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang cleared the table.
location: Restaurant, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help eldest son with his homework
description: After clearing away the dishes, Lu Mingqiang called his eldest son Zixuan into the study to do math homework, which was a few pages of exercises from 'Mental Arithmetic Pass'. He sat beside him to supervise. When Zixuan got stuck on subtraction with borrowing, Lu Mingqiang explained step by step using the vertical calculation method. Twenty minutes later, Zixuan finished, and Lu Mingqiang checked each problem and signed to confirm.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-Child Reading and Check-In
description: Next was the second son, Zihan. Lu Mingqiang lifted him onto the small bed, took out the picture book A Garden of Vegetables Turned into Spirits, and read it in a clapper-talk rhythm, making Zihan giggle and imitate the vegetables on the bed. His wife Wang Lijuan, after cleaning up the kitchen, leaned against the doorframe, smiling and recording the interaction with her phone. After reading, Lu Mingqiang tapped "Complete" in the check-in mini program.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, second bedroom

name: Advanced electrician simulated self-test and couple's joint study
description: Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son Zixuan to practice calligraphy quietly in the study, while he himself took out the senior electrician mock test questions for self-testing. After finishing the housework, Wang Lijuan made a cup of hot tea, brought it into the study, and sat beside him reading. Lu Mingqiang timed himself with his phone and completed all the questions. When he checked the answers, he found that the wrong questions were mainly about relay protection setting calculation and high-voltage safety regulations. His accuracy was only 60%, and he felt discouraged. Seeing his gloomy expression, his wife Wang Lijuan suggested helping his memory through recitation-based quizzing. The two reviewed the questions with one reading the question and the other reciting the answer. His wife used everyday analogies, such as comparing electric current to water flow and protection settings to sluice gates, to help him understand the difficult points. They spent over an hour going through the wrong questions, and Lu Mingqiang gradually regained confidence.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and going to bed
description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang felt that the difficult points today had been cleared up and his mood improved. He took a hot shower, washed away the fatigue, and changed into pajamas. His wife Wang Lijuan was already in bed looking at her phone. Lu Mingqiang lay down, said goodnight to his wife, felt his eyes grow dry, and drowsiness set in. He turned off the bedside lamp and, before sleep, quickly reviewed tomorrow's plans. Thinking of taking the children to visit his parents on the weekend and having his mother make Hainanese chicken rice, he felt at ease. After adjusting his sleeping position, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom bathroom and bed at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparation and rehabilitation training
description: The alarm went off at 6 a.m. Lu Mingqiang woke up feeling his lower back had eased somewhat. He rolled out his yoga mat and did rehabilitation exercises such as Superman poses, glute bridges, cat stretches, and standing side stretches. 25 minutes later, he took a hot shower and changed into his work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast porridge and steamed buns for him, and packed his lunch bag with shredded pork with green peppers, rice, and an apple.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up his second son Lu Zihan, helped him get dressed, brought char siu bao, and rode an electric bike to take him to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, watching him go inside. Then he returned to Banshan Garden to pick up his eldest son Lu Zixuan, gave him char siu bao and milk, reminded him on the way about the math quiz, and dropped him off at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 7:12.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, via Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

After arriving at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, he parked his bike in the shed and entered the workshop with breakfast and lunch.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District), stopping at Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store (Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District) on the way.

They worked in good coordination, securing the distribution box and connecting the main cable, with Xiao Zhao assisting. By 9:30 the installation was basically complete, and they began testing insulation resistance circuit by circuit with a megger. During the waiting period, Lu Mingqiang used his phone to review the chapters on electrical first aid and fire prevention from the work safety course.

participant.relation: Property management electrician for the residential community.

Lu Mingqiang used the microwave to heat up the shredded pork with green peppers and rice he had brought from home. His fellow worker Chen Jianguo teased that his wife was a good cook. While eating, he finished the last few video questions in the safety production course. After submitting the test, he passed with a score of 85, immediately took a screenshot and sent it to his wife to share the good news.
location: Inside a fast-food restaurant and a small truck near Chenhui Dijing East Zone, No. 6 Changbin West First Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch break and study notes

After the alarm went off, he took out his notebook on "Safety Technical Specifications for High-Voltage Electric Work" and reviewed the relay protection principles his wife had explained the night before using a "water flow metaphor," memorizing key formulas and operating procedures.
location: Workshop rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Finishing up the distribution box installation and on-site cleanup
description: In the afternoon, continued working in the underground power distribution room in the East Zone of Chenhui Dijing. name: Power emergency repair at the sweet soup shop on Guomao Road.
description: At 07:50, Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike with Zhao Qiang to Guomao Road, arriving at the reported "Old Hainan Sweet Soup Shop" around 08:10. After learning about the situation from the shop owner, Lu Mingqiang judged it to be an internal wiring problem. He had Zhao Qiang cut the power and hang a warning sign, while he pulled the main switch and carefully tested with a multimeter. Eventually, in the ceiling junction box, he found severely oxidized wire connections — the copper wire had turned black after stripping, causing excessive contact resistance, overheating, and tripping. Lu Mingqiang skillfully cut off the oxidized section, re-made the connections, tightened them, and wrapped them with insulating tape. Around 09:00, the fault was resolved, and after closing the circuit, the sweet soup shop resumed business. After a quick check to confirm no other hazards, the two set off back to the company at 09:10.
location: Old Hainan Sweet Soup Shop, near the intersection of Guomao Road and Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Master Li patiently answered over the phone, described several similar cases he had handled in his early years, and reminded him to pay attention to tightening the terminals and anti-oxidation treatment. Lu Mingqiang thanked him repeatedly, and after hanging up felt more confident.

location: Company team area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Ran into Uncle Wang after work, helped fix the power outlet, and had tea.
description: At 15:30 he left work on time. Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike home and arrived at the entrance of Banshan Garden community 10 minutes later (15:40). Just after parking, he ran into his neighbor Uncle Wang at the corridor entrance. Uncle Wang immediately asked for help, saying that his kitchen outlet sparked whenever he plugged in the induction cooker. Lu Mingqiang first went home to put down his tool bag, picked up a special screwdriver and electrical tape (15:55), and then went straight to Uncle Wang's home (Building 20, Room 103). He opened the kitchen outlet panel and found that the aluminum wire connection was obviously oxidized and burnt, caused by poor contact. He skillfully cleaned the oxide layer, stripped the wire ends, tightened the terminal posts, and wrapped them with electrical tape. Finally, he used a multimeter to measure grounding and voltage, both normal. Uncle Wang plugged in the induction cooker and tried it; everything worked, and he was so happy he slapped his thigh. After the repair, Uncle Wang brewed kuding tea and pulled him to sit and chat. The two talked about the community exterior wall painting project and their sons' final exam results. After about half an hour, Lu Mingqiang got up and took his leave.
location: Room 103, Building 20, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the corridor

name: Morning work: morning meeting and port maintenance
description: Arriving at the company, he clocked in with his fingerprint at the security gate and changed into a full set of labor protection equipment (safety helmet, insulated shoes, protective gloves). At 8:00 sharp, he attended the team morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang assigned the main task for the day: go to Haikou Port No. 11 Pump Station to replace an aged high-voltage load switch of model FZN21-12. He stressed the operating procedure of power-off, tag-out, and two-person verification, and designated Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo as the primary operators, with Zhao Qiang as safety monitor and assistant. At 08:10, the three drove the company's work pickup truck, departing from the industrial park, traveling east along Haisheng Road, then south along Ganghang Road for about 15 minutes, and arrived at 08:25 at the Haikou Port No. 11 Pump Station on Ganghang Road, Binhai Avenue. After arriving at the pump station, they confirmed the power outage with the shift leader on duty and strictly followed the procedure of power off, voltage test, ground wire installation, and warning sign placement. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo worked in a coordinated division of labor to dismantle the busbar connections and operating mechanism of the old switch. When moving the new switch, Lu Mingqiang paid special attention to keeping his lower back straight while exerting force, and guided Xiao Zhao in using a pry bar and roller bars in coordination. The entire replacement, wiring, and commissioning process took about two hours. At 11:00, the insulation resistance was tested and found qualified, and power was restored after three-party confirmation. After the work was completed, they cleaned up the site and loaded the old equipment, empty packaging, remaining spare parts, and tools onto the pickup truck. The three drove back to the industrial park. On the way, Lu Mingqiang took a few sips of the plain boiled water his wife had poured for him in the morning and moved his sore shoulders. They returned to the company at 11:30.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province   No. 11 Pump Station, Haikou Port, Ganghang Road, Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province   Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

At 12:15 he lay down on the folding bed in the break room, set a 30-minute alarm, closed his eyes and rested, to make sure he had energy for the afternoon.

Lu Mingqiang put down his shopping bags, sat on the living room sofa, and answered. They talked for over 20 minutes. On the other end, Wang Hai excitedly said he had confirmed he would return to Haikou this Spring Festival. Lu Mingqiang immediately decided: "Great! It's settled for the third day of the New Year, my treat at that time-honored grilled fish restaurant on Jiefang West Road!" Wang Hai laughed heartily: "I was waiting for those words! Be there or be square!" After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang felt very happy. He opened his phone photo album and found a photo from a few years ago of him and Wang Hai with their arms around each other's shoulders at the grilled fish restaurant on Jiefang West Road. He cropped it with a click and added the caption: "Old friend, see you on the third day of the New Year! @Wang Hai" and posted it to his Moments. Within a minute, Wang Hai liked it, and then Wu Gang, a fellow worker he knew from the construction site, commented: "Hey, Brother Mingqiang, count me in on the third day too?!" Lu Mingqiang replied with a smile, "Sure thing." Looking at the old photo, he couldn't help reminiscing for a while about funny stories from his youth, and only put down his phone ten minutes later.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He saw the post “Prevention of Terminal Corrosion in Distribution Cabinets,” liked it, and bookmarked it, then took a nap. In the afternoon, he took Xiao Zhao to complete the remaining drawer cabinet insulation tests, and the data passed. Jianguo filled in the maintenance record and signed it. Then he watched cartoons with his two sons for a while, urged them to brush their teeth and wash their faces, and coaxed them to sleep. Then he silently recited the key points of the solid-insulated switchgear learned that day to deepen his memory.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Because he had gone to bed late the past two days studying new teaching materials, his lower back felt a bit tight. He started his daily waist and back rehabilitation training on the bedroom floor mat: first two sets of superman exercises, feeling the stretch in his spine; then two sets of glute bridges to relax his lower back muscles; finally he tried the newly learned dead bug exercise, coordinating hands and feet to stabilize his core. After three sets, his body felt warm. After training, he woke his eldest son Lu Zixuan and told him to change into sports shoes; then he coaxed his second son Lu Zihan out of bed, promising to tell the story of breaking out of the cocoon and becoming a butterfly from "The Very Hungry Caterpillar". While the children washed up, Lu Mingqiang quickly showered and changed into his work clothes, while his wife Wang Lijuan was busy in the kitchen and a steaming breakfast was set on the table.

After handling one room, they went to the next, where Zhao Qiang independently completed the process of power-off, voltage testing, disassembly and replacement, moving deftly. Before 11 o'clock, all faults were eliminated, and the switch was closed and the power test was normal. The hotel owner expressed gratitude. Chen Jianguo shared his own similar experience and the solution from an old master, and suggested that the next time they encountered a similar problem, they could first think it through themselves and ask a more experienced hand if necessary.
