After getting up, he did 15 minutes of back and waist rehabilitation exercises on the bedroom floor, including the superman stretch, glute bridges, and a 50-second plank. He heard his younger son playing with blocks in the living room and knew he was awake. After the exercises, he went to the bathroom for a quick rinse and changed into his work clothes. He checked the two boys' schoolbags and water bottles. His wife Juanzi had already prepared breakfast. He quickly ate two steamed buns and drank a glass of milk. He reminded his elder son Lu Zixuan to remember to bring his calligraphy class materials. At 7:00 he left the house with the two boys on time. Juanzi saw them to the elevator and told them to be careful on the way.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the children to school and buy breakfast.
description: He rode an electric bike with his two sons, first arriving at Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At 7:20 he watched his younger son Zihan walk through the school gate. He then took his elder son Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, arriving at the school gate at 7:35. After telling him to listen carefully in class, he said goodbye. On the way back, he parked at Yanfen Dajia on Xisha Road, Meilan District, and ordered a takeout Hainan rice noodles with pickled cabbage and beef plus a cup of soy milk as an extra meal for today.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, passing Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, and finally arriving at Yanfen Dajia, No. 23 Xisha Road, Meilan District

name: Commute to the Industrial Park
description: Riding an electric bike from Yanfen Dajia, he headed north along Longkun South Road, turned right onto Haisheng Road, and the whole trip took about 10 minutes. He arrived at the industrial park before 8:00, parked the e-bike in the shed, took off his helmet, and felt relieved to see no unread messages on his phone.
location: From Yafen Dajia at No. 23 Xisha Road, Meilan District to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Team morning meeting
description: After changing into work clothes, he went to the workshop for the morning meeting. Team leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks: in the morning, go to Jiangnan Commercial Building in Longhua District to deal with a distribution box that frequently trips; in the afternoon, everyone returns to the warehouse to sort out pre-holiday supplies and maintain tools. He noted the key points and exchanged a look with his partner Jianguo to confirm the division of labor.
location: Overhaul Workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Rush to Jiangnan Commercial Building
description: 8:30 The three of them drove (company pickup truck) to Jiangnan Commercial Building. According to the navigation, the trip was about 17 minutes in total: along Haisheng Road, turn onto Longkun South Road, then turn onto Yilong West Road. On the way, he chatted with Jianguo about their plans for the Chinese New Year.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, to Jiangnan Commercial Building, No. 20 Yilong West Road, Longhua District.

name: Handling a tripped distribution box fault
description: Arrived at the destination at 9:00, contacted the property management, and entered the power distribution room. The inspection revealed that frequent tripping was caused by an aging air switch inside a standby power cabinet. He was in charge of cutting off power, hanging the safety tag, and verifying that there was no voltage. After confirming safety, he guided Zhao Qiang in replacing the old air switch with a new one, while Jianguo assisted by passing tools. The fault was cleared at 10:30, and the building's power supply returned to normal. At 11:00, they packed up the tools, cleaned the site, and drove back to the industrial park.
location: Electrical room, Basement Level 1, Jiangnan Commercial Building, No. 20 Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return to the industrial park
description: On the way back, his phone vibrated. An 8,000 yuan year-end bonus was transferred to his salary card, and the company system pushed a 500 yuan electronic shopping card. He was pleased and figured this money could just be saved. He returned to the industrial park before 12:00.
location: Return from Jiangnan Commercial Building, No. 20 Yilong West Road, Longhua District, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Lunch and message confirmation
description: He had lunch at "Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice" next to the industrial park and ordered a bowl of pork offal spicy soup rice with an egg. While waiting, he opened mobile banking and confirmed that the year-end bonus had been deposited, which made him feel much more at ease. While eating, he discussed the afternoon warehouse sorting plan with Jianguo, roughly splitting up to count spare parts and accessories.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Workshop lunch break.
description: During the lunch break, he lay on the recliner in the lounge for a nap to regain his strength. He thought about going to his parents' house in the evening and telling them about the bonus, and also mulled over how to discuss with Juanzi what to do with the money. He set an alarm on his phone for 13:20.
location: Overhaul workshop rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Warehouse organization and tool maintenance
description: In the afternoon, the crew entered the warehouse for work. I was mainly responsible for maintaining power tools and hydraulic equipment. I carefully oiled the hydraulic pliers and several commonly used wrenches and checked the hoses for leaks. Jianguo was in charge of counting consumables inventory such as cable lugs and circuit breakers. Zhao Qiang wiped down the shelves and a new batch of insulating gloves. At 16:30, the warehouse was organized and the tools were properly maintained, ready for work to start after the Spring Festival.
location: Spare Parts Warehouse, Overhaul Workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, go home, shop on the way, and rest up.
description: He left work on time and rode the electric bike home. Passing by Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store on Jinmao Middle Road, he parked the bike, went in, and bought a pack of squeeze jelly that his sons love and two jars of Lao Gan Ma chili sauce. Remembering that tomorrow was the weekend, he also bought a new exercise book for Zixuan. After arriving home, Juanzi was preparing dinner ingredients. He put the things on the coffee table and told her that the bonus had arrived. He changed into casual clothes, sat on the sofa for a while, drank a glass of water, and stretched his waist.
location: Starting from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, passing Xiangzhi General Merchandise and Grocery Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, and returning to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Go to parents' home
description: At 17:00, the family of four set off on an electric bike, arriving at the grandparents' home about 25 minutes later. While parking, the eldest son had already run upstairs and knocked on the door.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, to the South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District

name: Dinner and conversation at parents' home
description: My parents prepared a table of good dishes. My father asked about the progress of my preparation for the senior technician exam. I reported that I was almost done with the first chapter of the textbook. He nodded and said, "Theory and practice must be well combined." My mother kept putting food into my bowl and urged me not to work too hard and to watch my back injury. At the dinner table, I also mentioned the year-end bonus. My parents were very happy and said we should plan well ourselves.
location: Parents' home, South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home.
description: The family sat around and chatted for a while, then we took our leave around 19:30. Mother packed some home-pickled sauerkraut and fruit for us to take back. We got home at 20:00; the younger son was already a bit sleepy, and Juanzi helped him wash up.
location: Return from CCCC Longqi Yayuan South Area, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, to the Banshan Garden residential area at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Discussing how to use the year-end bonus and online shopping
description: Once the children were all settled, I sat in the living room with my wife and took out the ledger to discuss things. I proposed a plan: put 5,000 yuan in a one-year fixed deposit, set aside 3,000 yuan as the budget for Spring Festival red envelopes and New Year goods, and use a 500-yuan shopping card to buy the 'Li ethnic group God of Might totem' wine bottle I had had my eye on for a long time. Juanzi nodded in agreement and also suggested giving each of our parents an extra 200-yuan red envelope. Then I took out my phone, logged into the shopping card platform, searched for the bottle, saw it was priced at 498 yuan, paid with the shopping card, and placed the order for just 10 yuan in shipping. After ordering, I was in a great mood, and my wife teased, 'So you finally went for it.'
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help the eldest son with homework.
description: After finishing online shopping, he went to his eldest son's room to check his math homework. He found that the steps of two word problems were wrong, patiently guided him to correct them, and urged him to prepare the calligraphy supplies he would need for the next day.
location: The eldest son's room in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Study electrical theory.
description: In a good mood, he sat down in the study and opened the “Advanced Electrician Technician Theory Course”. He turned to the planned content for today, Section 3 of Chapter 1, “Ohm's Law”, and used his experience from the daytime distribution box work, when he measured current and voltage with a clamp meter, to understand it. He quickly mastered the application of the formula and, by analogy, calculated the resistance values of a few simple series and parallel circuits on paper. After confirming they were correct, he took careful notes.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening back rehabilitation training
description: After finishing studying, I did evening rehabilitation exercises on the bedroom floor, including the superman stretch, glute bridges, and dead bugs, three sets each. My lower back muscles felt pleasantly sore. I tried a 50-second plank and felt more stable than before.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Washing up and winding down before bed
description: After finishing recovery stretching, he went to the bathroom to take a shower and wash up. Back in the bedroom, Juanzi was already getting ready to sleep. He lay down quietly, thinking about how the year-end bonus had arrived, the tools had been properly maintained, and his studies were proceeding as planned. He felt very satisfied. He turned off the light at 22:30, and thinking about tomorrow afternoon's laobaicha appointment with Jianguo, he soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up, lower back rehabilitation training, and running preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:40 a.m., felt energetic, and no stiffness in the lower back. In bed, he gently moved his wrists and ankles. He checked the weather on his phone: sunny, 16-22°C, suitable for outdoor exercise. Then he spread out the yoga mat on the living room floor and did the daily lower back rehab routine: superman exercise for 3 sets (12 reps each), glute bridges for 3 sets (15 reps each), and a plank (target 55 seconds, today he held it for 58 seconds). After training, he changed into a dark blue quick-dry T-shirt, black sports shorts, and running shoes. He put his phone, keys, and a 10-yuan note into his sports armband pouch. Before leaving, he said to his wife Wang Lijuan, busy in the kitchen: "Juanzi, I'm going out for a run. I'll be back for breakfast together."
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Biked to Baishamen Park and went on a 5-kilometer morning run with Chen Bin.
description: I left home on an electric bicycle and rode along Binhai Avenue toward Baishamen Park. The weather was clear, the morning breeze was slightly cool, and the sea surface glimmered. About 15 minutes later, I arrived at the north gate of the park and met up with my running partner Chen Bin. The two of us jogged 5 kilometers inside the park at a pace controlled at around 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. At the third kilometer I was slightly out of breath, but there was no discomfort in my lower back. On the last kilometer I picked up the pace a little, and the total time was 31 minutes 15 seconds. After the run, we stretched on the boardwalk. Chen Bin said I had recovered well and thought that with more practice I could get my pace under 6 minutes.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, take a shower, and have breakfast with family.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Bin, he rode the electric bicycle back along the same route and arrived home at 8:25. After entering the door, he first drank a large glass of warm water, then took a hot shower and changed into loungewear. His wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked shredded pork noodle soup and fried two eggs. His 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan had just woken up and was sitting at the dining table. While eating noodles, he playfully chatted with him, asking whether he had dreamed of Ultraman. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Systematically review and draw a knowledge framework diagram
description: After breakfast, he went into the study, took out the "Electrician Advanced Technician Theory Course" and workplace safety study materials, and condensed what he had learned over the past half month into an A3 framework diagram. He wrote the main title with a black pen, and used red, blue, and green water-based pens to mark knowledge points as "mastered," "somewhat vague," and "completely unfamiliar" respectively, with emphasis on cross-linking the new-type distribution equipment and workplace safety key points in Chapter 1 of the textbook. After completing the diagram, he used transparent tape to stick the framework diagram on the wall directly in front of the desk for easy reference at any time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Have lunch with the family.
description: His wife called everyone to lunch. Lunch had pan-fried mackerel, garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and seaweed egg drop soup. The 8-year-old eldest son, Lu Zixuan, mentioned that the school sports meet was next week and that he had signed up for the 60-meter dash. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him to practice hard, and pointed at the framework diagram he had just drawn, saying he would make progress together with his son. After the meal, he voluntarily cleared the table to let his wife rest for a while.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday leisure and a brief rest
description: After tidying up, he played with his two sons in the living room: Lu Zixuan was building a LEGO robot, and he helped Lu Zihan piece together a small train. At 12:30 he felt sleepy, went back to the master bedroom, put on an eye mask, set a 30-minute alarm, and took a nap.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped his wife with the pre-Spring Festival cleaning
description: After the nap alarm rang, he got up and washed his face. Remembering the afternoon plan, he first went to the balcony to check the tools needed for taking down the curtains and cleaning the windows (ladder, screwdriver, basin, rags, glass cleaner, old newspapers, etc.) and confirmed they were all there. Then he officially started work: he moved the ladder, took down the curtains in the living room, master bedroom, and second bedroom, and carried them to the laundry room for his wife Wang Lijuan to wash. He wiped the aluminum alloy window frames himself, then used glass cleaner and a squeegee to make every window crystal clear on both the inside and outside. Though it was tiring, seeing the clean windows and smelling the scent of laundry detergent made him feel pleased.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went out shopping after a brief rest
description: After a major cleanup came to an end, I sat in the living room to rest and drank a large glass of plain boiled water, feeling a craving for spicy soup rice. I rode the electric bicycle first to Xiangzhi General Store in Chengzhongcheng Community at No. 19 Yusha Road, where I bought two packs of squeezy jelly and a set of colored pencils, notebooks and other stationery for the kids. Then I rode to Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on the first floor of Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, packed two portions of spicy soup rice as a snack, and chatted with the boss about the idea of introducing fried pork ribs. I got home at 16:10.
location: No. 19 Yusha Road, Xiangzhi General Merchandise and Daily Goods Store, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road

name: Organize the wine bottle collection and discover an old wine bottle
description: He placed the packaged spicy soup rice on the dining table, went into the storage room, and carefully carried out five boxes containing 52 wine bottles in total to the living room. He wiped each bottle with a damp cloth one by one, then sorted them into four rows by the year marked on the bottom: 1970s, 1980s, 1990s, and after 2000. While organizing the box of old bottles his mother had given him earlier, he was pleasantly surprised to find an empty bottle with a yellowed label printed with "Haikou Distillery 1987" and a simple coconut tree pattern. He was very excited, placed it alone on the coffee table, and took a photo to remember the moment. It was almost six o'clock when he finished sorting and putting everything back.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Walked to Datie Laoba Tea Shop to drink tea and chat with Chen Jianguo, then walked back.
description: While packing the wine bottles, he received a call from Chen Jianguo urging him. Seeing that it was already six o'clock, he quickly stacked the wine bottle boxes in the corner of the study and walked to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road. About 15 minutes later, he arrived. Chen Jianguo had already found seats and ordered two glasses of iced black tea, two baskets of steamed chicken feet, and pandan cake. As they ate, they exchanged study insights for the exam: Chen Jianguo shared a practical fault case where an incorrect inverter parameter setting caused the motor to vibrate, and Lu Mingqiang carefully noted it in his phone memo. Lu Mingqiang then explained Ohm's law using his maintenance experience, and Chen Jianguo found it easier to understand. They agreed to report their study progress via WeChat every Sunday evening. They chatted until 7:30. Lu Mingqiang reminded himself it was time to go back, said goodbye to Chen Jianguo, and walked home. After getting home, he went to the balcony first and saw that the curtains hanging there were almost dry.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study of series and parallel circuits
description: After changing into loungewear, I sat down at the desk, opened the textbook to Section 4 of Chapter 4, and focused on learning how to calculate equivalent resistance in series and parallel circuits. On scratch paper, I repeatedly drew simple diagrams of series, parallel, and series-parallel circuits, made up my own calculation problems, and worked through them again and again until I could immediately say that two 5-ohm resistors in parallel equal 2.5 ohms.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go online to share bottle collection and chat on forums
description: After studying, he used his phone to post the close-up of the 1987 Haikou Daqu liquor bottle taken in the afternoon and a "family portrait" of bottles to the bottle-collecting forum, with the caption: "Today's big cleanup—I've shown off all my treasured possessions! I also unexpectedly found an old-timer from the '80s—a 1987 Daqu from the Haikou Distillery. Any fellow collectors who recognize it?" After posting, he refreshed the page and saw several old guys reply praising the bottle's good condition, and he felt very happy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening core training, washing up, and wrap-up review
description: After turning off the computer, he went to the living room, spread out the yoga mat, and completed the second core workout of the day: three sets each of superman exercises and glute bridges, and held a plank for 55 seconds. Then he took down the dried curtains, folded them, and put them on the sofa, then went to the bathroom to wash up and soak his feet. When he came out, his wife Wang Lijuan was looking at her phone and said the children had gone to bed. Lu Mingqiang answered softly, then laid out his clothes for the next day. Lying in bed, he quickly reviewed the day: morning jog resumed, framework diagram completed, windows cleaned, wine bottles organized and an old treasure discovered, learning plan adjusted with Chen Jianguo, and circuit problems thoroughly practiced in the evening. He felt very fulfilled and grounded, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning low back and core training
description: Woke up naturally at 6:20 in the morning, feeling good. After washing up briefly, I unrolled the yoga mat on the master bedroom floor and began the morning lower back rehabilitation routine. I first did two sets of planks, 50 seconds each, then completed 15 glute bridges and 15 dead bugs, effectively waking up my body and preparing for the day's work.
location: Master bedroom floor, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up the family and take the two children to school.
description: After the training, he woke up his wife Wang Lijuan and their two sons. It was an overcast day, so he reminded her to dress the children in extra jackets. At 7 o'clock, he set off on the electric bike, with the older son Lu Zixuan on the back seat and the younger son Lu Zihan standing in the front. He first took Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then turned around and rode to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to take Zixuan to the school gate.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, they successively arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District).

name: Buy breakfast, commute, and attend the team morning meeting
description: After dropping off the children, he bought two glutinous rice cakes and a cup of hot soy milk at Chen Sanjie Breakfast Shop next to Longfeng Experimental Primary School and hung them on the handlebars. Then he rode his e-bike to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park in Xiuying District. After arriving, he changed into work clothes and attended the 8 a.m. team morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang assigned the morning tasks of inspecting the power distribution room and checking the seals, reminding everyone that this was the last inspection before the holiday and that safety must be ensured; in the afternoon, he arranged for organizing the warehouse and maintaining tools.
location: Chen Sanjie Breakfast Shop, 4-13 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to the maintenance team office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Inspect the power distribution room in the jurisdiction and apply seals.
description: After the morning meeting, he teamed up with colleagues Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang and set off in the company work vehicle to inspect the power distribution rooms in the Guomao/World Trade area. The three had a clear division of labor: Lu Mingqiang checked the main switch and busbar temperature, Chen Jianguo tested the leakage protection, and Zhao Qiang recorded data and applied seals. They focused on inspecting the old hotels and office buildings in Binhai New Village, paying special attention to insulation aging. The work was efficient and steady, ensuring electricity safety during the Spring Festival period.
location: Distribution rooms in multiple office buildings and old residential communities in Haikou's Guomao/Shimao area (the service vehicle departed from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: After inspecting the last distribution room, it was almost 11:30. The three of them drove back to near the industrial park. Lu Mingqiang and Jianguo went to their usual Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant for lunch. Aqiang ordered spicy soup rice with an egg, and Jianguo had pig trotter rice. While eating, Jianguo asked how Aqiang was preparing for the senior technician exam after the New Year. Aqiang said he planned to take his books to his parents' home during the Spring Festival, and they agreed to find time in the first week after the Spring Festival to quiz each other on safety regulations.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, I went back to the industrial park and lay on a folding bed in the staff lounge for half an hour to rest, setting an alarm for 12:55. The lounge was quiet, and the other workers were also taking their lunch breaks to store up energy for the afternoon physical work.
location: Staff Rest Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Organize the storeroom and maintain tools
description: Arrived at the warehouse on time at 1 p.m. and began cleaning my personal tool cabinet. I put the wrenches, screwdrivers, and multimeter back in place, used cotton yarn dipped in machine oil to carefully wipe down the impact drill and angle grinder, and oiled them for maintenance. My colleague Zhao Qiang was beside me learning how to lubricate crimping pliers. At about 15:30, Squad Leader Zhang inspected and announced the work was complete, reminded everyone to keep the emergency phone available, and wished everyone an early Happy New Year, marking the successful conclusion of the pre-holiday work.
location: Maintenance warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Checked the electric bike and left work.
description: After the shift leader announced the end of work, he exchanged New Year greetings with his workmates and went to the bike shed to get his electric bike. He checked the tires and battery level, and after confirming everything was fine, rode toward Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his older son.
location: On the way from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

name: Pick up both sons from school and head home.
description: Arrived at Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 4 p.m. sharp and picked up Lu Zixuan. Then rode to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Lu Zihan. The two little ones sat on the e-bike, one on each side, excitedly sharing funny stories from school: Zixuan said he got a little red flower for his winter vacation homework, and Zihan said the teacher taught them a Chinese New Year song. The family rode the electric bike back home to Banshan Garden.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) and then to Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Received the happy news of winning the parent-child reading check-in award.
description: After the family of four got home, his wife Wang Lijuan excitedly showed the kindergarten class group notification on her phone: because they had completed the parent-child reading check-in with full attendance, they were named ‘Reading Star,’ and the electronic certificate bore the names of the whole family. The two children happily jumped around in the living room, and the whole family was immersed in joy.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: The whole family set up a children’s reading corner.
description: Riding the excitement of winning the award, Lu Mingqiang suggested putting up the small bookshelf he had bought online. He carried the bookshelf and foam floor mats out of the balcony storage cabinet, while his wife wiped clean the corner of the living room. His eldest son, Zixuan, helped pass screws and a wrench, and his youngest son, Zihan, stacked up his beloved picture books one by one. In less than half an hour, a small reading corner covered with a cartoon mat and filled with picture books was ready.
location: A corner of the living room at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and have dinner together.
description: After setting up the reading corner, Wang Lijuan started cooking dinner, and Lu Mingqiang helped by trimming vegetables and cutting the Wenchang chicken. Dinner included stir-fried tomatoes and eggs, sautéed choy sum, and the roast duck bought during the day. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting. The conversation revolved around the new reading corner and the Reading Star honor, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Accompanied the children reading in the new reading corner.
description: After dinner, the two children could not wait to run to the reading corner. Zixuan picked out One Hundred Thousand Whys and flipped through it seriously, while Zihan hugged The Very Hungry Caterpillar and asked Dad to read it. Lu Mingqiang held Zihan in his arms and read the picture book in a slightly Hainanese-accented Mandarin, pointing at the fruit and butterflies in the pictures and making Zihan giggle. They had a lovely parent-child reading time.
location: Reading corner in the living room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Helped with homework and supervised the children's washing up.
description: After reading, his wife took Zihan to the bath. Lu Mingqiang sat down next to Zixuan and checked his winter vacation homework. He found that a math problem about “multiplication combined with addition and subtraction” was wrong, so he patiently explained it with real-life examples until Zixuan fully understood, helping the child consolidate the knowledge point.
location: Living room and children's room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Photograph and catalog the collected liquor bottles.
description: After the children had all fallen asleep, Lu Mingqiang cleaned the dining table, laid out a soft light cloth, and took out three wine bottles: a 1987 Haikou Distillery bottle, a newly acquired bottle featuring the Li ethnic group's Mighty God totem, and a 1972 bottle from the State-owned Overseas Chinese Farm. Using his phone's flashlight for lighting, he photographed the front, back, and bottom close-ups of each bottle, and neatly recorded the number, name, source, and date in a new notebook, improving his personal collection archive.
location: Banshan Garden Restaurant, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Compare the wine bottles and share them in the group
description: For comparison, he placed a 1987 Haikou Distillery bottle and a 1972 State-Run Overseas Chinese Farm bottle together, marveling at the simple, weathered feel of the old bottles. He then took a group photo of the three bottles and posted it to the "Hainan Liquor Bottle Collectors Exchange Group," adding a message asking for opinions on the Overseas Chinese Farm bottle. Fellow collectors in the group responded quickly, and the discussion was lively, adding to the joy of collecting.
location: Banshan Garden Restaurant, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simplified evening back training
description: Given the relatively high physical exertion during the day, he only did a simplified version of the evening training, completing a few sets of glute bridges and dead bugs on the bedroom floor to relax his tense lower back muscles and maintain training continuity.
location: Master bedroom floor, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and full-day review
description: After training, he took a comfortable hot shower. He changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed, briefly chatting with his wife Wang Lijuan about the day's work and the liquor bottles from the Overseas Chinese Farm; his wife joked that it was his little hobby. Then he set a reminder in his phone memo app to report his study progress to Chen Jianguo on Sunday. At 22:50, he turned off the bedside lamp, said goodnight, and fell asleep content and at ease.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Waking up, morning exercise, and urging the sons to wash up.
description: At 6:20 a.m., the phone alarm rang. After getting up, Lu Mingqiang did cat stretches and planks on the living room floor to relieve stiffness in his lower back. Then he went into his son Lu Zixuan's room, woke him up, and urged him to wash up and put on his school uniform, because there was a flag-raising ceremony on Monday. Father and son each washed up in the bathroom, and Mingqiang changed into his work clothes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Took his son to school, had breakfast on the way, and went home to prepare.
description: At exactly 7 o'clock, Mingqiang rode his electric bike with Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. After sending the child into school, he ate a bowl of pork offal noodles and drank coffee with milk at the Dad's Tea Shop near No. 19 Yusha Road. After breakfast, he rode back home to Banshan Garden, put the 5,000 yuan in cash to be deposited at noon and the ledger into his briefcase, and checked his tool bag to make sure the multimeter and screwdrivers were complete.
location: Dad's Tea Shop, near No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to the company
description: Mingqiang drove from Banshan Garden, along Binhai Avenue, listening to Haikou Traffic Radio, and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park about 15 minutes later. He parked the car downstairs, picked up his tool bag and briefcase, and entered the office building.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning meeting and low-voltage line maintenance on Bo'ai Road
description: At the morning meeting, Team Leader Zhang assigned the task of troubleshooting the low-voltage problem in the old Bo'ai Road neighborhood. Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang went there together. They drove the company's service vehicle to a residential building on Bo'ai Road. Mingqiang set up a ladder and found that the oxidized aluminum service wire was causing the low voltage. He and Zhao Qiang replaced it with 10 mm² copper-core wire, stabilizing the voltage at 220V. The resident granny gave them tangerines to express her thanks. Around 11:30, they returned to the company. Mingqiang put used tools back in place and wiped them clean, and threw the old aluminum wire removed from the building into the scrap bin.
location: A residential building in the old neighborhood on Bo'ai Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Mingqiang rode his e-bike to his elder sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant at Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, and ordered a bowl of spicy soup rice with a fried egg. While eating, he called his wife Juanzi to chat about everyday things. At 12:40, he returned to the company rest room and took a nap on a folding recliner, setting an alarm for 13:00.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, Ground Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Make a fixed deposit at the bank
description: After the lunch break, Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the Bank of China on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District. While taking a number and waiting in line, he flipped through the "Travel Fund" page in his account book. After waiting for about three people, he deposited 5,000 yuan in cash as a one-year lump-sum deposit with an interest rate of 1.8%. After receiving the deposit certificate, he checked the information and carefully clipped it into the inner pages of his account book.
location: Bank of China, Jinmao Middle Road Sub-branch, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work and warehouse inventory
description: Mingqiang returned to the company, first organized this week's work log and next week's inspection plan, then went to the archives to look up and mark old circuit diagrams for Bo'ai Road. Afterwards, he reported the morning maintenance situation to Squad Leader Zhang. Starting at 15:30, he and Chen Jianguo conducted a warehouse tool inventory and maintenance, testing equipment such as insulation megohmmeters and oiling rusty wrenches. The two chatted about their plans to go home, and Mingqiang mentioned that he wanted to buy dried sea fish before the Chinese New Year.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, buy a lumbar support
description: After work, Mingqiang drove along Haixiu Middle Road and Longkun South Road for about 20 minutes and arrived at the East Zone store of Decathlon Sun Moon Plaza, No. 8 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District. In the protective gear section, he compared several supportive back braces and finally chose one with breathable mesh fabric and reinforced support strips. Satisfied with the fit, he paid and left.
location: Decathlon Riyue Plaza East District Store, No. 8 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Picked up the packages and walked home.
description: After leaving Decathlon, Mingqiang drove along Guoxing Avenue and Longkun North Road to the Cainiao Station on Jinmao East Road, where he picked up the package for the Li ethnic Dalishen totem wine bottle he had bought online, a long, thin cardboard box. Then he walked about 8 minutes, carrying the package and the waist support, back to Banshan Garden.
location: Cainiao Station (Haikou Longhua China Resources Runfu Store 01), No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sharing daily life with family over dinner.
description: After arriving home, Juanzi had prepared stir-fried sweet potato leaves, steamed pork ribs with garlic, and egg drop soup. The family of four had dinner together. Xuanxuan excitedly talked about being praised at the flag-raising ceremony, and Hanhan said she learned to fold paper airplanes at kindergarten. Mingqiang felt the warmth of family, and casually reminded Juanzi that he had arranged to play squash with Lin Feng on Friday evening, asking her to keep an eye on Xuanxuan's math homework.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Unpack and display the liquor bottle collection
description: After the meal, Mingqiang opened the delivery box and took out the Li ethnic 'God of Power' totem wine bottle. He wiped it with a soft cloth, showed it to the family, and explained the culture of the Li people's guardian deity. Juanzi found it exquisite, and the children watched curiously. Finally, he solemnly placed the bottle in the middle compartment of the living room wine cabinet, alongside the old 'State-Run Overseas Chinese Farm' bottle he had obtained yesterday.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sharing electrician experience in a WeChat group.
description: Mingqiang went into the study and shared the application of Ohm's law in judging real-world line loss in the 'Haikou Electrician Technical Exchange Group.' Using the morning case of aluminum wire oxidation on Bo'ai Road, he explained in detail via voice messages and answered group members' questions about capacitor selection for single-phase motors, earning a like from group owner Master Li.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Self-studied Chapter 2 of Power System Fault Analysis.
description: Mingqiang poured a glass of warm water, opened the textbook Power System Fault Analysis, and focused on studying Chapter 2, 'Short-Circuit Types and Characteristics.' As he read, he drew diagrams of single-phase grounding and two-phase short circuits, and used the morning's transformer trip case to compare and understand the symmetrical component method formula. He persisted in writing a page and a half of notes, clarifying the characteristics of different short-circuit currents.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Bedtime washing and couple conversation
description: After finishing his studies, Mingqiang took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and lay down in bed. He talked with his wife about the day's work and suggested going for a run with Chen Bin at Baishamen Park on Saturday morning. His wife planned to take the children to Wanlv Garden to fly kites. They also discussed the weekend painting trial class for Hanhan.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After saying goodnight, Mingqiang set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning and checked the weather, which showed sunny, 18–25°C. He turned off the light, lay flat, and silently reviewed the day's work and life, feeling fulfilled and content. After adjusting his sleeping position, he fell asleep around 22:30.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Morning exercise, family breakfast, and budget planning
description: Morning sunlight streamed into the bedroom. After getting up on time, he put on a breathable lumbar support, spread the yoga mat on the living room floor, and did 20 minutes of waist and core training, feeling the muscles engage and the new lumbar support fit well. After the training, he wiped off the sweat with a wet towel, washed up, and then went into the kitchen to help his wife Wang Lijuan prepare breakfast. He took over the egg-frying task, and while frying, discussed the New Year's Eve dinner shopping list, planned to take white shrimp and dessert to his parents' home in the afternoon, and confirmed the red envelopes were ready. Breakfast was lean pork porridge and fried eggs. As the family of four sat around the table, he took out his pocket ledger and quickly went over the Spring Festival budget with Juanzi: New Year goods plus red envelopes controlled within 3,000 yuan, 800 yuan for each set of parents, 200 yuan for each child's new clothes, 30 yuan for couplets and the Fu character, and 170 yuan left as contingency — he knew exactly where things stood.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went to the New Year market to buy Spring Festival couplets and new clothes.
description: After breakfast, he changed into a casual jacket, grabbed his car keys, and drove along Jinmao Middle Road toward the temporary New Year goods market. The song 'Good Luck Comes' was playing in the car, full of festive cheer. According to the navigation, he arrived near the market in about 13 minutes. At the market stalls, he quickly bought a gold-embossed fortune character, auspicious Spring Festival couplets, and a pair of red lantern ornaments. Then he took his second son, Lu Zihan, and his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to the children's clothing section to choose new clothes. For Hanhan, he chose a hoodie with a small airplane pattern, and Hanhan happily imitated the sound of an airplane while trying it on; for Xuanxuan, he picked a zip-up jacket one size larger and encouraged him to study math, physics, and chemistry well so he could become an astronaut when he grew up.
location: Temporary Chinese New Year goods market on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returning home, family lunch, and putting up Spring Festival couplets.
description: After shopping, he carried large and small bags and drove back to Banshan Garden, arriving home about 13 minutes later. Downstairs, he sorted through the items and took a photo of the bright red couplets. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared lunch, and the family of four enjoyed a simple meal of Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried choy sum, and pork rib soup. After the meal, the whole family bustled about putting up Spring Festival couplets: you were in charge of tearing off the old couplets and cleaning the door frame, Juanzi handed over the tape, Xuanxuan stood on a stool and directed, and Hanhan carefully passed the 'fu' characters. After the front door was pasted, they deliberately pasted the big red 'fu' character upside down to signify that fortune had arrived, and also polished the wine cabinet glass to a shine, which foreshadowed the discovery that followed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cleaned out the wine cabinet, found old wine bottles, and researched their history
description: While wiping the liquor cabinet, he carefully took out an old Moutai bottle and found it was an empty bottle that had been collecting dust for years. The label was yellowed, but the words 'Haikou Distillery' and '1987' were still clear; he recognized it as an old keepsake his father had given him years ago. After gently wiping it with a damp cloth, the coconut tree trademark became visible, sparking his curiosity. He sat back down in the living room and searched for 'Haikou Distillery 1987' on his phone. From local historical records, he learned that the distillery had once carried on the traditional distillation technique of the Li people and had ceased production in the late 1990s. Recalling the wine bottle from the Overseas Chinese Farm he had discovered the day before, he felt a ripple in his heart. He got up, took a new notebook from the study, and on the first page wrote: 'Inside the bottle are the days of the workers of the past.' Then he held the old bottle up to the light and took detailed photos.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: After tidying up briefly, he drew the curtains and lay down in the bedroom. Although he was full of energy, he decided to close his eyes and take a nap before staying up late for New Year's Eve. Before falling asleep, he habitually murmured the short-circuit types from Power System Fault Analysis to himself and gradually drifted into light sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organizing the wine bottle records and preparing to go to his parents' house.
description: After waking from a nap, he felt refreshed. He turned on the computer and entered the distillery history he had searched for, the photos of liquor bottles taken that afternoon, and his thoughts into a new Word document, planning to later write a complete record of the discovery of the Overseas Chinese Farm and Haikou Daqu. Then he changed into a clean navy blue jacket, checked the car keys and trunk, and carefully packed the prepared New Year goods — two cans of Tieguanyin tea, a box of traditional Hainan pastries, and two big red envelopes containing crisp new banknotes — into a carrying bag. Juanzi had already changed the two children into new clothes, and the whole family was ready to go.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to parents' home
description: The family got into the car, started the engine, and set off for the parents' home on Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District. Sunlight streamed through the windows, Xuanxuan and Hanhan hummed "Happy New Year" in the back seat, and Juanzi, in the passenger seat, reminded them not to forget to thank the grandparents for their hard work on the New Year's Eve dinner. The navigation showed a driving time of about 18 minutes, and the whole ride was filled with a warm festive atmosphere.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to the South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Arrive at the parents' home and enjoy the Chinese New Year's Eve reunion dinner.
description: Carrying New Year goods through the door, the aroma of hometown dishes filled the house. Mother Chen Xiuying came up and beamed at the two children. Father Lu Jianguo came out of the study. You stepped forward, wished him a Happy New Year, and put the tea and pastries on the coffee table. After sitting down, mother laid out a sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner: white-cut Wenchang chicken, braised mackerel, steamed oysters with garlic, and stir-fried green beans. You deliberately filled father's wine glass, solemnly took out your phone to show him the photo of the overseas Chinese farm wine bottle and ask about its origin. Father put on his reading glasses, stared at the photo, and slowly began to tell the story.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Listened to his father recount stories of the farm and recorded them.
description: Father Lu Jianguo recalled the years in 1973 when he went to the Overseas Chinese Farm to erect drainage and irrigation lines. At that time, the farm was full of rubber forests and pepper gardens. More than 20 workers lived and ate at the farm headquarters, and the power lines were all installed by sheer manpower. You listened intently, quickly pulled out your notebook, and faithfully recorded the year, place names, and those vivid details. In your heart, you felt the wine bottle in your hand suddenly become warm.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner family chat and saying goodbye.
description: After the New Year's Eve dinner, the children watched the Spring Festival special in the living room while you, your parents, and your wife cleared the table and chatted about work, life, and the children's studies. Mother brought out freshly fried dough twists for you to try, and you respectfully handed the prepared red envelopes to your parents, wishing them good health and a happy new year. As it began to get dark, the family got ready to say goodbye and head home.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove back to his own home
description: After bidding farewell to his parents, the family drove back home. Hanhan was so sleepy that he fell asleep in the car, while Xuanxuan was still excitedly telling his mother about grandpa's stories. The navigation showed about 19 minutes of driving; you felt grounded and warm, and arrived smoothly at the entrance of Banshan Garden.
location: South Zone of CCCC Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening study: Power System Fault Analysis
description: After getting home, Juanzi coaxed the children to wash up and get ready for bed. You sat down at your desk, turned on the desk lamp, took out the textbook Power System Fault Analysis, and spent 30 minutes quickly reviewing the key points of the second chapter on short-circuit types, underlining key words with a pencil. On the last page of the notebook, you wrote: “On New Year's Eve, having studied a little, I feel at ease.”
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and putting on/taking off the back brace to relax.
description: After finishing the review, he felt mentally relaxed. He took off the back brace he had been wearing all day and did a short stretching routine. After washing up, he changed into comfortable pajamas and rested briefly before the coming New Year's Eve vigil.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Staying up on New Year's Eve to watch the Spring Festival Gala.
description: Walking into the living room, Juanzi had already brewed tea and turned on the TV to watch the Spring Festival Gala. You sat next to your wife, watching the skits and discussing tomorrow's route for New Year visits. Sporadic firecrackers sounded outside the window, and the festive atmosphere grew stronger as the two of you shared a warm evening of staying up for the New Year.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: New Year countdown ceremony and fireworks viewing
description: At the stroke of midnight, you and Juanzi gently woke the two children and walked out to the balcony. The distant sky was lit up by colorful fireworks, and the sound of firecrackers rose one after another nearby. You held the two children and wished them safety and good studies, and the family hugged each other and exchanged New Year wishes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Completed evening core training and rested.
description: After the New Year's Eve celebration, he spread out the yoga mat on the living room floor and completed that evening's core training. His body was slightly sweaty, and he felt the power of persistence. After washing up, he lay in bed thinking about the day — the old wine bottle, memories of his father, the sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner, and his family's laughter. His heart was full of steadiness and contentment, and he gradually fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning waist and core training
description: The alarm rang on time at 7:00. Although he had gone to bed late after staying up for New Year's Eve, he felt quite refreshed on the morning of the first day of the new year. He opened the window to let in fresh air, spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and began 15 minutes of core training for his waist and abdomen. Alternating between planks and crunches, he felt the slight fatigue from the previous night's New Year's Eve celebration vanish completely. After the workout, he wiped off the sweat with a towel and got ready for a full day of New Year visits.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing red envelopes
description: He took a quick hot shower and put on the new red shirt his wife had ironed the night before. Walking to the desk, he took the prepared red envelopes out of the drawer and checked them carefully: 200 yuan for each of his two sons, and 1,000 yuan for each of his parents, symbolizing perfection. He reminded his wife to put on her festive red coat, and together they packed the New Year goods for his parents — a case of Hainan local coconut juice and a box of exquisite rice cakes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up my son and prepare to head out.
description: Walking into the kids' room, the two little ones were still lingering in bed. As soon as they heard they were going to visit Grandma and Grandpa for New Year's greetings, they perked up and scrambled to put on their new clothes. I helped the younger son, Hanhan, straighten his collar, and checked the schoolbag of the older son, Xuanxuan, who was in elementary school, making sure his winter vacation homework booklet wasn't left behind. Once the family was all set, they carried the New Year goods and fruit and walked out of the house chatting and laughing.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to my parents' home to pay a New Year's visit
description: Driving out of Banshan Garden. On the morning of the first day of the Chinese New Year, traffic on Haikou's streets and lanes was sparse, with red lanterns hanging on both sides of the roads, filling the air with a festive atmosphere. He turned on the car radio, which played cheerful New Year songs. The two sons in the back seat excitedly discussed what delicious food their grandparents would prepare for them. About 18 minutes later, he smoothly drove into the South District of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, where his parents lived.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Paying New Year respects at parents' home and eating rice cakes
description: As soon as they entered, his mother came up beaming. On the rosewood chairs in the living room, his father had already laid out kneeling pads and red envelopes. The two sons knelt down obediently, kowtowed in a proper manner, and said in unison, “Happy New Year, Grandpa and Grandma! Wishing you good health and all the best!” His mother was grinning from ear to ear. After the New Year greetings, she brought out steaming hot Hainanese New Year cake and sweet soup, and the whole family sat around together. After the snacks, he set up a Chinese chess game with his father on the balcony. As they played, his father once again recounted more details about installing the irrigation and drainage lines at the overseas Chinese farm in 1973. Lu Mingqiang quickly took out the notepad and pen he carried with him and wrote down all those stories about the liquor bottles in detail — they were excellent material for his cultural notes.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help mother prepare lunch and enjoy the family reunion meal.
description: After a couple of games of chess, he got up and went to the kitchen to help his mother, peeling garlic and trimming vegetables. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of white-cut chicken, the familiar taste of home. While working, his mother reminded him to be safe at work. Lunch was very abundant, with his mother's signature Hainanese chicken rice, fried pork ribs, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. His father opened a bottle of rice wine from his collection, and father and son had a few cups together, chatting about work and life, enjoying a warm and happy time. After the meal, the two sons played in the living room, and his wife helped his mother clear away the dishes.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove back home in Longhua District
description: After saying goodbye to his parents, he drove along Haifu Road toward Longhua District. The two sons in the car were a little sleepy and dozed off in the back seat. His wife also leaned back against the seat with her eyes closed. The sunlight outside the window was warm and pleasant; on the afternoon of the first day of the Lunar New Year, the city seemed especially peaceful.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and preparing for the wine bottle notes
description: After returning home, I tidied up a bit and felt slightly tired. I lay down on the bed in the master bedroom and rested for half an hour. After waking up, I felt much more refreshed. I went into the study and took out the three carefully selected bottles from the liquor cabinet: the Overseas Chinese Farm bottle, the Li ethnic totem bottle, and an old 1987 Haikou Distillery bottle, placing them side by side on the desk. I also flipped through the notebook full of notes from yesterday to prepare for the writing ahead.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Writing cultural notes for the wine bottle
description: I turned on the study light and spread out a stack of A4 paper. First I picked up the "Qiongqiao Rice Wine Bottle" and, combined with the old farm stories my father told that morning, wrote down in detail the historical background and the workers' stories behind the bottle. Next, for the "Li Ethnic Totem Bottle," I wrote about the symbolic meaning of its Great God totem and my understanding of the Li people's ancient distillation process. Finally, I carefully studied the "1987 Haikou Distillery Old Bottle" and recorded its production year and the trademark details on the bottle. This afternoon, I felt as if I had a profound conversation with these bottles carrying the weight of time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare a gift to bring when visiting Aunt
description: After writing the notes, I discussed visiting Aunt with my wife. We picked out some fresh apples and oranges, and took a box of fine egg rolls and a pack of Shishan Yongyang mutton pastries from the storage cabinet, putting them into a gift bag printed with the character 'Fu' (meaning fortune). My wife also prepared a red envelope for Aunt. When the two sons heard they were going to visit their grandaunt, they excitedly changed their shoes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to visit aunt
description: Drove to Fucheng Town, Qiongshan District. On the first day of the Chinese New Year, the old street in Fucheng was bustling with crowds, much livelier than usual. He slowed down, carefully drove through the alleys, and finally parked in a residential complex with an empty space near his aunt's home.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visiting aunt
description: Aunt lives in an old folk house. She was pleasantly surprised to see our family visit. She held mine and my wife's hands and asked how we were doing, then brought out peanuts, sugar cakes, and fruit for the two children. Zixuan and Zihan respectfully paid New Year's greetings to their great-aunt, which delighted her. We sat and chatted about family matters, asked about her health, and told her to call us promptly if anything came up. After sitting for about an hour, we got up and took our leave.

name: On the way home

Shops and houses along the road were hung with red lanterns, and the whole city was immersed in the peaceful atmosphere of the Spring Festival. The two sons chattered in the back seat, telling their mother about the old street and the sugar-figure stall they had seen at their great-aunt's house.
location: Near Zhongjie Road, Fucheng Town, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simple family dinner
description: Back home, his wife reheated the white-cut chicken and vegetables packed from her parents' home at noon, and also stir-fried two more dishes. The family sat around the dining table and had a simple dinner. During the meal, his wife told the children that they would go to the supermarket tomorrow to buy some snacks for the spring outing.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Watched the Spring Festival Gala replay.
description: After dinner, the whole family curled up on the living room sofa watching the replay of the Spring Festival Gala. The comedy sketches had everyone laughing uncontrollably, and they also tried to guess the secrets behind the magic acts. Zixuan and Zihan sat between me and my wife, each holding a bag of potato chips, watching with relish. Outside the window, the sky occasionally lit up with colorful flashes as bursts of firecrackers sounded, while inside the room echoed the warm laughter of the family of four.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: In the evening, studied high-voltage equipment maintenance.
description: The 9 o’clock chime was about to sound. He stepped out of the lively atmosphere of the living room on time and went into the study. He opened Chapter 3 of the textbook High-Voltage Equipment Maintenance and began studying the preventive test cycles for high-voltage equipment such as transformers and circuit breakers. He carefully copied two key parameters — the standard value for transformer insulating oil withstand voltage test and the circuit breaker opening and closing time — onto a sticky note, planning to stick it on his toolbox after going to work the next day. Although it was Spring Festival outside the window, as soon as he picked up the book, his mind calmed down.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening waist and core training
description: After studying, he energetically completed a 15-minute evening core workout in the bedroom. Two workouts a day, he felt his body lightly sweating, very comfortable. This was also a little self-discipline for his weight amid the rich food of the Spring Festival.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and organizing files.
description: After washing up, he sat down at the desk. He folded the notes on bottle culture he had written today in half and put them into the file folder. Then he took out the sticky note with the high-voltage equipment parameters, carefully checked it once, and after confirming it was correct, planned to stick it on the inside of the toolbox lid tomorrow. After finishing all this, he felt the day had been fulfilling.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: He lay down on the bed and glanced at the date on his phone. He had not forgotten his study routine on the first day of the Chinese New Year, and he felt quite satisfied. He said goodnight to his wife beside him, then closed his eyes and silently resolved that this good habit should be maintained.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: On the morning of the second day of the Lunar New Year, I naturally woke up at 7 a.m., and first did 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching by the bed to fully wake my body from sleep, laying the foundation for the day's energy.

name: Morning core training.
description: Spread out a yoga mat on the living room balcony and started a 15-minute core workout, including three sets of planks (45 seconds each), 30 crunches, and side planks for 30 seconds on each side, to maintain fitness.
location: Living room balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepared supplies for going back to the wife's parents' home and woke up the family
description: Returned to the bedroom and, with his wife Wang Lijuan, prepared red envelopes for visiting her parents (600 yuan for each parent, 200 yuan for the little nephew/niece), and checked the gift list (Shishan Yongyang mutton snacks, Haima tribute wine, Coconut Tree brand cigarettes). Then he woke up his two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and helped them change into new clothes for the Chinese New Year.
location: Master bedroom and children's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family breakfast and pre-departure checks
description: The whole family had breakfast together. My wife cooked the leftover dumplings from last night and the rice cakes brought back from my parents' home. While eating, I checked the car keys and wallet and confirmed the New Year gifts for my wife's parents were in the trunk.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, dining room and foyer

On the way, he made a spontaneous stop at Jiapin Supermarket on Fengxiang Road, letting his wife take the eldest son inside for a quick shopping of spring outing snacks (chips, cookies, drinks), while he and the younger son waited in the car. About 15 minutes later, they continued on to his wife's parents' home.

I handed the New Year goods and Shishan Yongyang mutton snacks to my mother-in-law. We sat down in the living room; my father-in-law brewed Wuzhishan black tea, my wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang shared news from his electronics business in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen, and I talked about my plan to take the senior technician certificate exam after the New Year. The children played with programming robots or watched cartoons on the floor.
location: Living room, Qiongshan Telecom Bureau Residential Compound, No. 53 Zhongshan Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: New Year opening dinner gathering
description: Mother-in-law prepared a big table of dishes: Wenchang chicken, steamed grouper, braised family-style dish, boiled prawns, and more. Father-in-law opened his homemade deer-turtle wine, and Zhiqiang and I had two small cups of rice wine with him. The atmosphere at the table was lively; everyone exchanged blessings and the children ate happily.
location: Qiongshan Telecom Bureau Residential Area, No. 53 Zhongshan Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, dining room

name: Said goodbye to his wife's parents and headed back home.
