location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, on the way from No. 53 Zhongshan Road, Qiongshan District, back to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Arrived home and had a short rest
description: Returned home at 2 p.m., put the packed dishes into the fridge. My wife took the two sleeping children to the small bedroom to rest. I changed out of my outdoor clothes, brewed a cup of Dahongpao tea, and sat down in the study chair to relax.
location: Living room and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Write the story "Overseas Chinese Farm Wine Bottle".
description: While the family was resting, he went into the study alone, opened the memo app on his phone, and began writing a story based on the story his father told yesterday about going to the farm in 1973 to string power lines, combined with the details of the wine bottle discovered the day before (a small chip at the bottom, and a blurry label with the words "Haikou Distillery" visible). He wrote more than a thousand characters, detailing the process of discovering the bottle, his father's hard years stringing wires in the depths of the Wuzhi Mountains, and the bottle's unique significance as a witness to the industrial development of the era. In the middle, he flipped through yesterday's notes on bottle culture to add details, and was very satisfied with the finished piece.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Handled safety knowledge questions and looked up project start documents.
description: After writing the story, he took out the mock exam paper of the Electric Power Safety Work Regulations printed before the New Year, carefully completed 10 multiple-choice questions covering key operations such as disconnecting power, testing for voltage, and installing ground wires, and answered all of them correctly. Then he opened his phone to browse the electric power industry forum, searched for “precautions for resuming work after the New Year,” read articles summarized by several veteran workers, copied the key points about post-holiday equipment inspections, and recorded them on a sticky note.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Father-son interaction and preparing to set off fireworks
description: At 5 p.m., the two children woke up. I called them over and took out the sparklers bought in the morning. The children were extremely excited. I explained the safety precautions to them: they could only play in the safe area downstairs, were not allowed to throw them at people, and were not allowed to get near trees. Then, taking the lighter and sparklers, I got ready to go downstairs.
location: Living room and balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Set off small fireworks with the children
description: As dusk fell, I took the children to the designated fireworks spot in the central square of the residential complex. We lit sparklers, sparks flew everywhere, and the two kids cheered as they waved their “halos” and drew in the open space. While reminding them to stay safe, I filmed with my phone and posted it to the family group chat, earning praise from the elders.
location: Designated fireworks area, Central Plaza, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: 2025-11-24 08:15:00 to 2025-11-24 11:30:00
description: After setting off the fireworks, they went home. His wife had already reheated the dishes they had packed up from her mother's house at noon and also made some seaweed egg drop soup. The family of four sat around the dining table, listening to the children talk about the fun they had setting off fireworks.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, kitchen and dining room

name: Evening study and summary
description: After dinner, he returned to the study, exported the written story “Overseas Chinese Farm Wine Bottle” from his memos, and backed it up to a computer folder. He opened his notebook and neatly recorded the safety knowledge questions he had just done and the work-start key points copied from the forum, thinking to himself that after Chinese New Year he would add illustrations to the wine bottle story and polish it.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Accompanying his wife to discuss the next day's plans and family time
description: He sat on the living room sofa and discussed tomorrow's plan with his wife. They decided to take the children to Baishamen Park on the third day of the Lunar New Year, using the snacks they had bought for a spring outing, and agreed to sleep in a bit tomorrow morning and set off at 9. They enjoyed a brief moment of family warmth.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening core training and washing up
description: Completed 15 minutes of evening core training on the balcony, with movements similar to the morning but more focused on stretching and relaxation to relieve the day's fatigue. After training, went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, washing away the smell of cooking and tiredness.
location: Balcony and bathroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and diary writing
description: He changed into pajamas and lay in bed, briefly recording today's feelings in his phone memo: on the second day of Chinese New Year, he went back to his wife's parental home and chatted happily with Zhiqiang; in the afternoon, completing the wine bottle story gave him a strong sense of achievement; the children were very happy setting off fireworks; his weight was 73.1 kg, down from yesterday.
location: Bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reading and getting ready for bed

location: Bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning routine activities
description: On the morning of the third day of the Lunar New Year, Lu Mingqiang woke up right on time, spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and completed 15 minutes of waist and core training. After a quick wash, he went to the kitchen to help his wife Wang Lijuan reheat the Wenchang chicken that his mother-in-law had packed the previous night, and cut some fruit. He woke up his two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and the whole family sat around together for breakfast, enjoying Hainan rice noodles and so on. During the meal, he told his wife that he had an appointment with his childhood friend Wang Hai in the morning, and would take the family to Evergreen Park in the afternoon to fly kites. After breakfast, he returned to his study, replied to Wang Hai's message, and flipped through the notes for the story 'Overseas Chinese Farm wine bottle' he had written the previous night, thinking about the entry point for continuing today's story, 'Li ethnic group totem wine bottle'.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family shopping and travel preparations.

They purchased kumquats, apples, pastries, and blueberries, which his second son loves. After returning home, Lu Mingqiang sorted the fruit and brought a small gift for Wang Hai—a keychain shaped like a local specialty liquor bottle. After checking his belongings, he got ready to leave.
location: RT-Mart (Guomao Store), Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Spring Festival get-together with childhood friend Wang Hai
description: Lu Mingqiang drove from Banshan Garden, heading along Jinmao Middle Road toward Shimao South Road, parked in the parking lot near Jiamie Food Stall, and walked over. Wang Hai was already waiting by the window, and the two hugged in greeting. They ordered two grilled fish, one spicy and one garlic-scented, plus cold dishes and beer. While eating and chatting, Wang Hai shared the ups and downs of his mobile phone accessories business in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen, while Lu Mingqiang talked about the changes in Hainan's electric power engineering industry and his determination to obtain the senior technician certificate. After the meal (around 13:00), the two strolled along the arcade street on Jiefang West Road, trying to recognize old buildings from their childhood memories, and took a photo together in front of the old department store. Then they walked to People's Park, sat on a bench, and recalled fun childhood memories of setting off firecrackers and playing hide-and-seek. When they parted, Wang Hai gave him two bottles of liquor specialty from Shenzhen as new additions to Lu Mingqiang's bottle collection.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Qilou Old Street on Jiefang West Road; People’s Park on Binhai Avenue.

name: Return trip and brief midday rest
description: After parting with Wang Hai, Lu Mingqiang drove back to his home in Banshan Garden. The morning walk made him sweat slightly but put him in a good mood. After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, closed his eyes, and rested on the living room sofa for twenty minutes to recover his strength.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Continue writing the cultural story of the Li ethnic group's totem wine bottle.
description: Lu Mingqiang made a cup of green tea, sat down at his desk, and opened the ideas and sketches he had noted in his phone memo the day before. He immersed himself in writing, describing in detail the frog and human-figure patterns on the Li ethnic totem relief wine bottle, reflecting on the meaning of Li brocade, and recalling how, as a child, he had seen Li grandmothers weaving tube skirts in the countryside of Qiongshan. He also searched online for the symbolism of the related patterns, added them to his notes, and completed his second detailed wine-bottle culture note.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner at parents' home
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the computer, picked up the fruit he had bought in the morning, called his wife, who was playing with Lego with their second son, and the family of three drove to his parents' home on Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District. As soon as they entered, his mother poked her head out of the kitchen and greeted them, and his father was playing with the second son in the living room. During dinner, his mother served her specialty steamed Hainan noodles and steamed pork ribs, and his father drank rice wine while encouraging Lu Mingqiang to earn the senior technician certificate. Lu Mingqiang solemnly promised to get the certificate this year. The whole family clapped and encouraged him, and the atmosphere was warm and uplifting. After dinner they chatted for a while and said goodbye to his parents around 7 p.m.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home and parent-child reading time

After arriving home, Lu Zihan perked up again and pulled Lu Mingqiang to the reading corner in the living room, asking to hear the picture book Little Bear Doesn't Brush His Teeth. Lu Mingqiang held his son on his lap and played the story characters in an exaggerated tone, making the child giggle, and read it twice as requested. Then he coaxed the child to take a bath. Meanwhile, the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, was reading an extracurricular book in his room.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening skills study and 100-day sprint plan.

He turned on the computer, entered an electrician technology forum, and saved a post titled "Experience Sharing on Technician Thesis Defense". Then he opened a brand-new notebook, wrote "100-Day Sprint" on the title page, and began breaking down the daily tasks: the first 30 days focusing on the theory question bank and reviewing the "Safety Work Regulations"; the middle 40 days focusing on practical simulation and writing the thesis outline; the final 30 days focusing on defense preparation. He wrote the plan stroke by stroke until 23:00.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime exercise and preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang closed his notebook and quickly scanned the key knowledge points of High-Voltage Equipment Maintenance in his phone memo. Then he completed the evening 15-minute core training for waist and abdomen, took a shower, and went to bed. His weight remained steady at 73.0 kg. Feeling fulfilled, he turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and get ready
description: The alarm clock rang at 6:20 in the morning. Lu Mingqiang got up, washed up in the bathroom, then changed into a sports short-sleeve shirt and compression pants, and put on the newly bought reinforced-support lumbar guard next to his skin, getting ready for his morning run. Then he drank a glass of warm water, took his keys and phone, and went out quietly so as not to wake his wife and child, who were still asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

The two first did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching, then jogged side by side along the park trail for 5 kilometers at a pace of about 6 and a half minutes per kilometer, chatting about their Spring Festival experiences and post-holiday work plans. After the run, they each did two sets of superman exercises and glute bridges on a bench near the sea to strengthen their lower back muscles. Lu Mingqiang specifically felt the support effect of his new lumbar support belt and was quite satisfied.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, take a shower, have breakfast, and take a short break with the family.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Bin, Lu Mingqiang drove back to Banshan Garden Residential Area and sent his wife a WeChat message on the way. When he got home, he took a refreshing hot shower and changed into a clean set of loungewear. In the dining room, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and olive vegetable. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, had finished eating and was watching cartoons in the living room, while his younger son, Lu Zihan, was still drinking milk. As he ate breakfast, Lu Mingqiang asked his wife about the lunch plans. When he learned that she would make Hainanese chicken rice, he was filled with anticipation. After the meal, he helped clear the dishes.
location: From Haidian Sixth West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District; afterward, at home in the living room and dining room.

name: Organize the toolbox in preparation for work
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the study, took out his tool bag from before the Spring Festival, put on gloves, carefully wiped the pliers, screwdrivers, wrenches and other tools with cleaner, and dripped anti-rust oil on the joints. While sorting things out, he thought about the work he might face after the holiday and moved the most frequently used tools to the most convenient spots in the bag. After tidying up, he placed the tool bag at the entryway so he could grab it directly when going to work the next day.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrote the third liquor bottle story.
description: Lu Mingqiang took out two bottles of Shenzhen specialty liquor given by his friend Wang Hai and an empty 1987 Haikou Daqu bottle he collected from the wine cabinet. He sat at his desk, opened his laptop, created a new document and named it "Stories in the Bottle (Part Three): The 1987 Haikou Daqu and Junpo Festival". Recalling scenes from his childhood when he followed his father to the Junpo Festival, he examined the label and bottle design of the old wine bottle. After about an hour and a half of writing, he completed a narrative of about 400 words, describing the important role of a good bottle of wine in the "Gongqi" activity in an era of scarce goods and the simple friendship of the older generation. After finishing, he saved the document and uploaded it to the cloud drive as a backup.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He put on an apron, took the ginger and scallions his wife handed him, rinsed them carefully at the sink, then skillfully sliced the ginger into thin pieces and tied the scallions into knots. His wife focused on chopping the chicken and prepping the ingredients. The two chatted while preparing food, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, picked up a piece of chicken thigh, dipped it in sauce, and ate heartily. The second son, Lu Zihan, was learning to use chopsticks to pick up chicken with his mother's help. Lu Mingqiang first filled a bowl of chicken soup for his wife, then picked his favorite chicken breast, dipped it in garlic sauce, and sighed with satisfaction that the chicken rice at home was still the most authentic. The whole family chatted and laughed, full of joy.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Noon break, parent-child interaction, and holiday discussion.

His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, was assembling a substation model; his younger son, Lu Zihan, was building a house. Lu Mingqiang occasionally gave guidance. Half an hour later, he got up to clear the dining table and dispose of kitchen waste. Then he sat on the sofa with his wife, Wang Lijuan, checked the calendar on his phone, and discussed plans for the next day. They preliminarily decided to go to the supermarket on the morning of the fifth day of the Lunar New Year to buy gifts to visit their parents, and in the afternoon take the children to grandma's home in Meilan District to pay a New Year's visit.

He cooperated with his eldest son Lu Zixuan, one holding the line and the other holding the kite, running against the wind; soon the kite was flying steadily high in the sky. His younger son Lu Zihan clapped and jumped with excitement nearby. Lu Mingqiang handed the reel to Zixuan and let him practice controlling the kite. The father and sons ran and played freely on the grass, enjoying more than an hour of joyful afternoon time.

Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa drinking water and resting, while browsing his phone to check work group messages.

Then he returned to the study to quickly read through and polish the wine-bottle story he had written that morning.

Lu Mingqiang played a game of Ludo with his two sons in the living room, and then used toy building blocks to put together a simple electricity tower. His wife Wang Lijuan video-called her relatives in her hometown on her phone, chatting about funny stories from the Spring Festival. The home was filled with a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

After the family lunch, Lu Mingqiang helped clear the table. Xuanxuan and Hanhan watched cartoons for a while and then went for a nap. Lu Mingqiang lay on the living room sofa for a rest and set a 40-minute alarm.

Father and son were in the study; Lu Mingqiang sat beside Xuanxuan, watching the instructional video with him, helping him identify the brightly colored block commands, and encouraging him to try operating them. Xuanxuan successfully completed the game where the red panda eats bamboo, and felt a great sense of achievement.

I'll really teach you the backhand.' He smiled and replied with a voice message: 'Fine, bring it on!' Half an hour later, he arrived at the CCCC Longqi Yayuan South District community. His father was fiddling with tools on the balcony. Seeing his son arrive, he put down the work and chatted about technical matters; his mother brought out hot rice cakes and asked him to take some back for the grandchildren to taste. Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room with his parents talking about work and Xuanxuan's programming class, in a warm and relaxed atmosphere.

Instead, he searched on his phone at home for “national coach squash backhand improvement tips,” watched professional teaching clips, and simulated the swing movements in his mind. He then recorded a video of his own shadow swing, compared it with the teaching points, and corrected the problems of turning his wrist too early and having an improper stance, adding confidence for the evening's friendly match.

Lu Mingqiang tried his best to run but lost several points due to his weak backhand. After the match, Lin Feng patted him on the shoulder and said, "Brother Qiang, you really need to work on your backhand basics, otherwise I don't feel right taking these points." Lu Mingqiang sincerely admitted he needed systematic improvement, and they high-fived, agreeing to play again next Sunday.

He ate the noodles while listening to Xuanxuan talk about the funny moments from the afternoon programming challenge. Hanhan sat on his lap and ate peeled wax apples with a small fork. The family atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Then he opened his WeChat chat with Lin Feng, sent the link, and left a message: "Just learned this. Next month I won't let you score easily. Once I get this set down pat, let's play again!"

description: Lu Mingqiang opened the textbook "Power System Relay Protection," turned to the chapter on distance protection impedance calculation, and sketched common distance protection wiring diagrams in his notebook while reading. He marked the zero-sequence compensation question he did not fully understand and planned to ask Master Li after work. After the 45-minute study session, he felt mentally tired but his notes were solid.

Wang Lijuan had already laid out the children's clothes for the next day by the bedside. Lu Mingqiang softly told her that the day had been quite solid, then turned off the light and lay down. As the kite and the backhand reminder from earlier in the day flashed through his mind, he gradually fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

description: At 6 a.m., the alarm went off and Lu Mingqiang got up right on time. Considering that his lower back muscles were sore from playing squash the day before, he adjusted today's core workout to gentle rehabilitation exercises. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of superman and glute bridge exercises, focusing on stretching and relaxing his lower back. After the workout, he felt his muscles were loose and comfortable and simply wiped off the sweat.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

description: After finishing training, Lu Mingqiang quickly took a shower and changed into clean work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: white porridge, fried eggs, and pickled mustard. While eating, he chatted with his wife about going to the food factory for the annual inspection today and reassured her. After the meal, he checked his commuting bag, confirmed that he had brought his water bottle and two spare masks, and got ready to go out.
location: The bathroom and kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Commuted to the company by bike.
description: Lu Mingqiang set off on his electric bike. The morning temperature in Haikou was about 18°C, cloudy, and it felt comfortable. He rode along Binhai Avenue. Traffic was slightly heavier than usual. About 20 minutes later, he arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.
location: From No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to No. 57, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (Binhai Avenue route)

name: Gather at the company to receive tasks and tools.
description: After arriving at the company, Lu Mingqiang changed into his work shoes and met up with his old partner Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang. Team leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks: go to the Xiuying Food Factory for the annual inspection of the power distribution cabinets. The three went to the tool room together and picked up a high-voltage tester, insulating gloves, a complete set of wrenches, a multimeter, and two spare red indicator lights. After checking them and confirming the count, they signed to confirm.
location: Company Tool Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Lu Mingqiang drove the company's small truck, Chen Jianguo sat in the passenger seat, and Zhao Qiang was in the back seat. On the way, Chen Jianguo brought up a high-voltage cabinet troubleshooting case he had seen the previous night on a senior technician forum. The two discussed the logic of the 'five-prevention' interlocking system, while Xiao Zhao listened carefully. According to the navigation, driving from the industrial park to the food factory takes about 22 minutes.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, on the way from No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, to the food factory in Xiuying District, inside the company's small truck

name: Routine maintenance of low-voltage distribution cabinets at the food factory (morning session)
description: After arriving at Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd. in Xiuying District, Lu Mingqiang confirmed the power-off scope with Xiao Liu, the factory electrician, and strictly followed the tag-out rule: Do Not Close Switch, Men at Work. The three divided the work: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for cleaning the main cabinets and testing insulation, Chen Jianguo tightened all secondary circuit terminals, and Zhao Qiang used a brush and air pump to remove dust inside the cabinets. During the work, Lu Mingqiang paid special attention to a star-delta starter cabinet, observing how its contactors and thermal relays were wired, comparing it with the circuit diagrams he planned to study in the evening. By 11:30, they had completed inspection of two main cabinets, insulation values were acceptable, and they replaced two burnt-out indicator lights.
location: The electrical distribution room of Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and midday rehabilitation exercises.
description: After finishing lunch in the food factory canteen (braised pork trotters rice), the three returned to the break room. Xiao Zhao scrolled through his phone, and Chen Jianguo made a cup of aged-salt lemon water. Lu Mingqiang spread old newspapers on the break room floor and did 15 minutes of lower back rehabilitation exercises (superman stretches and glute bridges, etc.). Chen Jianguo teased that he felt uncomfortable all over if he went a day without training.
location: Canteen and rest room of Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Called a master for advice.
description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang walked outside the break room and called his mentor, Master Li. He first asked about Master Li's health, then asked for advice about his confusion regarding the application scenario of the "zero-sequence compensation coefficient" he had encountered while studying relay protection the night before. Master Li explained the effect of zero-sequence current in single-phase ground faults in a simple, thorough way, using the handling case from Nandu River Substation. Lu Mingqiang listened while sketching diagrams in his notebook. After more than ten minutes, everything suddenly became clear, and he thanked him repeatedly.
location: A corner outside the break room at Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Continue the finishing work on power distribution cabinet maintenance.
description: Work resumed in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang in a 'physical exam' of the remaining capacitor compensation cabinets and bus tie cabinets, focusing on checking capacitors for bulging or leakage and tightening the busbar connecting bolts. Chen Jianguo verified the morning's test data and filled out the maintenance report. By 3:30 p.m., the inspection of all electrical equipment in the workshop was completed.
location: The electrical distribution room of Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company
description: After packing up all the tools and equipment and completing the handover procedures with the factory electrician, the three took the company truck back to the industrial park. According to the navigation, the return trip takes about 23 minutes.
location: From Hainan Dongquan Yuewei Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Lu Mingqiang took out the photos of the star-delta starter cabinet taken that morning and the improvement sketch he had drawn last night, exchanged ideas with Jianguo, and asked for advice on how to strip the semiconducting layer with wire strippers when making cable terminations without damaging the insulation. Jianguo demonstrated the key hand movements based on his own exam experience, and Lu Mingqiang carefully noted the essentials.
location: Tool room and rest area of the company at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He went in and bought a 10 kg bag of rice, a pack of toilet paper, and also brought a pack of cookies for the two children. The supermarket is about 1 km from home; after shopping, he cycled 3 minutes to get home.
location: From No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, via Wanghao Supermarket (Sunshine Store) at No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Family interaction after work.

Lu Mingqiang first put the rice and toilet paper into the storage cabinet, then helped Hanhan build a "little castle," praising his imagination. Afterward, he went to the kitchen to help his wife Wang Lijuan, who was washing vegetables, and peeled a few heads of garlic.
location: Living room and kitchen of the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

As they ate, Lu Mingqiang listened to his wife talk about how Hanhan's handmade craft work at kindergarten was praised by the teacher, then asked Xuanxuan whether he had encountered any questions he didn't understand at school today. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

As he read, he drew wiring diagrams of the main circuit and control circuit in the draft notebook, marked key points on the time relay and contactor interlock nodes, and also drew in the labels from the photos he had taken during the day.

Xuanxuan remembered it very clearly, not missing even the detail that "they ate 700 kilograms of plants a day." His younger brother Hanhan pointed at the pterosaur in the book and said, "This looks like a kite," making the whole family laugh. Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang checked Xuanxuan's math homework, found that two division word problems were a bit careless, and patiently guided him to recheck and correct them.
location: Living room/study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Showering and personal relaxation.
description: After showering, Lu Mingqiang felt relaxed and sat on the living room sofa in a vest and shorts. He picked up his phone and first sent a WeChat message to his squash partner Lin Feng: "Feng, next Sunday (the 16th), same time, same place, let's play a game. I've been practicing my backhand!" Then he scrolled through local news and industry forums for a while and read a push notification about the new type of smart switchgear.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

description: Entering the bedroom, his wife Wang Lijuan was already in bed watching a drama on her phone. Lu Mingqiang briefly told her about tomorrow's work arrangements (the company group chat had notified that there might be new equipment installation tomorrow morning), then set an alarm for 6:00 a.m. and habitually put his phone on the nightstand to charge.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Going to bed
description: After turning off the lights and lying down, he reviewed the day: successfully completing the food factory maintenance, exchanging hands-on tips with Jianguo, resolving his circuit study doubts in the evening, and seeing Xuanxuan's progress. He felt grounded and gratified, and soon fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

First, he did cat-cow pose to mobilize his spine, then side bridge from a reclining position, holding each set for 15 seconds and alternating for 3 sets. He felt his lower back muscles awaken and stiffness ease.
location: Bedroom, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

location: Bathroom and bedroom, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

description: His wife Wang Lijuan made Hainan rice noodles with pickled mustard greens and peanuts, and they ate them while hot. As they ate, she reminded the children to listen to their teacher at school on rainy days, not to run around, and to bring umbrellas. His wife said she would make sure they dressed warmly.

location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Team morning meeting and changing clothes
description: Went to the team rest room to change into work clothes. Team Leader Zhang announced that field work was canceled due to the rainy weather and that everyone should gather at the warehouse at 8:30. He arranged for everyone to thoroughly reorganize the warehouse materials, maintain the tools that needed maintenance, and scrap those that needed scrapping, and had Zhao Qiang learn from Master Lu. Chen Jianguo joked that at least they would not have to be exposed to wind and sun. Lu Mingqiang responded and patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Warehouse organization and apprentice guidance.
description: After Team Leader Zhang assigned the work, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang were responsible for tidying up the area with cable trays and wiring tools. Old Lu first took out a roll of old cable and told Xiao Zhao how to distinguish specifications by the color of the outer sheath and the printed markings; then he opened the toolbox and demonstrated how to use the continuity setting and resistance setting of a multimeter to check whether a cable was good. Xiao Zhao took careful notes and asked that the settings for measuring voltage and resistance on a multimeter were easy to confuse. Old Lu pointed to the symbols on the multimeter dial and tested the function with a piece of scrap wire. Chen Jianguo, while counting fasteners, teased Old Lu that he was more patient teaching an apprentice than teaching his own son. Meanwhile, Xiao Zhao sorted the cables of different colors, coiled them, and put them on the corresponding shelves. Halfway through, Old Lu went to get water and, incidentally, used needle-nose pliers to fix the loose socket holes on an old power strip he had brought from home.

name: Lunch and chatting with coworkers
description: The rain had eased slightly, and the three of them walked about 8 minutes to the fast-food restaurant with umbrellas. Lu Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with a fried egg, Chen Jianguo ordered braised pork trotter rice, and Zhao Qiang ordered seasoned noodles. They chatted while eating. Jianguo said his son scored 98 on the English exam, beaming. Lu Mingqiang asked Xiao Zhao whether he preferred the canteen or the fast-food restaurant. Xiao Zhao said the fast-food restaurant tasted better but was expensive. Old Lu said that when they go on field assignments, there are also fast-food restaurants near the construction site.

name: Midday rest in the team lounge.
description: After eating, he walked eight minutes back to the lounge. Some colleagues were scrolling on their phones, while others were napping at their desks. Lu Mingqiang put two stools together, used his coat as a cushion, and rested half-lying with his eyes closed. Accustomed to this routine, he soon fell asleep to the sound of rain and snoring.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Continue warehouse sorting and minor repairs.
description: In the afternoon, work continued. Team Leader Zhang brought a distribution box whose main breaker had tripped. He judged that the intermediate relay might have poor contact, and had Old Lu take Little Zhao to practice. Old Lu had Little Zhao cut the power first, then use a multimeter to measure the contact resistance. It turned out the normally open contact was stuck closed. They removed the faulty one and had Little Zhao find a new one of the same model in the warehouse and replace it. Meanwhile, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo moved the tools with unclear labels and rusted exteriors, sorted out in the morning, to the repair room, preparing to clean, oil, or scrap them.
location: Warehouse/Repair Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, commuted and picked up a package on the way
description: He packed up his tools early and left work, riding an electric bike from Xiuying District back to Longhua District, about a 15-minute ride. Remembering that his wife said a package had arrived, he dropped by the Cainiao Station next to the residential community on the way, gave the pickup code, and received a cardboard box. Seeing that the sender address was in Meilan District, he guessed it was the rice cakes his mother had sent.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Cainiao Station, No. 121 Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and then to Banshan Garden Residential Area.

name: Go home and change clothes
description: After arriving home, he hung the wet raincoat by the door and changed into dry slippers. Xuanxuan was building with LEGO while Hanhan was making mischief. Lu Mingqiang put down the package, picked up Hanhan, spun her around, and asked if she had been good at kindergarten; then he patted Xuanxuan on the head and asked if he had much homework. His wife poked her head out of the kitchen and told him to take a hot shower first so he wouldn't catch a cold.
location: Home, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Bodyweight strength training
description: Changed into sports shorts and a T-shirt, and went to the community fitness corner downstairs. Although it was still raining, it was dry under the canopy. He did 3 sets of push-ups with 20 reps each, and 3 sets of squats with 20 reps each. His body felt warm, the back soreness was relieved, and he completed the day's exercise goal.
location: Community fitness corner (with canopy), Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home for a shower
description: After training, he returned home, quickly took a hot shower, changed into clean loungewear, and felt completely at ease.
location: Bathroom, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and sharing daily life
description: His wife made braised pork ribs and stir-fried water spinach, and also pan-fried a plate of rice cakes sent by his mother—crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. The family sat around the table eating. Lu Mingqiang served food to the children, talking about teaching Xiao Zhao in the warehouse and about Jianguo's son scoring high on an exam. Hanhan rushed to say she had eaten two bowls of rice at noon, while Xuanxuan, unconvinced, said he had eaten three. The children bickered, and Old Lu smiled and told them to eat more slowly.
location: Dining room, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help the eldest son with his homework and keep the second son company.
description: After cleaning up, he had Xuanxuan bring over his math homework. One two-digit word problem was tricky, and Xuanxuan chewed on his pencil, unable to figure it out. Lu Mingqiang drew a line-segment diagram on scratch paper and guided him step by step to identify the numerical relationship. Xuanxuan finally wrote down the calculation and got the answer, clapping his hands happily. Hanhan was playing with dinosaur blocks nearby, and Old Lu occasionally turned around to praise him for building well.
location: Living room and study, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Brief conversation with wife.
description: After his wife finished washing the dishes and sat down on the sofa to rest, Lu Mingqiang sat down beside her. Pointing at the express package, he said it was probably rice cakes sent by his mother, and he would bring some to the company tomorrow for everyone to try. His wife said okay, she would fry a little in the morning for him to take. Then she mentioned that Xuanxuan's homeroom teacher had sent a message saying there would be a parent open day next week. When she asked who would go, Old Lu said he would go, to see what the children's class was like, and let his wife rest from housework.
location: Living room sofa, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Study PLC programming.
description: Sat down at the computer, opened the PLC simulation software, and, based on last night's work on ladder diagrams, tried to implement the simplest motor forward/reverse interlocking control logic. First drew the circuit schematic, then dragged contacts, coils, and interlocking circuit blocks in the programming window, repeatedly checking for errors such as “double coils” and “misaligned interlocking.” After compiling and downloading, ran the simulation. Seeing the output indicator lights turn on and off as expected gave a strong sense of accomplishment. Took a screenshot of the program diagram to ask Master Li for advice tomorrow.
location: Study room, Unit 2, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wife led the parent-child reading
description: While studying, he heard his wife in the living room telling the children to each pick a book they wanted to read. Xuanxuan chose “A Different Carmela,” and Hanhan picked a dinosaur picture book. name: Afternoon work: repairing the contactor of the streetlight control box
description: Lu Mingqiang took out a multimeter and did a full checkup on the control cabinet. First he measured the incoming main voltage; it was normal. Then he tested the output circuits and found abnormal coil resistance in the AC contactor. He determined that the coil had burned out, preventing the contacts from closing. Lu Mingqiang removed the old contactor and guided Zhao Qiang to install a new contactor of the same model, wiring, tightening, and testing it. After confirming everything was correct, he closed the switch and restored power, and the streetlight control cabinet returned to normal operation. He also checked the other wiring and terminal blocks in the cabinet, confirming there were no loose connections or overheating hazards. The job was finished just after 4 p.m., so he packed up his tools and drove back to the company with Zhao Qiang to clock out.

name: Annual maintenance of power distribution cabinets at Hongcheng Lake Commercial Plaza.

Lu Mingqiang was in charge of the core inspection, Zhao Qiang assisted in removing the cabinet door panels, and Chen Jianguo recorded the data. They used a multimeter and an insulation resistance tester to check insulation resistance section by section. When they found a loose wiring terminal on a control circuit in the outgoing cabinet of the refrigeration equipment room, Lu Mingqiang immediately tightened the wire core and added a spring washer to prevent loosening, recording this hazard in detail on the work order. At noon, the three ate boxed lunches in the mall staff rest area. During the meal, they chatted about amusing stories involving children's classes and blind dates, and Lu Mingqiang shared a funny story about his youngest son getting a little red flower. After lunch, Lu Mingqiang rested in a corner of the electrical room with his eyes closed for 20 minutes, reviewing the afternoon work plan. At 1 p.m., they resumed maintenance, replaced three sets of oxidized terminal blocks, performed five open-close tests on all frame circuit breakers rated above 200 A, and re-tightened the busbar connecting bolts with a torque wrench. At 4 p.m., all work was completed and power was restored successfully on the first attempt. The property supervisor expressed his thanks. Lu Mingqiang filled out the Annual Maintenance Work Order for Distribution Cabinets and specially noted the reinforcement of the loose wiring.
