name: Return to the company and take a short break
description: At exactly 11:00, the three packed up their tools and loaded them into the vehicle, then drove back to the industrial park. After returning to the company, Mingqiang washed his hands first, went back to the team rest area, poured a cup of hot water into his thermos cup, sat down and rested for a while, took out his phone to look at posts on the electrician forum, and gathered his energy for the afternoon meeting.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and chatting with coworkers
description: At 12 o'clock, the three of them walked to the nearby Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. Today Mingqiang ordered a spicy soup rice with a fried egg, Jianguo had pork trotter rice, and Xiao Zhao ordered stir-fried rice noodles. While eating, they talked about the afternoon safety production study session. Jianguo said, "I heard Manager Liu is going to talk about the newly revised Safety Regulations for Electric Power Work. Quite a few clauses about working at heights have been changed, so we need to listen carefully." Mingqiang nodded in agreement, "Indeed, every time I watch accident videos I get terrified — we can't afford to slacken when it comes to safety."
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and preparation
description: After lunch, he returned to the company; it was already 1 PM. Mingqiang leaned back in a chair in the break room and rested with his eyes closed for twenty minutes. When he woke up, he went to his workstation to get his dedicated work notebook and pen, flipped to a blank page in advance, and prepared to take notes at the afternoon meeting. He also took out his phone, opened the electronic version of the new regulations, and browsed through it to get a rough idea of what he was about to learn.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Attended the company's monthly safety production learning meeting.
description: At 2 p.m., the meeting started on time. Manager Liu presided. He first explained the newly revised Safety Work Regulations for Electric Power, emphasizing mandatory rules such as double-hook alternating protection for work at height and daily testing of residual current devices for temporary power before starting work each day. Then the meeting played a warning video of an accident involving an arc burn caused by illegal operation. Seeing the victim's terrible condition in the video made Mingqiang's heart tighten. Subconsciously, he gripped his pen and quickly wrote down the cause of the accident and his own reflections in his notebook.
location: Large meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organizing notes and discussing implementation with the team
description: After the 4 o'clock meeting, Mingqiang returned to his workstation, opened his notebook, and organized the key revisions of the new regulations and the accident chain analysis item by item. With a red pen, he heavily marked three changes that must be implemented immediately: 1. Before checking for the absence of voltage, confirm that the voltage tester is in good condition; 2. Double-hook protection for work at heights; 3. The residual current device for temporary power must be tested every day. Then he called Jianguo and Xiao Zhao over and discussed in the rest area how to quickly implement them. After discussing, the three decided to post a 'Three-Step Voltage Verification Confirmation' tip in a prominent position on the toolbox, and agreed that starting tomorrow, they would supervise each other's proper use of safety belts for work at heights.
location: Engineering Department Office and Team Rest Area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: At 5 p.m., he clocked out. Mingqiang rode his e-bike to the Jinlong Vegetable Market near his company first, bought the pork ribs and two sweet corn cobs he had promised Juanzi in the morning, and also picked out a bunch of fresh water spinach. After shopping, he rode back to Banshan Garden Residential Area at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, parked his e-bike, and carried the groceries upstairs.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District; Jinlong Vegetable Market, Haixiu Road; Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Family time and dinner
description: After arriving home, Juanzi was busy in the kitchen. Mingqiang handed her the ribs and corn, saying, “We'll have this soup tonight, it's sweet and refreshing.” Then he went to the living room, played with his 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan with blocks for a while, and checked the math homework of his 8-year-old older son Lu Zixuan, pointing out a wrong approach in a word problem. At 6:30, the family sat around the dining table eating a piping-hot meal — rib and corn soup, water spinach, and Juanzi's specialty pan-fried mackerel. At the table, Mingqiang mentioned to Juanzi, “I saw that the Lady Xian Cultural Festival over in Meilan District is coming up, I think it's called the Junpo Festival. There's a lion dance parade at night. Want to take the kids to see it?” Juanzi happily agreed.
location: Living room and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Search for cultural festival information and finalize family activities
description: After dinner, Juanzi cleared the dishes, while Mingqiang sat on the sofa and used his phone to search for the official public account of the 'Xian Lady Cultural Festival in Meilan District'. He found a detailed schedule and noticed that at 7 p.m. on February 19 (tomorrow) there would be a lion dance, bayin music performance, and a costume parade on Zhongshan Road's arcade street. He took a screenshot of the time and location and forwarded it to Juanzi. The two chatted briefly on WeChat and decided that the whole family would go out tomorrow evening to experience the folk atmosphere.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Video call with childhood friend Wang Hai
description: At 7:40, his phone rang—it was a video call from his childhood friend Wang Hai, who was far away in Shenzhen. After connecting, the two chatted for forty minutes. Wang Hai talked about the opening of his new shop in Huaqiangbei, saying that while business wasn't easy, the momentum was good. Mingqiang then talked about how he had troubleshooted a ring main unit fault the day before, and his embarrassment last night when his backhand was still weak during squash practice. Wang Hai laughed heartily on the other side of the video and encouraged him: "Skills need to improve, but life also needs proper relaxation! Next time I go back, let's go have Laoba tea and find a place to eat grilled fish!" After hanging up, Mingqiang was in a good mood.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Study power system analysis in the evening.
description: After the video ended, at 8:20 p.m., Mingqiang enters the study, takes out the senior technician textbook and notebook, and begins studying the 'Power System Analysis' chapter. He focuses on tackling the two difficult points of 'short-circuit current calculation' and 'relay protection coordination,' drawing equivalent circuit diagrams on paper and verifying them step by step. He also incorporates a case about distribution network power flow analysis he saw on an electrician forum, simulating and comparing it with the residential distribution room situations he deals with daily, and his thinking gradually becomes clear.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening lower back stretching and bodyweight strength training
description: After the study session ended, at 21:10, Mingqiang began his evening workout in the open area of the living room. Today he focused on stretching and isometric contraction training. First, he did 5 minutes of supine knee-to-chest stretches to relax his lower back, then 3 sets of dead bugs to stabilize his core. Finally, he completed bodyweight strength training: 3 sets of 20 push-ups and 3 sets of 20 bodyweight squats. After finishing, he felt much less stiffness in his lower back from sitting through meetings during the day.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 21:45, Mingqiang took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. Back in the bedroom, he picked up the notebook on the nightstand and quickly reviewed tomorrow's work memo—the morning would be spent doing routine equipment inspection at Jinlianyuan Community. He had a general idea of the plan. He turned off the desk lamp and set the alarm.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After lying down in bed, Mingqiang and Juanzi chatted a bit about things to note for tomorrow evening's Junpo Festival parade, such as bringing an extra jacket for the kids and leaving early. After chatting, he habitually checked his phone to make sure no messages were missed. At 22:50, he turned off his phone, closed his eyes, thought about the fulfilling day, and fell peacefully asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang was woken by his biological clock. Looking forward to the folk activities in the evening, he felt full of anticipation. First, he did 10 minutes of waist stretching and core activation exercises in his bedroom to keep his lumbar spine flexible. Then he woke his wife Wang Lijuan and their two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and the whole family washed up together. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, put on his school uniform by himself, while the younger son, Hanhan, was still groggy and was dressed by his wife. Around 7 o'clock, the family got ready to go out.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school
description: At 7:15, Lu Mingqiang got on his electric bike and set off with his two sons. He first went to Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road in Longhua District, arriving at 7:25, and handed his younger son Hanhan to the teacher. Then he turned around with his elder son Xuanxuan, rode from Longhua District to Meilan District, weaving carefully through the morning rush-hour traffic, and arrived at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road at 7:45. Lu Mingqiang told Xuanxuan to go straight home after school and that his grandparents would pick him up, then rode on to the company.
location: Haikou Jinmao Central Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province) and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Arrived at the company, had breakfast, and attended the morning meeting
description: At 7:50, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. He bought two glutinous rice cakes and a cup of soy milk at a breakfast stall at the entrance of the industrial park, and walked into the team while eating. At 8:05, he arrived at the team break room and changed into his work clothes. At 8:10, Team Leader Zhang held a morning meeting and assigned the day's tasks: two old residential communities in Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District had submitted repair requests, one for unstable voltage and one for a tripping circuit breaker. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to accept the work orders and asked to bring apprentice Zhao Qiang with him. Team Leader Zhang agreed. Li Mingming then asked to take two hours of compensatory leave in the afternoon, using his previously accumulated overtime; Team Leader Zhang confirmed it in the system.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handle low-voltage faults in residential areas and mentor apprentices.
description: At 8:20, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang set out on electric bikes for work. They first came to Cuizhuyuan Residential Community on Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District. After inspection, they found that oxidation at the outgoing terminal of the meter box had caused poor contact and voltage instability. Lu Mingqiang sanded the wire ends and applied conductive paste while explaining to Zhao Qiang how to identify the hazard that the oxide layer is non-conductive and prone to heating. The problem was handled by 9:30. Then the two rode to the nearby Supply and Marketing Cooperative Dormitory on Yusha Road, arriving at 10:00. The inspection showed that the old leakage protector had aged and was tripping falsely. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang in hands-on replacement of the new leakage protector and explained its principle in detail. All faults were cleared and power restored at 11:30 a.m. The two packed up their tools and rode back to the company.
location: Cuizhuyuan Residential Community on Jinmao Middle Road and the Supply and Marketing Cooperative Dormitory on Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned to the company to submit documents, change clothes, and have lunch.
description: At noon, 12:00, he returned to the company. Lu Mingqiang quickly filled out two work orders and submitted them. At 12:05, he and Zhao Qiang walked to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on the first floor of Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, nearby. Because there were many diners, after a short wait Lu Mingqiang ordered a plate of Chinese sausage fried rice, which was served at 12:20. While eating, he told Zhao Qiang to learn more from Chen Jianguo in the afternoon. At 12:35 they finished eating, and the two returned to the company. Lu Mingqiang went to the changing room, changed out of his work uniform, and got on his e-bike to go home.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Cycling home.
description: At 12:50, Lu Mingqiang set off from Haisheng Road in Xiuying District and rode his bike home along Haixiu Middle Road. He was in no hurry, occasionally glancing at roadside shops. At 13:10, he reached the downstairs of Banshan Garden on Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, parked the bike, and went upstairs.
location: Cycling from No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: At home, prepare the parade items with the family.
description: At 1:15 p.m., Lu Mingqiang got home; his wife Wang Lijuan was wiping the table. He lent a hand, and together they prepared things for the evening cultural festival. Lu Mingqiang found the two small Tang-style jackets he had bought before the New Year and planned to have the children try them on after school. At 3:30 p.m., their second son Hanhan was picked up from kindergarten by a neighbor lady; at 4:00, their eldest son Xuanxuan was picked up from primary school by his grandparents and brought to the downstairs entrance. The two children were very excited when they got home. Xuanxuan put on his little armor himself, and Hanhan hung on an auspicious-lion sachet. The whole family checked their supplies: thermos cups, biscuits, wet wipes, two folding stools, small flags, and his wife also prepared some fruit. At 4:30, everyone changed into thicker clothes and got ready to leave.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving to the main venue of the cultural festival
description: At 4:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove the family car from Banshan Garden with the whole family on board. Although it was not yet rush hour, traffic toward Meilan District was gradually increasing. He chose to take Haifu Road to bypass the congestion, and the drive took 35 minutes. At 5:05 p.m., they arrived near the Meilan District Rule-of-Law Culture Square, found a roadside parking space, parked, and the family walked into the square.
location: Drove from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the Rule of Law Cultural Square, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Square Walk and Dinner
description: After entering the square, quite a few people had already gathered, and the snack stalls and folk-custom booths were set up. The family first took a stroll to soak in the lively atmosphere. At 5:30 p.m., they found a stall selling Wenchang chicken and baoluo noodles. Everyone ordered a serving of baoluo noodles, and they also ordered white-cut Wenchang chicken for the children. They finished dinner at 6 p.m. as night gradually fell.
location: Around the Rule of Law Culture Square, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Watching the lion dance and bayin performance.
description: At 6:30 in the evening, the main stage lights came on and the sound of gongs and drums rang out. The professional lion dance team took the stage; the colorful lions leaped and plucked the greens, and the children watched, fascinated. Lu Mingqiang let his eldest son Xuanxuan ride on his shoulders, and Xuanxuan waved a small flag and cheered. His wife stood nearby holding their younger son Hanhan. At 7 p.m., the lion dance ended, and the bayin ensemble performed next, playing lively Hainan tunes on suona and yehu. Lu Mingqiang recorded several videos on his phone to send to his father.
location: In front of the main stage of the Rule of Law Culture Square, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The whole family takes part in the military-costume parade
description: At 7:30 p.m., the traditional military-costume parade officially began. An ancient-costume honor guard and a martial arts team led the way. Xuanxuan put on a small suit of armor and excitedly joined the children's formation, marching with his head held high and chest out. Lu Mingqiang carried Hanhan and followed alongside, while his wife kept taking photos. Residents along the street threw popcorn, candy, and coins. Xuanxuan picked up several candies, his eyes shining. The whole neighborhood was extremely lively. The whole family followed the procession for about one kilometer, and Hanhan also trotted alongside excitedly.
location: Rule of Law Culture Square and surrounding streets, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Driving home on the return trip
description: At 8:30 PM, the parade ended and the crowd gradually dispersed. The children were tired but still excited. At 8:35 PM they walked back to the parking spot, and at 8:40 PM drove home. The roads were clear at night, and they arrived home smoothly at 8:55 PM.
location: Drive from the Rule of Law Cultural Square, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Video sharing and organizing photos
description: After arriving home at 9:10 p.m., Lu Mingqiang washed the children's faces and feet. Xuanxuan grabbed the phone, immediately made a WeChat video call to his grandparents, who live in the Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District, and talked at length about his impressive experiences in the parade. Lu Mingqiang, meanwhile, turned on his computer, exported the photos and videos taken that night, and picked out the clearest ones to share with the family group chat to make his parents happy too.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Brief study and rehabilitation training
description: At 9:45 p.m., his wife took the two sons to bed. Lu Mingqiang used the time before bed to take out the senior technician textbook "Fault Diagnosis Technology," quickly flipped through it for 15 minutes, and marked the chapter on motor winding faults. At 10 p.m., he did beginner-level core activation exercises on the living room mat, including glute bridges and dead bugs, for 10 minutes to maintain a good feeling in his lower back.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: At 10:30 PM, Lu Mingqiang finished washing up and chatted briefly with his wife, who was lying in bed looking at her phone. His wife said Xuanxuan was especially excited tonight and said he wanted to go every year from now on. Lu Mingqiang felt satisfied too. At 11 PM they turned off the lights, ending a busy and happy day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early rising and morning activities
description: At 6:30, the phone alarm went off right on time. Lu Mingqiang turned over and got up, spread the exercise mat on the living room floor, and began 15 minutes of lower back rehabilitation and core activation training: starting with the cat-cow stretch, then completing 2 sets of planks and 1 set of dead bugs. He felt his lower back muscles gradually relax and his sacroiliac joint loosen up. After training, he quickly took a warm shower and changed into a clean work uniform. Then he knocked on the bedroom doors one by one, gently waking his wife Wang Lijuan, and loudly called to wake his two sons Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, making sure they had time to fully wake up, before going to the bathroom to wash up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the child to school and shop on the way
description: After the whole family had breakfast of rice noodle soup cooked by his wife, they checked the two children's schoolbags and set off on an electric bike. The second son, Lu Zihan, sat on the rear seat, and the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, sat in front. They first took 10 minutes to take Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten and watched as he was picked up by his teacher; then rode another 15 minutes to take Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. After watching the child walk through the school gate, he turned the bike around and headed to the Dongcheng Professional Power Tools store on Haisheng Road, where he bought a new digital multimeter (the old one's backlight had broken), and also picked up small wooden boards, screws, and glue, planning to make an electric toy car model with the children on the weekend, spending 28 yuan in total.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing by Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao 3rd Horizontal Road, Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and ending at Dongcheng Professional Power Tools (Chuxin Garden Branch), No. 21-5 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Attend the morning meeting and perform quarterly maintenance on the transformer.
description: After arriving at the company, Lu Mingqiang walked quickly into the team rest room and attended the morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang. Team Leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks, arranging for Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang to go to the food processing factory on Haisheng Road to perform quarterly maintenance on a 200 kVA transformer. After the meeting, the three carried tools and testing instruments such as a megohmmeter and wrenches, and drove a pickup truck to the factory's power distribution room in 3 minutes. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for using the megohmmeter to measure the insulation resistance to ground and between phases on the high- and low-voltage sides of the transformer. Chen Jianguo checked the oil level and the color of the silica gel in the breather. Zhao Qiang tightened the terminal bolts and took photos for records. Lu Mingqiang also deliberately used a flashlight to carefully check the tap changer position, and compared it with the previous record, finding no abnormality. The whole maintenance process was well-coordinated. They completed all the work and site cleanup by 10:30, ensuring reliable power for the factory area.
location: Electrical distribution room at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the nearby food processing factory

name: Return trip and tool organization
description: At exactly 11:00, the three packed up the equipment and drove back to the company. After returning to the crew, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo carefully wiped down the used megger, wrenches, and other tools, and put them back in their original places in the storeroom. Zhao Qiang filled in the work record at his workstation.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch, contacting mentor, and recording exam preparation information
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant next to his company and ordered a serving of spicy soup rice for lunch. Around noon, he found a quiet corner outside the restaurant and called his master, Master Li. After a respectful greeting, he directly asked about the registration time for the senior technician theory exam, the practical assessment process, and the key areas to review. Master Li answered patiently, emphasizing that he should focus on automatic devices and fault diagnosis, and that the defense should draw heavily on his own work cases. He also encouraged him to sign up without hesitation and said he would help find his old review materials. After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang immediately took out his pocket notebook and jotted down the key information: registration requires an ID card, the original and a copy of the electrician certificate, and three 2-inch color photos with a blue background; the preliminary review is in mid-March; the theory exam is in April; the focus is on automatic devices, fault diagnosis, and case analysis. He then sent a voice message of thanks to his master via WeChat.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon rest and preview.
description: Back at the company break room, Lu Mingqiang leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for about 15 minutes. Then he took out his newly purchased digital multimeter, and following the manual, used batteries and small resistors to test the measurement functions and familiarize himself with the operation.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Entering reports and organizing the storeroom
description: At 1 p.m., Lu Mingqiang opened his computer at his workstation and entered the photos of the transformer tap changer positions taken in the morning and the insulation resistance test data one by one into the electronic work order system, noting good operating condition, no abnormalities. After completing the report, he went to the tool warehouse with Chen Jianguo, reorganized and placed the tools on the shelves, carefully inspected and picked out a batch of expired insulating gloves and voltage detectors, registered them, and prepared them for scrapping.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Internal technical exchange within the work group
description: After the warehouse was tidied up, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang held a technical exchange in the rest room. Lu Mingqiang thought of the "fault diagnosis" Master Li had mentioned, so he opened his phone and played a video of an eight-tone band performance recorded at the Madam Xian Culture Festival, using it as an analogy: troubleshooting, like eight-tone music, must be orderly and follow a process. Then, combining the earlier focus on "automatic devices," he discussed common cases of automatic switching failure in distribution cabinets with the two, sharing experiences with each other as a form of disguised study for the senior technician exam.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Left work and went home.
description: Getting off work at five, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike toward home. On the way, he passed a fruit stall, stopped, bought two pineapples and a bunch of bananas for 15 yuan, and took them home for the family to taste.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Arrived home and helped with household chores
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang greeted his wife Wang Lijuan, who was trimming vegetables in the kitchen, and handed her the fruit he had bought. He then took the wooden boards and screws he had purchased that morning into the room and put them away. Seeing that there was still some time before dinner, he went to the balcony, brought in the dried clothes, folded them neatly, and put them into the wardrobe.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and parent-child interaction
description: At 6:30, his wife prepared a nice meal, and the family of four sat around the dining table eating and chatting. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, excitedly talked about the new exercise routine he learned in PE class at school, while the youngest son, Lu Zihan, shared in a sweet childlike voice about the braised pork he ate at kindergarten. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang checked Xuanxuan's math homework, found that a word problem had a wrong approach, and patiently explained it with diagrams. Then he played with Hanhan using the wooden boards and screws they bought today, briefly teaching him how to use a screwdriver. The little guy enjoyed it a lot.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discussed the exam budget with his wife.
description: While his wife was washing dishes in the kitchen, Lu Mingqiang took the notebook recording the exam information into the study. After his wife finished, he called her into the study and seriously explained that the senior technician exam registration and possible purchase of materials would cost about 800 yuan, and discussed reserving it from next month's salary so that daily expenses would not be affected. Wang Lijuan readily agreed, believing that passing the exam would lead to a salary increase, and encouraged him to prepare for the exam with peace of mind, saying the family was taken care of by her and the money was enough.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Systematic study
description: After talking with his wife, Lu Mingqiang sat down at his desk and opened the textbook "Safety Regulations and Construction Management." Comparing it with the notes from the work safety study meeting the day before yesterday, he focused on learning the writing standards for "construction organization measures" and "technical measures," and used a red pen to make heavy marks in the paragraphs distinguishing the responsibilities of the work ticket issuer, the person in charge, and the work permit issuer. He also turned to the chapter "Voltage Testing and Installing Grounding Wires," and deepened his understanding by combining it with his experience of disposing of the expired voltage detector while organizing the warehouse today.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Core strength and bodyweight training.
description: At 9:10, hearing that his wife was taking the children to wash up and get ready for bed, Lu Mingqiang closed his book and went to the living room to start his exercise for the day. Because of the frequent climbing, his lower back began to feel tight, so he deliberately adjusted his breathing and used his thighs to exert force to reduce the strain on his lumbar spine.

name: Organize survey data

He took off his sweat-soaked work clothes, wiped his face, and turned on the computer to digitize the survey records and sketches of the two residential communities. On the CAD drawings, he marked hazard points such as aging wiring, unauthorized connections, and damaged meter boxes in different colors, attached on-site photos, and planned to hand the preliminary data to Team Leader Zhang the next day.
location: Office building of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Xuanxuan was waiting for him with a smile at the school gate. On the way, the father and son stopped at Shichang Hardware Store at No. 7 Jinmao Middle Road, bought a roll of 3M black electrical tape, and chatted with the owner for a bit, who said the waterproof tape he bought last time was of good quality.
location: First go to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, then to Shichang Hardware Store (Mengyuan Community Branch), 7 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Encountered a neighbor asking for help on the way home.

Lu Mingqiang parked the bike, comforted Uncle Wang, and said he had brought tools and would go take a look right away.
location: Downstairs at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped a neighbor troubleshoot an electrical fault
description: Lu Mingqiang told Xuanxuan to go home first, then carried his tool bag and followed Uncle Wang upstairs. After inspection, he found that the leakage protector tripped when the water heater circuit was closed, and judged that the water heater heating element had aged and was leaking electricity. He helped Uncle Wang bypass the water heater to restore power to the rest of the house, and suggested that Uncle Wang contact the manufacturer to replace the heating element, and if that didn't work, he would come on the weekend to replace it. Uncle Wang thanked him repeatedly and insisted on giving him a pack of cigarettes.

name: Go home to shower and bond with the kids

Four-year-old Hanhan was watching cartoons, and Xuanxuan was doing math problems. He walked over, leaned against the sofa, and while drying his hair, asked Xuanxuan whether the homework was difficult, enjoying a moment of relaxation.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Juanzi made pan-fried mackerel, stir-fried squid rings with scallions, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of four sat around the table eating. Lu Mingqiang talked about the spider-web-like wiring he had seen in the shantytown during the day. Xuanxuan asked curiously, and Juanzi put food in his bowl, telling him not to keep thinking about work. The dinner atmosphere was warm and peaceful.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Housework and homework tutoring
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to clear the table, while Juanzi cleaned the stove. He watched cartoons with Hanhan for a while, then sat down in the study to check Xuanxuan's math homework. Finding that an equation in a word problem was set up incorrectly, he guided Xuanxuan to reread the problem and distinguish between “two times more” and “increases to two times”.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening professional skill study
description: After Xuanxuan finished correcting his homework and went off to play, Lu Mingqiang opened the textbook High-Voltage Power Distribution Systems in the study. He focused on Chapter 4 of the Technical Guidelines for Renovating Power Distribution Systems in Old Residential Communities, which covers line loss calculation and short-circuit capacity verification. Comparing the photos of the electricity meter boxes he had taken at Binhai New Village during the day, he substituted the actual load data into the theoretical formulas to deepen his understanding. He also paid special attention to the fault tree analysis diagram for 'broken bar faults' in the appendix.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening exercise and rehabilitation training
description: Lu Mingqiang put on his sneakers and went downstairs. At the community fitness area, he did hanging stretches on the pull-up bar, holding each for 15 seconds to feel his shoulders and back stretch, for a total of 3 sets. Back home, he did lower back rehabilitation exercises on the living room mat: single-leg balance pad stands for 30 seconds, side bridges for 45 seconds per side, and slow bird-dog exercises 12 times, feeling his core muscles contract. He then used a foam roller to relax his lower back and hips, and his wife pressed the tight spots around his shoulder blades. The tightness in his lower back was noticeably relieved.
location: Public fitness area of Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and home

name: Free activity and socializing.
description: Leaning on the living room sofa and scrolling on his phone, he saw a push notification about the layout of electric vehicle charging piles in Hainan and thought it was worth researching. He sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Bin to invite him for a morning run tomorrow, and the other party instantly replied with agreement. Then he chatted a bit in the group with his friend Gangzi, who suggested going fishing on the weekend. Lu Mingqiang said he'd think about it.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime study log and parent-child reading.
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Lu Mingqiang took out his notebook, drew a circuit diagram, and wrote: Problem: What is the actual arc phenomenon in a broken bar fault? Action: Ask Master Li tomorrow. Improvement: Load calculations for old residential areas need to focus on the air-conditioning usage coincidence factor. Then he went into the children's room and told Xuanxuan and Hanhan the story of "The Praying Mantis Hunts" from The Book of Insects. The children were captivated. After finishing, he tucked them in, turned off the light, and closed the door. Back in the master bedroom, his wife had already turned off the light. He lay down and soon fell asleep.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning run and family breakfast
description: Waking up at 6:30 in the morning, I did some simple warm-up stretches in bed to wake up my body. Then I changed into running clothes and went out, riding my e-bike to Wanlv Garden Park to meet my running buddy Chen Bin. We jogged five kilometers together, keeping the pace at about six minutes per kilometer, and chatted about running tips and our physical condition as we ran. After the run, I did ten minutes of stretching by the lawn, focusing on relaxing my calves and lower back. Then I returned home. My wife Wang Lijuan was already up preparing breakfast. I quickly took a shower and changed into work clothes, then ate rice porridge, fried eggs, and BBQ pork buns with my wife and my second son Lu Zihan. During the meal, I also fed Hanhan some egg and listened to him recite a new nursery rhyme he had learned in kindergarten, enjoying a short but warm morning.
location: No. 1, Banshan Garden, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Evergreen Park

name: Dropping off the children and team morning meeting
description: After breakfast, he took his second son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. The child sat on the back seat of the e-bike, and they arrived in a few minutes; he watched as the teacher led him through the gate. Then, remembering that his colleague Zhao Qiang had not eaten breakfast, he went to a roadside breakfast stall and bought a steamer basket of steamed dumplings and a cup of soy milk, then rode for fifteen minutes to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. In the workwear room, he changed into the full work uniform and put on a safety helmet. At 8:20 he attended the team morning meeting. Team leader Zhang Yongqiang emphasized the task of inspecting the third old residential community that day, requiring focused checks on joint temperatures. After the meeting, he handed the steamed dumplings to Zhao Qiang.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (passing by Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten and the breakfast stall on Jinmao Middle Road)

name: Surveyed wiring in an old residential community in the morning
description: Together with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, carrying toolboxes and an infrared thermometer, they drove to an old residential area on Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City. Built in the early 1990s, the area had severely aging wiring. They checked the main distribution boxes and branch connectors of each building unit one by one and measured temperatures with the thermometer. In Buildings 3 and 7, they found three connectors with abnormally high temperatures, one of which even showed signs of arcing. Lu Tianqin used his phone to photograph and record the locations and severity of the hazards, and wrote down the inspection data in detail.
location: Old residential community on Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and sorting notes
description: After the morning inspection came to an end, the three went to Aqiang Lingshui Sour Noodle Shop on Yilong West Road for lunch. Lu Tianqin and Chen Jianguo each ordered beef brisket sour noodles, while Zhao Qiang had pig trotter rice. While waiting for their food, they discussed the hazards found in the morning and the renovation plan. After the meal, they parked the inspection vehicle in the shade to rest. Jianguo and Zhao Qiang dozed off, while Lu Tianqin took out his notebook, reorganized the hazard data recorded in the morning, and marked the points needing priority treatment, preparing for the afternoon work.
location: Aqiang Lingshui Sour Noodle Shop and nearby parking spaces, Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Continue surveying the old residential community in the afternoon.
description: After the break, they continued the inspection work. Lu Tianqin was responsible for climbing up to check the exposed incoming service wires and found that the aluminum jumper wires between buildings had oxidized. He called Chen Jianguo to confirm with binoculars, then recorded the new hidden danger to make sure no issues were missed.
location: Old residential community on Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Process the renewal of the high-voltage electrician certificate.
description: While recording data on the roof of Building 7, his phone received a text message from the Haikou Work Safety Qualification Examination Center, reminding him that his high-voltage electrician operation certificate was about to expire and needed re-examination. Lu Tianqin immediately read the message, then opened his phone calendar, set the re-examination date to March 1, and set an advance reminder. He then called his master, Master Li, to consult about the re-examination process, and learned that he needed to register online, attend one day of training, take a computer-based exam, and bring his ID card and old certificate. After hanging up, he used his phone to log in to the examination center website, filled in his personal information and certificate number online, selected the training session on March 1, and submitted it. After the confirmation receipt was generated, he took a screenshot and saved it, and also set an alarm for 7:00 that morning.
location: Rooftop of Building 7, old residential community, Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Completed the site inspection and returned to the company
description: After dealing with the reexamination matters, Lu Tianqin returned to work. He and his colleagues hurriedly completed the line inspections of the remaining two buildings and checked the main distribution room of the residential complex. Around 4 p.m., all tasks were completed. Back in the car, he merged all of today's hazard photos and recorded data into one folder. The three of them then drove back to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, talking about the exam reexamination on the way and sharing experiences.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (on the way back and at the company).

name: Organizing survey data and reporting
description: Back in the company office, Lu Tianqin immediately turned on his computer and entered the 26 hazard points found during the day's inspection into an Excel spreadsheet, generating preliminary rectification suggestions by urgency level. Then he took the printed report and reported to squad leader Zhang Yongqiang, highlighting the three high-temperature connector hazards in the Yilong West Road residential community, and suggested purchasing copper-core insulated wires to replace the aging aluminum wires. Zhang Yongqiang approved the plan and told him to pick up materials at the warehouse the next day.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Then on the way, he went to Shichang Hardware Store on Jinmao Middle Road and bought a roll of insulating tape. The shop owner, Old Chen, chatted with him about the wiring in the neighborhood. Afterward, he rode 5 minutes back home to Banshan Garden with the child.

During the meal, he talked about inspecting the wiring in the old residential community during the day, and his eldest son Lu Zixuan listened with great interest. He also reminded Zixuan that the midterm exam was next week and told him to take out his math book to review in the evening.
location: Home, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Tutoring homework and parent-child shared reading.
description: After dinner, Lu Tianqin accompanied his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, in the study to do math homework. After reading, he gave the children reading check-in stickers, and they happily put them up on the wall.

Then he opened the recertification question bank app on his phone and did fifty multiple-choice questions. He saved screenshots of the wrong questions, which were mainly concentrated on "safety color codes" and "electrical fire separation distances", planning to ask Master Li about them the next day.

Finally, he spread out the yoga mat and spent five minutes doing cat-cow and child's pose to relax his back, easing the lower back fatigue from a day of work.

name: Evening washing up
description: After the workout, Lu Tianqin was covered in sweat and took a hot shower in the bathroom, washing away the fatigue of the day and feeling refreshed all over.
location: Home bathroom, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Chatting with wife and reviewing before the exam.

After Lu Tianqin lay down, he talked with her about their plan to visit his parents over the weekend. Juanzi also wanted to go and planned to bring the little sweater his mother had knitted for Hanhan. After chatting, he picked up his phone and spent another ten-plus minutes reviewing the re-examination question bank, focusing on memorizing two figures: "compression depth 5-6 cm" and "rate 100-120 compressions/min." Then he turned off his phone, picked up the notepad from the nightstand, and wrote "motor broken bar fault analysis" to ask Master Li the next day.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Soaking feet and relaxing before bedtime.

After soaking his feet, he returned to the bedroom, checked his phone and saw nothing urgent, then turned off the light, said goodnight to his wife, turned over, and soon fell asleep.
location: Living room and master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake-up, breakfast, and kindergarten drop-off commute
description: The morning sky was overcast. The alarm rang on time. Mingqiang got up, washed up, and did cat-cow stretches and child's pose in the living room to loosen his muscles. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and meat buns for breakfast. name: Morning meeting, warehouse material pickup, and preparation work.
description: After changing into his work clothes and putting on his safety helmet, Mingqiang attended the team morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang. Team Leader Zhang stressed the importance of checking for hidden hazards before the summer peak season, and arranged for the day to focus on handling hazard points and being on standby. Mingqiang proactively reported the connector hazard on Yilong West Road and applied to draw 16 mm² copper-core insulated wire, which was approved. After the meeting, he went to the warehouse, showed the storekeeper the material requisition form, and received several coils of wire and connector lugs. Meanwhile, he sent a WeChat voice message to consult Master Li, who used the mnemonic "red means fire, yellow means warning, green means go" and construction site examples to help him understand safety color codes and fire separation distances. After moving the materials back to the team, he checked tool bags with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, inventoried the infrared thermometer, wrenches, voltage test pens, and so on, confirmed the radio channel, and got ready for the field work.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province): company meeting room, warehouse, and team rest room.

name: Emergency repair of the power distribution cabinet at Binhai New Village
description: The dispatch office sent an emergency work order: thick smoke was coming from the low-voltage distribution cabinet in Building 1 of Binhai New Village. Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang immediately took fire extinguishers and tools and drove the maintenance truck to the scene in light rain. After determining that it was a capacitor cabinet fault, Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo put on insulating gloves, cut off the upstream power supply, opened the cabinet door, extinguished the open flames, and removed the charred black capacitor, while Zhao Qiang set up barricades and evacuated residents. Then they fetched a high-temperature capacitor from the truck, worked together to replace it, and tightened the terminal screws. After closing the switch, Mingqiang measured the voltage with a multimeter; the three phases were balanced, and he notified that power could be restored. The hallway lights came on, and the residents cheered. The whole process took less than an hour and was handled cleanly and decisively.
location: Electrical distribution room, Building 1, Binhai New Village (Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Compiling on-site records and emergency repair report
description: As the rain gradually lessened, Mingqiang took out the maintenance record book at the door of the distribution room and carefully wrote down the fault symptoms (bulging capacitors, burning insulating paper), the handling process (extinguishing the fire, replacing high-temperature-resistant capacitors), and the operation time points. He took photos of the scene for the record, and added a note recommending a special inspection of old capacitors that had been in operation for more than 5 years within the jurisdiction. After returning to the company, he organized the handwritten records into an “Accident Emergency Repair Record Form” on the computer, attached rectification suggestions, and after checking that everything was correct, sent the electronic file to Team Leader Zhang.
location: Entrance to the electrical distribution room at Binhai New Village (Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)  Team break room at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province).

name: Lunch

During the meal, Chen Jianguo talked about his son's math grades, and Mingqiang mentioned that his eldest son Xuanxuan had midterm exams next week. They both sighed about how hard it is to be a father.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

Then he took out his phone, opened the photos of hazard data taken during yesterday's inspection of Yilong West Road, and checked the numbers one by one against the records in his notebook, confirming they were correct.
location: Team rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Moving newly arrived supplies and picking up wires

Seeing Zhao Qiang trying to lift a heavy box alone, he quickly called him over to lift it together to avoid back injury. After moving the goods, he took time to go to the warehouse, formally drew out 16 mm² copper-core insulated wire with the morning's material requisition form, and registered it.
location: From the unloading area at the warehouse entrance of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park to the warehouse (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Organizing and supplementing the survey report

Just as he was about to supplement the renovation plan, Squad Leader Zhang came over and said: 'Mingqiang, well done. Let's go over the plan at a meeting some other day.'
location: Team office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province).

name: Handled the rainstorm and inspected the warehouse.
description: Outside the window, the rain suddenly intensified. Mingqiang remembered that the scattered toolboxes in the tool room might have been left in the open corridor. He put on a raincoat and ran over, and together with Chen Jianguo carried the several toolboxes and spare insulators that were placed by the eaves into the storeroom, glad they had made preparations in advance.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park warehouse and tool room (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Housekeeping and end-of-day preparation
description: When the rain eased a little, Mingqiang returned to the rest room, wiped clean the tools he had used that day, checked the insulating gloves for any damage, and put them back in place. He backed up the emergency repair records and the inspection report to a USB drive. When it was about time, he changed out of his work clothes and put on his commuter bag.
location: Team rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Charging the electric bike.
description: Worried that the heavy afternoon rain and low battery would be a problem, Mingqiang plugged his electric vehicle into the charging station in the park, ensuring that he would have enough power to pick up his older son Xuanxuan after work.

name: After work, picked up the eldest son from school

While putting it on, Xuanxuan asked what he had repaired today, and Mingqiang simply answered, "A smoking capacitor."
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province) Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

Mingqiang took a hot shower as soon as he entered, then changed into dry loungewear. Xuanxuan went to do homework, while Hanhan played with building blocks in the living room. Juanzi was busy in the kitchen. Mingqiang greeted her, "It rained during today's emergency repair. You've worked hard." Dinner was stir-fried pork with green peppers, braised sea fish with fermented black beans, and stir-fried water spinach. The family chatted while eating. Mingqiang said the residents applauded in gratitude during the emergency repair, and Xuanxuan happily said the teacher praised his math progress. After dinner, Mingqiang cleared the dishes on his own.

name: Prepare squash equipment and go to the court

Then he shouldered his sports bag, drove to the court he had agreed on with Lin Feng. Navigation showed about 21 minutes. After arriving, he parked the car and walked into the venue.

Then they moved into backhand-specific training. Lin Feng continuously fed balls to the backhand position in the T zone. Mingqiang focused on feeling the shoulder turn driving the body and delayed wrist release, repeatedly hitting deep, fast baseline shots. After a break, they played a practice match. Mingqiang deliberately used his backhand more; although he occasionally made mistakes, his stability improved. A high-quality backhand crosscourt made Lin Feng give a thumbs-up. After the match, both were drenched in sweat.

They did a few minutes of dynamic stretching, focusing on their knees and ankles, then started a five-kilometer run along the park's rubberized track. Lu Mingqiang deliberately kept the pace at about 6:20 per kilometer, hoping to shake off a week's fatigue. On the third lap, his right knee felt heavy, so he slowed down and switched to brisk walking, adjusting his breathing. After the run, they stretched and chatted on the seaside boardwalk. Chen Bin asked about his review progress, and he admitted that he was stuck on the circuit part. Chen Bin encouraged him, saying, 'You can't get fat by eating just one mouthful; at your age, it's already commendable to keep studying for the exam.' At nearly eight o'clock, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to Chen Bin.

The family sat around the table eating breakfast. Lu Zixuan said his classmates had invited him to fly kites at Wanlv Garden, and Lu Mingqiang happened to want to take him there too; Wang Lijuan planned to take Lu Zihan to a painting class in the afternoon, so they decided that Lu Mingqiang would take Lu Zixuan to fly kites alone.

Lu Mingqiang helped Lu Zixuan straighten out the line of the big centipede kite, ran a few steps to let the kite rise into the wind, and then handed the reel to his son. Lu Zixuan gripped the reel, looked up at the kite flying higher and higher, and shouted and yelled excitedly. Lu Mingqiang sat on the grass nearby, occasionally reminding him to let out the line, and felt very content watching his son so happy.

name: Exchanging views on liquor bottle culture with fellow collectors at a teahouse.
description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove to the Laoguangwei Teahouse on South Bo'ai Road. Because street parking was hard to find, he parked in the pay lot at the intersection of North Bo'ai Road and Changdi Road and walked over. At 2:20 he met Chen Jianguo, who ordered a pot of Tieguanyin oolong tea, shrimp dumplings, and chicken feet, and could not wait to show off his newly acquired "Qiongya Column" internal commemorative liquor bottle. The blurred "Military Region Distillery" lettering on the bottom gave it a strong vintage feel, and made Lu Mingqiang quite envious. Lu Mingqiang then took out his three treasures one by one. Chen Jianguo picked up the sugarcane liquor bottle, held it up to the light, and praised the rare glass factory code on it. The two talked about the lettering, packaging styles, and shape changes of the bottles, and chatted about the rise and fall of the distillery back then. Time flew by. Near 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang asked Chen Jianguo to recommend collector forums and WeChat official accounts, and Chen Jianguo immediately sent him a few links via WeChat.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 104 Bo'ai South Road, Laoguangwei Teahouse

name: Go home and return the collectibles.
description: When he came out of the teahouse, the sky had turned cloudy. Lu Mingqiang drove home. He carefully took out the three bottles from the canvas bag, first wiped off the dust with a dry cloth, and then put each one back in its original place in the glass cabinet. After closing the cabinet door, he sat on the sofa and savored the afternoon conversation. In particular, he could not get the Qiongya Column bottle out of his mind and felt truly fulfilled inside.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the younger son from school
description: In the afternoon, Wang Lijuan suddenly had to go to her housekeeping employer's home to pick something up, and she might not make it in time to pick up Lu Zihan, so she asked Lu Mingqiang to go. Seeing the sky getting darker, Lu Mingqiang grabbed an umbrella and left. After a five-minute drive, he arrived at Jinmao Center Kindergarten just in time for the 4:50 dismissal. Lu Zihan jumped with joy when he saw his father coming to pick him up. Lu Mingqiang took his hand and helped him into the car, saying as he fastened the seatbelt that he would make braised pork for dinner.
location: Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Helped with household chores and prepared dinner.
description: When he got home, Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang hurried to help. He took out pork belly from the refrigerator to thaw and cleaned several small yellow croakers. Wang Lijuan planned to make sweet and sour fish and garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves, while he prepared to make twice-cooked pork. He helped by cutting scallions and ginger. Lu Zihan ran in and hugged his leg. He squatted down, pinched his son's little face, and asked what he had drawn today. Lu Zihan took out a drawing of a red kite from his schoolbag — it was exactly the scene of flying the kite that morning.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: At 6:30 the whole family sat down to dinner on time. Lu Mingqiang picked up sweet-and-sour fish for Lu Zixuan and added some twice-cooked pork to Lu Zihan's bowl. At the dinner table, Lu Zixuan excitedly told his mother about the kite-flying experience, and Wang Lijuan smiled and said she heard Lu Zihan tell his teacher that the kite made by his father was the best in the world. The family of four chatted and laughed, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Search the collection forum online and print materials.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang helped Wang Lijuan clear the dishes and then tutored Lu Zixuan in math homework for half an hour. After the family was settled, he went into the study, turned on the old computer, and logged into the 'Hainan Liquor Culture' forum using the link Chen Jianguo gave him that afternoon. After registering an account, he browsed several posts about Hainan sugar factories and old Haikou liquor factories from the 1980s and 1990s, and saw many valuable pictures. He then used his phone to follow the 'Hainan Cultural History' official account and read a long article titled 'An Examination of Traditional Hainan Liquor-making Techniques,' which cited local gazetteers in detail. He decisively printed out more than ten pages of materials, sorted the page numbers, stapled them into a booklet, and carefully tucked it into his notebook for preparing for the senior technician exam.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening session working on formulas in a theory textbook
description: After printing the materials, it was still before 8:30, and Lu Mingqiang was full of study momentum. He opened the Senior Technician Theory Textbook and focused on tackling the complex circuit formulas he had marked yesterday. Carried by the excitement of the afternoon exchange, he felt his brain was sharper than yesterday. He checked his notes for the relevant prerequisite formulas and tried to re-derive them. The process was slow, but he was no longer impatient — he repeatedly consulted different chapters, drew circuit diagrams, and broke through bit by bit like tightening a screw. By 9:30, although he had not fully understood the derivation, he had clearly grasped the relationship between two key variables. He wrote his ideas in the blank spaces of the printed materials, did a few related practice problems, and did not close the book until he felt sleepy at 10 o'clock.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing up and core training before bed
description: Coming out of the study, Lu Mingqiang went to the bathroom and took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. After showering, he did a set of planks to complete the day's exercise check-in. Then he changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. Seeing that Lu Zihan was already fast asleep and Lu Zixuan was still tossing and turning, he went over, said goodnight softly, and tucked him in.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rest
description: Lying in bed, Lu Mingqiang thought back on the day's experiences: a morning run, having bottled drinks at the teahouse in the afternoon, printing materials in the evening, and the small figure of his son flying a kite. He felt the day was fulfilling and well-paced. Tomorrow was Sunday, and he planned to take the family back to Meilan District to visit his parents. He closed his eyes contentedly and slowly fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m. the phone alarm woke me up on time. I felt my right knee a bit heavy but was in good spirits. To prepare for blood donation, I skipped the plank and did gentle full-body stretches in bed and beside the bed. After a quick wash, my wife had already prepared the meal: she stir-fried the leftover Hainan noodles with bean sprouts and shredded pork and served them with warm milk and bread. As we ate, we discussed the day's plan and decided to donate blood in the morning and take the children to do model building in the afternoon. My wife reminded me to eat more to avoid fainting from the needle.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Participate in the community voluntary blood donation activity
description: Bring your ID card and phone, wear casual clothes, and walk about 10 minutes to Jinmao Street Community Square. At the physical examination area next to the blood donation bus, my blood pressure was measured and my finger-prick blood test passed. While queuing to board the bus, I felt nervous at the sight of the thick needle. During the donation, the nurse chatted to distract me, and I successfully donated 400 ml of whole blood. In the rest area, I drank sugar water and ate biscuits, and received my first "Voluntary Blood Donation Certificate," a canvas bag, and milk. After resting, I walked back home.
location: Community Square, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (blood donation bus parking spot)

name: Returning home to rest and do housework after blood donation
description: After arriving home, he handed the blood donation certificate and canvas bag to his wife, recounting his nervousness and internal monologue during the donation. His wife praised him and put the certificate away. Then he tidied up the house: picked up the son's scattered toys and picture books, and folded and put away clothes. During this time, he replied to a friend on WeChat and took a photo of the label on the Coconut Island liquor bottle. His wife was preparing lunch ingredients at the same time, and they settled on the menu: steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, tomato scrambled eggs, and winter melon soup with dried shrimp.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family collaborative meal preparation and lunch
description: Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen to help, washing and cutting scallions, ginger, garlic, celery, and chatting with his wife about the difficult circuit points in the senior technician textbook. At lunch, the family of four sat together. His eldest son had a good appetite and excitedly talked about winning second prize in last week's sci-fi drawing competition, while his younger son clumsily scooped up egg custard. Lu Mingqiang picked fish for his wife and urged the children to eat more vegetables. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and preparation of parent-child craft materials.
description: After the meal, he leaned back on the living room sofa and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour; the slight fatigue from blood donation dissipated. Then he found waste wires, plastic bottle caps, battery boxes, small bulbs and other items from the toolbox on the balcony, and brought a large shoebox, scissors and glue from the study. He arranged them neatly on the living room floor to prepare for the electric car model handicraft class.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Led his son to make an environmentally friendly electric car model
description: Lu Mingqiang announced that he would teach the children to build a real electric-powered car. He explained the basic principles of electricity using simple analogies, emphasizing recycling and environmental protection. The father and two sons worked together on the floor: he guided the eldest son to cut out the car body, the younger son to glue bottle caps on as wheels, while he himself handled the circuit connections. His wife photographed the whole process. After nearly two hours, they connected the circuit and gently flipped the switch; the small bulb at the front of the car immediately lit up with a warm yellow glow. The children screamed with excitement and ran in circles, and his wife captured the moment of the whole family cheering, enjoying the warmth and satisfaction of working in harmony.
location: Living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Resting and preparing to go out
description: Lu Mingqiang sat on the ground wiping sweat and drinking water, while the children were still gathered around the cart discussing. Then he guided the children to put away the tools and clean up the paper scraps. He went back to the bedroom to change into sports shorts, a quick-dry T-shirt, and lightweight running shoes. His wife had prepared sun hats and thermos cups for the two children and stuffed the milk given as a blood donation gift into the backpack.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family outdoor activity at Wanlv Garden
description: The family walked about 20 minutes to Wanlv Garden. Lu Mingqiang power-walked about 25 minutes on the park's rubber track, covering nearly 2 kilometers. After working up a sweat, he did jumping jacks and lunge stretches to relax. His wife took the children to the lawn to fly kites and pick kapok fluff. Later they gathered on the lawn, and the eldest son held the string and watched the kite flying. On the way back, the younger son was tired, so Lu Mingqiang carried him and explained the principles of electric vehicles as they walked, and the family strolled home slowly.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the round-trip route

name: Shower and evening family dinner
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang first took a warm shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue, while his wife reheated the leftover lunch food. Dinner was simple and light. At the table, they talked about the afternoon's successful model; the eldest son suggested adding a remote control, which made the whole family laugh. Lu Mingqiang reminded his younger son to do his homework after dinner.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family financial budget meeting.
description: After the meal, his wife washed the dishes, and Lu Mingqiang put the chairs back and put away the schoolbags. The couple then took out the ledger and phones, tallied up February expenses, and found that spending on eating out and snacks was too high (grilled fish three times). Together they made a March saving plan: reduce eating out to once a week, stop buying new extracurricular books, cut the wife's shopping budget, and set a mandatory savings goal of 500 yuan per month. Lu Mingqiang personally wrote the new plan on the flyleaf of the ledger.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening parenting and parent-child bonding
description: Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son's Chinese sentence-making homework in the study, reading the text aloud, explaining word meanings, and writing imitation sentences. Afterwards, he watched ten minutes of cartoons with his second son, who had just taken a bath. At 20:30, he took the children back to the bedroom, turned off the light, and read the picture book 'Thomas the Tank Engine'. Before long, his second son fell asleep peacefully.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province - home study room and children's room.

name: Evening exercise and personal relaxation.
description: Because he had donated blood during the day, he reduced his core training: on the yoga mat in the living room, he completed, in order, 2 sets of Superman exercises, 2 sets of glute bridges, and 2 sets of planks (45 seconds each). Afterward, he took a quick shower, went back to the bedroom, and scrolled through the news by the bedside for more than ten minutes. He logged onto the Hainan Liquor Culture Collectors Forum, browsed a new post about the site of the old Haikou distillery, and bookmarked it.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep conversation and going to bed
description: After his wife finished and lay down, Lu Mingqiang chatted with her about the eldest son's studies and next week's work plan, then turned off the desk lamp. Recalling the day's blood donation, handicrafts, family outdoor time, and the money-saving plan, he felt at ease and fell asleep peacefully at around 22:30.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake up, morning exercise, prepare breakfast, and take the children to school
description: The 6:40 alarm woke him up. He still felt a bit tired but was in good spirits. He did two sets of 60-second planks and joint mobility exercises, and skipped his morning run because he had donated blood the day before. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white rice porridge and fried eggs. He changed into his work uniform and stuffed the raincoat into the seat compartment of his electric bike. At 7:10 he rode off to take his eldest son Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him to focus in class. At 7:30 he turned back to take his younger son Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and left only after watching him go inside.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province  Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province  Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting, buying breakfast, and attending the team morning meeting
description: After dropping off Hanhan, he cycled along Jinmao Middle Road and turned onto Haisheng Road. It rained on the way, so he bought a pork bun and soy milk at the Convenient Life Convenience Store and ate while riding. He arrived at the company at 7:55, clocked in, changed into work clothes, and checked his tool bag. At 8:15 he attended the morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang, who reported on last week's acceptance inspection of the old residential community renovation and assigned today's task: go with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang as a group to Haijing Bay Garden to deal with the frequent tripping of the air switch in the distribution box. Team Leader Zhang stressed careful troubleshooting and safety. Lu Mingqiang noticed Zhao Qiang was absent-minded and decided to keep an eye on him.
location: From Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District (meeting room of Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd.), passing by Haisheng Road Convenience Life Convenience Store

name: Maintenance and inspection of the distribution box at Haijing Bay Garden
