description: At 8:45, after picking up spare parts, rode a bike to Seaview Bay Garden, and after liaising with the property management, entered the power distribution room of Building 3. Asked Zhao Qiang to repeat the high-voltage testing procedure. His answer was incomplete and he was about to operate improperly, so I immediately stopped him and personally demonstrated the standard procedure of 'cut off power - test for voltage - attach ground wire - discharge', and seriously taught him, 'It's your own life; the rules are there to protect it.' Afterwards, I worked in good coordination with Chen Jianguo to inspect and tighten three loose points, replaced an aging AC contactor, and solved the tripping problem.
location: Power distribution room, Unit 1, Building 3, Haijing Bay Garden, 179 Yanzao Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After finishing work at 11:30, he rode an electric scooter with Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the company. He ordered the 12-yuan spicy soup rice with a braised egg; Jianguo had pig trotter rice, and Zhao Qiang ordered beef brisket noodles. While eating, he slowed down his tone and explained to Zhao Qiang why he had stopped him in the morning—not to embarrass him, but because he was afraid something might happen to him—and promised to help him look out for nearby rental listings. After the meal, at 12:35, they returned to the company. He dozed for 20 minutes on the chair in the break room to refresh himself, woke up on time at 13:00, and washed his face with cold water.
location: No. 56-4, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant; and the Company Rest Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon maintenance wrap-up, document organization, and warehouse equipment inspection
description: At 13:10 I went to Haijingwan Garden again to handle the debugging of the remaining two circuit breakers. By 14:50 all were completed and confirmed with the property management by signature. Then I returned to the company office, turned on the computer, and entered the cause of the tripping, the handling measures, and the spare part models into the maintenance log and ledger. At 15:00 Squad Leader Zhang informed me that Master Wang in the reception office reported that the power strip in the warehouse was heating up. Together with Jianguo, I checked and found that the cable on the cable reel was aging. After reporting, we applied for two new industrial power strips, replaced them, and tested them normally.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 179 Yanzao Road, Haijing Bay Garden; Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, company office and tool warehouse.

name: Commute after work, grocery shopping, and household chores and parenting after returning home.
description: Punched out on time at 16:00 and cycled home along Jinmao East Road. Passing Old Wang's vegetable stall at the entrance of the community, I remembered my wife saying we were almost out of greens, so I stopped and picked a bunch of water spinach and a few tomatoes, spending 8.5 yuan. The owner threw in two extra scallions. I got home at 16:50; my wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up our younger son Hanhan and was sorting vegetables. I helped wash the vegetables and rinse the dishes and chopsticks, then played with Hanhan with LEGO bricks. Hanhan showed off a painting he made in kindergarten and was praised.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan   Old Wang's Vegetable Stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan   Banshan Garden Residence, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Family evening time: dinner, homework help, and relaxing and tidying up
description: At 18:00, his wife made stir-fried water spinach, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and Wenchang chicken, and called the eldest son Xuanxuan to dinner. The family sat around the table and asked Xuanxuan about school. They learned that in math class he had learned two-digit multiplication. She tested him with one problem and he answered correctly. Hanhan wriggled in his chair and was gently patted by his wife. After dinner, she helped Xuanxuan with his math workbook, showing him how to line up the digits vertically. They finished half an hour later and signed it. After Xuanxuan went to take a shower, she watched local news for a while, folded the clothes that had dried on the balcony, and Hanhan read picture books by himself on the carpet.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Banshan Garden Residence

name: Senior Technician theory study
description: After the children quiet down, he enters the study. He first reviews the maintenance logs of the past month and the records of last week's renovation project, focusing on replaying the cases of transformer overload protection misoperation and line grounding resistance exceeding the standard, going over the details in his mind. He opens the chapters "Principles of Relay Protection" and "Grounding Systems" in the textbook Advanced Technician Theory, and substitutes the measured current and impedance values from the logs into formulas for verification. The theoretical knowledge suddenly becomes clear. In his notebook, he draws equivalent circuit diagrams and fills pages with insights and derivation processes.
location: Study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening core workout
description: After studying, though mentally excited, his body was tired. He changed into sports shorts, laid out the yoga mat in the living room, and completed 3 sets of planks, each held for 65 seconds, with 30 seconds of rest between sets. He tried side planks for the first time, holding each side for 12 seconds, and felt that his core strength still needed to be improved.
location: Living room of the residence at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After the workout, he took a shower to relax. Back in the bedroom, his wife Wang Lijuan was already in bed looking at her phone. He shared with her how the theoretical study "clicked" tonight, and she was happy for him. They talked about tomorrow's plans: she had two hours of cleaning work at someone's house in the morning, and he promised to come home a bit early from work to pick up Hanhan.
location: Bedroom at Banshan Garden Residence, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the desk lamp at 22:30 and lay down. Though my body was a bit tired, I felt at ease inside, especially having found a learning method that combines theory and practice. I look forward to being full of energy tomorrow, and soon drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at Banshan Garden Residence, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up, morning exercise, and breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off, and Lu Mingqiang got up quickly without lingering in bed. He started with a morning core workout: after a Cat-Cow warm-up, he completed three sets of 60-second planks and 18-second side planks on each side. While washing up, he mentally reviewed key points on electrical connection reliability analysis. His wife, Wang Lijuan, had prepared lean pork congee and fried eggs for breakfast. Lu Mingqiang made sure his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, finished breakfast and checked his schoolbag.
location: Room 403, Unit 2, Building (unspecified), Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting
description: At 7:00, rode an e-bike to take eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him to listen carefully in class and eat well at lunch. Then turned back to take younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten; Lu Zihan sang in the car. After dropping off the children, hurried to the company, on the way planning to find Squad Leader Zhang to sign up for Arbor Day and ask Xiao Zhao about renting an apartment. Arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:50.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District), and finally to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District)

name: Attend the team morning meeting
description: Arrived at the team office at 7:55 and attended the morning meeting at 8:00. Team Leader Zhang assigned the morning task: go to Tianyi International Building to investigate abnormal noises from the electricity meter boxes on floors 12 to 15. Lu Mingqiang was appointed to lead Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, and safety precautions were emphasized. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang privately signed up with Team Leader Zhang for the Arbor Day activity and asked Team Leader Zhang to help Zhao Qiang look for rental housing near the company. Team Leader Zhang agreed to provide the contact number of a real estate agent.
location: Team Office, 1st Floor, Building C, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Inspected the electricity meter box at Tianyi International Building
description: At 8:15, took the tools and testing equipment and set off with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang in the company's work pickup truck. Arrived at Tianyi International Building at 8:35, and after meeting with the property manager, began inspecting the electrical distribution rooms on floors 12 to 15. Lu Mingqiang carefully listened to the meter boxes with a listening rod, Chen Jianguo recorded the current and voltage data, and Zhao Qiang followed along to learn. In the 14th-floor distribution room, a main switch wiring terminal was found loose and making a faint buzzing sound. Lu Mingqiang judged it as a hazard, guided Zhao Qiang to fetch the tools, and personally demonstrated the standard process of de-energizing, testing for voltage, and tagging before retightening the terminal with a torque wrench. At 11:35, the inspection was fully completed; everything was normal except for that loose connection, and it was recorded in detail.
location: Electrical distribution room, 12th-15th floors, Tianyi International Tower, No. 85 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunchtime safety learning and task handling.
description: After returning to the company at 11:50, he let Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang go eat first. Lu Mingqiang went alone to the corner of the storage room to review the key steps of the standard discharge operation procedure in the Electric Power Safety Work Regulations. At 12:10 he found Team Leader Zhang, filled out the Tree Planting Day registration form, confirmed he was on the same team as Chen Jianguo, and obtained the phone number of Team Leader Zhang's distant relative who works as a real estate agent, to pass on to Zhao Qiang to solve his rental problem.
location: Corner of the storage room on the first floor of Building C, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province / team office

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the spicy soup rice fast-food restaurant near his company to meet Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang. The three ordered spicy soup rice, white-cut Wenchang chicken, and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang shared with Chen Jianguo his morning experience in diagnosing the abnormal sound, pointing out that the sizzling sound was a typical sign of unbalanced current, which over the long term could cause overheating and a fire hazard. At the same time, he gave Zhao Qiang the rental agent's contact information, telling Zhao Qiang to get the phone number from Team Leader Zhang later.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break study and fault analysis
description: After the meal, he returned to the company break room, first took a 20-minute nap to recover, then washed his face to wake up. Lu Mingqiang took out the senior technician textbook and notebook, and using the morning's loose terminal case as an example, studied the force model and thermal effect formulas in electrical connection reliability analysis, drew analysis diagrams in the notebook, and wrote down his insights.
location: Team rest room, 1st Floor, Building C, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the physical examination report and respond to health warnings.
description: At 14:00, Lu Mingqiang went to the staff clinic on the second floor, where Doctor Wang handed him his physical examination report. Back in the office, he opened the report. The physical examination page showed a weight of 72.0 kg and a BMI of 24.8, with a diagnosis of borderline overweight. The doctor advised controlling his diet and increasing aerobic exercise. Lu Mingqiang recalled the back pain caused by his weight at the beginning of the year and resolved to discuss adjusting the family diet with his wife and resume exercise.
location: Staff Clinic / Team Office, 2nd Floor, Building C, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wrap-up tasks and after-work commute
description: At 16:30 returned to the office, entered that day's inspection records into the computer ledger, and cleaned, calibrated, and put away tools such as the multimeter, stethoscope rod, and wrenches. Left work on time at 17:00 and rode the electric bike home, thinking along the way about how to discuss the physical examination results with his wife, planning to adjust the diet structure, add more fish, shrimp, and vegetables, reduce greasy dishes such as braised pork belly, and resume running.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Household help and health communication
description: Arrived home at 17:30; the younger son Lu Zihan had already been picked up by his wife and was playing in the living room. Lu Mingqiang changed into home clothes, stayed with his younger son for a while, then went to the kitchen door and handed the physical examination report to his wife Wang Lijuan, frankly saying that he was on the edge of being overweight and explained that this was related to his lower back pain at the beginning of the year. The two agreed that from the next day the family diet would change to less oil and less salt, with more steamed fish and blanched greens. His wife expressed support and was willing to supervise exercise together.
location: Room 403, Unit 2, Building (unspecified), Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and homework help
description: 18:30 dinner, with braised pork belly, stir-fried bean sprouts, and winter melon and white clam soup on the table. Lu Mingqiang deliberately took less fatty meat. After dinner he cleared the dishes while his wife bathed the younger son. At 19:00 Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son Lu Zixuan in math homework. For a word problem about route length and distance, he patiently explained by drawing line segments to help him understand how to calculate distances for different routes. By 20:00 Lu Zixuan fully understood and reworked the problems to consolidate.
location: Room 403, Unit 2, Building (unspecified), Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Learning advanced electrician knowledge.
description: After tutoring the children, Lu Mingqiang went to the study to continue studying the advanced technician textbook. He specifically linked the daytime loose-terminal fault with the chapter on the relationship between thermal effects and resistance, sorted out the principles in his notebook, and recorded his insights, deepening his understanding of integrating theory with practice.
location: Study room, Unit 2, Building X, Room 403, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening core strength training.
description: After studying, spread a yoga mat on the study floor and did core training: 3 sets of 70-second planks, 20 glute bridges, and 10 supine leg raises, slightly increasing the volume to make up for insufficient training during the day. After the workout, sweating profusely, felt refreshed.
location: Study room, Unit 2, Building X, Room 403, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Wash up and relax
description: Take a hot shower to wash away the fatigue of the day and the sweat from exercise, in preparation for rest.
location: Bathroom, Room 403, Unit 2, Building X, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Husband-wife exchange and bedtime
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan lay in bed chatting, sharing plans for Saturday's Arbor Day activities. His wife expressed support and volunteered to supervise exercise together; they also talked about their children's recent situation, gradually feeling sleepy in a relaxed atmosphere, and fell asleep peacefully at 22:50.
location: Master bedroom, Room 403, Unit 2, Building ?, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core workout and breakfast
description: When the morning alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up immediately. Remembering the overweight warning from his physical exam, he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and started core training: three sets of planks, each held for 70 seconds, followed by two sets of side planks on each side, 20 seconds per set. Then he quickly washed up, ate the breakfast prepared by his wife Wang Lijuan, simply microwaved last night's Hainan noodles, and paired them with a glass of warm water, eating quickly to save time.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an e-bike to take the two children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike to first take his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. Xuanxuan sat on the back seat holding his waist, and the two chatted and laughed all the way. After dropping him off at the school gate, he immediately turned back to take his second son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. Hanhan sat on the small stool in the front, still a bit drowsy, and before entering the kindergarten, he turned back and called out for Dad to pick him up early, which warmed Lu Mingqiang's heart.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District)

name: Rode his bike to the company, then took a bus to the nursery base.
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang rode along Binhai Avenue for less than ten minutes to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park and met up with his colleagues. He confirmed with Team Leader Zhang that the tree-planting location had been changed to Jinpan Nursery Base, then formed a group with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, dividing the work. Afterwards, they took a bus for about twenty minutes to the nursery base near the intersection of Nanhai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue in Longhua District.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (meeting point), to Jinpan Nursery Base near the intersection of Nanhai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue, Longhua District

name: Morning tree-planting activity
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang formed a three-person team, took shovels and buckets, and planted Casuarina saplings in the designated area. The sandy soil was easy to dig. He dug the holes, Jianguo held the saplings upright, and Xiao Zhao mounded soil and fetched water. They worked well together. After more than an hour of labor, everyone was sweating, but Lu Mingqiang felt this tiredness was different from the tension of emergency line repairs and felt especially at ease.
location: Jinpan Nursery Base near the intersection of Nanhai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and call mother
description: At noon, boxed lunches were distributed, including braised pork, green vegetables, salted duck egg, and apples. Lu Mingqiang remembered his wife's dietary advice, gave most of the fatty meat to Chen Jianguo, and ate only the vegetables and salted duck egg. While eating, he took out his phone and called his mother, Chen Xiuying. Her voice sounded tired; although she kept saying she was fine, he still sensed something unnatural in her speech, and decided in his heart that he must visit her on the weekend.
location: In the shade of the Jinpan Nursery Base near the intersection of Nanhai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon tree planting and cleanup after work.
description: In the afternoon, as the sun grew stronger, Lu Mingqiang's group finished planting the remaining saplings in one go. At 3 p.m., the team leader called it a day; everyone cleaned up the tools and took a group photo. Lu Mingqiang wiped the sweat from his face, feeling physically tired but mentally relaxed.
location: Jinpan Nursery Base near the intersection of Nanhai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned to the company by bus
description: The bus departed on time and returned to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. On the way, Zhao Qiang told Lu Mingqiang that he had already asked Foreman Zhang about the rental himself, and Foreman Zhang promised to keep an eye out. Lu Mingqiang nodded and said to come to him anytime if needed.
location: From Jinpan Nursery Base to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Cycled home, showered, and changed clothes
description: Lu Mingqiang got on his e-bike at the company gate and rode home along Binhai Avenue. When he got home, his wife and children were not back yet. He quickly took off his work clothes covered in sweat and dirt, went into the bathroom to take a cool shower, and changed into a clean home T-shirt and beach shorts, feeling instantly refreshed.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the supermarket to buy groceries, then go home to rest and spend time with the kids
description: Lu Mingqiang cycled to the Wangjiawang Fresh Supermarket next to the community and, as his wife had instructed, bought green vegetables, luffa, dragon fruit, and bananas. When passing the discounted durian section, he considered it but decided not to buy to save money. After returning home, his younger son Lu Zihan was already playing with building blocks. He sat with the child on the floor mat to build a rocket while reviewing safety training materials on his phone, combining yesterday's troubleshooting case with a review of the procedures.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 10 Shimao West Road, Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket and No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden.

name: Preparing dinner with his wife
description: Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to help in the kitchen, assisting his wife Wang Lijuan with picking and washing vegetables while they chatted about everyday things. Wang Lijuan did the main cooking, making steamed tilapia, garlic greens, and loofah egg drop soup, all light and low in oil. Lu Mingqiang watched from the side and felt reassured.
location: Kitchen, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dining table. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, came back from school and excitedly talked about the school tree-planting activity. Lu Mingqiang listened while picking food for him and told him to eat more vegetables. The dinner was light, but the whole family ate warmly and happily.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: After a brief rest following the meal, Lu Mingqiang sat next to Lu Zixuan to help him with math; today's lesson was about matching problems. He patiently explained two example problems, then let Xuanxuan practice on his own. When he finished, he praised the child and encouraged him to keep improving.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Make a video call to his mother.
description: Lu Mingqiang walked to the balcony and made a video call to his mother, Chen Xiuying. Seeing that his mother looked okay, he felt somewhat relieved, and urged her to go out and get some sun when the weather was clear and not to stay cooped up at home all the time. His mother smiled and agreed, telling him not to worry too much. Lu Mingqiang noticed the hot water bottle placed behind her, felt a pang in his heart, but did not mention it, and resolved to go back to the countryside to visit her on the weekend.
location: Balcony, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepare squash equipment and go to the squash court.
description: After the phone call, Lu Mingqiang rested briefly, drank a glass of water, then went to the bedroom to pack his squash bag: checked the racket grip, brought two new balls and a towel, and filled his sports bottle. Then he slung the bag over his back, rode his e-bike along Binhai Avenue onto Heping Avenue, and arrived at the Super Energy Squash Center on B1 of Blue Sky Building in about ten minutes.
location: Super Energy Squash Court, B1, Blue Sky Building, 19 Heping Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Played squash with Lin Feng and cycled home.
description: Friend Lin Feng had already arrived and was warming up. He mentioned that the club had a small tournament next month, which stirred Lu Mingqiang's competitive spirit. Tonight he cut down on smashes and focused on practicing his backhand, repeatedly adjusting his grip and footwork. Though his arms were sore, his backhand stability improved noticeably, and he could rally more than ten consecutive shots. The tree planting during the day had been exhausting, so the two deliberately kept the intensity moderate. After playing, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to Lin Feng and biked home in the night breeze, buying a bottle of Gatorade at a convenience store along the way to rehydrate.
location: Super Energy Squash Court, B1, Lantian Tower, 19 Heping Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and on the way home

name: Core training and stretching relaxation
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang did not sit down immediately. Instead, he spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did a second core workout: three sets of planks, each lasting 70 seconds, and two sets of 20 seconds each for left and right side planks. After finishing, he spent a few minutes stretching his thighs and calves to prevent muscle soreness the next day.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
description: After taking a shower and changing into pajamas, Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom. His wife, Wang Lijuan, had already settled the children and softly said that he had worked hard today. He lay down, feeling comfortable all over. He picked up his phone and set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning. Recalling that both tree planting and playing ball had gone smoothly, he was free of worries. After saying goodnight to his wife, he closed his eyes and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training
description: Got up at 6:20 a.m. and did core training in the bedroom, including 3 sets of 70-second planks, 20 seconds of side plank on each side, superman exercises, and glute bridges, to strengthen the lower back.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparation and breakfast
description: After training, he took a quick shower, prepared breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan, ate Hainan noodles and barbecue pork buns, checked the two children's schoolbags, and reminded them to bring an extra jacket for Hanhan on rainy days.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Wearing a raincoat, he rode the electric bike, first taking his 8-year-old eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, then taking his 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. On the way, he told the children to behave and rode carefully because the roads were slippery from the rain.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to company
description: Starting from Guomao Sanheng Road, he rode an electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road and Haisheng Road to the company. After arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, he parked the electric bike in the shed and hung the wet raincoat on the handlebars to drain.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: resolving hidden hazards in the power distribution cabinet
description: Attended Team Leader Zhang's morning meeting and was assigned to handle the task of abnormal noise and possible overheating hazards in commercial distribution cabinets near HNA Haoting on Guoxing Avenue. Drove to the site with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, used a temperature gun to check the temperature of the incoming and outgoing terminals, found 2 terminals above 60 degrees, judged it as poor contact, used a torque wrench to re-tighten according to standard torque, eliminated the hazard, and returned to the company.
location: HNA Haoting, Dayingshan West Fourth Street, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and phone call with mother
description: Walked with Chen Jianguo to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant for dinner. Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with fried dough sticks, and Jianguo ordered pork trotter rice. During the meal, he called his mother to ask about her knees. Her voice was hoarse and she said they were a bit achy. Mingqiang urged her to apply the medicine on time and said he would bring medicated oil and visit her on the weekend.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon study and exam preparation
description: Used the lunch break to read "Advanced Technician Theory Textbook" in the company lounge, reviewed the frequently tested parameter chapters with a mobile memory-method app, and used the mnemonics to understand the underlying principles, deepening my memory.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work preparation
description: Met up with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, checked the tool kits needed for the afternoon work, including the megohmmeter, multimeter, screwdriver set, etc., to ensure nothing was missing, and prepared to make written records of the morning's distribution cabinet plan.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: maintenance records and training new staff.
description: Wrote the process, data, and follow-up observation points for handling the distribution cabinet hazard in the morning into the maintenance log. Afterwards, seeing Zhao Qiang staring blankly at the Electric Power Safety Work Regulations, he took the initiative to walk over and explain the sequence and importance of power cut-off, voltage testing, and grounding wire installation based on the morning's practical operation, while emphasizing the key points of using insulating gloves. Finally, he went to the warehouse to get two rolls of new insulating tape and spare gaskets.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying vegetables after work
description: After work, I rode my electric bike home along Jinmao Middle Road and stopped at Wangjiawang Fresh Supermarket to buy groceries on the way. I bought greens, loofah, tofu, and cherry tomatoes, but didn't buy any meat because my wife was going to cook tilapia in the evening.
location: Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Minsheng Branch), Minsheng West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home to help with dinner
description: After returning home, he gave the vegetables to his wife and helped her pick and wash them. While stir-frying, his wife shared that their eldest son Xuanxuan had been praised by his math teacher. Mingqiang was delighted to hear it, and discussed with his wife about going back to their hometown to visit his mother on the weekend.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the table for dinner. The tilapia cooked by his wife was very tasty. While eating, Mingqiang listened to his elder son talk about funny things at school and asked his younger son what new nursery rhymes he had learned in kindergarten. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. To prepare for his evening run, he deliberately ate half a bowl of rice less.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Homework guidance and parent-child quality time.
description: After the meal, his wife cleared the dishes, and Mingqiang helped his eldest son Lu Zixuan with his math homework, using LEGO bricks to demonstrate multiplication word problems to help him understand. After that, he played with toy cars with his second son Lu Zihan on the carpet.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparations before night run.
description: Changed into running shorts, a quick-dry shirt, and running shoes, put my phone and earphones into an armband, took a sip of water, did some light ankle and wrist exercises, and got ready to go out for a nighttime run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Night run at Evergreen Park.
description: Rode an e-bike to Wanlv Garden Park, opened the running app and set a goal of 30 minutes at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer. At first my legs felt heavy and my breathing wasn't regulated; after 1 kilometer my body warmed up and my steps became light. I pushed through and ran about 4.7 kilometers. Sweat poured down but I felt great. It was the first time since being hit by the physical examination report that I felt back in control of my body. After the run, I walked a slow lap to cool down.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: At-home stretching and core supplementary training
description: After cycling home, he took a shower and changed into dry clothes, did a set of planks (70 seconds) on the living room carpet to strengthen his core, and then carefully did post-run stretches, especially for the thighs and calves, to prevent soreness the next day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study session for exam preparation
description: In the study, he turned on the desk lamp and studied the chapter on high- and low-voltage switchgear maintenance and commissioning in the senior technician textbook. He used a mnemonic app to turn key parameters into a short story to aid memory, and cross-referenced the earlier schematic diagrams to make sure he understood. After studying, he deliberately left his phone charging in the study and did not take it into the bedroom.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed and falling asleep
description: I tiptoed into the bedroom; my wife was already asleep. Lying down, I recalled the fulfilling events of the day. Though my body was tired, I felt a great sense of accomplishment. Listening to the light rain starting again outside the window, I soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm rang and Lu Mingqiang got up immediately. He weighed 73.0 kg, the same as yesterday. It was drizzling outside, so he did his morning core training on the living room floor: 3 sets of 70-second planks with 30-second rests between sets, followed by 15 Superman exercises. After training, he took a warm shower, put on his work clothes, and felt full of energy.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare breakfast and take the children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang had breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan and two sons, helping to serve steamed buns and milk. Since it was raining, he wore a raincoat and took the children to school on an electric bike. At 7:10, he first took his older son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School and watched him run into the school gate; then he turned around and took his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, reminding him to listen to the teacher.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home); then rode an electric bike to No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District (Longfeng Experimental Primary School) and Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District (Jinmao Center Kindergarten)

name: Morning work — morning meeting and worksite hazard inspection
description: Arrived at the company at 7:50, changed clothes, and attended the 8:00 morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang assigned tasks, prioritizing the hidden danger of terminals in the commercial distribution cabinet found during yesterday's inspection. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang, colleagues Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang took tools and drove to the commercial construction site near Binhai Avenue in Xiuying District. He guided Zhao Qiang to operate according to procedures, tighten the terminals to eliminate the hazard, and perform insulation tests and record data.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, then went to a commercial construction site near Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District.

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: After finishing work at 11:45, he went with colleague Chen Jianguo to 'Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant' near the company for lunch, each ordering a spicy soup rice with an egg. While eating, Lu Mingqiang mentioned that he planned to take his family back to Meilan to visit his mother tomorrow and bring her medicated oil and Wenchang chicken, and he and Jianguo agreed to visit the newly opened hardware market on the weekend.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and exam preparation study.
description: Back in the company rest room, Lu Mingqiang lay on the camp bed, opened a memory-training app on his phone, and reviewed the key parameters in the chapter “High and Low Voltage Switchgear Inspection and Commissioning,” focusing on consolidating the circuit breaker setting current values. After 20 minutes of focused study, he turned off his phone and closed his eyes for a short rest, recharging for the afternoon's work.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon site work and on-site instruction.
description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang drove to another power distribution room reported for repair near Haixiu Road. The inspection found that the incoming terminal of the main switch was hot and oxidized. He guided Zhao Qiang through the safety procedures of power outage, voltage detection, and ground wire attachment, then personally polished the contacts, applied conductive grease, and tightened them. With Jianguo's cooperation, he taught Zhao Qiang hand by hand how to judge torque. During the process, Lu Mingqiang became more confident in explaining technical details and more confident about obtaining the senior technician certificate.
location: A power distribution room with a repair request near Haixiu Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bought groceries on the way home from work and called his mother.
description: At 5:30 pm, he finished work, returned to the company to organize his tools, and clocked out. On the way home, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the Wangjiawang Supermarket (Banshan Garden branch) on Jinmao Middle Road and bought Shanghai bok choy, soft tofu, and dragon fruit, and also bought a box of yogurt for his wife. After arriving home, while his wife prepared dinner, he video-called his mother, Chen Xiuying, from the bedroom. He asked about her leg injury, told her not to go out in the rain, and said he would bring medicated oil and Wenchang chicken to visit her tomorrow.
location: Wangjiawang Supermarket (Banshan Garden Branch) on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, then returned home to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Family dinner and helping the children with homework.
description: At dinner, Lu Mingqiang consciously ate half a bowl less rice. After the meal, he played with building blocks with his younger son, Lu Zihan, on the living room floor, praising the child's castle creation. Then he helped his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, with his math homework, explaining multiplication word problems using the practical example of buying dragon fruit until the child understood. Seeing that the child got it, he felt very gratified.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Extra squash practice and growing friendship
description: At 8 p.m., after preparing his equipment, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the Super Energy Squash Court on B1 of Blue Sky Building, No. 19 Heping Avenue, Meilan District. After meeting his friend Lin Feng, they did targeted backhand training. Lin Feng pointed out his footwork problems and kept feeding balls as demonstrations; Lu Mingqiang humbly adjusted. They practiced extra until 9:30, then sat courtside drenched in sweat chatting, from skills to work pressure and family trivialities, finding they shared similar fatigue and persistence, and their friendship deepened.
location: Super Energy Squash Court, B1, Blue Sky Building, 19 Heping Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: At 10:15, after squash ended, Lu Mingqiang cycled home. After quietly checking on his sleeping son, he took a hot shower. Despite being tired, he persisted in completing the second core training session: 3 sets of 70-second planks plus side planks, followed by stretching and relaxation with a foam roller. Afterwards, in the study, he manually checked in the squash activity on a running app, browsed the liquor bottle collecting circle, and liked a post about Guangdong Yubingshao. Back in the bedroom, he discussed with his wife Wang Lijuan the specific time to return to their hometown to visit his mother the next day, settling on leaving at 8 a.m. and buying Wenchang chicken. Finally, he set the alarm for 6:20, put his phone on charge in the study, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning jogging
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the alarm rang. Lu Mingqiang got up by himself, put on his running shoes and quick-dry clothes, and rode his electric bike to Baishamen Park. Facing the cool sea breeze, he arrived after 12 minutes, jogged to warm up on the coastal walkway, and then started a 5 km run. Because his body had not fully recovered from yesterday's blood donation and he had exercised heavily this week, his steps felt heavy, and his final pace was 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer, slightly slower than usual. After finishing, he stretched carefully at the seaside viewing platform, did a few sets of core exercises, and did not leave until the sea breeze had dried his sweat.
location: Baishamen Park, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home to take a shower, buy breakfast, and take the eldest son to soccer class.
description: Lu Mingqiang cycled from Baishamen Park back to his home in Banshan Garden. After taking a cold shower, he changed into a casual T-shirt and shorts. Thinking that his wife Wang Lijuan was busy taking care of their second son Lu Zihan, he went downstairs alone to the usual breakfast stall at the gate of the community. As planned, he bought four servings of freshly ground soy milk, three steamer baskets of barbecue pork buns and shaomai, and added a serving of egg pastry for each of his two sons. When he brought it home, Wang Lijuan was already dressing Lu Zihan, and his eldest son Lu Zixuan had also gotten up. As the family sat around eating breakfast, Lu Zixuan excitedly talked about the leaf he had found yesterday. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang rushed off on his electric bike at 8:10 to take Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School for the soccer interest class. They arrived ten minutes later, and he left only after watching the boy run bouncing into the school gate.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

name: Purchase planting materials at the building materials market and pick up the eldest son on the way home.
description: After dropping off Lu Zixuan, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Feima Building Materials City on Heping South Road to buy materials for building a balcony planting rack. Following the list his wife Wang Lijuan had written and the balcony dimensions at home, he compared several shops and bought three thickened storage bins, several large compressed coconut coir bricks, and seeds for scallions, lettuce, and chili peppers. In the hardware section he carefully chose a simple smart timer and matching drip irrigation fittings. After confirming the installation parameters with the shopkeeper, he paid. Seeing that it was almost 10:20, when Lu Zixuan's football class ended, he secured the items to the footboard of his electric bike with zip ties, hurried back to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, and picked up the sweaty Lu Zixuan. Listening to his son excitedly talk about scoring two goals, he rode home with his son and the materials.
location: Feima Building Materials City, Heping South Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Prepared and drove to his parents' home.
description: After returning home, Wang Lijuan had already gotten their second son Lu Zihan ready and packed the fruit into bags. Lu Mingqiang put the medicated oil he had found yesterday into his pocket and checked the hex wrenches in the tool box. At 10:40, the family of four set off. Lu Mingqiang drove the Volkswagen Bora eastward along Binhai Avenue. Inside the car, old songs by Cai Qin played, the two children in the back seat chattered away, Wang Lijuan planned what to grow in a balcony vegetable garden, and Lu Mingqiang was thinking about his mother's recent condition. After a 17-minute drive, they arrived before 11:00 at the South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, where his parents lived.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, to Meilan District, Dayingshan East First Street, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Area.

name: Visited parents and discovered mother's leg condition.
description: Just after arriving at his parents' home, the two children rushed to their grandmother Chen Xiuying. Lu Mingqiang keenly noticed that when his mother stood up from the sofa, she supported herself with her left hand on her knee and dragged her left leg; she was smiling but seemed to be enduring pain, so he asked with concern. Chen Xiuying initially tried to hide it, but under his insistence she rolled up her trouser leg to reveal a visibly swollen left knee, and then admitted that it had started hurting the night before last and she had hardly slept last night. Lu Mingqiang felt both distressed and guilty, and immediately decided to take her to the hospital.
location: Parents' home, South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Rushed to seek medical care and established a care plan
description: Lu Mingqiang immediately helped his mother downstairs, then drove with his father Lu Jianguo to the Longkun Community Health Service Center in Longhua District, Haikou, holding his mother's hand and comforting her along the way. After an 11-minute drive, the doctor diagnosed an acute attack of cold-damp rheumatic joint pain in elderly patients caused by the wet and cold weather. He prescribed topical plasters and oral diclofenac sodium sustained-release capsules, and advised her to keep warm, avoid cold water, and walk less. Lu Mingqiang wrote all the medication instructions in his phone memo, then ran around paying fees and picking up medicine. At home, he applied the plaster to his mother himself, reminded her to take the medicine, and set up a care plan of stocking up on medicine every month and applying hot compresses before cold snaps. He said to his mother, "If anything happens, be sure to tell us." His mother nodded, her eyes red.
location: No. 14 Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Longhua District Longkun Community Health Service Center, Haikou City, and Parents' Home, South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District

name: Having lunch at his parents' home and reassuring the elderly couple
description: Father Lu Jianguo prepared lunch, making home-style dishes such as boiled prawns, stewed chicken with shiitake mushrooms, and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. Mother Chen Xiuying was not in high spirits, so Lu Mingqiang specially served her chicken soup. Wang Lijuan kept playfully talking to the children to liven up the atmosphere. Lu Mingqiang mentioned that they would go back to set up the planting rack, and the two children were excited to help. He tried to reassure his parents, saying that he would urge them to take their medicine on time. After the meal, he helped clear the dishes, chatted with his father for a while, and coaxed his parents to take an afternoon nap.
location: Parents' home, South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home and set up a balcony vegetable planting rack
description: Seeing that his parents were emotionally stable, Lu Mingqiang and his family of four drove back to Banshan Garden. After arriving home and resting briefly, Lu Mingqiang began his balcony renovation. He first planned the area, measured with a tape measure, fixed three storage crates onto a custom metal bracket to form a three-tier structure, soaked coconut coir bricks, mixed in organic fertilizer, spread it into the crates, then sowed scallion, lettuce, and pepper seeds in sections and covered them with soil. The key step was installing the drip irrigation system: using the timer and drip hose bought in the morning, he carefully compared the interfaces, used a heat gun on the tees and connectors, attached them to the balcony faucet, and repeatedly adjusted the water flow and timer settings, finally achieving the effect of pressing a switch to automatically water for one minute. Looking at the brand-new small vegetable garden, he felt extremely delighted.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organize tools and check the kite for tomorrow.
description: After the planting rack was set up, Lu Mingqiang cleaned up the balcony tools, wiping the screwdrivers, wrenches, electric drill, hot glue gun, and leftover pipe fittings clean before putting them back in the toolbox. After drinking half a pot of water, he sat on a stool on the balcony, eating the mango brought over by his wife, Wang Lijuan. Thinking that tomorrow he would take the kids to fly kites, he went to the storage room and found the eagle kite he had made by hand. After checking that the frame and line wheel were intact, he re-wound the line wheel tightly and placed it back by the shoe cabinet at the entrance, preparing for tomorrow's outing.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Accompanied my second son to ride a bike around the neighborhood.
description: When the second son Lu Zihan woke up from his nap and cried to go out and play, Lu Mingqiang brought his little bicycle and took him downstairs. First, he watched him ride in circles in the community square, then they went to the pavilion in the back garden to play a "find the leaves" game, picking up half a bag of leaves of various shapes. Before six in the evening, he took the sweaty little one home.
location: The plaza and garden outside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped his wife prepare a weight-loss dinner
description: Back home, Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang washed his hands and went over to help. Following that day's weight-loss plan, dinner had to be light. He helped place scallions and ginger on the cleaned sea bass, drizzled it with steamed fish soy sauce, and put it into the steamer. Then he cut cucumbers and tomatoes to make a cold dish. Tonight's main dishes were steamed sea bass and a cold three-shred salad, with multigrain rice as the staple.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family shared a weight-loss dinner together.
description: The family sat down to eat together. The dishes were light but tasty. Lu Mingqiang strictly controlled his food intake, eating only one bowl of mixed-grain rice. His elder son, Lu Zixuan, was very interested in the steamed sea bass and took several helpings himself; his younger son, Lu Zihan, played while eating and was scolded by Wang Lijuan. While eating, Lu Mingqiang asked Lu Zixuan whether he had been hurt playing football and reminded him to stretch after exercise. The mealtime conversation was warm and happy.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring the eldest son in math and reading picture books to the younger son.
description: After dinner and cleaning up, it was study time. Lu Mingqiang first helped Lu Zixuan with his math homework, which was classifying triangles and rectangles. He took out building blocks and explained while manipulating them; the child quickly understood, and after getting the answers right, drew a five-pointed star in his workbook. Then he went into the children's room to read Cloud Bread to Lu Zihan. The little boy was being mischievous and playing with a toy car, but was brought back to finish the whole book.
location: Home study and children's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: In the evening, self-studied the theoretical textbook for senior technician
description: After the two children were settled, Lu Mingqiang turned on the desk lamp in his study and opened Chapter 3, "High and Low Voltage Switchgear Maintenance and Commissioning," of the Advanced Technician Theory Textbook. Drawing on his experience that day with the control system while building the planting rack, he felt he had a deeper understanding of "electrical control logic." He worked through the example problems and derived the circuit diagrams on his own, then composed two fault analysis questions based on the week's maintenance log and tried to solve them using the methods in the book. His thinking went smoothly.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening core strength training.
description: After studying for an hour, Lu Mingqiang got up to stretch his muscles, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and did core training. He started with planks, holding each set for 70 seconds for 3 sets; then did superman exercises and glute bridges, 3 sets each, doing each set to failure. Since the workout volume that day was not large, he felt relatively relaxed, and after finishing, his whole body felt loose and stretched.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washed up, chatted with his wife, and went to bed.
description: After training, Lu Mingqiang first took a shower in the bathroom, then returned to the bedroom and saw his wife Wang Lijuan leaning against the headboard looking at her phone, browsing for a place to fly kites tomorrow. The two chatted about how they felt today. Lu Mingqiang was still worried about his mother's leg problem, and they agreed to go back every week to remind her to apply hot compresses. They also talked about taking the children to Wanlv Garden to fly kites tomorrow, and remarked that the children had been sensible recently. As they chatted, their eyelids began to droop. Wang Lijuan turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Lu Mingqiang turned off the light and lay down, recalling the day—his mother was in no serious trouble, the balcony had a new look, and the children were happy. He fell into a deep sleep, feeling secure and content.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning low back and core training
description: At 6:10 in the morning the alarm went off. Getting up quietly, he started lower back and core training on the living room mat. He completed three sets of superman exercises (20 reps each), glute bridges (20 reps each), and planks (60 seconds each) in sequence. The movements were in place, his core was engaged, he was slightly sweating, and the stiffness in his lower back was relieved.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After the training session and a shower, he sat at the dining table with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and younger son Lu Zihan. Breakfast was the Baoluo rice noodles bought yesterday and the poached eggs his wife had cooked. While eating, he reminded Lu Zixuan to finish the remaining math homework in the afternoon after flying kites in the morning. Lu Zihan ate with sauce all over his mouth, and his wife smiled and wiped it clean.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Inspect the drip irrigation system and deal with details
description: After breakfast, he went to the balcony to check the planting rack he had built the day before. He wrapped two more layers of waterproof tape around the connection between the timer and the drip irrigation pipe to make sure it was completely leak-proof. Then he manually started the submersible pump to test whether the water came out evenly. Only when he saw droplets dripping uniformly into the three vegetable planter boxes did he feel at ease.
location: Balcony, Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sowed seeds of scallions, lettuce, and chili peppers
description: After confirming that the drip irrigation system was fine, I started sowing. I took out the pre-soaked coconut coir soil, used a small trowel to make shallow furrows in the planting box, carefully sprinkled the scallion, lettuce, and pepper seeds into them, and then lightly covered them with a thin layer of soil. Finally, I used a spray bottle to water thoroughly for root establishment, and pushed the planting rack to a sunny spot. I planned that the balcony would turn green in ten days to two weeks.
location: Balcony, Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pack up and get ready to go out.
description: After finishing sowing, he went back inside, changed into sneakers and a T-shirt, checked the eagle kite in the corner of the balcony—the frame and string were intact—then felt for the e-bike key, confirmed his phone was in his pocket, and got ready to take the children to Wanlv Garden to fly kites.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take my son to Evergreen Park to fly a kite.
description: He rode an electric bike with Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan to Wanlv Garden. The wind that day was neither too strong nor too light, just right for flying kites. When they arrived at the park's big lawn, he taught Lu Zixuan to run against the wind and let out the line, and the eagle kite soon flew up into the sky. Lu Zixuan excitedly pulled the line and ran back and forth, while Lu Zihan chased after him clapping his little hands. The father and sons ran together, worked up a sweat, and felt very happy.
location: The big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home.
description: After flying the kite for over an hour, Lu Zixuan got tired from running, and Lu Zihan also started fussing to go home. So he packed up the kite and rode the electric bike back home with the two children.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch
description: When he got home, he wiped the children's faces with a damp towel, then went into the kitchen to help his wife. She had made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried choy sum, and reheated yesterday's leftover soy sauce chicken. He helped serve rice and set out chopsticks. The family sat down to eat. Lu Zixuan was still excitedly saying that the eagle kite had flown the highest, and he nodded and responded to him while eating.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and homework checking
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang had Lu Zixuan take out his weekend math homework to check. He found that one multiplication word problem asking 'how many in total' had been solved with addition, so he patiently explained it using fruit at hand until his son understood. Then he let his son go play in his own room, while he dozed off on the living room sofa for half an hour to make up for the early start.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Rest and study in solitude
description: After waking from his afternoon rest, while his wife took Lu Zihan for a nap, he used this quiet time to take out the senior technician textbook, focusing on the interlock control logic for distribution cabinet fault troubleshooting that he had marked before. He simulated several fault scenarios in his mind against the circuit diagram, and after pondering for fifteen minutes, he felt he had a clearer understanding.
location: Living room, 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family free time and household chores
description: At 3 PM, both children woke up. Lu Zixuan watched cartoons, while Lu Zihan played with building blocks. Taking advantage of the break, he tidied up the empty flower pots and old packaging boxes on the balcony and got ready to put them away. His wife used the washing machine to do laundry; he helped lower the drying rack and chatted with her for a bit about the schedule for grocery shopping and picking up and dropping off the kids next week.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Running alone in the evening and buying groceries at the market.
description: At 4 p.m., I changed into shorts and running shoes and went out. First, I stopped at the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket on Jinmao Middle Road to buy greens and loofah for dinner, and told the familiar shopkeeper I would pick them up in a little while. Then I jogged to Wanlv Garden Park and ran a steady 5 kilometers along the seaside trail at a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. After the run, I felt very comfortable and was soaked through with sweat. Then I stretched on a bench, jogged back to the market to pick up the vegetables, and went home.
location: Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Supermarket, No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District

name: Take a shower and prepare dinner.
description: After getting home, he took a cold shower in the bathroom and changed into dry loungewear. Then he went to the kitchen to help his wife wash and cut the greens and loofah she had bought, preparing for dinner.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: He stir-fried some choy sum with garlic, his wife made loofah and egg soup, and reheated the braised pork left over from the day before yesterday. The dinner was light and nutritious. Since he had just been running, he had a good appetite, but he restrained himself and ate a little less meat. The family chatted while eating. Lu Zihan said that in the afternoon she had gone to the balcony to look at the seeds they had just sown.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Called his mother to check on her and bought medicine online
description: After dinner, he used his phone to order a box of Musk Bone-Strengthening Plaster. The delivery address was his mother's home in Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Meilan District. Then he called his mother and asked in detail about her knee. She said the medicated patch she got yesterday really hurt less after applying it. He reminded her again to be sure to apply a hot compress for 10 minutes before putting on the patch, and reminded her to wear knee pads when going out next week because of the temperature drop. After hanging up, he felt much more at ease.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helping the children with their studies and quality family time
description: After the phone call, he tutored Lu Zixuan in correcting the multiplication mistake found during the afternoon check and made sure he fully understood it. Then he accompanied Lu Zihan in building a power tower with LEGO, explaining that the discs are insulators used to separate the wires. Meanwhile, his wife used her phone to prepare clothes and schoolbags for the two children for school the next day.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening exam preparation study
description: After settling the two children to sleep, he sat at the desk, turned on the desk lamp, and continued studying the senior technician textbook. He spent forty minutes reviewing the fault analysis mind map he had drawn last week, wrote out the key and difficult points of interlock control logic from memory in his notebook, then did five multiple-choice fault analysis questions from the textbook's companion materials. He got them all right, which added more confidence for next week's exam.
location: Desk at Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Core training and stretching relaxation before bedtime
description: After studying, he returned to the bedroom and did the second core workout of the evening on the floor. Just like in the morning, he stayed focused and tried to extend the plank to 65 seconds. Although the soreness in his core was intense, he gritted his teeth and completed all three sets. Afterward, he did Cat-Cow and Child's poses to relax his lower back.
location: Bedroom 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime review
description: After his workout, he washed up and brushed his teeth. When he returned to the bedroom, his wife was still awake. She asked about the pickup and drop-off arrangements for Lu Zixuan's interest class the next day, and they briefly went over tomorrow's work plan. Lying in bed, he reflected on the day: the drip irrigation system was improved, the seeds were sown, the kite was flown, the run was done, Mom was called, the medicine was bought, and the study tasks were completed. He felt grounded and content.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: He turned off the light, filed away everything for the day, and had a clear expectation for tomorrow's work and life. He soon fell asleep.
location: Room 203, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training.
description: Morning exercise on the living room floor mat at home: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 20 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 65-second planks. Felt the core more stable than yesterday; slightly sweaty at the end and in better spirits.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After showering, changed into work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had cooked lean pork porridge; he ate two bowls with fried eggs and shredded pickled mustard greens. He checked the weather on his phone, confirmed it would be cloudy and muggy in the afternoon, and decided to wear only a thin T-shirt under his work clothes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: He rode an electric bike, first taking his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him to listen carefully in class. Then he took his second son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and only left reassured after watching a teacher lead him inside.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District

name: Commuting to the company.
description: He rode the electric bike from the kindergarten along Guomao Road and Haisheng Road to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. On the way, he bought a large bottle of mineral water at the convenience store outside the park. After arriving, he parked the bike and greeted the colleagues who had arrived early.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (on the commute)

name: Team morning meeting and tool preparation
description: Team Leader Zhang led the morning briefing, emphasized work safety, and assigned the morning tasks: go to the old residential area on Haixiu Road in Xiuying District to fix a distribution box fault, then patrol along Binhai Avenue. After the meeting, he and Chen Jianguo picked up and inspected tools including a multimeter, voltage tester, and air switch, confirmed that the insulating gloves and boots were not damaged, and then set off in the pickup truck.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handling distribution box faults and inspections in residential areas.
description: At 8:45, he arrived at the old residential community on Haixiu Road, Xiuying District. Inspecting the distribution box of the building unit, he found that the branch circuit breaker had aged and caused the trip. Coordinating with Chen Jianguo, he cut off power, verified no voltage, and hung a safety tag, then replaced it with a new breaker. The line insulation resistance was retested and found normal. The resident aunt thanked him: "Master, is it fixed? Thank you so much!" Afterwards, he inspected the corridor lighting and meter boxes of the other two units in the community, tightened screws, and recorded that the grounding wire on the casing of one meter box was corroded and needed to be reported for repair.
location: Old residential area near Haixiuyuan, No. 20 Dongfangyang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning work wrap-up and lunch break preparation
description: After finishing the morning work, he drove to the shade of the trees outside the construction site on Haixiu Road and parked. He sent a WeChat message to his wife saying he would not go home for lunch. Then he discussed going to a fast-food restaurant with Chen Jianguo.
location: Haixiu Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (the perimeter of the construction site near Haixiuyuan).

name: Lunch
description: Went to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road to eat. Lu Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with a fried egg, Chen Jianguo ordered pork trotter rice. Zhao Qiang arrived later and joined the table. The three chatted about the weather and recent work while eating.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Midday brisk walk and rest.
description: After the meal, changed into old running shoes and briskly walked along the Haisheng Road sidewalk for 30 minutes, about 3 km, with a pace of 9:20 /km. I broke a slight sweat and felt more comfortable than sitting for a long time. After the walk, I sat in the shade to rest, drank the water bought in the morning, and chatted with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang about household expenses such as rising pork prices.
location: Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (near Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park)

name: Afternoon inspection and mentoring newcomers
description: In the afternoon, they inspected meter boxes along Binhai Avenue. Paired with Zhao Qiang, Lu Mingqiang checked the incoming and outgoing lines for overheating and loose screws while quizzing Zhao Qiang on site. He pointed out the oxidation problem at the neutral wire connection and taught him the tricks of sanding it down and judging the degree of oxidation. The inspection of the distribution rooms in two commercial buildings showed everything normal. He asked Zhao Qiang about his progress in the intermediate electrician textbook. Zhao Qiang mentioned difficulty with transformer calculation problems, and Lu Mingqiang promised to explain turns-ratio calculations to him during the lunch break the next day.
location: Distribution rooms and meter boxes along Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returned to the company to sort out the ledgers
description: After finishing work, he returned to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. He filled in the maintenance records and inspection forms and submitted them to Team Leader Zhang for signature, counted the tools and put them back in the warehouse, changed out of his sweat-soaked work clothes, and found salt stains on his back.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying groceries after work
description: Rode an e-bike off work and went to Jinmao Middle Road vegetable market (near Cailanzi Community Discount Supermarket). Bought dried coconut meat, pearl barley, mung beans, and other qingbuliang ingredients, plus greens and tomatoes, and picked up sugar apples that the second son loves.
location: Jinmao Middle Road Vegetable Market, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (near Cailanzi Community Discount Supermarket).

name: After arriving home, check the vegetable box on the balcony.
