description: After arriving home, his younger son Lu Zihan ran over for a hug. He went to the balcony to check the seeds they had sown. The soil surface was moist, but nothing had sprouted yet. He gently brushed the soil aside to confirm the seeds were intact, then picked up Hanhan and played with him.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: His wife used the bought greens and tomatoes to make stir-fried vegetables and tomato egg drop soup, plus braised pork. The family of four sat around the table to eat. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, shared that he came in second in the running race in P.E. class; the younger son, Lu Zihan, said he painted flowers at kindergarten.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: Help Lu Zixuan practice column arithmetic for three-digit addition and subtraction. Remind him to align the digits and correct missing carries, and give him three similar problems until he fully masters it.

He personally taught Zhao Qiang to tighten the nuts and use a file to clean the oxide layer on the terminal surface until the temperature returned to normal. Very annoyed, he crouched down and examined it carefully, then sighed helplessly. Since he needed the car the next day, he immediately drove to the 'Hot-Patch Car Tire' repair shop on Guomao Road that he often went to. The owner inspected it and said it needed sheet metal work and spray painting, quoting 600 yuan. Lu Mingqiang had no choice but to agree. While waiting, he smoked a cigarette gloomily at the shop entrance. About half an hour later, the mechanic told him the repair was done; the scratch had been smoothed out and polished, and the new paint covered it perfectly. Lu Mingqiang scanned a QR code to pay 600 yuan, picked up the car, and left.
location: No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park parking lot, Fire Patch Car Tire Repair Shop, Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Lin Feng quickly pointed out Lu Mingqiang's old habit of hitting the ball too late and reminded him to meet the ball earlier. Lu Mingqiang adjusted his stance, and the quality of his backhand returns improved noticeably. They played hard until 8 pm, both drenched in sweat. Afterwards they took showers, changed into dry clothes, and went to the rest area to drink sports drinks. Lu Mingqiang brought up the car repair, and Lin Feng comforted him with his own cracked-phone-screen experience, saying that exercise was the best remedy. Lu Mingqiang felt much better after hearing that.

As the family of four was eating, the younger son noticed that the chili pepper and lettuce seeds on the balcony had sprouted, and the whole family gathered around to look. The older son wanted to paint a picture to record it. Lu Qiang adjusted the drip irrigation settings and told the children not to mess with the soil.
location: Dining room and balcony, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Study preparation and evening tasks
description: After the meal, he rested for half an hour while his wife cleared the dishes. Lu Qiang went to the study, posted the power system theory framework diagram on the wall, focused on reviewing relay protection content, and deepened his understanding by combining it with the morning fault. In the middle, he called his aunt to ask how she was doing and chatted for ten minutes.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Heading to Wanlv Garden.
description: Changed into running shoes and quick-dry clothes, took my phone and arm pouch, and rode an electric bicycle to Wanlv Garden, arriving in less than 12 minutes.
location: Departed from No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China, heading along Binhai Avenue to Evergreen Park.

name: Interval running training at Wanlv Park
description: After warming up for a few minutes, did interval running on the inner loop trail of Wanlv Garden: 5 sets of 400 m fast running paired with 400 m jogging. Heart rate spiked during the fast runs, and I relaxed during the jogs. After running, stretched thoroughly on the grass. Checked the app: this week's cumulative mileage reached 15 km, hitting the goal. Did not meet running buddy Abin.
location: Inner loop trail, Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Returning home and taking a shower
description: After running, he rode his electric bike home, drank a large glass of plain water, then took a shower in the bathroom to wash away the smell of sweat.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Evening core training and review consolidation
description: After a short rest, I did a simplified evening core workout in the living room: 3 sets each of glute bridges and planks, holding the plank for 70 seconds, avoiding overfatigue. Then I went to the study, closed my eyes in front of the posted mind map, silently reviewing the principles of relay protection and confirming memory of key points.
location: Living room and study, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Family time and bedtime preparation
description: Went to the children's room to check the eldest son's math homework and explain the wrong answers; read the picture book The Train Station in My Tummy with the younger son. Then urged them to brush their teeth, wash their faces, and go to bed. Discussed with his wife going to the vegetable market tomorrow, the weekend, to buy pork ribs.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Folded the clean work clothes and underwear for tomorrow and placed them on the bedside table, and set the phone alarm for 5:30 tomorrow morning. Lying in bed and reviewing the day, I felt grounded and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Morning training and breakfast preparation
description: The phone alarm went off right at 6:15. Lu Mingqiang got up immediately and, seeing that his wife Juanzi was still sound asleep, quietly started core training on the mat beside the bed. He did 3 sets of flying swallow exercises, 20 reps each; 3 sets of glute bridges, 20 reps each; and 3 sets of planks, holding each for 60 seconds. Because he planned to run in the evening, he deliberately reduced the intensity, holding the planks 5 seconds less than usual. After that, he did a few stretching movements and felt his body was warmed up. When the training was over, he quietly took a quick shower in the bathroom and changed into clean work clothes. When he came out, Juanzi was already awake and looking at her phone. He told her to lie in a bit longer, went to the kitchen, and cooked a bowl of Hainan rice noodles, using the fresh rice noodles he had bought the previous day, topped with pickled cabbage, peanuts, dried beef, and homemade garlic oil. He finished it in a few bites, washed the bowl and chopsticks, then folded the workout T-shirt and shorts that had dried overnight and put them into a plastic bag, ready to wear for running in the evening.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work by e-bike
description: At 7:15 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang grabbed his keys and phone, put on a sun-protection jacket, and wheeled his electric scooter downstairs. Starting from the Banshan Garden residential area, he rode along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Haixiu Road, then took Haisheng Road. With green lights all the way, he arrived at the main gate of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park in about 7 minutes. He parked the scooter in the shed, locked it, picked up his safety helmet, and walked quickly to the office.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning meeting and work preparation
description: Just as he sat down in the office, Team Leader Zhang gathered everyone for a morning meeting and briefly explained the day's tasks: the Haikou China Resources Building in Guomao needed additional power distribution box interfaces, and someone would need to be arranged to do a routine inspection of residential meter boxes in the afternoon. Team Leader Zhang assigned Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo to focus on surveying the office building, with Zhao Qiang as assistant. Lu Mingqiang listened carefully, calculating the approach in his mind. After the meeting, he and Chen Jianguo went to the warehouse, checked all the tools and materials needed for the day—including the hammer drill, cables, and clamp meter—packed them into tool bags, and prepared for the field assignment.
location: Company office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: China Resources Building distribution line survey.
description: At 9:00 sharp, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang carried their tool bags onto the company's small van, and Chen Jianguo drove to the China Resources Building in Haikou. On the way, they talked about a restaurant fault that Chen Jianguo had fixed yesterday. Lu Mingqiang joked that the restaurant owner probably had to treat them to iced tea today. Zhao Qiang was scrolling through his phone in the back seat, and Lu Mingqiang reminded him to listen to instructions at the site and not be careless. They arrived at the China Resources Building at about 9:20. After coordinating with the property manager, the three started work. Lu Mingqiang was mainly responsible for comparing the actual cable routes against the drawings, Chen Jianguo was responsible for drilling holes and measuring whether the reserved conduits were clear. Zhao Qiang was a bit unfamiliar at first, so Lu Mingqiang had him unscrew the bolts on the access panel of the fresh air duct to check the cable routing at the top. They checked from the 15th floor to the 16th floor, walked through every pre-run cable channel, and made marks in the low-voltage cable shaft. There was no air conditioning in the corridor, only ventilation. After an hour and a half of work, sweat was dripping down the safety helmet straps. In the middle, they took a short break, drank the tea they had brought, and then continued. By about 11:40, the routes on the drawings had basically been verified on site. Lu Mingqiang also noted the blocked conduit problems he found in his work notebook, planning to report them to Team Leader Zhang when he got back. After finishing, the three packed up their tools, said goodbye to the property manager, and drove back to the company. On the way, Lu Mingqiang explained the key points of the survey to Zhao Qiang and told him to draw a sketch when he got back to deepen his understanding. They returned to the company at about 12:00.
location: Haikou China Resources Building, No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch time with colleagues
description: He got back to the company at exactly 12:00. Lu Mingqiang called Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to go downstairs to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant for lunch. He ordered a spicy soup rice set meal with a fried egg. The spicy soup warmed his whole body and dispelled most of the midday drowsiness. Chen Jianguo chatted about his son’s midterm exams while eating, Lu Mingqiang joined in with a few words, and the three briefly relaxed.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunchtime Brisk Walk and Work Break
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang told Zhao Qiang to go back to the office and rest, while he and Chen Jianguo started brisk walking along Haisheng Road outside the company. Not in a hurry, he kept his pace slightly faster than his usual stroll, mainly to stretch his muscles and stay energetic for the afternoon's work. After about 30 minutes, roughly 3.2 kilometers, he was slightly sweaty. On the way back, he noticed the bougainvillea by the roadside in full bloom and felt in a good mood. Back at the company, he sat down in the break room, took out his phone, and scrolled through local news for a while. In the balcony vegetable gardening group, he saw someone share a pest-repellent trick, found it useful, and saved it. He also sent his wife Juanzi a WeChat message asking what she wanted to eat for dinner. Juanzi replied that there were spare ribs and leftover greens from yesterday in the fridge, so no need to buy anything else.
location: Haisheng Road and internal roads of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province; company rest room

name: Inspection of electricity meter boxes in Binhai Yuewan Residential Community.
description: At about 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang went out to work again, heading to the Binhai Yuewan Community. The community was built around 2000, and they needed to inspect the first-floor electricity meter boxes of several buildings. The three inspected building by building carefully. The first few buildings were normal. When they reached Building 17, Lu Mingqiang found that the incoming line terminal of one meter box was hot and discolored. He measured it with a clamp meter and found the current was a bit high, estimating that the resident was using a high-power appliance or the wiring was aging. After discussing with Chen Jianguo, he decided to record the situation and notify the property management to temporarily monitor the load of this box, and to come back the next day with new circuit breakers and cables to solve it thoroughly. Zhao Qiang watched seriously and took the initiative to ask how to judge the degree of terminal oxidation. Lu Mingqiang patiently explained a few sentences to him. By the time they finished inspecting all the points, it was nearly 5 p.m. The three packed up their tools and drove back to the company.
location: Binhai Yuewan Residential Community, No. 76-1 Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-work preparation and tool check.
description: After returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang organized the drawings and inspection records from today's survey. Then he and Zhao Qiang carefully rinsed and wiped the tools that had been used and put them back in place. He also made a list of the materials needed for the next day and showed it to Team Leader Zhang. After everything was tidied up, it was already 5:15 p.m. He said goodbye to Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, changed out of his work clothes, and got ready to leave for home.
location: Company office and warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shopping at the vegetable market on the way home from work
description: Lu Mingqiang hopped on his e-bike. Instead of heading straight home, he first stopped by the vegetable market on Jinmao Middle Road. Juanzi had said a couple of days ago that she wanted to eat qingbuliang, and since he planned to have a bowl after his run tonight, he went to the dried-goods stall to find the familiar grandma. As soon as she saw him, she greeted with a smile, “Aqiang, here to buy groceries again!” He replied, “Grandma, weigh me some dried coconut, pearl barley, and mung beans, and give me half a catty of red dates.” He picked each item carefully and had her pack them separately in bags. After paying, he stopped at the fruit stall to buy two ripe papayas, planning to cut them up for the kids in the evening, and then rode home.
location: Jinmao Middle Road food market, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Tending balcony vegetable seedlings and parent-child bonding
description: When he got home, his wife Juanzi was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang first put away the Qingbuliang ingredients he had bought, then changed into an old T-shirt and went to the balcony. The chili pepper and lettuce seedlings that had only sprouted yesterday looked even more vigorous today, lush green. He gently touched the soil with his fingers and felt that the moisture was about right, but the drip irrigation seemed to be tilted to one side, so he squatted down and adjusted the positions of the drip emitters so the water could evenly nourish each seedling. Just then, his 4-year-old son Hanhan ran over with a toy excavator in his hand and insisted on 'planting vegetables' with him. Lu Mingqiang picked up Hanhan, showed him the newly sprouted lettuce shoots, and played with him for a while until Juanzi called them to dinner.
location: Balcony, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and post-meal rest
description: Dinner time. Juanzi stir-fried green peppers with pork, simmered a pork rib soup, and reheated yesterday's leftover greens. The family of four sat around the table, and Lu Mingqiang told the two boys to drink their soup slowly. After the meal, his elder son Xuanxuan helped put the dishes and chopsticks into the sink. Juanzi told Lu Mingqiang to go and rest, saying she would wash them later. The hour after dinner was their fixed rest time. Lu Mingqiang and Juanzi sat on the living room sofa. Juanzi took out the reply slip from the children's school that required a parent's signature; he read it and signed it, then chatted with her about the gossip he had heard at the vegetable market. While chatting, he took out the workout clothes and running shoes for the evening run and placed them by the door. He also opened the fitness app on his phone, selected the 'Easy Fat-Burning Run' mode, and set a 3 km goal.
location: Dining room and living room at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Couple's evening jog
description: At 7:30 in the evening, the father came as promised and took Xuanxuan and Hanhan to the community playground to play on the slide. Lu Mingqiang and his wife Juanzi changed into their sportswear and started warming up in the small square downstairs. He led a few sets of jumping jacks and high knees to get their heart rates up, then taught Juanzi lunge stretches and side leg stretches to loosen up her legs and hips. Juanzi was a bit reluctant, saying she hadn't run in a long time and was afraid she couldn't keep up. Lu Mingqiang smiled and told her not to worry, to take it easy and treat it as a walk. After warming up, the two set off from the community gate and jogged west along Jinmao Middle Road. Lu Mingqiang deliberately slowed down to match Juanzi's breathing rhythm, keeping a pace where they could chat while running without getting out of breath. The streetlights were bright, there were few pedestrians, and the night breeze felt pleasant. They ran about 1.5 kilometers to the entrance of the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park and turned back. On the way back, Juanzi was sweating on her forehead and breathing hard. Lu Mingqiang gently encouraged her to hold on a little longer, and they finally completed the full 3 kilometers.
location: The section from Banshan Garden Residential Area, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park

name: Deep heart-to-heart talk between the couple and walking home.
description: After running 3 kilometers, both were a little out of breath, so they sat down on a bench in the small park to rest. Lu Mingqiang handed Juanzi a bottle of water. Under the streetlight, she began telling him what was on her mind: Xuanxuan's math scores had dropped again, the English teacher had also texted saying he was distracted in class, and vegetable prices had gone up a lot this month, so household expenses were higher. Lu Mingqiang listened quietly and held her hand, feeling a little guilty. He said, “It's my fault. Lately my mind has been on reviewing, and I haven't been spending enough time with you.” Juanzi didn't say anything, just held his hand tighter. After a moment she said slowly, “The family is in good hands with me. Don't worry too much about the exam.” At that moment, the weight on Lu Mingqiang's heart seemed to lighten. After the heart-to-heart talk, the two got up from the bench, held hands again, and slowly walked home along Jinmao Middle Road. Neither spoke. Moonlight spilled onto the road, and their shadows stretched long, overlapping with each other.
location: Benches in the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule-of-Law Theme Park on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and walking back to the Banshan Garden residential area.

name: Family fruit time
description: After getting home, the two children were still playing with building blocks in the living room. When they saw their parents come back, they rushed over. Lu Mingqiang cut the papaya he had bought into small pieces, put them on toothpicks, and fed them to the two sons together with Juanzi. While eating, the older son Xuanxuan talked about the fun things he had encountered at the playground, making everyone laugh. Watching the children with papaya all over their faces, Lu Mingqiang and Juanzi exchanged smiles. The atmosphere at home was warm and harmonious.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation training and washing up
description: Once the children settled down, Lu Mingqiang returned to his room. Not wanting to do high-intensity training and disturb his rest, he simply did two sets of glute bridges on the floor, 15 reps each, then used a foam roller on his thighs and calves to relax the muscles from tonight's run. After that, he went to the bathroom to wash up and took a comfortable hot shower, and the fatigue in his body seemed to dissolve.
location: Bedroom and bathroom in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime talk between husband and wife
description: When Lu Mingqiang came out of the shower, Juanzi had already bathed the children and coaxed them to sleep. He leaned against the headboard, and Juanzi sat over to discuss tomorrow Saturday's plan with him: she would go to the vegetable market in the morning to buy groceries, and asked Lu Mingqiang to take Xuanxuan to Wanlv Garden to fly kites first, letting the child have a good time, then come home for lunch. Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement. They chatted a few more casual words, and as sleepiness gradually set in, they got ready for bed.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training, morning run at Baishamen Park, and packing breakfast
description: At 6:10 in the morning the alarm went off. After getting up, Lu Mingqiang spread a yoga mat in the bedroom and did core training, completing 3 sets of superman exercises, 3 sets of glute bridges, and 3 sets of planks, each set lasting 70 seconds, to protect his lower back. After training, he took a hot shower and put on clean clothes. He then rode his electric bike to Baishamen Park, met his running buddy A Bin at 6:50, and ran 5 kilometers on the rubber track at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer. After the run, he stretched at the park entrance and had a brief chat with A Bin. At 7:30 he rode back, and at the entrance to the neighborhood, he got two servings of marinated Hainan noodles to go from Sister Chen at Chen Ji's marinated noodle shop, one with an extra egg, and brought them home to share with his wife.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Emergency repair for burst kitchen water pipe.
description: At 7:55, Lu Mingqiang returned home and found that the cold water pipe joint in the kitchen had aged and cracked, with water gushing out and spreading into the living room. He immediately rushed into the kitchen and shut off the main valve, then used towels with his wife Wang Lijuan to stop the leak and clear the water. He then estimated the dimensions and cycled to Lao Chen's Hardware and Building Materials Store at the back gate of the residential area, where he bought a 1-inch PVC cold and hot water pipe 200 mm long, two female-threaded direct couplings, and thread seal tape. After returning home, he used a pipe cutter to cut off the old pipe, plugged in an electric heat fusion welder, and welded the new pipe into place. At 9:30, a water test showed no leakage. He and his wife cleaned up the water on the kitchen and living room floors, and tidied and hung the wet cardboard boxes to dry. After the repair, Wang Lijuan praised his skill, and Lu Mingqiang cleaned and put away the tools.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Lao Chen Hardware and Building Materials Store on Jinmao Middle Road

name: Balcony vegetable garden care and tidying
description: After fixing the water pipe, Lu Mingqiang took a shower and rested, then went to the balcony to tend the planted chili peppers and lettuce seedlings. He watered them with a small spray bottle and loosened the soil with a small trowel. The seedlings looked healthy, and he planned to buy compound fertilizer the next day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the market with the whole family to buy groceries, then lunch and an afternoon nap
description: At 10:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang, his wife Wang Lijuan, and their sons Xuanxuan and Hanhan walked to Wenhua Vegetable Market. Wang Lijuan selected fresh spinach, two jin of pork ribs, a mackerel, and scallions, while Lu Mingqiang pushed the small cart, handled the bargaining, and calmed the impatient children. At 11:50 they returned home fully loaded. Wang Lijuan cooked stir-fried spinach, braised mackerel, and pork rib and winter melon soup, while Lu Mingqiang washed the rice and cooked the meal. The family sat around and enjoyed lunch. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang washed the dishes, leaned back on the sofa scrolling through phone news, and napped for about half an hour.
location: Wenhua Vegetable Market and Banshan Garden Residential Area, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing to head to Evergreen Park to fly kites.
description: When he woke up from his nap, Lu Mingqiang woke his son Xuanxuan. He checked the old kite, found the frame was loose, and decided to buy a new one at the park entrance. He sent a WeChat message to his kite-flying friend Ajie, inviting him to come along, then prepared a power bank, a small fan, and the children’s water bottles. Wang Lijuan dressed Hanhan. Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike with Xuanxuan, while Wang Lijuan pushed Hanhan in a stroller, and the family set off.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Kite flying and family leisure at Wanlv Garden
description: The family arrived at Wanlv Park. First, they bought a new 'Super Wings' large kite and two rolls of string from a stall at the entrance for Xuanxuan, then picked a spot on the big lawn. Lu Mingqiang taught Xuanxuan to run against the wind and let out the string; the kite quickly lifted off. Xuanxuan shouted with excitement, Hanhan ran after the kite, and Wang Lijuan watched from a picnic mat under the shade of a tree. Around 3 p.m., Ajie arrived on his electric bike and showed off a new kite he had made from bamboo. Lu Mingqiang exchanged kite-making tips with him. Near 4 p.m., the wind weakened. Lu Mingqiang reeled in the kite and cleaned up the picnic mat and trash.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tidying up, buying coconut water, and visiting aunt
description: Before leaving Wanlv Park, Lu Mingqiang bought two fresh coconuts for the children to drink and rested briefly with his wife. Then he rode an electric bike with Xuanxuan on the back, while Wang Lijuan pushed Hanhan in a stroller, heading to Zhongjie Road in Qiongshan District. On the way, Lu Mingqiang bought dried coconut meat, Job's tears, mung beans, and other ingredients at a Qingbuliang ingredients shop. After arriving at Aunt Wang Xiuying's home, he handed over the ingredients and conveyed his mother's greetings. Aunt Wang warmly greeted everyone and brought out fruit. After chatting for about half an hour, they took their leave.
location: The home of his aunt Wang Xiuying near Zhongjie Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home to prepare dinner and have family dinner
description: Riding back to Banshan Garden from the aunt's house, they arrived home near dusk. Wang Lijuan used the ingredients bought that morning to simply prepare dinner: seafood porridge, sliced char siu, and stir-fried greens. Lu Mingqiang helped set the bowls and chopsticks and ladle out the porridge. The family sat around the table eating and chatting about the fun of flying kites that afternoon. Hanhan imitated his older brother's kite-flying movements, making everyone laugh, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping the children with homework and parent-child reading
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang did the dishes, then went to the study to supervise Xuanxuan's Chinese character copying homework, sitting beside him to keep him company. After Xuanxuan finished, Lu Mingqiang read a few pages of a picture book with Hanhan, telling the story of a little rabbit, enjoying a brief moment of parent-child time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Study for the senior technician certificate exam
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang quietly studied the textbook Comprehensive Case Analysis for Senior Technicians in the study. Combining it with the kitchen circuit short-circuit case at Juxiangyuan Tea Restaurant last Thursday, he analyzed the fault diagnosis model and recorded key points in his notebook. His approach to learning was becoming increasingly clear.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening reduced core training and washing up.
description: Because of the high physical exertion during the day, Lu Mingqiang reduced the intensity of his core training. He completed 2 sets of glute bridges and 2 sets of 60-second planks in the bedroom, then took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and relaxed his body and mind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Browsed the liquor bottle collection forum and fell asleep.
description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang lay in bed and browsed the Tianya Wine Bottle Collectors Forum on his phone. When he saw a local collector show off a 1990s Haikou Daqu vintage wine bottle, he liked it and commented, "Good stuff, my mouth is watering." At 22:40 he turned off the lights and rested. Recalling the day's experiences, he felt satisfied with fixing the water pipe and spending time with his family, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning. To avoid disturbing his sleeping wife and children, he tiptoed to the living room, spread out a yoga mat, and began his morning core training: 3 sets of planks (70 seconds each), 3 sets of glute bridges (20 reps each), and 3 sets of superman exercises (20 reps each), fully activating his back and abdominal muscles. After training, he washed up with warm water, then cooked himself a bowl of simple E-fu noodle soup in the kitchen with an egg and two slices of lettuce. After eating, he checked and organized his squash equipment — racket, spare string, sports towel, and a pair of old sports shoes — to make sure everything was complete.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Squash training and commuting
description: At 7:45 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on a clean T-shirt, took his keys and phone, and rode the gray electric bike parked downstairs. He rode along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Guomao Road, and reached Power Fitness Club under the Beijing Building in about eight minutes. He swiped his membership card to enter the squash court on the third floor and chose Court No. 1 at the innermost side. After a ten-minute warm-up of jogging and stretching, he focused on backhand multi-ball and serving drills. In response to the slow shoulder turn that his playing partner Lin Feng had pointed out, he deliberately slowed his movements and repeatedly practiced the technique of using his waist and abdomen to drive the rotation. He fed balls to himself nearly a hundred times and practiced until his back was slightly sweaty. At 9:30 he stopped playing, took a quick shower in the locker room, changed back into casual clothes, and rode home.
location: Squash Court, Power Fitness Club, 3rd Floor, Podium Building, Beijing Mansion, No. 56 Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home to pick up the family and buy groceries at Wenhua Market
description: After finishing squash practice at 9:30, Lu Mingqiang took a shower and changed clothes, then cycled home to pick up his wife, Wang Lijuan, and their two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. The family got into their old Jetta and drove along Jinmao Middle Road for about ten minutes to Wenhua Vegetable Market. In the seafood section on the first floor, Wang Lijuan carefully selected a plump grouper; Lu Mingqiang bought fresh choy sum, bitter melon, and garlic at the vegetable stall. When they passed the fruit stall, Xuanxuan clamored for mangoes, so Lu Mingqiang picked two small golden Tainong mangoes to satisfy the kids.
location: Wenhua Vegetable Market, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Visit parents, have lunch together, and take care of the balcony vegetable garden
description: After the shopping, the family drove along Changdi Road toward Meilan District and reached the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan on Dayingshan East First Street in about twenty minutes, then parked. Lu Mingqiang and his wife carried the grouper and vegetables upstairs. His mother, Chen Xiuying, had already brewed tea, and the kitchen smelled of Hainanese chicken rice. His father, Lu Jianguo, was in fine spirits. He pulled Lu Mingqiang over to ask about the details of yesterday's water pipe repair, and Lu Mingqiang explained the principle of the hot-melt pipe joint while gesturing. Lu Mingqiang then asked in detail about his mother's knee and urged her to apply the medicated patch and hot compress on time. His wife went into the kitchen to help prepare the grouper. At noon, a hearty lunch was served: glossy Hainanese chicken rice, steamed grouper, and garlic choy sum. The family sat around the table eating, and the two grandsons vied to pick food for their grandparents, filling the room with laughter and cheerful chatter. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang accompanied his father to the balcony to check the chili peppers and lettuce. Finding the soil in the pots rather dry, he watered it thoroughly with a sprayer and, following his father's instructions, mixed compound fertilizer with water and carefully poured it around the roots of the seedlings. Father and son chatted while tending the seedlings on the balcony, and also talked about Zhao Qiang, the apprentice at Lu Mingqiang's workplace. They stayed until a little after 1 p.m. before Lu Mingqiang got up to take his leave.
location: Room 201, Building 5, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Residential Area, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home for a midday rest.
description: After taking leave from his parents' home, Lu Mingqiang drove back to Banshan Garden Residential Area with his wife and children. They arrived home at about 1:40 p.m. His wife took the two sons to the bedroom for a nap, and Lu Mingqiang also lay down in the master bedroom, taking a short nap to relieve the fatigue from the morning exercise and rest up for the afternoon's activities.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Playing with the children at the neighborhood park
description: At two in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang woke up and woke his two sons. Seeing that the weather was fine, he took them to the central children's slide and lawn area of the community to play. Xuanxuan and Hanhan climbed up and slid down the slide, having a great time. Lu Mingqiang watched over them nearby and chatted with Uncle Wang, a retired teacher and neighbor who had also brought his child down. Looking at the children's happy, sweaty faces, he felt very at ease.
location: Central children's slide and lawn area in Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handling housework and personal affairs
description: At 3:30, took the children home and had his wife Wang Lijuan wipe their sweat and change their clothes. Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony to check the chili peppers and lettuce seedlings he had planted, found they were growing well, pinched off a few yellow leaves, and adjusted the drip irrigator's water flow. He then returned to the living room, took down the dry clothes that had been airing all day, folded them one by one, and finished the trivial household chores.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and contacting friends to confirm the gathering
description: At 4:30 p.m., taking advantage of a break while his wife was preparing dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa, opened his phone, and made a voice call to his friends Chen Jianguo and Lin Feng in the WeChat group "Slam Dunk Workers' Squash Club" to confirm the dinner get-together at the usual place at 7 p.m. The two readily agreed. At 5 p.m., his wife had stir-fried tomatoes and eggs and garlicky water spinach ready, so Lu Mingqiang had an early dinner with his wife and kids. He took a little extra food, thinking that later at the street food stall he would eat less to avoid overeating.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and hearty conversation with friends at Jiamie Food Stall
description: After dinner, around 5:30, Lu Mingqiang changed into a casual polo shirt, told his wife he would drink little and be back before 10 o'clock, then rode his electric moped out. He turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Shimao South Road, felt the evening breeze on his face, and reached Jiamie Food Stall in about fifteen minutes. Arriving early, he picked a table near the back under the open-air awning, ordered the signature garlic-flavored grilled tilapia from the owner he knew well, and also asked for half a dozen ice-cold draft beers, a plate of smashed cucumber, and peanuts. He drank and waited. After 6:30, Chen Jianguo arrived on his electric bike, and Lin Feng also showed up in his old pickup truck. The grilled fish came to the table sizzling with a rich sauce aroma, and over iced beer the three of them really opened up: Jianguo talked about the absurd incidents during his unit's power grid renovation, Lin Feng showed photos of a vintage 1980s liquor bottle he had just found, and Lu Mingqiang shared his morning practice insights and rehashed the story of fixing the water pipe yesterday. The atmosphere was lively. Mindful of having to work the next day, Lu Mingqiang only had half a glass of draft beer all evening and drank barley tea the rest of the time. The three chatted happily until nearly 10 o'clock before getting ready to leave.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return trip, and after arriving home, core training and washing up
description: At 10 p.m., the three split the bill evenly, and Chen Jianguo and Lin Feng each rode away. Although Lu Mingqiang had drunk little, for safety he still pushed his e-bike along Shimao South Road for ten minutes, waiting until the night breeze had completely cleared his head before getting on the bike and riding back the same way to Banshan Garden. He got home just after 10:20, and his wife and child were already asleep. He quietly laid out a yoga mat in the living room, quickly completed 2 sets of 60-second planks and 1 set of 20 superman exercises, managing to keep up his evening exercise habit. Then he took a hot shower to wash away the sweat and cooking fumes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Browsing the phone before bed, then going to sleep
description: After showering and drying his hair, Lu Mingqiang lay down on the bed and habitually opened his phone to browse a liquor bottle collecting forum. He saw a Hainan collector friend had posted a photo of a newly acquired old liquor bottle with the inscription "Fortune and Longevity Complete," and casually tapped the like button. Then he exited the app, switched his phone to silent, and put it on the nightstand. Thinking back on how he had managed to balance exercise, family, and friends today, he felt especially grounded and content. He closed his eyes and soon fell asleep, ready for Monday's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training, washing up, and tidying up
description: At 6:15 in the morning the alarm went off. He didn't linger in bed, laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom, and started core training. He completed three sets of superman raises, three sets of glute bridges, and three sets of 70-second planks, and felt soreness in his right shoulder blade. After training he took a quick warm shower, changed into clean work clothes, checked his tool bag, confirmed the test pen, screwdriver, and spare light bulbs were all there, and brought the old capacitor he had taken from the company to study side by side. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an electric bike to work and attended the team morning meeting
description: Cycled from Banshan Garden to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, arriving about 7 minutes later. When parking, met coworkers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, and entered the company together. Attended the team morning meeting in the meeting room on the first floor of the comprehensive building. Team leader Zhang emphasized the precautions for the day's distribution room upgrade at Xinhai Residential Community, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, including the models of self-healing capacitors, wiring specifications, and the coordination process with Director Wang from the property management.
location: Conference room, 1st floor, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Xinhai Community distribution room capacitor upgrade work (morning)
description: After the morning meeting, went with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the warehouse to pick up tools and spare parts, specifically taking extra sound-activated light wire and insulating tape. Then rode to Xinhai Residential Community and met with Property Director Wang. After entering the power distribution room, in the dim and stuffy environment, turned on the headlamp and confirmed the position of the self-healing capacitors to be replaced against the drawings. Operated strictly according to the safety procedures of power-off, voltage testing, and grounding wire installation. He was responsible for removing the old capacitors and passing tools in cooperation with Zhao Qiang, while Chen Jianguo tested the new capacitors with a multimeter. During the replacement, the wiring terminals were found to be oxidized; they were polished clean with sandpaper and reconnected. Old Li, the community grid worker, passed by to check and expressed approval of the upgrade work.
location: Electrical distribution room, Xinhai Residential Community, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch with co-workers at a fast-food restaurant.
description: After finishing the morning’s work, he rode an electric bike with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Sister’s Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road. They ordered the signature spicy soup rice with Chinese sausage; the broth was sour, spicy, fresh, and fragrant. The three chatted while eating, exchanging updates on the morning’s work and plans for the afternoon wrap-up. The lunch, including bottled water, cost 16 yuan in total.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Brisk walking in the rain for exercise and returning to the power distribution room.
description: After lunch it started to drizzle. Wearing rainproof work clothes, he briskly walked along the internal and surrounding sidewalks of Xinhai Community, keeping a pace of about 120 steps per minute for 30 minutes, covering about 3.2 kilometers. After the rain, he returned to the distribution room and joined Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, dried off the rain, and prepared for the afternoon work.
location: Sidewalks and the power distribution room around Xinhai Residential Community, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Xinhai Community power distribution room capacitor upgrade work (afternoon).
description: The afternoon focused on testing and energization. After re-checking that all wiring was correct, he put on insulating gloves and performed the closing operation. The indicator lights on the distribution cabinet lit up normally, and using a multimeter he measured the outgoing voltages on all circuits, all stable within the normal range. He completed the handover with Director Wang of the property management office and asked him to observe the operating data afterward. Director Wang expressed his thanks, and the work ended successfully.
location: Electrical distribution room, Xinhai Residential Community, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company to organize logs, maintain tools, and check drawings.
description: After cycling back to the company, I recorded detailed construction logs on the office computer in the team office, including the replaced spare part models, work content, and test results. Then I went to the tool room to maintain pliers, screwdrivers, and other tools and applied rust-preventive oil. Next, referring to the drawings of the Xinhai residential area power distribution room, I traced the automatic compensation circuit in pencil and explained the design principle to Zhao Qiang to deepen my understanding. Before leaving work, I tidied the desk, put the old capacitors into the tool bag, and changed into casual shoes to go home.
location: Team office and tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go home after work to fix the hallway light, reunite with family, and have dinner together.
description: He rode his bike back to Banshan Garden Residential Area. In the hallway on the third floor, he found the sound-activated light was not working. He tested the wiring with a voltage tester and replaced the bulb to fix it. Then he entered the house, where his younger son Hanhan greeted him joyfully, so he picked him up and lifted him high. His older son Xuanxuan was doing homework in the study, and his wife Juanzi was cooking in the kitchen. He played with Hanhan with magnetic tiles for a while, then checked Xuanxuan's math homework and marked the wrong answers. During dinner, the family sat around the table, enjoying boiled shrimp, stir-fried spinach, Chinese sausage stir-fried with garlic shoots, and seaweed egg drop soup, sharing amusing stories about replacing the capacitor and fixing the light that day, as well as how Xuanxuan's school football match went.
location: Hallway on the 3rd floor, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5

name: Tutoring eldest son in math homework
description: After dinner, he asked Xuanxuan to take out his homework notebook. For the marked second-grade math word problems (introductory pursuit problems), he patiently guided his son by drawing line-segment diagrams. In the end, Xuanxuan solved the correct answers by himself and gained a sense of accomplishment.
location: Study room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shower and brief relaxation.
description: After finishing homework tutoring, he felt hot and stuffy, took a cold shower, changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts, and watched NBA highlights on the sports channel from the living room sofa, relaxing for half an hour.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He then hand-drew a typical control circuit diagram for one-way starting and stopping with self-locking on white paper, and tried adding a thermal relay for overload protection, repeating the practice until all symbols and wiring were imprinted in his mind.
location: Study room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening core workout

location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

description: After the training, he sat down with his wife on the living room sofa and checked the money-tracking app on his phone, finding that cigarette expenses and lunch spending had exceeded the budget. They agreed to reduce his monthly cigarette budget from 450 yuan to 250 yuan, and to try bringing meals from home to save money. His wife also promised to cut down on unnecessary online snack purchases. They reached an agreement to start from the next day.
location: Living room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

location: Study room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

I carefully studied a ceramic Fenjiu bottle from the 1980s posted by a netizen and downloaded the images. Then I closed the app, confirmed there were no special arrangements for tomorrow, turned off the bedside lamp, adjusted my sleeping position, and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Then I washed up with cold water, changed into my blue work uniform, checked and organized my commuter bag, and brought my phone, power bank, insulated gloves, voltage tester, and other tools.
location: Bedroom and bathroom in the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

location: Small park near Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Then he and Zhao Qiang entered the maintenance workshop, where they disassembled and cleaned a batch of old AC contactors one by one, checked contact wear, measured insulation resistance with a megohmmeter, registered the parts that needed replacing, and explained the key points of contactor maintenance to Zhao Qiang.

location: Jinmao Middle Road food market, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

The family enjoyed a warm evening of parent-child interaction.
location: Dining room, living room, and study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.
