description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from Haisheng Road via Qiu Hai Avenue onto Jinmao Middle Road, arriving at Power Fitness Club in about twenty minutes. Upstairs, he greeted his squash partner Lin Feng, then went into the changing room to change into his sportswear and sneakers. In the squash court, he jogged laps to warm up and loosened his joints.
location: Squash court and locker room, Building 3, Power Fitness Club, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Squash training and recovery
description: Practiced with Lin Feng for an hour and a half, focusing on the backhand position. Lu Mingqiang paid attention to shoulder rotation and backswing, hitting several good down-the-line shots. They played four competitive games, with Lu Mingqiang winning 2:1, narrowly taking the final game 13:11. After training, he stretched for ten minutes at the courtside, then went to the locker room to shower and change back into casual clothes.
location: No. 3 Squash Court and men's locker room at Power Fitness Club, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Home rest and family time
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike away from the gymnasium, bought a few apples at the fruit stall at the entrance of the residential community, and then arrived home. His wife Wang Lijuan was tutoring the eldest son on his homework. After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang cut the apples and ate them with his wife and children, casually chatting about the day's trivial matters.
location: Home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Studying new equipment specifications.
description: After entering the study, Lu Mingqiang spread out the articles collected from the company and the Senior Technician Examination Textbook, and focused on learning the safe operating procedures for SF6 ring main units, enclosure grounding, and air chamber seal testing. He underlined and took notes while reading. Afterwards, he completed 20 multiple-choice questions from the textbook and got 17 correct in the self-test, which increased his confidence.
location: The study at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family cost-cutting plan
description: After his wife coaxed the younger son to sleep, Lu Mingqiang took out the account book and mobile phone bills and checked them item by item with his wife. They decided to cancel three items on Taobao pending shipment, turn down the outdoor food stall dinner arranged with Chen Jianguo, and pause the island road-trip savings fund plan. His wife wrote the resolutions down in the notebook, and Lu Mingqiang printed them out and stuck them on the refrigerator door.
location: Living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Checked the vegetable seedlings on the balcony
description: After discussing the spending plan, Lu Mingqiang felt reassured. He went to the balcony and observed the vegetable seedlings with a flashlight. The lettuce had grown two full true leaves, and the pepper seedlings had sprouted new buds. He then recorded the growth on the back of the wall calendar with a pencil.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening core workout
description: With a relatively large amount of exercise during the day, the evening training focused on activation. Lu Mingqiang completed 3 sets of glute bridges (20 reps per set) and 2 sets of planks (60 seconds per set) on the living room mat to keep his core muscles in good condition, so he would have enough lower back strength for the next day's work.
location: Living room floor mat at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: After training, he wiped clean the exercise mat. Lu Mingqiang lay on the bed and briefly browsed a bottle-collecting forum; when he saw someone showing off a 1980s tiger-bone wine bottle, he gave it a like. Then he set the alarm for 6:10 the next day, reviewed the day, and turned off the lights to sleep at exactly 23:00.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning activities
description: At 6:15 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally without disturbing his family. He quietly laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom and began core strength training: he held a plank for 75 seconds, and did 3 sets of 20 reps each of superman stretches and glute bridges. His core was sore but he felt refreshed. Then he took a cold shower. While shaving, he mulled over the emergency repair task at Xiuying Port. He put on his work clothes, checked his backpack, and placed the SF6 Ring Main Unit Installation Specification notebook inside. Before heading out, he went to the balcony and used a spray bottle to water the lettuce and chili seedlings, feeling delighted at the sight of the tender leaves.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Took his son to kindergarten
description: Lu Mingqiang helped his sleepy-eyed youngest son, Lu Zihan, put on a jacket, lifted him onto the back seat of the electric bike, and set off from Banshan Garden. He rode along Jinmao Middle Road to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Third Cross Road. On the way, he told his son to listen to the teacher and not fight. At the kindergarten gate, he watched Lu Zihan go inside with his schoolbag. After greeting the teacher, he left with peace of mind.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and breakfast
description: After dropping off his child, Lu Mingqiang rode to the 'Datie Laoba Tea Shop' at the intersection of Binya Road, ordered a takeaway portion of Hainan noodles with an added egg, and then continued riding for about 20 minutes before arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park. He finished his breakfast quickly in the car and just made the morning meeting.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team morning meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang attended the team morning meeting. The team leader Zhang Tou assigned tasks, and Lu proactively took on the work order for the lightning-struck distribution cabinet at the Xiuying Port cold storage warehouse, reporting to Zhang Tou his plan to first check the surge module and then the main circuit. He called his apprentice Zhao Qiang to come along with tools, planning to teach while working on site.
location: Meeting room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park Company, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Handle the power distribution cabinet fault at Xiuying Port
description: Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang to the power distribution room of the cold storage warehouse at Xiuying Port. After strictly cutting off power, verifying no voltage, and installing grounding wire, he said to Zhao Qiang, 'Troubleshooting faults is like peeling an onion — go layer by layer.' When the cabinet door was opened, they found that three Type 3 surge protector modules were burned black and cracked. He tested each stage with a multimeter and confirmed that the downstream circuit was normal, so he had Zhao Qiang obtain replacement modules of the same model. After replacement, he guided Zhao Qiang to measure insulation with a megohmmeter. The data passed, and after closing the switch and restoring power, the cooling tower fan resumed running. Lu Mingqiang also suggested to the warehouse manager, Lao Li, that a second-level lightning arrester be added to the main cabinet to solve the problem permanently. Lao Li agreed and immediately applied for approval.
location: Electrical distribution room, cold storage warehouse, Xiuying Port, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch
description: After the emergency repair was completed, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang cycled back to the 'Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice' fast-food restaurant near the company. To save money, Lu Mingqiang ordered the 8-yuan vegetarian set meal, which had tofu and green vegetables, light and good for the stomach; Zhao Qiang ordered pig trotter rice. The two ate while exchanging their thoughts on the morning's fault handling.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Brisk walking and review during lunch break
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang walked briskly for half an hour on the walking trail inside the industrial park to aid digestion, using the time to review in his mind the motor speed control principles he had studied the night before, sorting through the speed control mechanical characteristics of a separately excited DC motor to deepen his understanding. After three laps, his stomach felt comfortable and he was clear-headed.
location: Internal road at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Work log and tool maintenance
description: Back at his workstation, Lu Mingqiang wrote the morning's emergency repair process into the log in detail, including the fault symptoms, troubleshooting steps, replacement module models, insulation data, and rectification suggestions. Afterward, he called Zhao Qiang to the tool room, wiped down the multimeter and megohmmeter, applied rust-preventive oil, checked the calibration validity, and performed tool maintenance.
location: Workstation and tool room at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Spare parts preparation and communication with colleagues
description: In his spare time, Lu Mingqiang took several surge protector modules out of the warehouse, measured their parameters one by one with a multimeter, selected two with the most stable performance, packed them, and put them into the next day's tool bag as a precaution. During this time, he chatted with Chen Jianguo at the neighboring workstation and learned that his mother's condition had improved and she was about to be discharged from the hospital, which set Lu Mingqiang's mind at ease.
location: Company workstation, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying groceries after work
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike home. On the way, he stopped by the “Vegetable Basket” community discount supermarket on Jinmao Middle Road, bought fresh water spinach and bean sprouts, and spent 25 yuan on 500 grams of small sea shrimp at the seafood stall, planning to make sea shrimp and winter melon soup for the family that evening.
location: 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store)

name: Returning home and spending time with the kids.
description: After a few minutes, Lu Mingqiang rode home and plugged the e-bike into the charging station. As soon as he entered, he smelled the aroma of food and greeted his wife Juanzi in the kitchen, telling her he had bought small sea shrimp. His younger son Lu Zihan was the first to run over and hug his leg. He picked up Hanhan and spun him around twice, then walked to his older son Lu Zixuan's desk, flipped through his math homework, and praised him for writing neatly.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Strength training and running preparation.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into sports shorts and a tank top, laid out a mat in the living room, and began bodyweight strength training: 3 sets of push-ups, 20 reps each, then did single-leg squats while holding the balcony sliding door. His left knee felt strained after 10 reps, and his right side barely kept balance for 12. After training, he took a few big gulps of plain water, wiped the sweat from his face, and told Juanzi that he was going to Baishamen for a run and that she didn't need to wait for him for dinner. He put on a windbreaker, grabbed his phone and sports arm pouch, and prepared to head out.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Run and stretch at Baishamen, then return.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike along Longkun North Road, across the Century Bridge, and arrived at Baishamen Park on Haidian Island. He opened his fitness app and started a 6-kilometer run along the seaside trail, with a target pace within 6 minutes 18 seconds per kilometer. In the first two kilometers his thighs felt sore and heavy; in the third kilometer the sea breeze helped his steps feel light; in the second half his thighs became sore again. He gritted his teeth and focused on breathing and arm swing, and in the final 500 meters sprinted to a pace of exactly 6 minutes. He finished 6.19 kilometers in 38 minutes 31 seconds, with an average pace of 6 minutes 13 seconds per kilometer, meeting his goal. Gasping by the seaside, sweat streaming down, his stress was blown away by the sea breeze. Afterwards, he did static stretches on a park bench for his front thighs and hamstrings for five minutes, then rode his electric bike home.
location: Seaside trail at Baishamen Park, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening family time
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang took a shower and changed into clean loungewear. Seeing his younger son Lu Zihan playing with an eagle kite on the sofa, he sat down, put his arm around him, and with exaggerated gestures and tone told a funny story about chasing a kite for a kilometer after the string broke when he was a child. Both sons burst out laughing, and his wife Juanzi was amused too. Then Juanzi served blanched small sea shrimp, stir-fried water spinach, bean sprout stir-fried vermicelli, and sea shrimp winter melon soup. The family of four sat around the table eating. Lu Mingqiang listened to his elder son's funny school stories while eating; his younger son clumsily picked up shrimp with chopsticks, his mouth full. The dinner was warm and satisfying.
location: Living room and dining room at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Evening study and core training
description: After the child fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang went into the study, made a cup of tea, and opened the textbook Power Drive and Control to review the principles of motor speed regulation. As he read, he drew on the sketch of the mechanical characteristic curves for separately excited DC motor speed control and worked through several example problems. When drowsiness set in, he jotted down two questions in his notebook. Afterwards, he did a reduced-volume core workout in the living room: 2 sets of glute bridges (22 reps each) and 2 sets of planks (70 seconds each). Then he went to the kitchen, mixed a protein powder drink, and consumed it to replenish the nutrients needed by his muscles.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrap-up and bedtime
description: Lu Mingqiang rinsed the cups and checked the next day's work order, the e-bike key, and the phone charger. Returning to the bedroom, he saw that his wife Juanzi had already lain down. He chatted softly with her for a while, then turned off the lights and rested before 11 p.m., ending a full and satisfying day.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning routine activities
description: After the 06:10 alarm went off, I got up, first drank the warm boiled water on the bedside table, then spread out the yoga mat and did core training: 3 sets of 20 prone back extensions, 3 sets of 24 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 78-second planks, with 40-second rests between sets, timed on my phone. After training, I took a warm shower in the bathroom and changed into a dark blue cotton work uniform. In the kitchen I made high-calcium oatmeal with two slices of whole wheat bread for breakfast, and drank half a glass of cold boiled water. I put the notebook for "Principles of Motor Speed Regulation" into my tool bag and got ready for work.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and morning meeting
description: At 07:15, he grabbed his helmet and tool bag and went downstairs, riding his red electric scooter west along Jinmao Middle Road. After passing Qiuhai Avenue, he turned onto Haisheng Road and reached the company in less than 15 minutes. At 07:30, he attended the team morning meeting, led by Team Leader Zhang, who assigned the team the task of carrying out a unified safety inspection of electricity meter boxes in old residential buildings in the Haisheng Road area, with the team responsible for Buildings 8 and 12. He emphasized replacing corroded terminals, tightening meter covers, cleaning debris out of meter boxes, and sealing cable entry holes. Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang took on the work for Building 12. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang asked Chen Jianguo about his mother's recovery after being discharged from the hospital. After the meeting ended, he went to the tool room and picked up a voltage tester, insulating gloves, a wrench, diagonal cutting pliers, 20 M8 copper terminals, insulating tape, and anti-rust nuts. He also took a roller brush and anti-rust paint to treat the rust on the meter boxes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Centralized safety inspection of electric meter boxes in the morning
description: With tools and materials in hand, the three walked to Building 12 on Haisheng Road. They knocked on doors floor by floor to notify residents before carrying out safety inspections of the electric meter boxes. Lu Mingqiang operated, Chen Jianguo supervised and recorded, and Zhao Qiang handed tools and cleared away debris. On the 4th floor, they found the incoming wire terminals oxidized; after sanding them with sandpaper, they tightened them and dripped machine oil onto the box hinges. On the 7th floor, a terminal post on a downstream switch showed signs of overheating; after cutting off power and testing for live current, they re-crimped a new terminal and applied rust-preventive paint to the corroded areas at the bottom of the box. Around 10:30, Zhao Qiang noticed that the hinge of a meter box cover on the 8th floor was deformed; Lu Mingqiang guided him to straighten it and add a rubber sealing strip. The old screws and washers that were replaced were put into a plastic bag to avoid leaving them behind. During the work, Zhao Qiang went downstairs three times to buy bottled water to replenish fluids. All the meter boxes in the eight entrances of Building 12 were safety inspected, and the problems and handling measures were recorded on the back of the work order.
location: Stairwell of an old residential building, No. 12 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Work wrap-up and lunch
description: The three carried their tools back to the company. Chen Jianguo went to organize the electronic records. Lu Mingqiang returned to the tool room, cleaned and oiled the tools such as the voltage tester and wrenches, and put them back in place. The unused terminals and tape were returned to the original cabinet, and he left a note saying that 4 M8 copper terminals had been used and the remaining 16 were returned to the storeroom. Then he washed his hands and drank a few sips of the wild chrysanthemum tea his wife had brewed. At 12:00, he invited Chen Jianguo to eat at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. Lu Mingqiang ordered the vegetarian set meal (tofu, bean curd sticks, and green vegetables), and Chen Jianguo ordered braised pork trotter rice. While eating, Lu Mingqiang scrolled through his phone and saw the photo of balcony vegetables his wife had posted in the family group chat, and replied with a thumbs-up. The two chatted casually and learned that Chen Jianguo was going to the pharmacy to get medicine after the meal. At 12:25, Lu Mingqiang finished eating first and left the table.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park tool room, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road

name: Lunch break brisk walk and a nap
description: At 12:30, started brisk walking on the internal roads of the industrial park and safe surrounding roads, at a pace of about 11 minutes per kilometer, with even arm swings. After 20 minutes of walking, put in earphones and listened to the MP3 lecture "Common Faults and Troubleshooting of 10kV Circuit Breakers" downloaded the day before, focusing on the causes of opening/closing coil burnout. He walked about 3.6 kilometers in total and stopped after one section of the audio finished. At 13:10, returned to the office, unfolded the canvas folding recliner and took a short rest. Although he did not fall into deep sleep, it effectively relieved his drowsiness. At 13:25, the alarm went off; he put away the recliner and washed his face with cold water to refresh himself.
location: Internal roads and offices of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon safety inspection wrap-up and record sorting.
description: At 13:30, went to the office and entered the morning safety inspection records into the computer, creating the "Safety Inspection Record Form for the Meter Box at Building 12, Haisheng Road," detailing the positions of replaced terminals, rust-prevention paint application, meter cover alignment, and other details, with the note "quarterly re-inspection recommended," then printed and signed it. At 14:30, Squad Leader Zhang asked about progress and then assigned him to handle an emergency repair at Building 8: a prepaid meter had no display. Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang there and found that the power module inside the meter was loose; after unplugging and replugging it, the display returned. He told the resident to observe its use. After returning, he filed the repair work order and bound and stored all the day's paper records in the archive cabinet after signing.
location: Office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Building 8 on Haisheng Road.

name: Going home after work and buying groceries
description: At 16:50, he tidied his desk, changed into a dark blue jacket, went downstairs, and rode his e-bike along Haisheng Road eastward, then turned onto Qiuhai Avenue to Jinmao Middle Road. He arrived at the Vegetable Basket Community Budget Supermarket (Hainan Provincial Dormitory Branch) in about ten minutes and bought water spinach, bean sprouts, spring onions, and one jin of fresh small sea shrimp (25 yuan). He then continued riding to Banshan Garden, plugged in the e-bike to charge, and went upstairs. As he entered, his youngest son Hanhan ran over to greet him. Lu Mingqiang picked him up and asked how kindergarten went. His wife Juanzi poked her head out from the kitchen and, seeing the groceries, smiled and said she had been just thinking of making oil-braised shrimp. After putting Hanhan down, he took the groceries into the kitchen, then went to the bedroom and changed into a short-sleeved shirt, baggy shorts, and slippers.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Branch), and home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road.

name: Tending to Balcony Vegetables and Family Plans
description: After changing clothes, he walked to the balcony. His wife Juanzi was loosening the soil around the scallions. She handed him a bamboo strip to pull out weak seedlings and weeds, while she mixed organic chicken manure into the soil near the scallion roots. The two tended the scallions, lettuce, and chili seedlings while discussing tomorrow's (Saturday) plans: go to the vegetable market in the morning to buy pork ribs, and in the afternoon take their eldest son Xuanxuan to Baishamen Park to fly kites, the whole family of four going together. Lu Mingqiang watered the lettuce and chili with rice-washing water. After forty minutes of work, the balcony vegetable pots were tidied up, and Lu Mingqiang was slightly sweaty.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child interaction.
description: At 18:20, his wife went to the kitchen to cook, while Lu Mingqiang stayed in the living room playing with his younger son Hanhan with dinosaur models, teaching him to distinguish herbivorous and carnivorous dinosaurs. At 18:30, the older son Xuanxuan came home from school, and Lu Mingqiang asked about his homework; Xuanxuan said he needed help with math word problems. At 19:00, the whole family had dinner together, with dishes including oil-braised small sea shrimp, stir-fried water spinach, stir-fried bean sprouts with vermicelli, and tomato and egg soup. Hanhan scooped shrimp with a spoon, Xuanxuan shared funny stories from school, and the family discussed plans to fly kites the next day while the two children cheered excitedly.
location: Living room and dining room at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Help the eldest son with homework.
description: After dinner, he helped clear the dishes. At 19:25 he went to Xuanxuan's room to check his math homework. Several multiplication and division word problems had the right approach but careless calculation mistakes. Lu Mingqiang read through the problems with him, corrected two of them, and had him rework the calculations himself. After the homework was corrected, Xuanxuan talked about a classmate who had been praised in class and about playing soccer in PE class. Lu Mingqiang listened attentively and reminded him to stay safe while playing soccer. At 20:10, after the homework and textbooks were put away, he told Xuanxuan to go take a shower.
location: Eldest son's bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take a shower and change clothes
description: After Xuanxuan finished showering, Lu Mingqiang went to the master bedroom bathroom and took a refreshing hot shower, washing away the day's sweat and fatigue. He changed into clean cotton short-sleeved pajamas and felt completely relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organizing wine bottle collection and exchanging with fellow collectors
description: At 20:30 he entered the study, took out his treasured 1980s Haikou Daqu bottles and several 1990s Lugui wine bottles, and carefully wiped the bottle bodies with a white cotton cloth and used a brush to clean the dust accumulated on the labels. He took close-up photos of the Haikou Daqu bottle from multiple angles and sent them to his WeChat collector friend Chen Jianguo. The two chatted for more than half an hour about the bottles' condition, original caps, market prices, and tips on distinguishing genuine from fake. Afterwards, he wiped the other bottles, wrapped them in moisture-proof paper, and checked the cabinet seals.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and exercise
description: After turning up the desk lamp, he turned on the tablet and logged into the electrical maintenance technology forum. He carefully read the cable temperature measurement post recommended on the homepage, learning about infrared thermography precautions and the principles of distributed fiber-optic temperature measurement. He bookmarked the post and left a comment asking about sensor spacing intervals. At 21:55, he stopped browsing, laid out a yoga mat in the study, and did a simplified core workout: 3 sets of glute bridges totaling 24 reps (8 per set, 15-second rest between sets) and a 78-second plank held until the timer ended. After the workout, he stretched his limbs and put away the yoga mat.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and conversation.
description: After finishing the training, he entered the bedroom. His wife was already lying in bed scrolling on her phone. The two agreed to go to the vegetable market at 8:30 the next morning to buy pork ribs and other items. Then Lu Mingqiang went downstairs and checked that the e-bike charger was showing a normal green light and the battery was not hot. After returning, he set his phone alarm to 6:15 and plugged in the charger. Lying down, he chatted with his wife about trivial matters such as the smooth safety inspection that day and Chen Jianguo's mother being discharged from the hospital. About ten minutes later, he turned off the light and fell asleep on his side, still thinking about bringing the kite string the next day and checking Xuanxuan's homework.
location: Bedroom at home and the e-bike shed downstairs, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning core training
description: The alarm went off right on time. I got up quietly without waking my wife. I first went to the window to check the weather and found it sunny and breezy, which made me feel happy. Then I did morning core training on the living room mat, completing in order: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 80-second planks. After finishing, I stretched and felt that my core engagement was more stable.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run at Baishamen Park and buying breakfast.
description: Changed into running gear, grabbed his phone and earphones, and rode his e-bike along Binhai Avenue to the east gate of Baishamen Park. After parking, he ran 5 km along the seaside path at a pace of 6:12 per kilometer, feeling good. After the run, he stretched for 3 minutes and took a photo of the sea under the morning sun with his phone to post in the family group. On the way back, he passed the “Fu's Nadan Mixed Noodles” shop on Jinmao Middle Road, ordered two portions of Hainan mixed noodles (with garlic oil) to go, spending 24 yuan in total, then rode home.
location: Baishamen Park, Haishun Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Breakfast and kite gear check
description: When he got home, his wife was waking the children. The family sat together eating Hainan-style rice noodles and the white congee his wife had cooked. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang spread out the improved swallow kite in the living room, carefully checked the strength of the bridle line, and used cable ties to reinforce the seams on the tail. Then he prepared a picnic mat, line reel, spare line, cold boiled water, fruit and snack bags, and found his son's bucket hat and sunscreen, packing everything into an old travel bag.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Accompanying his wife to buy groceries
description: He walked with his wife to the Jinmao Wenhua Market to implement the family spending-reduction plan. His wife picked discounted Spanish mackerel (18 yuan each), spinach, bean sprouts, scallions, and tomatoes. Lu Mingqiang carried the groceries and listened to his wife talk through the dinner plan.
location: Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market, Wenhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare lunch and have an early lunch.
description: After returning home, he took the initiative to help in the kitchen, scraping skins and picking vegetables, and salted the mackerel for marinating. His wife took charge of cooking stewed mackerel with tomatoes, stir-fried spinach, and stir-fried bean sprouts with vermicelli. The family finished lunch early to prepare for the afternoon outing, and during the meal they discussed letting the children take a half-hour nap.

name: The whole family took an afternoon nap.

Looking back on this month, although I still often made mistakes on calculation problems, combining the theory with the actual case of handling a lightning strike fault in the cold storage warehouse worked especially well. On the summary page, I solemnly wrote: "April focus: PLC basics and motor control; ensure 45 minutes of effective study time every day." After counting and checking the items, they put them into the toolbox and got ready to leave.
location: Meeting room and tool warehouse of the electrical repair team, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visiting a resident's home to troubleshoot a tripped circuit breaker
description: Rode an electric bike with Zhao Qiang to the home of an elderly person living alone in an old residential community in Xiuying District (near Haixiu Road). After learning about the circuit breaker tripping, they cut off power, tested for voltage, and opened the panel to investigate. They found that the bathroom outlet circuit had aged and the insulation was damaged, causing a leakage. They reconnected the wires, replaced the outlet with a waterproof one, and tested insulation with a megger before restoring power. They used a hair dryer to confirm everything was normal. Before leaving, they urged the old man not to use high-power appliances at the same time and to report for repair promptly if the outlet became hot. During the process, guided Zhao Qiang in learning methods for troubleshooting old circuits.
location: Inside a resident's home in an old residential community near Haixiu Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return to the company to report on work
description: After completing the repair, he rode an electric bike back to the company with Zhao Qiang, reviewing the troubleshooting approach along the way and teaching Zhao Qiang to distinguish between the troubleshooting directions for a leakage protector trip and an air switch trip. After arriving at the company, he briefly reported on how things had been handled.
location: Return from an old residential community in Xiuying District to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and lunch
description: Returned to the company workstation for a brief rest, drank water, recorded dispatch orders, then headed with Zhao Qiang to the "Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant" near the company for lunch. He ordered a vegetarian set meal, Zhao Qiang ordered pork trotters rice, and they continued discussing the details of the fault handling while eating.
location: First, from the workstation at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on the ground floor of Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road

name: Post-meal rest and lunch break power walking
description: After lunch, he returned to the company office, sat for about ten minutes to help digestion while browsing his phone, then put on running shoes and Bluetooth earbuds. He did a brisk-walking workout along Haisheng Road west to Yongwan Road and back, about 3 km in total, at a pace of roughly 9:30 per kilometer, listening to Episode 2 of the audio program 'Industrial Memory' as he walked.
location: Office and surrounding streets of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Buy medicated patches for mother and return to the company.
description: After finishing the brisk walk, he rode his electric bike on the way to Yixintang Pharmacy on Jinmao West Road and used his medical insurance card to buy two boxes of musk bone-strengthening plaster and a bottle of medicated oil as backup for his mother's chronic knee problem. After buying, he returned to the company, taking about 10 minutes.
location: Yixintang Pharmacy (Jinmao West Road Store), No. 15 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: In the afternoon, organized the survey records and prepared the renovation plan
description: After returning to his workstation at the company, he drank some water and rested briefly. He took out the data notebook from yesterday's survey of the electrical room in the old supply and marketing cooperative dormitory building, opened the CAD software on his computer, entered the measurement data and hazard points, and began sketching a preliminary renovation draft. Meanwhile, Team Leader Zhang passed by and suggested replacing the incoming line conduits with thicker ones to make future upgrades easier, and he noted down the suggestion.
location: Workstation of the electrical repair team, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy groceries on the way home from work
description: Got off work at 4:30 p.m., rode an e-bike home, passed the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket on Jinmao Middle Road, and bought ingredients such as water spinach, soft tofu, tray eggs, and other items. Arrived home five minutes later.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing through Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Provincial Dormitory Branch), No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, he returned to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road.

name: Evening family time: interaction, dinner, and tidying up
description: After arriving home, he interacted with his family: his younger son Lu Zihan ran over, hugged his leg, and called for Dad, and he lifted him up high to play; his older son Lu Zixuan was doing homework at the coffee table. He handed the vegetables to his wife Wang Lijuan, changed into work clothes, washed his hands, and helped trim water spinach while his wife cut tofu, and the two chatted about the day's events. For dinner they made garlic water spinach, home-style tofu, seaweed egg drop soup, and homemade pickled cabbage. The whole family ate together, and at the table they talked about electrical safety issues for elderly people living alone and funny stories from the sons' school. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang voluntarily washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen, wiped down the stove, and tied up the garbage bag.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family bookkeeping and financial communication
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took out the ledger and a pen and sat with his wife on the living room sofa to go over March's income and expenses: income, daily spending, children's costs, allowance for parents, and the 10,000 yuan lent to colleague Chen Jianguo. Because money was tight, they discussed cooking at home more this month, eating out less, and his wife pausing online shopping. Together they made the April budget and wrote in the ledger: "April budget: reasonably control eating out; no shopping unless necessary."
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening homework tutoring and confirming training registration
description: In the study, he tutored his older son Lu Zixuan on multiplication and division math word problems, teaching him to circle the given conditions and question, and to use real-life examples to understand the problem. He also urged him to copy the wrong problems into the mistake notebook. After the tutoring session, he sent a WeChat message to Team Leader Zhang to ask about registration for the senior technician exam prep course. He learned that he had already been signed up; the training was expected to start in mid-to-late April, and the official exam would be in November. He took a screenshot and saved the message, feeling both expectant and pressured.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening family interaction and preparation for rest
description: After putting down his phone, he played with his younger son Lu Zihan on the living room floor with dinosaur model cars and building blocks to make tracks. Later, he took Hanhan to the bathroom to brush his teeth and wash his face, coaxed him to bed, and took a shower himself to wash away the fatigue. Then he went back to the bedroom and chatted softly with his wife Wang Lijuan about training arrangements, the plan to visit their parents on the weekend, and buying medicated patches for his mother. He only felt sleepy about an hour later.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: After changing into his pajamas, he did a few minutes of shoulder and neck stretches at the bedside to relax his trapezius and neck. He checked the work clothes in the living room and the condition of the flashlight and multimeter in the tool box to make sure everything was ready for the next day. Then he got into bed, set the alarm, said goodnight to his wife, turned off the light, and gradually fell asleep in the darkness.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning wake-up, core training, and washing up
description: Lu Mingqiang was woken by his alarm at 6:10 a.m. Though his muscles felt heavy, he insisted on laying out his yoga mat in the living room for a reduced core workout, including 2 sets of superman exercises, 2 sets of glute bridges, and 2 sets of 60-second planks. He then washed his face with cold water, changed into a clean sea-blue work uniform, checked his work badge and keys, and put on his old sunglasses because of the glaring sun.
location: Home, Building 5, Floor 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take Zixuan and Zihan to school
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike from Banshan Garden, first taking his second son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then taking his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way, the older son sat on the back seat and the younger son stood on the front footboard. At the kindergarten he watched Hanhan be led into the school gate by the teacher, and at the primary school gate he told Xuanxuan to listen carefully in class.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

name: Cycle to work and buy breakfast on the way
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang cycled along Longkun North Road and Haisheng Road. At a breakfast stall near the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, he bought a meat bun and a cup of hot soy milk, then continued riding into the park and parked in the bike shed. He arrived at the company workshop at around 7:35.
location: Breakfast stall near Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning pre-installation work on the distribution cabinet
description: Lu Mingqiang arrived at the workshop early at 7:45, changed into insulating shoes, and partnered with his colleague Chen Jianguo to assemble the main bodies of two new power distribution cabinets. He was responsible for the copper busbar wiring of the main circuit and tightening screws; Chen Jianguo was responsible for the secondary wiring and component installation. Although there were fans in the workshop, it was still hot. Lu Mingqiang brought a 2-liter water jug and stopped every hour to drink plain boiled water to stay hydrated. The two cooperated seamlessly and worked efficiently.
location: Workshop of Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch, brisk walk, and rest
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo walked out of the workshop and went to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the company, ordering the signature spicy soup rice and white-cut pork offal. During the meal, Jianguo offered a cigarette, but Lu Mingqiang declined. The two talked about financial pressure, and Lu Mingqiang mentioned that after his wife did the accounts last night, she decided to cut back on eating out. After the meal, he looked at his phone: his mother said in the family WeChat group that her legs were feeling better and told him not to worry. Afterward, he insisted on dragging Chen Jianguo for a brisk 15-minute walk along a nearby shady street. When they returned to the workshop, each of them had an old-fashioned ice pop from the company freezer to cool off, chatting about their children's recent situation while eating.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant and surrounding streets, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Continue the pre-assembly work on the distribution cabinet in the afternoon.
description: In the afternoon, the workshop became even more hot and stuffy. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo continued the assembly work. Lu Mingqiang paid special attention to workmanship details, repeatedly adjusting the installation angle of a circuit breaker to meet the standard of being perfectly horizontal and vertical. Chen Jianguo teased him for treating it like a work of art, and Lu Mingqiang replied that he had to be worthy of his pay. By 4 p.m., he had completed the main assembly of the second cabinet, ahead of schedule.
location: Company workshop, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-holiday work arrangement meeting for the team
description: Before the end of the workday, Team Leader Zhang gathered the team members, announced the adjusted holiday schedule for the Qingming Festival (April 4 is a holiday, and April 5-6 is a normal weekend), and assigned the urgent task of installing three new distribution cabinets at the Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza after the holiday, designating Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo as the main people in charge. Lu Mingqiang carefully recorded the key points and delivery time in his mobile phone memo. Team Leader Zhang also praised Lu Mingqiang for his excellent performance in last month's emergency repair in the old residential community.
location: Corner of the company workshop, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting off work and going home to reunite with family
description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools, clocked out, and rode his electric bike back home to Banshan Garden along Haisheng Road, Qiuhai Avenue, and Jinmao Middle Road. The evening breeze brought a chill, so he decided to practice only backhands during tonight's squash session, without any match play, to conserve energy. When he got home, the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice wafted from the kitchen, and his younger son Lu Zihan ran over to hug him, washing away much of the day's fatigue.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Have dinner with the family
description: After washing his hands, Lu Mingqiang sat down, and his wife Wang Lijuan served a whole white cut chicken and shiny rice. After tasting the dipping sauce, he praised Juanzi's cooking and asked her to put more food on his plate. At the table, the eldest son Xuanxuan shared funny stories from school, and the second son Hanhan sang a newly learned nursery rhyme. The family was filled with joy and harmony.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Playing with building blocks with the children and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang had his wife rest and cleared the table himself. Then, in the living room, he built a block castle with his second son, Hanhan. Partway through, his eldest son, Xuanxuan, came over with a math problem, and he patiently explained it until the child fully understood.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Squash training and relaxation.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into his sports gear and drove to Xingdongli Fitness Squash Center. On the way, he listened to local news radio and followed the progress of the Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza project. After arriving, he did backhand rally training with his squash partner Lin Feng. He had lowered the intensity in advance, focusing on placement shots and line changes. Lin Feng pointed out his rotation problem, and he tried his best to correct it. After training, he took a shower and used his phone's memo app in the lounge to record his backhand takeaways and improvement points.
location: Squash court at Xingdongli Fitness, Friendship Sunshine City Store, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Driving back home
description: Lu Mingqiang drove back to Banshan Garden from the squash court. On the way, recalling the message his mother had sent to the group chat earlier in the day, he felt even more reassured.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discuss Qingming Festival arrangements with wife.
description: Returning home, the children had already taken baths, and his wife Wang Lijuan was watching TV. Lu Mingqiang first asked about his mother's leg problem, suggested going back for Tomb-Sweeping Day to deliver medicated patches, and, on the way, drop Juanzi off at her parents' home to stay for two days. Juanzi agreed and suggested going to her parents' home for dinner on April 5. The two roughly finalized the three-day Tomb-Sweeping plan and planned to discuss the details with their parents on the weekend.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Search for senior technician exam materials and organize a review plan.
description: After the children fell asleep, the living room became quiet. Leaning back on the sofa, Lu Mingqiang used his phone browser to search for the exam syllabus and practical question bank for the senior electrical technician certification, and browsed experience posts on electrical technology forums about exam preparation. He learned that the theory exam covers automatic control principles and PLC. He took screenshots of key syllabus outline diagrams and made a brief review plan in his memo app to prepare for the training course in mid-April.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Reduced-volume core training before bed.
description: Despite soreness and fatigue in his lower back, Lu Mingqiang persisted in doing 2 sets of planks (60 seconds each) and 2 sets of glute bridges in the bedroom to prevent recurrence of the old injury.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Video call with parents about leg ailment
description: After training, Lu Mingqiang made a video call to his parents, who live in Meilan District. His mother answered, looked in good spirits, and said the medicated patches they bought were very effective and her knee pain was much better. He told his parents to take care of their health and said he would bring more patches to visit them after work tomorrow afternoon.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and foot-soaking relaxation
description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang did a simple full-body stretch, then soaked his feet in hot water. The slightly scalding water gradually washed away his fatigue. While soaking his feet, he thought about the things he needed to pack for his Qingming trip home before the holiday tomorrow.
location: Bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, and after lying down habitually scrolled through his phone. He saw a post about a baijiu bottle collection and tapped it to like it. He reflected on the day's work progress, study schedule, and family matters, felt down-to-earth and fulfilled, and soon fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Early morning core training at home.
description: Woke up promptly at 6:10. Since the muscle fatigue from yesterday's squash game had not completely gone, the morning core workout focused on recovery. On the yoga mat in the living room, I started: superman exercise 3 sets of 15 reps, glute bridges 3 sets of 25 reps, and planks 3 sets of 60 seconds. During the plank, I felt a slight soreness in my lower back, so I immediately adjusted my posture, tightened my core, and made sure my form was correct to avoid injury. After the workout I felt slightly warm and much more energetic.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, breakfast, and morning preparations
description: After a quick shower, he changed into clean work clothes. Breakfast was white congee, fried eggs, and Hainan rice noodles prepared by his wife Wang Lijuan, eaten quickly with a small dish of pickled radish. Before leaving, he deliberately checked the electric bike dashboard; the battery showed 40%, enough for the round trip to the company and picking up the children, so he did not charge it and planned to charge at work. Then he checked the two children's school bags and water bottles, and confirmed their masks were on properly.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: He rode his electric bike, first taking his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At the gate, he told him, 'Listen to the teacher today, and Mom will make something delicious tonight.' Then he turned the bike around, crossed several streets, and rode to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to take his older son Lu Zixuan. On the way, Xuanxuan said he had a math quiz today. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him: 'Relax, just take the test the way you practice — you've got this.' At around 7:35, after watching Xuanxuan walk into the school gate, he sped off toward the company.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Last working day before the holiday: finishing the power distribution cabinet and mentoring.
description: He arrived at the company at 7:45, changed into work clothes, and went straight into the workshop. The main task today was to complete the finishing work on the distribution cabinet from yesterday. First, he took a torque wrench from the toolbox and checked and tightened all the wiring terminals in the main circuit and control circuits inside the cabinet, confirming there were no loose connections. Then he printed out the equipment nameplate and circuit labels, carefully affixed them to the appropriate positions, and ensured the markings were clear and standardized. At around 10 o'clock, he took the initiative to check a small distribution box that his apprentice Zhao Qiang was responsible for, and found that the crimping process of a grounding wire did not comply with specifications and posed a risk of a poor connection. He then taught him hands-on the correct wire stripping, crimping, and tightening methods, and made him redo the joint. At around 11 o'clock, Team Leader Zhang notified everyone that, since tomorrow is Qingming Festival, the team could finish work one hour early this afternoon (at 4:30 sharp) and asked everyone to tidy up their workstations.
location: Company production workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: Got off work at 11:30 and went to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant near the company with old partner Chen Jianguo for lunch. Today he ordered the signature spicy soup rice and added a duck egg. The hot soup warmed him up and made him sweat, and he felt great all over. While eating, he and Jianguo talked about tomorrow's plans. Lu Mingqiang said he would go to the market in the afternoon for a big shopping trip, and Jianguo said his family planned to set off early in the morning for their hometown in Tunchang. The two also chatted about the installation task at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza after the holiday, and both had a clear picture.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and brisk walk around the factory area
description: After lunch, instead of going back to his workstation to rest, he chose to start a 30-minute lunch break brisk walk along Gongye Road outside the company's north gate. Today he took a shortcut, cut through a small grove beside it, and walked to the seawall near the coast before turning back. The sea breeze carried a salty taste, making him feel refreshed. He took off his glasses, squinted, and enjoyed it for a while. His cadence stayed steady at about 120 steps per minute, and he reached the company gate at exactly 1 p.m.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, the industrial roads and seaside embankment near No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: Afternoon work and desk organization
description: The afternoon work was relatively light, mainly reviewing the finishing work from the morning and tidying up his tools and workstation. He wiped clean and put away common tools such as the multimeter, screwdrivers, and insulating tape, then organized and filed the several maintenance logs and drawings accumulated this month. He also called over Zhao Qiang and pointed out a labeling error he had found in a wiring schematic while sorting the drawings, and explained the correct approach. Around 3:30, he went outside the workshop to plug in his electric bike and turned on the power switch to confirm the battery was fully charged.
location: Company production workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After work, went home to pick up my wife.
description: At 4:30 p.m., Shift Leader Zhang told everyone to get off work. He took off his work clothes, changed into casual clothes, greeted Jianguo, then wheeled out his fully charged e-bike and rode all the way home. Ten minutes later, he arrived home and saw his wife Wang Lijuan already waiting for him at the building entrance, holding a reusable shopping bag and an empty schoolbag. The couple exchanged a few brief words, got on the e-bike, and set off for the largest vegetable market in Longhua District.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go with my wife to buy supplies for Qingming ancestral worship.
description: They arrived at the market at 5 p.m. It was indeed crowded with people and full of festive atmosphere. The couple divided their tasks: Wang Lijuan went first to the incense and candle stall, haggled, and bought a thick stack of paper money, three bundles of eco-friendly incense, and a pair of smokeless candles. Lu Mingqiang went to the flower stall next door and carefully picked two bouquets of white, slightly fragrant chrysanthemums. Then they met up and went to the fruit area to buy Red Fuji apples, navel oranges, and a bunch of ripe bananas. Finally, Lu Mingqiang pulled his wife aside to a local bulk liquor stall in the corner of the market and bought a bottle of the owner's homemade Hainan rice wine. Carrying heavy bags, the two carefully squeezed out of the market through the crowd, placed everything properly in the front basket and on the footboard of the e-bike, and returned fully loaded.
location: Wenhua Vegetable Market (Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market) near Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family time
description: He arrived home at 6:10. Wang Lijuan began preparing dinner, while Lu Mingqiang was in charge of watching the two children do their pinyin and arithmetic homework in the living room. Dinner was Juanzi's stir-fried sweet potato leaves, chives with scrambled eggs, and a pork rib and radish soup — simple and tasty. At the table, the younger son Hanhan asked what Qingming Festival is. Lu Mingqiang explained in words a child could understand: "Qingming Festival is when we visit loved ones who have gone to a world very far away, just like going to see Grandpa."
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organize ancestral worship items and load them into the car.
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang spread all the ancestor-worship supplies purchased in the afternoon on the living room floor and sorted them together with his wife. Wang Lijuan wrapped the paper money and incense candles in moisture-proof bags and sealed them, while Lu Mingqiang wrapped the cut flower stems in wet newspaper and put them in an empty plastic bottle half-filled with water. They wiped the fruit clean with a clean cloth and packed it into a canvas bag. After everything was ready, Lu Mingqiang carried two large bags downstairs, opened the trunk of his family car, neatly arranged everything, and reserved space for drinking water and snacks for the next day. He glanced at the two child seats tied in the back seat through the car window and felt very reassured.
location: Home living room and downstairs parking space, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Plan tomorrow’s itinerary and financial communication
description: Back in the living room, Lu Mingqiang opened the map app on his phone and navigated to his parents' home in Meilan District, which showed a drive of about 32 minutes. He and his wife agreed to wake the children at 7 a.m. and set off promptly at 7:30, first picking up his parents, then heading back to the village together. After that, he brought up the transfer from his brother: Yesterday my brother transferred 5000 yuan, saying it was for Xuanxuan's and Hanhan's education fees. Xuanxuan's tutoring class is still short 900 yuan. I want to cover that first, and put the remaining 4100 yuan into the children's dedicated card. What do you think? Wang Lijuan nodded in agreement and said that this was best, as long as the accounts were clear in mind.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child reading and free activities.
description: At 8:30, it was family reading time. Instead of reading picture books to the two children as usual, Lu Mingqiang proposed looking at a picture book about "traditional festivals" together, as a simple preparation for tomorrow's Qingming outing. He pulled out the book "Chinese Memory: Qingming Festival" from the bookshelf and told Xuanxuan and Hanhan about Qingming customs. After the story, Xuanxuan went back to his room to read a pinyin storybook by himself, while Lu Mingqiang stayed with Hanhan in the living room and used building blocks to make a small "grave" model, using a small handkerchief as a "tomb-sweeping" cloth, which served as an early "lesson".
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed core training (reduced volume for consolidation) and washing up
description: After tucking the two sons into their respective beds, Lu Mingqiang did the last task of the evening in the living room: pre-sleep core training. Considering that he had been active all day, he cut the sets again, doing only 2 sets of 15 superman extensions and 2 sets of 20 glute bridges, and stopped after just 50 seconds of plank. The focus was consolidation and relaxation. After training, he took a hot shower to fully relax the muscles that had been tense all day.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: After washing up, he changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. Dimming the bedside lamp, he picked up his phone and saw that there were expected showers tomorrow, so he decided to remind Wang Lijuan to bring an umbrella in the morning. Then he made a WeChat voice call to his parents and briefly said he would arrive a little earlier tomorrow. After hanging up, he did not look at any more messages. Instead, he put the phone away, closed his eyes, took a few deep breaths, and mentally reviewed tomorrow's schedule: leave at 7:30, first pick up Mom and Dad... He felt calm and expectant, and within ten minutes fell into a deep sleep, ready for the family reunion tomorrow.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Waking up in the morning and doing simplified core training
description: The 6:30 alarm went off right on time. Lu Mingqiang got up quickly and did a simplified core workout in the living room: 3 sets of planks (70 seconds each), and 2 sets each of superman exercises and glute bridges (15 reps each). After the workout, he washed up briefly, changed into a long-sleeved shirt, and felt full of energy.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake the family and have breakfast
description: At 7 o'clock sharp, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan woke up their two sons. Seven-year-old Lu Zixuan dressed himself in casual clothes altered from his school uniform, while four-year-old Lu Zihan lay in bed for a while longer. His wife brought out lean pork porridge and scallion fried eggs. After the whole family finished breakfast, Lu Mingqiang checked the sacrificial offerings, incense candles, rice wine, and tool box that he had loaded into the car the day before. At 7:25, the family of four got into the family car parked downstairs.
location: At home and downstairs at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to parents' home
description: Lu Mingqiang drove the car, starting from Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, heading to Meilan District via Longkun North Road and Haifu Road. During the Qingming Festival, traffic was a bit heavier but smooth. The older son, Xuanxuan, asked excitedly, "Do Grandma and Grandpa have rabbits in their hometown?" The younger son, Hanhan, was playing with a toy car. After about 35 minutes, they arrived at the South Area of CCCC Longqi Yayuan, 92 Haifu Road, Meilan District. His father, Lu Jianguo, and mother, Chen Xiuying, were already waiting at the entrance of the building unit, with his father carrying an old electrician's bag. Lu Mingqiang put his parents' things in the trunk, and they set off together.
location: From Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, via Longkun North Road and Haifu Road, to the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan Residential Community at No. 92 Haifu Road, Meilan District.

name: Drove to the ancestral house
description: The car drove through the city and onto a country road, with banana groves and coconut trees flashing past on both sides. Lu Mingqiang slowed down. His father, Lu Jianguo, looked out the window, pointed at a pond, and said, "When I was little, I used to catch fish there." The eldest son, Xuanxuan, curiously poked his head out to look, while the younger son, Hanhan, leaned against his mother and dozed off. About 40 minutes later, they arrived at the ancestral house near Meilanxu in Yanfeng Town, an old tile-roofed house with a courtyard covered in creeping vines.
location: Starting from Haifu Road, Meilan District, via Qiongshan Avenue and country roads, to the Lu family ancestral house in Meilanxu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District

name: Solemn ancestral worship ceremony
description: After arriving at the ancestral house, Lu Mingqiang and his father worked together to push open the heavy wooden door. His mother and wife cleaned the altar table, while Lu Mingqiang led his eldest son Xuanxuan to place the offerings on it: a plate each of apples, oranges, and bananas, two bunches of fresh white chrysanthemums, and a bottle of local Hainan rice wine. His father used a match to light the incense and candles, and wisps of blue smoke slowly rose in the main hall. Lu Mingqiang led the whole family to stand before the ancestral tablets and was the first to bow deeply three times. His wife followed closely with their younger son in her arms, and his eldest son seriously imitated the gesture. Then, in a low voice, his father reported the family's recent news to the ancestors in Hainanese. The atmosphere was solemn and peaceful.
location: Lu Family Ancestral House, Meilanxu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Father recounts his past as an electrician.
description: After the memorial ceremony, father moved an old bamboo chair to sit in front of the hall, opened his old electrician's bag, took out an old-fashioned electrician's knife and pliers wrapped in black electrical tape, and talked about his emergency repair experiences at Haikou Power Supply Bureau in the early 1980s: every day he rode a 28-inch bicycle with a crossbar through the alleys, carried out emergency repairs during typhoons, and when sleepy he would lean against a utility pole and doze off for a while. Lu Mingqiang listened intently, looking at his father's gray hair and rough hands, admiration rising in his heart. The eldest son Xuanxuan curiously touched the electrician's knife and asked, "Grandpa, did snakes really climb up the utility poles back then?"
location: In front of the Lu family ancestral hall in Meilanxu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday family gathering
description: Near noon, his mother and wife walked into the simple backyard kitchen to prepare lunch, while Lu Mingqiang and his two sons were peeling garlic and picking vegetables in the yard. At 12:00 noon, a table of authentic Hainan dishes was set: white-cut Wenchang chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, winter melon and clam soup, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and a small dish of handmade shrimp paste. The whole family sat around the table, eating and chatting. His mother told an amusing story about Lu Mingqiang being naughty as a child and breaking the neighbor's fuse, making everyone laugh.
location: Dining table in the main hall of the Lu family ancestral house, Meilan Xu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Repair ancestral house windows and courtyard
description: After lunch, his mother and wife cleared the dishes, and his father took the two grandsons to watch ants in the courtyard. Lu Mingqiang took out his toolbox and inspected the east-side window his father had mentioned. He used a screwdriver to remove the loose screw, whittled a small wooden wedge, inserted it into the hole, and tightened the screw again, making the window fit snugly. He then checked the other window latches and reinforced the loose bolts with wire. After finishing the repairs, he picked up a broom and swept the fallen leaves and debris from the courtyard, and stamped down the loose flagstones leading to the courtyard gate.
location: Inside and outside the Lu family ancestral house, Meilan Xu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Packing up and saying goodbye.
description: In the afternoon, the sunlight was soft, and everyone began to pack up, cleaning up the offering packaging and incense ash. The mother gave each of her two grandsons a red envelope and told them to be obedient. Lu Mingqiang shook hands with his father and said goodbye: "Dad, take care of your health. After the holiday, I'll accompany you to the hospital for a follow-up." His father patted him on the shoulder and said, "You worked hard today. You haven't lost your skills!"
location: Lu Family Ancestral House, Meilanxu, Yanfeng Town, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving back
description: Wang Lijuan drove from the ancestral home in Yanfeng Town back to their home on Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, taking country roads, Qiongshan Avenue, and Haifu Road. Lu Mingqiang sat in the passenger seat, looking at the fields outside the window, and took the initiative to share his feelings about ancestor worship with the children. The older son, Xuanxuan, said excitedly, "Grandpa's electrician stories are so cool! He works so hard!" The younger son, Hanhan, chimed in, "Grandpa is really good at fixing things!" Lu Mingqiang taught them that they must first learn knowledge well so that they can be as capable as their grandfather when they grow up.
location: From the ancestral house in Yanfeng Town, via country roads, Qiongshan Avenue, and Haifu Road, returned to Banshan Garden Residential Area on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Helping the eldest son with holiday homework
description: After getting home, the two children were a little tired, so Lu Mingqiang had his younger son take a nap in the bedroom. He washed his face, changed into a T-shirt, and took out his eldest son Lu Zixuan's schoolbag to check his holiday homework. Xuanxuan was not very good at multiplication and division word problems, so Lu Mingqiang patiently explained by drawing diagrams, using apples and oranges as examples until he fully understood.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and household chores.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan quickly made shredded pork fried noodles and dried shrimp, seaweed, and egg drop soup with the remaining ingredients, and reheated the white-cut chicken brought back from the ancestral home. While eating, Lu Mingqiang told his wife about the details of fixing the window today. After the meal, he voluntarily cleared the dishes and let his wife rest.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child reading and block games
description: After dinner, the family sat in the living room. Lu Mingqiang took out the picture book Our Festivals and, drawing on the day's ancestor worship experience, told his two sons in vivid language about Qingming Festival customs and family stories. Afterward, he played with his younger son with the newly bought dinosaur building blocks, while his elder son Xuanxuan quietly read an animal encyclopedia nearby.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Exam preparation study and planning
description: After the two children went to take a bath and get ready for bed, Lu Mingqiang came to the study, turned on the computer, logged into the student platform of the 'Advanced Technician Exam Preparation Class', browsed the preview of tomorrow's (April 5) live class and the course handout preview, and jotted down a few mock exam questions from previous years in his notebook, thinking about how to systematically review using his after-work and lunch break time, and had a rough plan in mind.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and communication with spouse
description: On the bedroom floor, Lu Mingqiang did 10 minutes of pre-sleep stretching to relax his tired lower back and waist from the day. His wife Wang Lijuan also lay down, and the two quietly discussed the plan for going to her parents' home tomorrow: what local specialties and fruit to bring, and leaving around 9 a.m. Lu Mingqiang also planned how to use the 5,000 yuan his brother had transferred: tomorrow he would take 900 yuan in cash to pay Xuanxuan's tutoring class fee, and deposit the remaining 4,100 yuan into the child's dedicated bank card next week.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and going to bed
description: At 21:30, Lu Mingqiang went to the bathroom to wash up and deliberately soaked his feet in hot water to relieve the fatigue of a day of walking. At 22:00, he turned off his phone alarm and confirmed that the 7:00 a.m. alarm for the next day was set. At 22:15 he lay down in bed, savored the warmth of today's family reunion, and slowly fell asleep.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning core training and morning run.
