description: The alarm went off right at six. After getting up, I washed my face briefly and laid out the yoga mat in the living room to do core exercises: 3 sets of 20 superman raises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 75-second planks. After splashing my face with water, I changed into running shoes and a quick-dry T-shirt, set off by car at 6:30, and arrived at Baishamen Park 15 minutes later. I ran 5 kilometers along the coastal path, keeping the pace at about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. The morning sea breeze carried a salty, humid smell, and I felt completely refreshed after the run. At 7:15 I returned to the parking spot, wiped off sweat with a towel, took a few sips of warm water from the thermos, and then drove home.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Baishamen Park

name: Breakfast; prepare local specialties.
description: He arrived home at 7:30, took a quick shower, and changed into a clean light-colored T-shirt and athletic shorts. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: white porridge, fried eggs, and half a serving of char siu buns. While eating, Lu Mingqiang checked with his wife what they needed to bring today. At 8:00, he went to the kitchen, took out a large jar of pickled vegetables his mother had made yesterday, packed it into a food container, and bought 5 jin of fresh mangoes and a bunch of bananas at the Jinmao Convenience Fruit Store at the community gate. After packing everything properly, he urged his two sons to wash up and change clothes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: On the way to his mother-in-law's home, he handled financial matters and listened to a program.
description: A family of four set off by car. On the way, taking advantage of the moment when the two children in the back seat were playing, Lu Mingqiang said quietly to Wang Lijuan, “My brother transferred 5000 yuan. Let's first transfer 900 yuan to Xuanxuan's tutoring class. For the remaining 4100 yuan, I'll stop by the bank on the way to work tomorrow and put it all on the child's card. We have to get by, but the accounting must be clear.” Wang Lijuan nodded in agreement. After the car was running smoothly, he opened the Ximalaya app on his phone, connected it to the car's Bluetooth, and played the first episode of Industrial Memories. A voice full of vicissitudes told the story, with vivid detail, of an old factory in Northeast China using a hardwood winch to hoist a steam turbine in the early days of the People's Republic of China. He was so absorbed that he did not come to until the navigation prompted that they were about to arrive.
location: On the way from Banshan Garden Residential Area to Bazao New Town

name: Visiting wife's parents
description: Arrived at his mother-in-law's home in Bazao New City at 9:00. The younger son, Hanhan, rushed into his grandparents' arms as soon as he got out of the car. Lu Mingqiang put down the pickled cabbage and mangoes he had brought, sat down to drink tea with his father-in-law, and chatted about repairing the windows in the ancestral house during yesterday's Qingming Festival. The older son, Xuanxuan, took out his homework notebook and read the newly learned text to his grandmother. At 10:30, his mother-in-law and wife went into the kitchen to prepare lunch, while Lu Mingqiang played chess with his father-in-law in the living room, and the younger son played by his toolbox.
location: Bazao New Town, Binhai Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Had lunch at my mother-in-law's home and discussed family matters.
description: His mother-in-law had prepared a large table of Hainan dishes: white-cut Wenchang chicken, stir-fried Hainan winged beans, winter melon and white clam soup, and a steamed mackerel. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang brought up the money his brother had transferred, saying that he and Juanzi had agreed to put every cent of it into the children's education fund without keeping any. His mother-in-law praised him for being dependable and thrifty. After the meal, he helped clear the table. At 13:00, he asked his wife and the two children to take an afternoon nap at his mother-in-law's house first, saying he would join the charity run at Wanlv Park at 3:00 p.m. and come back to pick them up.
location: Bazao New Town, Binhai Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went home for a lunch break and finished listening to the first episode of Industrial Memories
description: At 13:00, he drove home alone. Instead of going to sleep right away, he leaned back on the living room sofa and finished the first episode of Industrial Memories, which he had not finished listening to in the morning. When he heard the part about workers lifting steel girders with their shoulders, he could not help sitting up straight. He sent a WeChat message to his fellow worker Chen Jianguo: "Buddy, I listened to the program; it was truly fantastic! Thanks for recommending it!" At 13:25, he got up, went to the bedroom, lay down, set an alarm for 14:00, and soon fell into a light sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Changing clothes to prepare for the charity run
description: The alarm went off at 14:00 sharp. He changed into the Saucony running shoes and quick-dry shorts he had bought specifically for running, put on his sports band, and tucked his phone and keys into a waist pack. Before going out, he sent WeChat to his running buddy Abin: 'See you at the usual place!' Then he went downstairs, checked the car to make sure there was enough gas, and drank a few sips of water.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Participated in and finished the 10-kilometer charity run.
description: At 14:30 he drove to the designated meeting point at Wanlv Garden and met up with A Bin. There were about forty or fifty people on site, with a relaxed atmosphere. Everyone did a 10-minute warm-up together, and the run started on time at 15:00. Lu Mingqiang advanced steadily at his own rhythm, maintaining a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, he and A Bin took turns leading, and occasionally chatted with nearby runners. At 16:15 he crossed the finish line smoothly in 1 hour and 7 minutes. After the race, he received a sports gift pack from the sponsor—a quick-dry T-shirt, a pair of wristbands, and a pair of sports socks. He tried on the T-shirt on the spot and found it fit very well. He sat on the lawn with A Bin, drinking water and eating refreshments, sharing their post-race thoughts.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up family members and go shopping at the mall.
description: At 16:45, he drove back to Bazao New City to pick up his wife, who had been taking an afternoon nap at her mother's house, and the two children. At 17:10, the family of four drove directly to Friendship Sunshine City Commercial Plaza near their home. The children lingered in the toy area, and his wife bought each of them a small construction vehicle toy. Lu Mingqiang pushed the shopping cart and accompanied his wife in the supermarket to buy a week's supply of fresh produce and daily necessities. He deliberately looked at new smart rice cookers in the appliance section, but after seeing the 999 yuan price tag, silently put it back and said to his wife, "Forget it, our old buddy at home can still be used." The family spent nearly an hour shopping in the mall.
location: Friendship Sunshine City, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home to prepare dinner
description: Arrived home at 18:30. Wang Lijuan went into the kitchen and busied herself with dinner: braised pork ribs and stir-fried lettuce. Lu Mingqiang washed the mangoes he had bought today, cut them into small pieces and put them on a plate, and poured each child a glass of yogurt. The eldest son, Xuanxuan, was in the living room seriously playing a “delivery” game with his younger brother using the new toy car. The home was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the dining table eating. Lu Mingqiang ate ribs while listening to Xuanxuan talk about interesting things that happened at school today, and reminded him to do his homework carefully tomorrow. After the meal, he took the initiative to put the dishes and chopsticks into the sink and wiped the table clean.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening workout in the community fitness area
description: After resting for half an hour after the meal, Lu Mingqiang changed into his workout clothes and went downstairs alone to the community fitness equipment area. He did 3 sets of pull-ups on the horizontal bar, 8 reps per set, and then 3 sets of crunches on the abdominal board. Uncle Wang, a neighbor who was taking a walk, passed by with his cane, stopped, and praised him: 'Mingqiang, you're in really great shape!' The two chatted for about ten minutes about the rise in the community property management fee. Uncle Wang complained that the property service did not live up to the fee. After his workout, Lu Mingqiang was slightly sweaty and felt his whole body relaxed.
location: Fitness area, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child reading and leisure
description: He got home at 21:10. He helped Xuanxuan finish a math word problem, then took out the Journey to the West picture book, put his arms around the two sons on the sofa, and told the younger son the story of 'Three Battles with the White Bone Demon'. His wife was browsing shopping websites on her phone beside them. At 22:00, he urged the two sons to wash up and get ready for bed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing up
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang took a shower. When he came out, he found his wife still using her phone and urged her to rest early.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Listened to episode 2 of Industrial Memory and fell asleep.
description: At 22:30, Lu Mingqiang lay in bed, put on his earphones, and continued listening to episode 2 of 'Industrial Memory' on Ximalaya. When he heard an exciting part, he sent Chen Jianguo a WeChat message: 'I'm listening to episode 2 now. This show is really well made — your recommendation was spot on, buddy!' At 23:00, he turned off his phone, took off his earphones, turned off the light, and set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning. The streetlights outside cast soft light and shadows through the curtains, and he soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: The alarm went off, and he felt some lingering soreness in the back of his thighs from yesterday morning's run. He first went to the balcony to water a few potted plants and loosened up his muscles a bit. He took a hot shower, heated a glass of milk, and had the wife cakes he had bought last night for breakfast. Meanwhile, he took out his phone and saw the yoga trial class poster and invitation message sent by his sports buddy Lin Feng. He felt a little awkward about it, but still replied, "Alright, I'll go over and take a look."
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (balcony, bathroom, dining room)

name: Drove to the gym
description: He changed into a cotton T-shirt and sports shorts and brought his water bottle. He told his wife Wang Lijuan, who was preparing breakfast, "Afeng asked me to go do some yoga; I'll be back for lunch." Then he set off by car. The road wasn't congested, so he used his phone app to continue listening to the sequel to Industrial Memory that he hadn't finished yesterday. The drive took about 10 minutes.
location: In Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, during a drive from Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, to Xingdongli Fitness Youyi Sunshine City Store, 2 Jinlong Road

name: Pre-class preparation and interaction at the gym
description: Arriving at the gym, Lin Feng was already waiting at the entrance. He handed Lu Mingqiang a clean club T-shirt and told him to change into it. The two chatted for a while, and Lin Feng patted him on the shoulder and said, "Don't worry, this class is just stretching—it's specially for someone with a lower back as stiff as yours." Lu Mingqiang took the clothes, still feeling a little uneasy.
location: Xingdongli Fitness Youyi Sunshine City Store, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (front desk, locker room)

name: Hatha yoga trial class
description: Walking into the yoga studio, soft background music began to play. Seeing that the seven or eight trainees in the room were all women, Lu Mingqiang felt a little uneasy and found a corner to stand in. The instructor led everyone in adjusting their breathing, and he followed along with reluctance. From Downward-Facing Dog to Cat-Cow, his movements were clumsy, and he nearly lost his balance several times, with sweat beading on his forehead. But when he got to the Spinal Twist, he clearly heard his spine crack, and a feeling of relief spread from his lower back to his upper back. He thought to himself, "Hey, it really does help."
location: Yoga Room, Xingdongli Fitness Youyi Sunshine City Store, 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sharing stretching techniques after class
description: After the class, Lin Feng deliberately kept him behind. He pulled up a human muscle anatomy diagram on his tablet and explained the erector spinae and hip flexors in plain language. "With the kind of physical work you do, these muscles are tight, and it's easy to get lower back pain." As he spoke, Lin Feng demonstrated child's pose and butterfly pose. Lu Mingqiang did not fully understand, but he carefully used his phone to record the demonstration and promised Lin Feng, "Okay, I'll try practicing at home."
location: Star Power Fitness, Friendship Sunshine City Branch (rest area), No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drove home and took a shower.
description: Drove home, about an 11-minute drive. After a hot shower, he felt relaxed all over, and even walking felt lighter. His wife was in the kitchen preparing ingredients for lunch, and their two sons were playing with building blocks in the living room.
location: Bathroom in Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and on the drive back from the gym

name: Resting at home and parent-child interaction
description: After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang felt a bit tired and sat down in the living room to rest. His older son Xuanxuan came over with a picture book and asked him to tell a story. His younger son Hanhan also came over and lay on his lap. He took the picture book and told the story vividly until his wife called them to get ready for dinner.
location: Living room, Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: The family of four ate lunch, with the children chattering about funny things from kindergarten and school. Lu Mingqiang had a good appetite and ate two bowls of rice. He also chatted with his wife about what he had seen in the morning yoga class, and said with a smile, "I thought it was some fancy Western thing, but after doing it, my waist does feel a little better."
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Restaurant)

name: Midday break and choosing a movie.
description: After lunch, the weather began to turn cloudy. Lu Mingqiang did not take a nap, but sat on the living room sofa and picked up the tablet to find an animated movie. His older son Xuanxuan came over, and his younger son Hanhan also climbed onto his lap and nestled into his arms. He adjusted the cushions, called his wife over to watch together, and prepared to enjoy the afternoon.
location: Living room, Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family watched an animated movie
description: A light drizzle began outside, pattering against the window. Inside, four people squeezed together on the sofa, watching an animated movie projected on the wall. The younger son Hanhan giggled, while the older son Xuanxuan analyzed the plot with him in a serious manner. Lu Mingqiang held the children, feeling that staying with his family like this was much better than running around outside.
location: Living room, Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child bonding and homework guidance
description: The movie ended, but it was still raining. Lu Mingqiang played with LEGO with his younger son for a while, then went to the study to help his eldest son Xuanxuan review next week's Chinese vocabulary. He patiently listened to Xuanxuan create words and sentences, and also corrected his pencil grip and sitting posture.
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room, study).

name: Family dinner
description: Wife Wang Lijuan had prepared dinner, and the family sat around the table eating. At the table, Lu Mingqiang urged Xuanxuan: "The weekend homework should be wrapped up; I'll check it after dinner."
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Restaurant)

name: Free activity and listening to audiobooks.
description: After dinner, the children watched TV and his wife cleaned up the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, opened the Ximalaya app, and continued listening to the latest episode of 'Industrial Memories'. When he heard the part about old workers repairing old machines, he felt a deep sense of empathy and nodded repeatedly.
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Master Bedroom)

name: Try yoga stretching at home
description: He found an old bath towel and spread it on the living room floor, then began recalling the moves Lin Feng had taught him that morning. He first did Cat-Cow pose for 3 minutes, then lay on his stomach and did Child's pose for 3 minutes, feeling his lower back gradually relax. Finally, when he tried Pigeon pose, the soreness in his thighs made him give up after 40 seconds. 'This thing is really not simple; I have to take it slowly,' he muttered to himself, stood up, and patted the dust off his shorts.
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (living room floor)

name: Washing up and preparing items for tomorrow's work.
description: After a simple stretch, he went to the bathroom to wash up. After showering, he picked out the work clothes and safety shoes to wear to work the next day, and checked the electric bike key again. Thinking that tomorrow would be the first day back after the holiday and he had to deal with the urgent task of the cabinet at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza, he mulled it over: "Tomorrow morning I need to go to the tool room first and bring that set of special wrenches."
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan (bathroom, bedroom)

name: Parent-child reading and putting the kids to bed
description: The two sons had already changed into pajamas and were waiting in bed. Lu Mingqiang picked up an adventure story picture book and told it to them vividly. After finishing one story, the younger son fell asleep first, and the older son also yawned and said he was sleepy. He tucked the children in, turned off the light, and went out.
location: Secondary bedroom, Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Chatting with my wife before bed
description: Back in the master bedroom, his wife Wang Lijuan told him that tomorrow morning she would go to the community hospital to get some blood pressure medicine. Lu Mingqiang nodded and said, 'I need to get to the company early tomorrow. After you get the medicine, come back on your own, and take your time on the road.' The two chatted about everyday matters for a while, then turned off the lights and got ready for sleep.
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Master Bedroom)

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the light, Lu Mingqiang felt comfortable from the inside out, especially in his lower back, with an unprecedented sense of relaxation. Thinking about the new experience yoga had brought him today, he drifted off to sleep with contentment.
location: Building 1, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Master Bedroom)

name: Early morning simplified core training
description: At exactly six o'clock, the alarm went off. Thanks to yesterday's yoga class, my lower back discomfort had eased. I quickly did three sets of planks on the bedroom carpet, holding each set for 70 seconds. After activating my core, I felt refreshed and ready for the day's heavy physical labor.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, breakfast, and tool check
description: Washed up quickly and changed into clean work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan was already steaming buns and heating milk in the kitchen; after a brief conversation, he told her he might be home late today. He carefully checked the tool box: infrared level, impact drill bits, tape measure, wrench, marker pen; he also replenished the canvas water bottle and set out a towel.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take my young son to kindergarten.
description: Rode an electric bike to take the younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, a ride of about 5 minutes. The child was a bit reluctant. He helped him tidy his kindergarten uniform and promised to buy seaweed snacks after work. He watched him go into the classroom with the teacher before leaving.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take eldest son to school and commute to the company.
description: He turned back home to pick up his eldest son Lu Zixuan, took him to Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 7:15, gave him five yuan of pocket money, and told him to listen carefully in class and do well on the exam. Then he cycled faster for about 20 minutes, going from Meilan District to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park in Xiuying District, and met his co-worker Chen Jianguo at the bicycle shed.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Company morning meeting and pre-departure preparations
description: Team Leader Zhang called a morning meeting, emphasizing post-holiday safety and focusing on assigning the installation task for the power distribution cabinets at the Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza. After the meeting, he and Chen Jianguo loaded tools and consumables onto the work truck, checked the stability of the hydraulic cart, and drove to the construction site at exactly 8 o'clock.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning - installation of the main body of the distribution cabinet.
description: At 8:15, they arrived at the construction site of Hongquan Commercial Plaza on Xiuying Street. The electrical distribution room was hot, stuffy, and dusty. He and Chen Jianguo put on their safety helmets and masks, marked the mounting hole positions for three cabinets with a spirit level and tape measure according to the drawings, and used a hydraulic trolley to move the roughly 200 kg cabinets into place one by one. One person steadied the cabinet while the other tightened the expansion bolts; they worked in good coordination. By 11:50, the three cabinets were neatly aligned vertically, with tolerances well controlled.
location: Electrical distribution room at the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site, Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch, work review, and a short rest
description: Finished work at 12:00, rode an electric bike with Chen Jianguo to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road, ordered spicy soup rice, stir-fried greens, plus a fried egg and iced coconut water. While eating, they reviewed the morning installation details and discussed tomorrow's busway plan. After the meal, he used his phone to review the senior technician exam syllabus, focusing on memorizing the motor control circuit schematic. Twenty minutes later, feeling sleepy, he dozed at the table for ten minutes.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: fine-tuning and finishing the cabinet body details.
description: At 13:20 he returned to the construction site and used a level to repeatedly adjust the horizontal gaps between three cabinets, rechecked the verticality, and removed the temporary internal supports. Poor ventilation caused his work clothes to be soaked through with sweat repeatedly. At 15:20 the main installation was fully completed, and the site was given a preliminary cleanup.
location: Electrical distribution room at the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site, Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Left work and went to the bank to make a deposit
description: Said goodbye to Chen Jianguo for now, rode an electric bike along the Haixiu Expressway service road for 5 minutes, and arrived at the Agricultural Bank of China Haixiu Sub-branch. Inserted a bank card into the self-service machine, entered the amount of 4,100 yuan, confirmed the transfer to Xuanxuan's education fund account, and left at ease after seeing "Transaction Successful".
location: Agricultural Bank of China (Haikou Haixiu Sub-branch Business Department), No. 106 Haixiu Middle Road, Haixiu Avenue, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Site wrap-up and planning for tomorrow
description: Returned to the construction site and counted and loaded the remaining tools with Chen Jianguo. Using the drawings, he marked the preliminary installation route for tomorrow's busway on the wall with chalk. The client's on-site supervisor checked the progress and was satisfied with the installation quality, agreed to a seamless continuation the next day, and they wrapped up early at 16:30.
location: Electrical distribution room at the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site, Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: After-work commute and relaxed time.
description: After finishing work early, walked 16 minutes to Wallace Whole Chicken Burger (West Station Branch 2), with a soothing cool breeze along the way. Bought a chicken leg burger and a serving of fries for Xuanxuan and Hanhan each as a small reward for them.
location: Wallace Whole Chicken Burger (West Station Branch 2), Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return home and rehydrate.
description: He hung the burger on the handlebar and rode the electric bike home. On the way, feeling thirsty, he detoured to the Convenient Life convenience store on Haisheng Road and bought a 1.5-liter bottle of mineral water and two packs of seaweed. He got home at 17:40 and locked the bike.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking a shower and father-son time.
description: After coming in, he drank cold water, took out burgers and fries, and the sons cheered and crowded around. He greeted his wife, then went to the bathroom to take a cold shower and changed out of his sweat-smelling work clothes. When he came out, the children were enjoying the food, and his wife had already prepared dinner.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the table eating. His wife had made soy sauce chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and seaweed egg drop soup. As they ate, they listened to Xuanxuan talk about funny things at school, and he put food into Hanhan's bowl. The atmosphere was warm, and most of the work fatigue melted away.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner family time
description: He took the initiative to clear the dishes and let his wife rest. He played with his sons in the living room with Lego and toy cars. Xuanxuan showed off a "power station" built with Lego, while Hanhan played with small cars—half an hour of parent-child interaction.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: In-depth communication with his wife.
description: After the child returned to his room, he had a serious discussion with his wife Wang Lijuan in the living room about the intensive training class starting next Monday. He frankly expressed his concerns about housework and tutoring the child. His wife firmly supported him and said, "I'll take care of the family." Together they anticipated contingency plans for situations such as the child getting sick or temporary household chores, and finally decided to ask his mother for help if necessary, which put both of them more at ease.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped with homework and did parent-child reading.
description: Entered Xuanxuan's room to check his math homework, pointed out a calculation error in a word problem, and guided him to correct it. Then, at Hanhan's bedside, told the story I Want to See the Sea from Different Carmela, and the child gradually fell asleep.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tidy up tools and stretch before bed.
description: After settling the children, I inventoried the repair tools for tomorrow in the living room and added spare impact drill bits. Then I did an 8-minute shoulder and neck stretch beside the bed in the bedroom, targeting the trapezius and back that were stressed during the day, to relieve stiffness.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal leisure and preparation for sleep.
description: After stretching, his body relaxed. Leaning against the headboard, he browsed local news and a baijiu bottle collecting forum and saw an article about Hainan’s “Datie old man’s tea” culture, so he planned to take his parents to experience it on the weekend. He turned off the lights at 10 p.m. and fell asleep quickly because he had expended a lot of energy during the day.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning core exercises and washing up
description: After waking up early in the morning, he did his usual core workout at home, including 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 75-second planks, to strengthen his waist and back. After exercising, he washed up and got ready for the day's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and taking the children to school
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast. As the family ate breakfast, Lu Mingqiang reminded his wife that there would be thundershowers in the afternoon and that she should remember to bring an umbrella when going to the hospital to get medicine. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike, first taking his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then taking his older son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way, Xuanxuan asked if he could buy a new jump rope, and Mingqiang promised to take him to buy one in the evening.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-work preparation and commute to the worksite
description: After arriving at the company's Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, I organized tools with fellow worker Chen Jianguo, counted cable lugs, crimping pliers, etc., and confirmed the construction drawings. Squad leader Zhang reminded us to take breaks due to the high temperature in the electrical distribution room. Afterwards, we took an engineering vehicle driven by Chen Jianguo to the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site, chatting about the weather and ball games on the way.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning task: connecting the main lines of the power distribution cabinet.
description: In the electrical distribution room at the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo worked together to connect the main circuits of three distribution cabinets. Mingqiang was responsible for stripping wires, crimping copper lugs, and connecting the busbars, while Jianguo assisted with checking the wires. While they worked, intern Xiao Zhao observed and learned, and Mingqiang shared his experience. The weather was hot and muggy, their work clothes were soaked through, and they took two breaks midway for herbal tea.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, Xiuying Small Street, Hongquan Commercial Plaza

name: Lunch and midday break
description: After finishing work in the morning, the three of them went to Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the construction site for lunch and ordered spicy soup rice with white-cut chicken. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang browsed a liquor bottle collecting forum, spotted a desirable vintage bottle but did not join the discussion. Afterwards, he rested with his eyes closed on the steps beside the construction site for more than ten minutes while thinking about the inspection procedure before powering up in the afternoon.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon wiring wrap-up and pre-power-on inspection
description: In the afternoon, he continued wiring the remaining 2 cabinets in the electrical distribution room. He and Chen Jianguo checked the circuit numbers one by one and measured insulation resistance with a multimeter. When they found labels with blurred numbers, they reprinted and replaced them. Before finishing work, Team Leader Zhang made an inspection and conducted a preliminary pre-power check on all the wiring. Everything was correct, and they were praised, making preparations complete for the next day’s commissioning.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, Xiuying Small Street, Hongquan Commercial Plaza

name: Finish work, pick up the children from school, and buy groceries on the way home.
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his eldest son. On the way, he passed Jiabo Stationery Store and, remembering his promise that morning, stopped to buy a jump rope with a counter and a box of watercolor pens. Then he arrived at the school gate to pick up Lu Zixuan, who happily tried out the new jump rope. Afterwards, he stopped by the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket to buy winter melon, pork ribs, and cherry tomatoes, and finally rode home with his son to Banshan Garden.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rest at home and family dinner
description: After arriving home, the youngest son rushed over to greet him. Lu Mingqiang took a shower and changed into loungewear, then briefly talked with his wife about her trip to the hospital to get medicine. Afterward, he played with building blocks with his youngest son. His wife had prepared dinner, including winter melon and pork rib soup. The family sat together, sharing funny stories from the construction site and the son's jump rope contest. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening family disagreement resolved through a walk and heart-to-heart talk
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang was in his study browsing his wine bottle collection notes. His wife Wang Lijuan saw him and scolded him for not focusing on exam preparation, and the two started arguing. Feeling upset, Mingqiang went out for a walk alone, then rode his e-bike to Boyou Teahouse on Bo'ai South Road, where he happened to run into his father Lu Jianguo. His father listened patiently and counseled him with his own experiences, helping Mingqiang understand that he should prioritize and prepare for the exam first. Relieved, Mingqiang went home, apologized to his wife on his own initiative, and put the wine bottle notes away at the bottom of his toolbox, saying he wouldn't be distracted until the exam. His wife had already prepared hot milk for him, and the two made up.
location: Boyou Tea House, No. 79 Bo'ai South Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Confirm tutoring class enrollment, parent-child activities, and bedtime preparations
description: Lu Mingqiang called the training institution to confirm that his application for the electrician senior technician exam prep class through his company had been successful, and noted the training dates as April 14 to 25, weekday evenings from 7:00 to 9:30, at the third floor of the training building, Haikou Electrical School. Afterwards, he helped his eldest son with math homework and checked the wrong answers, and told his younger son the story "Little Horse Crossing the River" to put him to sleep. After doing some simple shoulder and neck stretches in the living room, he looked through the exam prep materials, sorted out the next day's tool list, set his alarm, and went to sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training.
description: After the alarm went off, he got up immediately, laid out the training mat on the bedroom floor, and completed core strength training according to his usual routine: 3 sets of 20 reps of superman exercise, 3 sets of 25 reps of glute bridges, and 3 sets of 75-second planks, with standard form and steady breathing. The fifteen-minute workout fully awakened his body and prepared him for the high-intensity work of the day. After the workout, he did simple shoulder and neck stretches.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning washing up, breakfast, and message handling.
description: After morning exercise, he took a warm shower, changed into his work clothes, and rechecked the documents and tool lists needed for that day's acceptance inspection before putting them into his backpack. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing breakfast in the kitchen and reminded him to be safe. He quickly finished the Hainan noodles and warm milk prepared by his wife. During the meal, he sent a WeChat message to his squash partner Lin Feng (A Feng) to cancel the evening squash appointment and sent a 20-yuan red packet to express his apology.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Send the two sons to school
description: He went out with his wife, riding an electric bike and carrying the two sons. First, on the way, he took the 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, watched him complete the morning health check and enter the kindergarten, then went to Meilan District and took the 8-year-old eldest son Lu Zixuan to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. Before parting, he reminded him that Dad might be home late in the evening and that he should think about his homework on his own first.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the company to meet up with my partner
description: After dropping off the children, he rode his e-bike alone along Haifu Road and Haixiu Middle Road to his company at No. 57 Haisheng Road. Traffic was gradually increasing during the morning rush hour but the roads were smooth. Upon arrival, he went straight to the tool room and finally checked the acceptance forms, multimeter, and debugging tools to ensure all equipment was complete.
location: On the way from Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Pre-energization inspection and preparation for the power distribution cabinet
description: After briefly discussing the commissioning process with his partner Chen Jianguo, they each rode electric bikes to the Hongquan Commercial Plaza construction site. In the underground power distribution room, they used a multimeter and screwdriver to give all wiring terminals a final visual check and tighten them, while Chen Jianguo simultaneously checked the main cable connections and insulation resistance. At 11 a.m., Supervisor Liu from the mall's engineering department came to the site to ask about progress; the two reported that everything was ready and only the afternoon power-on commissioning remained.
location: Underground power distribution room, Hongquan Commercial Plaza, Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch near the construction site.
description: Walked with Chen Jianguo to Sister's Spicy Rice Soup Fast Food Restaurant next to the construction site. Each ordered an affordable spicy rice soup set meal with pickled vegetables and Chinese sausage. While eating, they chatted about family matters and evening plans. Jianguo mentioned that he had to accompany his son doing crafts in the evening, while I said I needed to help Uncle Wang pick up a package.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Brisk walking and listening to podcasts during lunch break
description: After the meal, he walked briskly alone along the shaded Xiuying Street, keeping a pace of about 120 steps per minute until he was slightly sweaty. At the same time, he put on earphones and listened to half an episode of the podcast "Industrial Memory", which happened to be about the changes in the previous generation of electrical equipment, echoing the topic he had discussed with his father yesterday and making him feel warm. After 25 minutes, feeling refreshed, he strolled back to the worksite.
location: Tree-shaded slow walking path along Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Power-on commissioning and acceptance of the distribution cabinet
description: At 1:30 PM, the official power-on commissioning began. Lu Mingqiang stood in front of a power distribution cabinet holding a multimeter. After signaling Chen Jianguo that everything was ready, Chen Jianguo closed the switch to energize the cabinet. The indicator lights in the cabinet lit up one by one, and the cooling fans ran normally without abnormal noise. Then voltage and current were measured circuit by circuit; all values were within the standard range, and Chen Jianguo checked and recorded them on the acceptance form. All six main circuits of the three cabinets passed on the first attempt. The mall supervisor, Manager Liu, signed the acceptance form on the spot and expressed thanks for the efficient work over the three days.
location: Underground power distribution room, Hongquan Commercial Plaza, Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Construction site wrap-up and trip to the bookstore to buy exam study materials
description: After debugging, he packed up the tools with Chen Jianguo, cleaned up the site, and said goodbye at the entrance of the construction site. Then he rode his electric bike east along Haixiu Middle Road toward the Xinhua Bookstore on Jiefang West Road, arriving about 30 minutes later. In the industrial technology section of the bookstore, he carefully selected and finally bought the officially designated 'Training Textbook for Senior Electrician Technicians (Third Edition)', 'Mock Exams and Past Paper Collection', 'Practical Assessment Guide', and a standard practical test tool kit (including a multimeter, clamp meter, etc.). After paying, he left.
location: From Xiuying Small Street, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Xinhua Bookstore (Jiefang Road Branch), Jiefang West Road, Longhua District

name: Returned to the residential community.
description: After leaving Xinhua Bookstore, he rode his e-bike along Jiefang West Road and Longhua Road back to Banshan Garden residential area. After parking the bike, he carried the purchased books and tool bag into the unit stairwell.
location: On the way from Jiefang West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Helped neighbor Uncle Wang, who had fallen, and picked up his express package for him.
description: Just as I walked into the corner of the first-floor hallway, I found my neighbor Uncle Wang sitting on the ground after a fall, wearing a pained expression. After asking, I learned that he had missed a step and sprained his foot. I immediately put down what I was carrying and went over to help him up. After confirming that he was not seriously hurt, I half-supported and half-helped him back to the sofa in his second-floor home. I poured him some water to comfort him, then proactively offered to collect his packages for him. Using the pickup code Uncle Wang gave me, I went to the parcel locker at the entrance of the community and retrieved two packages, then took them upstairs. Uncle Wang was very grateful and insisted on giving me two boxes of homemade Hainan coconut cakes as thanks. Unable to decline, I accepted them and told him to rest well.
location: Hallways of Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Uncle Wang's home, and the package collection point at the community gate

name: Go home and tidy up a bit.
description: Carrying the books, tools, and coconut cakes, he returned to his own home. He carefully placed the exam materials on the desk and put the coconut cakes on the dining table. Then he took a shower, changed out of his dusty work clothes, and put on clean loungewear.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Have dinner with the family
description: His wife had prepared dinner, and the family sat around the table. Lu Mingqiang excitedly announced the good news that the construction site had passed the acceptance inspection smoothly, and the family was very happy. The children's eyes lit up at the coconut cake, and his wife couldn't stop praising it. Lu Mingqiang told the story of how he had helped Uncle Wang, and his wife agreed that neighbors should help one another. At the table, he also briefly mentioned the family arrangements for after the exam preparation class started next week, and his wife expressed full support.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner walk and buying a jump rope
description: After dinner, his wife cleared the table and washed the dishes, while Lu Mingqiang took the two children downstairs for a walk to help digestion. Remembering that he had promised his eldest son to buy a jump rope with a counter, he went to the Xiangzhi Department and Grocery Store at the entrance of the residential community. Lu Zixuan picked out a bright blue counting jump rope and tried it on the spot, and Lu Zihan chose a small pinwheel. Then the three of them walked around the neighborhood watching the sunset, enjoying family time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road.

name: Helping with homework and parent-child reading
description: After returning home, I first checked my eldest son Lu Zixuan's homework. Finding his approach to the math word problems unclear, I patiently guided him to analyze by drawing diagrams until he fully understood. Then I taught him to write the newly learned Chinese characters; after demonstration and copying, his handwriting became neat. At 8 p.m., my younger son Lu Zihan came over with a storybook. I sat him on my lap and vividly told the story of The Three Little Pigs; the little guy was completely captivated.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child washing up and putting the children to bed
description: Close to 9 o'clock, he helped the two children take turns washing up: Lu Zixuan brushed his teeth and washed his face by himself, while Lu Mingqiang washed the younger son's face and little feet. Then he and his wife tucked the children into bed, said goodnight, turned off the light, and soon the two children fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Exam preparation study and bedtime preparation
description: After the family fell asleep, he sat alone at the desk in the living room, turned on the desk lamp, took out the newly bought Training Textbook for Senior Electrician Technicians (Third Edition) and began studying from the first chapter. He carefully marked key points and carefully pondered the difficult section on the principles of power electronic devices. After studying for an hour, he wrote "Class starts on April 14" on a sticky note and put it up on the desk. Then he did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches to relax muscles that had stiffened from standing during the day. After stretching, he drank a glass of warm water, washed up briefly, lay in bed and reviewed the fulfilling day, set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, planned the new equipment installation tasks, and soon fell asleep.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning core workout.
description: After the alarm went off, his back was still a bit sore, but he dared not slack off. The goal was to break through the 80-second plank. He first did 3 sets of “little swallow” warm-ups (20 reps each), then 3 sets of glute bridges (25 reps each), and finally gritted his teeth and pushed through, successfully holding the plank for 80 seconds. His lower back strength had improved. After finishing, he took a shower and changed into his work clothes.
location: Own bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school
description: After waking up the two sons, he first rode an electric bike to take his younger son Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, telling him to be good; then he took his elder son Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, having him recite English words on the way, and left only after confirming he entered the school gate.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road), then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

name: Breakfast and commute
description: After dropping off the kids, he bought two pork buns and a cup of soy milk at the breakfast stall at the community entrance, ate while riding the electric bike, and arrived at the company about ten minutes later.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District) to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District)

name: Start-of-work preparations and morning meeting.
description: Went to the team, changed into work clothes, and checked the tool bag. Team leader Zhang assigned the day's task: go to Haijian Machinery Factory to repair an old power distribution cabinet. Paired with Chen Jianguo, the two carried a multimeter, screwdrivers, and spare relays, then rode off.
location: Company office/team rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: On-site maintenance: troubleshooting at Haijian Machinery Factory.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo rode an electric bike to the power distribution room of Haijian Machinery Factory. An old distribution cabinet had an intermittent tripping fault. The two checked all visible wires and components and measured the voltage with a multimeter, but found nothing abnormal. They went deeper inside the cabinet but still had no clue, and began to grow anxious.
location: Electrical distribution room, Haijian Machinery Factory, No. 18 Yilonghou Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Call Master Li for help.
description: After almost two hours of troubleshooting with no progress, he felt uncertain. He walked to the corridor outside the distribution room and called his retired mentor, Master Li, describing the fault symptoms and troubleshooting process in detail. His mentor was silent for a moment, then said, “Wait, I’ll come over,” and hung up.
location: Corridor outside the electrical distribution room, Haijian Machinery Factory, No. 18 Yilonghou Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The master arrived and pinpointed the fault precisely.
description: The master arrived on an old electric bike. He walked around the distribution cabinet, observed it, and listened closely. After the power was cut off, he shone a flashlight at the relay in the corner and pointed out that the aged spring plate was causing unstable pull-in under high current. After replacing the relay with a new one, power was restored and tested, and the fault was eliminated. I was deeply impressed by the master's judgment.
location: Electrical distribution room, Haijian Machinery Factory, No. 18 Yilonghou Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drinking tea with my master at Zhengfanghua Laobacha
description: After fixing the equipment, the sky began to drizzle. He insisted on treating his master to a meal but failed, so he cycled to Zhengfanghua Laoba Tea (Mingzhu Branch) on Haixiu East Road for tea. He ordered hot tea, peanuts, and turnip cake. With the sound of rain pattering outside the window, he confided in his master his wish to take the senior technician exam. His master affirmed his skills, encouraged him to take on the theoretical challenge, and said he was "most like him in his younger days," which greatly inspired him.
location: 4th Floor, Haixiu East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Zhengfanghua Laoba Tea (Mingzhu Branch)

name: Return to the company
description: Said goodbye to his mentor at the tea shop entrance as the rain gradually stopped. He cycled back to the company, feeling encouraged and driven all the way.
location: From Zhengfanghua Laobai Tea (Mingzhu Branch) to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the company, he ordered a serving of spicy soup rice for lunch and felt warm all over. After the meal, he took a walk near the company to aid digestion and organized his thoughts for the afternoon's work.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, ground floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road

name: Afternoon work and payroll check
description: In the afternoon, organized the morning's maintenance records into a detailed log, noting the causes of faults and handling methods, and counted and wiped down the tool kit. Then received a bank text message that April's basic salary plus overtime allowance, 4,200 yuan in total, had arrived, and carefully checked the amount. Afterwards, helped Chen Jianguo proofread the maintenance report, and discussed with shift leader Zhang the preparatory work for tomorrow's emergency repair task, deciding on the cable models needed.
location: Company office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Bought groceries on the way home from work.
description: After clocking out, he cycled home. On the way, he stopped at the Cailanzi Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Branch) near the neighborhood and bought a fresh tilapia and two bunches of water spinach.
location: No. 10, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store)

name: Return home.
description: After a six-minute walk home from the supermarket, his wife Wang Lijuan was already cooking.
location: At home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family evening time.
description: Gave the fish and vegetables he had bought to his wife, then took out the family ledger and neatly recorded the 4200 yuan that had arrived in the income column. During dinner, he planned the rigid expenses with his wife: they set aside money for car insurance, annual inspection, and the son's running shoes, leaving a few hundred yuan. The family finances were arranged properly. After dinner, he played with blocks with his younger son and checked the older son's math homework, patiently explaining two word problems until he understood them.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, living room and study at home

name: Organize the study corner and formulate a review plan.
description: After the children rested, he cleaned up the corner of the study where clutter had piled up, wiped the desk clean, and neatly arranged the textbooks and exercise books bought the day before yesterday. On a new notebook, he worked backward to create a preview plan from now until the intensive training: focus on the basic theory of the first two chapters of the textbook, study at least one and a half hours a day, and post the plan on the wall so the study path is clear.
location: Home study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: Before going to bed, he did Cat-Cow and Child's Pose yoga stretches on the floor, holding each pose for 30 seconds, to relax his tired lower back. Afterward, he washed up briefly and went to bed at 22:00. Reviewing the day's experiences—troubleshooting a difficult fault, receiving encouragement from his mentor, receiving his salary, planning family finances, and setting up a study corner—everything was looking up, and he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; at home, beside the living room sofa and in the bedroom

name: Early morning waist and back core training
description: At 6:30 in the morning, it was already bright outside the window. The sky was cloudy turning clear, the temperature 28-33°C, and a humid sea breeze seeped through the window screen into the bedroom. I (Lu Mingqiang) got up on time, spread the yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and started core training: superman exercise, 3 sets of 20 reps; glute bridges, 3 sets of 25 reps; planks, 3 sets holding for 80 seconds each. I strove to keep the movements standard, to set an example of determination for my eldest son, who was competing today, and to consolidate the condition of my lower back. After about half an hour of training, I was slightly sweaty and felt my body surging with vitality.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Wake everyone up, wash up, and get dressed
description: After training, I took a quick shower and changed into the dark blue polo shirt I had specially prepared. At 7 o'clock sharp, I went to wake up my two sons. My elder son Lu Zixuan was going to compete in the 400-meter race at the city primary school track and field meet today. He was excited and nervous, lying in bed staring at the ceiling. I patted him on the shoulder and encouraged him, “Relax, today you are the star!” Then I helped my 5-year-old younger son Lu Zihan get dressed. My wife Wang Lijuan was organizing sun hats and water bottles in the kitchen. The family quickly washed up, and the living room was filled with the atmosphere of anticipation before the competition.
location: Home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast (Hainan rice noodles)
description: Considering that it's best not to eat too much before the competition, I took the whole family downstairs to the old shop at the community gate, 'Yamei Hainan Noodles'. For my eldest son Xuanxuan, I ordered a small bowl of dry-mixed Hainan noodles and specifically told them to go easy on the chili; for Hanhan, I ordered clear soup noodles without garlic oil; I finished a big bowl in a few quick bites. My wife Juanzi also ate a little. During the meal, I reminded Juanzi to bring sunscreen and a parasol—the sun was fierce today. The family had a simple, warm breakfast and stored up energy for the upcoming competition.
location: Yamei Hainan Rice Noodles store at the entrance of Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drove to Haikou Sports Center
description: After breakfast, our family of four walked to the parking lot, and I drove the silver-gray Wuling Hongguang. Xuanxuan sat behind the passenger seat, fiddling with his race bib over and over, looking both nervous and excited; Hanhan played a clapping game with Mom in the back seat. Seeing Xuanxuan's tightly pressed lips in the rearview mirror, I deliberately teased him: "Hey, our little 'flyer' is going to finish in what place today?" He shot back: "Anyway, I'm going to win a medal!" The car immediately filled with laughter. We drove along Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue, traffic was normal along the way, and we arrived smoothly at Haikou Sports Center in about 25 minutes.
location: Along the route from Banshan Garden, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Sports Center, Changbin Road, Xiuying District (mainly via Binhai Avenue)

name: Accompany the eldest son to the 400-meter race at the municipal primary school track and field meet.
description: At 8:35 AM, he arrived at the sports center. The place was packed, and flags of various schools fluttered. They went to the assembly area of Longfeng Experimental Primary School. I helped Xuanxuan check in and took him through warm-ups. Before the starting gun, I knelt on one knee and tightened his shoelaces again, reassuring him in a tone only father and son understood: "Run relaxed, just like when Dad takes you running on weekends. Stay calm, and after the race I'll take you to eat barbecue!" Xuanxuan nodded firmly and walked to Lane 3 full of fighting spirit. As soon as the gun went off, Juanzi and I squeezed into the stands and watched nervously. In the first 200 meters, Xuanxuan was in the middle of the pack. On the straight he began to accelerate, and on the curve he overtook! In the final 100 meters, I wildly waved my fists and shouted until my voice went hoarse: "Kid! Go!" In the end, he crossed the finish line in third place with a time of 1 minute 12 seconds and won the bronze medal! I excitedly high-fived my wife and recorded the whole process of him receiving his medal on my phone. Hundreds of teachers, students, and parents witnessed this glorious moment.
location: Track and Field Stadium of Haikou Sports Center, Changbin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to the restaurant and rested briefly
description: After the competition, Xuanxuan was panting with a shiny bronze medal around his neck and excitement all over his face. We returned to the parking lot and drove along Binhai Avenue to Friendship Sunshine City in the Guomao business district. On the way, he recounted the details of the competition over and over, and Hanhan chimed in. I played Beyond's No More Hesitation, and the atmosphere in the car was relaxed and cheerful. After reaching the underground parking lot of Friendship Sunshine City, it took about ten minutes to wait for the elevator up to the mall due to the large weekend crowd.
location: Underground parking lot and shopping mall of Friendship Sunshine City, Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Family dinner to celebrate
description: To celebrate Xuanxuan winning the bronze medal, we came to 'Little Piggy Korean BBQ Restaurant' on the 6th floor of Friendship Sunshine City, a restaurant Xuanxuan had been talking about for a long time. The place was almost full of family customers and very lively. I let Xuanxuan order the food, and he was overjoyed. Hanhan was especially fond of the self-serve soft-serve ice cream machine and dragged Mom to get some several times. I sat next to Xuanxuan, helping him grill the meat while listening to him share his competition experience. He said that when he was most exhausted, he remembered the 'inhale through the nose, exhale through the mouth' breathing technique I taught him at Wanlv Garden, and that was what kept him going. I touched his head approvingly and told him that the fighting spirit was more precious than a gold medal. The whole family ate heartily and left completely satisfied, spending about 260 yuan.
location: “Little Piggy Korean BBQ Restaurant”, 6F, Youyi Sunshine City, Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying sports equipment for the eldest son
description: After dinner, I noticed that the soles of Xuanxuan's old running shoes had worn smooth, so I said to my wife, “I'll take him to buy a pair of shoes. You take Hanhan downstairs for a stroll.” Then Xuanxuan and I headed straight to Decathlon at Yixin Commercial Plaza, near the mall. In the sports shoe section, I picked out a pair of professional youth running shoes on sale for 299 yuan, and also chose a breathable short-sleeve shirt and shorts set for 101 yuan. The checkout came to exactly 400 yuan. I took out my wallet and paid without hesitation. Xuanxuan put on the new shoes and carefully walked a few laps around the store, so reluctant to take them off that I felt the money was especially well spent. My wife took Hanhan for a walk downstairs, and we met up in the underground parking lot.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao West Road, Yixin Commercial Plaza, Decathlon (Jinlong Store)

name: Took wife and children home and had a short rest
description: After shopping, our family met up in the parking lot. Xuanxuan couldn't wait to show his mother and younger brother his new running shoes, his excitement written all over his face. On the drive home, the children, who had been excited all morning, gradually quieted down in the back seat, and Hanhan fell asleep leaning against her mother. After arriving home, I carefully placed Xuanxuan's medal in a prominent spot on the shoe cabinet and let the two children go back to their rooms to rest. I changed into comfortable loungewear and rested with my eyes closed on the sofa for 20 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon.
location: Home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went to Cailanzi Supermarket to buy ingredients.
description: After a short rest, I picked up a reusable bag and walked five minutes to the Vegetable Basket community supermarket at the side gate of the residential complex. Tonight I planned to make a light congee with dried scallops and choy sum. I carefully picked a bunch of fresh choy sum, two carrots, a small handful of dried scallops, and two salted duck eggs, for a total of 16 yuan. At the checkout, thinking of Xuanxuan's hard work on the track that morning, I still felt warm inside and walked with a light step.
location: Vegetable Basket Community Supermarket in Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Dinner, family time, and initial budget discussion
description: When I got home, my wife Juanzi was already in the kitchen preparing dinner. I washed the vegetables and briefly reported today's expenses to her. While chopping vegetables, she teased, "I knew you would buy him shoes. The extra can come out of my share—I won't buy a skirt this month." I also smiled and replied, "Then I won't get that bottle of aged liquor next month either." We smiled at each other, reaching an unspoken understanding. Dinner was the conpoy and choy sum congee with salted duck egg that Xuanxuan had specifically requested—light and delicious. After dinner, Xuanxuan took the initiative to start his homework, while Hanhan took out the newly bought dinosaur puzzle and dragged me to work on it together. Father and son lay on the floor, comparing pieces one by one, and the room was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helping eldest son with homework, parent-child reading, and previewing lessons
description: After finishing the jigsaw puzzle, at about 8 p.m., I took Xuanxuan to the study to check his math homework. I found that his approach to one word problem had taken a roundabout path, so I patiently drew diagrams on paper and explained until he suddenly understood. After helping with homework, I also read two picture books with Hanhan — The Very Hungry Caterpillar and Guess How Much I Love You. The children finished washing up, and it was almost 9 p.m. I took a short rest and previewed the textbook Advanced Maintenance Electrician - Electrical Control and PLC, which I would need for the upcoming vocational training.
location: Home study, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening stretching and relaxation, and getting the children to bed.
description: After finishing the preview, feeling a bit sore and swollen in my legs from standing all day, I spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of stretching and leg massage, focusing on relaxing the thigh and calf muscles. My wife was busy organizing the children's schoolbags for the next day. Then, Juanzi and I together settled the two sons to sleep—Xuanxuan had his new running shoes and bronze medal beside his pillow, with a satisfied smile on his face; Hanhan also fell asleep quickly, hugging a dinosaur plush.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discuss today's expenses and budget adjustment plan in detail with wife.
description: After the children fell asleep, Juanzi and I sat down on the living room sofa and formally took stock of today's extra expenses: the dinner gathering was 260 yuan, sports gear was 400 yuan, and the supermarket was 16 yuan, for a total of 676 yuan. Juanzi voluntarily offered to give up the dress she had previously had her eye on, and I decided not to buy the old liquor bottle I had planned to get next month, so the two of us shared this unplanned expense together. There was no argument, only mutual consideration and understanding, and this rapport made our relationship stronger. The discussion ended in a relaxed atmosphere, and the budget plan was successfully finalized.
location: Living room at home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal leisure time (browsing phone, preparing items for tomorrow)
description: After the budget discussion, I leaned back on the sofa and relaxed by browsing my phone, scrolling through posts with good-condition bottles on the baijiu bottle collection forum. Then I set the alarm for tomorrow (Saturday) — I planned to take the whole family to Evergreen Park to fly kites in the morning. I also carefully reviewed the video of Xuanxuan receiving the award on my phone. Watching the scene of my son wearing the bronze medal, I felt full of pride and happiness.
location: Living room and study at home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: It was already 11 p.m. I finished washing up, turned off the light, and lay down. Looking back on this perfect day: my son's medal, my wife's understanding, and the tacit resolution of the family budget—everything was satisfying. With this sense of fulfillment and joy, I soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 15, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Early morning core workout.
description: Woke up at 7 a.m. sharp, washed my face with cold water to refresh, then laid out the yoga mat in the living room for core training. Completed 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 80-second planks. After training, I wiped off sweat and drank water, felt a pump in my muscles, and was full of energy.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Weekend family breakfast.
description: After showering, he had breakfast with his family. His wife had prepared lean pork congee, BBQ pork buns, and egg custard buns. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son how he felt about yesterday's game and reminded him to look after his younger brother and finish his homework in the afternoon. His younger son kept pestering to go play ball, but his wife talked him out of it.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Listened to a program on the history of the liquor factory and conducted online research.
description: In the study, he used the Ximalaya app to listen to The Rise and Fall of Hainan Distilleries, learning about the rise and fall of Haikou Distillery and others. After finishing, he was still eager for more, so he searched on his computer for the packaging evolution history of old brands such as "Haikou Daqu" and "Yedao Deer-Turtle Wine". He found a featured post on a bottle collecting forum and saved screenshots to his phone.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organize digital notes for the wine bottle collection.
description: On the computer's D drive, under the Materials Collection folder, he created a subfolder called Hainan Distillery Rise and Fall Materials 2025 and organized the found images and articles by brand and era. He confirmed that the blue-and-white porcelain wine bottle in his collection was a 1990s commemorative edition for the establishment of Hainan Province, and recorded the new discovery in his electronic notebook, noting the bottle's characteristics and historical background.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: His wife Juanzi prepared stir-fried choy sum and congee with dried scallops and choy sum for lunch. Lu Mingqiang only ate until 70–80% full to maintain his competition form. After the meal, he leaned on the sofa and checked his phone, dealing with the squash group's match grouping information, and replied, "I'll arrive on time in the afternoon."
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and preparing squash gear
description: Changed into squash clothes and sneakers, packed a spare jersey, towel, racket, and water bottle into the sports bag, and put on wrist guards. Before leaving, went to the balcony to check the weather. Since a sun shower was forecast, took a folding umbrella from the shoe cabinet and put it into the bag.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Heading to the squash court.
description: Rode an electric bike from Banshan Garden, turned onto Binhai Avenue along Jinmao Middle Road, and arrived at the entrance of Evergreen Park after about 10 minutes. Parked at the designated spot, then walked into the squash hall inside the park.
location: On the way from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue

name: Internal squash match and asking for backhand training advice
