description: After arriving at the gym, did 15 minutes of dynamic stretching and shuttle runs to warm up. The internal knockout tournament started at 2 p.m. After winning three straight matches, he was stopped in the quarterfinals by old rival A Qiang, who kept pressing his backhand position, and finally lost 0-2. After the match, he asked Lin Feng for advice on his backhand. Lin Feng played back the video on his phone and pointed out that his body rotation was insufficient and his hitting point was too far away. He designed a 'three-step' breakdown training plan and agreed to practice an extra half hour every Wednesday after squash day. He also taught two exercises to strengthen the forearm muscles to prevent injuries. Lu Mingqiang recorded the key points on his phone.
location: Squash court in Evergreen Park, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying dinner ingredients
description: Remembering that his wife wanted steamed fish, he rode his electric bike and stopped by the Cailanzi Market on Guomao Sanheng Road. He picked a live sea bass and asked the vendor to clean it, then bought scallions and ginger, spending less than 30 yuan in total.
location: Haikou Vegetable Basket Market (Guomao Branch), Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Shower and prepare dinner with his wife
description: After getting home, he first put the fish in the kitchen, then took a shower and changed into loungewear. In the kitchen, he marinated the sea bass with cooking wine and ginger slices, washed the greens, and boiled water, while Juanzi helped peel garlic beside him. As they chatted, Lu Mingqiang told his wife that he had lost the match but found someone to coach him on his backhand, and his tone was full of drive.
location: Kitchen and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and family movie night
description: Enjoyed a dinner of steamed sea bass, blanched choy sum, and fried egg soup. During the meal, he asked about the eldest son's homework and learned that math was finished, leaving only the composition. After dinner, the family of four watched the animated movie Coco in the living room. Lu Mingqiang watched with his younger son, hummed the theme song, and felt relaxed.
location: Dining room and living room at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Call to schedule the vehicle's annual inspection
description: After the movie, he found that the vehicle license monthly inspection had expired. He called Haikou Anjie Vehicle Inspection Station and made an appointment for 10 a.m. the next day, and was told to bring the vehicle license, compulsory traffic insurance policy, and owner's ID card, and ensure the vehicle was in normal condition. After hanging up, he set a reminder in his phone calendar for the next morning, went downstairs to walk around the car and check it, and after confirming there were no problems, went upstairs reassured.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child reading and homework tutoring
description: First he went to the younger son's room and read the picture books 'Little Bear Doesn't Brush His Teeth' and 'Dinosaur Continent.' Hanhan listened intently and asked questions. After coaxing the younger son to sleep, he went to the older son's room to check his math homework, pointed out a calculation error, and patiently explained the technique of addition with carrying until everything was corrected.
location: Home study and second bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep yoga stretching
description: On the master bedroom floor, I did 15 minutes of yoga stretching, focusing on Cat-Cow and Child's Pose to relax my back, and did forward stretches and leg extensions to relieve the tension in the leg muscles after the afternoon squash. After stretching, I turned off the lights and went to bed, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Early morning core workout.
description: Spread a yoga mat on the living room balcony at home and did core strength training, including superman exercises, glute bridges, and planks. After about forty minutes of exercise and working up a good sweat, he felt his lower back and core were stable and his spirits were high.
location: Living room balcony, home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wash up, wake the family, and prepare breakfast.
description: After taking a shower, he changed into clean loungewear, went to the bedroom to wake up his wife Wang Lijuan and the two sons, and told them about the plan to go to Evergreen Park in the afternoon to fly kites. Then he went to the kitchen to heat milk, fry eggs, and toast bread, and had a simple meal with his family.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast downstairs and pre-departure checks
description: He went to the community breakfast shop, ordered a portion of Hainan rice noodles and soy milk to go, and ate quickly. After returning home, he carefully checked the vehicle registration, ID card, and electronic insurance policy, grabbed the car keys, told his family, and went downstairs to get ready to leave.
location: In the Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and at home

name: Drive to the inspection station and complete the annual vehicle inspection
description: Drove alone along Binhai Avenue, turned onto Haisheng Road, and arrived at Haikou Anyuda Motor Vehicle Testing Co., Ltd. in about 20-plus minutes. After verifying the appointment information with the staff, handed over the car keys and documents. Waited about 40 minutes in the waiting area. The vehicle passed all inspections smoothly. Paid a 300 yuan inspection fee and received the new annual inspection qualification mark.
location: Haikou Anyuda Motor Vehicle Testing Co., Ltd., No. 16 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Renew the insurance and check tire pressure and on-board tools.
description: In the car in the inspection station parking lot, renewed the compulsory traffic insurance and 500,000 third-party liability insurance via the mobile app, with a total cost of 1,850 yuan. After payment, saved the electronic policy, set a recurring reminder for 2026, and affixed the new inspection sticker. Then drove to the adjacent Sinopec Xixiu Gas Station, used a portable air pump to inflate the right rear tire to the standard pressure, and checked the spare tire, jack, and warning triangle, confirming they were in good condition.
location: No. 16 to 18 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (Haikou Anyuda Inspection Station Parking Lot and Sinopec Xixiu Gas Station).

name: Drove back home
description: After finishing the vehicle matters, drove back to Banshan Garden along the same route, listening to radio music on the way, feeling relaxed.
location: No. 18 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Return home, rest, and check the kite.
description: After returning home, he went to the balcony, took out the improved swallow-shaped kite, carefully checked every bamboo joint to make sure it was not loose, confirmed the previous paint on the wings was intact, and rewound the string spool neatly, making full preparations for flying the kite in the afternoon.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch
description: His wife Wang Lijuan prepared boiled shrimp, stir-fried water spinach, Wenchang chicken, and tomato egg drop soup. The family of four sat together for lunch. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang announced that they would go to Evergreen Park to fly kites in the afternoon. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, was so excited that he ate an extra half bowl of rice. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the table.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and experiencing the thunder shower
description: Napped on the living room sofa for about half an hour. During the nap, a sun shower started outside the window, and the sound of rain helped me fall asleep. When I woke, the rain gradually stopped, sunlight reappeared, and the air was filled with the fresh smell of earth and grass, making it very pleasant.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the family to Evergreen Park to fly kites.
description: The family of four drove to Wanlv Garden Park. After the rain, the lawn was emerald green. Lu Mingqiang first successfully flew a swallow-shaped kite, then hand-by-hand taught his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to control the kite string. The child quickly got the hang of it and was very excited. His second son, Lu Zihan, chased butterflies on the grass, while his wife Wang Lijuan spread out a picnic mat and watched with a smile. The family enjoyed two and a half hours of outdoor time until the children said they were hungry, then they packed up and headed home.
location: The big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home to rest and have dinner together
description: After returning home, he took a shower, changed into dry clothes, and helped his wife pick vegetables to prepare dinner. During dinner, his eldest son Lu Zixuan excitedly described what it felt like to fly kites, and his second son Lu Zihan imitated a butterfly fluttering around. The dinner table was full of laughter and cheerful talk.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy a foot-soaking bucket and sleep aids
description: After dinner, I went downstairs alone. First, I went to Wangjiawang Supermarket in the community and picked a deep plastic foot-soaking bucket, then went to the neighboring Guang'antang Pharmacy and bought a 10ml bottle of lavender essential oil. After returning home, I also purchased a natural white noise and light music album on the music platform to prepare for evening relaxation.
location: Wangjiawang Supermarket and Guang'antang Pharmacy inside Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Parent-child time and personal preparation
description: He helped his eldest son Lu Zixuan finish the picture-writing exercise in the weekend homework, then read a picture book story to his younger son Lu Zihan. After settling the two children down, he went back to his room, put the Senior Technician Theory Textbook, notebook, and pen needed for the next day's intensive training into his backpack in advance, and placed it on the desk.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: He filled the newly purchased foot bath bucket with hot water and added a few drops of lavender essential oil. While soaking his feet, he played soft music on the Bluetooth speaker with his eyes closed, relaxing and relieving the day's fatigue. After soaking his feet, he spread out a yoga mat and did pre-bed stretching, focusing on relaxing his legs and lower back. At about 20:30 he turned off the lights and went to bed, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6:05 in the morning and completed the daily core training on the straw mat in the living room: superman exercise, 3 sets of 20 reps; glute bridge, 3 sets of 25 reps; plank, 3 sets of 80 seconds. Then he went to the balcony to check the small vegetable garden, watered and loosened the soil for the lettuce, tomato seedlings, and pothos, and pinched off a few tender lettuce leaves. After taking a warm shower and changing into work clothes, he gently woke his wife Wang Lijuan and told her that the balcony lettuce was ready to pick. Then he went to the children's room, lifted his second son Lu Zihan up high to make him laugh, and patted his eldest son Lu Zixuan awake, reminding him to check the wrong questions on today's math test. The whole family sat around the dining table eating the pre-prepared plain congee, char siu bao, and fried eggs. While eating, Mingqiang told Xuanxuan to be careful on the exam, and specifically took out the fresh milk bought last night from the refrigerator to drink, determined to stay alert for the evening's study.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: School drop-off and morning commute
description: At 7:35, Lu Mingqiang set off on his electric bike with his two sons. He first took his younger son, Hanhan, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, and watched him run into the classroom. Then he rode along Longkun North Road and Haifu Road to take his elder son, Xuanxuan, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and made sure he joined the morning reading queue. After dropping off the children, he continued riding faster along Qiongzhou Avenue and Qiuha Avenue, arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, at about 7:55.
location: On the commute from Banshan Garden, passing Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: Morning distribution cabinet commissioning work
description: After the morning briefing, Lu Mingqiang and his partner Chen Jianguo carried out pre-energization checks and parameter calibration on two new distribution cabinets at a commercial plaza on Guoxing Avenue in the maintenance workshop. They checked the wiring against the drawings and measured resistance at key nodes with a multimeter, working in close coordination. Midway, they sent the apprentice Zhao Qiang to the storeroom for insulating tape, while Lu Mingqiang took milk from his bag and drank it with warm water. Chen Jianguo teased him about turning health-conscious, and Mingqiang explained that he had something important in the evening and was afraid tea would keep him awake.
location: Repair Workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo walked to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant at the ground-floor shops of Xianghe Jiayuan on Haisheng Road near the company. Mingqiang ordered roast duck rice, and Jianguo had the usual spicy soup rice. As they ate, Jianguo complained that his son did poorly in the midterm exam, and Mingqiang shared the experience of having Xuanxuan organize a mistake notebook. They also talked about the company's 'Technical Expert' selection; Jianguo encouraged him to sign up. Mingqiang said he would see, but in his heart he became more determined about getting certified at the end of the year.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunchtime brisk-walking ritual
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang completed what was probably his last lunch-break brisk walk before the intensive training, alone in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. He deliberately avoided the main road and walked along the internal wall and new green belt for thirty minutes, at a pace slightly faster than usual, maintaining 9 minutes per kilometer. He noticed the newly planted bougainvillea and power distribution boxes by the roadside, silently said goodbye to the habit he had kept for half a year, and walked with a firm, ritual-like stride.
location: Internal road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrapping up the afternoon's work at a faster pace
description: Back in the workshop in the afternoon, the morning's debugging data needed a parameter fine-tuned. Lu Mingqiang proactively picked up the pace and arranged for Zhao Qiang to handle basic tasks such as putting tools away. When drowsiness hit at 3 o'clock, he instinctively reached for his tea, but remembering last night's insomnia, he ended up just drinking some warm water. Around 4:30, all work was done. He reported the progress to Team Leader Zhang and explained that he needed to leave early for his evening study plan; the team leader nodded in agreement.
location: Maintenance workshop and surrounding construction site, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and preparation before class
description: At 4:30, Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools, teaching materials, and notebook, left work early, and rode his electric bike straight to the area near Haikou Electrical School in Qiongshan District. At a Ding'an bone soup fast-food restaurant, he quickly finished a bowl of trotter rice, silently reviewing the first chapter of Fundamentals of Circuits he had previewed the night before, warming up for the evening class.
location: Ding'an Bone Soup Fast Food Restaurant near Qiongzhou Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Self-directed review before the exam.
description: Lu Mingqiang entered Room 301 of the training building at Haikou Electric Power School early; seven or eight trainees were already seated. He chose a seat in the front with a good view, opened his textbook and notebook, and quickly reviewed the “Steady-State Analysis of Power Systems” section, jotting down a few unfamiliar keywords in the margin, planning to ask the teacher in class. He took a deep breath to settle himself and resolved to study steadily.
location: Classroom 301, Practical Training Building, Haikou Electric Power School, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: First lesson of the Senior Technician exam preparation course
description: At seven in the evening, Wang Weiguo, a retired senior engineer, began the lecture, emphasizing that the training was intense and fast-paced, laying the foundation for the year-end exam. The course was information-dense, covering power system models and mathematical formulas. Mingqiang, used to hands-on work, found it difficult to follow the theory, but he took notes in familiar language and with simple sketches, drawing the topological structure as a circuit diagram and comparing differential equations to water flow. During the break, he proactively asked about two formula derivations he did not understand. After class, he completed a mock test paper and exchanged contact information with the student next to him, agreeing to consult each other.
location: Classroom 301, Practical Training Building, Haikou Electric Power School, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home at night
description: After the class bell rang, Lu Mingqiang packed up his books and rode his e-bike home. The night breeze in Haikou was damp and cool. Along the way, he kept recalling the steady-state model the teacher had explained; his mind was excited but overloaded. About thirty minutes later, he arrived at Banshan Garden.
location: On the commute from Haikou Electric Power School to Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Night relaxation, review, and going to bed
description: After slipping in quietly, he saw the warm milk and encouraging note his wife Wang Lijuan had left on the dining table, and felt a warmth in his heart. After confirming that his wife and children were fast asleep, he filled his new foot-soaking bucket with hot water, added a few drops of lavender essential oil, put on earphones, and soaked his feet for fifteen minutes while listening to soft music, letting his tense nerves fully relax. After soaking his feet, he sat at his desk and quickly reviewed the evening's course, marking with a highlighter two concepts he did not understand in “Power System Analysis,” then wrote out the next day's preview plan (reviewing the basics of high school derivatives) and set a reminder in his phone's memo app. Finally, he turned off the light and lay down at 11:10. Though his body was tired, he felt fulfilled, and soon fell asleep amid the even breathing of his family.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training, balcony gardening, and breakfast preparation
description: After getting up at 6:10 in the morning, he did core training in the living room, including superman exercises (3 sets of 20 reps), glute bridges (3 sets of 25 reps), and planks (3 sets of 80 seconds). After training, he went to the balcony to check on the lettuce, picked fresh lettuce, and watered the tomato seedlings. Then he took a quick shower, changed into work clothes, and prepared breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan, handing her the picked lettuce to make a salad. He also checked his toolbox and readied his raincoat.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten.
description: Rode the electric bike carrying my younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. On the way, I told him to behave and eat well at school. After arriving, I watched him enter the kindergarten safely before leaving.
location: Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten)

name: Morning commute to work and equipment replacement and maintenance
description: Rode an e-bike from the kindergarten to the company along Haixiu Road and Haisheng Road. After attending the morning meeting, he went with his colleagues Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to an old factory building near Jinxing Road in Xiuying District to replace old-fashioned air switches for a client. During the operation, he strictly followed the de-energizing, voltage-testing, and ground-wire installation process, and patiently guided Zhao Qiang in identifying the routing and wiring methods of the old lines, emphasizing key safety points.
location: No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the customer's factory on Jinxing Road, Xiuying District

name: Called mother to teach her joint stretching exercises.
description: After returning to the company, he called his mother Chen Xiuying in the corner of the break room, asked about her knees, and reminded her to apply the medicated patch. He then carefully taught her the newly learned joint stretching methods, including heat compresses, opening and closing the fingers, and wrist rotations, and later forwarded the stretch diagram to her.
location: Company rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had lunch with fellow workers.
description: At noon, I walked with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant we often go to, and each ordered a meal. During the meal, we talked about the problem of feeling sleepy when studying, and I encouraged Zhao Qiang to spend more time after class thinking about wiring techniques.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and nutrition plan
description: After lunch, returned to the company rest room and took a 20-minute nap on the desk. After waking up, he jotted down a family note on his phone, planning to go to the supermarket after work to buy healthy ingredients: chicken breast, eggs, broccoli, and milk, to restore his energy.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon equipment emergency repair wrap-up and team summary
description: Led the team to complete the wrap-up of the morning's air switch replacement work and tested all circuits. Team Leader Zhang was satisfied after an on-site inspection. Back in the team, he filled in the work log and noted the points to watch in Zhao Qiang's operation, ready to bring them up the next day.
location: No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the customer's factory on Jinxing Road, Xiuying District

name: Supermarket shopping and family dinner
description: After work, he rode his electric bike to Wanghao Supermarket on Jinlong Road. In the fresh food section, he carefully selected chicken breast, free-range eggs, fresh milk, broccoli, and tomatoes as ingredients to supplement his physical strength. After shopping, he rode home and put the ingredients in the refrigerator. He had dinner with his wife Wang Lijuan, his elder son Lu Zixuan, and his younger son Lu Zihan, and took the time to ask Xuanxuan about school.
location: Wanghao Supermarket (Sunshine Store), No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Braved the rain to go to the electrical school for a tutoring class and returned late at night.
description: The sky suddenly darkened and heavy rain began. His wife urged him to stay out of concern, but determined not to miss the explanation of the PLC control technology practical assessment process, he resolutely put on a raincoat, wrapped his books in plastic bags, wore the backpack underneath the raincoat, put on a helmet, and rode his electric bike to Haikou Senior Technical School. By the time he arrived, his pant legs were wet but the books were dry, and he listened and took notes attentively throughout. During the break, he exchanged smiles with fellow trainees who were also soaked. After class, the rain had eased; he put on the raincoat again and rode home. The road was chilly and quiet, and when he got back to the residential compound, the raincoat was dripping.
location: Haikou Senior Technical School, No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the round-trip route

name: Before-bed stretching, foot soaking, and falling asleep
description: After returning home, the family had already gone to bed, so he washed up quietly. He did Cat-Cow and Child's Pose yoga to relieve lower back fatigue, then soaked his feet in lavender essential oil to relax his tense nerves. After soaking his feet, he lay in bed recalling the fulfilling day, confirmed the alarm, and fell asleep with a sense of peace.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning core workout and stretching.
description: He got up quickly after the alarm rang and spread out the yoga mat in the living room. As planned, he completed 3 sets of superman exercises (20 reps each), 3 sets of glute bridges (25 reps each), and 3 sets of planks (75 seconds each), 25 minutes in total. To avoid waking the family, he moved as gently as possible. After finishing, he did a few cat-cow poses to relax his spine and felt the soreness in his lower back ease considerably.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and tidying the balcony.
description: He took a quick shower and changed into clean work clothes. He went to the balcony to check the flowerpots where he had picked lettuce yesterday, saw they were growing well, and watered them. He also checked the scallions his wife Juanzi had planted and removed two yellow leaves while he was at it.
location: Home bathroom and balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake up the children and take them to school
description: First he went to his younger son Hanhan's room, gently woke him up, and helped him put on his kindergarten uniform. His older son Xuanxuan had already washed up and dressed himself. After eating the simple breakfast (bread and milk) that Juanzi had prepared, the three of them left together at exactly 7 o'clock. Riding the electric bike, he first took Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At the Xiangzhi Department Store and Grocery Store at the gate, he bought each of his two sons a box of their favorite yogurt and cookies as a snack for recess. Then he turned around and took Xuanxuan to the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School before 7:20.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting by electric bike
description: After leaving the school, I rode west along Haixiu Middle Road all the way to Haisheng Road. The weather was cloudy with no sun, so cycling was quite pleasant. On the way, I ran into a few coworkers from the company and greeted them. Arrived at the company at 7:35, parked the electric bike, went to the changing room, put on the work uniform, and wore a safety helmet.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Listen to the task assignments at the morning meeting.
description: Team leader Zhang presided over the morning meeting, focusing on the details of today's task to complete the rectification work on the old factory building wiring on Jinxing Road, and required that acceptance be completed before 4 p.m. He also reminded everyone that the weather was getting hot and to be careful of heatstroke. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang checked the tools and materials.
location: Team meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning: wrapping up the factory wiring renovation.
description: The group of three drove to an old factory site on Jinxing Road. Today's task was to complete the wiring, sealing, and power-on testing of the last few distribution boxes. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of leading the circuit verification, Chen Jianguo was responsible for wiring, and Zhao Qiang assisted and took notes. The work pace was intense, with a 10-minute break in the middle. At around 10:30, they successfully completed the rectification of all circuits and the first power-on was successful, with equipment running normally.
location: Old factory building near the intersection of Jinxing Road and Jinpan Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Lunch and phone call with mother
description: The morning's work wrapped up early, and he was in a good mood. He rode his electric bike with Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Restaurant for lunch and ordered a spicy soup rice with an egg. While eating, he called his mom (Chen Xiuying) to ask if her leg pain had improved. It was overcast today, so he reminded her to remember to apply a warm compress. His mom said she had been applying warm compresses the way he taught her for a few days and felt much better, and told him not to worry. After hanging up, a notice came through in the company group chat on his phone: in the afternoon he needed to go to the new factory building on the south side of Haisheng Road for an embedded pipeline inspection.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and listening to audio
description: After dinner, instead of going back to the company, he rode his e-bike directly back to the construction site. In the rest shed, he took out his phone, plugged in earphones, and opened Ximalaya to listen to a story from "Industrial Memory" about veteran electricians tackling problems in the 1970s and 1980s. He was completely absorbed, especially because some of the troubleshooting ideas mentioned in it matched the morning's work, and it made him forget the fatigue of a day's work. He listened for about 20 minutes, then leaned back in the folding chair and dozed for 20 minutes.
location: Temporary rest shed at the construction site near the intersection of Jinxing Road and Jinpan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon inspection of embedded pipes in the new plant
description: The afternoon work was relatively light, mainly coordinating with the civil construction team to check whether the embedded cable conduits were in line with the drawings and specifications. Lu Mingqiang, together with Zhao Qiang, checked section by section using the drawings and a tape measure. They found that three conduit bends had too small a radius and had the construction crew correct them on the spot. At 4:30 pm, all the inspection work was done, so they wrapped up and cleaned the tools. Since he had to rush to an event in the evening, Lu Mingqiang said hello to Team Leader Zhang and rode back from the site 15 minutes early.
location: Newly built factory building on the south side of Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Heading to the squash hall and warming up
description: From the new factory building, he rode an e-bike to the squash club; it was not far, and he arrived in about 20 minutes. After reaching the club, he went to the locker room first to change into sports T-shirt and shorts, and stretched his shoulders and wrists in advance.
location: Qiuqiu Dongli Billiards Club (Squash Hall), Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Squash backhand intensive training
description: Lin Feng had already arrived. After briefly exchanging pleasantries, the two began today's special training session. Lin Feng focused on correcting his problems of taking the racket back too late on the backhand and hitting the ball at too low a contact point. Through repeated half-court targeted feeds, he helped him feel how to generate power by turning his body. After an intense hour, his clothes were completely soaked, but he felt that the power and stability of his backhand had clearly improved.
location: Qiuqiu Dongli Billiards Club (Squash Hall), Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Having a meal on the way to the electrical school.
description: After leaving the gym, he bought a steamer basket of xiaolongbao and a bottle of mineral water by the roadside, and rode an electric bike to Haikou Senior Technical School while eating. The trip took about 15 minutes, and when he arrived at the school gate, he still had half a baozi left in his hand.
location: Hainan Technician College, No. 77 Dayuan Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Electrical school intensive training and after-class Q&A
description: He entered the classroom right at 18:45. Today's main topics were the conditions for parallel operation of transformers and hands-on wiring practice. The teacher spoke quickly, and Lu Mingqiang listened attentively, taking photos of the important parts with his phone. During the hands-on session, he took the initiative to operate once. His wiring was a bit unfamiliar, and the teacher corrected him on several points on the spot. After class, he went to the teacher with his notebook and clarified the two confusing points about circulating current control from the lesson. By the time he came out of the teaching building, it was already almost 9:50.
location: Training classroom, Hainan Technician College, No. 77 Dayuan Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Called his wife on the way home
description: Cycling out of the school, with the evening breeze on his face, he felt at ease. He called Juanzi and asked if she had gone to bed. Juanzi said the children were all asleep, told him to ride slowly, and said a bowl of porridge was still kept for him. The couple chatted about household matters for a while, then hung up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: At home, wash up, stretch, and soak feet.
description: Arrived home at 22:10. Juanzi was watching TV in the living room waiting for him, and there really was a bowl of warm preserved egg and lean pork porridge on the table. After finishing the porridge, he took a quick shower. Then he went back to the bedroom, rolled out the yoga mat, and did 10 minutes of Cat-Cow and Child's pose stretches to relieve the day's lower back soreness. Next, he soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes, feeling the fatigue of his whole body dissipate with the rising steam.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reviewed notes and rested.
description: Before going to bed, he sat on the bed and went through today's class notes from the electrical school, hand-drew a few simple diagrams of transformers in parallel to deepen his memory. Then he ran through tomorrow's work schedule in his mind. He put down his phone, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Early-morning core workout and body-signal observation
description: After being woken by the 6:05 alarm, Lu Mingqiang did his core three-piece workout in the living room (plank, glute bridge, and superman). During the last ten seconds of the plank, his core shook violently, but he clenched his teeth and held on until completion. After the workout, he carefully checked the condition of his knees and lower back, confirmed there was no soreness from yesterday, breathed a sigh of relief, and realized his body was gradually adapting to the high-intensity pace of the intensive training.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home living room)

name: Washing up, family interaction, and breakfast preparation
description: After washing up briefly, Lu Mingqiang quietly walked into the bedroom and woke his sleeping wife, Wang Lijuan. They briefly discussed the day's plans. He told her that his evening class would end late, so she didn't need to wait for him for dinner. Then he went to the kitchen to prepare breakfast: he ladled out the pre-set white porridge, fried eggs and ham sausages, and got breakfast ready for his two sons.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bathroom and kitchen at home)

name: Waking up the two sons and getting them settled.
description: Lu Mingqiang walked into the children's room, first woke up his older son Lu Zixuan, urged him to put on his school uniform and wash his face, then helped his sleepy younger son Lu Zihan get dressed and put on socks. While putting shoes on the children, he reminded Xuanxuan to arrive early for classroom duty and wear his red scarf.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Community (home children's room)

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Lu Mingqiang set off on his electric bike with his two sons. Along the way, he first dropped off his younger son Lu Zihan at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District. He bought him a bottle of yogurt at the grocery store at the gate and watched him walk into the kindergarten with his schoolbag. Then he turned around and took his elder son Lu Zixuan through several streets to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District. At the school gate, he told him to pay attention in class and drink plenty of water.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, via Jinmao Middle Road, Guomao Sanheng Road, Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Yinpo Road, Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School

name: Commute and morning meeting preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike about 20 minutes to arrive at Hainan Elevator Support Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. In the changing room, he changed into his washed-out dark blue work clothes, picked up his safety helmet and tools, and went to the team meeting room. He ran into the team leader distributing work orders. He learned that the morning task was to go to the dormitory of the power supply bureau on Longhua South Road to handle a reported main switch trip; Old Chen and Xiao Zhao were already preparing.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handle an electrical switch fault in a residential building.
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang drove to the Power Supply Bureau Dormitory at No. 34 Datong Road, Longhua District. After inspection, they confirmed that the aging main switch had caused overload tripping. Lu Mingqiang directed Zhao Qiang to pull down the main switch and hang a "Do Not Close" warning sign, while he and Chen Jianguo disassembled the old air switch. During the operation, he observed Zhao Qiang's technique and reminded him of the voltage testing steps. After the repair, they checked the residents' wiring one by one and reminded an auntie not to use high-power appliances at the same time to ensure safety.
location: Haikou Power Supply Bureau Dormitory (Building 3), No. 34 Datong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrap up work and prepare for lunch break
description: After finishing work early, the three of them packed up their tools. Instead of going straight back to the company cafeteria, Lu Mingqiang told his colleagues that he had been suffering from internal heat recently and needed light food, so he found an Awen Seafood Noodle Soup shop on Haisheng Road and planned to have lunch there alone.
location: Near Awen Seafood Noodle Soup Restaurant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and fragmented learning
description: Lu Mingqiang quickly finished a bowl of authentic Hainan rice noodle soup at Awen Seafood Noodle Soup Shop, adding a marinated egg. While waiting for his food, he took out his phone. Instead of scrolling through short videos, he opened screenshots of last night's electrical school courseware, reviewed the principles of transformer parallel connection, and silently recalled the key points of the cable termination process, preparing for the evening's hands-on class.
location: Awen Seafood Rice Noodle Soup Shop, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and call to mother
description: After returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang found a shady spot in a rest shed in the corner of the construction site and sat down using his safety helmet as a cushion. He called his mother Chen Xiuying to ask about her leg pain. Hearing her answer in a strong, vigorous voice that she was 'much better,' he felt relieved. After hanging up, he leaned against the wall and dozed for twenty minutes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Equipment Industrial Park (construction site rest shed), No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inspect the embedded pipes in the new factory building.
description: The first task in the afternoon was to go to an industrial building under construction on the south side of Haisheng Road to work with the civil construction team to inspect the cable conduits embedded in the concrete floor. Lu Mingqiang moved among the steel and concrete with a flashlight and tape measure, checking the diameter and position of each conduit and using the tape measure to verify the burial depth standard. He found three conduits slightly bent and deformed, marked them on the spot, and asked the civil works supervisor to sign for confirmation, demanding immediate rectification.
location: Newly built industrial plant on the south side of Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Assist Zhao Qiang in handling technical problems.
description: After dealing with the new factory building problem, Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang to a street-front shop at No. 97 Haisheng Road, not far away, to handle an electrical capacity expansion issue. Instead of doing it himself, he guided Zhao Qiang from the side in calculating the cable diameter based on the load and selecting matching cables and switches. When making the cable intermediate joint, he demonstrated the process with his own hands, emphasizing the key points of stripping, crimping, and insulation treatment. Zhao Qiang was slow, but every step was done to standard, earning Lu Mingqiang's approval.
location: A street-facing shop at No. 97 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Ending work, changing clothes, and preparing for the commute
description: After finishing work in the afternoon and returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang quickly showered, changed out of his sweaty work uniform into a clean T-shirt. He put the notebook and pen he would need in the evening into his bag, got on his e-bike, set the navigation destination to Haidian Island Campus of Haikou Senior Technical School, and chose the Haixiu Middle Road expressway to avoid the evening rush hour.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to the electrical school
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike via the Haixiu Expressway to the Haikou Senior Technical School on Haidian Island. Traffic was heavy during evening rush hour. He wore his helmet and maneuvered carefully, replaying the cable-making details he had taught Zhao Qiang during the day, feeling that his understanding of this area had become more solid.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, from No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, via Haixiu Expressway to Haikou Senior Technical School, Haidian Sanxi Road, Meilan District.

name: Arrive early at school to review and preview
description: When he arrived at school, there was nearly an hour before class. Lu Mingqiang did not go into the classroom; instead, he sat on a stone bench outside the school gate, took out his notebook, reviewed the notes on parallel transformers from last night, and marked key points in the cable termination fabrication chapter with a red pen. Midway, he got up and went to a small shop across the street to buy a bottle of mineral water to refresh himself.
location: Haikou Senior Technical School, Haidian Third West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (at the stone bench by the school gate).

name: Attend intensive training on cable termination and insulation testing
description: The intensive training class started on time. The teacher explained in detail the fabrication techniques for high-voltage cable terminal heads and intermediate joints, the use of insulation resistance testers, and safety regulations. After the theory, they moved to hands-on practice. Lu Mingqiang was the first to try. While stripping the semiconductive layer, he failed to control his grip and cut into the insulating layer underneath, ruining the first piece of material. He did not get discouraged. Under the teacher's guidance, he adjusted the blade and technique, and the second piece finally passed. He deeply realized the importance of practice.
location: Haikou Senior Technical School (Cable Practice Classroom), Haidian Sanxi Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After evening class, buy sugarcane on the way
description: After class, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike home, deliberately slowing down to watch for fruit stalls on the roadside. When he passed near the vegetable market on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, he saw several bundles of purple-skinned sugarcane in front of a stall, so he stopped, chose two long-jointed, good-looking stalks, asked the vendor to peel and cut them into pieces, and happily hung them on the handlebars.
location: Fruit stall near the vegetable market on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home late at night and interacting with his wife.
description: It was nearly 10:30 when he got home. His wife, Wang Lijuan, heard the door lock click and immediately came up to greet him, playfully scolding him for buying sugarcane. She brought out a bowl of warm coconut milk Qingbuliang from the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang felt a warmth in his heart. He ate the Qingbuliang eagerly, telling his wife about his embarrassing mishap with the wasted materials that evening. His wife smiled and comforted him.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home living room)

name: Washing up, stretching, and review.
description: After eating Qingbuliang, Lu Mingqiang washed up and soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue. While soaking his feet, he mentally reviewed the complete cable-making process from the training course and drew a simple step diagram in a newly bought notebook. Afterwards, he did a few minutes of leg stretching to prevent soreness the next day.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Banshan Garden Residential Area (home bathroom and bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang gently closed the bedroom door, glanced at his sleeping wife and children, and lay in bed reviewing the day's gains and losses: the work issue was resolved smoothly, and although the intensive training required rework, the final result was good. Thinking that after tomorrow's Friday evening training he could take the children to Wanlv Park to fly kites on the weekend, he turned off the light and fell asleep with a sense of reassurance.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area (home bedroom)

name: Morning wake-up and exercise.
description: The phone alarm rang. Master Lu got up and first went to the balcony to check the lettuce in the foam box, finding that the first crop of leaves was already green and mature and ready to pick. Then he left a message on WeChat to the owner of the time-honored Qingbuliang shop near his home to order a portion of qingbuliang. Afterward, he started core training on the living room mat, doing 4 sets of 12 reps each of 'little swallow' and 'glute bridge' exercises, with cat-cow stretches in between to ease his waist. After training, he wiped off sweat with a towel, took a quick shower, changed into the company's gray short-sleeved work uniform, checked his canvas tool bag to make sure the notebook, power bank, sun hat, and other items were packed, and also brought a bottle of water and tissues. Ready to go.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and taking the child to school
description: Master Lu entered the children's room, woke up his elder son Lu Zixuan, reminded him of the weekend kite-flying plan, then helped his younger son Lu Zihan put on his kindergarten uniform and tie his shoelaces. The family then had breakfast together; his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared rice porridge, fried eggs, and stir-fried vegetables. During the meal, he reminded Xuanxuan to bring his math workbook, and his wife reminded him to be careful on the way to class in the evening. At 7:20, Master Lu rode his electric bike to take Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten first, buying yogurt for Hanhan at a general store near the gate and watching him enter the school; then he took Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. After dropping off the children, he continued riding his electric bike to the company.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute and morning meeting at work.
description: Master Lu started from the school and rode along Haifu Road, Longkun South Road, and Haisheng Road for about 10 minutes to reach the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. After parking his e-bike in the shed, he entered the team break room, changed into protective work clothes and a safety helmet, and then attended the morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang presided over the morning meeting, noting that the weekend was approaching, and arranged that today's main task was to inspect the embedded conduit lines in the new factory building south of Haisheng Road and cooperate with the civil construction team on rectifications.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inspection of embedded pipelines in the new factory building
description: After the morning meeting, Master Lu, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang carried testing equipment and walked to the new industrial factory construction site on the south side of Haisheng Road. They inspected the cable trench one by one and found that three embedded pipes were not bent enough and one pipe opening was blocked by cement. The three divided the work: Master Lu heated and straightened the pipes with a pipe bender, Chen Jianguo cleared the blockage with a steel pry bar, and Zhao Qiang recorded the problem points. The work lasted until 10:30, and after confirming that all problems had been handled, the civil construction crew also withdrew from the area.
location: A construction site for a new industrial factory building on the south side of Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: It was hot. Lu and his colleagues went to the "Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant" near the construction site for lunch, ordering the signature spicy soup rice with fried egg and preserved sausage. While eating, they chatted; Chen Jianguo mentioned that his child's midterm exam results were not ideal, and Zhao Qiang shared amusing stories about his new girlfriend. After the meal, Lu called his mother Chen Xiuying, who was in his hometown, to ask about her leg pain. His mother said it had improved after hot compresses and told him not to worry. Then they took a lunch break in the temporary rest shed next to the construction site. Lu used a cardboard box sheet as a mat on the ground, leaned against the wall, and rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Handle customer repair requests in the afternoon.
description: Shortly after work resumed in the afternoon, Master Lu got an urgent call from Team Leader Zhang saying that the main distribution box in an office building in the Guomao area was making abnormal noises and needed immediate attention. He and Chen Jianguo took a multimeter and an insulation resistance meter and rode electric bikes to Haiya International Building, 24 Guomao Road, Longhua District. They spent 2 hours checking circuit by circuit and found that an unbalanced three-phase load had caused the neutral wire to overheat and become loose. They retightened the screws and adjusted the power load distribution in some offices, and the abnormal noise disappeared at once. After the fault was cleared, they returned to the company.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 24 Guomao Road, Haiya International Building

name: Return home from work
description: After handling the fault, Master Lu and Chen Jianguo returned to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park. Master Lu wiped the testing instruments clean, put them back in the tool cabinet, and recorded the day's two field service jobs and their results in the team work log. Then he changed into casual clothes, rode his e-bike out of the company, detoured to a fruit stall on Jinmao West Road to buy a few ripe mangoes, and returned home at Banshan Garden at 17:00.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Home gardening and repairs
description: After returning home, Master Lu first went to the balcony and carefully cut five of the largest lettuce leaves with scissors, then placed them in the kitchen sink. Wang Lijuan, who was preparing dinner, saw this and happily said she would make lettuce sandwiches for the children tomorrow. Next, Master Lu found a screwdriver, moved the old fan from the bedroom to the balcony, tightened the screws on the base and the motor head, oiled the oscillating gear, and powered it on—the test worked normally.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: His wife had prepared Hainanese chicken rice with freshly picked lettuce, and the whole family ate together. At the table, Master Lu asked Lu Zixuan about his weekend homework and learned that he needed to write an essay about spring. Lu Zihan excitedly shared his experience of making handmade flowers at kindergarten. Master Lu and Wang Lijuan discussed the weekend arrangement: tomorrow morning he would take the children to Wanlv Garden to fly kites; in the afternoon Wang Lijuan would take Hanhan to her parents' home, and he would accompany Xuanxuan to do homework.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to the electric school to attend class
description: After dinner, Master Lu cleared the table, changed into a clean polo shirt, and put a power bank, notebook, and pen into a canvas tote bag. He grabbed his car keys, said goodbye to the children who were watching cartoons, and drove to Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School. To avoid traffic, he took a detour along Guoxing Avenue, playing crosstalk on the way to relax. He arrived at the school at 18:50, parked on the roadside, went to the classroom on the third floor of the teaching building, signed in at the door by writing his name and unit, then entered the classroom, found a suitable seat, opened his notebook, and prepared for class.
location: Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Electrical school intensive training
description: The course started on time, with the theme “Relay Protection Principles and New Smart Grid Technologies.” The teacher explained overcurrent protection, distance protection, differential protection, and smart substation network architecture. Master Lu listened attentively. Although the mathematical derivation parts were difficult, he tried hard to write down the key formulas and concepts, filling five pages in his notebook. During the break, he asked the teacher about protection dead zones and received a patient answer.
location: Classroom, Teaching Building, Hainan Provincial Advanced Transportation Technician School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-class discussion and heading home
description: After class, Master Lu chatted in the hallway of the teaching building with two trainees from other power plants about the problems encountered in circuit retrofitting. They added each other on WeChat and agreed to discuss them later. He then drove away from the school and, on the way, stopped at the "Time-honored Qingbuliang" shop to pick up two portions of pre-ordered Qingbuliang before heading home. He arrived home at 22:10. His wife Wang Lijuan was still watching TV, and the children were already asleep. He put the Qingbuliang on the dining table, and his wife reminded him that the water had been boiled. He took a quick shower and changed into pajamas.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: Master Lu brewed some hot tea and soaked his feet in warm water. At the same time, he took out his class notes, added the details he had missed during the day, and thought about tomorrow's schedule: run at 7 a.m., then take Xuanxuan to fly a kite, and in the afternoon accompany Xuanxuan to do homework. Then he did a few waist twists and stretching exercises, and used his phone memo to note the items to bring tomorrow, such as a kite and a scooter. Finally, he walked into the bedroom, said to his wife, "The lettuce was truly delicious," turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning core workout and stretching.
description: Early Saturday morning, the alarm clock went off on time. Lu Mingqiang felt a little tired from the training camp, but the sun was shining brightly outside the window. He spread out his yoga mat on the bedroom floor and began his 25-minute routine core workout, including planks, glute bridges, and superman exercises. Although he moved a bit slower than usual, he completed all the movements with good form to wake up his body. The following 5-minute stretching focused on his hips, neck, and shoulders, relieving the stiffness from sitting through lectures for a long time and leaving his body feeling light again.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and today's plan
description: After the training session, Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower and had breakfast together with his wife Wang Lijuan, his eldest son Lu Zixuan, and his youngest son Lu Zihan. On the table were white porridge, fried eggs, stir-fried vegetables, and Hainan noodles. While eating, he checked today's schedule with Juanzi: in the morning he would help Xuanxuan review his lessons, in the afternoon he would take the lettuce to his parents' home, and Juanzi would take Hanhan to the supermarket to shop. The atmosphere was relaxed, and he also reminded Xuanxuan, who had just woken up, to get his weekend homework ready.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, home dining room

name: Post-meal rest and early preparation.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang helped clear the dishes. Then he went to the balcony, carefully looked at the lettuce in the planter. It was growing beautifully, green and lush, and he took a close-up photo with his phone. Considering that he needed to focus on accompanying his eldest son in the morning, he took out the small scissors and basket for afternoon harvest in advance and placed them in the corner of the balcony for later use.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, home balcony

name: In the study, tutored the eldest son as he reviewed his schoolwork.
description: Lu Mingqiang and his eldest son Lu Zixuan went into the study and began tutoring and review. He first checked the homework and found that Zixuan stumbled on the higher multiplication facts, so he explained it with the analogy of a parallel circuit. Xuanxuan quickly understood, and the father and son worked together to overcome the difficulty. Then he reviewed key Chinese passages with him and patiently corrected the wrong characters in his recitation. The whole morning was efficient and fulfilling.
location: Home study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon rest and self-directed study
description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang let Xuanxuan go play in the living room. He returned to his desk, opened his relay protection course notebook, and reorganized the mathematical derivation logic of main protection and backup protection, circling the points he was unsure about in red pen. He planned to ask the teacher the following week. This kind of weekend studying gave him a sense of grounding.
location: Home study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and midday rest
description: The whole family had lunch together, with Hainanese chicken rice and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about the afternoon plans. After the meal, he rested on the living room sofa with his eyes closed for 20 minutes. Hanhan was coaxed into taking a nap, while Xuanxuan quietly read the picture book Secrets of Everything.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; the dining room and living room at home.

name: Take eldest son to harvest lettuce on the balcony, a little nature lesson.
description: After the midday rest, the sunlight was gentle. Lu Mingqiang took his eldest son Lu Zixuan to the balcony to harvest lettuce. He guided Xuanxuan to use small scissors to cut the mature outer leaves, and explained the functions of roots, stems, and leaves, comparing roots to straws and leaves to a kitchen. Xuanxuan excitedly tried it and suggested growing water spinach. Lu Mingqiang promised to buy seeds next week. The father and son harvested a full basket of lettuce.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, home balcony

name: Organized the lettuce and prepared to leave
description: After harvesting, Lu Mingqiang and his wife brought the lettuce into the kitchen, shook off the soil from the roots, and wrapped it in paper towels to keep it fresh. He picked out one-third and packed it in a fresh-keeping box to take to his parents, and washed and drained the rest with Juanzi, preparing for the lettuce dinner in the evening.
location: Home kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to visit parents and share the harvest.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove with his eldest son Lu Zixuan to his parents' home. The drive took about 17 minutes, and they arrived at the South Area of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan in Meilan District. His father, Lu Jianguo, was playing chess in the neighborhood and was very happy to see his grandson. His mother, Chen Xiuying, took the fresh lettuce and was delighted, wanting to keep them for a meal, but Lu Mingqiang politely declined. The family chatted about how things were going for half an hour, and Lu Mingqiang reminded his father to be careful about heatstroke. When they left, his mother insisted on giving them homemade Hainan rice noodles and some mangoes.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home and do household chores
description: Lu Mingqiang drove home and put the food his mother had given him into the refrigerator. Seeing the storage room was messy, he took the opportunity to put the toolbox back in place and plugged the electric bike in to charge. Around then, his wife came back from the supermarket with their young son, who had just woken up. She had bought ingredients such as pork ribs and golden pomfret and joked that they should celebrate the garden’s harvest.
location: At home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The couple works together to prepare a hearty dinner
description: Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan were preparing dinner together in the kitchen. Juanzi handled the fish and the pork ribs, while Lu Mingqiang peeled and chopped garlic and prepared a sauce with oyster sauce and light soy sauce. As they worked, they chatted about interesting moments from helping the children with homework and about their visits to their parents. The kitchen was filled with the flavor of everyday life and laughter.
location: Home kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family shared a lettuce dinner.
description: During dinner, the family sat together. Garlic and oyster sauce dressed lettuce sat in the center, green and fragrant, along with lotus root and pork rib soup, steamed golden pompano, and Hainan noodles. The children scrambled to eat the lettuce. His wife praised the balcony vegetable garden for being fresher than the market. His youngest son Hanhan said childishly that he would water it tomorrow too. Lu Mingqiang felt a deep sense of contentment.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, home dining room

name: After-Meal Cleanup and Relaxation
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to clear the table, wash the dishes and chopsticks and put them away, and wipe clean the stove. Then he cut the mangoes his mother had given him and brought them to the living room for the family to enjoy.
location: At home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family science popularization and happy time.
description: The whole family sat together in the living room. Xuanxuan was still curious about the harvest, so Lu Mingqiang played a science-popularizing animation about seed germination on his phone and explained the growth process in simple language, emphasizing patience. His wife also shared funny stories about growing vegetables in her childhood, making the children laugh. The evening was full of warmth and educational meaning.
location: Living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Recording and planning: balcony garden blueprint
description: After the children got ready for bed, Lu Mingqiang returned to the study, picked three harvest photos and sent them to the family group, and wrote an entry in his balcony vegetable garden diary recording the lettuce variety, taste, and pairing suggestions. He also planned to buy water spinach and amaranth seeds the next week, add flower pots and nutrient soil, and expand the balcony vegetable garden, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening routine: soaking feet and stretching.
description: Lu Mingqiang fetched hot water to soak his feet and did some simple pre-sleep stretches to relieve the fatigue of the day. He scrolled through phone messages, declined his friend Lin Feng's invitation to play ball, and decided to take the family to Wanlv Garden tomorrow.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After soaking his feet, Lu Mingqiang leaned comfortably against the headboard and read the circuit calculation chapter of the senior technician tutoring textbook for about ten minutes. Feeling relaxed and sleepy, he closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a smile, marveling that he had spent a fulfilling, perfect rest day. His wife Wang Lijuan had already lain down.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Waking up, preparing, and heading to the squash court
description: At 6:30 in the morning the alarm went off. Lu Mingqiang got up; his wife Wang Lijuan was still sound asleep. He tiptoed to the bathroom to wash up, drank a glass of warm water, then checked the weather forecast on his phone: overcast in Haikou, light rain in the afternoon, temperature 24-29.
