location: Training Classroom, Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: At 12:00 the assessment ended. Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the company and ordered a braised pork trotter rice. While eating, he did not look at his phone, but silently went over the key points of the afternoon theory exam in his mind, especially the formulas and data that were easy to mix up. He finished at 12:50 and rode back to the electrical school.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Final review before the exam.
description: Before 13:00, Lu Mingqiang returned to the electric power school without taking a lunch break. He found a quiet corner in the corridor of the teaching building, took out his organized notes, and quickly scanned the key points he had marked in 'Specifications for Lightning Protection and Grounding Resistance' and the 'New Technology' chapter, making a final sprint for the afternoon written exam.
location: Corridor of the teaching building, Hainan Provincial Communications Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Written theory test: a major exam on electrical knowledge
description: At 13:00, the written theory test began. The paper covered several major modules, including electrical basics, safety regulations, and applications of new technology. Lu Mingqiang answered the first half fairly smoothly, but in the second half, he could clearly feel that his memory of certain fill-in-the-blank and calculation questions was fuzzy. He adjusted his breathing, answered whatever he could, guessed at the ones he didn't know based on experience, and never left any question blank. At 16:30, he handed in his paper on time, feeling somewhat uncertain.
location: Theory Examination Room, Hainan Provincial Advanced Transportation Technician School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Proactively asked the teacher about the wrong questions.
description: As soon as the exam ended, Lu Mingqiang immediately took the test paper with mistakes marked in advance and found the training instructor. The instructor patiently explained questions such as “Calculation Methods for Three-Phase Unbalanced Current” and “Specific Requirements for Lightning Protection Grounding Resistance,” and pinpointed that he mainly lost points on data memorization and newly added chapters, suggesting that he go back and copy the relevant standard tables several times to deepen his impression. While nodding, he quickly noted down all the key points and the review direction suggested by the instructor in his phone memo.
location: Teacher's office, Hainan Provincial Advanced Technical School of Transportation, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving to the next venue and warming up for squash
description: At 17:30, he came out of the electrical school, feeling a bit tight in the chest. Lu Mingqiang directly got on his electric bike, rode via Nanhai Avenue, Longkun South Road, and Guomao Road, and arrived at Xingdongli Fitness (N Power Branch) at 17:55. After arriving, he quickly changed into his sportswear.
location: On the way from Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Xingdongli Fitness (N Power Branch), No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Squash backhand intensive training and partner practice.
description: At 18:00, Lin Feng still had not arrived, so Lu Mingqiang went to the court first and practiced backhand drives alone against the wall for quite a while. He hit with plenty of power, venting all his pent-up frustration on the ball. At 18:30, Lin Feng arrived on time. The two exchanged only brief greetings and immediately started a match. After a high-intensity half-hour practice session, sweat soaked their clothes, and the vigorous exercise calmed Lu Mingqiang's mood considerably.
location: Star Power Fitness (N Power Branch) Squash Court, No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return trip, Qingbuliang, and phone calls.
description: At 19:00, the practice session ended. Lu Mingqiang and Lin Feng exchanged a few words about today's exam, and then he took a quick shower. At 19:10, he rode his e-bike to the Jia Mie food stall next to the club and ordered a takeaway portion of qingbuliang to fill his stomach. Then he hurried home on the e-bike. On the way, he called his wife Wang Lijuan, told her the exam was over and that he wouldn't be home for dinner because he had already bought qingbuliang, so she didn't need to bother cooking. His wife acknowledged and told him to come back early. At 19:50, he returned to Banshan Garden Residential Area.
location: In Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, on the way back from Star Power Fitness (N Power Branch) to Banshan Garden Residential Area via Jiami Food Stall.

name: Going home to organize the mistake notebook
description: He got home at 20:00. Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower first, then plunged into the study. He turned on the desk lamp, spread open his notebook, and carefully copied the wrong questions from today's mock exam and the teacher's key explanations into three categories: 'Electrical Fundamentals,' 'Safety Regulations,' and 'New Technologies.' He highlighted the easily confused resistance values and power calculation formulas in red ink and wrote down his own understanding beside them in his own words. Wang Lijuan quietly walked into the study and refilled his cup with warm chrysanthemum tea, placing it on the desk.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Made a final sprint review plan
description: After organizing the wrong questions, it was almost 11 o’clock. Lu Mingqiang looked at the notes and wrong-question distribution in his phone memo and made a final two-day sprint plan for himself: all day tomorrow (the 24th), he would focus single-mindedly on memorizing the standard parameters and formulas; the day after (the 25th), he would concentrate on past years’ real exam papers and redo today’s wrong questions. With the plan set, he felt much more at ease. Before going to bed, he checked the raincoat in the basket of his electric bike to make sure it was ready for the next day’s work.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Communication and reflection before bed.
description: Back in the bedroom, his wife Wang Lijuan was still awake. After lying down, Lu Mingqiang briefly told her about today's exam. He had done poorly on the theory test, but he already knew where the problem was and had a clear sense of it, so he told her not to worry. They chatted for a bit about their plan to go to Wanlv Garden on the weekend. At 23:45, they turned off the lights and went to sleep. In the darkness, he closed his eyes and silently recited the lightning protection grounding resistance value he had answered wrong that afternoon, once, twice, and slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning exercise and washing up
description: Lu Mingqiang was woken up by his phone alarm. Although he had gone to bed late the previous night because he was organizing wrong answers, he still insisted on doing low-intensity core training, doing only 2 sets of planks and 1 set of Superman. He then took a hot shower to shake off drowsiness and washed his face with cold water to wake himself up. Next, he carefully checked the equipment he needed for the day, including a raincoat, plastic bags, two pairs of gloves, a power bank, and earphones, and put the “Standard Parameter Quick-Reference Card” into the pocket of his work shirt.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake and care for the two sons, then have breakfast together
description: Lu Mingqiang first woke up his 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan and helped him put on his kindergarten uniform, then woke his 8-year-old elder son Lu Zixuan. He used “Dad is going to learn magic tricks tonight” to urge Xuanxuan to wash up quickly. While the children were washing up, he served multigrain porridge and boiled eggs, and the family had a simple breakfast.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an e-bike to take the two children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang first rode his electric bike to take his younger son Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, bought him yogurt at the shop by the gate, and watched him walk into the school. Then he took his older son Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him on the way to listen carefully in class, and after sending Xuanxuan to the school gate, watched him run into the campus.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and buy breakfast.
description: Lu Mingqiang cycled to his company on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. On the way, he passed the 'Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant' on Haisheng Road and ordered a takeaway portion of spicy soup rice and fried dough sticks for breakfast.
location: Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Company morning meeting and task assignment.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into his work uniform and attended the team's morning meeting. Team leader Zhang assigned the day's field task: go to Siji Huating Longcheng Community to replace the emergency power supply control cabinet of the new elevator model. He specifically emphasized that the old community had aging wiring, so they should pay attention to fire prevention and insulation testing.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Field work to replace the elevator emergency power supply cabinet and return to the company
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang prepared their tools together. During the break, he silently recited standard electrical parameters. The three then rode through light rain to the Siji Huating Longcheng Residential Community. In the basement-level electrical distribution room, Lu Mingqiang acted as the lead operator, cutting off power and testing for voltage, then hanging a "Do Not Close Switch" warning sign while explaining each step to Zhao Qiang. When removing the old cabinet, he found oxidized wire ends and tinned them. During a break, he also pulled out flash cards to reinforce his knowledge. After the new cabinet was installed, power was restored successfully on the first attempt. After testing and confirming normal operation, they packed up their tools and rode back to the company in the rain.
location: Distribution room on B1, Longcheng Community, Siji Huating, Hongcheng Lake Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and study after lunch
description: Lu Mingqiang and a colleague had lunch at Qionghai Liu Ji Beef Brisket Restaurant near the company. He ordered the beef brisket dressed rice noodle set meal. After the meal, he sat down at the restaurant entrance, took out his mistakes notebook, recited the calculation formula for the protection range of an air-termination device, and silently sketched the protection angle diagram.
location: Qionghai Liuji Beef Brisket Shop, beside Xianghe Hardware Store, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon nap and checking tax status.
description: Lu Mingqiang returned to the company rest shed, lay on a folding chair and rested for 20 minutes. After waking up, he checked the Individual Income Tax APP on his phone and found the filing status still displayed "Treasury processing."
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: system testing and file organization.
description: Lu Mingqiang worked with Chen Jianguo to carry out a remote linkage test on the power supply cabinet replaced that morning, and together they filled in the equipment maintenance record file. During this, Team Leader Zhang asked about the work situation, and Lu Mingqiang reported the problem of wire oxidation. Before leaving work, Lu Mingqiang went to the tool room and collected a new set of waterproof electrical gloves.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, shower, change clothes, and prepare for class
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang took a warm shower in the company's simple shower room and changed into a clean T-shirt and a light jacket. He wrapped his mistake notebook and quick-note cards in a dry towel, checked the e-bike battery, and confirmed it had enough power for the round trip to the electrical school.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to the electrical school, buying dinner, and reviewing before class
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to Hainan Mechanical and Electrical Engineering School (Haikou Electrical School) in Meilan District. On the way, he stopped at Grandpa Baozi Shop on Wenzhuang Road and bought two char siu buns and a cup of monk fruit tea. After arriving, he sat in a corner of the cafeteria and ate the buns with the tea, then took out his error notebook and focused on reviewing the easily confused points of ground resistance testers and lightning-protection grounding resistance, preparing for the evening review session.
location: Hainan Provincial Electromechanical Engineering School, Qiongzhou Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Attend the electrician exam mock test review class.
description: The training class started on time. Teacher Wang used a projector to explain the mock exam paper question by question. Lu Mingqiang listened with great concentration. When it came to the lightning rod protection range, he used a red pen to add the teacher's explanation to his error notebook. After class, he pulled Teacher Wang aside to ask questions about the influence of different soil types on earth resistance test values, and did not leave until he fully understood.
location: Hainan Provincial Electromechanical Engineering School, Qiongzhou Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycled home at night and reviewed the questions I got wrong.
description: In the night, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike carefully avoiding puddles, heading home against the sea breeze. After arriving home, his wife Wang Lijuan brought him a glass of warm water. He went straight into the study, first copied the newly understood knowledge points from the lesson evaluation class into his mistake notebook, then closed the book, covered the answers with his hand, and mentally went through all the questions in the notebook, answering them silently, until his accuracy rate reached over 80 percent, then put down the notebook with satisfaction.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening family time and bedtime preparation.
description: Lu Mingqiang soaked his feet in hot water prepared by his wife in the living room, chatting with her about household matters and sharing what he learned in class. Afterward, he used his phone to play old songs to relax. When he finished, he went to the study to prepare the past exam papers and scratch paper for the next day, then went to the balcony to check on the water spinach and amaranth seeds planted a few days earlier, only to find they had not sprouted. Before bed, he listened to a few minutes of soothing light music to completely unwind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: After setting the alarm for 6:10 the next morning, Lu Mingqiang turned off the light and went to bed. Feeling reassured by the day's fullness, he soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning core training and morning preparations
description: Early in the morning at 6:10, the phone alarm rang on time. Mingqiang turned it off, then laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom for core training. He completed 2 sets of planks (80 seconds each) and 1 set of superman exercises (15 reps), then focused on pigeon pose stretches, holding each side for 1 minute. He felt the tight muscles in his lower back effectively relieved. After training, he weighed 71.5 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than the previous day. Then he quickly showered, changed into clean work clothes, walked into his sons' room, woke up his eldest son Lu Zixuan, helped his 4-year-old youngest son Lu Zihan get dressed and put on shoes, and checked that Lu Zixuan's books and homework were all packed.
location: Room 201, Unit 1, Building 2, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and chat
description: The family of four sat around the dining table at home. His wife, Wang Lijuan, had prepared whole-wheat steamed buns, boiled eggs, and hot milk for breakfast. Mingqiang ate a bun and praised the home-cooked meal for being nourishing, saying that he had been able to get through the two-week training camp entirely thanks to his wife's logistical support. Wang Lijuan smiled and replied that breakfast would follow this standard from now on, and that she would continue packing lunchboxes so they could eat less greasy food outside. Mingqiang nodded in agreement and reminded their two sons to behave at school.
location: Dining room, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 2, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an e-bike to take his sons to school
description: At 7:35, Mingqiang set off from home on an electric bike, first taking his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At the Xiangzhi General Store at the gate, he bought a box of strawberry yogurt at Lu Zihan's request. Then he continued riding to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, delivered his older son Lu Zixuan to the school gate before 7:50, and only after watching him walk into the school did he turn the bike around and leave with peace of mind.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, first go to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District), then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District).

name: Attend the morning meeting and head to Haoda Building to complete the final work on the distribution cabinet.
description: At exactly 8:00, Mingqiang arrived at the company, changed into work clothes, and attended the team's morning meeting. Squad leader Zhang assigned tasks, explaining that the main work for the day was to finish the renovation of the distribution cabinet in the Nongji residential area, requiring checking the wiring diagrams and conducting final tests. Mingqiang also reported to the squad leader his plan to take leave on Saturday to go to the electrical school to practice exam questions, and it was approved. After the meeting, he and his colleagues Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang took their tool bags and cycled to Haoda Building, No. 35 Haisheng Road. In the electrical distribution room, the three checked one by one the tightness of the wiring of all circuit breakers and contactors, and used a multimeter to test three-phase voltage balance. Mingqiang explained wiring standards on site to Zhao Qiang, stressing that terminals must be firmly pressed and must not have burrs. Around 11:00, all test data met the standards, and he filled out the completion acceptance form. After packing up the tools, the three cycled back to the company. Passing the Haisheng Road intersection, Chen Jianguo suggested drinking coconut water, so they bought coconuts from a roadside stall. After drinking the sweet and refreshing coconut water, they rode slowly back to the company.
location: First floor, Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (morning meeting), and the power distribution room of Haoda Building, No. 35 Haisheng Road (work)

name: After lunch at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice, took a lunch break in the company lounge.
description: At 12 o’clock, Mingqiang did not stop at the company canteen and walked directly to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. He ordered a signature spicy soup rice with pork offal, pickled mustard greens, and two fried eggs. While waiting, he browsed photos of last night’s lecture-review notes on his phone, quickly revisiting the easy-to-get-wrong points about grounding resistance and three-phase imbalance in his mistake notebook; while eating, he used his phone memo to record key values. At 12:45 he returned to the company rest room, set a 15-minute alarm for a nap on the folding bed. Before sleeping, he planned to officially say goodbye to strong afternoon tea, switching to chrysanthemum tea from then on, and placed his safety helmet and tool bag neatly at the foot of the bed.
location: No. 56-4, first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant; and the rest room on the first floor of Building A, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road

name: After handling file and leave matters, rode his bike to the electrical school
description: After waking from his lunch break, Mingqiang organized his desk work in the company office: he filed the completion form for Haoda Building from the morning, filled in the team construction log, then printed a leave request, wrote the reason and date, asked Squad Leader Zhang to sign for confirmation, and submitted it to Manager Liu of the Engineering Department. After that, he took out his phone and photographed the 'Pre-exam Psychological Adjustment' section from the course outline for the evening. At 15:00, he changed into casual clothes, checked that the electric bike was fully charged, and rode off to Haikou Electric Power School in Longhua District. On the way, he passed a bakery and stopped to buy a char siu bao and a bottle of mineral water as a simple dinner.
location: On the way from the office area of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District.

name: Review and pre-class preparation at the electrical school campus.
description: Arrived at the electrical school at 15:40. Mingqiang found a bench in the shade of a tree on campus, and while eating a char siu bao, silently recited the high-frequency exam points the teacher had emphasized. At 16:00 he walked into the teaching building, confirmed the classroom was empty, sat down and continued flipping through his notebook, reviewing the bolt tightening torque values and standard grounding resistance values in his mind once more. At 16:10 he went to the corridor outside the classroom to charge his electric bike, then carefully checked his tool bag to make sure the calculator, exam admission ticket, ID card, and other items were all there.
location: Campus and teaching building of Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lu Mingqiang turned down the TV volume, went alone to the study to study the chapter on ground short-circuit handling in Power System Fault Analysis. While reading, he drew current flow diagrams and protection logic in his notebook, and marked key data. He planned to discuss it with his colleague Zhao Qiang. After studying, he went to the entrance to clean and check his tool bag, wiping each wrench, screwdriver, voltage tester, etc., confirming everything was complete, then put them back neatly, and finally set a 6:30 alarm for work the next morning.
description: At 4:30 p.m., the last class started on time. The trainer led the whole class through a systematic review of the Senior Technician exam syllabus, highlighting practical safety regulations and frequently tested theoretical points from recent years. Mingqiang listened attentively and occasionally took photos of the blackboard with his phone. At 6:00 p.m., during the break, he and several classmates encouraged each other in the corridor, calming their anxiety, and checked their toolkits again. At 6:10 p.m., in the second half of the class, the trainer gave pre-exam psychological guidance, sharing tips for dealing with nervousness, and reminding them to allocate exam time wisely and not to get stuck on difficult problems. Around 8:30 p.m., the trainer wrote on the blackboard: "Today is only the starting point; true masters are forged by time." Mingqiang solemnly copied it onto the flyleaf of his notebook. At 8:45 p.m., the trainer declared the training officially over, and applause filled the classroom.

participant.name: Li Zhi
participant.relation: Classmates from the intensive training class

location: Room 302, 3rd Floor, Teaching Building, Hainan Provincial Transportation Senior Technical School, No. 32 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Talked with teachers and classmates and celebrated the end of the training with a late-night snack.
description: After class, Mingqiang did not leave immediately but gathered with several classmates around the teacher to ask how to answer some theoretical questions, and the teacher patiently explained. After saying goodbye, Mingqiang and some good classmates agreed to go for a late-night snack to celebrate. The group rode electric bikes to Jia Mie Food Stall on Shimao South Road and ordered the shop's signature grilled fish, stir-fried snails, salt-and-pepper duck necks, and several cold dishes. Mingqiang opened a bottle of ice-cold beer for himself, and everyone chatted freely about their exam preparation experiences, from initially not being able to remember the parameters to later independently analyzing faults. Laughter and the clinking of glasses continued, and the stress of the past two weeks was completely released. By the time the gathering ended it was almost 11 p.m. Mingqiang did not ride his electric bike but called a ride-hailing car to go home.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tidying up briefly after returning home and planning for the next day.
description: The ride-hailing car arrived at Banshan Garden before 23:00. Mingqiang opened the door quietly. The living room light was still on, but his wife Wang Lijuan had already gone to bed. He changed into slippers, washed his face, made himself a cup of warm water, and put it by the bedside. Then he sat in the study, opened the Notes app on his phone, created a folder named “Exam Countdown,” and saved the photos of the review outline the teacher had sent and the motivational quotes he had copied down. Reviewing the past two weeks of effort, he now had a clear plan for the upcoming independent review. After setting the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, he turned off the light, lay down, and fell asleep calmly and with determination.
location: Study and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning core training and stretching
description: After getting up, he weighed himself first; his weight was 71.6 kg, the same as the previous day. After drinking half a glass of warm water, he did a 15-minute core workout in the living room, including three sets of planks (70 seconds each) and three sets of glute bridges (20 reps each), followed by 10 minutes of yoga stretching, focusing on relieving the lower back tightness caused by sitting for long periods during the previous day's intensive training.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning bike ride, jog, and park breakfast.
description: He changed into quick-dry athletic clothes and running shoes, put on a helmet and Bluetooth earphones, and rode about 5.5 km from home to Baishamen Park. He warmed up in front of the lake inside the park, then completed a 5 km jog along the coastal trail at a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. Because he hadn't run in two weeks, his breathing was a bit rapid, but after sweating he felt refreshed. After the run, he ordered a bowl of Hainan noodle soup and a marinated egg at a snack stall at the park entrance for energy, then cycled home.
location: Baishamen Park, Renmin Avenue, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shower, change clothes, and prepare to head out.
description: After taking a shower, changed into a clean T-shirt and casual shorts, made himself a pot of cold chrysanthemum tea, checked and prepared the items needed for the trip to Jiuzhou Town for shopping: car key, phone, charging cable, empty mineral water bottle, and shopping bag, and placed them all in the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving to a farmer's household in Jiuzhou Town
description: Set out from home, drove along Longkun South Road onto the Eastern Line Expressway, heading toward Jiuzhou Town, Qiongshan District. On the way, he confirmed the specific location and arrival time with the farmer over a Bluetooth headset. The weather was clear along the route, the temperature gradually rose, and the car's air conditioning kept the cabin at a comfortable temperature.
location: A farmhouse near Fuwen Village Committee, Jiuzhou Town, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Select free-range eggs and talk with the farmer.
description: Arrived at the farmer's house and saw free-range chickens foraging under the bamboo grove. Spent about 40 minutes carefully selecting 5 jin of free-range eggs. They were not large, but the yolks were plump. Wrapped them in old newspaper and put them in a cardboard box in the trunk. Then sat in the yard chatting with the farmer about the tricks of raising free-range chickens, and used my phone to take photos of the flock and the eggs being picked.
location: A farmhouse near Fuwen Village Committee, Jiuzhou Town, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Got a flat tire on the way back and had it repaired.
description: After saying goodbye to the farmer, he drove back. At about 11:25 on a county road near Yunlong Town, Qiongshan District, the dashboard warned that the right rear tire pressure was too low. He pulled over and found a small nail embedded in the tread. He immediately took the jack and spare tire from the trunk. Although the lug nuts were tight, he changed the tire in about 20 minutes, and took photos of the tire change and the original tire to post on WeChat Moments with a self-deprecating remark. Afterward, he drove cautiously at below 60 km/h for about 15 minutes to Xiao Li's Tire Repair Shop on Jinmao Middle Road, where the mechanic performed a hot patch repair and checked the pressure of the other tires. The repair was completed in about 20 minutes.
location: County road near Yunlong Town, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Xiao Li's Tire Repair Shop on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: After repairing the flat tire, drove home.
description: Starting from the tire repair shop, he drove along Jinmao Middle Road for a few minutes to get home, then carefully carried the free-range eggs from the trunk into the kitchen.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sharing experiences with family during lunch
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared lunch, including stir-fried pork with peppers, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and lotus root and pork rib soup. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang told his wife and eldest son Lu Zixuan about buying free-range eggs and changing the spare tire. After hearing it, his wife chided him a little, but it was mostly concern.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, feeling drowsy, he returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, took a quiet nap for about an hour, and recovered his energy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handling personal affairs and reviewing electrical knowledge

He set a reminder for April 30. Then he told his wife about the plan and urged her to pay attention to electrical safety during thunderstorms, avoid touching switches with wet hands, and unplug appliances. His wife mentioned that the last time it thundered, the TV went black, which made her nervous, and she agreed with the inspection.

When the rain eased, he walked briskly along the sidewalk of Haisheng Road with an umbrella for 30 minutes, breathing in the fresh air after the rain and breaking into a slight sweat. At 12:50 he returned to the company rest shed and, with Chen Jianguo, talked about thunderstorm season safety brought up by the recent rain. I need to go out for some errands tonight — first to the pharmacy and the hardware store, then to my parents' place, so I'll be home later.'

When Zixuan went off track again while summarizing the main idea of a short passage, Lu Mingqiang did not give the answer directly but used the formula 'Edison + persistent experimentation + eventual invention of the light bulb' to guide him, asking him to summarize from three aspects: the person, the event, and the result. He also reminded Old Chen to reinforce the swaying canopy at the entrance of the shop. Old Chen smiled and agreed.

Then he sat down on the living room sofa, drank the plain boiled water his wife handed him, and used his phone to browse technical posts on the industry forum and messages in the family group.

description: Lu Mingqiang took a simple shower, put on a vest and shorts, lay in bed, and told his wife about today's events: "I checked Dad's knee; he's got a patch on it and he's in good spirits. Everything is ready; early tomorrow morning I'll first go over our household wiring." His wife told him to rest early. He leaned against the headboard and spent 15 minutes on his phone reading electrician forum posts about leakage protector testing techniques, then scrolled through short videos about car repair and rural self-built houses. Around 11 pm he put down his phone and placed the safety helmet and insulated shoes he would need the next day by the bedside. At 11:15 he turned off the bedside lamp, listened to the insects chirping outside the window, and soon fell asleep, saving his energy for tomorrow's circuit inspection.

I first did a 15-minute wake-up routine: two sets each of the superman exercise and glute bridges, with slow, powerful movements; then two sets of planks, gritting my teeth through 50 seconds each; finally, I fully stretched my lower back and hips with cat-cow and pigeon poses, feeling the stiff muscles from last night's overtime gradually relax.

She asked me to keep an eye on the pot. I acknowledged, turned and walked to the balcony, squatted beside the toolbox, and once again counted the insulating tape, waterproof putty, and new screwdrivers I had bought yesterday. After confirming nothing was missing, I felt much more at ease. Back in the kitchen, I brought the steaming plain noodle soup to the table, and the two of us had a simple, warm breakfast with the leftover dried radish from last night.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China (bathroom, kitchen, balcony)

name: Wake the children up and help them get out of bed
description: I walked into the boys’ room, first gently waking Xuanxuan, who was still lazing in bed, and helped Hanhan find the kindergarten vest he needed to wear today. Juanzi quickly stuffed water bottles and umbrellas into the kids’ schoolbags. I told Xuanxuan, “The weather forecast says there will be showers in the afternoon. Remember to bring the blue umbrella in your drawer so you don’t get wet.” The little guy rubbed his eyes and nodded groggily.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China (master bedroom, children's room)

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: I got on the electric bike, took the two kids, and set off from Banshan Garden on time. First I headed east along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Yinpo Road, and at 7:20 dropped Xuanxuan off at the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School, watching him walk through the school gate with his schoolbag. Then I turned around and rode along Daying Road and Guomao Road, and at 7:35 took Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handed him to the teacher on duty, and the little guy obediently waved goodbye to me.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District)

name: Commute to company
description: Starting from the kindergarten, I cycled west along Guomao Road, turned onto Haixiu Middle Road, and headed straight toward Xiuying. The sky was overcast and the air damp, so I didn't dare ride too fast. At 7:55 I arrived at the industrial park on time, parked the e-bike in the bike shed, and walked toward the office building carrying my water cup.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: End-of-month team morning meeting and wrap-up work
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Shift Leader Zhang presided over the team's morning meeting. He mainly assigned the end-of-month winding-up tasks: first, a full inventory of spare parts and accessories in the warehouse; second, everyone was to sort and archive this month's maintenance documents. After the meeting, I took Zhao Qiang to the warehouse first and checked the in-stock models of common parts such as leakage protection switches, contactors, and tape one by one. Then we returned to the workshop and conducted a second inspection of an old distribution box replaced from China Resources Building, recording all the data. Just as we caught our breath, Chen Jianguo came over and whispered, 'Brother Qiang, how is the electrical work at home going? Did you buy all the materials last night?' I patted him on the shoulder: 'All ready. I'll do it after work. No problem!'
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan, China (park office building meeting room, warehouse, workshop)

name: Lunch, midday break, and recovery brisk walking
description: At noon, I went to the industrial park canteen with Jianguo and Xiao Zhao. I ordered steamed sea fish with black bean sauce, a plate of stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and a bowl of rice. After eating, I saw it was cloudy but not raining, so I said hello to Jianguo and walked briskly around the park on my own for 30 minutes. The moist air was refreshing. As I walked, I thought: this habit is truly comfortable; starting in May, I must stick with it and walk at least three times a week.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (canteen and main park road), No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Afternoon wrap-up work and arrangements
description: The afternoon work was relatively light. I sat at my office desk, copied the warehouse documents that had been inventoried in the morning into a spreadsheet, and filed this month's inspection and maintenance records. In the middle of that, I sent Juanzi a WeChat message: "Juanzi, the circuit check will probably take about an hour. Let Mom know not to wait for me for dinner tonight; just leave me some food. Have Xuanxuan do his homework by himself first, and if he has questions, he can wait until I get back." Soon Juanzi replied with a "Got it, be safe" emoji. Around 5:00, I tidied my desk and said to Team Leader Zhang, "Team Leader, I've sorted everything on my end, so I'm heading off." Team Leader Zhang nodded and reminded me, "Be safe on the road."
location: Workshop Office of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Commute home from work
description: I rode my electric bike out of the industrial park gate. Because I was thinking about checking the circuits while it was still daylight, I rode a bit faster than usual. Heading east along Haisheng Road, I arrived back at Banshan Garden at about 18:00. I didn't stop at the neighborhood gate and rode straight into the courtyard.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Comprehensively inspect the electrical circuits throughout the house
description: After arriving home, I changed into an old T-shirt and shorts, and took out the insulating tape, waterproof putty, and screwdriver that I had prepared last night from the balcony toolbox. Starting from the living room, I checked every wall switch and socket one by one, feeling the temperature with the back of my hand, and used the screwdriver to tighten a slightly loose terminal on a living room socket. Then I checked the kitchen and the master bedroom; everything was normal. The main event was the balcony. The sky had grown darker and a fine drizzle began to fall. Braving the drizzle, I carefully inspected the outdoor conduits of the air conditioner outdoor unit and the water heater, and found that the insulating tape at two joints was slightly curling up. I patiently wrapped and reinforced them tightly with new tape and waterproof putty. Finally, I went back inside, squatted in front of the main distribution box, and repeatedly pressed the test button of the residual current device. I saw it trip reliably with a 'clack', then pushed it back to reset. After all the tests were normal, I took out my phone and checked off three items in the memo. The weight in my heart was finally lifted.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China (living room, kitchen, balcony, master and secondary bedrooms, electrical distribution box)

name: Have dinner with the family
description: After checking the circuit, I quickly washed my face. Juanzi had already set the food on the table. Tonight was a simple and tasty meal of three dishes and a soup: scrambled eggs with scallions, stir-fried lettuce with garlic, a plate of steamed sausages, and the leftover winter melon and meatball soup from yesterday. Xuanxuan chattered away about fun things at school today, while Hanhan shoveled rice and poked at the meatballs in his bowl with a spoon. I ate quickly because I was still thinking about the evening squash training.
location: Dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Drive to the squash court for intensive training.
description: After dinner, I changed into my sports gear and drove to Xingdongli Fitness and Swimming at Youyi Nanhai City. When I got to the court, Lin Feng and I warmed up briefly and then went straight to practice. Today was entirely focused on real-game situations; Lin Feng simulated match rhythm, forcing me to use my backhand while moving quickly. I was pleasantly surprised to find that I could already consistently control the placement and line changes of my backhand, and a few shots even grazed the line beautifully. After 45 minutes of training, Lin Feng drank some water, gave a thumbs-up, and said: “Old Lu, your backhand has improved at an amazing speed—it's really become a full system! Wait until the technician exam is over, I'll have a serious match with you.” We agreed to add another practice session after the exam when we get a chance.
location: Star Power Fitness & Swimming (Youyi Nanhai City Branch), Youyi Nanhai City, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, China

name: Went home, took a shower, and organized the intensive training notes
description: I drove home covered in sweat and immediately took a refreshing hot shower. After that, I dried my hair and sat down at the desk in my study. From my bag I took out the notebook from the training session and several blank palm-sized index cards. Using a marker, I copied key principles, calculation formulas, and important data onto the cards: keywords on the front, details on the back. As I copied, I murmured them to myself. Finally, I bundled the cards with a rubber band and planned to put them in my work clothes pocket tomorrow so I could review them anytime.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area (bathroom and study), No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Discussed May family arrangements and reviewed expenses with his wife
description: After putting away my notes, I walked out of the study and saw Juanzi leaning on the sofa looking at her phone. I sat down beside her and spoke first: "Juanzi, didn't you say yesterday that Xuanxuan's school has an event next Monday?" Juanzi looked up and said, "Mm, a parent-child fun sports day. The teacher said it would be best if his dad could come." I took out my phone and checked the shift schedule: "I probably won't be busy next Monday. When the time comes, I'll talk to Squad Leader Zhang about swapping a day off and try to go." Juanzi happily responded. Then we took out the account book and went over the family expenses for April together. I noticed that although I had spent some extra money on the intensive training trip in the first part of the month, after I came back Juanzi had adjusted the menu and ordered much less takeout, which actually saved some money. Juanzi said, "In May we have to keep it up, eat out less and cook more at home. The money should go to the kids' nutrition and your study materials." I nodded in agreement. We also chatted about a simple plan for a family outing in May and agreed that if the weather was good, we would take the two boys to Wanlv Park or a nearby park for a walk.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: After chatting with Juanzi, she went to put Hanhan to sleep. I checked my sons' schoolbags to make sure all homework notebooks were packed, ironed the clothes for tomorrow, and hung them by the door. Then I washed up briefly and drank half a glass of warm water. After lying in bed, I browsed a few informative posts on an electrician forum on my phone for a few minutes and felt my eyelids growing heavy. Looking back on this fulfilling day — the circuit was fixed, my squash improved, and May's plans were discussed with Juanzi — I felt at ease. I turned off the light and slept soundly, recharging for tomorrow's energetic work and life. The alarm was set for 6:15 the next morning.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China (bathroom, master bedroom)

name: Waking up and morning core training
description: On the first day of the Labor Day holiday, Lu Mingqiang woke up at 5:40, changed into sportswear, and went to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park near his home. In the morning exercise area of the park, he used the horizontal bar and steps to do core exercises such as crunches and planks, enjoying the fresh morning air and the lively atmosphere of residents exercising, and felt invigorated.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

Along the way, he photographed Haikou's early-morning street views and the distant Century Bridge, sent them to his wife Juanzi, and wrote, 'First day of the holiday, full of energy!'
location: Footpath in the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule-of-Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

The clerk warmly reminded him that there was a promotion on plasters during the holiday and suggested stocking up one more box. Lu Mingqiang said he would get it next time and took them home for his mother first. Then he walked back to Banshan Garden.
location: Haoyaoshi Pharmacy (Yanzao Road Branch), Shuichan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Breakfast was the lean pork congee, fried eggs, and pickled radish Juanzi had made. He ate it all quickly, feeling full of energy and looking forward to the family outing.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Lu Mingqiang was in charge of checking the outdoor gear: he reinforced the frame of the big eagle kite, attached new flying line to his son's little dinosaur kite, and found the folding frisbee and bubble machine, checked the batteries, and stuffed them all into the big backpack.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home kitchen, living room, storage room)

description: Once everything was ready, the couple went to wake their two sons, who were still sleeping. The elder son, Xuanxuan, got up immediately when he heard they were going to fly kites; the younger son, Hanhan, still groggy, was coaxed out of bed only by the bubble machine. Lu Mingqiang helped Xuanxuan put on his sneakers and reminded him to bring his water bottle. Juanzi changed Hanhan into a sun-protection jacket and sun hat, and checked the small backpack stuffed with snacks.

name: Driving to Baishamen Park
description: Lu Mingqiang drove a silver family sedan. The family of four set off from Banshan Garden, turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue, and headed east toward Baishamen Park. The drive took about 15 minutes. Along the way, the two children in the back seat chattered as they looked at the sea outside the window, while Juanzi played the song 'Treading the Waves' over Bluetooth. The car was filled with a relaxed and happy atmosphere.

description: Arrived at Baishamen Park, and the family flew kites on the large lawn on the south side. Lu Mingqiang skillfully launched the big eagle kite, drawing cheers from the children. Xuanxuan tried to control the string and, with his father's guidance, kept the kite stable. Hanhan, also with her father's help, made the small dinosaur kite rise unsteadily into the air and shouted excitedly, 'Dad, look! My dinosaur is flying!' Juanzi sat on the picnic mat and recorded the heartwarming scene with her phone.

description: After flying kites, the family sat around a picnic mat and enjoyed the food Juanzi had prepared. The ginger-and-scallion aroma of Hainanese chicken rice, the coconut milk sweetness of Qingbuliang, and the charred fragrance of grilled fish mingled together. Lu Mingqiang picked grilled fish for the two children. Hanhan ate with an oily mouth, and Xuanxuan praised, 'Mom's grilled fish is the best in the world!' Juanzi felt happy and remarked how rare it was for the family to spend time together outdoors.

name: Resting on the lawn and playing with the bubble machine
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang took out the bubble machine, producing colorful bubbles all over the sky. The two children screamed and chased them. Lu Mingqiang lay on the picnic mat under the tree shade and took a half-hour nap, gazing at the blue sky and white clouds. Juanzi tidied up the lunch boxes and took photos of the father and children chasing, preparing to post them on Moments.

name: Strolling in the park and watching the sea.
description: After resting, the family strolled leisurely along the park trail. Lu Mingqiang held his younger son Hanhan's hand, while his older son Xuanxuan ran back and forth. They passed through the coconut grove and reached the seaside boardwalk, feeling the sea breeze and looking out at the Qiongzhou Strait and the ferry. Hanhan marveled at the seagulls, Xuanxuan asked questions about the ocean, and Lu Mingqiang shared stories about sea fish and fishing boats.

name: Pack up for the return trip

name: Drove home

Watching his wife busy, he felt reassured.

Lu Mingqiang smiled and suggested taking them cycling at Wanlv Garden tomorrow, and the children cheered in unison.

The children were completely absorbed.

The two decided to cook more at home in May and settled on boiling noodles for tomorrow's breakfast.

First, I did leg stretches in the fitness area of the central garden, then jogged along the internal roads of the community for about 25 minutes at a moderate pace, mainly to relax my muscles. A gentle breeze was blowing, and it felt comfortable.
