location: Bathroom and master bedroom, home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Browse news and go to bed
description: Leaning against the headboard, he used his phone to browse local news and several technology-related WeChat official accounts. In his mind, he silently went through the list of tools he needed to bring the next day. At exactly 22:00, he turned off the light and lay down. Recalling tomorrow's tasks, he soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning workout and weigh-in celebration
description: At first light, just after a rain shower, the air was especially fresh. Lu Mingqiang went downstairs and jogged for 25 minutes in the central garden of the residential complex, and his step count increased significantly. After returning home, he took a shower, stepped on the electronic scale, and it read 71.0 kg, 0.8 kg lighter than yesterday morning. Excited, he photographed the scale reading, captioned it "Running really does make you lose weight! Persistence is victory!", and posted it to Moments. He soon received likes from ball buddy Lin Feng and running buddy Chen Bin.
location: Central Garden, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and work preparation
description: After showering and changing into clean clothes, his wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked lean pork congee and fried eggs. Lu Mingqiang told her about today's overtime work, and she reminded him to watch out for slippery roads in the rain. After breakfast, he threw the work clothes he had taken off the night before into the washing machine and checked his backpack again: an infrared thermometer, a voltage tester, insulating gloves, a raincoat, and a power bank. He confirmed the meeting time with Team Leader Zhang at the industrial park.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to the industrial park
description: A light rain was falling. Lu Mingqiang drove off from Jinmao Middle Road and headed west along Binhai Avenue. The road was slippery after the rain, so he drove fairly steadily and arrived at the industrial park after about 20 minutes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (departure)

name: Met up with fellow workers to receive tasks
description: Met his long-time partner Chen Jianguo at the entrance of the industrial park and went together to the team office. Squad Leader Zhang handed them the old circuit diagrams for priority inspection, mainly concentrated in the residential areas along Haigang Road in Xiuying District, and reminded them to pay attention to connectors and branch boxes during the rainy season. They took their tools, put on raincoats, and set out.
location: The entrance of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the team office

name: Inspect old circuits in Xiuying District (morning)
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo patrolled on foot in the rain, using infrared thermometers to check low-voltage branch boxes and cable wells one by one. At an old-style branch box on Gangdong Street, they found the phase B connector temperature was too high, exceeding the normal value by 15 degrees. Following the procedures, they cut the power, verified no voltage, tightened bolts, and cleaned off dust. After reconnecting, the temperature returned to normal. Chen Jianguo praised, 'Old Lu, your eye is still as sharp as ever!' Lu Mingqiang felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Old residential area, Haigang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Gangdong Street)

name: Lunch and rest
description: After the rain stopped, the two went to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the industrial park that they often visited and ordered hot spicy soup rice with eggs. While eating, Lu Mingqiang replied to comments on his Moments, telling his squash partner Lin Feng that losing weight depended on encouragement, and making an appointment with his running buddy Chen Bin to go running at Wanlv Garden on the weekend if it didn't rain.
location: Yangtianhe Pharmacy No. 110, 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant)

name: Midday nap and reflection
description: After eating, he went back to the rest room in the industrial park, leaned back in a chair, and dozed for 15 minutes. He kept thinking about his son Xuanxuan's parent-child sports meet next week and planned to sign him up for the three-legged race to build teamwork.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Troubleshoot aging lines in Xiuying District (afternoon)
description: In the afternoon, the weather turned cloudy. The two continued the unfinished line inspection from the morning and, on the way, checked the distribution boxes of several residential communities on Xiuhua Road to make sure nothing was missed. Around 14:30, they completed the inspection of all key points in the plan.
location: Near Haigang Road and Xiuhua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Finished work and returned to the industrial park
description: Returning to the industrial park, the two clocked in, returned the tools, and wrote down in detail in the logbook the hazards handled that morning and took photos for the record.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuted back home and passed by the convenience store on the way
description: On the drive home, he was in a relaxed mood. He made a special detour to the Convenience Life Convenience Store, located 80 meters southwest of the Haixiu Expressway entrance intersection, and bought a pack of betel nuts and a bottle of iced black tea, planning to joke around with his wife when he got home.
location: Convenience Life Convenience Store, 80 meters southwest of the intersection of Haixiu Expressway and the Haixiu Expressway entrance

name: Returning home and sharing the joy
description: As soon as he entered, his youngest daughter Hanhan ran over to be picked up. Lu Mingqiang handed the betel nuts to his wife Wang Lijuan, who smiled and rolled her eyes at him. He pulled her to the sofa to look at the lively Moments: 'Lin Feng said I look thinner, and Brother Bin told me to treat everyone to dinner!' Juanzi laughed as she scrolled and teased him, 'Quit the fried chicken now. Tonight, less oil and less salt—I'll supervise you!' The atmosphere was especially nice.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Assisted with meal preparation and adjusted the diet plan.
description: After talking, the couple went into the kitchen together. Lu Mingqiang voluntarily set aside the fried peanuts and braised pork, and washed more vegetables and enoki mushrooms. During dinner, he said seriously in front of the whole family, "Juanzi, from today on, let's keep our family dinner low in oil and salt, and you can keep an eye on me too." She smiled and agreed.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child communication
description: The whole family sat around eating. Lu Mingqiang picked up some vegetables and asked his son Xuanxuan about the school sports meet events. Xuanxuan excitedly said he had signed up for the three-legged race and the sack race, and pulled him into agreeing to practice at home tomorrow evening.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Weekend Laobaicha social
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang strolled over to the Datie Laoba Tea House near his home and ran into Lao Chen, who ran a hardware store. He sat down and said, “Lao Chen, while checking the circuits today I found a loose connection at a joint. It’s fixed now, and I feel much better.” Lao Chen poured him some tea and chatted about the vintage Wuliangye empty bottles he had recently collected; they agreed that Lu Mingqiang would go to the shop tomorrow afternoon to take a look.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home to spend time with the children
description: He strolled home to find his two sons still awake. He practiced the rhythm of the three-legged race with Xuanxuan in the living room for a while, then read the picture book Swimmy to Hanhan.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal recharge and leisure time
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang returned to the study, opened his tablet, and archived photos of key equipment from inspections by date. He then visited an electrician forum to read posts about increasing capacity and renovation in old residential communities. Finding them enlightening, he saved them.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Took a shower and washed up, then lay in bed feeling that today had been especially fulfilling. Set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow morning and planned to take the kids to Wanlv Garden on Sunday to ride bikes. Then turned off the light and soon fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Getting up, weighing in, and morning wake-up
description: Got up after the alarm rang, first went to the bathroom to weigh himself, weight 71.1 kg. He felt more tired than yesterday, but his weight was stable, and he felt reassured. After a quick wash, he drank a large glass of warm water, then changed into a sports T-shirt and running shoes, ready to go downstairs for exercise.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Light morning run and leg relaxation
description: Jog slowly in the residential area for about 25 minutes, keeping the pace at 7 minutes per kilometer, until the body is slightly sweaty. After the run, do leg stretches and cooldown stretching in the fitness area of the central garden in the residential area, focusing on relaxing the calves and knees.
location: Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Returned home and took a quick shower, then changed into a plaid short-sleeve T-shirt. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast. The two of them had rice porridge with pickled vegetables and fried eggs, chatting about the general plan for the day while eating.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take Xuanxuan to school
description: Drove his son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. Because the school had an unscheduled drum and bugle corps rehearsal, he needed to arrive before 7:40. On the way, he reminded him to practice carefully in preparation for tomorrow's sports meet. Xuanxuan ran excitedly into the school gate.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to the meeting point and meet up with old partners.
description: After leaving school, he drove toward Jinmao Middle Road and, as it was on the way, bought two pork buns at Xinyuan Breakfast Shop, one for himself and one for his colleague Chen Jianguo. He parked near the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and Yusha Road, met up with Jianguo, handed him the pork bun, and the two offered each other cigarettes. They discussed the old alleys that should be the focus of that day's patrol and learned that the weather might change in the afternoon, so they decided to inspect the 'troublesome' old branch boxes in the morning.
location: At the entrance of Xinyuan Breakfast Shop, at the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Inspect aging electrical lines.
description: Chen Jianguo and I carried tool bags and walked through the old alleys around Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, focusing on checking the copper-aluminum transition joints in branch boxes and using an infrared thermometer to measure the internal temperatures one by one. In the branch box at the corridor entrance of a unit building near No. 20, Guomao First Cross Road, we found one joint with slight oxidation and a temperature 8 degrees higher; it was still within the safe range, but we tightened the bolts with a wrench, took photos, and recorded the location and measured values in detail in the phone memo.
location: Unit building near No. 20, Guomao Yiheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch, squash planning, and midday rest
description: Drove with Jianguo to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant in Xiuying District, and each ordered a bowl of spicy soup rice and an iced beer. While waiting for the food, he watched a slow-motion video on his phone of the backhand power stroke in squash and used chopsticks to trace the force-generation path. After the meal, he sent a WeChat message to his squash partner Lin Feng asking about getting a membership card and the Wednesday evening session; Lin Feng replied with a voice message of encouragement. Afterwards, the two sat on the shady steps outside the company gate, smoking and chatting. Jianguo shared tips for tomorrow's parent-child sports meet kangaroo jump race, reminding him to have Xuanxuan wear non-slip shoes, and also talked about his son's upcoming middle school entrance exam.
location: First floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province — Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and the steps outside the company entrance

name: Complete the remaining inspection tasks
description: Continued inspecting the old distribution boxes near Guomao Road and Jiahua Road, confirming no other abnormalities. Before finishing work, I sat on the curb with Jianguo to compile photos and records, and identified hazards that need to be prioritized for reporting and rectification.
location: Near Guomao Road and Jiahua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up family and go cycling at Wanlv Park
description: After finishing work, he drove straight back to Banshan Garden. On the way, he called his wife to ask her and Hanhan to get ready. When he got home, he picked up Juanzi and his daughter Hanhan and drove five minutes to Wanlv Park. He rented a parent-child bicycle, put Hanhan in the front child seat, with Juanzi holding on behind, and rode two laps along the park's main path. Hanhan excitedly rang the bell. When passing the park's big lawn, he noticed that Old Chen's kite was not there.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the hardware store to look at the collection and pick up family members to go home.
description: While Juanzi and Hanhan were still playing in the park, Lu Mingqiang called Lao Chen and then drove to Lao Chen's hardware store on Jinmao Middle Road near Guomao First Cross Road. Lao Chen showed him an old empty Wuliangye bottle in very good condition and told the story of how he had acquired it. The two studied the glaze and cap of the bottle against the light. Lao Chen also showed him several new German pliers, and they chatted about family matters. After that, he returned to the entrance of Wanlv Park to pick up his family, and on the way home stopped at the supermarket under the auto repair building at Binhai International Financial Center to buy green vegetables and pork ribs.
location: Old Chen Hardware Store, Evergreen Park, and the supermarket downstairs from the auto repair shop at Binhai International Financial Center, near the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and Guomao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to put on an apron, rinse the rice, and cook. He blanched the pork ribs and put them in the electric slow cooker with Chinese yam to make soup. His wife stir-fried the dishes, and the two chatted about what they had seen in the afternoon. Dinner had four dishes and a soup: Chinese yam and pork rib soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and cucumber salad. When his son Xuanxuan came home from school, the family of four sat around the table to eat. He reminded Xuanxuan to hurry up with his homework after dinner.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring homework and practicing the three-legged race
description: After dinner, helped Xuanxuan check his math and Chinese homework. Then I took out the cloth strips and took Xuanxuan to the open area in the community to practice the three-legged race. We started with slow walking to find the rhythm and gradually moved to smooth jogging; Xuanxuan became more and more excited as we practiced, getting ready for tomorrow's sports meet.
location: Open space at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child block building and watching TV.
description: Accompanied his daughter Hanhan in playing with building blocks on the living room sofa. Hanhan built a “pyramid” and asked to take a photo. Xuanxuan sat nearby watching cartoons.
location: Living room, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking a shower and organizing work documents
description: First take a shower, then sit down at the computer desk in the living room and organize the hazard photos taken during today's inspection and the memo notes from his phone into the "May 2025 Inspection" folder on the computer.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening leisure and preparations for bed.
description: Leaning on the sofa, he browsed the “Haikou Squash Enthusiasts” forum on his phone to learn basic movement corrections and energy distribution, and took screenshots to save the key points. He messaged his squash partner Lin Feng again to confirm the Wednesday evening session, and Lin Feng replied that it was no problem. Then he checked his and Xuanxuan's sneakers and sweat-wicking T-shirts, and packed water bottles and snacks into a canvas bag, preparing for tomorrow's sports meet. After that, he went to the kitchen to wash dishes and wipe the countertop. Finally, he returned to the bedroom, charged his phone, and leaned against the headboard watching short videos for a few minutes to relax. He chatted with his wife, who was applying a face mask, about tomorrow's sports meet schedule, set the alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early-morning weigh-in, breakfast, and getting ready to go out.
description: Woke up at exactly 7 a.m., weighed 71.4 kg on the digital scale in the living room, up 0.3 kg from yesterday. Then opened the memo on his phone and created "Diet Log 2025-05-05", took photos of the Hainan rice noodles and boiled eggs that his wife Wang Lijuan was cooking in the kitchen, estimated the calories, and recorded them. During breakfast, the family of four sat around the table. Lu Mingqiang discussed improving the family diet plan with his wife and decided to go to the vegetable market together later to buy more sea fish and green vegetables. After the meal, he wiped down the commonly used adjustable wrench and screwdriver and put them into a canvas tool bag, preparing for the day's outings and activities.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Walked to the market with my wife to buy ingredients
description: Lu Mingqiang carried an empty cloth bag and set out with his wife Wang Lijuan from Banshan Garden, walking along Jinmao Middle Road for about 20 minutes to the Longhua District farmers' market. In the seafood section, Lu Mingqiang actively guided his wife in choosing live sea bass, squid, and fresh shrimp, suggesting light cooking methods such as steaming. In the vegetable section, they bought sweet potato leaves, tomatoes, and scallions. When passing the pork stall, his wife initially wanted to buy pork belly, but Lu Mingqiang persuaded her to buy pork tenderloin instead, to make steamed egg with minced meat for the children. Throughout the process, the two chatted and laughed, and his wife expressed support for the healthy eating attempt.
location: Longhua District Farmers' Market, No. 68 Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home, put away the ingredients, and wake my son to change and prepare for the sports meet.
description: After buying groceries, Lu Mingqiang walked back to the Banshan Garden home. He helped his wife salt the sea bass and wrap it in plastic wrap, and portioned and stored the sweet potato leaves and tomatoes. As they tidied up in the kitchen, they discussed the benefits of a low-oil, low-salt diet for weight control and the children's health. His wife agreed to look up healthy recipes online. Then Lu Mingqiang went into the bedroom, woke up Lu Zixuan, the eldest son who was still lying in bed, and Lu Zihan, the younger son who was sound asleep, and told them that today they would go to the elder brother's school for the parent-child sports meet. The children excitedly started changing into their sports clothes and finding their sneakers.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an electric bike to school and participated in the parent-child sports meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bicycle with his two sons and arrived at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School in about 15 minutes. On the playground he first took part in the three-legged race with his eldest son Lu Zixuan; the father and son cooperated well and won second place in their group. Then they took part in the sack race, with Lu Mingqiang cheering them on from the side. The younger son Lu Zihan played on the lawn with his mother Wang Lijuan, who had caught up on foot, and clapped and laughed when he saw his dad and brother competing. During the sports meet, Lu Mingqiang used his phone to take many photos to record these parent-child moments, and the whole family was happy together.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycled home and had a light lunch together
description: After the sports meet, the family rode an electric bike back to Banshan Garden. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared steamed egg with minced pork, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and chicken soup made from yesterday's leftover chicken, with steamed rice as the staple. Lu Mingqiang served food to his two sons; his own bowl was mainly vegetables, and he only had a small bowl of chicken soup. As usual, he took photos of the meal with his phone and estimated the following in his food diary: one serving of steamed egg with minced pork at 200 kcal, a large plate of stir-fried sweet potato leaves at 100 kcal, and one small bowl of chicken soup at 80 kcal, emphasizing that he kept to a low-fat diet.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon rest to regain energy.
description: After the meal, his wife cleared the dishes, and Lu Mingqiang arranged for their two sons to play in their own room for half an hour before taking a nap. He went back to the master bedroom, drew the curtains, lay on the bed with his eyes closed to rest, and soon fell sound asleep, storing up energy for the afternoon's parent-child activity and community service.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon parent-child activities and community fitness equipment maintenance
description: After the lunch break ended, Lu Mingqiang woke up his son, took a water bottle and tool bag, and went downstairs. The younger son played on the slide in the children's play area, while Lu Mingqiang played badminton with the older son for 30 minutes on the open ground. Afterward, using his electrical skills, he walked to the public fitness area and carefully inspected each piece of equipment with an adjustable wrench. He found that the handle screw of a rowing machine was loose, skillfully tightened it, and confirmed it was secure. Neighbors around him cast approving glances.
location: Public area downstairs, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went home, showered, and organized photos of yesterday's work hazards.
description: He brought his two sons home and had them wash their hands and rest first. Lu Mingqiang went into the bathroom, quickly rinsed off the sweat with warm water, and changed into clean short sleeves and shorts. Then he sat down at the computer in the study and moved several photos of oxidized connectors taken with his phone during yesterday’s line inspection into the “2025-05-04 Hazard Record” folder, noting “Slight oxidation at the connector of the branch box on Jinmao-Guomao Yiheng Road, handled,” completing the archiving of the work documents.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare dinner ingredients and have a healthy dinner together
description: Lu Mingqiang entered the kitchen, took out the sea bass, sweet potato leaves, and tomatoes he had bought that morning from the refrigerator, skillfully scaled the fish, removed the innards, scored it, marinated it, and placed it on the steaming plate; he carefully washed the sweet potato leaves one by one. His wife Wang Lijuan simultaneously prepared tomato and egg soup, and the two chatted and laughed in the kitchen. The eldest son took his younger brother to watch cartoons in the living room. Dinner was on the table before 6 p.m.: steamed sea bass, garlic sweet potato leaves, tomato and egg soup, with multigrain rice mixed with millet and brown rice as the staple. Lu Mingqiang picked fish meat for the children, praised his wife's cooking after tasting it, and continued taking photos and estimating calories (half a steamed sea bass about 150 kcal, sweet potato leaves 80 kcal, egg soup 60 kcal, small bowl of multigrain rice 150 kcal), totaling about 440 kcal, nearly 200 kcal less than usual, and felt pleased with his diet control results.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Watching TV with the children and reading together
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa with Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan snuggled beside him. At the older boy's request, they first watched two episodes of Super Wings, and then he found the picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar for the younger one. He read it aloud word by word, pointing at the text, while the older brother listened curiously at his side. His wife Wang Lijuan cleared the table and did housework nearby. Simple companionship immersed the father and his two sons in warm moments.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organized the day's diet records and reviewed advanced electrical knowledge.
description: His wife took the two children to take a bath. Lu Mingqiang went into the study, opened the memo app on his phone, compiled the detailed calories and dishes of breakfast, lunch, and dinner into a table, calculated the total calories for the day, and wrote down his thoughts on diet control. Then he took the textbook Senior Electrician Technician Exam Study Guide from the bookshelf, turned to the chapter Transformer Differential Protection, and read carefully for about 50 minutes, continuing to recharge for professional skill improvement.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take a shower and prepare work equipment for the next day
description: Lu Mingqiang took a shower in the bathroom and changed into a clean undershirt and shorts. He took out the work pants and work clothes to wear to work tomorrow from the wardrobe, hung them on the clothes rack by the headboard, and put his keys, phone charger, and work badge on the nightstand. Finally, he checked the tool cabinet to make sure all tools were back in place, ensuring everything was ready for Monday's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening couple communication and pre-bedtime relaxation
description: Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard and browsed industry forums on his phone, watching a squash technique video sent by his squash buddy Lin Feng. After his wife Wang Lijuan finished the housework and lay down as well, the two chatted about their experiences during the day. Lu Mingqiang thanked his wife for cooperating with the dietary adjustments, shared his progress in weight control, and discussed the next day's work schedule and Wednesday evening's squash appointment with Lin Feng. At around 9:30 PM they said goodnight to each other, turned off the light, and went to bed. Faint light from outside filtered through the curtains. Lu Mingqiang soon fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment, ending this ordinary but warm day.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: The familiar alarm sounded, and a new day began. As usual, Lu Mingqiang stood barefoot on the electronic scale in the bedroom. The display settled at 71.2 kg, down 0.2 kg from yesterday. The effect of sticking to a light diet and morning runs this weekend was immediate. He nodded with satisfaction, changed into his workout clothes, and got ready to go out.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and ran into a fellow runner
description: It took 16 minutes to drive from Banshan Garden to Baishamen Park. The morning sea breeze carried a salty, damp smell. Lu Mingqiang jogged along the park's rubberized track, keeping a steady pace of about 6:15 per kilometer. At the third bend, he met his old running buddy Chen Bin. They ran side by side and chatted. Chen Bin praised him: "Mingqiang, the weight you posted on Moments is really inspiring. Even my wife saw it and pushed me to learn from you!" Lu Mingqiang smiled and shared his tips on eating less oil and salt and doing more cardio.
location: Baishamen Park, No. 6 Renmin Avenue, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Commute home and personal tidying
description: After finishing his morning run, Lu Mingqiang drove back and returned to Banshan Garden about 19 minutes later. He took a quick warm shower and changed into a clean dark blue work uniform, with the words “Haikou Electric Power” prominently printed on the chest.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and family interaction
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: a pot of steaming sweet potato porridge, boiled eggs, and a small plate of homemade pickled cabbage. While eating, Lu Mingqiang peeled an egg for his younger son Lu Zihan, while his older son Lu Zixuan excitedly talked about the science animation he had watched the night before. His wife reminded him that the pork ribs bought yesterday were in the fridge and could be stewed into soup in the evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Lu Mingqiang packed up his tool bag and called his two sons downstairs. To save time and make sure he arrived at work on time, he decided to first go to the Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, which was closer to home. He arrived at 7:46, handed his younger son Lu Zihan to the teacher, and told him to listen to the auntie. Then he drove for 16 minutes and arrived at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 8:00. He watched his elder son Lu Zixuan walk through the school gate before leaving with peace of mind.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to company
description: From Meilan District, he headed west along Binhai Avenue and turned onto Haisheng Road. About 19 minutes later, he arrived at today's work site — Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. He parked in the lot, grabbed his tool bag and water cup from the passenger seat.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift preparation
description: Arriving at the workshop early, he neatly arranged his work uniform and safety helmet. He opened the toolbox, carefully checked and lined up the wrenches, test pens, screwdrivers, and multimeter he might need today, making sure everything was in order. He walked to the team office, greeted colleagues such as Chen Jianguo as they arrived one after another, and waited energetically for the morning meeting.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Attended the morning meeting and was named an outstanding employee.
description: The morning meeting began. After Team Leader Zhang finished the roll call, he cleared his throat and announced, “Last month, Comrade Lu Mingqiang completed his regular duties outstandingly while participating in company training. Through the team's recommendation and the company's assessment, he has been named Employee of the Month!” Warm applause broke out in the meeting room. Team Leader Zhang took 300 yuan in cash from a red envelope and handed it to him in front of everyone. Lu Mingqiang stood up a little shyly, took it, and said with a smile, “Thank you, Team Leader and brothers, for the recognition. I'll continue to work hard!”
location: Conference Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going out to replace the electricity meter box and carry out inspections
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang and his partner Chen Jianguo packed their tool bags and drove the company's electric power engineering pickup truck to Jinding Building on Jinding Road in Xiuying District. The main task today was to replace an aging meter box on the third floor of the commercial building. The two worked well together. Chen Jianguo handled the power shutdown and safety monitoring, while Lu Mingqiang skillfully removed the old box, installed the new one, and rechecked the wiring. After finishing, they also inspected a secondary branch box along the same line and performed temperature checks to make sure nothing was abnormal.
location: Jinding Building, No. 160 Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: After finishing the morning's work, the two drove back to near the industrial park and went to their usual “Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant.” Lu Mingqiang ordered a spicy soup with pork offal over rice plus a fried egg, while Chen Jianguo had salted fish and eggplant clay pot rice. They ate and chatted about the morning's work. Chen Jianguo teased, “What about that 300 yuan bonus from this morning? Shouldn't you show a little appreciation tonight?” Lu Mingqiang smiled and shook his head: “It has to be handed over to the leadership first. Adding an extra dish on the weekend counts as treating you all.”
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company break room. He leaned back in the chair, took out his phone and browsed a few technical posts on an electrician forum, then looked at a photo of a vintage 80s liquor that Lao Chen had just posted in the baijiu bottle collecting group, and casually gave it a like. After resting for about 20 minutes, he felt refreshed, got up, and poured a cup of water from the water dispenser.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon work: document organization and tool maintenance
description: There were no off-site assignments in the afternoon. He went to the office, logged into the company system, entered the operation data and inspection results from the morning's electricity meter box replacement, printed them, and filed them. Then he returned to the workshop, took out his toolbox, and counted and performed cleaning and maintenance on the wrenches he had used. During this time, the apprentice Zhao Qiang brought over a faulty contactor for advice, and Lu Mingqiang spent nearly an hour patiently disassembling it on the spot, explaining its working principle and common troubleshooting methods.
location: Office and workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the children after work
description: When it was time to get off work, Lu Mingqiang clocked out and drove away from the company. To save time, he first drove 19 minutes to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up Lu Zixuan, who had just finished school, then drove 16 minutes along the way to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Lu Zihan. The two children chattered away in the car, sharing funny things that had happened at school, and the car was filled with laughter and joy.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home and hand over the bonus.
description: Arriving home with the two children, Wang Lijuan, who was preparing dinner in the kitchen, came out to greet them. Lu Mingqiang changed into slippers, took the unopened red envelope from the pocket of his work clothes, and handed it to Wang Lijuan, saying with a smile, 'Juanzi, this month's Outstanding Employee Award, 300 yuan, still warm.' Wang Lijuan took the envelope, opened it, and looked at it. With a smile in her eyes, she said, 'That's really nice! I didn't expect your company to be so generous. Then this weekend I'll buy some extra pork ribs and a sea bass to add a dish for the kids and you, and we'll have a good celebration!'
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: The family sat around the dining table for dinner. On the table were stir-fried baby bok choy, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and a plate of steamed cured sausage carefully prepared by Wang Lijuan. During the meal, Lu Zixuan excitedly talked about being praised by his teacher in math class today, while Lu Zihan sang in a childish voice the nursery rhyme "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" he had just learned at kindergarten. Lu Mingqiang also told his wife in detail about winning the award that morning. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Homework guidance and parent-child time.
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang cleared the table and sat down in the study to help Lu Zixuan finish today's Chinese homework—a picture-based writing exercise. He patiently guided his son to observe the details in the picture and used the formula "who + where + what + what result" to help him organize his language. His son quickly got the idea. Meanwhile, Wang Lijuan was in the living room with Lu Zihan, playing with building blocks and watching "PAW Patrol".
location: Study and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Review senior electrician technician exam materials
description: After the homework tutoring, Lu Zixuan also went to the living room to watch TV with his younger brother. Lu Mingqiang returned to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and took out the textbook *Power System Relay Protection (for Senior Technicians)* from the drawer. He opened it to the place marked with a folded corner last time and began to carefully study the section on the setting calculation of transformer differential protection. He drew key formulas and points in his notebook with a red pen, and from time to time worked out calculations on paper. To achieve his goal of obtaining the certificate within three years, he persisted in studying every day.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and family communication
description: Closing the book, Lu Mingqiang stretched. He walked out of the study and saw that his two children had already brushed their teeth, accompanied by his wife. He said goodnight to the children and chatted with his wife for a while. He mentioned that he had arranged to play squash with Lin Feng tomorrow, Wednesday evening, so she didn't need to wait for him for dinner. Wang Lijuan nodded and reminded him not to play too late and to remember to bring protective gear and a towel. Then Lu Mingqiang went to take a shower and wash up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Browsed his phone before going to bed.
description: Lu Mingqiang lay down on the bed and looked at his phone for a few minutes. He sent a WeChat message to Lin Feng to confirm the time and place for tomorrow's squash game, then browsed the baijiu bottle collection group. Seeing a photo Old Chen had just posted of a bottle of baijiu from the 1980s with an antique-style bottle design, he casually liked it and commented, "Nice one!"
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: Sleepiness came over him. Lu Mingqiang turned off the desk lamp and put his phone on the nightstand. Closing his eyes, he reviewed the fulfilling day—the joy of the morning run, the pride of winning the award, the warmth of family, and the richness of study. With a slight sense of accomplishment, he soon fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: After the alarm went off at 6:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang did not go out for a run. Instead, he weighed himself on the bedroom floor and was 71.1 kg. Then on the balcony he used a foam roller to relax his back and shoulder blades, and did shoulder external and internal rotation stretches to prepare for the evening squash session. Afterwards he washed up and checked his sports bag in the entryway, which contained a spare racket, towel, change of clothes, and a large-capacity water bottle. At 7:10 he walked into the living room. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared meat buns, white congee, and pickled vegetables for breakfast. During breakfast, Mingqiang told Juanzi that he planned to get a 1,200-yuan six-month squash membership with his colleague Lin Feng at noon, and would probably be home around 9 p.m. after practice. Juanzi didn't say much, only helped their younger son Hanhan wipe his mouth. Mingqiang took a folding umbrella from his bag and put it in his work clothes pocket in case of rain. The whole process balanced personal health and family communication.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take eldest son to school
description: At 7:35, Lu Mingqiang put on his work clothes, went downstairs, got into his car, and set off for school with his eldest son, Lu Zixuan. He drove along Jinmao Middle Road and turned onto Longkun North Road, chatting with his son while dealing with the morning rush-hour traffic and asking whether the homework was difficult. At 7:55 they arrived at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. He told his son to rest after lunch, watched him enter the school gate, then turned the car around and headed to the company.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

name: Morning workshop maintenance and hidden hazard investigation.
description: At 8:10, Lu Mingqiang arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, changed into work clothes and insulating shoes, then met up with colleague Chen Jianguo and accepted the task assigned by team leader Zhang: go to Jinding Building to investigate abnormal noises from the public electricity meter boxes. At 8:25, the two drove there in the company service vehicle. They arrived at Jinding Building at 8:35 and split up to check the terminal connections of the meter boxes in each building, measuring current and voltage. While working until 10:00, they found a main switch terminal in Building B was overheating, tightened it with a wrench, and recorded it in the log. At 10:40, they completed the electrical and plumbing inspection of the entire building, then communicated daily precautions with the property manager. At 11:00, they packed up tools and signed off, returned to the park at 11:10, arrived at 11:25, and then stood by in the park. The whole morning was spent handling equipment hazards to ensure the building's electrical safety.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Jinding Building, No. 160 Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District

name: Get a squash membership card, have lunch, and discuss the family budget.
description: At 12:05 noon, Lu Mingqiang drove directly to Guomao Avenue, Longhua District to meet Lin Feng. At 12:20, the two entered the squash club together. Through Lin Feng's introduction, Mingqiang talked with the manager, chose a six-month membership, and paid 1,200 yuan. He entered his personal information and fingerprint, and confirmed a fixed court every Wednesday night at 8 p.m. After completing the procedures, Lin Feng left to teach a class, and Mingqiang walked about 12 minutes to the nearby Wudao Yimian at 12:50, ordering a signature yimian and a bowl of conch soup for lunch. During the meal, he sent a WeChat message to his wife Juanzi saying that he had gotten the membership and the fee was deducted from his salary card. His wife replied that she supported his playing but suggested saving money on weekend eating out and Laobacha, and asked him to watch his weight. Mingqiang promised to eat at home for the next two months, which would go along with evening ball practice to control his intake. At 13:35, he checked out and left, walked back to the parking lot, and drove back to the industrial park at 13:40. This event involved sports investment and family financial consultation, balancing personal hobbies and family expenses.
location: The Guomao Avenue Squash Club, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the nearby Wudao Yimian restaurant.

name: Afternoon work log and skills review
description: At 13:55, Lu Mingqiang returned to the office. After making tea, he started sorting out the electronic ledger for the morning inspection of Jinding Building, recording in detail the hazard descriptions, handling measures, and part models, which took half an hour. Starting at 14:30, he took out the exam materials for the senior electrician technician certificate and focused on reviewing the variable-frequency speed regulation principle in 'Electric Drive Automatic Control System,' drawing control diagrams in his notebook. During that time, he found a moment to instruct his apprentice Zhao Qiang on repairing an electric fan, explaining motor winding connections and capacitor selection. At 17:00, he tidied up his tools and desk, and at 17:15, he changed into casual clothes and clocked out. In the afternoon, he combined practical operation records with theoretical study to strengthen his professional abilities.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Gone home after work and had dinner with the family.
description: At 17:30, Lu Mingqiang drove home from the industrial park. At the entrance of the residential area, he bought enoki mushrooms and cilantro at the 1+1 Fresh Supermarket, planning to add them to the pork bone soup his wife might be simmering that evening. At 17:55, when he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was stir-frying bitter melon with fermented black beans and stir-fried bean sprouts, and had reheated the leftover braised pork from the morning. At 18:00, the family sat down to eat. Mingqiang had a bowl of rice, mainly eating the bitter melon and bean sprouts, and only tasted one piece of braised pork. During the meal, he told his two sons he would be going to play squash in the evening, and reminded them to listen to their mother, finish their homework first, and then watch cartoons. The whole dinner was warm and cozy, balancing family discipline with his diet control.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-departure preparation and pre-training warm-up
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes, then went back to the bedroom to wash his face, changed into his workout suit and running shoes, and checked again the racket, towel, change of clothes, and lemon water in his sports bag, and made sure his phone was fully charged for shooting. At 18:50 he said goodbye to his wife, drove for 15 minutes, and arrived at the squash club parking lot at 19:05. Inside the club, he first jogged to warm up until slightly sweaty, then completed 10 minutes of dynamic stretching (lunge leg presses, torso twists, shoulder circles), and finally did air swing practice with the racket, focusing on the grip and contact point of backhand strokes, preparing for the upcoming lesson. The whole process was tightly connected and focused on self-adjustment.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to the Squash Club on Guomao Avenue, Longhua District

name: First squash backhand special training
description: 20:00 Lu Mingqiang started a squash training session with coach Lin Feng at Court 4. For the first 10 minutes they did forehand rally warm-up, then spent 40 minutes focusing on backhand technique: Lin Feng broke down the grip (thumb pressed against the racket handle), turning the body to swing, contact point and follow-through, and used his phone to video and replay in slow motion for analysis. Mingqiang, while panting, jotted down key points in his phone memo such as turn upper body early and tighten wrist at the moment of impact. After practice, he could consistently hit more than 3 placement shots with his backhand, and his movement was noticeably smoother. In the last 10 minutes, the two played a friendly match to reinforce feel. At 21:00, drenched in sweat, he ended the session and agreed to meet Lin Feng again next week. This session significantly boosted his backhand confidence and skill.
location: Court 4, Squash Club, Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, tidy up, and have a family evening talk.
description: After training ended at 21:00, Lu Mingqiang showered and changed at the club, rolled up his wet jersey and put it in his backpack. At 21:30 he drove home, and on the way used his phone to record voice memos with key backhand technique points: "not enough shoulder rotation, thumb pressing against the racket, low balls." At 21:45 he got home; his wife Wang Lijuan was still folding clothes in the living room, and his two sons were already asleep. He put down his sports bag and drank some water, then went into the study, took out his sports notebook, drew a four-step breakdown of the backhand with a red pen, and wrote down the power-generation mnemonic. He also made an extra practice plan of 100 shadow swings every night for the next week. His wife brought him warm water and teased him for being so serious. Mingqiang shared the joy of his breakthrough, and the two of them soaked the sportswear and tidied up the toys together. At 22:45 Mingqiang felt muscle soreness but was fulfilled inside. He set the alarm for 6:30 the next day, turned off the lights at 22:50, and fell asleep peacefully at 23:00. The day ended with self-improvement and family warmth.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning weigh-in, exercise, and preparations
description: After the phone alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up and stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 71.0 kg; the steady downward trend put him in a good mood. He washed his face with cold water in the bathroom to wake himself up, then spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 30 minutes of core strength training, including sit-ups, planks, and squats, which effectively relieved the stiffness in his shoulders and neck. After training, he took a hot shower, changed into clean blue work clothes, went to the kitchen to drink warm water, and checked the meat buns in the refrigerator.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community (No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Wake up the children, have breakfast, and get ready to go out.
description: Lu Mingqiang first woke up his eldest son Lu Zixuan and urged him to brush his teeth and wash his face, then dressed his younger son Lu Zihan. His wife Wang Lijuan had steamed meat buns and white porridge in the kitchen, and the family of four sat around the dining table and quickly finished breakfast. He told Lu Zixuan to mark the long division problems in his math homework that he didn't understand and that he would help him in the evening. He also checked both children's schoolbags and prepared raincoats.
location: Children's room and dining room at home; Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Rode an e-bike to take the two children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang put on a rain poncho, rode his electric bike to first take Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and watched him enter. Then he turned around and rode along Longkun South Road and Haifu Road, arriving at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road in Meilan District. At the school gate, he again urged Lu Zixuan to listen carefully in class, and only left with relief after watching him walk through the school gate.
location: From Banshan Garden, first go to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province), then go to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Drive to the company
description: Starting from Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, Lu Mingqiang drove along Haifu Road, Longkun South Road, and Nanhai Avenue for about 20 minutes, arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park on Haisheng Road in Xiuying District.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

Squad Leader Zhang stressed the need to continue the re-inspection of the Jinding Building power distribution room and arranged for Lu Mingqiang to work with Chen Jianguo.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, company meeting room (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Morning inspection of the power distribution room and branch box maintenance at Jinding Building
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo drove to Jinding Building to recheck the main switch terminal posts in Building B. They used an infrared thermometer to confirm the temperature was normal. Then they separately inspected the branch boxes on floors 1 through 3. Lu Mingqiang found a cable connector with slight oxidation, sanded it with sandpaper, applied conductive paste, and made a record.
location: Jinding Building (No. 160, Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: Midday individual income tax annual settlement and guidance for a colleague
description: After returning to the company at 11:45, Lu Mingqiang sat down at his workstation and opened the individual income tax app to check the special additional deduction information for children's education, support for the elderly, and other items. After submitting, he found that he was due a tax refund of 120 yuan, and excitedly took a screenshot and sent it to the work group's WeChat chat. Then Chen Jianguo called to ask for advice, so Lu Mingqiang walked over and guided him through the filing step by step. Chen Jianguo found that he could get a refund of 80 yuan. Apprentice Zhao Qiang also came to ask about the housing rent deduction item. Lu Mingqiang helped him analyze it and guided him to contact the landlord to verify the information, and finally the filing was completed successfully.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, company workstation (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Lunch and shopping on the way.
description: After finishing the tax rebate matters, Lu Mingqiang walked with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. He ordered the signature spicy soup rice with Chinese sausage. While eating, he discussed the afternoon work schedule with Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang expressed thanks for the tax rebate help. After the meal, he stopped by the Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store on the way and bought a pack of cigarettes.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (No. 56-4, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road), and on the way went to the Bianli Life convenience store near the entrance to Haixiu Expressway.

name: Work break and lunch break
description: After returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang lay on a chair in the rest room for half an hour, resting his eyes and recharging for the afternoon's work.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, company break room (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: In the afternoon, organize inspection ledgers and discuss work plans.
