Then Chen Jianguo came to find him, and the two discussed tomorrow's work plan based on this week's inspection, listing key sites to check. At around 16:30, Team Leader Zhang came over to confirm the plan details and gave safety instructions.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, company workstation and office (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Pick up the eldest son from school after work and buy breakfast bread.
description: At 17:00, Lu Mingqiang clocked out on time and drove to Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way, he passed a bakery, stopped, and bought two cream buns as the children's breakfast for tomorrow. He arrived at the school gate around 17:20, waited about ten minutes, picked up Lu Zixuan, and the father and son went home chatting and laughing.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province), passing by a bakery (not specifically named).

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: After returning home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up their younger son Lu Zihan and arrived home first. After greeting his wife and children, Lu Mingqiang took Lu Zixuan into the study to check his homework and found three mistakes in vertical division problems. He patiently drew diagrams on scratch paper to explain the principle that 'division is equal sharing' until Lu Zixuan truly understood.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Family dinner and household chores
description: Wang Lijuan made steamed tilapia, garlic water spinach, and pork rib soup. The family of four sat around the table, and Lu Mingqiang asked the two boys about school while eating. After the meal, he took the initiative to help clear the dishes, wipe the table, and take out the trash.
location: Home dining room and kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Community (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Family parent-child time
description: After tidying up, the family of four gathered in the living room. Lu Mingqiang suggested first watching 15 minutes of the animated series Super Wings together, then he and his two sons built a block castle on the carpet, having a great time.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Put the younger son to sleep and remind the eldest son to pack his schoolbag
description: After Wang Lijuan bathed Lu Zihan, Lu Mingqiang picked up the picture book "The Very Hungry Caterpillar" and told him a story, then held him and paced gently around the room, humming a Hainan lullaby until he fell asleep. Afterwards he went to the study to urge Lu Zixuan to pack his schoolbag himself and confirm that the math textbook and homework notebooks were all brought.
location: Bedroom and study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Evening study and self-improvement: reading maintenance notes.
description: After the children quieted down, Lu Mingqiang brewed a cup of tea. In the study, he took out Master Li's electrical maintenance notebook and, based on the connector oxidation problem encountered during the day's inspection, wrote in his own notebook: "For oxidation treatment of wiring terminals, in addition to sanding and applying paste, you can try coating a layer of petroleum jelly for moisture protection; the effect needs to be verified." He then compared and analyzed similar cases in the notebook, marked two points of doubt, and filled two full pages of notes.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Bedtime preparations and couple's evening talk
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, with the lights off, Lu Mingqiang quietly said to Wang Lijuan that today's tax refund was 120 yuan and he would give it to her tomorrow noon for groceries. He also suggested taking the two children to Evergreen Park to fly kites if the weather was nice over the weekend. Wang Lijuan agreed and planned to prepare some food.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: Falling asleep
description: As they chatted, drowsiness crept in. Lu Mingqiang said goodnight to Wang Lijuan and soon fell asleep, ending a full and contented day.
location: Home bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: The alarm went off at 05:50. He sat up gently without waking Juanzi beside him. He sat still at the edge of the bed for half a minute to clear his head, feeling the soreness in his shoulders. Thinking about today's mock exam, he decided to go for a run and release the pressure. He changed into his workout clothes and running shoes, drank half a glass of warm water, secured his phone in the armband, and quietly left the house. The scale showed 71.0 kg.
location: Room 702, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Morning run to release stress
description: I jogged from Banshan Garden to the park in about five minutes. On the park trail, I increased my cadence and used 40 minutes of aerobic exercise to release the pent-up feelings of the past few days. The wind blew on my face, and my mind gradually emptied. Halfway through the run, I ran into an acquaintance, old Chen (a retired cadre), who was also there for morning exercise. We ran side by side for five minutes. He asked me if I had been busy lately. I simply said, "I'm busy preparing for the technician exam." He encouraged me. At 6:40, feeling in good shape, I stretched for five minutes and then jogged home.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road (adjacent to Longkun North Road), Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Preparing breakfast and learning the test results
description: I got home at 06:45, took a shower, and felt much more refreshed. The scale showed 70.7 kg. I went to the kitchen, cooked plain congee, fried three eggs, and heated up the char siu buns bought yesterday. At 7:00 Juanzi came out to help make soy milk. At 7:10 I called the two children to get up and watched them wash up. During breakfast, Xuanxuan slowly took out his math test paper from his backpack: 82 points. I couldn't help furrowing my brow. Pointing at the calculation mistake, I said, "Xuanxuan, losing points on this kind of calculation problem isn't worth it. After you correct it today, Dad will watch you do two more similar problems when he comes back in the evening." I was worried about the exam, so I didn't speak too harshly, just told him to tuck the test paper into his textbook. Hanhan, sitting nearby scooping soy milk with a small spoon, saw her brother being scolded and obediently lowered her head to eat.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: At 07:20, after he got ready, he put thin jackets on the two children. He got on the electric bike, first dropped Hanhan off at Jinmao Center Kindergarten on the way, and watched him being led through the gate by the teacher. Then he turned around, went north along Longkun South Road, and arrived at Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 07:40. Xuanxuan jumped off the bike, and I told him, “Remember to find your mistake notebook and review it yourself at noon.” He nodded and ran into the school gate.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and purchasing supplies
description: Set out from school, took Haifu Road onto Haixiu Middle Road, and headed all the way west. There was heavy traffic, but I was thinking over today's work in my mind. At 08:10, I arrived at the industrial park. At the "Convenient Life" convenience store on the roadside, I bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of cigarettes, and said hi to the clerk Azhen.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team morning meeting and on-site work (distribution cabinet installation)
description: 08:20 arrived at the team, changed into work clothes. Team Leader Zhang held the morning meeting and stressed that today we needed to finish installing the main power distribution cabinet in Building 3 of the new Binhai New Village residential area. Jianguo and I were in one group; at 08:35 we loaded the tools and set off in the company's pickup truck. We arrived at the site at 09:00, coordinated the position with the civil construction contractor, and started working. This job required focus, so I pulled myself together, but my mind still wandered a bit. While connecting the main incoming line, the thought of Xuanxuan's test paper and tomorrow's exam flashed through my mind, and before I knew it, I connected the phase sequence of the A and B phase busbars in reverse. Fortunately, Jianguo was sharp-eyed during the recheck and immediately pointed it out: "Brother Ming, that's wrong—look at the phase meter!" I took a look and nearly broke out in a cold sweat. I quickly dismantled it and reconnected it, apologizing repeatedly: "Old Chen, I'm sorry, I was distracted!" Jianguo patted me on the shoulder: "Buddy, the exam is tomorrow, don't think too much; get to work first." I steadied myself and didn't dare get distracted again. Jianguo and I worked smoothly together, and by 11:30 the cabinet was installed and passed the temporary power-on test on the first try.
location: A residential development under construction in Binhai New Village, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch at the work site and a brief rest.
description: As soon as the work was done, I felt hungry. At 12:00, I drove back from the Binhai Xincun construction site with Jianguo and Xiao Zhao to near the industrial park. We parked the pickup truck at the company and walked two minutes to this 'Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice (Xianghe Jiayuan Branch)'. We each ordered a spicy soup rice with a fried egg, and with the shop's free sea snail soup, we ate heartily. After the meal, I used the excuse of going to the pharmacy across the street to buy cooling balm, and sent Juanzi a WeChat message: 'The work is done. I'm going back to the company in the afternoon. We'll talk about Xuanxuan's matter tonight.' I also went over the relay protection calculation formulas for tomorrow's exam in my head.
location: Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice (Xianghe Jiayuan Branch), No. 8 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Rest and recharge during the lunch break.
description: At 12:50, he returned to the company workshop, leaned back in the worn sofa chair in the rest area, put his cap over his face, and dozed for 30 minutes. He got up at 13:20, feeling much refreshed.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company to organize the ledgers and cram the key points before the exam.
description: Got up at 13:20 and felt a bit better. There were no urgent field tasks in the afternoon. I first washed my face, then went back to the office, turned on the computer, and added this morning's installation records to the electronic ledger. I also wrote down the incident where I nearly connected the phase sequence incorrectly, as a reminder to myself. At 14:00, I took the review materials for tomorrow's mock exam out of my toolbox—a dog-eared copy of Relay Protection Setting Calculation and a handwritten formula notebook. I didn't plan to go through it from the beginning today; instead, I focused on cracking a formula I had gotten wrong in the last mock questions: the setting of the ratio restraint coefficient for transformer differential protection. I worked it out three times on scratch paper until I confirmed that every step was clear. At 15:30, Xiao Zhao came over to ask about a parameter for a new smart circuit breaker; I spent 15 minutes explaining it to him with the help of drawings. After 16:00, I took out Master Li's handwritten notes again and carefully reviewed a case analysis of a main transformer overcurrent protection maloperation, drawing a mind map in my notebook. At 17:20, I packed up my things and clocked out.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up Xuanxuan from school and buy groceries on the way.
description: Set off on the electric bike at 17:30, arrived at the gate of Experimental Primary School at 18:00, and picked up Xuanxuan. On the way, he asked him: 'Did you review the wrong questions on the math test paper?' He said he had. He made a soft 'mm' sound and did not ask further, thinking he would talk about it at home. At 18:15, he stopped by the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket at the entrance of Banshan Garden, bought the loofah and tofu Juanzi had asked for, and picked a fresh golden pomfret to steam. Since it was within walking distance, he had Xuanxuan wait at the door and went in to buy quickly.
location: 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store)

name: Family dinner and homework tutoring
description: Got home at 18:30; Juanzi was already cooking. I put down the groceries, first scooped up Hanhan who ran over for a hug, lifted him high and spun around, making him giggle. Then I helped marinate the fish and prepared the seasonings. Dinner was at 18:50. At the table, Juanzi couldn't help bringing up Xuanxuan's grades again. I stopped her with a look: "Let's not talk about this at dinner; I'll talk to him later." After eating, I cleared the dishes into the kitchen. At 19:15, I sat down next to Xuanxuan and had him spread out his math test paper. With a red pen, I wrote the correct calculation steps next to the wrong questions, then flipped through the textbook and made up three similar three-digit multiplication and division problems. I watched him finish them all correctly. I breathed a sigh of relief and patted his head: "See, you can get them right if you're careful. Okay, go play."
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child interaction and household chores
description: Xuanxuan went to play with LEGO by himself. I accompanied Hanhan on the living room floor mat for half an hour with building blocks; the little one built a crooked tower and insisted it was “Daddy's power station.” At 20:10, Juanzi bathed the two children one by one. I used this time to push the electric bike onto the balcony, wipe the body clean with a cloth, and check the tire pressure. At 20:30, I went to the balcony and put the empty beer bottles and mineral water bottles I had been saving for two days into a woven bag, planning to take them to the community recycling station tomorrow.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Couple's late-night talk: their child's education and tomorrow's exam.
description: At 20:40, the kids were already in bed; Hanhan fell asleep quickly, but Xuanxuan was still tossing and turning. At 21:00, I went to the kitchen, boiled some water, poured a cup for Juanzi and myself, and walked into the bedroom. Juanzi was leaning against the headboard. I spoke first: “Juan, Xuanxuan’s math grade has dropped this time. We can’t just blame the child. I’ve been focused on the exam lately and really haven’t given him enough attention.” Juanzi sighed: “He has been a bit distracted while doing homework recently, always thinking about watching TV. Tomorrow after your exam, the day after tomorrow is Saturday—you should have a good talk with him.” I nodded and said, “Mm. I’ll finish my mock exam tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow is Saturday. I’ll set aside half a day to take him to Wanlv Garden to fly kites and have an open chat.”
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Final sprint before the exam and feeling unprepared.
description: At 21:30, Juanzi went to bed first. I walked into the study, turned on the desk lamp, feeling somewhat heavy-hearted. I gathered the admission ticket, ID card, calculator, two black gel pens, and a pencil needed for tomorrow's exam and put them in a document file. Then I opened 'Relay Protection Setting Calculation' again and quickly skimmed the 'ground fault protection' and 'overcurrent protection' sections most likely to appear on tomorrow's test, but I couldn't settle down, worried I might slip up on some detail. I wasn't efficient and felt restless after half an hour. I closed the book, picked up Master Li's notebook, flipped to tomorrow's exam points, and glanced at the typical wiring diagrams he had drawn. At 22:40, I rubbed my temples and thought, forget it, last-minute cramming can only do so much.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Alone with anxiety, tossing and turning in bed
description: At 22:50 I went to wash up and looked at myself in the mirror; I looked a bit tense. At 23:00 I lay down in bed, but my mind was racing — one moment it was Xuanxuan's test paper, the next the phase sequence that almost went wrong during the day, and then the formulas for tomorrow's exam. Juanzi was already fast asleep. I tossed and turned, afraid of making too much noise, so I just lay there staring at the ceiling, silently praying that tomorrow's exam would go smoothly. I don't know how long passed; only deep in the night did I finally drift off to sleep in a daze.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning preparations, and breakfast.
description: After being woken by the alarm at 6:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang had not slept soundly because he was preoccupied with the exam. On the balcony, he did a few simple stretches to loosen his shoulders and waist. While washing up, the sound of pattering rain outside the window reminded him that today would be a busy day, so he packed his raincoat, tool bag, admission ticket, and notebook in advance. Then he had breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan and his second son Lu Zihan: plain rice porridge, boiled eggs, and pickled cabbage. During the meal, his wife told him not to be nervous about the exam and asked him to take an extra umbrella; meanwhile, he flipped through his "Relay Protection Setting Calculation" notes and silently recited formulas he tended to forget. Four-year-old Hanhan was woken by the rain, so Lu Mingqiang gave him a quick hug and told him to listen to his mother. In his mind, he planned out the day: mock exam, visiting his master, inspecting the line, and a talk with his eldest son.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Send the younger son to kindergarten and head to the exam venue.
description: Helping Hanhan put on a raincoat in the rain, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike from Banshan Garden, turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Guomao Sanheng Road, and safely delivered Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handing her to the teacher on duty. Then he continued riding directly, turned from Guomao Sanheng Road onto Yusha Road, drove carefully on the slippery road, and finally arrived at the building of Fenbi Education (Haikou Campus) at 7:30 sharp, preparing for the upcoming mock exam.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, then to Fenbi Education (Haikou Branch) on Yusha Road.

name: Pre-exam preparation, check-in, and senior technician mock exam
description: After arriving at Fenbi Education (Haikou branch), he first got hot water from the water dispenser at the entrance and used the restroom to ease his nerves. After signing in, he entered the theory exam room and sat in the second-to-last row by the window. He placed his admission ticket and pen on the desk, looked around at the equally nervous examinees, and took deep breaths to calm his heartbeat. The exam started on time at 7:50. The questions generally matched the key areas he had reviewed the night before, but a few case-analysis questions about high-voltage tests were rather difficult, so he adjusted his strategy and first answered the questions he was confident about. He submitted his paper on time at 10:00. The score that appeared on the screen showed 58 points—not passing. His head buzzed, his palms sweated, and his heart felt as if it was being squeezed.
location: Fenbi Education (Haikou Branch), Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Post-mock-exam review, contacting colleagues, and going to Master Li's home.
description: After the exam, he sat alone in a corner of the corridor outside the examination room for 10 minutes, repeatedly recalling the questions he got wrong. After his emotions settled a bit, he used his phone to first send a WeChat message to his colleague Chen Jianguo to confirm the meeting point for the afternoon inspection, then called Team Leader Zhang. From him, he learned that it was only a placement test, which relieved him a little, but his inner sense of urgency only grew stronger. Then he rode his electric bike from Yusha Road, crossed streets, passed Haixiu Road, headed toward Haifu Road in Meilan District, and went to Master Li's home to seek advice.
location: From Fenbi Education (Haikou Branch) on Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Master Li's home on Haifu Road, Meilan District

name: Visited Master Li and received his handwritten notes
description: He knocked on Master Li's door on the third floor of the old work-unit dormitory on Haifu Road. Seeing how badly he looked, Master Li guessed he had failed the exam. After pouring out all his pressure and confusion, Master Li did not lecture him. Instead, he turned, went into the study, and came back holding a stack of notebooks with worn, frayed edges, and said solemnly: “This is my handwritten copy of 200 Cases of Common Substation Fault Troubleshooting. It's what I relied on when I took the technician exam back then. Take it home and work through it item by item.” His eyes felt hot as he took the heavy handwritten notebook with both hands. For the next half hour or so, Master Li used his own experience to explain several typical cases, which made his thinking much clearer.
location: Third floor, old work-unit dormitory near the south zone of CCCC Longqi Yayuan, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and contacting family
description: After saying goodbye to his mentor, he rode his electric bike back in the direction of Banshan Garden, passing Haisheng Road along the way, and had lunch at Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (Xianghe Jiayuan Branch). He ordered a signature spicy soup rice, plus a fried egg and sugarcane juice. While eating, he contacted his wife Wang Lijuan via WeChat video, told her that the exam did not go well but the mentor had been a great help, and asked about the lunch situation of his eldest son Xuanxuan, telling her not to worry about him.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 8 Haisheng Road, Xianghe Jiayuan, first floor, Sister's Spicy Soup Rice (Xianghe Jiayuan Branch)

name: Lunch break, organizing tools, and heading to the inspection assembly point.
description: After eating, he rode directly to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park Company. He sat in the rest area until 13:00, carefully placed the handwritten notes his mentor had given him into the innermost pocket of his tool bag, and checked and organized the flashlight, infrared thermometer, screwdriver, and other inspection tools. Then he sent Jianguo his location, confirming that he would arrive in about 20 minutes. After that, he walked to the breakfast shop at the entrance of the industrial park (near Yusha Road) to meet Jianguo. Along the way, he checked his backpack and planned the key inspection areas for the afternoon.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the breakfast shop near Yusha Road.

name: Worked overtime to inspect old electrical lines in Xiuying District.
description: Jianguo drove the company pickup truck to pick him up. As planned, they inspected distribution boxes in old residential communities on Haigang Road and Xiuhua Road in Xiuying District for hidden dangers in the rain. At a distribution box deep in an alley, they heard a slight 'sizzling' sound. When opened, they found a connector with poor contact due to oxidation. He then carefully polished the contact with sandpaper, retightened the screws, and sprayed on moisture-proof agent. Jianguo held the flashlight and passed tools beside him. After eliminating this potential tripping hazard, his mood improved considerably. They then checked two other locations, and everything was normal.
location: Distribution box locations in the old residential areas of Haigang Road and Xiuhua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finishing work and buying groceries on the way home
description: After the inspection, he and Jianguo parted ways at the roadside; Jianguo drove back to the company, while he rode his electric bike home. Before leaving, Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and encouraged him, 'Brother Qiang, all roads lead to Rome. Don't be too anxious.' He returned to Banshan Garden along Haigang Road, parked downstairs at the residential complex, and then dropped by the Jinmao Middle Road vegetable market, where he bought a fresh grass carp (to make the steamed fish his wife had been asking for), a bunch of water spinach, scallions, ginger, garlic, and a few tomatoes.
location: From Haigang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to the vegetable market on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Returning home to rest and take a short break.
description: Back at Banshan Garden, he first put the fish in the kitchen sink, then loudly greeted his wife who was cooking. He hugged Hanhan, who ran over, changed out of his damp work pants, drank a glass of water, and then went to the study to visit his eldest son, Xuanxuan, before the talk planned for the evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had an in-depth talk with his eldest son and helped him with his homework.
description: He went into the study, pulled over a chair, and sat next to Xuanxuan, saying frankly, "Xuanxuan, Dad failed his exam today too—he didn't pass the electrician's certificate test." After Xuanxuan showed a surprised expression, he continued, "But we're not afraid. Dad went to Grandpa Li, and he taught Dad a lot. Let's find the problems in your math together, okay?" Xuanxuan let down his guard and confessed that he found word problems very hard and couldn't understand the questions. So he opened his workbook, picked two typical problems, and taught him step by step how to analyze the meaning of the questions and find the equality relationships. After finishing, the two agreed to study an extra 20 minutes every night, and Xuanxuan's face relaxed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (Lu Zixuan's study)

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: His wife placed a piping hot steamed grass carp on the table, and the family sat around, all praising the fish for being fresh and sweet. At the table they shared funny moments from the day, and the atmosphere was warm. After dinner, he played with building blocks with his second son Hanhan on the living room carpet; Hanhan built a “big house where Daddy works,” while Xuanxuan sat nearby quietly reading a book. The family enjoyed a rare moment of togetherness.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Independent study and plan adjustment
description: After his wife got the children washed and put them to bed, he sat down at the desk and opened Master Li's notebook. The neat handwriting and clear diagrams on the yellowed pages lifted his spirits. He took out red and blue highlighters and, referring to the wrong answers from the mock exam, marked out the key points of the chapters in "Relay Protection" and "High Voltage Engineering". On a new sheet of paper, he drew a timeline for the rest of May and planned a two-stage review schedule: "Foundation Consolidation" (5.11-5.20) and "Case Breakthrough" (5.21-5.31). Around 9 p.m., he sent a message in the work group chat inviting Jianguo to go running at Wanlv Park the next morning.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Daily air swing practice and reflection
description: Following the set squash training plan, he fixed a marker on the study wall and did 100 backhand air swings with the racket in front of the mirror, feeling the power generation on every swing. After practice, he compared the wrong answers on the exam papers with the corresponding parts of his master's notes, reviewed the key points again, and felt his problem-solving thinking was clearer.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (study, balcony)

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: He took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. Though his heart still felt somewhat heavy, he no longer felt as helpless as in the morning. He placed his master's handwritten notes solemnly on the bedside table and resolved to begin studying them in depth the next day. After setting his phone alarm, he fell asleep peacefully at 23:00, looking forward to tomorrow's morning run and family time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family birthday breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: At 7 a.m., he was woken by the children's shouts of "Happy Birthday, Dad!" and the alarm clock. At the bedroom door, he received a hand-drawn card from his son Lu Zixuan featuring a wrench and a utility pole, and the younger son Lu Zihan's scribbles. After washing up, his wife Wang Lijuan served longevity noodles with two poached eggs. The family sat around the table for breakfast and pressed the children's drawings under the glass on the dining table. After the meal, he weighed himself: 70.8kg, the same as yesterday. Then he changed into his work clothes, checked the multimeter, temperature gun, and tool bag, replied to the birthday greeting WeChat message from his childhood friend Wang Hai, took a bottle of water, and went downstairs to get ready to drive.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute and inspection of aging lines.
description: Drove along Jinmao Middle Road and Jinlong Road to the old residential community inspection point in Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District. With little traffic on Sunday, he arrived in about 8 minutes. He met up with his co-worker Chen Jianguo and inspected the remaining old wiring. Working together, they used a temperature gun to measure and record the transformer outlet temperature and cable joints section by section. They found a joint that was oxidized and loose, sanded it smooth, re-tightened it, and recorded and reported a replacement plan. All inspections were completed before 11:00; after confirming everything was normal, he high-fived Chen Jianguo to mark the job done.
location: Power distribution room and lines of an old residential community near Jinlong Road, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou.

name: Bought groceries on the way home
description: After work, he drove along Jinlong Road, turned onto Guomao Road, and headed to the Guomao Road vegetable market. At the market, he picked out a live grouper (about 1.5 jin) and bought water spinach, scallions, and ginger, which his wife liked. He chatted with Old Li, a fishmonger he knew well, who wished him a happy birthday. After shopping, he returned to the car.
location: Guomao Road Vegetable Market, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Received birthday gifts and had a family lunch.
description: After a few minutes' drive from the vegetable market, he arrived home. At the entrance to the residential community, he signed for a large parcel sent from Shenzhen. After getting home, he opened it to find an exquisite vintage Cantonese baijiu bottle and a greeting card from his childhood friend Wang Hai. After taking photos and sending a WeChat message to thank him, he enjoyed the meal his wife had reheated. He had lunch with his family, explained to the children the origin and collecting significance of the bottle, and agreed to play Ludo and Chinese checkers together in the evening.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and parent-child interaction
description: After dinner, I took a nap on the sofa for about 30 minutes. After waking up, I played with building blocks with Lu Zihan, then checked Lu Zixuan's weekend homework, pointed out small mistakes in the math problems, and praised his improvement in handwriting. The father and son agreed to play Ludo and Chinese checkers together in the evening.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Took the family to Wanlv Garden to fly kites and walked home.
description: In the afternoon, the sunlight was moderate. The family of four walked about 25 minutes to Evergreen Park. The two sons took out the 'eagle' kite. Lu Zixuan let out the line skillfully, while Lu Mingqiang held Lu Zihan's hand and ran. They met their neighbor Grandpa Chen, who was also flying a kite with his grandson, and helped fix the jammed kite reel. After playing to their hearts' content, they walked home along the same route, with the children chasing and laughing all the way.
location: Wanlv Park, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the walking route home.

name: Help with meal preparation and birthday family dinner
description: After returning home, the children watched cartoons. Lu Mingqiang cooked, cleaning the grouper by scaling, gutting, and marinating it, picking and washing the water spinach, and working in sync with his wife, who was stir-frying Wenchang chicken. During this time, he called his mother, Chen Xiuying, to say hello and tell her he had spent his birthday very well. At 6:30 in the evening, the family sat together for the birthday dinner: steamed grouper, white-cut Wenchang chicken, garlic water spinach, and winter melon and sea snail soup. The children raised their cups to wish Dad a happy birthday, and the atmosphere was warm. Lu Mingqiang thought back to last year's anxiety and felt that everything was getting better.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner stroll and light night jog
description: Since vigorous exercise is not advisable right after a meal, he first took a walk with his family around the neighborhood and along Jinmao Middle Road to aid digestion. Then he had his wife take the children home first, changed into running shoes, and jogged about 2 kilometers along the service road of Guomao Road, taking 15 minutes. He broke a light sweat and felt refreshed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the area along Jinmao Middle Road to Guomao Road.

name: Wash up and prepare collections
description: After getting home, he took a shower and changed into loungewear. He placed the newly received old Cantonese-style liquor bottles and his own collected old Hainan local liquor bottles (such as Deer Turtle Wine and Haikou Daqu) on the desk, opened his laptop, logged into the collecting forum, and prepared to make comparative notes.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Had a video call with a childhood friend.
description: He set out the liquor bottles and notebook in advance, waiting for his childhood friend Wang Hai to video call. At 8 p.m., Wang Hai called exactly on time, and the two had a detailed exchange about the details of the Cantonese-style liquor bottles and their experiences hunting for treasures. The topic turned to yesterday's mock exam. Lu Mingqiang admitted his failure with a score of 58. Wang Hai comforted and encouraged him over the video, saying he would come back next time to drink with him and ease his worries, which made him feel deeply warmed.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wine bottle comparison and forum interaction
