name: Taking the children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang first rode his electric bike to take his younger son Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At the gate, he briefly exchanged a few words with the teacher on duty about the weather turning colder and adding clothes, then turned around and headed to Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way, he reminded his elder son Xuanxuan not to run in the hallway in the rain and to put on his jacket. He only left relieved after watching Xuanxuan walk through the school gate.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and morning meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang rode along the familiar route and arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park in about 30 minutes. After parking, he went to the changing room, put on his work uniform, and spread out his raincoat to dry. He then entered the meeting room and chatted with his fellow workers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, who had already arrived. The morning meeting began at 8:10. Squad Leader Zhang first reported that yesterday's finishing work on the distribution box at the printing factory had gone smoothly, then assigned the day's task: working with the newly arrived factory technicians to conduct a pre-upgrade survey and data collection on the old power distribution cabinets in the industrial park. Lu Mingqiang accepted the task and mentally began estimating the workload.
location: Changing room and meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: On-site survey and data collection in the morning.
description: Starting at 8:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo, together with the manufacturer's technician, went to the distribution rooms of each workshop one by one to open and inspect the old distribution cabinets. While using an infrared thermometer to measure the temperature of key nodes, he guided Zhao Qiang to record the nameplate parameters and cable routing, while Chen Jianguo was in charge of holding a flashlight. Old Lu also discussed the difficulties of retrofitting the old cabinets with the technician, shuttling back and forth between several distribution rooms all morning. The air was humid after the rain, but the work proceeded in an orderly manner.
location: Electrical distribution rooms of various workshops in Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and a call to mother
description: In the morning, he went to the electrical distribution room of a commercial building to clean the insulators of the high-voltage cabinet and inspect the grounding wires. Lu Mingqiang deliberately worked according to the mind-map process in his head and felt that his work was more standardized.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and registering for first aid training
description: Back in the company break room, Lu Mingqiang felt sleepy because of insufficient sleep the night before and the rainy weather, so he put chairs together to make a makeshift bed, folded his work jacket as a pillow, and closed his eyes for a nap of about half an hour. After waking, he felt better and took out his phone. Through the Haikou Red Cross official account, he looked at the 'Safety Production Month' first aid training course, carefully read the outline covering CPR, trauma bandaging, and the Heimlich maneuver, and after confirming it met his needs, paid the 150 yuan training fee online. The system showed that registration was successful, with training scheduled from May 17 to 18. He took a screenshot and saved it, feeling much more at ease.
location: Company rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon preparatory work for the renovation.
description: Starting at 1:10 p.m., they continued the morning's survey work. According to the manufacturer's technician's requirements, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo needed to draw simple sketches of the secondary circuit routing of several key old cabinets. The two cooperated seamlessly: one recalled the circuit routing while the other gently moved cables with a small tool to confirm, while Zhao Qiang organized tools and handed over wrenches. All data collection and preparation work came to a stop near 5 p.m. Team leader Zhang came over to inspect and expressed satisfaction.
location: Electrical distribution rooms of various workshops in Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the children after work and go home for dinner
description: At 5 p.m., he clocked off and left work. Lu Mingqiang first rode his bike to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his older son Xuanxuan, then went to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Hanhan. The two chattered about school on the back seat, and the air after the rain carried the smell of soil and grass. When they got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared dinner: steamed sea bass, water spinach with minced garlic, and tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table to eat. Lu Mingqiang asked the children about their school day. Xuanxuan said he scored 97 on a math quiz, while Hanhan boasted that the dinosaur he had drawn was put up on the wall by the teacher.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time and helping with homework
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang was in charge of clearing the table and washing the dishes, while his wife Wang Lijuan played with blocks with their younger son Hanhan in the living room. After washing the dishes, he sat down in the study to help Xuanxuan with Chinese and math homework, patiently explaining math problems, checking the dictation of new words, and placing the Quick Calculation workbook bought the day before at Xiangzhi General Store on the desk. After the tutoring session, he went to the living room, drank a glass of plain water, and seeing Hanhan building blocks with great enthusiasm, smiled and patted his head.
location: Living room and study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and bedtime preparation
description: After washing and coaxing the two children to sleep, Lu Mingqiang went into his study and began his evening study. He opened “200 Common Fault-Troubleshooting Cases” and focused on the troubleshooting approach and real cases for ground faults, connecting the relevant content on “resonance overvoltage” from yesterday's mistake notebook with the knowledge in the book. As he read, he used a red pen to mark the practical experience that “rainy-day humidity accelerates contact oxidation.” He studied until 10:15, getting up in the middle to pour water and rub his eyes. Then he went to the bathroom and washed up quickly. Remembering that tomorrow was Friday and he needed to get up early to take the children to school, he returned to the bedroom, where his wife Wang Lijuan was scrolling through her phone checking housekeeping group messages. He changed into pajamas, applied a new medicated plaster to his lower back, and reminded his wife not to forget to buy fruit and glutinous rice cakes when going to his parents' house on Saturday. Then he turned off the light and lay down.
location: Study, bathroom, and bedroom in the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Occasionally, muffled thunder came from the distance outside the window, but the rain had long stopped. Lu Mingqiang turned over, feeling the warmth of the medicated patch on his lower back, and reflected on the day: he had called his mother, signed up for first aid training, and both work and study were fulfilling. He felt at ease and soon fell asleep on this post-rain night.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning run.
description: It rained yesterday, and the air this morning was especially fresh. I got up at 5:50, washed up quickly, changed into sportswear, and headed out. Starting from Banshan Garden, I jogged along Jinmao Middle Road to the Wanlv Garden section of Binhai Avenue, keeping a pace of about 6 minutes 12 seconds per kilometer. I turned back at the entrance of Wanlv Garden, got home at 6:29, and stretched for 5 minutes.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, along Jinmao Middle Road to Binhai Avenue (Evergreen Park section).

name: Breakfast and preparing to leave home
description: After the morning run, he took a warm shower and changed into his blue work uniform. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared Hainan rice noodles with chili sauce and conch soup for breakfast. Over breakfast they discussed going to his parents' home the next day; his wife said they would leave at 9 a.m. and she would prepare everything.
location: Home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school
description: He rode the electric bike to first take his younger son Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. On the way, Hanhan talked about learning to sing Little Swallow today, and he promised to bring snacks when picking him up. They arrived at the kindergarten at 7:13. Then he took his older son Xuanxuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, arriving at the school gate at 7:27. Xuanxuan said there was a math quiz today, and he encouraged him to read the questions carefully.
location: Route: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City

name: Found a wallet on the way to work
description: After dropping off the kids, he rode the electric bicycle along Jinmao Middle Road toward Xiuying for work. At 7:38, at an intersection near home, he found a man's wallet on the ground. He picked it up and checked: the leather looked fairly new and had some weight to it. No one around was looking for it, so he temporarily put it in his work clothes pocket and arrived at the industrial park at 7:53.
location: Jinmao Middle Road (section near Banshan Garden), Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Morning work: rechecking parameters of old distribution cabinets
description: After the morning meeting, I went with fellow worker Chen Jianguo to No. 2 Workshop to recheck the parameters of the secondary circuit in the old power distribution cabinet. Following the drawings, I used a multimeter to measure the terminals and recorded voltage and resistance. I found one label that did not match the drawing, determined that the on-site routing had not been updated on the drawing, and made a special mark. The entire morning was spent carefully checking without finding any loose connections.
location: Workshop No. 2, Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Walk to lunch
description: After knocking off in the morning, he walked about 8 minutes with Chen Jianguo to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant under Xianghe Jiayuan. They ordered the signature spicy soup rice with egg and iced soy milk, eating and chatting about family matters. Jianguo complained that his son didn't like to eat, and he suggested buying digestive tablets. After the meal, they strolled back to the company, having finished eating at 12:05.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunchtime tasks: return wallet, discuss compensatory leave and lunch break
description: Back in the rest area, he took out his ID card from his wallet, looked up the community phone number through 114, and contacted the owner, Old Mr. Lin. About half an hour later, the old man arrived at the company. After verifying the information, he returned the item and politely declined the 200 yuan reward. The old man wrote a thank-you letter, and his coworker Chen Jianguo praised him. Then he reported to Team Leader Zhang that he wanted to attend Red Cross first aid training over the weekend and asked to move his weekend overtime tasks to next week. The team leader agreed and asked him to hand over to Xiao Zhao. After finishing, he leaned back in a chair in the rest area, pulled his cap over his face, and took a 15-minute nap.
location: Company rest area and Team Leader Zhang's office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: wrapping up the distribution cabinet renovation.
description: In the afternoon, he did the finishing work on the distribution cabinet renovation with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang. After confirming the morning's marked points with the manufacturer's technician by phone, they tightened the wiring and wrapped it up, and he explained the circuit principle to Zhao Qiang on site, emphasizing the details of grounding treatment. All work was completed by 16:30, and he was satisfied with the progress.
location: No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Workshop No. 2 of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park and surrounding work areas

name: Purchased gifts for the hometown trip on the way home from work.
description: After work, he rode his e-bike home and on the way stopped at the Guomao Road food market to shop for tomorrow’s visit to his parents’ home. At the fruit stall he picked fresh mangoes and Feizixiao lychees, then bought two boxes of traditional coconut glutinous rice cakes at the pastry shop (his mother’s favorite). After buying everything at 17:05, he continued home.
location: Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (Guomao Road Vegetable Market)

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: At 17:25, picked up the elder son Xuanxuan from Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. When asked about the math quiz, he said it went okay. Then went together to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up the younger son Hanhan; picked him up at 17:50. Hanhan rushed over. The three returned home to Banshan Garden at 18:25.
location: Route: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou   Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou   Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou

name: Spending family time together over dinner
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared home-style dishes such as stir-fried pork with green peppers, garlicky water spinach, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the dinner table, Xuanxuan talked about his math quiz, Hanhan showed the family portrait she had drawn in kindergarten, and the couple confirmed that they would leave for the grandparents' house at 9 a.m. the next day.
location: Home dining room: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help children with homework and play with them.
description: After dinner, his wife washed the dishes. Lu Mingqiang first went to the study to check Xuanxuan's math homework. A unit conversion problem had him stumped, so he used a drawing to guide his understanding. Hanhan played with LEGO by herself in the living room. At 19:35, his wife called the children to take a bath.
location: Home study and living room: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organized first aid training supplies.
description: While the children were taking a bath, he went to the study, took out a new notebook, a pen, and his ID card, then found a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts from the wardrobe, folded them neatly into the backpack, and prepared for the weekend Red Cross first aid training.
location: Home study: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Senior Technician Theory Review
description: Based on '200 Cases of Common Fault Elimination', reviewed the 'Equipment Installation and Adjustment' chapter. Went through the key and difficult points in the wrong-question collection; for the part where he was stuck on the motor forward-reverse self-locking circuit, he drew a simplified diagram with a red pen to deepen his understanding.
location: Home study: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and knee care
description: After studying, he washed up. The area with the plaster on his lower back had improved, but he still applied medicated oil to his knee joints and rubbed them to keep his legs flexible for the first aid training drill the next day.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Audio learning and phone socializing before bed.
description: Lying in bed with earphones on, he listened to the audio of "Electrician Safety Mnemonics" sent by Master Li, then checked WeChat. His co-worker Chen Jianguo asked him to bring breakfast the next morning. He replied "Sure thing" and asked about his child. After chatting, he put down his phone.
location: On the bedroom bed: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-sleep check and settling down to sleep
description: After turning off his phone, he went to the children's room and tucked in Xuanxuan and Hanhan. Back in bed, he reflected that the whole day had gone well, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep listening to the chirping of insects.
location: Children's room and bedroom at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and morning activities
description: At 6:10 in the morning, the alarm went off and I got up immediately. Today is Saturday and I need to attend first aid training, so I can't delay. In the bathroom, I washed my face with cold water and shaved my stubble, which made me feel refreshed. Then I spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a few chest stretches and leg stretches to loosen up my joints and muscles, preparing for the hands-on practice during the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Preparing breakfast and checking supplies.
description: My wife Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. I told her to keep it simple, make a bowl of rice noodle soup with an egg. I went to the door and checked my canvas bag: textbook, bandage practice kit, notebook, and pen — nothing missing. I also put on a dark gray cotton T-shirt and took a light plaid shirt as a jacket, because the training center's air conditioning would definitely be strong.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Eating breakfast
description: Wang Lijuan served steaming hot Baoluo rice noodles. The broth was clear, topped with a poached egg and sprinkled with scallions and peanuts. I slurped them up, finishing even the soup. Wang Lijuan drank soy milk and reminded me to ask Lao Zhou about the air conditioner. I nodded and told her I would call during the lunch break.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Depart and commute to the training center.
description: After cleaning up the dishes and chopsticks, he put on his canvas bag, grabbed the e-bike keys, and filled a cup of warm water to take along. Before leaving, he went to the door of the secondary bedroom and glanced in; Xuanxuan and Hanhan were still asleep. After saying goodbye to Wang Lijuan, he went downstairs. Riding the e-bike, he drove along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Longkun North Road, and crossed the Haidian River via the Century Bridge. It was 33 degrees today with strong sunshine; the wind on the bridge was strong and felt pleasant. After riding for about 20 minutes, he arrived at the entrance of the Red Cross Training Center at No. 41 Haida Road, parked the bike in the designated shed, and locked it.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China to Haikou Red Cross Society, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou City

name: Sign in, pick up supplies, and prepare before class.
description: Entering the first-floor lobby, there were already quite a few people. At the registration desk I signed in; after checking my information, the staff member handed me a document folder printed with the Red Cross logo, containing the textbook, the First Aider's Guide, and a brand-new bandage practice kit. I found a seat near the front but not too conspicuous, sat down, opened the textbook, and glanced at the content for today's lesson.
location: First-floor lobby, Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Morning first aid training: cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR)
description: At 8:30 the training started on time. The instructor was a male doctor in his forties with a loud voice. First was the theory class, covering the "golden four minutes" of CPR, compression depth of 5-6 cm, and rate of 100-120 compressions per minute. Then came group practice, with everyone practicing on a mannequin. I knelt on the ground and pressed to the count of "01, 02, 03..." one compression at a time. My arms had to be straight, using upper body strength. After the first few rounds my arms were terribly sore, but gradually I found the rhythm. During the break, I saw Wang Lijuan's WeChat saying the kids were all awake, and I replied "Got it."
location: Practical training classroom, 2nd floor, Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Midday break and arranging to buy an air conditioner
description: The morning training ended at 12. Instead of going to the cafeteria with the group, I rode my e-bike and sat down at a small shop by the roadside. I called Lao Zhou, who deals in second-hand home appliances, and asked if he had a good-condition Gree or Midea 1.5 HP wall-mounted air conditioner at a fair price. Lao Zhou said he happened to have a Gree unit in 70% condition, including delivery and installation, for just over 700 yuan. I made an appointment with him to check the unit at his shop on Haidian 2nd East Road around 5:30 PM. After hanging up, I sent Wang Lijuan a voice message telling her that I had arranged it with Lao Zhou, would go look at it after the training, and it could be delivered and installed next Wednesday evening.
location: Near Haikou Red Cross Society, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Lunch and rest
description: After finishing the call, he rode the e-bike and turned onto Haidian 2nd East Road to the "Awen Seafood Noodle Soup Shop" he often went to. He ordered a bowl of the signature seafood yee noodle soup and added two fish balls. After eating, he felt satisfied. Then he rode back to the training center. There were still more than twenty minutes before the afternoon class began, so he sat down on a bench in the corner of the first-floor lobby, scrolled through the news for a while, and exchanged a few messages with his workmate Chen Jianguo on WeChat. Feeling a bit sleepy, he leaned back against the chair and rested his eyes.
location: Awen Seafood Noodle Soup Shop, at the intersection of 2nd East Road and Haida Road, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China; and the first-floor lobby of the Haikou Red Cross Training Center

name: Afternoon first aid training: AED use and scenario drills
description: In the afternoon course, the focus was on learning the automated external defibrillator (AED). The instructor demonstrated turning on the device, attaching the electrode pads (one on the upper right chest and one on the lower left chest), and following the voice prompts to deliver a defibrillation shock. Then we practiced in groups: one person performed chest compressions, one operated the AED, and one called 120. I was paired with an auxiliary police officer in his thirties, and we practiced three or four times. From checking consciousness to operating the procedure, the process gradually became clearer. The instructor corrected our movements on the side. By the end of the day I was tired but felt very reassured.
location: Practical training classroom, 2nd floor, Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Training ends: collect certificate and tidy up
description: The training ended at 4:30 p.m. The instructor summarized and encouraged everyone to practice more. The staff issued each trainee a Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR + AED) Training Certificate. I carefully put the certificate into the inner pocket of my canvas bag, went to the restroom, washed my face, and felt much more refreshed.
location: First-floor lobby, Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Go to Old Zhou's used home appliance store.
description: He put on his backpack, walked out of the training center, and got on his electric bike. After a whole day of training he was a bit sweaty, and the evening breeze felt very refreshing. Riding along Haidian Second East Road for about 10 minutes, he saw the sign for “Old Zhou’s Second-hand Home Appliances.” Old Zhou was lying on a rattan chair at the shop entrance scrolling through his phone; when he saw me, he stood up warmly.
location: From Haikou Red Cross, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China, to Old Zhou's Second-hand Home Appliance Shop, Haidian 2nd East Road

name: Selecting an air conditioner and purchasing dinner snacks
description: Lao Zhou led me to the back yard of his shop to look at a white Gree 1.5-horsepower wall-mounted air conditioner. The casing had some normal scratches but was generally clean. I asked him to plug it in and test it; the cooling was good and the noise was low. After confirming it was genuine, I bargained with Lao Zhou and finally closed the deal at 750 yuan all-inclusive, including delivery, installation, and the mounting frame. I paid a 100 yuan deposit by scanning a QR code with my phone. Lao Zhou wrote a receipt and agreed to send someone to install it at my home at 7 p.m. next Wednesday. I was in a good mood after getting the air conditioner sorted. Then I went back to "Awen Seafood Noodle Soup Shop" and asked the owner to pack a serving of marinated rice noodles, adding a braised egg and fried chicken wings, intending to bring it to Wang Lijuan for dinner. On the way, I also bought some snacks from a roadside stall - glutinous rice cakes with coconut shreds, pandan cake, and pandan cookies - and weighed out half a jin of the coconut candy that Xuanxuan and Hanhan love, to take to my parents when I visit them tomorrow.

participant.name: Owner of Awen Seafood Rice Noodle Soup Shop

location: Near Lao Zhou's Second-hand Home Appliance Store and A Wen's Seafood Noodle Soup Shop, Haidian Second East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Cycling home
description: Bought everything and rode home. There was a little traffic on the way, but I was in a good mood and not in a hurry. Arrived at the building, parked the electric bike, and carried the seasoned rice noodles, snacks, and coconut candy upstairs.
location: From Haidian East 2nd Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China, to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Dinner and family time.
description: Opening the door, I smelled food. Wang Lijuan saw me and asked about the air conditioner. I put down the seasoned noodles and snacks, told her it was all set — 750 yuan including delivery and installation, with installation next Wednesday evening. I had specially brought her Awen's seasoned noodles. Wang Lijuan was very happy. Xuanxuan and Hanhan gathered around me calling "Daddy," and I gave them coconut candies, telling them one each and not to eat too many. For dinner, Wang Lijuan stir-fried water spinach and peppers with pork. Together with the seasoned noodles I brought back, the four of us ate happily. At the table, I talked about the first aid I learned today. Xuanxuan was very interested and asked what to do if someone fainted. I smiled and said I would teach him a few moves later.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Homework tutoring and parent-child interaction.
description: After dinner I cleaned up the dishes and let Wang Lijuan go rest. First I went to the second bedroom. Xuanxuan was doing a math test and had made a few careless mistakes. I pulled up a chair and sat down, asking him to reread the questions. He scratched his head, reread them, and suddenly understood. He corrected the answers himself, and I praised him. Then I helped him with a few word problems. After that, Hanhan came running over with building blocks and asked me to help him build a castle. The three of us played with blocks on the living room floor. Xuanxuan built the city wall, Hanhan built the tower, and I guided them on how to build more steadily. There was nonstop laughter.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Evening Study Notes
description: After settling the children to wash up and get ready for bed, I returned to my study, poured myself a glass of warm water, took out "200 Common Troubleshooting Cases" from my canvas bag, and turned to the page where the bookmark was, featuring the two cases "Abnormal Transformer Noise" and "Ground Fault Troubleshooting." I turned on the desk lamp, highlighted key points, and copied the core steps into my notebook in red pen as I read. Although my shoulders and neck were a bit sore, I was very focused.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Evening washing up and getting ready for bed.
description: I closed the book and stretched lazily. I went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, and the hot water washed away the day's fatigue. When I came out, I applied a hot towel to my shoulders and felt the soreness ease a lot. Then I briefly prepared what I needed for going back to my parents' house tomorrow: I put away the first-aid training textbook and certificate, and also checked the battery level of the electric bike.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Pre-sleep conversation and going to bed
description: Lying in bed, Wang Lijuan was still awake, scrolling on her phone. She asked if I had bought the things for going to my parents' place tomorrow. I said I had and put them on the kitchen cabinet, and we'd leave at 9 in the morning. She said she would make porridge in the morning and bring some fruit. I chatted with her a bit about interesting things from today's training, feeling very at ease. Then I set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning, said goodnight to Wang Lijuan, and turned off the light. I fell asleep quickly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Wake up early, wash up, have a simple breakfast, and prepare to leave.
description: After the alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang heard the sound of steady rain outside the window. He moved his shoulders and felt they were much looser than yesterday. After washing up, he changed into a comfortable old T-shirt and sweatpants, put the raincoat, notebook, pen, and ID card into the canvas bag he used for training, and also stuffed a clean plastic bag in to hold the wet raincoat. Then he padded quietly to the kitchen. His wife and two children were still asleep. He heated up the leftover plain congee from last night, cut up a ham sausage, and ate it quickly with a small dish of pickled mustard greens. After washing the dishes, he put on his raincoat, grabbed his backpack and helmet, checked the e-bike keys, and left.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commut ed to the Red Cross Training Center.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bicycle east along Binhai Avenue, carefully avoiding the waterlogged sections. The raindrops felt cool on his face, but the air was fresh. About 30 minutes later, he arrived at the Haikou Red Cross Training Center, located at No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District. He found a sheltered parking spot for electric bicycles, parked, and locked the bike.
location: Binhai Avenue, Haikou, Hainan Province (during commute)

name: Signing in at the training center and preparing for class
description: Lu Mingqiang shook the raincoat dry, stuffed it into a plastic bag, and put it in his bag. After checking in at the registration desk, he found the same seat as yesterday and sat down. There were still 45 minutes before class started. He made good use of the time to review yesterday's notes, silently reciting the compression depth and rate for CPR and the steps for using an AED. Quite a few people had already arrived in the classroom; some were discussing quietly, while others were gesturing at the mannequins.
location: Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning training: trauma bandaging and comprehensive drill.
description: The course officially began. In the morning, they mainly reviewed yesterday's CPR, then focused on learning trauma hemostasis, bandage wrapping, fracture immobilization, and casualty transport. Lu Mingqiang studied very carefully. During the practical session, he took the initiative to practice the figure-eight bandage on the elbow and the large arm sling fixation with his partner. Near the end, the instructor began calling on trainees for a combined CPR + bandaging simulation drill. Lu Mingqiang was called first. He took a deep breath and calmly completed a full standard procedure, earning the instructor's approval.
location: Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and social media interaction.
description: After class, Lu Mingqiang went to "A Qiang Fast Food Restaurant" across the street from the training center and ordered a 15-yuan pork knuckle rice set meal. While waiting for the food, he took out his phone and scrolled through his Moments, seeing a series of photos posted by his squash buddy Lin Feng practicing backhand drives at the squash club, with the caption "Saturday match, cramming at the last minute." He smiled, gave a like, and commented: "Looking mighty! Good luck for Saturday's match!" Lin Feng quickly replied: "Waiting for you to take me on!" Lu Mingqiang locked his phone and enjoyed his lunch.
location: Aqiang Fast Food Restaurant, Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and final exam review sprint
description: After eating, he returned to the classroom; there was still an hour before the afternoon theory exam. Lu Mingqiang found his seat, put on his earphones, and quickly went through key points from the morning in his phone notes: pressure for bandaging different body parts, and principles of fracture fixation. Feeling he was about ready, he rested his head on the desk and dozed for 20 minutes to recharge.
location: Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon assessment: theory and hands-on practice
description: At 1:30 in the afternoon, the assessment officially began. First was a 45-minute theory written test, mostly multiple-choice and true-false questions. Lu Mingqiang answered smoothly; the knowledge he had learned yesterday and in the morning made him confident. After handing in the paper, he took a short break, and then came the practical assessment. He drew the topic "CPR + lower leg fracture immobilization." Following the procedure, he called out loudly for help, checked consciousness, and performed chest compressions (depth and frequency precisely controlled within standards), then cooperated with his partner to complete temporary immobilization of the lower leg using bandages and a triangular sling. The whole set of movements was clean and decisive, and the assessor nodded to indicate a pass.
location: Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Awarded the Red Cross Emergency Responder Certificate
description: After all the trainees had been assessed, the instructor announced the list of those who passed, and Lu Mingqiang's name was prominently on it. Then the instructor issued the Red Cross First Aid Certificate to each trainee who had passed. Lu Mingqiang took the certificate with both hands. It bore the Red Cross emblem and his photo, and he felt both relieved and proud. He carefully placed the certificate in the safest zippered pocket in the inner layer of his backpack, then took out his phone, photographed the certificate, and sent it to the coworkers' group chat. He soon received many likes and congratulatory messages.
location: Haikou Red Cross Training Center, No. 41 Haida Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return trip, buying groceries on the way, and calling to arrange an air conditioner inspection.
description: When he came out of the training center, the sky had cleared and the air felt especially fresh. Lu Mingqiang got on his electric bike and headed back. Thinking that his wife and children had gone out for dim sum at noon and might not have time to buy groceries, he stopped along the way at the Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Vegetable Store (Binhai Xincun Branch) at No. 31 Longhua Road, buying some fresh beef, a bunch of water spinach, and a few tomatoes. While waiting at a red light, he called Lao Zhou, an acquaintance who deals in second-hand home appliances: “Brother Zhou, this is Mingqiang. About that Gree unit from yesterday, I'd like to set up a time with you. Can I go to your warehouse next Saturday (May 24) to see the actual item?” On the other end came Lao Zhou's hearty voice: “Sure, Mingqiang! I'll be at the warehouse all day next Saturday. Come anytime!” Lu Mingqiang felt even more at ease, hung up, and continued home.
location: No. 31 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Vegetable Shop (Binhai Xincun Branch).

name: Arrive home, take a shower, and change clothes
description: Back home at Banshan Garden, he found the house quiet—his wife and children weren't back yet. Lu Mingqiang put the groceries in the kitchen fridge, then grabbed clean clothes and took a nice, hot shower in the bathroom, washing away the day's fatigue and sweat. After changing into loose loungewear, he felt completely refreshed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner preparation, family gathering, and dinner.
description: Lu Mingqiang had just tidied up when he heard the sound of a key opening the door. His wife Wang Lijuan came back with the two sons, chatting and laughing. The younger son, Hanhan, ran in and threw himself onto his leg, calling out Daddy, while the older son, Xuanxuan, ran over curiously to look at the food they had brought back. Seeing that he had already bought groceries, his wife smiled and said he was thoughtful as always. The family talked and laughed as she put on an apron and began preparing dinner, with Lu Mingqiang helping peel garlic and pick vegetables while telling her about passing the assessment and getting the certificate that day. Dinner was plentiful: the beef and water spinach he had bought, plus the tomato scrambled eggs his wife made and the morning tea snacks packed back from noon. At the table, Lu Mingqiang showed the first aid certificate to his two sons. Xuanxuan asked in admiration if his dad could become a doctor now. He smiled and touched his son's head, saying that Dad could save people now but was still far from being a doctor. The whole family laughed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study: organizing training notes and reviewing work knowledge
description: After dinner, his wife cleared the dishes and helped the eldest son practice writing new characters from memory. Lu Mingqiang went to the study and copied the key content from the two-day training into a new large notebook. He drew a simple human figure, marked the bandaging methods for each part, and circled in red the "depth 5-6 cm, rate 100-120 compressions/min" for chest compressions and the positions of "AED electrode pads: right upper chest, left lower chest." After organizing the notes, he picked up 200 Examples of Common Fault Troubleshooting for a light review, quickly flipping through the table of contents and previously marked key cases. When he turned to the transformer differential protection chapter, he vaguely felt that some details were still unclear, so he took out his phone and wrote in his memo: "Question about the calculation principle of the balance coefficient for transformer differential protection; to ask Master Li later." Then he closed the book, feeling confident.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family leisure: watching a movie
description: Lu Mingqiang walked out of the study and saw his wife and children curled up on the sofa watching the animated movie Zootopia. He sat down beside his wife, lifted his younger son Hanhan onto his lap, while his older son Xuanxuan leaned against his shoulder and occasionally discussed the plot with him. Outside the window, the night was deepening, but the warm lights at home dispelled all the fatigue of the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, preparing the next day's work clothes, and bedtime conversation.
description: After the movie ended, Lu Mingqiang urged the two children to wash up, and when they got into bed, he tucked them in and said goodnight. Then he returned to the master bedroom, took out the dark blue work pants and gray T-shirt he would wear to work the next day from the wardrobe, folded them, and placed them on the nightstand. He also put the e-bike key and meal card on the tray in the entryway so the next morning wouldn't be a frantic rush. Later, he and his wife Wang Lijuan leaned against the headboard. She asked how the training had gone that day, and he described the assessment in detail, especially mentioning how nervous he was when he was called up first to practice CPR and how satisfied he felt when he finally passed smoothly. His wife praised him and said, “Our family now has an extra first aider, so I feel much more at ease. By the way, how is Old Zhou's air conditioner matter going?” He told her about his plan to go look at the goods next Saturday. She nodded and said, “Okay. The 500 yuan hospitality fund we set aside this month is ready, so next week is just the right time to buy.” After chatting about everyday family matters for a while, he looked at his phone and saw it was already 22:00. Tomorrow was Monday and they needed to get up early, so they said goodnight, turned off the light, and lay down.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Listening to the occasional sound of cars outside the window and the hum of the air-conditioning unit, Lu Mingqiang thought about the two big things he had accomplished today: getting his first aid certificate and settling the arrangement for buying the air conditioner. Tomorrow he would return to the familiar distribution cabinets and tool bag. He turned over and soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: The bedside alarm went off right at 5:45. Lu Mingqiang turned it off and got up, feeling that the shoulder soreness from last night had eased considerably. He stepped on the scale and weighed himself; it showed 70.6 kg, and he silently noted that he had eaten too much grilled fish last night. After a quick wash, he changed into quick-dry sportswear and running shoes, drank a few sips of warm water, checked his phone battery, and got ready to go out for his morning run.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: It was already daylight and the air was slightly warm. Lu Mingqiang started from the gate of Banshan Garden residential community and ran east along Jinmao Middle Road, keeping a pace of about 6:15 per kilometer, then turned back at the Guomao Sanheng intersection. On the way, he checked the breakfast price lists at roadside restaurants and considered today's breakfast choices. At 6:40 he returned to the community gate and did 5 minutes of core stretching in the stretching area at the entrance, loosening up his shoulder joints and the posterior leg muscles.
location: Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning chores and taking the children to school
description: After running, Lu Mingqiang went home and quickly took a shower and changed clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had already gotten up and made a simple qingbuliang in the kitchen (dragon fruit and coconut milk). Lu Mingqiang quickly finished breakfast and also stuffed a steamed sweet potato into his bag as an extra snack for lunch. He packed his commuting backpack, checked his work clothes and tool bag, and confirmed that his keys, phone, power bank, and work badge were all with him. At 7:10, he left with his two sons, riding an electric bike. First, he went west along Jinmao Middle Road and turned into Guomao Third Cross Road. At 7:18, he arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. He helped 4-year-old Hanhan straighten his backpack straps, told him to listen to the teacher, and watched him enter the kindergarten. Then he turned the bike around and headed along Longhua Road-Haixiu Road toward Meilan District. At 7:35, he arrived at Longfeng Experimental Primary School. 8-year-old Xuanxuan jumped off the back seat by himself, said, 'Goodbye, Dad. I get out of school early today, remember to pick me up,' and ran into the school gate.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Work commute and task assignment.
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike for about 15 minutes to reach Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. At exactly 8 o'clock, he met Team Leader Zhang in the team rest room, changed into blue work clothes, and fastened his safety helmet. Team Leader Zhang assigned the day's task: finishing the installation of distribution cabinets at the new residential community Fenghuang Yayuan on Changbin Road, Xiuying District. Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang collected the required tools and drawings. At 8:20, the three loaded the power tools and distribution cabinet parts onto the company's small truck, and Lu Mingqiang drove along Haisheng Road-Changbin Road. On the way, Lu Mingqiang mentioned to Jianguo that his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang was planning to bring his girlfriend home for the National Day holiday.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning: distribution cabinet installation work
description: After arriving at Fenghuang Yayuan Community, Lu Mingqiang located the base of the distribution cabinet according to the drawings. He first guided Zhao Qiang in using a level to correct the base, then the three of them worked together to move the heavy distribution cabinet into the distribution room on Basement Level 1 of Building 3. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for wiring the main lines, Chen Jianguo for checking the wire numbers, and Zhao Qiang for passing tools and tightening screws. While working, Lu Mingqiang reminded Zhao Qiang to properly seal the cable entry and protect it from moisture. At 11:30 a.m., the first phase of cabinet installation and main line connection was completed.
location: Electrical distribution room, Basement Level 1, Building 3, Fenghuang Yayuan Community, Changbin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and personal matters
description: At noon, everyone found a shady spot at the stairwell entrance on level B1 to have lunch. Lu Mingqiang chatted with Jianguo and Zhao Qiang while eating. He proactively asked Jianguo about his child's plan to go to Sanya Bay during summer vacation. Jianguo mentioned the hotel budget of nearly 3,000 yuan. Lu Mingqiang silently noted down a few cost-effective budget chain hotels as references for National Day guests. During the meal, he ate part of the sweet potato he had brought in the morning. After finishing at 12:50, he contacted Lao Zhou, who deals in second-hand appliances, via WeChat, confirmed the delivery and installation time for the air conditioner from 7 to 8 tomorrow evening, and reminded him to bring all installation accessories. Then he leaned against the wall and rested with his eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Construction site of Fenghuang Yayuan Residential Community, Changbin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: finishing and testing the installation of the power distribution cabinet.
description: Continued working in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang checked that all wiring was secure, used a multimeter to test the insulation of the secondary circuit, then guided Zhao Qiang and Jianguo through the final checks before powering on. At 4 p.m., the power distribution cabinet was successfully energized and the indicator lights flashed normally. Lu Mingqiang took out the work order, signed the inspection column, and asked the civil works foreman in charge of the site to confirm. At 4:25, the three of them put the tools back in place and confirmed that no debris was left behind.
location: Electrical distribution room, Basement Level 1, Building 3, Fenghuang Yayuan Community, Changbin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returning to the company and shopping on the way home
description: At 16:30, Lu Mingqiang drove everyone back to the industrial park. After arriving at the company, he, Jianguo, and Xiao Zhao returned the tools to the warehouse and cleaned them up. Then he went to the changing room, took off his work clothes stained with sweat and dust, changed into a daily T-shirt and trousers, and washed his face with water. At 17:00, he rode his electric bike toward home. On the way, he stopped at the Vegetable Basket Community Supermarket at No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, quickly picked up a bunch of water spinach, two tomatoes, three apples, and two packs of the yogurt his wife liked. After checkout, he hung the groceries on the handlebars of the electric bike.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Vegetable Basket Community Budget Supermarket (Hainan Provincial Dormitory Store), No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: At 17:25, Lu Mingqiang arrived at the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School. School ended at 17:30. When Xuanxuan saw his dad, he ran over. Lu Mingqiang took his schoolbag and let him sit on the rear seat. Xuanxuan excitedly said he scored 95 on the math test, and Lu Mingqiang praised him. Then Lu Mingqiang rode from Meilan District back to Longhua District, arriving at Jinmao Center Kindergarten at 17:55. Hanhan was waiting at the entrance and ran over happily. Lu Mingqiang helped him onto the front seat, sat himself in the middle, and the two children squeezed on the e-bike, one in front and one behind.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family evening time.
description: Back home, his wife Wang Lijuan was in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang told her to take a break, put on an apron, and put the water spinach, tomatoes, and milk he had bought into the refrigerator. He had Hanhan play with building blocks in the living room, then sat in the dining room to help Xuanxuan correct his math test paper, analyzing the reasons for the wrong answers and explaining the problem-solving approach. After that, he went into the kitchen to help his wife, washing vegetables, cutting tomatoes, and peeling garlic. The main dish tonight was roasted tilapia. At 19:00 the family sat around the table for dinner. The roasted fish smelled wonderful; Lu Mingqiang tried it and found it delicious, with a tender texture. While eating and chatting, he mentioned Xuanxuan's improvement on the exam and that his younger brother was going to bring his girlfriend home. His wife was very happy to hear it and even picked a large piece of fish for herself. Although Lu Mingqiang deliberately controlled his portions, he still ate quite a bit. After dinner, he took the initiative to clear the dishes while his wife wiped the table. He asked Xuanxuan to go recite his lesson, played with Hanhan with building blocks for a while, then checked Xuanxuan's recitation and had him read the unfamiliar parts three more times. At 20:20, the children were all settled.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Video call with wife's younger brother and discuss reception arrangements
description: After the children were settled, Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat down on the living room sofa. At 20:25, his phone rang. It was a video call from Chen Zhiqiang, his wife's younger brother in Shenzhen. Chen Zhiqiang excitedly introduced his girlfriend Lin Yue, and Lu Mingqiang and his wife warmly greeted her. Chen Zhiqiang said he planned to bring Lin Yue back to Haikou during the National Day holiday to meet his parents and asked them to help make arrangements. Lu Mingqiang readily agreed and said he would get the guest room ready. The call lasted about 20 minutes. After hanging up, the couple immediately began discussing the reception plan. Lu Mingqiang suggested letting Zhiqiang and Lin Yue stay in the guest room, and planned to organize a family barbecue. His wife added that they should buy good meat, and that Zhiqiang's aunt liked pineapple beer. Lu Mingqiang also mentioned setting aside 500 yuan each month starting this month, which would be about 2,000 by the National Day holiday, enough to entertain them well. His wife nodded in agreement and noted 'September guest fund - 500 yuan' in her phone memo.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening theory review
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang returned to the study. He took out the mistake notebook for "200 Common Fault Troubleshooting Cases" and turned to the blind spot on transformer differential protection, finding that it was indeed related to his understanding of Kirchhoff's current law. He re-derived the process from the formula and silently wrote out the complete steps in red pen in the mistake notebook. Then he opened the "Senior Technician Review Notes" and did several basic problems using Ohm's law until he fully mastered them. At 22:30, he closed the book, feeling his thinking had become much clearer.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime journaling and falling asleep
description: Lu Mingqiang opened his phone memo and wrote down that the grilled fish at dinner was high in calories and he should watch his intake tomorrow. Then he lay in bed and confirmed the next day's plan with his wife, telling her that Old Zhou would come at 7 p.m. tomorrow to install the air conditioner, and reminding her to take the kids downstairs for a while so they wouldn't be disturbed. His wife responded. He also said he would transfer the savings to her tomorrow. After that, he turned off the bedside lamp, reviewed the day's various tasks, and felt at ease. Although he was a bit tired, thinking of the joy of the National Day family reunion and the progress he had made on knowledge points, he felt fulfilled. After adjusting his sleeping position, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 401, Building B, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning routine chores and family financial management.
description: After the morning alarm went off, I got up, washed up, and stepped on the electronic scale to weigh myself. It showed 70.5 kg, the same as yesterday. While washing up, I saw that it was already light outside; the forecast called for thunderstorms, so I folded my old raincoat and put it into the seat compartment of the electric scooter. Then I went into the kitchen, where my wife Wang Lijuan was already preparing baoluo rice noodles for breakfast. I sat at the dining table, opened the family account book, wrote '5.20, hospitality fund, 500 yuan' in the fixed expenses column, and noted last night's video call with Zhiqiang in my phone calendar.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and taking the children to school
description: The whole family sat around eating breakfast. My younger son Lu Zihan ate slowly, and I urged him a few times. At 7:00 sharp, I rode the electric bike with the two children. First, I dropped Hanhan off at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten along the way and watched the teacher lead him into the kindergarten. Then I took my older son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, and at the school gate told him to listen carefully in class and not to run around after school.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, and ending at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Commute and team morning meeting.
description: After dropping off the kids, I rode my electric bike along the expressway to the company. After arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, I parked, swiped my work card, and entered the tool room. I met my co-worker Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang. Shift leader Zhang Tou assigned the day's task of installing cable trays at the new plant near the intersection of Yongwan Road and Fukang Road. I checked the electric drill, wrenches, spirit level, and other tools to make sure everything was correct.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning installation of cable trays and safety communication
description: We arrived at the factory building under construction in a pickup truck. The site was dusty, but the power was already connected. The three of us divided the work: drilling expansion bolts and installing the main beams and cross braces of the cable tray. After each section was fixed, I checked it with a spirit level. During the work break at 10:30, Chen Jianguo mentioned an accident at a relative's factory in his hometown, where a worker doing live electrical work nearly got electrocuted. I showed them the Red Cross first aid certificate I had just obtained, emphasizing the importance of safety first and first aid skills.
location: A factory building under construction at the intersection of Yongwan Road and Fukang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break brisk walking and lunch
description: After finishing work in the morning, I saw the sky was cloudy but not raining, so I walked briskly along the concrete road around the factory for about 20 minutes, at a pace of about 11 minutes/km, to stretch my body. Then I went to my usual Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant and ordered a spicy soup rice with a fried egg. While waiting for the meal, I used my phone browser to search for comparative reviews of one-year family accident insurance, to get an initial understanding of family protection.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Brief break during work hours
description: After eating, I returned to the workshop; there was still half an hour before the afternoon shift. I put a piece of cardboard on the passenger seat of the pickup truck and leaned back to rest with my eyes closed, regaining energy for the afternoon work.
location: Pickup truck inside a factory building under construction at the intersection of Yongwan Road and Fukang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: In the afternoon, installed cable trays and guided apprentices.
description: In the afternoon, I continued the cable tray installation work. I led my apprentice Zhao Qiang to secure the remaining main beams, and then laid the cover plates of the cable tray. While working, I explained to Zhao Qiang the techniques for making bend connectors and the importance of cross-bonding grounding; he quickly understood and started doing it himself.
location: A factory building under construction at the intersection of Yongwan Road and Fukang Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finish work and return tools.
description: All the cable trays were installed. I checked the tightness of the screws one by one, and after confirming everything was correct, reported completion to the team leader. Then, together with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, I returned to the company in a pickup truck. In the tool room, we cleaned and put away tools such as the electric drill and grinder, then changed out of work clothes and placed them in the lockers.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inquire about family accident insurance.
description: After work, I rode my e-bike to the PICC Haikou Business Department at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road. Entering the business hall, I told the front desk I wanted to inquire about family accident insurance. A customer manager explained the coverage, the annual premium for a family of four, and the claims process in detail, and provided a brochure and a trial calculation sheet totaling about 846 yuan. I carefully kept the materials and left.
location: People's Insurance Company of China Haikou Business Department, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the child from school
description: After leaving the insurance company, I went directly to pick up the children. First I went to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up my younger son Hanhan, who excitedly showed me the painting he had done that day. Then I hurried to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up my older son Xuanxuan, who was already waiting at the school gate. I had Xuanxuan sit on the back seat and Hanhan stand on the front footboard, and we went home together.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Horizontal Road, Longhua District, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Return home for dinner and communicate with the family.
description: When I got home, my wife Wang Lijuan had already stir-fried garlic water spinach and braised tilapia. I washed my hands and helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the family sat down to eat together. I put food on Xuanxuan's plate and told Juanzi about the insurance consultation in the afternoon, mentioning that the family accident insurance package would cost about 846 yuan. She supported it, saying that safety matters most.

description: His wife arranged for the children to take baths. Lu Mingqiang checked his squash bag in the bedroom, confirmed the racket, wristband, towel, spare T-shirt, and sports drink were all there, zipped the bag and put it on the nightstand. Then he took a shower, set the phone alarm to 6:00 the next morning, turned off the overhead light and left the night light on. He lay down, played soft music, reviewed the match tactics, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: After waking up naturally in the morning, Lu Mingqiang did 15 minutes of stretching on the balcony, moving his shoulders, waist, and knees to prepare for the squash match. Then he took out the heat-relief jelly and bread from the refrigerator to prepare breakfast. His younger son Hanhan got up midway looking for water. His wife Wang Lijuan made porridge and fried eggs, and the whole family sat together to enjoy breakfast. His older son Xuanxuan asked about the match, and Lu Mingqiang said he wanted to win the semifinal. After the meal, he checked the squash equipment and brought insulating cable ties and a screwdriver to use when selecting an air conditioner.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to the squash club
description: After saying goodbye to his family, Lu Mingqiang walked to the Binhai International Financial Center bus stop, took bus No. 57, and after 4 stops (about 15 minutes) got off at Wanlv Garden Station. He then walked to Feite Squash Club on the basement level (B1) of Nanyang Building.
location: Feite Squash Club, B1, Nanyang Building, 91 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Squash match and post-match exchange.
description: After arriving at the club, he changed into his jersey and warmed up in the waiting area. The match started at 08:30. Lu Mingqiang was in great form, with a high success rate on backhand volleys, and easily won the first round. In the semifinals, he met his playing partner Lin Feng. The score was tight, and he finally lost narrowly 1:3, but it was his first time reaching the final four, and he was praised by his fellow players. After the match, he stretched at courtside and agreed with Lin Feng, Xiao Liu, and other players to teach them first aid bandaging and CPR skills next time they played.
location: Feite Squash Club, B1, Nanyang Building, 91 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

description: He walked with fellow players Lin Feng, Xiao Liu, Lao Zhang, and others to the Yeyutang Qingbuliang shop near Wanlv Garden Park. Each ordered a bowl of classic coconut milk qingbuliang, chatting about match insights while eating. During this, Lu Mingqiang thought of adapting the training points chart in his study into a programming challenge points chart to motivate his older son. At 11:45 he said goodbye to his fellow players and headed back. On the way, he bought two bottles of mineral water and heat-insulating sealing tape at Xiangzhi General Store on Yusha Road, then walked home.
location: Yeyutang Qingbuliang (Wanlv Garden Branch), No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch and rest
description: When he got home, his wife and children were already preparing to have lunch. When they learned that Lu Mingqiang had reached the semifinals, the children cheered. After he took a quick shower and changed clothes, the family ate tomato egg noodles and stir-fried greens. After the meal, he rested on the living room sofa for 20 minutes.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Called Lao Zhou, an acquaintance who deals in second-hand appliances, and agreed to go to his warehouse in the afternoon to pick an air conditioner. Taking a tape measure, screwdriver, and other tools, he rode an electric bike to the Comprehensive Second-hand Goods Market on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. At Lao Zhou's warehouse, he carefully inspected two Gree wall-mounted units and chose a well-maintained white 1.5-HP air conditioner manufactured in 2019, closing the deal at 850 yuan.
location: Warehouse 7, Area A, Second-hand Goods Comprehensive Market, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bought the computer assembly materials and transported them home.
description: At Yubing Hardware and Building Materials Store at the market entrance, he bought extended copper pipes, wall-hole sealing putty, and shock-absorbing pads. He tied the air conditioner and accessories to the back seat of his electric bike with rope, rode carefully to avoid bumps on the main roads, and arrived downstairs at home at 15:10.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 57 Haisheng Road, inside the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, right side of the main gate of the second-hand goods comprehensive market, Yubing Hardware and Building Materials Store

name: The couple moved and installed the air conditioner.

Then the couple worked together on the installation: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for drilling holes, fixing brackets, running pipes and wiring, while his wife cleaned the filter screens. The eldest son Xuanxuan handed over tools, and the youngest son Hanhan played on the bed. After the power-on test, cold air blew out, and the children cheered.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Using a level, he fine-tuned the angle of the wall-mounted unit and sealed the wall hole, while his wife wiped the casing. The children played in the cool room, and Lu Mingqiang discussed the programming points table plan with Xuanxuan, then took photos and sent them to his father to share the results.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family enjoyed a cool dinner in the air-conditioned room, with stir-fried water spinach and winter melon and sea snail soup. Lu Mingqiang voluntarily did the dishes after dinner.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: After dinner, he took a short break and went to the study to review electrical knowledge. He focused on mastering the principle of transformer differential protection, hand-drawing logic block diagrams and studying them repeatedly. Then he learned surge arrester selection and did practice calculations using chemical plant cases. Finally, he reworked six related wrong questions and got all of them right. During this, he realized that the third difficult point, dielectric loss testing, was rather complex, and decided to ask Master Li the next day. He wrote a sticky note - "Tomorrow 9:00 AM: study and conquer the dielectric loss test, and leave time to call Master Li" - and stuck it on the desk lamp.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (study)

name: Washing up and chatting with his wife.
description: After taking a hot shower, he chatted with his wife in the living room about today's match and review progress; his wife praised his perseverance. The two spent a relaxing time together.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Checked tomorrow's keys, phone charger, and other items, and confirmed that the children were asleep. Lying in bed, I reviewed the fulfilling day: setting a squash record, installing an air conditioner, and tackling two difficult knowledge points. I felt grounded and proud. I set the alarm for 6:30 the next day and fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bedroom)

name: Waking up and getting ready
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up to the alarm clock and felt full of energy. He looked out the window and saw the weather was sunny, so he decided to go to Wanlv Garden to fly kites as planned. After washing up, he changed into sportswear and got ready to start a new day.

name: Breakfast and departure preparation
description: Wang Lijuan prepared seasoned noodles and hot milk for breakfast. Lu Mingqiang ate with the children and announced his plan to fly kites at Wanlv Park today; the children were thrilled. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang packed up the dragon-headed centipede kite and the little swallow kite, put on a sun hat, and the family of four set off to Wanlv Park on an electric bike.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Community, home dining room and doorway

name: Family flies kites in the park.
description: At the large lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, Lu Mingqiang found an open area and unfolded the dragon-head centipede kite. Lu Zixuan excitedly grabbed the reel and ran against the wind, and with his father’s guidance flew the kite. The long centipede kite danced in the blue sky, drawing cheers from the surrounding children. Lu Zihan, in his mother’s arms, pointed at the kite and laughed. The whole family was sweating all over.
location: The big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Passing Shimao West Road, Wang Lijuan suggested going to Wangjiawang Supermarket to buy soy sauce. In the supermarket, Wang Lijuan pushed a cart to pick out vegetables and fruit, Lu Mingqiang held Hanhan and grabbed some snacks, and Lu Zixuan helped carry the items. After a quick purchase, they checked out and went home.
location: Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Shimao Store), 10 Shimao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going home and settling in
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang put away the purchased items while Wang Lijuan took the children to wash their hands and faces. Lu Mingqiang, still thinking about the line re-inspection task, got ready to go out.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

After confirming there were no hidden overheating or leakage hazards, he recorded the data.
location: The electrical distribution box area of the old residential community on Bazao Street, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return home, family lunch, and homework tutoring
description: After completing the follow-up examination, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike home. Wang Lijuan used the ingredients she had bought in the morning to make stir-fried water spinach, bitter melon scrambled eggs, and pork rib and lotus root soup, and the family had lunch together. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang checked Lu Zixuan's math homework and found a mistake in a word problem. He patiently explained it by drawing a line segment diagram until he fully understood. Lu Zihan played with a puzzle on the sofa.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Create a score table for programming challenges.
description: After helping with homework, Lu Mingqiang went to the study and took out Lu Zixuan's previous squash training points chart. Using white paper and colored pens, he redesigned it into a "Programming Explorer Points Chart." He drew the grids and designed items such as "Daily Challenges," "Continuous Check-ins," and "Mistake Reset," and drew a small rocket at the top of the chart to represent the programming learning adventure.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Lu Mingqiang showed the points chart to Lu Zixuan and explained the redemption rules — for example, collecting enough stars could be exchanged for KFC or a sand-digging activity — which sparked Xuanxuan's interest. Xuanxuan immediately went to the study, turned on the computer, and tried the 'first level' of the programming tutorial. Lu Mingqiang, meanwhile, changed into a clean T-shirt and got ready to meet his collector friend Old Zhou.
location: Living room and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: At the Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Old Zhou showed Lu Mingqiang an original bottle of Hainan Yedao Deer Turtle Wine from the late 1980s. Lu Mingqiang put on his reading glasses, carefully examined the glaze color and the bottom mark, listened to the story of its acquisition, and noted down key identification points on his phone. The two had a pleasant conversation about wine bottles, Hainan history, and old objects.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province
