description: After saying goodbye to Lao Zhou, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike home. Once home, he looked at the 'Little Cat Walking' programming animation made by Lu Zixuan and felt pleased at his progress. Then he picked up Lu Zihan and read her the newly bought Ultraman picture book, imitating Ultraman's moves to amuse her.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and rest
description: Wang Lijuan made braised pork ribs and garlic lettuce. During dinner, Lu Mingqiang shared what he had learned from his afternoon exchange with Lao Zhou, Lu Zixuan showed his programming animation, and the family spent a warm time together.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Housework and self-improvement preparation
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang voluntarily washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen, and checked the e-bike battery for charging. Then he took out the High Voltage Engineering textbook and previewed the dielectric loss testing chapter to prepare for the evening study.
location: Various locations in the home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening exam preparation: tackle the dielectric loss test
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang studied dielectric loss testing in his study. He drew the schematic diagram of the Schering bridge and derived the formula for reverse connection. When he had difficulties, he sent a message to ask Master Li for advice. Master Li patiently explained over voice messages and added notes on field operation precautions. After repeated study, Lu Mingqiang did practice problems and finally overcame this difficult point.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Mock test and knowledge consolidation
description: Lu Mingqiang completed a set of mock self-test questions on the high voltage technology chapter, timing himself strictly and grading the answers, then analyzing the reasons for his mistakes. Finally, he drew a mind map of the week's knowledge points, linking modules such as transformers, lightning arresters, and dielectric loss testing into a coherent system, and felt he had gained a solid grasp.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening wash-up and relaxation before bed.
description: Lu Mingqiang contentedly tidied up his desk, exchanged study progress with Wang Lijuan, then took a quick shower. Lying in bed, he listened to soothing piano music and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Weighing in early in the morning and preparing for morning exercise
description: The alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up and felt refreshed. He stepped barefoot on the wooden bedroom floor and got on the scale—70.3 kg, 100 grams lighter than yesterday, which improved his mood. Hearing the wind outside, he remembered the forecast called for showers, so he took out a quick-dry sports T-shirt and shorts from the wardrobe and changed into them. Then he grabbed a dry towel and stuffed it into his sports armband bag, ready for his morning run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Ride an electric bike to Baishamen Park for a morning run and chat with fellow runners.
description: Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes, grabbed his e-bike keys, and went downstairs. The sky was just getting light and the air was fresh. He rode the e-bike along Jinmao Middle Road, turned left onto Binhai Avenue, and headed east. Fifteen minutes later he arrived at the entrance of Baishamen Park, parked the bike, bought water at a small shop, and began to warm up. He did shuttle runs under the park's landscaped corridor while a light drizzle came and went. After running less than a kilometer, he ran into his old friend Chen Bin, who was also warming up. They ran and chatted, and Chen Bin complimented him on having lost weight. He opened the food diary APP on his phone to share his weight-loss experience, and they agreed to run together along the coast next week if the weather was good. He completed 5 kilometers as planned, with a pace of 6 minutes 10 seconds, and a moderate amount of sweat.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, take a shower, and get ready for work
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his bike home and saw his wife Wang Lijuan feeding their youngest son Lu Zihan porridge. He greeted them, took a quick shower, and changed into clean work clothes. Before going out, he took the lemon water his wife had made the night before from the fridge and checked the notebook and pen in his commuter bag. Lu Zihan called out "Bye-bye, Daddy!" He patted the child's head, told him to be good, and then left home for work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work by e-bike
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike through the morning rush-hour traffic, turning right from Binhai Avenue onto Haixiu Expressway, then onto Haisheng Road. While waiting at a red light, he briefly browsed industry news on his phone. After arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, he parked the electric bike in the bike shed, nodded a greeting to the security guard Old Li, and quickly walked into the complex building.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team morning meeting and work planning.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into his work clothes and walked into the office; Team Leader Zhang was already there. At the morning meeting, he briefly conveyed the week's key task—to conduct preventive inspections of the distribution rooms in several old residential communities in the area to cope with the summer electricity peak. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang sat back at his workstation, turned on the computer, took out from the drawer the three notebooks and several handwritten data sheets he had recorded last weekend on Bazao Street, spread out the scattered records, and marked the key hazard points (such as insecure crimping of grounding wires) with a red pen in preparation for the upcoming summary report.
location: Office of Power Team One, 3rd Floor, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Summarize the hazard investigation report and report to the manager
description: Lu Mingqiang spent nearly two hours integrating the inspection records from three weekends at Bazao Street and two other old facilities into the “Summary Report on the Special Inspection for Summer Power Supply Assurance,” focusing on three hidden dangers found (grounding wire, aging sealing ring of the meter box, and a stuck lightning arrester counter), all with before-and-after photos and treatment effect assessments. At 9:50, he first took the draft to Team Leader Zhang for review. After reading it, Zhang nodded and said, “The data is solid.” At 10:20, he mustered his courage and took the report to the second floor to give Manager Liu a five-minute briefing. Manager Liu closed the report and said affirmatively, “Good job, thanks for the hard work. This report can serve as a template for the future.” This affirmation made him feel much more at ease.
location: Third-floor office and second-floor manager's office, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying daily necessities on the way, lunch, and a midday rest
description: Near lunchtime, Lu Mingqiang remembered his mother's request for AA batteries and the batteries needed for Hanhan's toy. He rode his electric bike to Xiangzhi General Store, located at the ground-floor commercial area of Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, near his company. He bought four batteries (8 yuan) and a bottle of dark soy sauce (12 yuan), and put them in the seat storage compartment of his e-bike. He then rode back near the company and walked to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant on the ground floor of Xianghe Jiayuan on Haisheng Road. He ordered the spicy soup rice set meal (15 yuan). The spicy soup was flavorful, and he finished quickly. After lunch, he returned to the team rest room at the company, drew the curtains, and lay down on a folding bed for a short nap of about 40 minutes, feeling refreshed.
location: Team rest room, 1st Floor, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went with a colleague to Jinlianyuan Residential Community to re-inspect the power distribution room
description: In the afternoon, Team Leader Zhang assigned Lu Mingqiang and his partner Chen Jianguo to Jinlian Yuan Residential Community for a preventive inspection recheck. The two packed their tools, got on their electric bikes, and rode along Haisheng Road, Qinhai Avenue, Nanhai Avenue, and Jinlian Road, arriving at the community 20 minutes later. In the underground power distribution room, they used flashlights, an infrared thermometer, and a megohmmeter to recheck each item. Lu Mingqiang found that a terminal he had handled last time was at a normal temperature and breathed a sigh of relief. While working, Chen Jianguo took out his phone to show him the new house being built in his hometown, and the two chatted about masonry and wiring layouts in a relaxed mood.
location: Underground power distribution room, Jinlianyuan Community, 8 Jinlian Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned to the company and participated in the team's internal case-sharing meeting
description: The follow-up examination was completed and everything was normal. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo returned to the company by the same route. Back in the team rest room, Team Leader Zhang temporarily gathered everyone for a sharing session on equipment faults that are prone to occur in hot, humid summer conditions. Based on the report compiled that morning, Lu Mingqiang proactively shared a case of a grounding wire hazard he had discovered, explaining in detail the basis for his judgment and the handling process. Colleagues listened attentively, and the new recruit Xiao Zhao asked several questions, which Lu Mingqiang answered one by one.
location: Team rest room, 1st Floor, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Completed report archiving and document organization.
description: Back at his workstation, Lu Mingqiang spent an hour adding the key points from other cases raised during the sharing session to the Common Fault Troubleshooting Handbook. At the same time, he completed the electronic archiving of the summary report that Manager Liu had approved, following the company's internal procedures, and made a backup on his hard drive. Closing his computer, the day's work came to a perfect end.
location: Workstation, 3rd floor, Comprehensive Building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Contact Master Li on the commute home from work.
description: Lu Mingqiang cycled home from work. Before turning into Banshan Garden, he stopped by the roadside and called Master Li to confirm the hands-on guidance time for tomorrow. He asked if tomorrow evening was convenient. Master Li said readily, "I can make it after work tomorrow afternoon; let's meet at 7:30 in the evening." After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang felt reassured and continued cycling home.
location: Near Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home and interact with family
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang put down his bag and handed the battery and soy sauce to his wife Wang Lijuan. His second son Lu Zihan was sitting on the floor mat watching cartoons. He sat over, held the child on his lap, ruffled his hair, and briefly told his wife about being praised by Manager Liu. Wang Lijuan smiled and said, "Then we should add an extra dish tonight," and he felt very happy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wang Lijuan made braised pork ribs with the dark soy sauce Lu Mingqiang had bought, and the family sat around the dining table. Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son Lu Zixuan about today's math class. He picked up a rib and mumbled, "There was one; the teacher taught a new lesson." Lu Mingqiang did not say much, thinking he would talk properly after dinner. The dinner atmosphere was warm.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Make a math improvement plan with the eldest son and conduct the first tutoring session.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang called his eldest son Lu Zixuan into the study, praised his recent progress in English and Chinese, and then changed the subject to the midterm math results. Lu Zixuan hung his head. Lu Mingqiang did not criticize him, but instead took out a notebook and worked with him to draw up the 'Lu Zixuan Math Improvement Plan': 30 minutes of tutoring every evening, focusing on word problems and geometry problems, with 5 points added to the points table after each completed session. Lu Zixuan's eyes lit up, and he nodded in agreement. They immediately began the first tutoring session. Lu Mingqiang took out a tape measure and had Lu Zixuan measure the length and width of the desk and the thickness of the book, then calculate the perimeter and area, helping him understand the concepts through hands-on measurement. Lu Zixuan corrected his own mistakes, and Lu Mingqiang solemnly added 5 points to the 'Programming Explorer Points Table' in front of him. Lu Zixuan showed a happy smile.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Read Common Fault Troubleshooting: 200 Cases
description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang washed his face and returned to the study to calm down. He opened the 200 Common Troubleshooting Examples given by Master Li and began reading through examples 1 to 50 in the latter part, circling key points with a pencil. In particular, for a case about insulation resistance decreasing year by year due to moisture, he combined it with the idea of measuring dimensions from tutoring Lu Zixuan and drew a comparison curve chart on a notebook page. When he reached example 35, he rubbed his eyes and decided to continue tomorrow.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Lu Mingqiang closed his book and went to the bathroom to wash up. His wife Wang Lijuan had already finished and was sitting on the living room sofa with a face mask on. While brushing his teeth, he said to his wife, "Tomorrow evening I've made an appointment with Master Li to guide the hands-on practice, so I won't come home for dinner after work." Wang Lijuan nodded and said, "Okay, then treat yourself to something nice outside."
location: Bathroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talk with wife before bed and then go to sleep

Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about running into Chen Bin during the morning run, having his report praised by Manager Liu, and tutoring Lu Zixuan. Wang Lijuan also shared with him the funny things she saw while taking Lu Zihan downstairs to play today. As they chatted, drowsiness crept in. Lu Mingqiang turned over and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and stretching

He jogged 5.2 kilometers along Jinmao Middle Road toward Wanlv Garden on Binhai Avenue at a pace of 6 minutes 7 seconds per kilometer. He turned back at the entrance of Wanlv Garden and did ten minutes of stretching on the sidewalk by the road to loosen up and prepare for working at heights.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to the Binhai Avenue section near Evergreen Park.

He heated up the custard buns and barbecue pork buns his wife had steamed last night in the microwave, paired them with milk and two boiled eggs, and quickly finished breakfast. In the kitchen, his wife was preparing school bags and water bottles for their two sons.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute, morning meeting, and departure with materials prepared
description: Packed the tool backpack, checked safety ropes, insulating gloves, and other equipment, said goodbye to his wife, and rode an electric bike from home to the company. After hanging up, I felt warm. After eating, I leaned against the wall and rested with my eyes closed, mentally going over the remaining afternoon steps: crimping the main line, checking the circuits, and testing insulation, so I knew exactly what to do.

location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

After confirming my thinking was clear, I turned off the light just after ten and went to sleep, ready for the next day's self-test.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up in the morning, doing morning exercises on the balcony, and buying breakfast on the way to get medicine for his mother.
description: In the morning, he woke up naturally before the alarm went off. The weather was cloudy and comfortable. He walked to the balcony to check the new leaves on the chili seedlings, did five minutes of waist stretching and lunge leg presses to loosen up, and felt full of energy. In his mind, he planned to give Xuanxuan a special Children's Day. Then he walked nearly 47 minutes to Haoyaoshi Pharmacy on Yanzao Road, greeted the familiar shop assistant, Sister Liu, and bought four boxes of pain-relief plasters for his mother's chronic cold-leg pain and two small bottles of medical alcohol, paying in cash. On the way home, he passed a breakfast stall at the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and packed up breakfast for the whole family: for himself, two meat buns and soy milk; for his wife Juanzi, Hainan rice noodles with sauce; for Xuanxuan and Hanhan, one egg custard bun and hot milk each. After arriving home, he put the plasters into the medicine cabinet in the living room, ready to take them to his parents in Meilan District on the weekend.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (set out from home, pass by Haoyaoshi Pharmacy on Yanzao Road and the breakfast stall at the Jinmao Middle Road intersection, and return home)

description: Back home, his wife Juanzi had already helped the two children wash up, and the whole family sat around the dining table having breakfast. Lu Mingqiang announced the special Children's Day plan to Xuanxuan in a mysterious tone: they would fix the old desk lamp that no longer worked, and then go to the hardware store to let Xuanxuan pick out the tools himself. Xuanxuan was so excited that his chopsticks stopped in midair as he fired off question after question. Juanzi smiled and reminded him to be careful not to hurt his hands. Hanhan also joined in, shouting, 'Fix the lamp!' The breakfast was lively and warm.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Repair preparation and taking Xuanxuan to the hardware store to choose tools.
description: After breakfast, Juanzi took Hanhan to the balcony to play, while Lu Mingqiang and Xuanxuan carried an old desk lamp and a toolbox out of the storage room. They spread old newspapers on the coffee table, and Lu Mingqiang taught Xuanxuan to recognize different screwdriver bits, read the multimeter needle, and practice turning screws. Then, with a shopping card with about 120 yuan left on it, the father and son walked about 7 minutes to Xianghongfa Hardware Store on Jinmao Middle Road. Xuanxuan chose carefully in the store and, under guidance, finally selected a small Phillips screwdriver and a beginner circuit experiment kit (with a battery holder, a small light bulb, and wires). They paid with the shopping card and added a bit of cash, and the owner gave an extra small magnetic screwdriver bit as a gift. Xuanxuan hugged the tool bag all the way home, excited.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; and Hainan Xianghongfa Hardware Store (Zhidi Garden Branch)

name: Father-son collaboration to repair an old desk lamp and tidy up
description: After returning home, he washed his hands briefly and tidied up, then officially started fixing the lamp. Lu Mingqiang first explained the working principle of the desk lamp and taught Xuanxuan to unscrew the screws on the lamp holder and identify the live and neutral wires. He used a multimeter to test for continuity and found a hidden break in the vertical tube. Then came the highlight: Mingqiang held Xuanxuan's little hand and taught him to grip the soldering iron, apply solder, and complete the joint. Xuanxuan held his breath and focused, finished the soldering, and wrapped it in insulating tape. After the wires were connected, they plugged it in. When he flipped the switch and the lamp lit up, Xuanxuan jumped with excitement and shouted that he had fixed it. Afterward, they cleaned up the solder dross and wire ends together and solemnly placed the repaired lamp on the upper right corner of Xuanxuan's desk. Juanzi came over holding Hanhan, praised them, and told Hanhan not to casually touch her brother's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simple lunch and midday rest
description: Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to cook: boiled noodles, four fried eggs, and blanched greens. The children watched cartoons in the living room, and Xuanxuan kept talking about the welding details. Lunch was served at 12:30, and the whole family ate and chatted. After the meal, Mingqiang cleared the dishes, had Juanzi take the children for a nap, and dozed on the sofa for about twenty minutes to rest.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: After the lunch break, the weather cleared up with a gentle breeze—perfect for flying kites. Mingqiang drove the whole family to the large lawn on the south side of Wanlv Garden. He helped Xuanxuan launch the eagle kite and handed the reel to Xuanxuan to control himself. Hanhan ran across the grass pulling a little goldfish kite, and even when he fell down he didn't cry. Juanzi chased after him wiping away his sweat. Mingqiang took off his shoes and ran wildly with the kids. When they got tired, they sat in the shade to rest and drink water. As the sun got stronger, they packed up and went home, and Hanhan fell asleep in the car.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returned home to shower and rest, family free time, and tidied up the laundry that was drying.
description: After arriving home, he gave the children showers one by one and changed them into dry clothes. After showering himself, he cut a watermelon for the whole family to enjoy. Hanhan snuggled half-asleep in Juanzi's arms. Then Juanzi went to prepare dinner, while Mingqiang took Xuanxuan back to the room, put the new tools into Xuanxuan's small toolbox, and built a simple LED circuit with circuit components for Xuanxuan to play with. Hanhan flipped through picture books in the living room. At 5:30, Mingqiang went to the balcony, took in the clothes washed that morning and folded them, then checked what Xuanxuan needed to bring to school on Monday.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and themed sharing session
description: Juanzi made minced pork eggplant, garlic stir-fried lettuce, pan-fried mackerel, and tomato and egg soup. Xuanxuan took the initiative to "hold a small meeting," telling his mother and younger brother about the technical process of repairing the desk lamp: using a multimeter to find the break, the soldering iron burning his hand, his nervousness while soldering, and his excitement when the light came on. Mingqiang added professional explanations from the side. Although Hanhan only half understood, he clapped hard every time he heard "the light came on." Juanzi praised Xuanxuan as Daddy's good little helper, and the family laughed continuously.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Housework tidying and evening parent-child time
description: After the meal, Mingqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, wipe the stove, and pack the trash. He heard Xuanxuan in the living room teaching Hanhan how to play with circuit components. After washing up, he cut mango and honeydew melon and shared them with the family. Then he took out One Hundred Thousand Whys: Electricity and Magnetism and explained the transmission of electricity to Xuanxuan, tying it to the lamp repair he had done during the day; Xuanxuan was fascinated. Then he played two episodes of Octonauts, while Mingqiang used his phone to handle work-assignment messages in the work group. At 8 pm he urged the children to wash up, helped Hanhan brush her teeth and wash her face, and Xuanxuan did it by himself.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Children's bedtime and personal time
description: Mingqiang first coaxed Hanhan to sleep, making up a story about a little rabbit fixing a car's headlight, and Hanhan quickly fell asleep. Then he went to Xuanxuan's room, tucked him in, and praised his performance that day; Xuanxuan said he still wanted to fix things. After that, Mingqiang returned to his desk, took out the family ledger to calculate the remaining living expenses for the month and the shopping card balance (a little over 30 yuan), then pulled out his electrician study notebook to review the five-prevention interlocking and relay protection knowledge for high-voltage switchgear, preparing for the mock exam next weekend. After half an hour of studying, he felt more confident.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, relaxing, and having a bedtime chat before sleep
description: Mingqiang closed his notebook, went to wash up and take a shower, changed into pajamas, and lay down in bed. He used his phone to reply to friends' Children's Day greetings, checked tomorrow's weather forecast (cloudy, 23-31 degrees, suitable for going to work), set his phone alarm to 6:20 in the morning and switched it to vibrate. Juanzi also lay down. They turned off the light and chatted. Juanzi said she would go to the community tomorrow morning to help her older female cousin take care of her child for half a day, and asked him to buy groceries on the way home from work. Mingqiang savored the memory of Xuanxuan's excited little face that day and the moment the desk lamp lit up, and felt that this Children's Day was very meaningful. After saying goodnight to each other, they quickly fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 6 a.m., rain was pouring outside. Lu Ming decisively gave up his morning run, laid out an old yoga mat in the living room, and began indoor training: 3 sets of 45-second planks, 3 sets of 1-minute wall sits, and focused on cat-cow stretches and upper-back foam rolling. The 20-minute workout warmed his body slightly and eased the stiffness in his lower back. He then quickly took a hot shower and changed into his blue work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing breakfast in the kitchen. He checked the raincoats and rain boots of his two sons, confirmed that Hanhan's cartoon raincoat zipper was intact and that Xuanxuan's spare socks were stuffed in his schoolbag. After a brief family exchange, he sat at the dining table and quickly ate the hot Hainan noodles with a fried egg that Juanzi had cooked, while checking the work group on his phone and reviewing the key points of the typhoon-day safety operation rules Team Leader Zhang had sent last night.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school in the rain
description: After breakfast, Lu Ming put a raincoat on his younger son Hanhan, and put on an army-green long raincoat himself, picking up a large umbrella. His wife prepared Xuanxuan's school bag rain cover. At 06:50, the father and his two sons went downstairs and drove off in the rain. He first took Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District), hugged the child at the gate, and watched as the teacher led him into the teaching building. Then he turned the car around and took Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District). After arriving, he specifically told his son not to play on the slippery playground during breaks and to be careful. They arrived at 07:20.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, via Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Third Cross Road, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Commute, work preparation, and departure.
description: After dropping off his child, Lu Ming drove from Meilan District to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park in Xiuying District. The windshield wipers swung wildly. On the way, he remembered weighing 70.7 kg the day before and sighed that his weight might have gone up again after breakfast. At 07:30, he arrived at the company, walked straight into the team's standalone office building, changed into a full set of rain gear in the break room, and put on his safety helmet. His colleague Chen Jianguo also arrived, and the two met in front of the tool room. Lu Ming took out his phone, opened the saved 'Distribution Map of Key Equipment in the Area', and circled the locations of transformer boxes A1 and A2 with a marker. Then he and Jianguo checked and collected an infrared thermometer, a clamp meter, wrenches, screwdrivers, a flashlight, a notebook, and walkie-talkies. Team Leader Zhang passed by and again stressed the safety precautions for working in heavy rain. Afterwards, the two referred to the drawing to confirm the optimal inspection route, avoiding low-lying sections prone to water accumulation, checked each other's raincoat hems were tied tightly, and wrapped their tool bags in waterproof bags. After confirming everything was in order, at exactly 08:00, they dashed into the rain curtain during a lull in the rainstorm.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, from Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, and the team rest room and tool warehouse in the industrial park.

name: Inspected A1 and A2 transformer boxes in the rain
description: Lu Ming and Chen Jianguo walked to the A1 box transformer in the Guomao area. It was pouring rain. Lu Ming held an umbrella while Jianguo was responsible for recording. He squatted down and carefully scanned the temperature of each phase wire connector and busbar with an infrared thermometer, while also checking the cabinet sealing and whether the terminal blocks were oxidized or blackened. During the A1 inspection, he found that the C-phase terminal temperature was about 8 degrees Celsius higher than normal, with slight signs of oxidation. He immediately noted down the location, temperature, and appearance in his record book in detail, and took photos as evidence. Then the two moved on to the A2 transformer box and conducted a comprehensive inspection of the equipment; the condition was basically normal. The heavy rain pounded against the equipment enclosure with dense rattling sounds, and both men's pant legs were already soaked through, but the inspection process was carried out meticulously.
location: Site of A1 and A2 transformer boxes in Guomao area, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Urgent return and regrouping
description: The rain suddenly intensified and visibility was extremely low. For safety, Lu Ming and Chen Jianguo decided to suspend fieldwork and return to the company immediately. Back in the team rest room, the two took off their heavy wet raincoats and hung them up. Lu Ming dried his hair and neck with a dry towel and changed into a spare pair of dry trousers. In front of the radiator, he drank the hot water Jianguo handed him to warm up while transcribing the abnormal data recorded at the A1 box-type transformer into the official inspection form, ensuring the information was accurate.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Write the inspection report and handle miscellaneous tasks.
description: After his body warmed up, Lu Ming sat at his desk, turned on the computer, and entered today’s inspection records into the “Summer Inspection Ledger for Substation Facilities.” For the abnormal phase C of A1, he added a preliminary analysis: it might be caused by increased contact resistance at the wiring terminal or overload, and it needed to be included in the weekly inspection plan, with a scheduled power outage for handling. He then printed out a paper copy to report to the team leader in the afternoon. Around 11:30, he used the spare time to handle squad chores: he put the wet socks and shoes next to the dryer; while checking his tool bag, he found that the load-bearing buckle of the safety rope was worn, so he wrote “Safety rope buckle worn, needs replacement” in the “Tool Requisition and Loss Register” and sent a WeChat message to the warehouse manager to explain the situation.
location: Team office and rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon the rain was still heavy. Lu Ming and Jianguo did not want to brave the rain to go to the canteen, so they called the Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant on their phones, ordered two portions of the signature spicy soup rice and two sausages, and asked the owner to deliver them to the guard room of the industrial park. Lu Ming took an umbrella and trotted over to pick up the food, and the two had a hot meal together in the break room. After the meal, Lu Ming lay down on a simple recliner in the break room, covered his belly with his raincoat, and rested for half an hour to recover his energy.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Update the hidden hazard ledger and report to the team leader.
description: After the lunch break, Lu Ming opened the Dynamic Management Ledger for Power Equipment Hazards and formally logged the Phase C abnormality in the A1 transformer box, including the discoverer, time, location, phenomenon description, preliminary cause analysis, and handling suggestion (apply for a power outage to tighten the connection and perform anti-oxidation treatment). He then took the printed inspection report and ledger to Squad Leader Zhang's office and explained the situation in detail. After reviewing the records, Squad Leader Zhang nodded in agreement with his analysis and asked him to prepare the outage work ticket the next morning and deal with this hazard as a priority. Lu Ming accepted the task and returned.
location: Team office and team leader's office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tool inspection and maintenance
description: After the report, Lu Ming returned to the tool storage, took out the worn safety rope connector, and brought it to the maintenance room. He carefully smoothed the edges with a file and sandpaper, tested it to ensure it could bear the load, then reassembled it as a spare. At the same time, he wiped the lens of his infrared thermometer clean and fully charged the battery, ensuring precise and reliable use next time.
location: Equipment Maintenance Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Planned tomorrow's work and prepared to leave work
description: After the maintenance was completed, Lu Ming returned to his desk, opened the notebook for tomorrow's work, and wrote down the first task: “08:30 After the team pre-shift briefing, go with Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the A1 electrical box to perform a power outage operation (in coordination with the power outage notice sheet).” He filed the forms used today and tidied up the desk. He checked the weather forecast; the rain was expected to ease tomorrow, which relaxed him a bit. At 16:00, he changed into spare dry clothes and got ready to leave work.
location: Team office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy groceries on the way and pick up the younger son from school
description: After work, Lu Ming drove first to the Longhua District farmers' market (No. 68 Binya Road) and, as his wife had instructed, bought fresh shrimp, a bunch of greens, and pork ribs for soup. He then arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten before 16:30, swiped his card to pick up his youngest son Hanhan, who was wearing a little raincoat and smiling brightly. Hanhan excitedly held up a paper frog he had folded in a craft activity, saying it was a gift for his father. Lu Ming's heart warmed, and he took him into the car to go home.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District Farmers' Market at No. 68 Binya Road, Longhua District, and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road

name: Went home and helped prepare dinner
description: After arriving home, Lu Ming handed the groceries and his younger son to his wife Wang Lijuan, then changed out of his work clothes and went to the kitchen to help peel garlic and pick vegetables. He told Juanzi that he would need to work overtime tomorrow morning to deal with a hidden hazard point and might not be able to take the kids to school. Juanzi said it was no problem; she would adjust her schedule.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time: homework help and playtime.
description: After finishing in the kitchen, Lu Ming sat down next to his eldest son Xuanxuan in the living room and watched him do math homework. Xuanxuan was stuck on a word problem involving multiplication and division. Lu Ming used the points table calculation method, breaking down the quantitative relationships in the problem into a "points redemption" scenario familiar to his son. Xuanxuan suddenly got it and happily wrote down the answer. Meanwhile, his younger son Hanhan pulled him to play with toy cars on the living room floor. Lu Ming propped up a cardboard vegetable box as a tunnel, making Hanhan giggle. The one-hour parent-child time was full of laughter and joy.
location: Living room and children's room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wife Wang Lijuan made winter melon and pork rib soup, blanched shrimp, and stir-fried greens. The family sat around the dining table. Lu Ming gave each of the two children a shrimp and talked about what he had seen during the rainy inspection today. Xuanxuan listened intently, while Hanhan was busy grabbing ribs with her hands. The atmosphere at the table was warm, and the gloom brought on by days of heavy rain was temporarily dispelled.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Household chores and family leisure
description: After the meal, Juanzi washed the dishes, and Lu Ming cleared the table and mopped the floor. The children curled up on the sofa watching cartoons. He sat nearby, took out his phone to check the work group. Team Leader Zhang had sent the approval form for tomorrow's power outage work on the A1 distribution box. After confirming it was correct, he replied "Received." Then he also browsed local news and learned that many road sections in Haikou were severely flooded, glad that he had come back early.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Checking homework and updating the points chart
description: After the cartoon ended, Lu Ming let Hanhan go play with his mother, and he sat down at Xuanxuan's desk to check all of Xuanxuan's Chinese and math homework for the day, then signed to confirm. Based on the quality and timeliness of his homework, Lu Ming added 5 points on the points chart on the wall. Xuanxuan's eyes lit up, calculating that once he saved another 10 points he could exchange them for a new stationery item.
location: At home, beside the desk in Xuanxuan's bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal washing up and relieving fatigue
description: After letting his wife take a shower first, Lu Ming took a very comfortable hot shower. The water washed over his sore back muscles and washed away the fatigue. After drying off, he deliberately applied the medicated oil patch that Juanzi had prepared on his lower back to relieve the strain from working bent over in the rain today.
location: Bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and family communication
description: Lu Ming lay down on the bed in his pajamas, opened WeChat, and replied to a few friends' messages. His wife Wang Lijuan was also lying beside him. The two discussed whether to take the children back to his parents' house on the weekend if the weather improved, and Lu Ming readily agreed. They chatted about family matters for a while, and Juanzi reminded him not to get the medicated oil on the quilt at night.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and falling asleep
description: After chatting, Lu Ming set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning on his phone, checked the weather forecast, and saw that the heavy rain warning was still in effect but the wind had weakened. He turned off the desk lamp, turned over, and listened to the rain outside gradually becoming sparser. Waves of fatigue swept over him. The last thought that flashed through his mind was that tomorrow he needed to properly deal with the hidden danger in A1 and not let it cause trouble during the typhoon. Then he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Wake-up, stretching, and morning preparation
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:05, with a fine drizzle outside the window. After getting up, he laid a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 5 minutes of cat-cow stretch and two sets of wall sits to relieve soreness in his lower back. Then the scale showed 71.1 kg. Next, he splashed cold water on his face to wake up, checked the muscles in his lower back, and reminded himself to watch today's work intensity. Back in the bedroom, he organized his work clothes, raincoat, and tool bag, and confirmed that the clamp meter and infrared thermometer batteries were fully charged.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared rice porridge, steamed flower rolls, eggs, and homemade pickled radish. The family sat around the table. The eldest son Lu Zixuan mentioned that his math class was going to learn new word problems, while the youngest son Lu Zihan fiddled with the egg in his bowl. Lu Mingqiang told his wife that he might not come home for lunch today, because he needed to work overtime to handle a hidden hazard in the transformer box and complete the inspection.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Took the two children to school in the rain.
description: Lu Ming had the two children put on raincoats and rode the electric bike, first taking his younger son Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten and telling him not to step in puddles on the playground. Then he rode about 10 minutes in the rain to take his older son Xuanxuan to the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School, watched him run into the school gate with his schoolbag, and then left.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province   Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy breakfast on the commute.
description: After dropping off the child, Lu Ming rode along Longkun North Road toward the company. The rain gradually let up. He ordered two portions of lean pork rice rolls at Awen Rice Roll Shop on the roadside, planning to bring one for his partner Chen Jianguo as well. At 7:50, he arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, parked his electric bike, and swiped his card to enter the factory.
location: Awen Rice Roll Shop, Longkun North Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Team morning meeting and preparation for power outage work
description: Lu Ming changed into work clothes and went to the tool room, where he handed the rice noodle rolls to Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang. The three ate while holding a brief pre-shift meeting. They reviewed yesterday's record of high temperature and oxidation at the C-phase terminal of transformer box A1 and confirmed the power-off treatment plan. Then Lu Ming and Chen Jianguo signed the 'Power Line Work Ticket Type 1', and Zhao Qiang served as the safety watcher. They counted and packed tools including insulating gloves, a voltage tester, grounding wire, wrenches, alcohol, fine sandpaper, a clamp ammeter, and spare waterproof tape.
location: Tool Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Went to the site to perform the power outage operation
description: The three of them put on their not-quite-dry raincoats, carried their tools, and drove to the A1 transformer box at a customer's factory on Jinpan Road, Longhua District. After arriving, they strictly followed the procedures: Lu Ming operated the circuit breaker to cut off power, Chen Jianguo supervised and called out the steps, and after the voltage tester confirmed there was no electricity, they hung the grounding wires. Zhao Qiang took the initiative to check the sealing strips of the terminal box and confirmed that no moisture had seeped in.
location: A1 power distribution box at a customer's factory, Jinpan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Handling the oxidation hazard at the C-phase wiring terminal of the A1 transformer box
description: Opened the terminal box; the C-phase terminal was oxidized and blackened. Lu Ming first measured the phase A and B currents and found them normal. Then he removed the C-phase terminal screw, polished the terminal and cable lug with fine sandpaper until they were shiny metallic, and wiped them clean with anhydrous alcohol. He re-tightened all three-phase screws, and Zhao Qiang measured the contact resistance to confirm it had recovered. Lu Ming took before-and-after comparison photos for archiving, then cleaned up the site and removed the grounding wire.
location: A1 power distribution box at a customer's factory, Jinpan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Inspect the third and fourth transformer boxes
description: After finishing the A1 box, the rain stopped. They drove to the third transformer box on Haixiu Middle Road in Xiuying District. Lu Ming used an infrared thermometer and a clamp meter to measure the operating temperature and load current, and found that the Phase B current was slightly high but normal; he recorded the data. Chen Jianguo checked the box seal and drainage holes and found no standing water. Then they went to the fourth transformer box at another customer's factory area in Xiuying District, tightened two loose screws, and retested the indicators, which passed. Zhao Qiang took photos at each point as baseline records before the typhoon season. Throughout the trip, Lu Ming had obvious soreness in his lower back and could only relieve it by straightening his back at intervals.
location: Transformer boxes at a factory compound on Haixiu Middle Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and at another factory compound in Xiuying District

name: Return to the company to report and archive data.
description: The three returned to the company's team office. Lu Ming took off his wet raincoat and hung it up, and let Chen Jianguo rest for a while. He alone entered the A1 box treatment results, inspection photos of the other two locations, and key data (phase-to-phase insulation resistance, grounding resistance, load current, etc.) into the electronic ledger on the computer, then filled in the completion time on the work ticket, signed it, and filed it.
location: Team Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Lu Ming rode his bike alone to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Restaurant on Haisheng Road and ordered the signature spicy soup rice set with a fried egg. The air was humid after the rain, and a bowl of hot spicy soup dispelled the dampness. After eating, he scrolled through his phone to check work group messages and local news, then rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes.
location: Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice, No. 56-4, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team housekeeping and mentoring Zhao Qiang.
description: Back in the team room, Zhao Qiang was reading. Lu Ming took out the motor forward-reverse control circuit diagram he had drawn earlier and analyzed the self-locking and interlocking logic step by step from the power supply until Zhao Qiang fully understood it. Lu Ming also arranged for him to try to draw a star-delta step-down starting sketch next week to improve his ability to read diagrams.
location: Team Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-work preparations, chores, and grocery shopping.
description: Lu Ming checked the notice in the work group chat about next week's typhoon season emergency drill, found that a screwdriver bit was worn, and registered it on the warehouse requisition form. He changed out of his work clothes, packed up his things, and cycled away from the company. After the rain, the sky cleared, and he went straight to Jinmao Wenhua Market to buy fresh water spinach, tomatoes, 15 yuan worth of lean pork, and two hairtail fish to prepare for dinner.
location: Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market, Wenhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: Lu Ming cycled first to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, waited a moment and picked up his elder son Xuanxuan, told him they would have hairtail for dinner, and Xuanxuan was excited. Then they went together to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, where his younger son Hanhan was already waiting at the gate, holding a little paper boat folded in arts and crafts class. The three went home together.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province   Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home and played with his young son
description: After getting home, Lu Ming handed the vegetables to his wife Wang Lijuan and told her how to make dinner. Then he sat on the living room floor with Hanhan to play with the new paper boat and track car, and Hanhan sang a newly learned nursery rhyme haltingly while pushing the car.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: Lu Ming called Xuanxuan to the study to do homework. Today's math was the more complex 'chickens and rabbits in the same cage' word problems. Xuanxuan was confused at first. Lu Ming patiently used the assumption method, drawing step-by-step diagrams on scrap paper to guide him. After going through two example problems, Xuanxuan was suddenly enlightened and completed the remaining problems independently. Lu Ming added 5 points to his reward chart, and Xuanxuan happily reported it to his mother.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wang Lijuan served stir-fried water spinach, tomato and egg soup, braised hairtail, and steamed egg with minced pork. The family sat around the table; Lu Ming asked Xuanxuan how he was doing with his applied math problems and checked on Hanhan's performance at kindergarten. The dinner atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Squash training and matches.
description: After dinner, Lu Ming changed into quick-dry sportswear, warmed up with lunge stretches and shoulder rotations, told his wife, then cycled to Donglibao Squash Club. His fellow player Lin Feng was already warming up. The two of them first jogged lightly and did dynamic stretching, then practiced backhand shots for 20 minutes. In the three-game match, Lu Ming lost the first game 7-11, adjusted his rhythm to win the second 11-9, and narrowly lost the deciding game 12-10. After the match, he showered and changed. On the way back, the sea breeze blew gently, leaving him refreshed and greatly relieving the soreness in his back and waist.
location: Donglibao Squash Club, Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening family interaction and homework check
description: When Lu Ming arrived home, Wang Lijuan was cleaning up the kitchen, and Xuanxuan and Hanhan were watching TV. He watched cartoons with Hanhan for a while, then urged Xuanxuan to wash up, carefully checked that all his homework was correct, and neatly wrote "completed" on the points chart.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal skill learning
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Ming logged into the electrical technology forum in his study, focusing on common fault codes and troubleshooting approaches for variable-frequency drives, and taking screenshots of key parameter settings for vector control and V/F control. He also browsed information on senior technician evaluation to get an initial understanding for future career advancement.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Couple conversation before bed and lights out
description: After washing up, Lu Ming returned to the master bedroom, where his wife was already lying down. He turned off the main light and kept only the bedside lamp, shared with his wife the day's experience of handling the transformer box and conducting inspections, and suggested taking the children to Wanlv Garden to fly kites on the weekend if the weather was clear. His wife readily agreed. They chatted until nearly 11 o'clock, then Lu Ming turned off the light and went to sleep, fully relaxed. The soreness in his back and waist was noticeably lighter than in the morning, and he felt at ease.
location: Master bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and morning stretching
description: At exactly six, he woke up naturally. It was overcast outside, but Lu Mingqiang decided to keep his spirits up. First he stretched in bed and felt that the soreness in his lower back was lighter than yesterday. Then he laid out a mat on the balcony and did a 10-minute Cat Stretch and Child's Pose, focusing on his waist. After stretching, he washed up, shaved, and rinsed his face with cold water, feeling refreshed.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Sorting out chili sauce, having breakfast, and talking with his wife
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and stir-fried greens. Lu Mingqiang carefully wrapped in plastic bags two jars of chili sauce his wife had made from peppers grown on the balcony, and put them in his backpack. His wife reminded him to bring them for Brother Jian and the others to try. He smiled and said, 'Of course!' The family sat around the table for breakfast, simple and warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to take the child to school and then head to the company
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang picked up his work bag and the lunch bag with chili sauce, went downstairs, and rode his electric bike. He first took his 4-year-old younger son Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, gave him a kiss and told him to be good; then took his 8-year-old eldest son Xuanxuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, asking on the way how well he understood the chickens-and-rabbits math problem. Then he rode from Meilan District to his company in Xiuying District, a total of about 15 minutes.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, starting from Banshan Garden in Longhua District, passing through Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District), Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, along the way

name: Team morning meeting
description: Changed into blue work clothes and attended the morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang. Lu Mingqiang proactively reported on the inspection plan for the last transformer box that had been postponed due to rain yesterday, and proposed finishing it with Chen Jianguo in the morning. Team Leader Zhang stressed the importance of data collection during typhoon season, requiring that every wiring terminal and sealing strip be handled carefully and that reports be detailed and truthful. Everyone agreed.
location: Team meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Field inspection of substation boxes and return to the company
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo took an infrared thermometer, tool kit, and record book and rode an electric tricycle to the power distribution room of a factory site along Xinghai Road, Xiuying District. On the way, Lu Mingqiang said he had brought some chili sauce for Jianguo to try. On site, the two conducted a thorough inspection of the transformer box: measured the temperature of the three-phase wiring terminals and found it normal, retightened all screws, checked that the drainage holes were not blocked, and took photos, recorded, and signed off. After finishing, they returned to the company; light rain fell on the way, and when they arrived, they parked the tricycle and put the tools back in place.
location: Power distribution rooms in factory areas along Xinghai Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and return to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road

name: Sharing chili sauce and interacting with the work team over lunch.
description: At lunchtime, Lu Mingqiang placed two jars of chili sauce on the table in the rest area of the work shed and invited everyone to taste his wife's cooking. Chen Jianguo tried it first and was full of praise, jokingly calling him 'the gardening electrician'; Zhao Qiang also said it tasted authentic; Squad Leader Zhang smiled and tried it too. The atmosphere was lively as they ate and chatted, bringing them closer together.
location: Rest area in the work shed at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After tidying up after the meal, Lu Mingqiang set a half-hour alarm and took a nap on the folding bed in the rest room. The morning's physical work plus mental concentration had left him tired, and listening to the rain outside, he soon dozed off.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Systematically compile and submit the inspection report
description: After lunch break, he splashed cold water on his face to refresh himself, then returned to the office to sort and organize the inspection records and on-site photos from the past three days. He carefully filled in the "Summer Inspection Report" with the oxidation treatment of the C-phase terminal in Box A1, the repair of loose wiring in the fourth transformer box, and the inspection results of the last box from the morning, adding notes with follow-up suggestions. After printing, he handed it personally to Squad Leader Zhang and gave a detailed verbal report on the locations of anomalies and how they were handled, providing first-hand evidence for the typhoon season emergency plan.
location: Team office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy groceries and pick up the child after work
description: After submitting the report and getting off work, I rode my electric bike first to the Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market to buy pork spine and winter melon to make dampness-dispelling soup, then passed by Xiangzhi Department and Sundry Store to buy Mimi shrimp chips for my two sons. After that, I went to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up my younger son Hanhan, then to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to wait for Xuanxuan. After picking up both children, I rode slowly home, asking Xuanxuan about his math class on the way.
location: Longhua District and Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing by Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market on Wenhua Road, Xiangzhi General Store at Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, then returning to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: After getting home: family activities, dinner, and evening stretching.
description: After arriving home, he handed the vegetables and items to his wife and changed into loungewear. He played with Hanhan with the track car, checked Xuanxuan's math homework, and after confirming he understood it, added two points to the points chart. Then he went to the balcony to water the chili peppers and flowers that had wilted from days of rain, carefully soaking them thoroughly. Next, he went to the kitchen to help wash and cut winter melon and prepare dinner. Dinner was the pork spine and winter melon soup his wife had stewed, stir-fried water spinach, and leftover hairtail. The family sat together, the children shared funny stories from school, and Lu Mingqiang mentioned that his chili sauce had been well received, making his wife beam with joy. After dinner, it was still light outside. Lu Mingqiang laid out a mat on the balcony and did 10 minutes of cat stretch and child's pose to relieve the soreness in his lower back, feeling very relaxed.
location: Home living room, balcony, kitchen, and dining room at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and household chores
description: After helping clear the table, he first tutored Xuanxuan on his reading homework. name: Emergency repair field assignment
description: At 13:00, he received a call from Wang Jianguo, the property management liaison for Jinmao Middle Road, saying that multiple units in an old residential building had tripped. He quickly prepared the emergency tool kit, checking the clamp meter, screwdriver set, spare circuit breakers, electrical tape, etc., changed into work clothes, and told his wife before leaving. He drove along Jinmao Middle Road and arrived at the scene in about 12 minutes. After reassuring the residents, he entered the meter room. A wave of heat hit him from the main breaker box. Using the clamp meter, he found that the load on phase A exceeded the limit at 127A, and the wiring terminals were oxidized, loose, and hot. He shut off the main breaker, removed the oxidized terminals in the cramped space, replaced them with copper terminals and fuses, and shifted part of the air-conditioning load to phases B and C to balance the three phases. This took about 30 minutes. He then closed the breakers floor by floor to confirm power was restored, advised residents to use electricity during off-peak hours, and accepted a resident's bottle of water as thanks. Feeling discomfort in his lower back when leaving, he rested briefly in the car and then drove home.
location: Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (electricity meter room of an old residential building and the route to and from it)

Instead of getting up immediately, he lay on his side and did a few gentle cat stretches to mobilize his spine, then lay flat, hugged his knees, and rolled gently left and right, listening to the rain pattering outside, letting his body gradually adapt.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Indoor core training and massage relaxation
description: After getting up, Lu Mingqiang spread out a mat in the living room and did targeted core training. He first did 5 minutes of wall sits, with each set lasting 45 seconds and 10 seconds of rest in between; then he did 10 minutes of glute bridges, pausing for 2 seconds when lifting with the glutes; afterward, he used a foam roller to relax the quadratus lumborum and gluteus medius. He stopped after only one 30-second set of planks because his lower back began to feel sore. Although the intensity was not high, his body was slightly sweaty afterward, and the tension in his lower back had eased somewhat.

description: After arriving at the company, Lu Mingqiang first went to the pantry to get some warm water, then attended the morning meeting organized by Team Leader Zhang at 8 o'clock. The team leader specifically arranged for him to take the apprentice Zhao Qiang to study the wiring diagrams of the newly arrived vacuum circuit breaker cabinet in the workshop, and to get hands-on practice in the power distribution room in the afternoon. Considering that outdoor field work was postponed due to rain, this suited him perfectly.

Zhao Qiang asked serious questions about interlock protection, and Lu Mingqiang answered them one by one. During this time, they also went to the warehouse to pick up copper busbars and insulators of various specifications to prepare for the afternoon hands-on practice.

Jianguo noticed that he looked unwell and asked about his back injury. Lu Mingqiang admitted that he had stopped running for nearly a week and couldn't sleep at night, with his lower back feeling like a stone was under it. Jianguo shared his own experience, suggested lowering the running pace after the rain stopped, and taught him a little-swallow exercise, telling him to lie face down on the bed and do 15 of them. Lu Mingqiang nodded and felt a little more at ease.

Then he opened Xuexi Qiangguo to finish the quiz, and browsed the PDF of "Transformer Maintenance and Fault Analysis" saved on his phone, quickly reviewing the section "The Impact of Transformer Overload on Insulation Aging" from yesterday's emergency repair notes, planning to systematically review in the evening. After that, he lay on the small bed in the rest room for 20 minutes to let his lower back rest.

He used a megger to test the insulation of the main busbar and each feeder cabinet, and the readings were good. Then he simulated replacing an aging wire terminal on a feeder cabinet, strictly following the procedures: tightening the nut with a torque wrench and applying conductive paste. Throughout the operation, he deliberately slowed his movements and used leg strength instead of back strength when crouching, to avoid sudden force on his lower back. Zhao Qiang carefully recorded the data and handed him tools.
location: The power distribution room of a commercial building under construction on Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Before leaving work, he noticed that the rain outside the window had completely stopped and the sky was slightly bright, and his gloomy mood had lifted a bit.
location: Engineering Department Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

He suppressed his anger, pointed at the practice grid, and demonstrated stroke by stroke for Xuanxuan, telling him where to start and where to end each stroke. Xuanxuan was somewhat impatient. Lu Mingqiang patiently held on for half an hour, finally getting him to finish writing the characters neatly, then supervised him in completing the reading check-in for the lesson.

Drawing on yesterday's emergency repair of the old transformer, he focused on reviewing the chapter "Transformer Overload and Thermal Faults," drawing a concept map as he read, connecting key points such as insulation aging, abnormal oil level, and gas relay operation, and wrote a note beside it: "6.8 emergency repair, Phase A overload 30%, pay attention to temperature rise." It took him 55 minutes, and he wrote another two and a half pages of notes.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Wang Lijuan reminded him to buy the snacks and fruit his parents liked in advance on Friday. After applying the hot compress for nearly half an hour, his back felt warm and much more comfortable.

He felt his lower back muscles were moderately stimulated. After finishing this relaxation routine, his body felt much lighter.

Thinking that he had completed work, exam preparation, and physical recovery as planned today, he felt at ease. He set the alarm for 6:30, closed his eyes, listened to the occasional sound of cars passing outside the window, and slowly fell asleep.

The work was not heavy but required care, and after checking several main cabinets we were all sweating. During a water break, I also went over the transformer protection mind map I had conceived last night.

He rolled down the window, took out the transformer protection notes he had organized the night before, and began sorting out the logical relationships among the five core formulas with a mind map. In just twenty minutes, the differences between differential protection and overcurrent protection became clear on paper, and he felt much more at ease. At 13:00, he returned to the workshop on time.

Time passed quickly; at 17:00 we successfully completed the repair and filled out the maintenance record.

I found a sticky note, neatly copied down the two most essential formulas from the transformer protection section, and stuck it on the bedroom nightstand. Next, I searched in my phone browser for running warm-up and stretching tutorials, carefully watched a 15-minute dynamic warm-up video for runners, and wrote key points in Notes, such as 'keep your center of gravity low during lunge twists and make full circles with your ankles.' Then I searched e-commerce sites for professional cushioned running shoes, focusing on the 'Bimai 42K', 'Do-win War God 2', and a little-known domestic brand. I read reviews on last width, cushioning, and traction, and added two favorites to the cart. Finally, I sent a WeChat message to my friend Chen Bin: 'Lao Chen, are you free Saturday morning? Want to go try on shoes at the Runner's Gear store on Haixiu Middle Road? I've saved a few models but I'm not sure about them.' A few minutes later, Chen Bin replied 'OK' and a thumbs-up.

Lao Lu put on insulating gloves, carefully unscrewed the aged, hot switches with a screwdriver, cleaned the accumulated dust and oxide layer inside the boxes, and then replaced them with matching new switches, using a multimeter to confirm the wiring was correct. The two took turns operating and reminded each other to stay safe. As the outdoor temperature rose, the stairwell became stuffy and hot, and sweat quickly soaked their work clothes. The two hydrated every half hour.
location: Unit corridors, Buildings 2 and 5, Haikou Jinjiang Teachers' Village, No. 31-1 Qingnian Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch at the worksite and theory review in the car

Lao Lu ordered a pork offal noodle soup with egg and specifically asked for extra vegetables and less oil; Jianguo ordered dry-fried beef ho fun. After eating quickly, Lao Lu paid. Back in the work truck parked in the shade, Lao Lu reclined the seat and rested with his eyes closed for a while. After the lunch break, he took out the textbook Advanced Electrician Theory, leaned back in the seat, and read the chapter "Three-Phase AC Circuits" for about 20 minutes. He copied the power formulas into his pocket notebook and thought about how to draw a mind map, deciding to have his son teach him in the evening.
location: Azheng Fast Food Restaurant opposite Haikou Jinjiang Teachers' Village, No. 31-1 Qingnian Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and inside a nearby work vehicle.

name: Afternoon wrap-up of distribution box maintenance and assistance with ceiling fan repair at the company.

He rechecked the switch replaced in the morning to ensure it was tightened, then inspected the main power distribution room on the first floor of Building 5, measuring the incoming line voltage and grounding resistance; the readings were normal. After packing up all tools and checking the site, a light rain began to fall, so the two quickly got into the car. Lao Lu then drove back to the company as the rain grew heavier, driving carefully. They arrived at the company at around 3:25 PM, returned the tools to the warehouse for cleaning and storage, and then went to the office to fill out a paper work order, recording in detail the model, location, and completion status of the replaced switch. After checking it, Team Leader Zhang signed and praised the work. Afterwards, the new apprentice Zhao Qiang asked for help because an industrial ceiling fan in the workshop was not turning. Lao Lu inspected it with him and found that the start capacitor was broken. He taught Zhao Qiang hands-on how to test the capacitor and replace it with a new one. After powering on, the fan returned to normal, and Zhao Qiang carefully wrote down the steps.
location: Building 5 and the electrical distribution room of Haikou Jinjiang Teachers Village, No. 31-1 Qingnian Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; office and maintenance workshop of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

After about 18 minutes of riding, he arrived at the south gate of Baishamen Park. He parked, did some simple stretches, and started running at 6:22. He tested the shoes in three segments as planned: first, he ran at a steady pace for 2 kilometers on the park's stone slab path (pace about 6'10"), feeling the cushioning of the soles; then he turned onto the asphalt road and sped up to a 5'50" pace for 2 kilometers; finally, he finished the last 1 kilometer steadily at a 6'00" pace on the rubber track. The total 5 kilometers averaged a 6'00" pace, 15 seconds faster than before, with no discomfort in his knees or soles. After the run, he walked slowly to let his heart rate settle, then rode home for a shower. After showering, he opened the notes app on his phone in the living room and recorded the data: "6.23 morning run 5k, pace 6'00", weight 72.4kg, no knee or foot pain" and thought about adding variable-speed running starting in July.
