location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (starting point), then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District), Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store at Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, and finally back to Banshan Garden Residential Area.

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Lu Wenqiang arrived home and put the groceries in the kitchen. His wife had already cooked Hainan rice noodles and poached eggs. He sat down and quickly finished breakfast, then checked his tool bag, confirming the multimeter and screwdriver were there. He was ready to ride his electric bike to work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work.
description: Lu Wenqiang put on a rain poncho and rode his electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road and Haixiu West Road toward Xiuying District. With slow traffic during the rainy morning rush hour, it took about 25 minutes; he reached the company bicycle shed before 08:05 and locked the bike.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team morning meeting and work arrangements
description: Lu Wenqiang changed into his work clothes and attended the team morning meeting. Team leader Zhang briefly reviewed yesterday's inspection and repair of the distribution box in the old residential community on Haixiu West Road, praised Zhao Qiang for learning quickly, but emphasized safety during rainy-day work: insulated gloves and boots must be worn properly. The morning task was to go back to yesterday's community to finish up and recheck the ground restoration and insulation test. After the meeting, Lu Wenqiang specifically pulled Zhao Qiang aside and reminded him to guard against heatstroke. Although it was not hot today, the stuffy weather could easily cause dehydration, so he told him to fill his water bottle.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (company tool room and office)

name: Morning: finalizing field maintenance work and returning to hand it over.
description: Lu Wenqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang took their tool bags and equipment and drove the company pickup truck to the old residential community on Haixiu West Road. Though the rain had stopped, the ground was slippery. They reinstalled all the distribution box panels removed yesterday, tightened the screws, and used a megohmmeter to re-test the insulation of all circuits; all readings passed. After completing the wrap-up work, they cleaned the site and took the waste materials and old wires back. Around 11:30 they knocked off and took the pickup back to the company; on the way, Jianguo brought up the topic of running. After returning to the company, Lu Wenqiang returned the borrowed instruments to the warehouse.
location: Old residential community on Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: Lu Wenqiang and Chen Jianguo went to "Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant" near the company for lunch. He ordered a spicy soup rice with a fried egg and a big chicken leg for 5 yuan to reward himself. The hot and sour soup drove away the dampness of the rainy day. The two chatted while eating. Jianguo said he wanted to go sea fishing on the weekend. Lu Wenqiang said he had arranged to go running with Chen Bin early in the morning on the weekend and was afraid it would affect his condition, so they could make an appointment next time. Together they spent 36 yuan.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Lu Wenqiang returned to the company, leaned back in his chair in the break room for a while, scrolled through discussions about warm-up exercises on the running forum, and confirmed the title of the video he wanted to watch in the evening.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon work: organizing tools and preparing reports.
description: In the afternoon, the rain stopped and there were no field assignments. Lu Mingqiang stayed in the tool room, cleaned and dried the gloves and safety helmets used in the morning, and ground down the worn screwdriver bits. He then returned to the office, turned on the computer, compiled the survey data of the electrical distribution cabinets in the old residential area from the previous weekend into electronic form, filled out the material requisition list for the next week (insulating tape and wire lugs), and sent it to Team Leader Zhang. He also checked several data items with Chen Jianguo and submitted after confirming they were correct.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (tool room and office)

name: Commute after work and car repair.
description: At 17:00 he clocked out. Lu Wenqiang rode his e-bike first to the electric bike repair shop next to the car repair shop at Binhai International Financial Center. He told the repairman that the brake felt too loose when squeezed and wouldn't stop properly. After checking, the repairman tightened the brake cable and charged 5 yuan. The brake feel was immediately firm. Then he continued home.
location: Electric bike repair shop, 32F, West Zone, Building A, Binhai International Financial Center, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Supermarket shopping
description: After leaving the car repair shop, Lu Wenqiang stopped by RT-Mart on the way. He pushed a cart and bought paper towels that were almost used up at home (two packs of Vinda), laundry detergent (one jug of Chaoneng), and bulk jelly and Swiss roll snacks for his two sons, spending 89 yuan in total.
location: RT-Mart (Guomao Store), No. 8 Mingzhu Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home to help with chores and parent-child interaction
description: When Lu Wenqiang got home and put down his things, he saw his wife washing vegetables, so he rolled up his sleeves and helped peel garlic and trim vegetables. His younger son Lu Zihan ran over and hugged his leg. He picked up Hanhan, kissed him, and played with him on the floor with building blocks. His eldest son Lu Zixuan was doing homework. Lu Wenqiang walked over and asked how today's word problems went. Lu Zixuan said there was one he couldn't figure out, and Lu Wenqiang said they would look at it after dinner.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: His wife cooked home-style dishes: pork rib and winter melon soup, stir-fried choy sum, and pan-fried mackerel. At the table, Lu Wenqiang asked his wife about the payment. She said she had already gone to the community service center, paid 3,950 yuan, and gotten a receipt. He nodded, then asked Lu Zixuan if anything new had happened at school. Zixuan said his team won the relay race in the afternoon PE class. The family atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Rest and family time after dinner.
description: After dinner, Lu Wenqiang took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes in the kitchen. His wife bathed the two children. He dried his hands, sat on the living room sofa, and rested to help digestion.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Systematically study warm-up and stretching videos
description: Lu Wenqiang took out his phone and searched Bilibili for two popular videos: "Dynamic Warm-Up Before Running: Full Follow-Along" and "Static Stretching After Running: Avoid Thick Legs and Knee Injury." He cast his phone to the TV while his wife played with Hanhan beside him. He first watched the videos through once, memorizing key moves such as jumping jacks, high knees, and butt kicks. On the second round, he turned on follow-along mode, stood on the mat, and did the moves with the video, carefully feeling the muscle engagement and stretch.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Practice standard movements on your own.
description: After watching the video, Lu Wenqiang practiced the dynamic warm-up from start to finish again by himself (jumping jacks, straight-leg front kicks, side-step leg presses), then static stretching (quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves, each held for 30 seconds). His flexibility was average; when bending forward, his fingers could only reach his ankles, but he gritted his teeth and kept the movements standard. His second son Hanhan imitated him nearby, wobbling like a little penguin, and finally sat down on the floor, making the whole family laugh.
location: Living room floor mat, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Neighbors help each other repair a lamp holder.
description: Lu Wenqiang was wiping off sweat with a towel when the doorbell rang. Uncle Wang next door came over with homemade coconut cake to ask for help, saying the kitchen light had been flickering for the past few days and now wouldn't turn on. Lu Wenqiang took the coconut cake, went back inside to get a voltage tester and screwdriver, and put on a headlamp. At Uncle Wang's kitchen, he checked and found the lamp socket's spring contact strip had deformed, causing poor contact. He carefully pried the strip up with a small screwdriver, then screwed in the bulb; the light came on and no longer flickered. Uncle Wang thanked him repeatedly.
location: Neighbor Uncle Wang's home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shower, wash up, evening tidying, and leisure
description: Lu Wenqiang returned home, put the coconut cakes on the table, and then took a cool shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue. Back in the living room, he carefully wiped his new running shoes with a soft cloth and put them back in the shoebox. In his phone memo app, he noted down the important stretching exercises he had learned this evening. Then he went to the balcony and wiped his collection of liquor bottles one by one with a soft cloth, holding them up to the light to examine the glaze.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Night talk with family and checking the children
description: After his wife finished the housework, the two of them sat on the sofa and watched a Hainan local food documentary for a while. Lu Wenqiang chatted about the day's events at the company while watching. At 10 p.m., he went to his eldest son's room and saw Lu Zixuan had already packed his schoolbag and was lying in bed reading. Zixuan said he had been thinking about that math problem for a long time tonight and finally solved it. Lu Wenqiang rubbed his head, praised him for his persistence, told him to go to sleep early, and turned off the light for him.
location: Living room and eldest son's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest
description: Lu Wenqiang returned to the master bedroom and set the alarm for 06:15 tomorrow morning. Lying down, he reviewed the day: although the rain kept him from running, he systematically studied warm-up and stretching and corrected his form; helping Uncle Wang made him feel at ease; and the tutoring class fee was paid, a major matter settled. He turned off the lights and went to sleep at 22:45.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Getting up in the morning, weighing, morning activation, and washing up
description: The alarm rang at 5:50 on time. Lu Mingqiang got up quickly, first stepped on the scale to weigh himself — 72.3 kg, the same as yesterday, so the weight loss plan was going well. Then he did a simplified version of the pre-run dynamic warm-up in the living room, including jumping jacks, lunge twists, and high knees, 15 seconds each, to fully activate his hip joints and knees. Next, he quickly washed up, changed into his company work clothes, and packed the coconut cake that Uncle Wang gave him yesterday into his bag for later. During this time, he received a WeChat message from his wife Juanzi. Learning that she might have caught a cold, Lu Mingqiang replied, telling her to drink more warm water and saying he would bring qingbuliang back in the evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the two sons to school and return home for breakfast.
description: Lu Mingqiang took his electric bicycle to first take his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Central Kindergarten. On the way, he bought him a lollipop at the Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store on Yusha Road and watched his son go into the kindergarten happily. Then he turned to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to take his older son Lu Zixuan, and at the school gate told him that they would review the wrong questions together in the evening to fix his careless habits. After dropping off the children, he returned home. His wife Juanzi had already gone to work at the community. Lu Mingqiang quickly ate the white congee with fried egg she had left, plus a meat bun bought that morning to replenish his energy, then put on his safety helmet and took his water bottle, ready to go to work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Sanheng Road, Guomao, Longhua District); Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

name: Commuted to the company by electric bike
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from his home on Jinmao Middle Road, turned from Longhua Road onto the auxiliary road of Haixiu Expressway, then onto Haisheng Road. After riding for about 12 minutes, he arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, parked the bike, and entered the office.
location: From No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Team morning meeting and daily work arrangement
description: After Lu Mingqiang changed into his work clothes, Team Leader Zhang called a morning meeting. Zhang first reported on the completion of the rectification of the old residential community on Haixiu West Road yesterday, then assigned today's core task: go to an old commercial-residential building on Jinmao Street in Longhua District to inspect and replace electricity meter boxes with potential hazards. Zhang specifically reminded everyone that the weather was hot and humid, and asked them to drink more water and watch their physical condition, especially mentioning that Xiao Zhao looked unwell yesterday and should not push himself too hard.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning inspection of electric meter boxes in an old commercial-residential building and safety training notice confirmation
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang arrived with tools at an old mixed residential-commercial building on Jinmao Subdistrict. The hallway was narrow and stuffy, and the three took turns turning screws, measuring current, and replacing aging switches as planned. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of the main operations, Chen Jianguo assisted and kept watch, and Zhao Qiang handed tools and took notes. During the work, Lu Mingqiang noticed that Zhao Qiang was sweating heavily and looking pale, so he immediately had him rest and drink water in a ventilated area. During a break, his phone received a notice in the team WeChat group: Foreman Zhang required everyone to attend the heatstroke prevention and first aid safety training at 9 a.m. the next day. Lu Mingqiang replied “Received” and reminded Zhao Qiang to confirm. Near the end of work, they tidied up the replaced old meter boxes and waste materials and carried them back to the car. Taking advantage of the break, Lu Mingqiang ate half a meat bun and drank more than half a pot of water. Chen Jianguo talked about his weekend sea fishing plans, while Lu Mingqiang mulled over the matter of going to his mother's home on the weekend.
location: Old mixed residential-commercial building, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (specific address unknown).

name: Lunch: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo went as usual to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the company for lunch. The weather was hot, so Lu Mingqiang ordered a bowl of pork offal spicy soup with a large bowl of rice. After the hot soup went down, he sweated freely and felt refreshed. During the meal, Chen Jianguo brought up sea fishing again. Lu Mingqiang made it clear that he would be taking his wife and children to his mother's home for the weekend and could not join, so Chen Jianguo did not insist and moved on to other topics.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break at the office.
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang returned to the office and took a half-hour nap on his desk to save energy for the afternoon material inventory and report work, as well as the evening squash session.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon materials inventory check and maintenance report work
description: In the high outdoor temperatures of the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang stayed in the office to organize the morning's on-site situation, compile a maintenance report, verify the spare parts list, register the materials that needed replenishment, and report it to Zhang Tou. During this period, he received a WeChat message from Manager Liu asking about his preparation for the senior technician assessment. Lu Mingqiang replied that he was looking up materials to study and planned to systematically watch video courses starting in July.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: End-of-day wrap-up and tool and equipment inspection before leaving work
description: Lu Mingqiang checked the safety warning tape and first aid kit needed for tomorrow's safety training and confirmed they were within their validity period; he also organized the tools that might be needed tomorrow and put them back in place. At exactly 17:00, he clocked out and left the company on his electric bike.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returning home to change clothes and replenishing energy before exercise
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang took off his sweat-smelling work clothes and changed into loose gym shorts and a quick-dry T-shirt. He ate a banana and drank a large glass of warm water to replenish energy; he checked his water bottle and filled it, put his squash racket and wrist guard into his sports bag, and got ready for the evening training.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycled to the squash court.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from his home in Longhua District to the squash court in Qiongshan District. Along the way, the sun slanted down, but the summer heat had not yet faded. While riding, he silently recited the key points of the dynamic warm-up moves he would need in the evening: lunge twists, jumping jacks, high knees, etc., reminding himself not to go on court blindly as he used to. He arrived at the court 25 minutes later.
location: From No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to a squash court in Qiongshan District.

name: Squash training and practicing the new warm-up routine
description: Lu Mingqiang met his squash partner Lin Feng at the Qiongshan District squash court. Lu Mingqiang suggested doing a 10-minute dynamic warm-up first using the newly learned method: jumping jacks to raise the heart rate, lunge twists to activate the hip joints, and high knees to engage the core. Seeing how professional his movements were, Lin Feng laughed and said, 'Brother Ming, you've become a professional coach.' After the warm-up, with their hips and legs fully activated, the two practiced near-wall volleys and recovery runs as planned, then played three games against each other. It was scorching hot, so Lu Mingqiang deliberately controlled the pace and reminded himself and Lin Feng to hydrate every few rallies.
location: A squash court in Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Stretching and relaxing after squash and politely declining a late-night snack
description: After playing ball, Lu Mingqiang pulled Lin Feng to the rest area of the gym and carefully stretched his quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves using static stretching methods. Lin Feng praised the stretching as thorough and said he would also learn this routine in the future. After changing clothes, Lin Feng suggested going to the newly opened barbecue stall across the street for a couple of drinks. Lu Mingqiang politely declined, saying he was cutting fat and had to study for a certification exam at night. The two said goodbye at the gym entrance.
location: Rest area of a squash court in Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Bought cooling dessert soup for the family on the way home
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike home, deliberately detouring to the qingbuliang stall beside the 'Datie Laoba Tea Shop' on Binya Road in Longhua District, and packed two bowls of coconut milk qingbuliang, the favorite of his wife Juanzi — one for Juanzi, one for the two sons. He then returned smoothly to his home on Jinmao Middle Road.
location: Qingbuliang stall on Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (next to the Datie Old Man Tea Shop), and Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Father gives video guidance on rehabilitation exercises
description: After entering, Lu Mingqiang put down the qingbuliang, took a quick shower, and changed into dry clothes. Seeing his younger son Lu Zihan sitting on the floor building with blocks, he squatted down to play with him and taught him to build a high-voltage tower where Daddy works. Hanhan clapped happily, and Lu Mingqiang enjoyed a rare moment of relaxation.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped the elder son correct his wrong answers
description: After the youngest son was taken by his wife Juanzi to have a bath, Lu Mingqiang called the eldest son Lu Zixuan over and took out the mistake notebook. He patiently guided Zixuan to review several math problems, pointed out the carrying errors, and demonstrated the correct solutions step by step, trying to control his tone so as not to put pressure on his son. Zixuan occasionally muttered during the corrections, but Lu Mingqiang did not take it to heart and promptly affirmed and encouraged him after they were corrected.
location: Dining table in the living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Self-Study: PLC Programming Basics
description: After both children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, opened his laptop, and searched online for 'senior technician practical assessment PLC programmable controller'. Realizing that this was a new field different from his daily high-voltage electrical maintenance, he downloaded a free introductory tutorial video and took notes while watching, recording concepts such as ladder diagrams and basic instructions. Although he felt a bit unsure, he decided to study systematically at least three evenings a week starting in July, taking the first step toward career advancement.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening tidying and preparing for bed
description: After turning off the computer, Lu Mingqiang took out a newly acquired ceramic liquor bottle with a distinctive shape from his collection cabinet, carefully wiped it with a dry towel, and put it back in place. When he returned to the bedroom, his wife Juanzi was already asleep. He turned off the light and reviewed the day: work went smoothly, training was confirmed, the warm-up practice was effective, he politely declined pointless social engagements, tutored the children, and started learning new knowledge. Although his body was tired, his heart was at ease. He set the alarm for 6:10 the next morning and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Study and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: At 6:10 a.m. on June 26, 2025, the alarm went off on time. The first thing Lu Mingqiang did after getting up was to step on the electronic scale in the bedroom. It showed 72.4 kilograms, about the same as yesterday, and he felt relieved.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning preparation and waking the children
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang deliberately wore a cotton short-sleeved work uniform to prevent heatstroke. At 6:25, he went to wake up his two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. Zixuan wanted to sleep five more minutes, while Zihan got up by himself as soon as he heard about school, thinking about buying lollipops. He helped them get dressed and checked their schoolbags.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the kids to school by electric bike
description: At 6:30, Lu Mingqiang set off on his electric bicycle with the two children. First, they arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road. Zihan picked out a watermelon-flavored lollipop at the convenience store near the gate before going in. Then he took Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road, Meilan District. At the school gate, Lu Mingqiang squatted down and asked Zixuan whether he had figured out yesterday's queuing problem, and reminded him to solve problems by drawing diagrams. They returned home at 7:05.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and discussion of family matters.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: dry-mixed Hainan rice noodles and conch soup. While eating, Lu Mingqiang told his wife that the company would have a heat-stroke prevention training in the morning, and Manager Liu would also attend. After eating, he changed into a more formal long-sleeve work uniform and put his notebook and ballpoint pen into his tool bag.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and pre-shift preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike along Binhai Avenue and arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, in about fifteen minutes. After parking, he went into the team tool room, checked his tool bag, and confirmed that his notebook and pen were there. Team leader Zhang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang arrived one after another. Jianguo offered a cigarette, but Lu Mingqiang politely declined. Team leader Zhang assigned the day's schedule: attend safety training in the morning, go to Jinlong Community in the afternoon to finish the distribution box work, and reminded them to stay hydrated. Lu Mingqiang wrote down the afternoon work in his notebook.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: High-temperature safety training and practical assessment
description: At 8 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang and his colleagues attended heatstroke prevention safety training. Safety supervisor Lao Zhou used a PPT to explain heatstroke accident cases, analyze the stages of heatstroke, and stress that workers should immediately stop work and move to a cool place if they feel dizzy or nauseous. Lu Mingqiang listened attentively and drew a flow chart for heatstroke emergency response in his notebook. Then came a hands-on CPR assessment. He knelt beside a mannequin and performed the standard procedure: 30 chest compressions at a rate of 100-120 per minute, a depth of 5-6 cm, followed by 2 rescue breaths after every 30 compressions. Lao Zhou praised his rhythm. When Xiao Zhao was operating, his compression depth was insufficient, and Lu Mingqiang quietly reminded him to use strength from his waist and abdomen. The training ended at 10:30.
location: Large meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Conversation with Manager Liu and career encouragement.
description: After the training, Manager Liu called Lu Mingqiang to his office and said he had solid skills and was a key person being groomed. The company was expanding its business, and if he passed the senior technician exam, they would consider making him deputy team leader to lead a team. Lu Mingqiang was both excited and under pressure, and said he was worried about his lack of experience. Manager Liu encouraged him to strengthen his weak points and prepare well for the exam. Lu Mingqiang was deeply encouraged.
location: Manager Liu's office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and camaraderie with colleagues
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo walked to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant at Xianghe Jiayuan on Haisheng Road near the company. He ordered the signature spicy soup rice with a fried egg. Jianguo asked about the conversation with Manager Liu, and Lu Mingqiang told him what was discussed. Jianguo was happy for his old friend, encouraged him, and reminded him that being a team leader requires patient communication. The two decided to finish up at Jinlong Residential Community in the afternoon. They finished eating at 11:50 and returned to the company.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and recharging
description: Back at the company break room, Lu Mingqiang had planned to take a nap, but with Manager Liu's words and the PLC on his mind, he couldn't sleep. He took out his phone and watched a teaching video on 'PLC Beginner Ladder Diagrams' for 20 minutes, and in his notebook he added ladder diagram symbols. At 13:20, he closed his eyes and rested for a dozen or so minutes.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon commute to work.
description: At 13:45, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang rode electric bikes from the company to Jinlong Community in Longhua District. On the way, they bought two large bottles of mineral water at the Bianli Shenghuo convenience store. They arrived at the community gate at 14:00.
location: Jinlong Community, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Community distribution box inspection wrap-up
description: In the underground power distribution room of Jinlong Community, the room temperature was 34 degrees Celsius. Lu Mingqiang used a temperature gun to check, then inspected the wire terminals replaced the day before, re-tightening them one by one with a wrench. Jianguo used a multimeter to measure insulation resistance, and Xiao Zhao recorded the data. They were drenched in sweat while working, and Lu Mingqiang reminded Xiao Zhao to drink water to prevent heatstroke. At 16:45, all inspections were completed with normal readings; they inventoried the tools, took photos for records, and returned to the company.
location: Power distribution room of Jinlong Residential Community, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Get off work, return home, and go shopping.
description: At 16:45, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company, clocked out, organized the afternoon work log, and checked the next day's spare parts list. At 17:00, he left the company by bike. On the way home, he stopped at a fruit stall and bought two fresh coconuts and red-fleshed dragon fruit, and also bought mung beans and pearl barley to make qingbuliang for his wife on the weekend. He arrived home at 17:30, took a shower, and changed into loungewear.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child time
description: After Lu Mingqiang got home, his wife was stir-frying dishes. He cleaned the table and set out bowls and chopsticks. His younger son Hanhan was playing with a new Lego car, and his older son Xuanxuan was doing homework. During dinner, Lu Mingqiang asked Xuanxuan about interesting things at school. Xuanxuan said he had scored a goal playing soccer in PE class. Lu Mingqiang promised to look at those two word problems together after dinner. He also teased Hanhan, asking if the lollipop was tasty. The whole family was happy and harmonious.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family sharing and wife's encouragement
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and his wife cleaned up the dishes together. At 19:00, the children were playing in the living room. Lu Mingqiang pulled his wife into the kitchen and excitedly told her that Manager Liu had asked him to take the senior technician exam and that he might become deputy team leader in the future. His wife was very happy and encouraged him to prepare for the exam with peace of mind, saying she would share more of the household responsibilities. Lu Mingqiang felt reassured.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study, parent-child tutoring, and personal hobbies
description: At 20:00, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and continued watching the video tutorial 'PLC Beginner's Ladder Diagram' he had saved in the morning. As he watched, he silently drew ladder diagram symbols and instructions in his notebook. At 20:30, he came out of the study and spent 20 minutes playing with blocks with his younger son Hanhan. Then he checked his older son Xuanxuan's math homework, patiently explaining those two difficult problems using line segments until he fully understood them. After the children bathed, at 21:00 Lu Mingqiang went to the display cabinet in the living room, took out several ceramic baijiu bottles from his collection, and carefully wiped them with a soft cloth, enjoying the most relaxing moment of the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening wash-up and bedtime conversation
description: After washing up at 21:30, Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom; his wife was already leaning against the headboard. They talked about going back to his parents' house on the weekend and bringing the coconuts they had bought for the old man to try. They also discussed how, after the conversation with the general manager, life seemed to have prospects. At 22:30 they turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: This morning the alarm went off right at 5:50. After getting up, I habitually stepped on the scale; I weighed 72.3 kg, a bit lighter than yesterday, and felt a little happy inside. I opened the curtains and the weather was clear. Remembering that today is Friday and I planned to take the family to Baishamen Park in the evening, I started looking forward to the time after work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: I briskly woke up my two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. Hanhan was a bit reluctant to get out of bed, so I coaxed him into getting dressed. First, I rode the electric scooter to take Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District. On the way, I bought him a lollipop at Xiangzhi Daily Necessities Store at No. 19 Yusha Road, and he was happy. Then I rode with Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and at the school gate told him that I would pick him up after school today and not to run around.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing by Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

name: Going home for breakfast and family communication
description: When I got home, my wife Wang Lijuan had already laid out breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and the salted duck left over from last night. As I ate, I discussed with her the plan to take the two children to Baishamen Park in the evening and asked her to prepare the beach mat and sand-digging tools. She happily agreed and said she would buy some cold dishes to bring along in the afternoon.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work
description: After changing into work clothes, grabbing my tool bag and folding umbrella, I rode my electric bike from Banshan Garden along Jinmao Middle Road and Qiuhai Avenue to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. The traffic was smooth, and I arrived in about 20 minutes. I clocked in at the gate with facial recognition and reported to my work group at exactly 7:40.

name: Morning work: heat-prevention training assessment and field maintenance
description: As soon as I arrived at the team, Squad Leader Zhang urged everyone to hand in the heat safety training questionnaire; I checked mine and submitted it. Squad Leader Zhang arranged for us to do the final inspection of the meter boxes in Jinlong Residential Area in the morning. Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang and I took our tools and went to Jinlong Residential Area. While working, I told Jianguo that Manager Liu was thinking of promoting me to deputy squad leader. Jianguo encouraged me, saying that passing the technician certificate exam would make it a sure thing, which boosted my confidence.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Jinlong Community, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and communication.
description: After the inspection, Chen Jianguo and I went to Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant outside the industrial park for lunch. I ordered the garlic spare ribs set meal, and Jianguo had spicy soup rice. While eating, I called my wife to ask about the living-room air conditioner not cooling. I guessed it was a capacitor problem and asked her to check it at noon. I planned to go home early in the afternoon to fix the air conditioner.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and advance planning
description: Back at the office, I set up the folding bed and lay down to rest. In my mind I was planning the afternoon: I need to ask for leave and leave early, repair the air conditioner, and pick up the child. I noted in my phone memo: "Ask for 1.5h leave in the afternoon, repair the air conditioner, pick up the child (Xuanxuan's school ends at 16:30)."
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: complete reports and material inventory
description: After the lunch break, I went to ask Squad Leader Zhang for leave, explaining that the air conditioner at home needed urgent repair. I wanted to leave an hour and a half early and promised it would not affect my weekend duty. The squad leader approved. Back at my workstation, I turned the morning's maintenance records for Jinlong Community into an electronic report, then went to the tool room to count the spare parts needed for next week and reported them to the squad leader.
location: Office and tool warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Left work early to go home and repair the air conditioner.
description: At 3:00 p.m., I said goodbye to Jianguo and Xiao Zhao, changed into casual clothes, and rode my e-bike home. After arriving, my wife was waiting for me in the living room. I changed into an old T-shirt and started checking the air conditioner. When I opened the indoor unit panel and the outdoor unit cover, I found the starting capacitor was bulging. I noted the specifications, rode my e-bike to the familiar Shichang Hardware Store on Jinmao Middle Road, and spent 15 yuan on a capacitor with the same specifications. After going home, I quickly replaced it. When I turned it on, the cold air worked normally. My wife smiled and said it's really convenient to have an electrician at home.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, and then to Shichang Hardware Store, No. 7 Jinmao Middle Road.

name: Pick up the children from school and go home to prepare.
description: After fixing the air conditioner, I took a quick shower, then rode my electric bike to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up Lu Zixuan, and then detoured to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Lu Zihan. When I got home, my wife had already packed the beach mat, sand-digging tools, and cold dishes. I called everyone to change shoes and get ready to go.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; go to Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) to pick up Zixuan; then go to Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) to pick up Zihan; finally return to Banshan Garden.

name: Driving to Baishamen Park
description: The family of four got into the car, and I drove along Binhai Avenue toward Haidian Island. Hanhan was chattering in the back seat asking whether the park had big boats, while Xuanxuan quietly looked out the window. The sea breeze blew in through the half-open windows, carrying a salty, damp smell.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Baishamen Park, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Strolling in Baishamen Park and playing on the beach
description: After parking the car, the two children scrambled out and immediately started running around. We walked along the coconut grove path to the sandy beach, where Xuanxuan and Hanhan took off their shoes and built sandcastles. My wife and I sat on a bench, letting the sea breeze blow on us as we watched them play. In the evening, we ran into our neighbor Uncle Wang, who had brought his grandson to play. He told us the city children's reading room was offering free book borrowing during the summer vacation and suggested I take Xuanxuan there. I thanked him.
location: Baishamen Park, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy qingbuliang on the way back, and dinner
description: As it got dark, we packed up, took the fine sand, and left the park. At the cooked food stall outside the park gate, we bought four servings of low-sugar coconut milk qingbuliang to go. After driving home, my wife put the cold mixed dishes and the cooked rice noodle soup on the table. The family sat around the table, each with a bowl of qingbuliang, eating and chatting. Xuanxuan took the initiative to say that the math teacher praised him for improving on the quiz, and I encouraged him to make progress step by step.
location: At a cooked food stall outside Baishamen Park, then returned to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Evening chores and parent-child time
description: After the meal, I took the initiative to do the dishes so my wife could rest. After that, I played toy cars with Hanhan while Xuanxuan did his homework beside us. My wife packed the clothes for taking the kids to their grandmother’s house tomorrow.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal washing up and getting ready for bed
description: Only after the children washed up and fell asleep did I go take a shower. After washing up, I felt in a good mood, so I took out a few newly acquired bottles of baijiu from the display cabinet, wiped them with a soft cloth, and admired them. Then I opened my phone and watched an introductory PLC programming video for 15 minutes, as a warm-up for next month's systematic study.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: My wife was already in bed. I told her she could sleep in on Saturday. I turned off the bedside lamp and thought back over the day: the air conditioner was fixed, the family went out and relaxed, and Xuanxuan was a bit more at ease too. I felt at peace and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: First early-morning interval run training
description: At 6 a.m., when the sky was just beginning to lighten, I arrived on time at the meeting point at the north gate of Baishamen Park and warmed up with my running partner Chen Bin. I started my first interval running attempt and completed 6 sets as required: 400 meters of jogging (pace 6:30) followed by 200 meters of fast running (pace 4:50). By the end of the last set, my calf muscles were noticeably sore, but my breathing was still fairly smooth. After the run, I stretched for 10 minutes in the pull-up bar area. Chen Bin taught me two new hamstring stretches, and I carefully noted the key points.
location: Park loop track at Baishamen Park, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying breakfast and lollipops
description: After finishing the run, I said goodbye to Chen Bin and rode my electric bike to the usual breakfast cart outside the park. I bought two Chinese-style crepes and two cups of freshly ground soy milk for the family, packed them, and hung them on the handlebars. Then I rode to Xiangzhi General Store in Chengzhongcheng Community on Guomao Sanheng Road and bought a strawberry-flavored lollipop for my younger son Hanhan, planning to reward him if he behaves well today.
location: Convenience breakfast cart outside Baishamen Park, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Xiangzhi Grocery and Sundry Store, Chengzhongcheng Residential Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and family time
description: Back home, Juanzi had already finished washing Hanhan. The family of three sat around the table eating jianbing and soy milk. As they ate, he told Hanhan that if she behaved well this afternoon, she would get another lollipop. Hanhan happily hugged his neck and gave him a kiss. He asked Juanzi whether he should take them back to her parents' home. Juanzi said she would just drive there. He told her to drive safely, rest more at noon, and not get too tired.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Seeing family off
description: After breakfast, he helped Juanzi put the nutritional supplements and fruit for his mother-in-law into the car trunk. He again told Hanhan to behave at Grandma's house, and told Juanzi to drive slowly and send a message when she arrived. He watched the white sedan slowly drive out of the community gate, then turned and went upstairs home with Xuanxuan.
location: Downstairs parking space at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organized maintenance logs and refined the troubleshooting method
description: Changed into a home T-shirt, left the study door half-closed, and spread out on the desk more than a dozen handwritten notebooks from the past two years and the electronic maintenance logs on the computer. Picking up a red marker, he carefully selected 9 typical cases of poor contact in distribution cabinets, and next to each case he stuck a sticky note with the phenomena and steps corresponding to "look (observe oxidation and discoloration)," "smell (sniff for burnt odor)," and "measure (test contact resistance)." After outlining a three-step troubleshooting method based on "look, smell, and measure," he then turned on the computer and used his phone to photograph the key pages, planning to turn them into a PPT later. During this time, he quietly gave a trial lecture for a few minutes and felt the logic was smooth.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Resolved the PPT remote pen malfunction.
description: He fished out an old PPT remote pen from the drawer, put in batteries, and tested it. The indicator light did not turn on, confirming that it was damaged by battery leakage. He decisively took out his phone, downloaded a free remote-control app from the app store, connected it to the computer, and tested functions such as page turning and full screen. Only after confirming that everything was normal did he feel at ease.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cooking lunch
description: He put on an apron and went into the kitchen, quickly cut the winter melon for a simple stir-fry, and took out the pork rib soup that Juanzi had made yesterday from the fridge to heat it up. While cooking, he popped his head out and asked Xuanxuan, who was watching cartoons in the living room, whether he had much homework. Xuanxuan said not much and that he would finish it soon.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Sat across from Xuanxuan and had a simple lunch, asking him about fun things at school while eating. The atmosphere was relaxed. After eating, he cleaned up the dishes, told Xuanxuan to go rest in his room for a while, then lay on the living room sofa, set a 30-minute alarm on his phone, and closed his eyes for a nap.
location: Dining room and living room at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child teaching aid making
description: The alarm went off and I felt in good spirits. I remembered the children's reading room that Uncle Wang next door mentioned yesterday, and decided to go take another look in the afternoon. I called Xuanxuan over, spread old newspapers on the coffee table, and dug out the leftover foam boards from the balcony storage cabinet. Using a utility knife and a ruler, I first cut out a cube and a rectangular prism. Xuanxuan squatted nearby, curious. I explained geometry concepts as I cut. When I finished, I had a brainwave and cut a few more pieces, planning to paste red paper on them and label them with area formulas tomorrow so Xuanxuan could learn geometry more intuitively. Xuanxuan excitedly joined me in sanding the edges of the foam blocks with sandpaper. We worked together happily.
location: Living room and balcony of home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Plan the afternoon itinerary.
description: After finishing the handicraft, he returned to the study, opened his phone to check the location of the city children's reading room, and found it was near Longkun North Road, not far from home or the Rule-of-Law Theme Park. He planned that in the afternoon he would first take Xuanxuan to buy groceries, come back and rest for a while, then walk to the Rule-of-Law Park for a stroll and stop by the reading room on the way.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying groceries at the supermarket

Pushing a shopping cart, he taught Xuanxuan to recognize vegetables and price tags, and bought fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, broccoli, and a bunch of scallions. Passing the fruit section, he also weighed out two jin of red grapes that Xuanxuan loves.
location: Wanghao Supermarket (Sunshine Store), No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Strolling through the vegetable market
description: After leaving the supermarket, I walked with Xuanxuan across the road and turned into Wenhua Vegetable Market. At the seafood stall, I carefully picked half a jin of lively jiwei shrimp, planning to make boiled shrimp in the evening; at the cooked food stall, I weighed half a Wenchang chicken that Juanzi likes. Xuanxuan followed along the whole way, and as I taught him how to tell whether ribs are fresh, I asked him what he wanted to eat.
location: Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market (Wenhua Road Branch), Wenhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home and tidy up
description: After returning home, he had Xuanxuan go do homework. He first sorted the groceries and put them in the fridge, kept the blanched shrimp in clean water, and tore the Wenchang chicken into pieces and arranged it on a plate. After changing into clean loungewear, he sat in the living room, took a sip of herbal tea, and rested for a while.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Walk in the Rule of Law-themed park
description: It was still light. Xuanxuan and I put on our sneakers and walked to the rule-of-law themed park near home. In the park, the evening breeze was gentle, and quite a few people were strolling and walking dogs. We walked two laps along the path, chatting about the cartoons he had been watching recently. We also ran into a neighbor walking a big golden retriever, and Xuanxuan couldn't help going over to pet it.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule-of-Law Theme Park near Longkun North Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visited the city children's reading room.

The environment was quiet, with shelves full of various children's books. Xuanxuan excitedly flipped through several dinosaur picture books. He also took a look and found many extracurricular books suitable for him, and made up his mind to bring Xuanxuan to get a library card tomorrow afternoon.
location: Haikou Children's Library, Longkun North Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing Dinner and Helping with Homework
description: After returning home, he had Xuanxuan do his homework at the dining table while he put on an apron and started preparing dinner: blanching the shrimp, chopping the cooked Wenchang chicken, and washing and cutting vegetables, all with practiced skill. During this time, Xuanxuan couldn't solve a math word problem. He put down the kitchen knife, wiped his hands with his apron, and drew a line-segment diagram on scratch paper to explain it until Xuanxuan fully understood.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Father-son dinner
description: Facing a table full of dishes with Xuanxuan: boiled prawns, Wenchang chicken, stir-fried broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. I picked food for Xuanxuan, told him to eat more prawns for protein, and the father and son chatted while eating about the dinosaur picture books and crafts they had seen in the afternoon. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation and PLC study
description: After dinner, he told Xuanxuan to take a shower, then went to the study, turned on the computer, carefully watched a 15-minute PLC programming tutorial video, and noted down a few key instructions in his notebook. Afterward, he wiped clean the old-brand Deer Turtle Wine bottle he had taken out from the kitchen wine cabinet tonight and put it back on the display shelf.
location: Study and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Couple communication and review before bed
description: Juanzi and Hanhan came back from her parents' home. After the family said good night to each other, he lay side by side in bed with Juanzi. He mentioned that in the afternoon he had taken Xuanxuan to the city children's reading room, which is right on Longkun North Road — lots of books and a nice environment. He suggested taking him there tomorrow afternoon to get a library card, and Juanzi agreed, saying they would go and have a look together. Then they talked about the handicrafts made today and the preparation of the speech draft, especially the fact that the remote pointer broke and they used a phone instead. Juanzi smiled and praised him for being clever and full of ideas. He felt happy inside, thinking that although the day had been busy, it was fulfilling.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Going to bed
description: After chatting about family matters, he turned off the light and lay down, mentally planning tomorrow's schedule: in the morning go to the company to draft the PPT for the exchange meeting, and in the afternoon take Xuanxuan to the reading room. Thinking that he would get some real work done tomorrow, a slight smile appeared on his lips, and he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Wake up and morning routine
description: The alarm went off on time, and Lu Mingqiang didn't linger in bed. After getting up, he first weighed himself. It was steady at 72.0 kg, which reassured him. Then, using the living room space, he did several new stretching moves he had learned from Chen Bin yesterday, focusing on loosening the thigh and calf muscles that were sore from yesterday's interval running. He felt limber and relaxed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast

While boiling water for noodles, he heard his son Xuanxuan getting up. After the noodles were done, he poured chicken soup over them, topped them with shredded chicken and greens, and also fried a sunny-side-up egg for Xuanxuan. The father and son sat at the table to eat. Lu Mingqiang reminded Xuanxuan that he would be going to a meeting in the afternoon, told him to finish his homework at home in the morning, and then they would build models together. Xuanxuan readily agreed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare the speech script and presentation slides.
description: After quickly clearing the dishes, Lu Mingqiang went into the study for final preparations. He turned on the computer and carefully adjusted the brightness and contrast of the photos of the burned-out distribution cabinet case to make the fault point clearer; then he confirmed on his phone that the presentation app could perfectly replace the broken remote presenter. He stood up and silently rehearsed his opening remarks twice in front of the dressing mirror, making sure to keep them within 2 minutes.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning arrangements and phone contact.
description: Lu Mingqiang went over the core logic of his speech in his mind. Feeling fully prepared, he left the study to check his son Xuanxuan's homework. Xuanxuan was doing mental arithmetic math problems and had got one wrong about the side lengths of a triangle. Lu Mingqiang sat down and patiently explained it with a set square until he understood. Around ten o'clock, he thought of Uncle Wang and called to ask whether he could conveniently pick up his granddaughter in the afternoon. Uncle Wang said the timing was not convenient and thanked him for his kindness.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch

He called Xuanxuan over to eat, served the food in advance, and told Xuanxuan he could watch TV or take a nap after the meal and to call if anything came up. Lu Mingqiang ate his own lunch quickly, saving energy for the afternoon exchange meeting.

location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Set off for the training center
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into a clean light-blue short-sleeve shirt, put a USB flash drive, a notebook, and two pens into his canvas bag, and checked again that the phone remote-control app was connected normally. He sent a WeChat message to his wife, Wang Lijuan, telling her he was going to a meeting, then pushed his electric bike out the door. Starting from Banshan Garden, he rode east along Jinmao Middle Road and turned into Jinmao West Road, covering about 1.5 kilometers in about 10 minutes.
