description: After the three arrived at the distribution cabinet site near the intersection of Xiuying Avenue and Meihua Road, they first set up safety warning tape. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for the main line renovation, Chen Jianguo assisted by handing tools and holding the ladder, and Zhao Qiang studied alongside. The sun was scorching hot, and the sheet metal cabinet had been baked hot enough to be painful to the touch even through wire gloves. The clothes on their backs were soon soaked through. Lu Mingqiang reminded everyone to drink more water and not to push themselves.
location: The power distribution cabinet renovation site near the intersection of Xiuying Avenue and Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shaded lunch and heatstroke prevention talk
description: After finishing the morning work, the three of them found a shady spot at the back of a building with a through breeze to have lunch. Lu Mingqiang took out the lunch box prepared by his wife, which had braised pork with pickled mustard greens, stir-fried vegetables, and seaweed soup. Zhao Qiang complained about the heat, so Lu Mingqiang signaled him to drink a bottle of Huoxiang Zhengqi Water to prevent heatstroke, and while eating, they chatted about how his brother had messaged yesterday saying Shenzhen was also unbearably hot.
location: The shaded side of a building near Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break at the convenience store entrance.
description: After the meal, the three moved to the nearby Kuai Ke convenience store. Lu Mingqiang bought a bottle of iced C'estbon water and borrowed three plastic stools from the shopkeeper. The three leaned against the wall corner beside the store entrance and dozed for a while, taking advantage of the cool air leaking out of the convenience store, and felt much better. While resting with his eyes closed, Lu Mingqiang ran through the electrical theory formulas he had studied last night in his mind.
location: In front of Kuai Ke Convenience Store near Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work and finishing of the outdoor distribution cabinet renovation.
description: The afternoon heat became even more intense, so the three of them sped up their work pace and hurried to finish the wiring and debugging left over from the morning. At around 4:30 p.m., all the renovation work was successfully completed, and tests showed everything was normal. Then they packed up their tools and cleaned up the removed old parts and the garbage on site.
location: The power distribution cabinet renovation site near the intersection of Xiuying Avenue and Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Riding back to the company
description: After tidying up, the three got on their electric bikes, turned from Meihua Road onto Haisheng Road, and returned to the company together.
location: During the ride from Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to No. 57 Haisheng Road.

name: Attended the safety evening meeting and returned tools to their designated places
description: After returning to the company, Team Leader Zhang gathered everyone for a brief evening safety meeting, emphasizing that tomorrow's high-temperature warning would remain in effect, and requiring outdoor workers to carry heatstroke prevention medicine at all times and report any physical discomfort immediately. He named Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo for praise, saying they had led the team well that day and had kept both progress and safety under good control. After the meeting, the three of them rinsed the dust off the tools with a water hose and put them back neatly in their designated places according to requirements.
location: Pre-shift safety briefing stand and tool warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying medicine on the way home from work
description: After leaving the company, he rode his electric bike toward home. Passing the Guang'antang Pharmacy on Haisheng Road, he stopped and went in. The Huoxiang Zhengqi oral liquid at home was almost used up, so he bought two boxes. At the counter, he remembered that his mother had mentioned a few days earlier that the hot weather was making her feel heaty, so he also picked up a pack of Xiasangju granules and a box of throat lozenges, planning to bring them when he visited her on the weekend.
location: Guang'an Tang Pharmacy, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Arriving home and meeting the family
description: Carrying the medicine upstairs, as soon as he opened the door, his 4-year-old younger son Hanhan ran over calling "Daddy" in a babyish voice. Lu Mingqiang picked him up and gave him a kiss, saw his wife Juanzi stir-frying in the kitchen, and his eldest son Xuanxuan watching cartoons on the sofa in the living room. He put the medicine into the storage cabinet and changed into a dry home T-shirt.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The whole family had dinner together.
description: His wife had made dinner: pan-fried mackerel, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, and tomato and egg soup. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang mentioned that while installing the distribution cabinet today, he encountered a particularly stubborn screw and only managed to loosen it with WD-40. His wife smiled in response. He noticed that Xuanxuan was quiet during dinner and was thinking about tonight's tutoring session.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son downstairs to play
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took Hanhan downstairs to the community garden to get some fresh air. He taught Hanhan to kick a small ball for a while, then held him to watch ants moving near the flower beds. The orange-red sunset glow spread across the sky. He took a few photos and sent them to the family group.
location: Community garden in the Banshan Garden residential complex, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tutored the eldest son in math and resolved the conflict.
description: After going upstairs, Lu Mingqiang asked Xuanxuan to take out his math workbook. Just as he was about to use the prepared teaching aids to explain area units, Xuanxuan said impatiently, "I know how to do it, you don't need to teach me." Lu Mingqiang's anger flared up instantly, but he remembered the idea of "understanding children's emotions" that the psychology teacher had mentioned during safety training, so he took three deep breaths to suppress his anger. He changed his approach and asked Xuanxuan to explain the problems to him. Xuanxuan explained while drawing figures, but got stuck when he reached "how many square decimeters are in one square meter." Lu Mingqiang then realized that his son did not fully understand, so he used a water bottle cap and floor tiles as analogies and asked him to count. Although Xuanxuan still pouted occasionally, he was noticeably more cooperative than yesterday, and in the end he corrected all the wrong problems by himself.
location: Eldest son's bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Do housework with his wife and discuss weekend plans.
description: After tutoring Xuanxuan, Lu Mingqiang went to the living room. His wife was folding dried clothes. He took out his tool kit, removed the electric screwdriver tip that had gotten dirty today, cleaned and oiled it, to make sure it would work properly tomorrow. At the same time, he discussed with his wife whether they should buy some seafood tomorrow evening, since tomorrow is Friday, and visit his parents the day after.
location: Home living room and storage room at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After showering, study the advanced electrician technician theory.
description: Took a shower and felt completely refreshed. Changed into pajamas, sat at the desk, opened the textbook Advanced Technician Electrical Theory, and focused on reviewing the principle and circuit diagram of star-delta starting for three-phase asynchronous motors, which was used in today's work. Then he made a simple mind map with a note-taking app on his phone for future review.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talked with my wife before going to bed.
description: His wife had already lain down. Lu Mingqiang turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. He talked with her about the change in today's tutoring of Xuanxuan, feeling that he had started to get the hang of it. His wife said Xuanxuan had been in a good mood today and had become much friendlier. Lu Mingqiang thought that perhaps because both the exam study and today's work had gone smoothly, nothing was weighing on his mind.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to bed and rest
description: Said goodnight to his wife and turned off the light. Though his body was a bit tired, he felt calmer and more grounded than last night. Thinking that tomorrow would be a new day and mulling over weekend plans, he soon fell into a dream.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wake up early, breakfast, and commute to work
description: The alarm went off at 6:05 a.m. Lu Qiang woke up with a slightly stiff neck and stretched his waist and neck. He got out of bed quietly without waking his wife and children, and went to the bathroom to wash up. Then he changed into work pants and a short-sleeved shirt, grabbed his motorcycle keys, and headed out. At about 6:35, he rode his motorcycle to the Datie Laobaicha Tea Shop on Binya Road, greeted the owner, and ordered a pot of jasmine tea and two pieces of the signature taro cake. While eating breakfast, he thought about how to tutor his son Xuanxuan in math in the evening. After finishing the morning tea, he stopped by the small shop next door and bought a pack of Hongtashan cigarettes, planning to share them with his coworkers during work. At 7:10, he rode his motorcycle along Binya Road and turned onto Haixiu Middle Road. There were not many cars on the road, and about 15 minutes later he arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road. He parked the bike and got ready to start the day's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Company morning meeting and material collection.
description: Lu Qiang first went to the office water room and filled his large water bottle with Xiasangju herbal tea, then attended the morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang. The day's task was to go to the old residential community "Island Sunshine" on Jintan Road, Xiuying District, to repair the public lighting circuits in several buildings, as one group with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang. After the morning meeting, the three went to the tool room and picked up a multimeter, a test pen, screwdrivers, a flashlight, insulating gloves, a coil of BV wire, and two new circuit breakers. Lu Qiang put on his safety helmet and tucked a bottle of Huoxiang Zhengqi liquid into his bag to prevent heatstroke, then got ready to set out.
location: Office and tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning circuit inspection work
description: Lu Qiang and two colleagues arrived at Haidao Yangguang Apartments by bike. After meeting the property manager, they started troubleshooting. The main problems were oxidized wire connections and an aging air switch causing voltage instability. The three divided the work: Chen Jianguo took Zhao Qiang to handle the connections, while Lu Qiang climbed the ladder to replace the air switch. Working continuously under the scorching sun, he took a sip of Xiasangju herbal tea every half hour. Near noon, he felt soreness in his neck, but persisted and completed the morning work tasks.
location: Haikou Haidao Sunshine Apartment, No. 3 Xiangrong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break, lunch, and return trip.
description: At 12 noon, the three men sat down on newspaper spread on the ground in the shade of the trees in front of the building. Lu Qiang took out Hongtashan cigarettes and shared them with Jianguo and Xiao Zhao. Xiao Zhao went to buy water. While smoking, Lu Qiang checked the weather forecast on his phone, learned there would be thundershowers in the afternoon, and decided to finish the job quickly. At 12:30, he and Jianguo rode to the Jiajie Latang Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the industrial park for lunch. Lu Qiang ordered a bowl of Hainan rice noodles, and Jianguo had latang rice. Over the meal, they talked about their children. Lu Qiang mentioned his communication problems while tutoring Xuanxuan in math, and agreed with Jianguo that both families would go to Baishamen to fly kites on Saturday morning. After eating, they immediately rode back to Haidao Sunshine Apartment to continue the afternoon work.
location: Shaded area of Haikou Haidao Yangguang Apartment Community, No. 3 Xiangrong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan; and Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice (Xianghe Jiayuan Branch), first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, No. 8 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Afternoon circuit inspection and repair work
description: In the afternoon, he continued handling the remaining work. Lu Qiang asked Zhao Qiang to help hold the ladder. While checking a lamp post line, the weather suddenly changed, with wind and rain. The three quickly put away their tools and took shelter in a stairwell. While sheltering from the rain, Lu Qiang carefully recorded the circuits checked and parts replaced that day in his small notebook. After the rain stopped, they hurried to finish up, testing the last few lamp sockets to ensure everything was normal.
location: Haikou Haidao Sunshine Apartment, No. 3 Xiangrong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wrap up work, hand in the job sheet, and go home.
description: Finished work at 5:10 p.m., and the three of us cycled back to the industrial park. Squad leader Zhang checked the maintenance records, nodded with satisfaction, and signed. Lu Qiang cleaned the tools and put them back in place, then left the industrial park on his motorcycle and arrived home at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, 10 minutes later.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Evening family time
description: As soon as Lu Qiang entered the house, his daughter Hanhan ran over, hugged his leg and called him Daddy, while his wife Juanzi said from the kitchen that dinner was almost ready. He played with blocks with Hanhan in the living room. His son Xuanxuan asked him whether a corrected problem in his homework notebook was right. Lu Qiang praised his handwriting and said he would help check the rest later. Dinner was served at 6:30. On the table were dry-fried duck, stir-fried green beans, and winter melon and white clam soup. While eating, Lu Qiang asked Xuanxuan about interesting things at school, and the family atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Living room and dining room at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Post-meal rest and exercise preparation
description: After the meal, Lu Qiang helped clear the dishes. Knowing that he would go play squash after the evening tutoring session, he packed his sports bag in advance, putting in a change of T-shirt, shorts, towel, racket, and a bottle of Gatorade. Then he sat in the living room to rest, scrolling through an electrician forum on his phone to see how others handled tricky circuit problems.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutor Xuanxuan in math
description: Lu Qiang called Xuanxuan into the study. Instead of directly opening the textbook, he took out a test paper, pointed to an area geometry problem, and asked him to solve it on his own, telling him to voice his thoughts even if he couldn't work it out. After thinking, Xuanxuan said that he had previously misread the base of the figure. Lu Qiang followed his line of reasoning and corrected him step by step, without getting impatient at all. Although a few problems were still answered wrong in the end, the father and son did not clash, the atmosphere was much better than the day before, and the tutoring session lasted 15 minutes longer than usual. Xuanxuan's eyes lit up.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Heading to the squash court and warming up
description: After the tutoring session ended, Lu Qiang let out a long breath, changed into his sneakers, picked up his sports bag, said goodbye to his wife, and went out. He rode his motorcycle first to the Convenient Life Convenience Store on Jinlong Road, bought a bottle of Pocari Sweat and a can of Red Bull, planning to share them with his squash buddy Lin Feng. Then he rode for two minutes to the Power Fitness Club squash court, where Lin Feng had already arrived. The two chatted a few words about the day's work while putting on wrist guards, did a simple stretch of wrists and ankles, and hit a few balls to get a feel. Lu Qiang felt his footwork was not as nimble as last week.
location: Convenient Life Convenience Store, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Power Fitness Club Squash Court

name: Squash practice
description: The two played three games. In the first two games, Lu Qiang made more mistakes, started slowly, and returned backhands poorly, so he lost both. After adjusting his rhythm in the third game, he improved somewhat, but still lost 9-11. Lin Feng asked how he was doing, and Lu Qiang said he had been distracted by tutoring his child in the evening. Lin Feng patted him on the shoulder and said, 'Balance work and rest.' Afterward, they practiced backhand line changes together, with Lin Feng deliberately slowing down the pace and feeding balls to help him find his feel.
location: Squash Court, Haikou Power Fitness Club, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home after exercise and getting ready for bed.
description: After agreeing to meet Lin Feng again next week, Lu Qiang cycled home. The night breeze blew on him; despite the sweat, he felt much better and his neck was no longer so stiff. When he got home, his wife Juanzi was scrolling through her phone, and the two children were already asleep. After a shower, he lay down on the bed and told Juanzi that the tutoring session with Xuanxuan had gone smoothly that evening, and that they planned to fly kites at Baishamen on the weekend. Juanzi teased, 'You've finally learned to be a dad.' Lu Qiang felt very happy.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing before bed and preparing for sleep
description: Lying in bed, he looked through the memos on his phone and confirmed that he needed to buy free-range chicken and seafood to bring to his parents' home the next day. He also watched a few short electrician repair videos, seeing how others handled old wiring problems, and thought he could try it on the weekend. As he watched, his eyelids began to get heavy, and he got ready to sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Nighttime sleep
description: Lu Qiang turned off the light and went to sleep, storing up energy for the next day's work and weekend family activities.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: At 6:10 in the morning, he woke up naturally, feeling that his neck was not stiff and his mood was relaxed. Lying in bed, he savored the new method he had used the night before when tutoring his son Xuanxuan in math; it had worked well. He got up at around 6:20, washed up briefly, and changed into a fresh short-sleeved work uniform. Then he rode his motorcycle to the nearby Datie Dad's Tea Shop, ordered a bowl of soup noodles and a cup of black tea for breakfast, and chatted briefly with the owner, Ade. Seeing freshly baked egg crisps, he packed one for his wife Juanzi and brought a char siu bao for each of his two sons. After returning home, he gave the breakfast to Juanzi. She was about to take their younger son Hanhan to kindergarten and was delighted to receive the egg crisps. Lu Mingqiang reminded her not to forget about going to his parents' house for dinner in the evening. Juanzi agreed and said she would wait at home with Hanhan.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the nearby Datie Old Man Tea Shop

name: Cycling to work
description: Riding a motorcycle from Banshan Garden, I turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Haixiu Road and headed west all the way to the company on Haisheng Road in Xiuying District. The weather was cloudy and not sunny, and riding felt comfortable. Along the way, I mentally planned the day's work arrangements. With the typhoon season approaching, I needed to prioritize checking the emergency repair tools.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Morning work: morning meeting and emergency supplies inventory and maintenance.
description: After arriving at the company, he changed into work clothes and attended the team morning meeting on time. Team leader Zhang emphasized that typhoon season was approaching and arranged for a three-person team consisting of Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang to thoroughly inventory and maintain the emergency repair tools and spare parts in the warehouse, requiring them to record lists of items to be scrapped and purchased. The three then divided the work: Jianguo was responsible for keeping the ledger, while Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang to inspect generators, water pumps, cable reels, safety ropes, headlamps, insulating gloves, and other supplies one by one. When Zhao Qiang focused on checking the airtightness of the insulating gloves, he found two pairs leaking, and Lu Mingqiang recorded them for reporting and replacement. They also opened several old water pumps and lubricated the motor bearings. Although the warehouse was dusty, the work was solid and orderly.
location: Meeting room and warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After getting off work at noon, he went with Chen Jianguo to the Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant diagonally across from the company for lunch. Lu Mingqiang ordered the signature spicy soup rice and added a Chinese sausage, while Jianguo ordered pork trotter rice. Over lunch they talked about the weekend plan to fly kites at Baishamen. Jianguo's son, one year older than Xuanxuan, also wanted to go, so the two agreed to meet at Baishamen at 3 p.m. on Saturday. After the meal, he returned to the rest room in the corner of the company warehouse, where the air conditioning was strong. Lu Mingqiang lay on a folding chair to rest, set an alarm for 13:10, and fell asleep quickly because of the morning's labor.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the warehouse rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: Afternoon work wrap-up and leaving work early
description: In the afternoon, continued the inventory wrap-up from the morning, put the maintained tools back in place, and checked the materials list with Jianguo. Then returned to the office, filled out the wrap-up material sheet for yesterday's maintenance at Island Sunshine Apartment and gave it to Squad Leader Zhang to sign, and also organized the list of tools that needed to be scrapped and purchased in the morning and submitted it together. Near the end of work, because he planned to go to the school and the vegetable market, then return to his parents' house for dinner, he reported to Squad Leader Zhang in advance and got permission to leave half an hour early.
location: Warehouse and office of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the child from school and go to the market to buy groceries
description: Riding a motorcycle from the company, he took Haixiu Road, then turned onto Haifu Road and went to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his eldest son Xuanxuan. It was just after school. Xuanxuan was excited to see the motorcycle and hugged his father tightly after getting on. Lu Mingqiang asked about his day at school. Xuanxuan said he scored 95 on a math quiz and was praised by his father. Then they took a detour to Dongmen Market and bought a live free-range chicken and a fresh Spanish mackerel as ingredients for dinner. Xuanxuan wanted white radish cake, so Lu Mingqiang bought one for him to eat on the way.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, via Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, to Dongmen Market, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to parents' home for dinner together
description: Laden with groceries, he rode his bike to the downstairs of his parents' building. Xuanxuan ran ahead and pressed the doorbell. His mother, Chen Xiuying, opened the door and was overjoyed to see her grandson. She took the vegetables and fish, saying he had bought too much. After entering, Lu Mingqiang took the pain-relief patches from his backpack and handed them to his mother, telling her that rain was coming and she should warm her knees with a hot towel before applying the patches. His father, Lu Jianguo, came back from the community's chess and card room, and the family sat around having dinner, including Hainanese chicken rice. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang talked about checking the typhoon repair tools today. His father, a retired electrician, nodded as he listened and urged that safety came first. His mother kept putting food on Xuanxuan's plate and also pressed two freshly picked mangoes on him. After the meal, she packed some white-cut chicken for them to bring to Juanzi and Hanhan.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Ride home with the children by bike.
description: After dinner, he said goodbye to his parents. His mother packed some white-cut chicken and dishes for him to take home to his wife and youngest son. Lu Mingqiang put them in plastic bags, hung them on the handlebars, and rode home with Xuanxuan in the evening breeze. Along the way, Xuanxuan excitedly said that Grandma's chicken rice was the best.
location: From Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family parent-child time and getting the child ready for bed
description: When he got home, Juanzi and Hanhan had already eaten. After Lu Mingqiang put away the packed dishes, his younger son Hanhan pulled his hand and wanted to go to the living room to build a castle with LEGO. He gladly agreed and suggested that Xuanxuan act as the little teacher and teach his younger brother how to build a stable foundation. The three of them busied themselves on the floor for over an hour. Although the castle was crooked, there was constant laughter. Juanzi remarked from the side that today was especially harmonious. When they were tired of playing, the couple each urged the two children to take a bath and brush their teeth. Hanhan got fussy because he was still thinking about the blocks, but Juanzi appeased him with a promise to buy new ice cream tomorrow. After the children were asleep, the house became quiet again.
location: Living room, bathroom, and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Personal interests: organizing the liquor bottle collection and studying senior technician theory.
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang went to the study to enjoy some free time. He first took out two uniquely shaped baijiu bottles he had picked up from Old Chen last month, one with a cloisonné body and one in a bamboo-joint design. He carefully noted the source and feel in his notebook, took photos, and sent them to the baijiu bottle collecting WeChat group, sharing with @Old Chen. Then he made a cup of instant coffee to refresh himself, took out the Senior Electrician Technician Training Course, turned to the chapter on complex circuit analysis examples, and calmly worked through it again. Starting with Kirchhoff's current law and deriving step by step, he figured out the step that had stumped him last night, and neatly copied the problem-solving approach and key points into his notebook, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Chat before bed and going to sleep
description: After closing the book, his head felt a little foggy. He washed up briefly and returned to the bedroom. His wife Juanzi was still awake, and the two chatted about weekend plans: on Saturday afternoon they would go to Baishamen to fly kites and would bring Jianguo's son along, so they needed to prepare some fruit and drinks in advance. Juanzi also wanted to buy Xiasangju and throat lozenges for his mother, and get some sour plum drink mix while they were at it. As they chatted, drowsiness crept in. After turning off the light, Lu Mingqiang remembered that he still had to do the final confirmation of the scrapping list tomorrow, and fell asleep with the expectation of the weekend.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Early wake-up and departure
description: He got up at 6:30, changed into his running shoes, grabbed his keys and phone, and quietly went downstairs, ready to go for his morning run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run, met a fellow runner
description: Rode a motorcycle to Baishamen Park, then stretched and started his morning run. He met his running buddy Chen Bin, and they chatted about knee problems while running. Lu Mingqiang suggested switching to shock-absorbing insoles. They ran 5 km in total at a pace of just over 6 minutes per kilometer, and he broke a sweat.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast grocery shopping
description: After the run, he ate a bowl of Hainan rice noodles with an egg at the familiar breakfast stall at the park gate, and packed up five large meat buns and two cups of hot soy milk to take home.
location: Breakfast stall at the entrance of Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home.
description: Rode the motorcycle along Binhai Avenue back to the home in Banshan Garden.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Household tidying and kite inspection.

Around 10:00, he tested the microphone and screen sharing of the online meeting software. His son Lu Zixuan looked forward to flying a kite in the afternoon, and Lu Mingqiang agreed with a smile. After the meal, his wife took the younger daughter for a nap. Lu Mingqiang told his son to lie down for a while too, and he himself took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa.

In the evening, as the sky grew dark, they packed up the kite and trash. Lu Mingqiang promised his son they would come again next week, then the family rode the motorcycle home, arriving at 5:40 PM.

Lu Mingqiang told her not to worry. After dinner, his wife went out, and Lu Mingqiang began tutoring his son in math word problems, using building blocks to demonstrate area calculation. After that, he played a train game with his daughter, bathed her, and she played and splashed in the water, which took quite a while.

After his wife returned from her parents' home, he asked her to be the audience for a rehearsal of his technical sharing presentation. He spoke fluently through the PPT content he had prepared in the morning. His wife reminded him about his speaking pace and details, and he carefully noted the improvements.

location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

The work lasted until a little past ten. After that, they inspected the public lighting distribution boxes for the whole unit building and supplemented the inspection records. After lunch, Lu Mingqiang went back to the office and took a short nap in a chair for twenty minutes. When he woke up, he went to his workstation, sorted out the screw washers removed from the old meter box cover and filed them away, then flipped through an example problem on the superposition theorem in the "Advanced Technician Textbook." After a little thought, he decided to study it further in the evening.

Then Lu Mingqiang took out the safety training log and signed the entry for last Thursday (July 3), when the team had studied "preventing electric shock during outdoor work in rainy weather." The work continued until after four in the afternoon, when the rain gradually weakened, and Lu Mingqiang prepared to leave work.

After dinner, Lu Mingqiang voluntarily gathered the dishes and chopsticks and took them to the kitchen to wash, then wiped down the stove, letting Juanzi go rest in the living room. Juanzi wanted to help but Lu Mingqiang politely declined.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Zixuan quickly grasped it and even used small blocks to build a 'castle' and drew the shapes on paper with labels. The tutoring session was completed efficiently, and Lu Mingqiang was very satisfied. Meanwhile, Juanzi was folding clothes in the living room, occasionally smiling at the father and son.

Lu Zihan mischievously climbed onto his back to cause trouble, so Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to pick him up and teach him the "cat stretch" move. Lu Zixuan also imitated it readily. The father and sons spent a relaxed fifteen minutes full of laughter, making it the most relaxing family time of the day.

name: Supervise the children's washing and bedtime story.
description: After stretching, Lu Mingqiang urged his two sons to go to the bathroom, watched over them as they brushed their teeth carefully, and then washed Lu Zihan's face and put on some moisturizer. Back in the bedroom, Lu Zihan ran over with a storybook in his arms. Lu Mingqiang sat on the edge of the bed and read him the story “The Little Turtle Looks for Friends” using different voices, while Lu Zixuan flipped through a dinosaur picture book beside them. The children quieted down and got ready for sleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, bathroom and children's bedroom

name: Self-study of circuit analysis
description: After the two children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang tiptoed into the study, turned on the desk lamp, took out the "Senior Technician Textbook," and re-derived the current flow of the superposition theorem example he had reviewed at noon, checking his understanding against the answers. Then he previewed some intermediate-difficulty examples of Thevenin's theorem and recorded key points, building knowledge toward obtaining the senior technician certificate.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Chatting with my wife before bed
description: Lu Mingqiang closed his book and returned to the bedroom. Seeing his wife Wang Lijuan leaning against the headboard scrolling through her phone after just hanging up the clothes, he sat down beside her and shared his successful experience tutoring Zixuan in geometry that evening, praising Zixuan for picking it up quickly. Juanzi laughingly said it was because her husband knew how to teach. The two then discussed the next day's grocery shopping plan and decided to buy fresh ribs to make soup for the children. The brief, harmonious exchange left them both feeling calm.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Set the alarm clock and prepare to sleep
description: After chatting, Lu Mingqiang got up and went to the bathroom to brush his teeth. When he came back, he set the alarm for 6:15 the next morning, checked the door locks, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the day — work went smoothly, tutoring the children showed results, and the family atmosphere was harmonious — he felt content and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and departure preparations
description: After the alarm went off, I got up and heard the sound of raindrops outside the window. I stretched my limbs and felt energetic. Remembering that I needed to buy pork ribs today, I took an extra 30 yuan and a spare shopping bag from the drawer. Then I did a rainy-day damp-proof check, carefully organized the toolbox, and put in a raincoat and waterproof tarp. When I touched the work clothes hanging out to dry, they felt a bit damp. I walked to the bedroom door and quietly reminded my wife Juanzi to tell my mother not to come over on rainy days and to watch out for slippery roads.
location: Building 3, Room 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast: Datie Laoba Tea House
description: When the rain eased a little, he put on his raincoat and cycled to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop. The waiter, A Ming, greeted him from afar and prepared the usual. He ordered Hainan noodles and specially asked for extra bamboo shoots, plus a takeaway portion of crispy egg pastry and soy milk. There were not many customers on the rainy day. He leaned in a corner and slowly ate the noodles with hot tea, listening to the old men chatting about when the rain would stop.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute, morning meeting, and morning indoor work.
description: After breakfast the rain had mostly stopped, so he rode to the company at a slower speed and arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park ten minutes later. At the team morning meeting, Team Leader Zhang, considering the rainy weather, arranged to suspend outdoor line inspections and asked Lu Mingqiang to take Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to first check the warehouse ledger for the newly arrived insulating gloves and voltage detectors, and then inspect the contacts of the switchgear in the maintenance bay. The three then divided the work: Jianguo called out the model numbers, Mingqiang stacked the goods, and Xiao Zhao applied labels. It took an hour and a half to finish organizing the warehouse. Next, they moved to the power distribution bay, pulled open three switchgear cabinets, and inspected the contacts with a flashlight. They found that one cabinet had condensation water droplets caused by moisture, so they wiped it with a dry cloth and applied conductive grease. The work was completed efficiently and ahead of schedule.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: After finishing the morning's work, he walked with Chen Jianguo to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant for lunch. The shop was full of workers on their lunch break. Lu Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with cured sausage. The soup was rich and flavorful, and he felt warm all over. Jianguo shared the good news that his son's high school entrance exam score was enough to secure a place at Haikou No. 2 Middle School. Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder in congratulations, and they agreed to celebrate on the weekend. After the meal, the two returned to the company team rest room. Zhao Qiang was already lying on a folding bed taking a nap. Mingqiang took out his phone and browsed an electrician forum. Seeing a post analyzing an inverter overvoltage fault insightfully, he saved it. Jianguo, meanwhile, scrolled through short videos. The two rested separately.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: finishing up warehouse organization.
description: After the rain stopped, Team Leader Zhang arranged insulation tests and maintenance for the old water pump in the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang was mainly responsible for measuring insulation with a megger, Chen Jianguo lubricated the bearings, and Zhao Qiang recorded the data. When they came across a pump with an illegible nameplate, Mingqiang and Jianguo worked together to carry it to a ventilated area to dry out for later identification. The work ended exactly at 16:00, and Mingqiang packed up his personal tools.
location: Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing to leave work and buying groceries on the way
description: Before leaving work, he filled in the work log and signed it, told Team Leader Zhang he was going to the vegetable market to buy ribs, and left. He cycled to Xiuying Farmer's Market. The market was a bit muddy after the rain but crowded. Familiar with the place, he found Chen Laosi's pork stall, picked out two middle rib racks, and asked to have them chopped into small pieces. It cost 32 yuan in total. He also saw fresh hairtail fish, so he weighed out two, intending to surprise his wife, and packed them in the spare shopping bag he had brought.
location: Xiuying Farmers' Market, No. 68 Xiuhua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home, take a shower, and change clothes
description: When he got home, his wife Juanzi had just picked up their second son Hanhan and was rinsing rice in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang handed her the pork ribs and hairtail fish. Although Juanzi said he was wasting money, she had a smile on her face. Mingqiang then took a quick shower, changed into shorts and an old T-shirt, and felt fresh and comfortable.
location: Building 3, Room 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: Juanzi prepared the pork ribs. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to scale the fish and wash the vegetables, busying himself while squatting by the kitchen door. Their younger son Hanhan was building a LEGO spaceship in the living room and often showed his work to his father; Mingqiang responded with praise while working. After the ribs were blanched, they were put into an electric stew pot with corn and carrots to simmer slowly. When the elder son Xuanxuan came home from school, the family of four sat around the dining table. Juanzi ladled out steaming hot pork rib soup, and Mingqiang picked food for his two sons, chatting about how his team leader had praised him for working efficiently. Xuanxuan proudly said, 'My dad is the best,' and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Building 3, Unit 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring eldest son in math (geometry review)
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang took his eldest son Zixuan to the study, took out the building blocks used yesterday, and let him first review the concepts of 'edges' and 'vertices' by himself. Zixuan explained them fluently and proactively asked how many edges a cuboid has. With his father's guidance, he calculated that it has 12 edges. Mingqiang then took out a triangle ruler and a protractor so Zixuan could intuitively see right, obtuse, and acute angles. When Zixuan put together a triangle with the blocks, he excitedly discovered its stability and demonstrated to his father that the triangle couldn't be pulled apart. His enthusiasm for learning was high.
location: Study, Room 504, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Community, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Study the theory for the senior electrician technician
description: After tutoring the child, Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the living room sofa, opened the learning app on his phone, and watched the video course 'Troubleshooting Complex Circuit Faults'. Drawing on the actual emergency repair during the last typhoon, he focused on the logical chain of 'deducing the fault point from the symptoms' and jotted down several key points in his phone memo to prepare for the senior technician certificate.
location: Living room, Room 504, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare for squash training and confirm with Lin Feng.
description: Seeing that it was about time, Lu Mingqiang sent a WeChat message to his squash buddy Lin Feng letting him know he was heading out. Lin Feng replied instantly that he had already arrived and wanted to practice his backhand more. Mingqiang changed into a sports vest and shorts, filled a bottle with warm water, slung his racket bag over his shoulder, and got ready to leave.
location: Building 3, Room 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Squash training
description: Rode to Xingdongli Fitness Squash Center, first did 5 minutes of dynamic stretching in the facility corridor. After entering, played three practice matches with Lin Feng. Felt lighter on my feet than last week, but still some impatience on key points, letting Lin Feng score from openings. After the match, the two of us did 10 minutes of cool-down stretching together to relieve muscle fatigue.
location: Squash court, Star Power Fitness (N-Power Store), Tower C, China Resources Center, No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After exercising, went home and showered.
description: After exercise, his whole body felt refreshed, and he rode home against the night breeze. At home, he opened the door quietly; the children were already asleep, and his wife Juanzi was waiting for him in the living room. Mingqiang shared in a low voice that he had a great game tonight, saying Lin Feng's backhand had improved a lot, then took a hot shower to wash away the sweat and fatigue.
location: Building 3, Room 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talked with his older brother on the phone to consult about investment matters
description: After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang walked to the bedroom balcony and called his elder brother Lu Minghua. After some small talk, he sent his brother screenshots and an introduction of the high-yield platform recommended by his childhood friend Wang Hai, expressing his unease about its promised 15% annualized return. Brother Minghua said in a serious tone that this was very likely a capital pool scam and urged him never to invest in it. After hearing the professional analysis, Mingqiang felt completely at ease.
location: Bedroom balcony, Room 504, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing for bed and going to sleep
description: After hanging up, he returned to the bedroom. His wife asked with concern what had happened. After Mingqiang briefly explained, Juanzi also thought it was right to follow Big Brother's advice. Mingqiang prepared his work clothes for the next day, set the alarm for 6:10 in the morning, drank a sip of water, and lay down on the bed. Outside the window, a fine rain began to fall again, and the sound of the rain lulled him to sleep. Reviewing the day, tutoring the child had gone smoothly, learning had been productive, exercise had been refreshing, and investment doubts had been resolved. Feeling at ease, he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Room 504, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Get up, wash up, and get ready to go out
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm on his phone went off, and Lu Mingqiang got up to start the new day. He took a shower, shaved, changed into work short-sleeves and trousers, checked the squash racket and spare balls that had been charging the night before, hung his sports bag by the door, and made sure he had his car keys and phone.
location: Room 302, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Buy breakfast at Blacksmith Dad's Tea Shop.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his motorcycle to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road and got takeout: a serving of Hainan noodles, a serving of marinated noodles with egg, a basket of small steamed dumplings, and an unsweetened soy milk for his wife Wang Lijuan. After buying them, he rode home carrying the breakfast, planning to leave for work after a while.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Shop 12, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Motorcycle commute, pre-shift meeting, and tool collection
description: Lu Mingqiang set off from home, rode his motorcycle along Binya Road and turned onto Haisheng Road, arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park after more than ten minutes. He changed into his work clothes and attended the pre-shift morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang. Team Leader Zhang assigned tasks: in the morning, go with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Guomao City Garden to inspect the power distribution room; in the afternoon, return to the warehouse to disassemble old vacuum circuit breakers. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang and his partner Chen Jianguo went to the warehouse to pick up tools such as insulated gloves, a voltage tester, and a multimeter, and the two checked them off together.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inspection work at the power distribution room of Guomao City Garden
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang drove the company's pickup truck to Guomao City Garden, and after communicating with the property manager, they started work. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of the power distribution room in Building 1, with Zhao Qiang assisting. They first ventilated and cooled the room, then checked the instruments and transformer sounds item by item according to the inspection checklist, and used an infrared thermometer to measure the temperature of the main contacts. In Building 3, they found a circuit breaker handle was hot, judged it to be oxidized contacts, and after polishing and treatment, re-testing was normal. At 11:30 a.m. they completed all inspections, filled in records, signed, and took photos for documentation.
location: Guomao City Garden, No. 1 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rest between work tasks and prepare for the technical sharing session
description: After wrapping up the patrol inspection, Lu Mingqiang asked Jianguo and Xiao Zhao to go ahead to the fast-food restaurant and order, while he sat on the steps outside the power distribution room and took out his phone to review the PPT outline on Common Inverter Fault Code Analysis and Rapid Troubleshooting Ideas, which he would explain in the evening. He silently organized the logic and key points to prepare for the night's technical exchange group sharing.
location: Outside the power distribution room, Building 1, Guomao City Garden, No. 1 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Have lunch with colleagues and take a midday break back at the company warehouse
description: Lu Mingqiang met up with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang and drove back to the Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the industrial park. It was hot, so each of them ordered a bowl of winter melon and clam soup to cool off; Lu Mingqiang also ordered an extra spicy soup rice and a fried egg. While eating, the colleagues talked about the evening's tech sharing session, and Lu Mingqiang looked confident. After the meal, the three returned to the company. Lu Mingqiang went straight to Warehouse No. 3, spread cardboard on the floor next to an industrial fan, and took a short nap to recharge.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Disassembled and overhauled an old vacuum circuit breaker in the warehouse.
description: When work started in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang and Chen Jianguo to dismantle old vacuum circuit breakers on the workbench in Warehouse No. 3. While operating, he explained the structure to the younger colleagues and pointed out common faults in the vacuum interrupters and operating mechanism springs. Two units were disassembled today; one was marked for scrapping because the interrupter chamber was damaged, and the other was judged to have abnormal mechanism noise due to low oil and connecting rod wear, so they decided to repair and maintain it. At 4:30 they cleaned up the workbench and put the tools back in place.
location: Warehouse 3, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Rode my motorcycle home from work and stopped by Xiuying Farmers' Market on the way to buy groceries.
description: After clocking out, Lu Mingqiang got on his motorcycle and headed home. Passing by the Xiuying Farmers' Market, he remembered his wife saying that the fruit at home was gone, so he stopped, went in, and bought a jin of fresh mangosteen and a bunch of green-skinned mangoes, with portions for his own family and his parents. After buying the fruit, he continued riding home.
location: Xiuying Farmers' Market, No. 68 Xiuhua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home, take a shower, review the sharing materials, and organize sports equipment.
description: Lu Mingqiang got home, handed the fruit to his wife Wang Lijuan, who was busy in the kitchen, and told her to put it in the fridge to chill. He then took a shower, changed into home clothes, opened his phone to do one last check of the PPT for the evening tech sharing, and carried his squash bag to the living room door, ensuring everything was ready for his evening workout.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The family of four had dinner together.
description: At dinner, Wang Lijuan prepared stir-fried beef with bitter melon, stir-fried water spinach, and tomato egg soup. Lu Mingqiang, his wife, and their two sons sat together to eat. The older son, Lu Zixuan, shared funny stories from school; the younger son, Lu Zihan, clamored to eat mangosteen. Lu Mingqiang peeled mangosteen for the children, and the family of four enjoyed the warm time with laughter and conversation.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Coaching son Lu Zixuan on the basics of fractions
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang used colorful building block teaching aids and apples to help his son Lu Zixuan understand the concept of fractions. He had Zixuan divide the blocks equally and color them to represent fractions, and explained the meaning of the numerator and denominator. Zixuan was somewhat resistant at first, but after hands-on work he became interested, eventually grasping the intuitive meaning of "parts of a whole" and independently completing the first exercise in the book.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Debugging equipment and hosting a frequency converter fault analysis sharing session in the group.
description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang moved his laptop into the study, plugged it in, debugged the screen-sharing software, and sent a message in the technical exchange group to remind his fellow workers. At 8:10 p.m., he started the voice conference on time, gave a brief self-introduction, and shared his screen. Using photos he had taken of faulty motors and circuit boards, he explained in detail how to interpret common inverter fault codes and quickly troubleshoot them. The presentation lasted over an hour, and during that time he patiently answered questions from group members, such as how to handle an "OC alarm". The sharing session was lively; when it ended, the fellow workers in the group gave likes and thanks, and everyone called Lu Mingqiang "Group Owner".
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Called his older brother to ask about investment risks and rejected Wang Hai on WeChat.
description: As soon as the sharing session ended, Lu Mingqiang immediately called his elder brother Lu Minghua in Shenzhen to ask whether the investment platform with 15% annualized return recommended by his childhood friend Wang Hai was reliable. Lu Minghua warned his younger brother that it was very likely a capital scam and advised him not to touch it. Lu Mingqiang understood, chatted briefly with his brother, and hung up. Then he sent Wang Hai a WeChat voice message politely declining the investment, saying he preferred to play it safe, and they agreed to have Laoba tea together next time in Haikou. With that settled, Lu Mingqiang felt reassured.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had a squash training session with my squash buddy Lin Feng and went home to wash up.
description: Putting down his phone, Lu Mingqiang changed into quick-dry sportswear, packed his squash gear, greeted his wife, and rode his motorcycle to the squash court at Power Fitness Club. After meeting up with his playing partner Lin Feng, they warmed up briefly and started rallying, focusing on forehand volleys. Lin Feng praised him for having hot hands tonight. The training lasted until nearly 10:45, and the two agreed to practice again next time. Lu Mingqiang rode home, slipped in quietly, took a shower, changed into dry pajamas, and got ready for bed.
location: Squash court, Dongli Fitness Club, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talking with his wife before bed and resting
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang went into the bedroom and found his wife Wang Lijuan wearing earphones and watching a TV drama, not yet asleep. He quietly told her that work went well that day, the sharing session was successful, and he had turned down an unwise investment. Wang Lijuan told him not to get too tired. Lu Mingqiang went to the living room to confirm the two children were sound asleep, then returned to the bedroom and set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning. Reflecting on the fulfilling day, he felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: I got up at 06:05 in the morning; it was already light. My wife Wang Lijuan was still fast asleep. I got out of bed quietly, went to the bathroom, and washed my face and brushed my teeth with cold water to clear my head. At the same time, I was thinking about the matter of sending tea to my childhood friend Wang Hai today and mulling over the wording of the note.
location: Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Breakfast and sending tea
description: At 06:30 he left home and rode his electric bike to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road, where he ordered a bowl of Hainan rice noodles with a fried egg and iced black tea. He chatted with the owner, Lao Xu, about the weather, then ate quickly and packed an unsweetened iced soy milk to go. Afterward, he detoured by electric bike to the Binya Road Postal Branch, carefully packed the two packs of Wuzhishan green tea he had brought from home along with a handwritten note, and mailed them to his childhood friend Wang Hai in Bantian, Longgang, Shenzhen, paying 12 yuan postage. After mailing, he took a photo with his phone and sent it to Wang Hai, telling him the tea had been sent and to keep an eye out for it.
location: China Post Branch Office, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Commute and morning meeting
description: Rode an electric bike from the postal sub-branch to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, departing at 07:10, along Binya Road, Qiuhai Avenue, and Haisheng Road, arriving in about 20 minutes. After greeting the security guard Lao Wu, he went into the changing room, put on his work clothes, and wore his safety helmet. At 07:30 he attended the team morning meeting in the conference room. Team leader Zhang summarized yesterday's work, praised my performance in mentoring the apprentice, and assigned the morning task: go to the Jinmao Subdistrict Office, Longhua District, for routine inspection of the distribution cabinet, with me leading the team, and members Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Inspection and maintenance of the power distribution cabinet at Jinmao Subdistrict Office
description: Collected tools with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, loaded the three-phase four-wire maintenance tool cart onto the three-wheeled motorcycle, and I drove to the Jinmao Subdistrict Office. After arriving, we set up warning tape, disconnected the main switch and locked it, then began the maintenance. First I guided Zhao Qiang to use a vacuum cleaner and brush to clean the dust inside the distribution cabinet, while I used a flashlight to check each air switch and wiring terminal for overheating, discoloration, or looseness. Then I used a screwdriver to tighten the wiring terminals of each branch circuit. I found that a 63A air switch on a backup circuit was slightly oxidized, so I polished it with a small file and sandpaper, applied conductive paste, and retightened it. After all the work was completed, I measured the insulation with a megger, and the data was acceptable. Finally, I signed to confirm and handed the maintenance records to the subdistrict office staff.
location: Power distribution room, Jinmao Subdistrict Office, No. 12 Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Lunch: spicy soup rice
description: After completing the repair work, Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and I rode back to Haisheng Road. On the way, we ate at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. I treated—each of us had a portion of the signature spicy soup rice, plus a plate of white-cut Wenchang chicken. We ate and chatted, sweating happily. During the meal, I talked with Jianguo about his son's high school entrance exam results, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Lunch break and handling investment matters
description: After lunch I returned to the company and, in the corridor outside the break room, made a WeChat call to my older brother Lu Minghua to ask about the investment platform recommended by my childhood friend Wang Hai. My brother concluded it was a Ponzi scheme and warned me not to get involved. After hanging up, I leaned back in my chair and dozed for about ten minutes. When I woke up, I opened WeChat and sent Wang Hai a carefully worded message, declining the investment on the grounds of my brother's friend's professional opinion, while again mentioning the matter of sending tea to express my sincerity in maintaining the friendship. Wang Hai replied with a smiley face and 'Got it, waiting to have tea with you.' The weight in my heart lifted.
location: Rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Afternoon work: organizing the warehouse and mentoring apprentices
description: In the afternoon, I sorted inventory in the warehouse. With Chen Jianguo, I was responsible for checking the models of newly arrived contactors, relays, and fuses, tearing off old labels, printing new numbers with a label printer, and guiding my apprentice Zhao Qiang to update the electronic ledger on the computer. During the work, I explained in detail to him how to distinguish different coil voltages of contactors and the key points of installation, passing on experience.
location: Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Getting off work and buying groceries.
description: Got off work at 16:30, changed into casual clothes, and rode the electric bike to Xiuying Farmers' Market. Since my wife wanted a light soup, I bought winter melon and white sea snails to make winter melon and sea snail soup in the evening, and also weighed out a jin of lychees for the two sons.
location: Xiuying Farmers Market, No. 68 Xiuhua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China.

name: Family dinner
description: After returning home, I gave the vegetables and fruit to my wife Wang Lijuan, who was busy in the kitchen, and briefly told her about today's events. Then I took a cold shower, changed into home clothes, and helped wash the white clams and cut the winter melon. My wife made steamed ribs with fermented black beans and stir-fried sweet potato leaves, plus the winter melon and sea snail soup I made. The family of four sat around the table for dinner. During dinner, my wife brought up taking the children to swimming lessons on the weekend, and I agreed.
location: Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Parent-child math competition and interaction
description: After dinner, I cleared the dining table, took out the math teaching cards and colored markers, and set them up on the living room coffee table. Then I called over my two sons and announced the start of a family math knowledge competition. The elder son, Lu Zixuan, answered the questions, while the younger son, Lu Zihan, acted as the referee and drew stars to keep score. The game lasted for over an hour, and Zixuan actively rushed to answer, creating a lively atmosphere. At the end, I deliberately asked a difficult question but gave hints so that Zixuan got it right, and as a reward they would have qingbuliang on the weekend. After the game, we cleaned up the materials together. I sat on the floor mat and told the children the amusing story of how I learned to read circuit diagrams with my master back in the day, and the two children were completely fascinated.
location: Living room, Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Supervise the children's washing and bedtime story.
description: It was getting late, so I urged my two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces. The elder son, Lu Zixuan, did it on his own, while I helped the younger son, Lu Zihan, wash up; the little guy playfully fooled around with the foam. After washing, I told Zihan the story 'The Little Gecko Borrows a Tail' and waited until he fell asleep, then went to Zixuan's room to turn off the light and say goodnight.
location: Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Evening conversation with wife
description: After the children fell asleep, the house was quiet. Returning to the master bedroom, I chatted with my wife Wang Lijuan, who was leaning against the headboard, about today’s tea delivery, the phone call with my brother, and Wang Hai’s reply. My wife affirmed my approach. I also discussed with her taking the children to Evergreen Park on the weekend afternoon to fly kites, and she agreed.
location: Master bedroom, Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Professional technical study
description: After chatting with his wife, he went to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and reviewed the chapter on troubleshooting complex circuit faults in "Advanced Technician Theory Tutorial." He read the example problems and drew circuit diagrams on scratch paper to analyze them, planning to spend an hour going over the chapter's key points to improve his professional skills.
location: Study, Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: After finishing the study session, he went to the bathroom to wash up quickly, then returned to the master bedroom, adjusted the air conditioner temperature, set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the day, work had gone smoothly, his bond with his childhood friend was intact, and his family was warm. He felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 203, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang was awakened by the alarm clock, and it was already bright outside the window. He got up, washed up, splashed cold water on his face to wake up, changed into a dark blue quick-dry short-sleeve shirt and black athletic shorts, and put on running shoes. After drinking half a glass of warm water, he did simple leg stretches in the living room to loosen his joints, preparing for the morning run.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning run training at Baishamen Park
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike to Baishamen Park for interval running training. After stretching at the gate, he warmed up by jogging the first two kilometers at a pace of 6:10 per kilometer, sped up to 5:40 per kilometer for the middle two kilometers, felt his heart beat faster and his thighs sore, then slowed to 6:30 per kilometer for the last kilometer as a cooldown. His average pace for the five kilometers was 6:10 per kilometer. He felt the training was effective; although tired, he felt invigorated and planned to do it once a month.

participant.name: Running partner
participant.relation: A morning jogger I happened to meet

location: Park trail at Baishamen Park, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy breakfast on the way
description: After his morning run, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to the convenience breakfast cart near the south gate of Baishamen Park. He bought two servings of Hainan-style marinated noodles with extra toppings, four barbecue pork buns, and two fried dough sticks, spending 28 yuan in total. He hung the breakfast on the handlebars and brought it home.
location: Convenience breakfast cart near the south gate of Baishamen Park, Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return home, shower, and have breakfast with the whole family.
description: When Lu Mingqiang got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already gotten the two children ready. He first took a cold shower, changed into a clean old T-shirt and casual shorts, and then the four of them had breakfast together. He broke the fried dough sticks into pieces, dipped them in soy milk, and gave them to his son Xuanxuan and daughter Hanhan. He himself ate big mouthfuls of sauced rice noodles, shared his morning run experience with his wife, and reminded her that there would be thundershowers in the afternoon and to be careful about the children going out.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning family time and tidying up
description: After breakfast, Wang Lijuan went to wash the dishes. Lu Mingqiang asked his son Xuanxuan to pick up the scattered homework notebooks and helped his daughter Hanhan re-tie her loosened braid. He then went to the balcony to soak his work clothes, scrub the mud spots off his running shoes, and hang them out to dry. Meanwhile, Xuanxuan asked when they would have qingbuliang in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang smiled and replied that they would go after the rain.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family supermarket shopping.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove the Wuling Hongguang to take the whole family to Wangjiawang Supermarket for shopping. Wang Lijuan picked green vegetables, tomatoes, eggs, and pork ribs in the fresh food area, while Lu Mingqiang took the two children, each pushing a kids' shopping cart, and let them each choose one snack in the snack area, fulfilling his wife's earlier promise. At checkout, they found the bill was more than 30 yuan higher than last week, so he reminded his wife to keep in mind the recent rise in vegetable prices.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 8-3 Jinyuan Road, Wangjiawang Supermarket (Jinyuan Road Store)

name: Handle courier waybills
description: After finishing shopping, Lu Mingqiang, inside his car in the supermarket parking lot, used his phone to photograph the express receipt for the tea he had sent to his friend Wang Hai. He sent the photo via WeChat and left a voice message saying it would be delivered in about two or three days.
location: Inside a car in the parking lot of Wangjiawang Supermarket, No. 8-3 Jinyuan Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returning home and preparing lunch ingredients
description: After arriving home, Wang Lijuan put the supermarket items away in the refrigerator, while Lu Mingqiang put on an apron and prepared lunch in the kitchen. He scraped the skin off the winter melon and cut it into chunks, soaked sea white snails in salt water to let them expel sand, and blanched the pork ribs for braising.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cooking lunch and having a family meal.
description: Lu Mingqiang was the head cook, with Wang Lijuan assisting by peeling garlic and passing plates. They made braised pork ribs, winter melon and sea snail soup, and stir-fried Shanghai bok choy. The meal started right at noon. The two children went straight for the ribs, while Lu Mingqiang and his wife drank the savory soup. The table was full of laughter and cheerful talk.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and thundershowers
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang let the children play in the living room for a while to help digestion, and at 1:30 urged them to take a nap. He and his wife went back to the master bedroom to rest. Outside the window, the sky turned overcast and thunder rumbled in the distance. At around 2:00 p.m., a thunderstorm began to pour, and the raindrops hit the window noisily. Lu Mingqiang thought it would be perfect to take the children out once the rain stopped.
location: Master bedroom and second bedroom of the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family games after the afternoon nap.
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up at 2:30 to find it was still raining. Seeing that the two children were already awake and making noise, he called them into the living room and brought out Ludo and Chinese checkers to play together. His daughter Hanhan messed around throwing the dice, while his son Xuanxuan played seriously and was very happy after winning a round. Around 3:20 the rain began to quiet down, and the air outside the window was fresh.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: A walk after the rain and Qingbuliang
description: After the rain stopped, Lu Mingqiang took the two children downstairs and played on the slide and seesaw in the damp garden of the community. A little after four, his son reminded him of the promise of qingbuliang, so he took the children to the usual Yeyutang on Shimao South Road. He ordered a coconut milk qingbuliang for himself, a brown sugar water qingbuliang for his son, and freshly squeezed coconut water for his daughter. The children happily enjoyed their treats.
location: Yeyutang Qingbuliang Shop beside Fuguo Food Stall, Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returning home and previewing homework
