description: After having the qingbuliang and returning home, Lu Mingqiang let his daughter watch cartoons in the living room, while he took his son Xuanxuan to the desk, had him look at the fraction addition problems in the weekend math homework, and try the first one, while he observed from the side.
location: Home study/living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Couple works together to prepare dinner.
description: Wang Lijuan came home from her part-time housekeeping job and, seeing Lu Mingqiang already in the kitchen, quickly washed her hands to help. Lu Mingqiang made spicy stir-fried clams, while Wang Lijuan reheated the leftover ribs from lunch and stir-fried hot and sour shredded potatoes. As they cooked, they chatted about their respective days.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was a little late, but the family ate with great enjoyment. His daughter Hanhan coquettishly said her father's clams were the most delicious. Lu Mingqiang praised his son for proactively previewing lessons that afternoon and said he would teach him fraction addition after the meal.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helping his son with math homework
description: After a short break, Lu Mingqiang cleared the dining table, took out the math textbook, workbook, and building blocks, and used the objects to demonstrate the principles of adding fractions and converting to a common denominator. For example, he broke the blocks into pieces to explain that 1/4 plus 1/4 equals 1/2. His son Xuanxuan quickly understood and completed all the problems independently. Lu Mingqiang was gratified, praised his son for being smart, and encouraged him to keep working hard at the swimming training tomorrow.
location: Study/dining table at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Prepare swimming gear
description: After helping his son with homework, Lu Mingqiang took him into the bedroom and dug out swim trunks, goggles, and a swim ring. He checked the goggle seals, inflated the swim ring fully with a pump and confirmed there were no leaks, then packed all the gear into a waterproof bag and placed it on the shoe cabinet by the door for use the next morning.
location: Master bedroom and second bedroom of the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family leisure and bedtime preparation.
description: After everything was ready, the whole family watched TV in the living room. Lu Mingqiang leaned on the sofa, occasionally scrolling his phone to check work group messages, and discussed the children's summer interest classes with his wife. At 10 p.m., he urged the two children to brush their teeth and wash their faces, then he himself took a shower and got ready for bed.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard reading "Advanced Technician Theory Tutorial" and read a few pages of PLC control system diagrams. Reviewing the day: the morning run plan was completed, supermarket shopping went smoothly, the promise of qingbuliang was fulfilled, and his son's math homework was explained clearly. He felt grounded and satisfied, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Master bed at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Got up in the morning and washed up.
description: At 7 a.m. the phone alarm went off right on time. I turned off the alarm, got up, washed up, changed into comfortable loungewear, and got ready to start the new day full of energy.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Went out to buy breakfast and Job's tears; whole family had breakfast and talked.
description: I took some change and a shopping bag downstairs and bought four bowls of Hainan noodles and four pork buns at the breakfast stall I usually go to by the entrance. Then I walked to the dried goods stall in the Jinmao Middle Road vegetable market and bought five yuan of coix seeds, planning to have my wife Juanzi take them to my mother Chen Xiuying to dispel dampness. When I got home, my wife had already washed Hanhan up, and Xuanxuan was dressed too. Our whole family sat around the table for breakfast. I handed the coix seeds to Juanzi and told her to take them to my mother later, because the weather forecast said it would be rainy for the next few days and my mother's knees might bother her. I also told Xuanxuan that after breakfast we would review the mistake notebook together.
location: Breakfast stall downstairs (at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Area), Jinmao Middle Road vegetable market (Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province), and the dining table at home (Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: Helped his son organize his math mistake notebook.
description: After breakfast, I told Xuanxuan to bring his math error notebook and test papers to the living room coffee table. I sat beside him and went through each problem with him. One solid geometry problem he didn't quite understand, so I took out the building block teaching aids and explained how to observe the cube from different angles while building it up. Xuanxuan listened carefully and kept trying by himself with his hands; finally he understood clearly and shouted excitedly that he got it. During the review, he also told me funny stories from school, saying his deskmate drew a rectangle that turned out like a trapezoid and was called out by the teacher. We laughed for a good while. The two-hour tutoring session ended in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Living room at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Call to ask about mother's knee.
description: After tutoring Xuanxuan, I called my mother Chen Xiuying, asked about her knee, and told her to hot-compress her knee at home and apply a medicated patch in advance while the weather was clear, because the forecast said the next few days would be rainy and overcast. My mother said she was fine, just a little uncomfortable when the weather changed. I told her I would have Juanzi bring over some dampness-dispelling coix seeds later to cook porridge. My mother told me not to bother, saying she could take care of herself. After hanging up, I felt much more at ease.
location: Living room at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Prepare and enjoy lunch
description: After the phone call, I went into the kitchen, took over the water spinach Juanzi was trimming, let her go keep the kids company, and started preparing lunch myself. At noon I made shredded pork and pickled mustard soup and garlic stir-fried water spinach, and reheated the winter melon and sea snail soup we had brought back from Wanlv Garden yesterday. While slicing the pork, I chatted with Juanzi in the living room about taking Xuanxuan to swim lessons next week. Xuanxuan excitedly chimed in that he wanted to learn breaststroke. When the food was on the table, the four of us sat around it. Xuanxuan kept talking about going swimming in the afternoon, and Hanhan joined in the fun. I promised to take the older brother to scout the place first in the afternoon, and once he had learned, we would take the younger brother and mom together. Juanzi reminded Xuanxuan to listen to his father. Lunch ended in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Home kitchen and dining table in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Family afternoon nap
description: After lunch, I helped clear the dishes. Juanzi took Hanhan to the room for a nap, I urged Xuanxuan to go back to his room to rest, then returned to the master bedroom and lay down. Although it was a bit muggy, the fan felt very comfortable, and soon everyone was asleep.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Afternoon outing: went to Haitida Qiaozhong Swimming Pool to scout it out and make inquiries.
description: At 2 p.m., I got up, washed my face, changed into a dry T-shirt and shorts, and woke Xuanxuan. We brought water and a backpack, I took out the electric bike, and rode with him toward Haidian Island in Meilan District, telling him on the way that we were going to see the swimming pool recommended by a classmate's parent. Along Binhai Avenue and turning onto Renmin Avenue, we arrived at the Haiti Daqiaozhong Swimming Pool after about 20 minutes. After parking the bike, I took Xuanxuan into the lobby and asked the young coach at the front desk about the summer children's swimming classes, including the schedule, coach qualifications, and water quality reports. A coach also showed us around the pool, and the water was clear and clean. Watching the people swimming in the pool, Xuanxuan's eyes were full of envy and he kept urging me to sign up. I kept the coach's business card and said I would contact them after thinking it over.
location: Haiti Da Qiaozhong Swimming Pool (Haidian Island, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Strolling in Wanlv Garden and resting over Laoba tea.
description: After leaving the swimming pool, I rode my bike, turned back onto Binhai Avenue, and went straight into Evergreen Park. At around two or three in the afternoon, there weren't many people in the park. I parked the bike and strolled slowly with Xuanxuan along the path beside the lawn. Someone was flying a kite on the lawn, and Xuanxuan wanted to try too. I said we'd bring his little brother next time. We walked a big loop, enjoying the comfortable sea breeze and the rare coolness. After leaving Evergreen Park, I made a special detour to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road. I found a seat under a fan and ordered a pot of Tieguanyin, plus an iced lemon black tea for Xuanxuan, along with pineapple buns and pandan cakes. Xuanxuan ate with his mouth all greasy, while I drank tea and looked at my phone, enjoying a leisurely father-son moment.
location: Evergreen Park (No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province), Datie Laoba Tea Shop (Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province).

name: On the way home, call to arrange coix seed delivery and prepare dinner.
description: After leaving the tea shop, I called Juanzi, told her we were almost home, and asked her to go out and deliver the pearl barley to my mother, Chen Xiuying. After hanging up, I started the electric bike and rode back with Xuanxuan. When we got home, Juanzi had just gone out, and Hanhan was playing with building blocks alone on the floor. I went over and built a small castle with him, then went to the kitchen to prepare dinner before dark. I reheated the leftover soup from lunch and stir-fried tomatoes and eggs—simple and satisfying.
location: On the way back from Datie Laobacha Tea House (Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province) to Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province) and at home

name: Family dinner
description: Juanzi came back from delivering coix seeds just in time for dinner. I called everyone to eat. At the table, I shared with Juanzi about my afternoon trip to check out the swimming pool. I thought it was quite professional and planned to sign Xuanxuan up for a class next week. Juanzi said she supported it, adding that learning a skill is good. Xuanxuan, listening nearby, was excited, his eyes sparkling.
location: At the family dining table at Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province).

name: After-dinner cleanup
description: After dinner, I took the initiative to clear the table and let Juanzi go rest. I carried the dishes into the kitchen and washed them, then wiped down the stove and dining table, and tidied the home thoroughly.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Summarized the tutoring session with praise and gave a notebook as a gift.
description: After cleaning up, I called Xuanxuan to the dining table and looked at him seriously. The two-week math tutoring plan was over. Instead of asking him to take out his homework book, I acknowledged his progress. From being unable to sit still at first to now taking the initiative to review, I was happy for him. I told him that math requires more practice and more thought. When you come across something you don't understand, don't rush; take your time to figure it out. Then I took out a new notebook with a seagull pattern on it and gave it to him, telling him to write down any problems he couldn't solve in it in the future, and I would work through them with him. Xuanxuan happily took the notebook, his face beaming.
location: At the family dining table at Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province).

name: Washed up and chatted with his wife
description: After the tutoring session, I urged the two children to go wash up. I also took a quick shower and felt much fresher. Back in the bedroom, Juanzi was sitting on the bed looking at her phone. I lay down beside her and talked about the week: my childhood friend Wang Hai asked me to invest, but my brother said it was an investment scam, so I declined; Xiao Zhao at the company picks things up quickly; and the progress I'd made tutoring Xuanxuan. Juanzi praised me for handling things correctly. We also discussed sending Xuanxuan to a summer swimming class on Wednesday.
location: Bedroom at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Evening study: delved into senior technician theory
description: After chatting, I let Juanzi rest first and went to the study by myself. I turned on the desk lamp, took out the Senior Technician Theory Tutorial, and turned to the fault cases about IGBT module drive circuits in the frequency converter chapter. I took out my calculator and scratch paper and studied in depth. I deduced the circuit diagram repeatedly, writing detailed notes and key points beside it, until I thoroughly understood it. The weekend study was quite effective, and my mind felt much clearer.
location: Home study in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Closed the book, put the pen and notebook away. I picked up my phone to check the technical discussion group, then scrolled to Wang Hai's Moments; he was posting a gym check-in as if nothing had happened, and I smiled. I left the study and did a set of shoulder, neck, and lower-back stretches in the living room. Turned off the living room lights, checked the doors and windows, and went back to the bedroom. After lying down, I remembered the forecast said it might rain in the early morning, so I took another look at my phone to confirm. Then I put on my eye mask, reviewed the fulfilling day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area (No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm rang at 6:10 in the morning. Outside the window, the typhoon brought cloudy skies and wind. When I (Lu Mingqiang) got up, I felt some soreness in my lower back. I reminded my wife Wang Lijuan to drive carefully in the typhoon weather and to remember to bring a raincoat for our daughter Hanhan. After washing up, I changed into a long-sleeve work uniform. Then I checked the tool bag, added non-slip gloves and dry socks, put on a one-piece rain suit, filled the water bottle, put on labor-protection shoes, and went out the door with the tool bag.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and team morning meeting
description: Riding an electric bike from home through the rain, it took 12 minutes to reach the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. After changing into work clothes, I attended the team morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang deployed the emergency response for Typhoon Talim. I (Lu Mingqiang) was assigned to inspect and reinforce the outdoor power distribution cabinets, cable distribution boxes, and emergency generators in the Jinmao Street area, and I confirmed the backup batteries and fuel status with the team leader.
location: Team meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preventive inspection and reinforcement before the typhoon
description: Together with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, I drove an engineering vehicle to conduct a blanket inspection and reinforcement of outdoor power distribution facilities in the Jinmao Street area. I (Lu Mingqiang) personally guided apprentice Zhao Qiang to check cable ends for moisture and reinforce loose insulation. Around 11:00, I called my mother on my work phone and told her not to go out during the typhoon and to remember to drink coix seed water. After the inspection, I returned to the company and gave a brief report to Squad Leader Zhang, who told everyone to go to the cafeteria for lunch first.
location: Multiple outdoor power distribution facility points in the Jinmao Subdistrict area, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park

name: Had lunch and chatted with coworkers
description: The three of us went to the Jiejie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant next to the company, and I (Lu Mingqiang) ordered spicy soup rice with white-cut chicken. We chatted while eating. Chen Jianguo was worried that tonight's typhoon would keep him busy all night; I said that was part of the job and reminded Zhao Qiang to stay close and be careful in the afternoon.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and standby preparation
description: Back in the company's team rest room, he lay down on the folding bed to rest, but with things on his mind, he only dozed for 20 minutes. Afterwards he took Zhao Qiang to the warehouse to check the insulating gloves, voltage tester, and spare fuses, and tested the emergency lights on the work vehicle. Then he remained on standby in the rest room, waiting for dispatch orders.
location: Team rest room and warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: First small-scale emergency repair
description: At 2:30, received a dispatch instruction that a circuit breaker tripped in an office building in the jurisdiction. Immediately took Zhao Qiang and Chen Jianguo there. Inspection found that the low-voltage main switch protector had tripped but the wiring was normal. Determined it was caused by transient overcurrent. Guided Zhao Qiang to reset and restore power successfully. On the way back, reminded Zhao Qiang that even small problems should be taken seriously to avoid burning out equipment.
location: Electrical distribution room in an office building, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Emergency repair of a broken line on Jinding Road
description: The walkie-talkie reported that a line near Jinding Road in Xiuying District had tripped due to a fault and was at risk of breaking. Team Leader Zhang ordered our team to set out immediately. I (Lu Mingqiang), along with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, put on raincoats and rushed into the heavy rain to the scene. In the strong wind, I decided to climb the pole myself, had Zhao Qiang hand up tools and shine a flashlight from below, and Chen Jianguo keep watch at the foot of the pole. I fastened my safety belt and climbed the slippery utility pole, explaining the key operation points to Zhao Qiang while connecting wires. After two hours of emergency repairs, we successfully closed the switch and restored power. When I got down from the pole, I was so exhausted I was gasping for breath.
location: Fault site on Jinding Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Rest and nighttime emergency repair and wrapping on Qinzheng Road
description: After the emergency repair, we returned to the engineering vehicle to rest. I (Lu Mingqiang) drank some water and praised Zhao Qiang for his steady operation. Then I reported to the team leader that Jinding Road was done. When I learned that the box transformer on Qinzheng Road had a problem, I decided to go and check it. After arriving at Qinzheng Road, I used a flashlight to search for the fault point. While moving a metal sheet that had been blown down by the wind, Chen Jianguo's arm was scratched and bleeding. I immediately took the first aid kit out of the tool bag, rinsed and disinfected the wound for Jianguo, and bandaged it to stop the bleeding. At the same time, I reported to Team Leader Zhang over the walkie-talkie, and he approved Jianguo going back to the vehicle to rest. After that, I had Zhao Qiang hold the light for me, and I checked along the line for hidden dangers on my own. Only after confirming that there were no other problems did I return to the vehicle.
location: At the fault point near Qinzheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and inside the engineering vehicle

name: Task wrap-up and summary reporting.
description: After returning to the service vehicle, I (Lu Mingqiang) first checked that Chen Jianguo's wound was not bleeding, then used my phone to compile the day's emergency repair situation, fault cause, handling process, and Jianguo's injury, and reported in detail to Team Leader Zhang. The team leader instructed other teams to take over the follow-up and had our team stand by.
location: Temporary parking spot for engineering vehicles near Qinzheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Early-morning standby, confirmation, and wrap-up records
description: I told Zhao Qiang and Jianguo to rest in the car, and although exhausted, I stayed awake and on standby. At 3 a.m., Shift Leader Zhang confirmed over the walkie-talkie that the main fault points in the area had all been restored. I reported Jianguo's injury and that I would take him to see a doctor after dawn. The shift leader arranged for us to hand over and rest after daybreak. Then, by flashlight, I recorded several key locations and causes in my notebook, and only after writing the last character did I lean back in the chair and close my eyes.
location: Temporary rest stop for engineering vehicles, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Waking up in the work vehicle and preparing
description: Moderate rain pattered against the roof of the work truck, and the sky was barely light. Lu Mingqiang slowly sat up in the back seat, wiped his face with a damp towel, and felt that his lower back was still sore. He picked up his phone and saw a message saying his wages and high-temperature allowance totaling 4,200 yuan had been credited, which made him feel more at ease. He found the half bottle of water and a pack of compressed biscuits left over from last night in his toolbox, and grabbed a few bites to replenish his energy.
location: Temporary parking spot near Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Riding home and buying an account book
description: Putting on a raincoat, I started the e-bike and rode back to Banshan Garden from the Electric Power Industrial Park in the rain. Passing the convenience supermarket at the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road, I stopped and went in to buy a new account book and a black gel pen, preparing for keeping accounts.
location: Convenience Store on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Household accounting and savings
description: When he got home, the family hadn't gotten up yet, so he walked softly. He took a hot shower and changed into clean loungewear. Sitting at the dining table, he placed the new and old ledgers side by side. He first used the mobile banking app to transfer 3,000 yuan from the demand deposit to the time deposit savings account, then carefully wrote in the brand-new ledger: “July 15, income 4,200 yuan, fixed deposit 3,000 yuan, remaining 1,200 yuan. Typhoon emergency repair allowance to be counted separately.” His handwriting was neat, and he went through everything methodically.
location: Home, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Handing over work at the company and applying for compensatory leave
description: Changed into dry work clothes and rode a bike to the company. First went to the tool room to count, clean, and put away the complete set of emergency repair tools used last night (insulating rods, wrenches, voltage testers, etc.). Then he filled out a detailed emergency repair work order. At 8:30, after Zhang Tou arrived at the office, he immediately reported last night's situation, focusing on what happened to Chen Jianguo's injury and the outcome. After listening, Zhang Tou patted him on the shoulder and readily approved half a day of compensatory leave (afternoon).
location: Office of Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Repairing the car and arranging meal delivery
description: He was about to ride his e-bike home when he found the rear tire was a bit soft, probably punctured by broken glass on the road last night. He pushed the bike to Old Zhang's repair shop at the company gate and asked the old man to patch the tire. While waiting, he walked to the industrial park cafeteria and happened to run into the apprentice Zhao Qiang eating breakfast. He told Zhao Qiang, “In the afternoon, after I come back from seeing Jianguo at the hospital, I'll send you a WeChat message. After you get off work, come to my building and take the grilled fish to him for me.” Zhao Qiang readily agreed.
location: Repair stall and canteen at the entrance of the Electric Power Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Went home to catch up on sleep.
description: After fixing the flat tire, he rode home and arrived around 10:15. At home there was only a note left by Juanzi before she went out for housekeeping, saying the two children had gone to their grandmother's house to play. A wave of drowsiness hit him. He set the alarm for 1 p.m., pulled the curtains, lay down on the bed, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and a phone call to greet parents.
description: Woken by the phone alarm. Though he still wanted to sleep, he was hungry. He went to the kitchen and cooked a bowl of dried noodles, added two eggs and some chopped green onions, and made do with a simple meal. After eating, he called his parents at their home in Meilan District to let them know he was safe, saying last night's emergency repair had gone smoothly and telling them not to worry. He also asked about his father's chronic knee problem lately.
location: Home kitchen at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon rest and checking the children's homework.
description: After the meal, he sat on the sofa and rested for a while, drinking a glass of warm water. He soaked the work clothes he had changed out of yesterday in a laundry basin. He checked the e-bike's battery and raincoat, planning to go visit Jianguo. Remembering Zixuan's summer homework, he flipped through the homework notebook on the desk and found the handwriting fairly neat, which comforted him a little.
location: Living room, home in Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Go to the hospital to visit an injured colleague.
description: He put on his rain gear and rode to Jinmao Street Community Health Service Center. On the way, at a fruit shop, he bought a basket of seasonal fruit (mangoes, dragon fruit) and two boxes of milk. At the hospital, he went to the second floor of the inpatient building and found Chen Jianguo's ward. His arm was wrapped in gauze, and he was half-sitting in bed watching TV. Seeing Lu Mingqiang come in, Jianguo smiled and said, 'Brother Qiang, sorry to make you come all this way.' Lu Mingqiang put the fruit on the bedside table and conveyed best wishes from Boss Zhang and the guys in the crew.
location: Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, intersection of Jinlong Road and Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Ward conversation and work arrangement
description: The two talked for half an hour. Lu Mingqiang explained Foreman Zhang's arrangement in detail: this week he should just rest up and stop thinking about work; the crew leader had said that next week he would first take care of tools in the warehouse for a couple of days, easy work. Jianguo was grateful and said his wound was healing well. Lu Mingqiang also reminded him to change the dressing on time and not to skip the anti-inflammatory medicine out of laziness. Jianguo laughed and said he got it, and that Lu Mingqiang was more nagging than his wife.
location: Ward, Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, at the intersection of Jinlong Road and Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pack up the grilled fish and contact a colleague to deliver the meal.
description: Leaving the hospital, the rain had gradually eased. He rode his bike and turned to the Jia Mie Food Stall on Shimao South Road; Jianguo loved this place's grilled fish. He ordered a tilapia, garlic-flavored, mildly spicy, to go. While waiting for the fish, he called Zhao Qiang and told him to come by about 6:30 after work to pick up the fish. He also asked the owner to add extra pickled bamboo shoots and side dishes. Carrying the packed grilled fish, he returned home.
location: Jiamie Food Stall and Banshan Garden, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Handed over the grilled fish and had some alone time to rest.
description: Just as he arrived downstairs at his home, he saw Zhao Qiang riding a shared bike over. Lu Mingqiang handed him the grilled fish, told him to make sure it was delivered and to pass on that he would go see him in a couple of days. Zhao Qiang nodded and left. When he got home, the house was empty. Lu Mingqiang could finally lie on the sofa alone, propped his legs up on the coffee table, turned on the TV and switched to the local news channel. Listening to the sound of the rain and the news, he completely emptied his mind.
location: Downstairs at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the living room at home

name: Family reunion and helping children with homework
description: Just after 6, Juanzi came home with the two sons. As soon as Xuanxuan and Hanhan entered, they shouted 'Dad.' Lu Mingqiang perked up and hugged Hanhan. Dinner was still being prepared, so he led Zixuan to the coffee table to check his homework. Opening the math workbook, he saw that two of the word problems had incomplete solution steps. He circled them with a red pen and patiently explained, 'This step can't be skipped; you need to write out the process clearly.' Zixuan understood and obediently corrected the mistakes.
location: Living room, home in Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Juanzi made his favorite white-cut pork, garlic lettuce, and winter melon and clam soup. At the dinner table, Lu Mingqiang, as usual, did not mention the details of last night's emergency repair in the rain, but said lightly: 'The circuit was fixed last night, everyone is safe, it's just that Jianguo scraped his skin a little, nothing serious.' Then he asked Juanzi: 'Is there anything we need at home? I'll buy it after work tomorrow.' He also reminded her: 'Don't forget to call my mother this weekend.'
location: Home dining room in Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening parent-child activities and getting ready for bed
description: After dinner, Juanzi cleared the table. Lu Mingqiang played with building blocks with Hanhan on the play mat and told him a Peppa Pig story. Before he had been telling it for more than ten minutes, he couldn't stop yawning. Juanzi said with concern, 'Go take a shower and go to bed; you have to work tomorrow.' He acknowledged, told Hanhan to go to his mother, then took a quick shower, plugged in his phone to charge, and put the clean work clothes for the next day by the bedside.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Relax before bed and listen to a podcast.
description: After settling the children down, Juanzi went back to the bedroom too. Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard, not in a hurry to sleep. He opened the audio app on his phone and listened to his subscribed program Electrician Crash Course and an episode of the podcast Hainan Old Dad Tea Talk, catching up on local news and interesting stories. This was a rare moment of complete relaxation that belonged entirely to him.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Go to bed and rest
description: After listening for a short while, drowsiness swept over him again. Lu Mingqiang said "going to sleep" to Juanzi, turned off his phone, and adjusted his sleeping position. The extreme fatigue of his body mixed with the relaxation of having completed his task, and he soon fell into a deep sleep. Tomorrow, a new round of typhoon-season emergency repair work might begin again, but today, he needed a restful night's sleep to regain his strength.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and breakfast
description: Woke up in the cab of the work truck, stretching stiff shoulders, neck, and lower back, feeling the soreness after the emergency repair. Checked the weather: cloudy turning to thundershowers, 27–33°C. Sent a WeChat message to his wife Wang Lijuan saying he might have dinner with colleagues in the evening. Then went to the public restroom in the industrial park to wash up with cold water, ate bottled water, whole wheat bread, and pickled mustard as breakfast beside the work truck, and replied to his wife's message.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Emergency repair wrap-up and site cleanup
description: The whole team gathered. Squad leader Zhang assigned tasks: repair the last section of line joints and complete the power-on acceptance, then thoroughly clean the site. Lu Mingqiang guided Zhao Qiang in conducting line insulation tests and parameter verification, and praised his performance. At 10:00, the emergency repair was completed and power was restored. Everyone cleaned up safety barriers, warning signs, scattered tools, and cable ends. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo carried heavy equipment such as hydraulic clamps and generators back to the service vehicle. At 11:15, the squad leader announced that work ended ahead of schedule; in the afternoon they would return to the warehouse to organize tools.
location: Power emergency repair site on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, near the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: Lunch: light spicy soup rice
description: Rode the electric bike alone to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road, ordered a signature spicy soup rice with greens, and instead of a drink had warm water. The spicy soup made me sweat and eased my fatigue. While eating, I replied to my wife's message letting her know I had eaten lunch.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon nap and body relaxation
description: After the meal, he returned to the industrial park, sat down in the warehouse rest area, massaged the sore lower back with medicated oil, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour. During this time, he browsed an electrician technology forum on his phone and replied to peers' technical questions.
location: Warehouse rest area of the Electric Power Engineering Company, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tool retrieval, counting, and storage
description: Together with Zhao Qiang, he cleaned, maintained and categorized the emergency repair tools, checked the quantity and condition of multimeters, insulating rods, wrenches, etc. one by one, focused on inspecting and registering the damaged cable information, and guided Zhao Qiang in filling out the Emergency Repair Material Recovery Form. All work was completed at 15:20.
location: Warehouse of the Power Engineering Company, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Consult the community health service center
description: Hearing that work ended early and remembering the strained lower back from the emergency repair, he rode his e-bike along Haisheng Road, Qiuhai Avenue, and Jinmao Middle Road to the community health service center. Arrived at 15:50, registered, and described the lower back soreness and stiffness to the doctor. The doctor advised continuing topical medication with hot compresses and taught a few lower back stretching exercises. After confirming the rehabilitation physiotherapy appointment on the 29th, he picked up the ointment and left.
location: Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home to change clothes and prepare to go to the appointment
description: After riding the e-bike for 5 minutes from the community health service center, he returned home to Banshan Garden. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing dinner ingredients. He briefly mentioned the evening team dinner, and his wife told him to drink less and watch his back. He took a quick warm shower and changed into a loose T-shirt and shorts. Sitting on the living room sofa, he confirmed the dinner location on his phone and sent a WeChat message to Chen Jianguo asking him to help keep the drinking in check.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team dinner: Jiamie Food Stall
description: Rode the electric bike to Jiami Food Stall for a group meal with the whole team, including Team Leader Zhang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang. The table had dishes such as salt-and-pepper duck jaws, fried noodles, grilled oysters, and stir-fried river snails. Team Leader Zhang treated everyone to ice-cold beer. Lu Mingqiang only drank half a glass of beer and then switched to tea. He talked with Chen Jianguo about the hard work of emergency repairs and his back injury, and vented his work pressure. Chen Jianguo also shared his own experience of straining his back. Team Leader Zhang came over for a toast to acknowledge everyone's performance over the past few days. Laughter filled the table, and his mood relaxed.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Late-night snack finished, rode the e-bike home.
description: After the dinner gathering, said goodbye to the workmates and reminded Zhao Qiang to be safe. Rode the electric bike home slowly against the night breeze, and sent a voice message to his wife on the way saying he was about to arrive home.
location: From Jiamie Food Stall, 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, to Banshan Garden Residential Community, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Return home to weigh in and wash up.
description: After arriving home, first stepped on the scale and it showed 71.7 kg, which I attributed to water retention. Then took a hot shower, applied the newly bought ointment to my lower back, and did some simple stretching movements as taught by the doctor.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family communication and bedtime preparation
description: After taking a shower, he chatted with his wife, who was folding clothes, sharing the dinner gathering situation, Chen Jianguo's condition, and the doctor's advice, and asked about how the children Xuanxuan and Hanhan had behaved today. He was relieved to learn that Xuanxuan had gotten all the math homework correct. After some small talk, the couple said goodnight to each other. Then he lay in bed watching local news and an electrician podcast, confirmed that the rehabilitation physiotherapy appointment on the 29th had been added to the calendar, put down his phone, moved his ankles, thought about returning to the normal work rhythm and picking up and dropping off the children tomorrow, then turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Home living room and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Early morning lower back pain flare-up and emergency treatment
description: In the early hours of the morning, Lu Mingqiang was woken by severe lower back pain, as if an electric drill were boring into his waist, and he could not turn over. His wife Wang Lijuan woke with a start, applied a hot towel to his waist, and massaged it with medicated oil. After he failed to sit up, Wang Lijuan used her phone to ask the team leader, Zhang Tou, for leave on Lu Mingqiang's behalf, and it was approved. She then applied a Yunnan Baiyao plaster to his back. Their elder son Lu Zixuan got up and dressed himself. Wang Lijuan cooked white porridge and scrambled eggs for breakfast, and Lu Mingqiang barely managed to eat half a bowl. Wang Lijuan had already notified her mother-in-law to pick up their younger son Lu Zihan after school. Lu Zixuan put on his schoolbag and left for school.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Took a taxi to the community clinic and saw a doctor
description: With his wife supporting him, Lu Mingqiang went downstairs with difficulty and took a taxi from the community gate to the Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center. After arriving, Dr. Zhang examined him, pressed the erector spinae muscles on both sides of his lumbar spine, ruled out a herniated disc, and diagnosed acute lumbar muscle strain with myofascial inflammation. The doctor prescribed Voltaren ointment and oral celecoxib, and told him not to bend over or carry heavy loads for the next month, to apply heat every day, and to put a thin pillow under his lower back when sleeping.
location: Jinmao Subdistrict Community Health Service Center, Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy medicine at the pharmacy and take a taxi home
description: After the consultation, Wang Lijuan went to Jianrentang Pharmacy across from the clinic and bought Voltaren, a hot water bottle, Huoluo oil, and Yunnan Baiyao plaster as backups. Lu Mingqiang waited at the entrance. The two then took a taxi back to their home in Banshan Huayuan. In the car, Lu Mingqiang leaned on his wife's shoulder and sighed that he could still drink yesterday, but today he could hardly sit up straight.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jianrentang Pharmacy on Guomao Road, and on the way back to Banshan Garden

name: Bed rest and online study of rehabilitation knowledge
description: After getting home, Wang Lijuan placed a hot water bottle under Lu Mingqiang's lower back and urged him to take his medicine. Lu Mingqiang lay flat on the living room sofa and scrolled through Bilibili on his phone. He searched for and bookmarked several lumbar strain rehabilitation videos, such as "Lumbar Strain Rehab Therapist Follow-Along" and "Core Muscle Group Home Training," and began planning his rehabilitation.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wife goes out to buy ingredients and prepare lunch
description: Wang Lijuan went to Xingang Farmers Market to buy ingredients such as crucian carp, golden pompano, baby bok choy, and tomatoes, then bought milk. After returning home, she cooked crucian carp and tofu soup, stir-fried baby bok choy, and steamed golden pompano. Lu Mingqiang had little appetite when he saw the low-oil, low-salt dishes, but Wang Lijuan advised him to give up late-night snacks and iced beer, saying health is the most important thing.
location: Xingang Farmers' Market, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the home dining room at Banshan Garden

name: During his lunch break, he talked with his master, Master Li, on the phone.
description: After lunch he took his medicine. Wang Lijuan closed the curtains and let Lu Mingqiang rest in bed. Although he was tired, he couldn't fall asleep, so at 1:30 pm he called his mentor, Master Li. Master Li shared his experience recovering from a lower back injury at age forty and encouraged him to keep doing the superman exercise and five-point support training and not get discouraged. Master Li's words greatly inspired Lu Mingqiang.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Solemnly wrote down health goals.
description: Inspired by his master, Lu Mingqiang opened the memo app on his phone and wrote clear recovery goals: reduce his weight to below 70 kg before New Year's Day 2026 (currently 71.8 kg), jog three times a week for 5 kilometers each time, and complete 30 minutes of core training (superman exercises + plank). He felt he had regained a sense of control over his life.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon rest, stretching, and rehabilitation video planning
description: Lu Mingqiang got up and watched TV news in the living room. After sitting too long and feeling back soreness, he lay down on the sofa and followed a video to do some simple stretching on the bed. Then he downloaded all the saved rehabilitation videos to his device, selected a '15-Day Recovery Plan for Lumbar Muscle Strain,' set a scheduled reminder for the next morning, and was determined to recover scientifically.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Two children returning home and family time
description: At 4:30 p.m., Grandmother picked up Lu Zihan from kindergarten and then left. After 5:00, Lu Zixuan walked home by himself. Seeing their father lying on the sofa, the two children sensibly did not make a fuss. Lu Zixuan did his homework on the tea table while Lu Zihan played with building blocks beside him. Wang Lijuan was in the kitchen preparing dinner; the aroma of fish filled the home, wrapping it in warmth.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: First attempt at rehabilitation training
description: While the children watched cartoons, Lu Mingqiang had Wang Lijuan spread out the straw mat. Gritting his teeth, he completed the first rehabilitation session: 10 five-point supports, each time slowly lifting his hips and holding for 5 seconds. Though stiff and trembling, he persisted for 2 sets. After training, sweat appeared on his forehead, but he felt reassured inside, marking the start of his rehabilitation plan.
location: Living room floor at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Nutritious dinner and determination to quit alcohol
description: At dinner, Wang Lijuan made steamed golden pompano, scrambled eggs with shrimp, stir-fried cabbage, and crucian carp tofu soup. Lu Mingqiang habitually wanted to drink ice beer, but Wang Lijuan handed him hot milk. He resolutely accepted, realizing he had to say goodbye to late-night snacks and beer and take responsibility for his recovery.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring eldest son in math homework
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang leaned back in his chair and helped Lu Zixuan with the tricky millimeter-centimeter conversion problems in his math homework, explaining with a ruler. His son suddenly understood and finished the homework smoothly. Lu Mingqiang felt a sense of satisfaction as a father.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Video call with parents to report on the rehabilitation plan
description: Lu Mingqiang video-called his parents who live in Meilan District, told them about his back injury and rehabilitation plan, relayed the doctor's and his master's advice, and promised to exercise scientifically and stop overdoing it. His mother told him not to catch a cold; Wang Lijuan also explained the recovery diet arrangements to reassure the old couple.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Accompanying the child for leisure and entertainment.
description: Lu Mingqiang played with the children in the living room. He and his son used LEGO to build a model of a utility pole, and he taught him techniques for making the base stable. His daughter drew a picture of 'Superman Daddy' and wrote 'Daddy, keep going!' on it. The heartwarming scene made him silently resolve to recover as soon as possible.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, weighing, and confirming tomorrow's plan
description: Lu Mingqiang urged the children to wash up and also cleaned himself up briefly. Wang Lijuan applied a hot compress to his lower back for 15 minutes and then applied Voltaren. Afterward, he nervously weighed himself; the scale showed 71.8 kg, 0.1 kg more than the previous day. Wang Lijuan reassured him that this was normal fluctuation. He drank hot milk and confirmed the next day's 6:30 alarm and rehabilitation plan.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime review and peaceful rest
description: After lying down with a thin pillow under his lower back, Lu Mingqiang felt a little more comfortable than last night. He watched the saved rehabilitation video again, set the alarm for the next morning, and thought to himself: tomorrow is the first day of the official rehabilitation plan. He fell asleep with hope.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off. Lu Mingqiang got up slowly, his lower back still a little stiff. His wife Wang Lijuan asked how he was with concern. He felt a little better than yesterday, got out of bed slowly, stood up, took a few deep breaths, and gradually loosened up.
location: Master bedroom, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning core stretching
description: After spreading a yoga mat on the master bedroom floor, Lu Mingqiang followed the rehabilitation video and, lying flat on his back, did the five-point support exercise for 2 sets of 10 reps. His lower back felt a slight engagement but no stabbing pain, which reassured him.
location: Master bedroom, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, breakfast, and confirming household division of tasks.
description: Lu Mingqiang washed up quietly, and his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: rice porridge, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. As the family ate, his wife said that her mother-in-law, Chen Xiuying, would be coming over from Meilan District in the morning. She had taken a half day off, and planned to first take the children to school, then buy groceries and make soup. Lu Mingqiang agreed and asked her to pick up the hot water bottle he had bought online. Their son Lu Zixuan packed his schoolbag himself, and their daughter Lu Zihan was still drinking porridge.
location: Dining room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: School drop-off and household chores.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan rode the e-bike, first taking their daughter Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, then taking their son Xuanxuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road, Meilan District. Lu Mingqiang stayed at home, put the clothes they had changed out of into the washing machine, and tidied up the medicine bottles and water cups on the coffee table, preparing for his mother's arrival.
location: Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Solitary rest and technical study
description: His lower back was still not suitable for prolonged sitting or standing, so Lu Mingqiang half-reclined on the living room sofa and watched rehabilitation video tutorials on his phone, focusing on rehabilitation contraindications after the acute phase. Afterwards, he took out the Electrical Installation Manual and carefully read the transformer commissioning chapter while taking notes. In the meantime, his colleague Chen Jianguo sent a message asking how he was. They talked on the phone, and Lu Mingqiang told him about his condition and declined his kind offer of rice wine, saying he needed to avoid alcohol as instructed by the doctor.
location: Living room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Greet mother Chen Xiuying.
description: Mother Chen Xiuying took Bus No. 40 to the entrance of the residential community. His wife Wang Lijuan went downstairs to greet her. Lu Mingqiang also slowly moved to the door to wait. After his mother came in and saw him holding his waist, she fretfully muttered a few words out of concern, but said nothing more. She put down the pastries and change of clothes she had brought, and began to check on the condition of the home.
location: Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Accompany mother and help with housework.
description: His mother put on an apron and prepared the chicken his wife had bought. Lu Mingqiang moved a small stool to the kitchen doorway, helped his mother peel garlic and trim green beans, and chatted with her. His mother mentioned that a neighbor in the countryside used mugwort fumigation on the waist to treat an old injury, and Lu Mingqiang said to follow the doctor's advice first. His wife, Wang Lijuan, settled the luggage his mother had brought into the guest room.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunchtime
description: Mother made coconut water chicken soup, white-cut pork belly, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and braised sea fish with fermented black beans. The family sat together for the meal. To control his weight and protect his back, Lu Mingqiang kept a light diet, only drinking soup, eating fish and vegetables, and half a bowl of rice. During the meal, they talked about Xuanxuan's studies and Hanhan's performance in kindergarten, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and recuperation.
description: Half an hour after the meal, Lu Mingqiang felt sleepy. He lay on his side on the bed in the second bedroom for a nap, placed a small cushion under his waist, and applied a hot water bottle to the painful area. The warm sensation slowly relaxed his stiff muscles. He set a 40-minute alarm and soon fell asleep.
location: Second bedroom, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The couple jointly discussed a recovery diet
description: After the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang felt better. He and his wife, Wang Lijuan, sat at the dining table, took out paper and pen, and refined the meal plan for the next two weeks based on the recipe suggestions on their phone and the doctor's instructions. The focus was high protein, low oil and salt, light and easy to digest. They made a shopping list including chicken breast, basa fish, tofu, and broccoli, and added a note to use less chili and soy sauce.
location: Dining room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Balcony rehabilitation exercise
description: Feeling some relief in his lower back, Lu Mingqiang walked to the balcony and, holding the railing, tried a standing back extension stretch. With his feet shoulder-width apart, he slowly leaned back and felt a slight stretch in his lower back. The range of motion was very small; he repeated it a few times. There was some soreness and achiness but no stabbing pain, and he felt he was recovering well.
location: Balcony, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Couple's shopping trip.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into a loose T-shirt and walked with his wife Wang Lijuan to Wenhua Vegetable Market. He walked very slowly, and his wife took his arm and matched his pace. Following the rehabilitation diet list, they did the shopping together. His wife chose the vegetables and bargained, while Lu Mingqiang carried the light tofu and milk. The fresh fish stall owner greeted them, and he smiled and replied that there was good news at home and they were treating themselves to an extra dish.
location: Wenhua Vegetable Market, Wenhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home and organizing the ingredients.
description: After returning from shopping, Lu Mingqiang sat down in the living room to rest and wiped off sweat. His wife, Wang Lijuan, sorted the purchased ingredients, cut the chicken breast and sea fish into small portions, packed them in plastic bags, and froze them. The refrigerator was stuffed full, which looked reassuring.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helping with housework and enjoying family time.
description: Lu Mingqiang did simple leg raises on the sofa to exercise his lower limbs. His mother Chen Xiuying was preparing dinner in the kitchen. He walked to the kitchen door with his hand on his waist to help his mother, handing her plates and peeling garlic. His mother started to simmer his favorite Hainanese chicken rice in a clay pot, and the aroma filled the air.
location: Living room and kitchen, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the child from school
description: His wife Wang Lijuan went out on an electric bicycle, first going to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road to pick up their daughter Lu Zihan, then heading to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road, Meilan District, to pick up their son Lu Zixuan. Lu Mingqiang stayed at home to rest and wait for the family to return.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province) and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province)

name: Three-generation family dinner
description: The family sat around the table, enjoying the Hainanese chicken rice made by his mother, with golden and smooth chicken skin. Lu Mingqiang made an exception and ate a small half bowl of chicken-oil rice and drank hot soup. Xuanxuan shared with Grandma that he had earned a little red flower in English class, while Hanhan clumsily scooped up egg custard. Lu Mingqiang used warm milk in place of wine and toasted his mother to express thanks.
location: Dining room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Math homework tutoring
description: After the meal, his wife and mother cleared the dishes. Lu Mingqiang took his son Lu Zixuan to the desk in the second bedroom to help him with his math homework, mainly mixed three-digit addition and subtraction and word problems. He noticed that Xuanxuan was not quite clear on subtraction with consecutive borrowing, so he demonstrated step by step on scratch paper until he fully understood.
location: Second bedroom, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time: building a fire station.
description: After tutoring Xuanxuan, his daughter Lu Zihan pulled Lu Mingqiang to play with building blocks with her. He sat on the floor mat, leaning against the sofa, helping Hanhan build a 'fire station' while telling stories of firefighters putting out fires. Hanhan listened with great interest, handing him blocks from time to time.
location: Living room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing, goodnight rituals with the children, and late-night couple talk
description: In the evening, his wife Wang Lijuan urged the two children to take a bath and brush their teeth. Lu Mingqiang also took a warm shower slowly, avoiding his waist, and felt refreshed. After putting on his pajamas, he went to the children's room, ruffled Xuanxuan's and Hanhan's hair, and said goodnight. Then he returned to the master bedroom. His wife filled a hot water bottle for him to apply to his waist, and the two chatted about their recovery that day, next week's schedules, and the arrangement for his mother to stay for a few days. He felt at ease.
location: Master bedroom and children's room, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Free time and falling asleep peacefully.
description: After applying the hot compress to his waist, Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard, spent some time reading work group messages and technical repair posts on his phone, and recalled the quitting smoking mentioned when he and his wife were planning the diet, feeling even more determined. Around 10 p.m., he put down his phone, turned off the light, lay down, adjusted his sleeping position, propped his waist on a soft pillow, and, breathing in the scent his mother had brought, gradually drifted into a warm and peaceful sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Room 603, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning rehabilitation and family breakfast preparation
description: Woke up at 6:50 in the morning with no discomfort in his lower back. He first did morning stretches on the bedroom floor, moving his neck, shoulders, back, and hip joints, and then performed two sets of eight reps of five-point support rehabilitation exercises. After a quick shower, he went to the storage room to check the three kites. The big butterfly kite's line was knotted, so he used a lighter to singe the line end and retied it, and straightened the reel. The frames of the other small kites were intact. After his wife Wang Lijuan got up, she packed a canvas bag with homemade lemonade, mineral water, and snacks prepared by his mother Chen Xiuying, including triangular pastries and coconut-shred buns. Chen Xiuying had been busy in the kitchen since even earlier, steaming cakes and cooking white congee. The whole family then sat around the dining table to enjoy a hearty breakfast of Laoba tea snacks, white congee, fried eggs, and pickled mustard greens, while the two children excitedly discussed flying kites.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden, Building 2, Unit 2, Room 502, master bedroom, storage room, dining room, and living room.

name: Family kite-flying trip to Wanlv Garden
description: At 8:30, the whole family drove to Evergreen Park. Lu Mingqiang drove, while his wife and mother sat in the back with the two children. The road was smooth and they arrived in about 12 minutes. On the central lawn, Lu Mingqiang squatted and taught his elder son Lu Zixuan to launch a large butterfly kite in the sea breeze. After Xuanxuan successfully got it aloft, he was extremely excited. His younger son, Lu Zihan, dragged a small airplane kite and chased after seabirds, and the father and sons competed over whose kite flew higher. Wang Lijuan took photos and videos nearby, while the mother sat on a picnic mat and watched with a smile. When Lu Mingqiang's lower back began to feel slightly sore, he sat down on the mat to rest, drinking water and watching the children run. At 10:30 the wind weakened, so he called the children over to reel in the kites, gathered all the trash, bagged it, and threw it into the trash can. At around 11:00 they loaded the gear into the car. On the way back, the children fell asleep in the car, and they arrived home at 11:14.
location: Central Lawn, Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Warm lunch.
description: After arriving home, his mother immediately went into the kitchen to reheat the dishes, and his wife helped tidy up the room. Lu Mingqiang waited hungrily at the dining table. His mother brought out clay-pot braised Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and pork rib and lotus root soup. He filled a large bowl of rice and ate contentedly with the chicken. The children woke up, washed their hands, and joined the table. The family ate and chatted lively together. His mother also mentioned that she had already taken Hanhan to play in the community garden in the morning and cleaned the room.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and hot compress on the waist.
description: After the meal, his wife coaxed Hanhan to take a nap, while his mother helped Xuanxuan with summer homework in the living room. Lu Mingqiang returned to the master bedroom, filled a hot water bottle, and applied it to his lower back. The heat eased the soreness from the morning, and he soon fell asleep lying down.
location: Master bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon family time and a walk around the neighborhood
description: He napped until 2 p.m. and woke up refreshed with no discomfort in his lower back. In the living room he saw his mother helping Xuanxuan with homework, while Hanhan was playing with building blocks by herself. Lu Mingqiang squatted down to build a castle with Hanhan and played for over an hour. At 3 p.m., he took his mother and the two children downstairs for a walk in the community garden. They strolled slowly along the shaded path, Hanhan ran and jumped, Xuanxuan followed behind, and his mother chatted about family matters, mentioning the current situation of Aunt Wang's grandson back home and his older brother in Shenzhen.
location: Garden of Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and living room of Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2

name: Decided to participate in the community table tennis tournament.
description: On the way back from a walk, he ran into Uncle Wang, a neighbor, at the entrance to the stairwell. Uncle Wang warmly asked how his recovery was going and suggested he take part as a substitute in next Saturday's community table tennis match, saying table tennis was good for exercising the waist and abdomen and the intensity could be controlled. Lu Mingqiang was tempted. After asking about the time, place, and rules, he agreed on the spot. Back home, he told his wife and mother about his decision to compete. Juanzi and his mother both supported him, and Xuanxuan excitedly shouted that he wanted to go cheer. Lu Mingqiang sat down with his family to discuss the details of the match, settled the matter, and felt that life had gained a new sense of purpose.
location: Corridor of Unit 2, Building 2, Half Mountain Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the living room of Room 502.

name: Prepare and enjoy a light dinner
description: His wife and mother started preparing dinner. Lu Mingqiang helped take fish out of the fridge to thaw and peeled garlic, and suggested a lighter dinner with winter melon soup. His wife prepared boiled prawns, his mother stir-fried water spinach, and he made a cucumber salad. On the dinner table were boiled prawns, stir-fried water spinach, winter melon and meatball soup, and cucumber salad. Lu Mingqiang ate mostly dishes and meat, with little rice, and felt comfortable in his stomach. The family talked about next week's plans and the arrangement to visit grandma.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Household cleaning and a hot bath.
description: He took the initiative to clear the dishes and wash them, and wiped the stove clean. Then he went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, deliberately using hot water to rinse his lower back for heat therapy, washing away the day's fatigue and sweat stains, and relaxing his whole body.
location: Kitchen and bathroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening parent-child and rehabilitation training
description: Refreshed and clear-headed, he came to the living room and watched the animated series 'Octonauts' with the two children. He held Hanhan on his lap and chatted about the fun of kite flying, while Xuanxuan corrected him, saying that they were going to Grandma's house on Sunday. At eight o'clock, he told the children to get ready for washing up. Lu Mingqiang did a set of stretches and two sets of five-point support exercises on the living room floor to strengthen his core. Then he went to Hanhan's room first to read a picture book and coax him to sleep, then went to Xuanxuan's room to talk about homework and the next day's plans, turning off the light and saying goodnight to him.
location: Living room and children's room, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal time before bed and preparation for sleep
description: After the children fell asleep, he and his wife leaned against the headboard looking at their own phones. Lu Mingqiang browsed posts on a technical forum about inverter fault troubleshooting, sent a few of today's photos to the family group, added Uncle Wang on WeChat to get the details of next Saturday's ping-pong match and saved them in his memo, and discussed with his wife going to his mother's house tomorrow and shopping for clothes at the supermarket. Before ten o'clock, he went to the bathroom to wash up, weighed himself at 71.8 kg, one step closer to his goal. Back in bed, he opened his memo and noted tomorrow's plan: go to Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan for a meal and check the match information again, then turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core stretching and family breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang got up quietly so as not to wake the family. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did about twenty minutes of core stretching and five-point support training, feeling that his lower back had recovered well. After stretching, his son Lu Zixuan passed by, laughing and calling him "Daddy looks like a big shrimp," which drew laughter from his wife Wang Lijuan and his mother Chen Xiuying. Then he washed up and went to the kitchen to help his mother set out the bowls and chopsticks. Early that morning, his mother had bought fresh rice noodles and rice roll sheets from the Jinmao Middle Road vegetable market and made authentic Hainan rice noodles and steamed rice rolls. The whole family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Mingqiang praised his mother's cooking and confirmed with his wife the plan to repair the vegetable rack in the morning. His daughter Lu Zihan picked out peanuts for him, saying they would help his back. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Repairing the balcony vegetable rack and buying family accident insurance.
description: After breakfast, his wife cleared the table and his mother took the two children to watch cartoons. Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony to inspect the typhoon-damaged vegetable rack and found three support poles broken and the drip irrigation tube loose. He found wire, pliers, and zip ties, squatted down to re-bind and reinforce the broken joints, adjusted the drip irrigation line, and added a drainage channel at the bottom. After nearly an hour of work, the vegetable rack was stable again and the soil was leveled. While working, he discussed buying insurance with his wife, and they both agreed. He opened the Ping An app on his phone, browsed the "Family Protection" accident insurance package, compared the coverage amounts and terms, confirmed the annual fee of 800 yuan, paid via WeChat Pay, and sent a screenshot of the e-policy to the family group.
location: Balcony of Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Father and son designed a technology model plan
description: After repairing the vegetable trellis, Lu Zixuan excitedly brought over a flyer for the community summer class science and technology model competition. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him to think about the toy car model he wanted to build. Finding a discarded electric toothbrush at home, he had an idea and suggested making an eco-friendly powered car using the toothbrush motor and a waste plastic bottle. The father and son sketched on the whiteboard in the study. As he drew, Mingqiang briefly explained the simple principles of eccentric wheels and gear transmission. Xuanxuan listened intently and kept asking for details. Finally, the two high-fived and agreed to officially sign up for the competition.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Free time and household chores.
description: After the design was completed, Lu Mingqiang took Xuanxuan to tidy up the study, cleaned the motor and plastic bottle, and put them away. His mother was hanging clothes on the balcony, and his wife was helping Hanhan learn characters in the living room. Mingqiang played with Hanhan with building blocks for a while, then went to the kitchen to help his mother pick vegetables and prepare lunch. During this time, he talked with his mother about taking Xuanxuan to math tutoring the next week; she expressed support and said she could help if the tuition was not enough.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Lunch was cooked by his mother: steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried choy sum, and tomato egg drop soup, light and nutritious. Lu Mingqiang made a point of eating more vegetables. After the meal, he voluntarily did the dishes so his mother and wife could rest. After cleaning up the kitchen, he went back to the bedroom, applied a hot water bottle to his lower back for 20 minutes, then took a nap for about 40 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and head out to have Laoba tea with Uncle Wang
description: Waking from his nap, Lu Mingqiang felt refreshed. He changed into clean clothes, found his old table tennis paddle, took a photo and sent it to his neighbor Uncle Wang, asking to meet in the afternoon. He then took his water cup, phone, and wallet, and walked about five minutes to the Datie Laoba Tea House on Binyi Road. Around 2 p.m., he arrived, and Uncle Wang was already waiting in his usual spot. Mingqiang ordered black tea with milk, chicken feet, and steamed pork ribs, using tea in place of wine to thank Uncle Wang for recommending him for the neighborhood staff table tennis competition.
