Uncle Wang shared anecdotes from his youth, analyzed the characteristics of several opponents, and even pulled up match videos on his phone to explain serving, receiving, and placement tactics. Mingqiang listened with great interest and felt he benefited a lot.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went to the community cultural and sports center to sign up for the table tennis tournament
description: After saying goodbye to Uncle Wang, Lu Mingqiang walked about ten minutes to the Jinmao Street Community Cultural and Sports Center. He found the table tennis tournament poster on the bulletin board, confirmed the time and rules, picked up and carefully filled out a registration form at the service desk. After he submitted it, the staff reminded him that the group assignments would be sent by text message before the competition.
location: Jinmao Street Community Cultural and Sports Center, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Walk home and take the children to the park to play.
description: After registration ended, Lu Mingqiang walked home from the cultural and sports center, arriving in about ten minutes. He called his wife and asked her to bring the children to the community gate. After the four met up, they walked about ten minutes to the nearby Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park. The park had a rubber running track and a children's play area. His daughter Hanhan ran straight to the slide, while Mingqiang played small soccer on the grass with his son Xuanxuan. He also ran around a bit and felt no obvious discomfort in his waist. After playing for half an hour, the family of four walked home, arriving at about 17:30.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule-of-Law Theme Park, near the intersection of Longkun North Road and Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: A warm dinner time
description: Back home, his mother had already prepared dinner, including pan-fried mackerel, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and winter melon and clam soup. The family sat around the table; Mingqiang picked fish for his mother to thank her for her hard work. Xuanxuan excitedly told his grandmother about the toy car he had designed today, and Hanhan imitated the dance moves of the children in the park, making everyone laugh.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Father-son table tennis practice.
description: After dinner, his wife and mother cleaned up the kitchen and looked after Hanhan. Lu Mingqiang took out a racket and an old ball, and practiced the grip and ball-juggling moves Uncle Wang had taught him in the open area of the living room. His son Xuanxuan came over curiously, and Mingqiang taught him to play along. The father and son competed over who could juggle the ball more times. Although they were not yet skilled, laughter filled the room as they spent a joyful time exercising.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Homework tutoring and parent-child block building.
description: After practicing table tennis for half an hour, Lu Mingqiang took Xuanxuan to the study to help with his summer math homework, which was about the perimeter of rectangles and squares. Using the floor tiles at home, he drew shapes on the floor to explain, and Xuanxuan quickly understood and got the problems right. Outside the study, his wife was playing with blocks on the floor with their daughter Hanhan, building a 'Water Park' castle.
location: Study and living room, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening personal care, work review, and chatting with his wife before falling asleep.
description: After urging the children to wash up, Lu Mingqiang took a warm shower to wash off the day's sweat. Then he stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 71.9 kg; his weight was well maintained. Leaning against the headboard, he took out his maintenance notebook and reviewed the frequency converter fault cases from a few days ago, repeating the troubleshooting process against the symptoms and diagnostic logic. After his wife Wang Lijuan finished tidying up, she returned to the bedroom. They talked about the day's expenses, and Mingqiang reported the 800 yuan spent on insurance. His wife said her mother would return to Meilan District next week and told him to spend more time with the elderly woman. They also talked about Xuanxuan taking part in the science and technology model competition and agreed that it was good for their child to have an interest. At 22:00, Mingqiang set the alarm, said goodnight to his wife, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning rehabilitation and family breakfast
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up to the alarm clock, first moved his ankles and wrists by the bed, then stood up to do core stretches and five-point support training, and his waist felt better. After training, his wife Wang Lijuan prepared Hainan rice noodle breakfast. The family sat together to eat, and Lu Mingqiang told the children to be obedient. After the meal, Wang Lijuan helped him fasten the newly bought elastic lumbar support belt, adjusted the tightness, and urged him to be steadier when returning to work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting
description: Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike to take the two children to school. He first took Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then took Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, and told them to listen carefully in class. After dropping off the children, he continued riding along Haisheng Road to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, arriving about 15 minutes later. He parked the bike and entered the workshop.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, he went first to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) and then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), finally arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park (No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District).

name: Light work in the morning
description: After Lu Mingqiang changed into his work clothes, Team Leader Zhang assigned him to work with Chen Jianguo as a group responsible for cleaning and inspecting the distribution cabinets in Workshop No. 3, avoiding climbing and lifting heavy objects. He and Chen Jianguo cooperated in opening the cabinet doors, vacuuming, and checking the wiring terminals. During the process his waist occasionally felt sore, but the task was completed smoothly. Zhao Qiang also helped carry over the cleaning tools.
location: Workshop at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Mid-work break
description: During a work break, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were drinking water in the rest area. Zhao Qiang offered a cigarette, but Lu Mingqiang politely declined, saying his wife didn't allow it. The three chatted about next Saturday's community table tennis match. Zhao Qiang reminded Lu Mingqiang that Old Zhang from the neighboring unit had also signed up and was pretty good, so he should be careful.
location: Workshop rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After getting off work at noon, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road and ordered a 15 yuan spicy soup rice with a fried egg. The spicy soup dispelled the cold and made him sweat, and his waist felt looser. After eating, he returned to the team rest room in the industrial park, spread an old sheet on the folding bed, lay on his side, applied a hot towel to his lower back, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province) and the team rest room of the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park.

He finally found two old electric toothbrushes and an unused toy four-wheel-drive chassis, and readily paid 5 yuan. Zixuan hugged his “loot” excitedly and refused to let go.

His wife Wang Lijuan pushed the door open, saw that he was not reading but fiddling with his liquor bottle notes, and her face fell. She said, “There are only a few days left before the intensive training. It’s not too late to play with these bottles after the exam. Isn’t doing it now a waste of time?” These words were like a bucket of cold water poured over his head. Lu Mingqiang felt a surge of grievance and irritation, but looking at his wife’s figure toiling over household chores, he forcibly swallowed the words he wanted to argue. Feeling suffocated at home, he said to his wife, “I’m going out for a walk,” then went downstairs alone and strolled aimlessly along the street. Before he knew it, he arrived at a Cantonese teahouse on Bo’ai South Road that he often visited. Pushing the door open, he was surprised to see his father Lu Jianguo sitting alone in a corner, staring blankly at a cup of hot tea.
description: When he got home, his mother was busy in the kitchen. She took out the dumpling wrappers and meat filling bought from the fridge yesterday and prepared to make dumplings. After power was restored, Wang Jianguo thanked him repeatedly.

Leaning against the headboard, he used the notes app on his phone to record the day's expenses: scallions and ginger 3.5 yuan, water 2 yuan, fish 15 yuan, vegetables 12 yuan in total. He set the work alarm for 6:30 the next morning. Feeling sore in his lower back, he took out a heating pad and applied it.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Going to bed
description: After his wife finished her tasks and lay down, Lu Mingqiang remarked, “What a fulfilling day.” He fell asleep quickly after the lights were turned off, replaying in his mind the moments of floating in the water and hitting the ball during the day.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally a few minutes before the alarm went off. Lying on the straw mat, he did his morning stretches according to the rehabilitation plan. He first moved his ankles and wrists, then slowly did 10 minutes of cat stretches and spinal twists, feeling a slight stretch in his lower back. This is a daily must-do to take care of his body.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After washing up, his wife Wang Lijuan had already put breakfast on the table. This morning's breakfast was Hainan rice noodles, well seasoned, with fragrant peanuts and pickled vegetables. While serving him soup, Wang Lijuan reminded him about buying groceries in the afternoon: she needed water spinach, scallions, and soft tofu. Lu Mingqiang responded while thinking about the day's work.
location: Living room/kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten.
description: Lu Mingqiang got on the electric bicycle, and his youngest son Lu Zihan sat on the back seat, hugging his waist with his little head leaning against his back. When they arrived at the gate of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, he handed the child to the teacher, told Hanhan to eat well at lunch and not be picky, and only left reassured after watching the child skip into the kindergarten.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Starting from the kindergarten, Lu Mingqiang rode west along Binhai Avenue. The morning sea breeze carried a chill. More than ten minutes later, he arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, parked the e-bike in the shed downstairs, brushed the dust off his work clothes, and prepared to start the day's work.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning meeting and receiving tasks
description: Put on his work uniform and fastened the back brace, Lu Mingqiang attended the Engineering Department morning meeting. Squad Leader Zhang called roll and then assigned tasks: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang were to form a team and go to Jinlianyuan Community on Haixiu Middle Road to carry out routine inspection and insulation testing on the power distribution rooms of two buildings in Phase 3, emphasizing that they must bring the complete standard self-inspection checklist and do the job well. Lu Mingqiang took the task sheet, checked with his two colleagues, and each inspected their tool kits to make sure the multimeter, megohmmeter, voltage tester, and other tools were all there.
location: Engineering Department Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Inspection of the power distribution room of Building 3-1#, Jinlianyuan Community
description: The three of them drove a pickup truck to Jinlianyuan Community. The power distribution room was hot and stuffy. Lu Mingqiang skillfully opened the distribution cabinet panel, checked the tightness of the busbar screws, and used a megohmmeter to test the insulation resistance of the incoming cable. Around 9:30, he felt his lower back ache, so he put down the tools and did a few stretching exercises against the wall. Chen Jianguo teased him about his health-maintenance routine being solid, and Lu Mingqiang responded that the body is the capital of revolution.
location: Power distribution room, Building 3-1#, Jinlian Yuan Residential Community, Haixiu Middle Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Work break and confirming the ball game appointment.
description: Went to a shady spot downstairs to drink water and rest. Lu Mingqiang took out his phone and sent a WeChat message to Wang Hao, a playing partner he had just added last night, to confirm the practice arrangement. They agreed to meet at the community activity room on Thursday (July 31) at 7 p.m. to get familiar with each other's shots. Wang Hao quickly replied and agreed. This social progress gave Lu Mingqiang something new to look forward to.
location: Shaded area at the foot of Building 3-1#, Jinlianyuan Residential Community, Haixiu Middle Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Testing of the power distribution room, Building 5-2#, Jinlianyuan Residential Area.
description: Moving to another building, Lu Mingqiang was responsible for inspecting the low-voltage capacitor compensation cabinet and circuit breakers. He carefully used a flashlight to check the equipment nameplates, focusing on verifying the transformation ratio of the current transformers—these are essential practical applications in the technician exam. While working, he pondered and decided to strengthen his theoretical study after going back.
location: Power distribution room, Building 5-2#, Jinlianyuan Residential Community, Haixiu Middle Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch time
description: Driving back to near the company, the three men walked into their usual Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant. It was hot, so each ordered a bowl of spicy soup rice; the pickled cabbage and pepper broth whetted their appetites. While eating, Lu Mingqiang discussed with Chen Jianguo the several old circuit labeling problems they had just found, and agreed to mark them specially in the afternoon records and report them to Team Leader Zhang later.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: Back in the engineering department lounge, the air conditioning was cool. Lu Mingqiang unfolded his own folding bed, placed the lumbar support behind his lower back, and slept on his stomach for 40 minutes. The adequate midday rest recharged him for the afternoon's work.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work preparation and departure
description: After the alarm went off, I got up, washed my face, tidied my work clothes, and refastened the lumbar support. Lu Mingqiang double-checked the morning inspection record sheet to confirm nothing was missed, then with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang took the tools needed for the afternoon and set off again for Jinlianyuan Residential Area.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon power distribution room inspection and hazard elimination
description: In the afternoon, continued inspections in the electrical distribution rooms of Buildings 7-1# and 8-2# in Jinlianyuan Residential Complex. While checking the grounding wire on a switchgear cabinet, Lu Mingqiang discovered a hazard: a poorly crimped connection and a loose screw. He immediately called Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to assist, reworked the grounding bolt, and completely eliminated the hazard. The job was done well, giving him a strong sense of accomplishment. By around 17:00, inspections of all buildings were completed. He directed Zhao Qiang to clean up the site, take photos of key equipment, and then put tools back one by one and wipe them clean.
location: Electrical distribution rooms of Buildings 7-1# and 8-2#, Jinlianyuan Community, Haixiu Middle Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting off work and buying groceries.
description: He rode his e-bike out of Jinlian Garden and returned to the familiar vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden residential area. Following his wife Wang Lijuan's instructions, he picked a bunch of fresh water spinach and also bought two scallions and a block of firm tofu. The stall owner knew him and gave him a few extra sprigs of cilantro.
location: Vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child interaction and household chores.
description: As soon as he entered the door, his younger son Hanhan rushed up, hugged his leg, and called out dad. Lu Mingqiang smiled, handed the groceries to his wife, bent down, picked up Hanhan, and spun him around. His older son Xuanxuan, doing homework in the living room, looked up and greeted him. He went to the kitchen to put down the groceries, told his wife about eliminating the hidden danger in the electrical distribution room that day, then returned to the living room, sat on the floor mat, and helped Hanhan build a high-voltage tower with blocks. Hanhan was very interested in the I-shaped structure. Lu Mingqiang helped him find blocks and explained why this shape makes the tower more stable. The child listened with shining eyes.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: For dinner, Wang Lijuan made stir-fried water spinach, scallion tofu soup, scrambled eggs with Chinese sausage, and a bit of leftover meat dish from yesterday. The family sat around the table. As they ate, Lu Mingqiang asked the children about their classes and fun moments that day. Hanhan said the teacher praised him for building blocks well, while Xuanxuan complained that the math application problems were too hard. After hearing this, Lu Mingqiang knew what to do and planned to give them proper tutoring after dinner.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Help the eldest son with homework.
description: After cleaning up after dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat beside Lu Zixuan to help him with his summer homework. Faced with a word problem about buying tickets and making change, Lu Zixuan couldn't figure it out. Lu Mingqiang held back his temper and did not give the answer directly. Instead, he guided him using the example of buying a soda at a small shop. He explained little by little in a simple way, and Lu Zixuan finally understood and corrected the mistake.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Learn complex circuit fault diagnosis
description: After tutoring the homework, Lu Mingqiang felt a bit tired but still had learning on his mind. He went into the study, turned on the desktop computer, plugged in the USB drive, and played the teaching video 'Analysis of Complex Circuit Fault Diagnosis'. He focused on two mock-exam cases where he had lost points: differential protection and ground fault troubleshooting. He paused the video as he watched, compared it with the fault tree sketch in his notebook, and added key decision nodes and test points in red pen. During this time, he also used his phone to download a popular electrician learning app and browsed the senior technician course outline, finding the question bank and simulated operation module very practical.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Confirm the practice arrangement and wash up
description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang picked up his phone and confirmed again the arrangement with Wang Hao: starting from this Thursday (July 31), they would practice table tennis regularly every other Thursday from 7:00 to 8:00 p.m. in the table tennis room of the community activity room. He replied to Wang Hao, "Okay, it's settled. See you Thursday!" Then he went to the bathroom for a quick shower to relax his body.
location: Study and bathroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and planning.
description: Lying on the bamboo mat, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the differential protection principle he had learned that day in his mind like a movie, and thought about what work the team might be assigned tomorrow. After a few casual words with his wife, he turned off the desk lamp and set the alarm on his phone for 6:30 the next morning.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Going to bed
description: The chirping of cicadas on a summer night in Haikou came through the screen window. After the day, with hidden dangers eliminated at work, a harmonious family, productive learning, and new progress in social connections, Lu Mingqiang felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning wake-up and rehabilitation stretching
description: After getting up in the master bedroom, Lu Mingqiang drank warm water, spread out a yoga mat, and did lower back rehabilitation stretches, including cat-cow, glute bridge, and child's pose. He felt his lower back loosen up. Then he stepped on the scale and weighed 71.7kg.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and dropping the child off at kindergarten
description: Lu Mingqiang, his wife Wang Lijuan, and their youngest son Lu Zihan ate breakfast at home. Wang Lijuan made Hainan noodles. During the meal, they talked about the community meeting on Tuesday. After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to take Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten in Haikou, exchanged a few words with the teacher, and then left.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area Restaurant, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District)

name: Commute to company
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike from the kindergarten along Guomao Road, Binhai Avenue, and Haixiu Road to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park on Haisheng Road, arriving in about 15 minutes. After arriving at the company, he changed into work clothes and insulated shoes, charged the e-bike, and checked the crew's work assignment sheet.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning field work
description: After attending the team morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang went with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Jinling Huayuan to replace the distribution box. He was responsible for technical guidance and safety supervision to avoid excessive strain on his waist. After finishing, an additional inspection task at Dianli Xincun was added. They checked the main switches and lines of three residential buildings and recorded 2 locations of aging wires and 1 hidden hazard of corroded grounding wire. They returned to the company at 11:45.
location: Jinling Garden, Haixiu Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Electric Power New Village, No. 1 Qiumai Avenue

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang went to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant next to the company and ordered spicy beef brisket soup rice and fried eggs. After the meal, he bought three bottles of iced mineral water for them at Convenience Life Convenience Store, then returned to the company break room and took a 30-minute nap leaning back in a folding chair.
location: Ground Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, No. 87 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and Bianli Life Convenience Store (80 meters southwest of the intersection of Haixiu Expressway and the entrance).

name: Indoor work in the afternoon
description: In the team workshop, Lu Mingqiang turned the Dianli Xincun inspection records into electronic work orders and submitted them. Then he wiped down tools such as the multimeter and clamp meter and checked their insulation. At 17:00, he chatted with Chen Jianguo and agreed to play squash the evening after tomorrow. At 17:30, he began packing his personal toolbox, getting ready to leave work.
location: Team workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: On the way home from work and grocery shopping
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike home after work. Passing by Liu's vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden, he bought soft tofu, loofah, and green peppers for 8.5 yuan, then hummed a song as he entered the residential complex.
location: Liu Ji vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: After Lu Mingqiang came home, his wife Wang Lijuan used the groceries he had bought to make luffa egg soup, minced pork tofu, and garlic water spinach. The family of four sat around the table and shared what they had seen and heard during the day: Lu Mingqiang said he had done one additional community inspection; Wang Lijuan described helping the elderly in the community measure blood pressure; the younger son Lu Zihan played with magnetic tiles; and the older son Lu Zixuan was absent-minded, thinking about his calligraphy copybook.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tutored the eldest son in Chinese dictation.
description: After a 10-minute rest following dinner, Lu Mingqiang helped Lu Zixuan write 'Gazing at the Waterfall on Mount Lu' and new characters from memory. He found that the character for 'waterfall' was written incorrectly several times, so he patiently demonstrated the stroke order and had him form words with it. After 40 minutes, all the corrections were done, and father and son high-fived to encourage each other.
location: Living room desk, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Exam prep for Senior Electrician Technician
description: Lu Mingqiang entered the study in the second bedroom, opened the electrician learning app, and completed complex circuit fault tree analysis exercises, simulating question types such as open circuits and short circuits. Then, using the senior technician exam syllabus as a benchmark, he circled two weak areas in red: inverter principles and maintenance, and PLC programming basics. He also wrote a note about focusing on them in August and asking an old colleague for advice.
location: Study room in the second bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang lay on the bed in the master bedroom, quickly reviewed the fault tree analysis method and the difficult points in the exam syllabus he had studied that day, and felt reassured. He set the alarm for 22:30 the next day, said goodnight to Wang Lijuan, who was scrolling on her phone beside him, and fell asleep around 22:00.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: After the alarm rang, he got up quickly and did 10 minutes of core and lower back stretches on the bedroom floor according to the rehabilitation guidance, feeling no soreness in his lower back. Then he went to the living room scale and weighed himself; it showed 71.8 kg, and he was satisfied with his weight control.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After a quick wash, I went to the table; my wife Wang Lijuan had prepared porridge and steamed buns. While eating breakfast, I watched my young son Lu Zihan drink porridge with a spoon and praised him. Feeling the warmth of family, I was full of energy for the day's work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten.
description: Rode an electric bike with my young son Lu Zihan along Jinmao Middle Road to Guomao Third Cross Road, arriving at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten in about 10 minutes. After watching him run into the kindergarten gate, I left.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Riding the electric bike from the kindergarten along Jinlong Road and Haixiu Middle Road toward Xiuying District, arriving at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park in about 15 minutes. Parked the bike in the shed, picked up the tool bag, and walked to the team activity room.
location: From Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Company morning meeting and preparation of tools.
description: After clocking in, he attended the morning meeting led by Squad Leader Zhang and learned that the day's task was to lead a team to Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket on Yehai Avenue in Longhua District for a circuit inspection. After the meeting, he checked the tool bag in the pickup truck, confirmed that the multimeter, clamp meter, flashlight, insulating gloves, and other items were all there, and asked Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to change into insulating shoes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (team activity room and toolbox storage area)

name: Drove to the supermarket to inspect the site.
description: Driving the company pickup truck, he took the Haixiu Expressway and then turned onto Yehai Avenue, arriving at Guoxing Hongfa Life Supermarket (Cangxi Farmers Market Branch) in about 20 minutes. After parking, he greeted the waiting Store Manager Wang and led his apprentice into the supermarket's office area.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Led an apprentice to survey the supermarket circuit upgrade.
description: After briefly discussing the expansion needs with Manager Wang, he led Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun into the supermarket. Starting from the main distribution room, he taught them how to read the system diagrams and identify the main switch capacity, then inspected the cold storage, fresh food area, grain and oil area, store lighting, and other areas along the planned route. At each critical distribution box, he guided them to check cable colors and grounding, used a clamp meter to measure single-phase circuit currents, and shared Master Li's teaching: "Safety first; see with your eyes, act with your hands, and focus with your mind." Xiao Zhao took careful notes.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and work break.
description: Found a Wenchang chicken rice restaurant near the supermarket and had a meal. He ordered white cut chicken rice and winter melon and clam soup; Zhao Qiang ordered roast duck rice, and Liu Xiaojun ordered pig trotter rice. While waiting for the food, they reviewed the morning survey, drew a sketch, and pointed out the overloaded circuits and key locations for recommended capacity expansion.
location: Wenchang Chicken Restaurant near Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Return to the company for lunch break
description: After lunch, drove back to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, filed the survey records into a folder, lay down on the simple camp bed in the team rest room, set an alarm for a 25-minute lunch break nap, and refreshed himself.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (team rest room)

name: Organizing the survey report and preparing to leave work
description: At his workstation, he turned on the computer and, referring to his field notes and photos, wrote a Word document detailing the capacity and aging condition of existing equipment such as distribution cabinets, air conditioners, and cold storage units. He drew a simple zoning diagram of the renovation circuits on paper and marked the capacity increase proposal in red. In the afternoon, he checked tomorrow's tool list and cleaned his insulating shoes and gloves, making sure everything was ready.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (workstation)

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping
description: Rode the e-bike back to Banshan Garden along Haisheng Road, Haixiu Middle Road, and Jinmao Middle Road. At the “Liu Ji Vegetable Stall” at the entrance of the residential community, he picked a bunch of water spinach and two tomatoes as his wife had requested, and paid 7.5 yuan.
location: Liu Ji vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Arrive home, spend time with family, and have dinner.
description: After returning home, he played with building blocks with his two sons and built a shopping mall model, sharing what he had seen and heard at the cold storage during the day. At dinner, his wife served stir-fried water spinach, tomato and egg soup, and braised fish. The family of four chatted while eating, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping eldest son Lu Zixuan with his homework
description: After the meal, I sat with my eldest son Lu Zixuan at the desk and helped him with length word problems in his math homework. I guided him to draw line-segment diagrams to understand the logic of "from short to long". I watched him finish and checked that everything was correct. The youngest son was quietly playing with a puzzle nearby.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (children's study desk)

name: Monthly family financial organization.
description: The children watched cartoons while my wife Wang Lijuan and I checked the July income and expenditure details at the dining table. We found that fuel costs exceeded the budget by nearly 200 yuan, so we decided to ride the electric bike more often from August to save gas. We made a plan to eat out less and cook at home in August, saving money to sign the children up for a summer swimming class. My wife recorded the accounts in the bookkeeping app.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (dining table)

name: Preparing for the exam and making an August plan
description: After a short rest, he went into the study and first watched a practical video on “Frequency Converter Control Principles,” focusing on PID closed-loop adjustment and the action logic of common fault protection, sketching wiring diagrams while watching. Then he turned on the computer, referred to the exam syllabus, and used spreadsheet software to create a detailed review plan for the first two weeks of August targeting the two weak areas of frequency converter control and PLC programming. He printed it out and posted it on the wall in front of his desk.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Washing up, bedtime preparation, and falling asleep
description: After a hot shower, he changed into pajamas, lay in bed chatting with his wife about tomorrow's work schedule, and reminded her that on Thursday evening he needed to prepare a towel and water bottle for playing squash with Lin Feng. Then they said goodnight, turned off the lights, and slept soundly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bedroom)

name: Getting up and lower back injury recovery summary
description: At 6 a.m., you wake up naturally. When you bend over to tie your shoelaces, you are pleasantly surprised to find that your lower back is basically pain-free. Leaning against the headboard, you open the notes app on your phone and record the key points for recovering from the two-week back injury: keep stretching daily, maintain correct sitting posture, give up late-night snacks, and rinse your lower back with hot water while showering. Then you get out of bed and do 5 minutes of lower back stretches.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: You washed up quietly, careful not to wake your sleeping wife and two sons. Your wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and barbecued pork buns. As you ate, you chatted with Juanzi about planning to play ping-pong with Wang Hao in the evening, and reminded her to wear a sun hat when picking up your younger son in the afternoon. After breakfast, you wiped your mouth.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten and then head to the company.
description: At 7:30 you woke up your second son, Lu Zihan. He was a bit reluctant to get up, so you teased him, 'If you don't get up now, you won't see your good friend Xiaomei.' He immediately got up and put on his little sandals. You rode your e-bike with him along Middle Jinmao Road and Guomao Third Cross Road to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. After handing him to the teacher, you continued riding along Middle Haixiu Road and Haisheng Road to the company, arriving at about 7:55.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning meeting and tool preparation.
description: After arriving at the company, you clocked in and changed into work clothes. Squad Leader Zhang presided over the morning meeting, stressed that they would go to Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket that day for detailed circuit measurements, and arranged for you to lead Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun. After the meeting, you went to the tool room to check the tools: distance meter, multimeter, clamp ammeter, etc. You reminded Xiao Liu to bring insulating gloves. After confirming everything was correct, the three of you pushed the tool cart toward the pickup truck.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Detailed measurement of the supermarket electrical circuits
description: You drove a pickup truck with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun, starting from the company. Along Haisheng Road, Qiuhai Avenue, and Yehai Avenue, you arrived at Guoxing Hongfa Daily Supermarket in about 20 minutes. After communicating with the store manager, you began work. You used a laser distance measurer to check the distance from the cold chain equipment area to the distribution box and found that the main cable was undersized. You checked the checkout counter outlets and used a multimeter to test voltage stability. You took photos and records of the store's lighting zones. On the hand-drawn circuit sketch, you marked with a red pen the switches that needed replacement and the nodes needing capacity expansion. The work was meticulous.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: After the measurement work, Zhao Qiang suggested going to the Furong Wenchang Chicken Restaurant on Lantian Road. Lu Mingqiang checks the impact drill, angle grinder, wire strippers, and two multimeters one by one, and has Zhao Qiang pack the tools into cases. He then calls Engineer Wang from the supermarket's engineering department to confirm the 8 a.m. entry tomorrow, the designated power-off area, and safety preparations, and reminds Zhao Qiang to watch out for the ceiling wiring safety in the fresh food area tomorrow.
location: Company warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return trip and buy extra dishes for dinner
description: Lu Mingqiang drove home and remembered that his wife wanted braised pork ribs, so he stopped at a familiar pork stall near Haixiu Road, bought two pork ribs for 38 yuan, and then picked out two potatoes and a few green peppers at the vegetable stall next to it, planning to add a dish for dinner.
location: Pork and vegetable stalls near Haixiu Road, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help prepare dinner and have a family meal
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang handed the vegetables to his wife, rolled up his sleeves to help peel potatoes, and chatted about the afternoon's warehouse preparations. His wife deftly made braised pork ribs with potatoes. During dinner, the family ate the ribs and the leftover white-cut chicken from lunch, talking about the afternoon's car and the next day's work in a warm, harmonious atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner leisure and family interaction.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang used his new phone to show the two children photos of the small car he had made today. He and his sons discussed how to add a lightning logo to the car. He also played with blocks for a while with his younger son Lu Zihan, enjoying the warm Sunday evening.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening bookkeeping and financial reconciliation
description: After the children went off to play, Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat in the study. He took out the ledger and first formally recorded the 1,499 yuan expense for the phone, noting 'paid from the year-end bonus balance.' His wife then reported the day's other expenses: 65 yuan for groceries and meat, 15 yuan for the children's snacks, and 38 yuan for pork ribs. Lu Mingqiang wrote them all down and praised the new phone, saying he should have listened to her earlier. His wife smiled in response.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening review and note organization
description: After finishing the bookkeeping, Lu Mingqiang sat at his desk and opened the senior technician exam study materials. He focused on the V/F control chapter in “Frequency Converter Principles and Maintenance” and deepened his understanding using videos on his new phone. After about 40 minutes, he organized the week's review content—basic electrical knowledge, frequency converters, and so on—into knowledge cards, marked the error-prone points in his notebook, and planned to ask Master Li about them next time.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Personal leisure and social sharing
description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang's phone vibrated—there was a new post on the local wine bottle collecting forum. He used his new phone to take a photo of the small cart, posted it with text to share the weekend's new gear and father-son handmade project, and replied to several old friends' comments with satisfaction.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and going to bed.
description: Lu Mingqiang got up to stretch his muscles, did a set of pre-sleep stretches to relieve fatigue in his lower back, then took a hot shower and changed into pajamas. Before going to sleep, he lay in bed and used his new phone to browse tomorrow's construction schedule. After confirming the weather would be clear, he felt at ease. He also chatted with his wife about family matters and agreed that she would take the younger son to kindergarten tomorrow. At about 22:30, he turned off the light and went to sleep, storing up energy for tomorrow's supermarket renovation project.
location: Bathroom, master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang woke to the sound of his alarm and habitually did about 5 minutes of lower back stretches and spinal twists in bed to relieve stiffness. While washing up, he splashed cold water on his face to wake up fully. He then changed into dark blue work clothes and insulated shoes, checked the voltage tester pen and gloves in his pockets, and put the fully charged new phone from the previous night, a power bank, a copy of Electrician Basics Quick-Reference Manual, and the project manager contact list into his tool bag, preparing for a full day of work.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast.
description: During breakfast, Lu Mingqiang sat at the table with his wife Wang Lijuan and his second son Lu Zihan. His wife had prepared Hainan rice noodles with pickled vegetables, peanuts, and dried beef. Mingqiang ate heartily and told Hanhan, who was drinking milk beside him, to listen to the teacher at kindergarten. His wife put a washed apple into Mingqiang's tool bag and told him to remember to eat it at noon.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the second son to kindergarten
description: Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike carrying his second son Lu Zihan along Jinmao Middle Road toward Guomao Sanheng Road, arriving at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten at about 7:05. After watching Hanhan run into the school gate with his backpack on and greeting the teacher, Mingqiang turned the bike around and left, ready to head to the construction site.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to the construction site
description: Setting off from the kindergarten, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike along Guomao Road and Longkun South Road onto Yehai Avenue, heading straight for the Guoxing Hongfa Living Supermarket construction site. After arriving, he parked and locked the bike in the staff passage behind the supermarket and walked into the construction area, ready to start work.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Construction preparation and pre-shift meeting.
description: In a temporary tool room set up in the supermarket's emptied warehouse, Lu Mingqiang changed into thicker electrician's clothing and insulating gloves, and checked one by one the tools and materials for himself and his team: multimeters, test pens, screwdrivers of various sizes, wire strippers, crimping tools, safety signs, temporary barriers, and so on, confirming they matched the list. Then he gathered his apprentice Zhao Qiang and team member Liu Xiaojun for a pre-shift meeting. On the whiteboard he drew a schematic diagram of the old circuit routes to be removed that day, highlighting the main distribution cabinet, the cold storage dedicated line, the fresh food area sockets, and the lighting circuits, and emphasized three iron safety rules: after power-off, two people must jointly verify the voltage; work at height must be done with a safety harness and a designated person holding the ladder; removed cables must be sorted and stacked immediately to keep the passages clear.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning demolition work on old electrical circuits
description: After confirming that the main switch in the upstream distribution room was disconnected and the "Do Not Close" warning sign was hung, Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to begin removing the old wiring from the warehouse at the innermost end of the supermarket. He tested every wire repeatedly with a voltage tester before allowing Zhao Qiang to cut and pull it out; Liu Xiaojun sorted and stacked the removed damaged fluorescent light fixtures, old-style air switches, and weathered sockets behind them. During the work, Mingqiang frequently corrected Zhao Qiang's hand gestures, emphasizing that he should keep his hands steady and the blade facing outward. The work was intense but orderly, and by the end of the morning they had basically cleared the old wiring from the warehouse area.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: After the three of them washed up quickly, they went to Awen Fast Food Restaurant opposite the work site for lunch. Lu Mingqiang ordered shredded pork in garlic sauce over rice with the daily soup. As he ate, he reviewed the morning's progress with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun, and confirmed that the afternoon would focus on the old wiring on the middle shelves of the store. After the meal, he sent his wife a WeChat message, telling her that he could not pick up Hanhan in the afternoon and asking her to pick him up after work.
location: Awen Fast Food Restaurant, Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: During the lunch break, practiced questions on the phone.
description: Back in the supermarket staff rest area, Lu Mingqiang used his lunch break to open the "Electrician Exam Master" app on his new phone and work through intermediate electrician review questions, focusing on the easily confused knowledge points in the chapters on inverter PID adjustment and power factor compensation. He took screenshots of two wrong questions and copied the explanations into his memo. After studying for about 30 minutes, he stood up and did a few chest expansion exercises to relieve eye strain, ready to continue the afternoon's work.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon demolition work and preparation for inspection
description: In the afternoon, the three moved to the supermarket's main sales floor, where the work was heavier. Lu Mingqiang personally went up the ladder to dismantle the ceiling fluorescent light fixtures and personally taught Zhao Qiang how to safely pass the long light tubes down to the ground with ropes. Around 4 p.m., Foreman Zhang suddenly came for a site inspection. Seeing the materials stacked neatly, the safety signs conspicuous, and the operations standard, he praised Mingqiang with satisfaction: "Well done! The site is clean and tidy. Obviously, these are your men. Tomorrow, when laying the wires, you must be even more energetic." Mingqiang was deeply encouraged. Then the three quickened their pace to finish up and transported the last batch of dismantled materials to the designated disposal point.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket (Cangxi Market Branch), Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycled home after work.
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools, rode his electric bike along Yehai Avenue, turned onto Longkun South Road, then onto Jinmao Middle Road, and rode all the way back to Banshan Garden Residential Area.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Errand shopping and meal preparation assistance
description: On the way home, Lu Mingqiang first went to the Pagoda fruit store on Mingzhu Road to buy bananas and Feizixiao lychees, then took a detour to the authentic Qionghai stir-fried ice and Qingbuliang stall on Wanguo West Road and packed two servings of coconut water Qingbuliang. When he got home, he handed the Qingbuliang to his wife, gave her the lychees to wash, changed into his house clothes, and went to the kitchen to help pick the water spinach. He happily shared with his wife that he had been praised by Squad Leader Zhang that afternoon. His wife was very happy and decided to add a dish of stir-fried shredded pork with bell peppers to celebrate his success.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four had dinner together. The dishes included white-cut Wenchang chicken, garlic water spinach, stir-fried bell pepper with shredded pork, and winter melon and clam soup. While eating, Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son Lu Zixuan about school. When he learned that Xuanxuan scored 90 on his math test, he praised him but reminded him to stay humble. The second son, Lu Zihan, imitated his father's way of eating, making the whole family laugh.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help eldest son with his homework
description: After dinner, in the study, Lu Mingqiang helped his eldest son Lu Zixuan finish his math and Chinese homework. Xuanxuan had difficulty with mixed operations, so Mingqiang guided him to think in the order of parentheses first, then multiplication and division, then addition and subtraction, helping him understand. After that, he checked Xuanxuan’s Chinese character notebook and praised that the character ‘teach’ was written more neatly than yesterday.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child swimming floating game
description: After finishing their homework, Lu Mingqiang moved the coffee table aside in the living room, spread out the crawling mat, and played a game with his two sons mimicking swimming and floating. He demonstrated the move himself, lying face down on the mat with arms stretched forward and legs together and lifted. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, copied it convincingly. His younger son, Lu Zihan, floundered at first; Mingqiang laughed and corrected him, telling him to keep his legs as straight as a stick. The three of them kept giggling and playing, filling the living room with joy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Review household expenses and update the ledger
description: Lu Mingqiang took out the account book, and his wife Wang Lijuan opened the bookkeeping app on her phone to check the day's expenses together. Mingqiang reported 15 yuan for qingbuliang and 18 yuan for fruit; his wife added 65 yuan for groceries, 120 yuan for Hanhan's kindergarten meal fee for next week, and also recorded yesterday's fuel cost of 350 yuan. After totaling, they confirmed the expenses were within budget. His wife reminded him that they had just spent 1,499 yuan on a phone and needed to save. Mingqiang said he didn't smoke, drink, or drink tea, and would save up to realize his dream of having a workshop.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and note organization.
description: Despite the heavy physical exertion during the day, Lu Mingqiang still insisted on studying in his study. He opened his notebook and, using the explanations on his new phone app, reviewed the principle differences between the braking unit and the regenerative unit of a frequency converter. He also neatly copied down the analysis of the wrong questions he had practiced in the morning, and drew a simplified diagram of the dynamic braking circuit, labeling the key component parameters.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and relaxing with a foot soak
description: After finishing his study, Lu Mingqiang felt tired, so he went to the bathroom to take a hot shower to wash away the sweat and dust. Then he soaked his feet in hot water for about 15 minutes. The hot water relieved the soreness all over his body and relaxed him.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime Relaxation and Couple Communication
description: Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard and used his new phone to browse Haikou news, electric power industry updates, and liquor bottle collecting forums. After carefully reading a post by a forum member about “Guizhou's classic Eight Famous Liquors from the 1990s,” he liked and saved it, thinking he would go check out the flea market on the weekend. His wife Wang Lijuan, after washing up, lay down beside him, reminded him to bring an extra jacket tomorrow because of the temperature drop, and discussed taking the kids to the seaside on Saturday. The two cuddled and chatted about everyday things, then Mingqiang set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, thought about the next day's tasks such as cutting grooves, running wiring, and preparing the new distribution box, and fell asleep contentedly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning solitude and jogging.
description: The alarm went off right at 5:30. Feeling refreshed, he washed up quickly, changed into quick-dry sportswear and running shoes, then drove along Binhai Avenue to Xixiu Beach Park, arriving at the parking lot at 5:43 after about 13 minutes. He completed a 5 km morning run on the red rubberized track, keeping a pace of about 6 minutes per kilometer. After the run, he stretched on the breakwater, took photos of the sunrise, and set a satisfying one as his phone wallpaper. The whole process was full of energy.
location: Xixiu Beach Park, Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning commute and work preparation
description: After the morning run, he drove away from Xixiu Beach. Passing Baiguoyuan (Haijiao Garden store) on Haixiu Middle Road, he stopped and bought two fresh coconuts. He drank one on the spot to quench his thirst and planned to take the other home for the family. He then drove on to the Guoxing Hongfa Living Supermarket construction site at No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, arriving at 7:05. He changed into work clothes, fastened his safety belt, and checked his insulated shoes and tool bag. At 7:15 he attended the pre-shift meeting led by Team Leader Zhang, who stressed the safety points for the finishing work, especially confirming power disconnection. After that, he led apprentice Zhao Qiang and crew member Liu Xiaojun in moving tools out of the warehouse and arranging them neatly, and started work on time at 7:30.
location: Construction site of Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket next to RT-Mart Guoxing Branch, 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Supermarket renovation finishing work (morning)
description: In the morning, he focused on finishing up the removal of the old wiring, leading Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to handle the last two old distribution boxes in the cold-chain area. During the work, he guided Zhao Qiang on proper operating procedures and promptly noticed and corrected his tendency to rush. Using pliers, he picked up an old copper cable and explained the characteristics of cables of different specifications and materials. Zhao Qiang listened carefully and learned. He completed the task meticulously and ensured safety.
location: Inside the construction site of Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket, next to RT-Mart Guoxing Store, No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and study recharge
description: He left work at 12:00 sharp and went with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to the Guilingyang Beef Rice Noodle Shop on Lantian Road near the construction site. Each of them ordered a bowl of mixed rice noodles with a marinated egg, costing 15 yuan. After lunch, he returned to the site's employee rest area at 13:00. He put on his Bluetooth earphones, leaned back on a folding chair, and listened with his eyes closed to the audio course 'Frequency Converter Acceleration and Deceleration Time Settings,' concentrating on the confusing knowledge points and finally gaining a clearer understanding.
location: Employee rest area at the Guoxing Hongfa Living Supermarket construction site, No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (lunch at Guilingyang Beef Rice Noodle Shop on Lantian Road)

name: Supermarket renovation finishing work (afternoon)
description: At 13:10, work resumed, focusing on on-site cleanup and organizing the tool room. They bundled the sorted old copper cables and loaded them onto the truck, swept up construction debris, and led the team in tidying the tool room so it was neat and orderly, making space for the new cable trays to arrive the next day. At 15:30, Team Leader Zhang inspected the site and praised the clean, orderly area and neatly stacked materials, patting shoulders in recognition of the team's results. At 16:30, all finishing work was completed ahead of schedule.
location: Inside the construction site of Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket, next to RT-Mart Guoxing Store, No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going home after work, shopping, and family dinner.
description: After getting off work at 17:00, he rode an electric bike home and reached Banshan Garden Residential Area in 7 minutes. At the vegetable stall at the entrance of the community, he bought a bunch of fresh water spinach and two pieces of tender tofu for 5 yuan, and the vendor lady threw in two spring onions. When he got home, he was greeted by the aroma of the meal prepared by his wife Wang Lijuan. He handed the vegetables to his wife and pried open the coconut left over from the morning for his two sons to drink. The younger son, Lu Zihan, and the elder son, Lu Zixuan, happily shared it. Dinner included braised fish, stir-fried water spinach, and clear tofu soup. The whole family sat together, chatting about community happenings while eating. The warm atmosphere dissipated the fatigue of the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child tech DIY project
description: After dinner and a rest, he continued yesterday's model car project with his eldest son Lu Zixuan at the living room coffee table, this time installing the power system. Using a motor, battery holder, and wires taken from an old electric toothbrush, he explained the basic principles of electric current to Zixuan while working, and guided him to twist the wires onto the terminals with his own hands. Once the motor was fixed and connected to the battery, the car ran successfully. Zixuan cheered excitedly, and father and son shared the joy of success.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Checking family accounts.
description: On the living room sofa with his wife Wang Lijuan, he took out the family ledger and checked the day's expenses. His wife listed 56 yuan for groceries and 48 yuan for the children's stationery and Qishi oranges; he added the 10 yuan for coconuts and 15 yuan for pickled noodles at lunch, and stressed that clear bookkeeping facilitates end-of-month financial management and ensures reasonable family spending. His wife agreed.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Exam preparation review and working through wrong questions
description: After entering the study, turn on the desk lamp for the daily review of electrical engineering basics. Take out the mistake notebook and focus on the two marked problems: "Resonant Circuit" and "Three-Phase Short-Circuit Calculation." Draw equivalent circuit diagrams on scratch paper and work through the derivations. When you hit a snag, take a photo of the problem with your phone and ask retired Master Li for advice via WeChat. Master Li later explained with voice messages, and the problem was smoothly solved. Carefully complete the solution steps and reasoning to consolidate what you have learned.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After reviewing, he stretched to relax, went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, then soaked his feet in hot water while browsing a wine bottle collecting forum on his phone. He saw a Li ethnic totem bottle shared by a fellow enthusiast, gave it a like, and interacted. The shower and foot soak relieved fatigue and prepared him for sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After soaking my feet, I returned to the bedroom. My wife Wang Lijuan was already in bed. I told her that I needed to leave early for a company meeting and asked her to take our second son, Lu Zihan, to kindergarten tomorrow morning. After she agreed, I turned off the bedside lamp and, filled with the day's fulfillment and satisfaction, soon fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Wake up, morning stretching, and washing up
description: Woken by the patter of rain outside the window and the 6:10 alarm. When I turned over, I felt some soreness in my lower back due to yesterday's heavy lifting and the damp weather. After sitting up, I did five minutes of targeted lower back stretches and forward bends by the bedside to relieve the stiffness. Then I went to the bathroom to wash up, rubbed my face with cold water, and was fully awake.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Had breakfast with family.
description: Entering the dining room, his wife Juanzi had already placed breakfast on the table. Today she had made Hainan rice noodles topped with peanuts, pickled vegetables, dried beef, and cilantro; the aroma was tempting. While blowing on the hot noodles and eating heartily, Lu Mingqiang told his two sons, “It's raining today, so don't run around at school. If your shoes get wet, you'll catch a cold.” He took the raincoat his wife handed him and put it by the door.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the second son to kindergarten
description: Putting on his raincoat, he lifted his younger son Lu Zihan onto the back seat of the electric bike and put a small rain poncho on him as well. After riding for about 8 minutes, they arrived at the kindergarten gate. He squatted down to straighten his son's backpack straps, reminded him to drink plenty of warm water and listen to the teacher, and only left after watching his son walk into the teaching building.
location: At the entrance of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work and buy a drink on the way.
description: Rode the electric bike from Jinmao Middle Road, heading west along Binhai Avenue. The road was slippery in the rain, so I slowed down. Passing the Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store at the Haisheng Road intersection, I stopped and bought a 1.5L bottle of mineral water and a sports drink, planning to take them to the construction site.
location: On the way from Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, to No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, passing by Convenient Life Convenience Store (80 meters southwest of the intersection of Haixiu Expressway and the Haixiu Expressway entrance).

name: Reported for duty, changed into work clothes, and inventoried tools
description: Arrived at the company and parked the e-bike in the shed. Entering the tool room, he saw the apprentice Xiao Zhao had already arrived, but the electric wrench and spirit level on the tool rack were still a bit messy. Lu Mingqiang muttered about putting tools back after use, then reorganized and counted them, confirming that the expansion bolts, cutting discs, and other consumables needed for today's cable tray installation were all available.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Attended the crew briefing and rode to the construction site.
description: Team Leader Zhang chaired the meeting and stressed that the priority today was wrapping up the line renovation at the RT-Mart supermarket on Guoxing Avenue. The meeting assigned Lu Mingqiang to lead a three-person team, with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun, responsible for installing the new wire ducts and cable tray supports on the ceiling on the east side of the supermarket. He also specifically reminded them about safety when working in the rain, and that non-slip mats needed to be laid on the floor. Lu Mingqiang accepted the task and noted the key points in his small notebook. After the meeting, the three took all the tools and materials and set off in the company pickup truck, driving along Haisheng Road via the Haixiu Expressway to Guoxing Avenue. Road conditions were fair in the rain, and they arrived at RT-Mart after about 20 minutes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province to RT-Mart (Guoxing Store), No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: In the morning, installed wire ducts and cable tray brackets in the ceiling void.
description: After arriving at the supermarket, Lu Mingqiang met with the on-site supervisor, changed into insulated shoes, and put on his tool bag. He led the two apprentices up in the freight elevator to the space above the ceiling, which was cramped and stuffy but where the sound of the rain was much quieter. He first used an infrared level to lay out a reference line, then demonstrated how to secure the expansion bolts, stressing that the nuts had to be tightened and the bracket absolutely must not wobble. As they worked, he and Liu Xiaojun worked together, using a spirit level to repeatedly align each bracket, while Zhao Qiang handed up materials and tools. Throughout, he kept reminding Xiao Zhao to watch his footing and not to step off the ceiling joists. Sweat soon soaked through his work clothes.
location: Above the ceiling of RT-Mart (Guoxing Store), No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break meal and electrician practice-question review.
description: He stopped work and sat down in the employee rest area inside the supermarket. Lu Mingqiang took out the two steamed buns he had bought in the morning and made do with a simple meal with mineral water. While eating, he took out his phone, connected to the supermarket's public Wi-Fi, opened the electrician exam practice app, and began to concentrate on practicing phasor diagram analysis of three-phase AC circuits, his weak area. He solved 15 questions and took screenshots of 3 typical questions that he repeatedly got wrong, planning to look up materials at night to understand them.
location: Staff rest area, RT-Mart (Guoxing Store), No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Carried out construction in the afternoon and completed the final cleanup.
description: After a break, the three men continued working. The afternoon task was to fix galvanized cable trays onto the brackets installed in the morning and connect the tray sections one by one. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for handling the bonding jumpers at the joints to ensure proper grounding. Around 16:00, all installation work was completed about one hour earlier than expected. He led Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun in clearing away all waste packaging and offcuts, then organized and packed up the tools. Afterwards, he called Shift Leader Zhang to report the day's progress, and Zhang expressed his approval over the phone.
location: Above the ceiling and sales floor of RT-Mart (Guoxing Store), No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bought groceries on the way home from work
description: The pickup truck sent the three back to the company. Lu Mingqiang got on his e-bike and headed home from the industrial park. Passing by Old Liu's vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden residential community, he stopped to look, bought a bunch of fresh water spinach and two pieces of soft tofu, thinking that in the evening he would have his wife make stir-fried water spinach with garlic and tofu soup.
location: From RT-Mart, No. 63 Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, with a stop at Old Liu's vegetable stall at the entrance of the residential community along the way

name: Returned home to rest and agreed to help a neighbor repair an outlet
description: After arriving home, he handed the vegetables to his wife and changed into dry loungewear. Just as he was about to take a drink of water, he ran into his neighbor Wang Jianguo in the hallway. Uncle Wang said that the kitchen outlet in his house sparked whenever it was used, and asked him to take a look. Without a second word, Lu Mingqiang put down his cup and agreed to go over right away.
location: Stairwell and home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Volunteer to repair the kitchen outlet for a neighbor.
description: He went home and got his tool bag with a multimeter, screwdriver, pliers, and so on. At Uncle Wang's kitchen, he first switched off the main breaker, opened the burnt socket faceplate, and found that the internal wiring had aged and short-circuited. He carefully cleaned the oxide layer off the wire ends, re-wrapped them with insulating tape, and replaced it with a new socket of the same model he had brought. After installing it, he switched the breaker back on, tested it with a test pen and found everything normal, and also checked the surrounding wiring. Uncle Wang was very grateful and insisted on giving him a handful of vegetables grown on his balcony. Lu Mingqiang tried to decline but could not, so he accepted and thanked him with a smile.
location: Kitchen at neighbor Uncle Wang's home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Quick dinner and getting ready to go out for exercise
description: Returning home, dinner was already on the table. He quickly finished a bowl of rice and dishes, told his wife that he had arranged to play ball with Afeng, and left the dishes to wash when he got back. Then he quickly packed his sports backpack, changed into a tank top and sports shorts, and took his racket and a spare T-shirt.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went to the squash court and played squash with friends
description: He got on his e-bike and rode about 10 minutes from home to Xingdongli Fitness (N Power Branch), where he and Lin Feng often played squash at the squash hall. The two warmed up for five minutes and then started a match. The court was filled only with the sounds of hitting and running. Lu Mingqiang's movements were solid and steady, complementing Lin Feng's fast and sharp style. After the game, he felt thoroughly refreshed and covered in sweat, as if every bone and muscle in his body had been loosened up.
location: Squash Court 3, Xingdongli Fitness (N-Power Branch), No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home and took a shower after exercising.
