description: After the workout, he agreed with Lin Feng to play again next week. He cycled home, threw his sweaty clothes into the washing machine after entering, took a ten-minute hot shower in the bathroom, washed away the sweat and fatigue, and changed into fresh pajamas.
location: Bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family finances: discussing a plan to save on electricity bills
description: His wife was looking at her phone on the sofa. Lu Mingqiang sat down beside her, and she showed him the electricity bill text message she had just received. This month's electricity bill was 320 yuan, nearly 50 yuan more than last month. Lu Mingqiang took the phone, thought for a moment, and said it was probably because recently he had been studying at night, his wife had been helping Zixuan with homework, the living room air conditioner had been running for a long time, and Zihan's air conditioner had also been on. The two discussed it and decided that from tonight on, the children's rooms would only use fans on a timer when sleeping, the living room air conditioner temperature would be raised from 25°C to 26°C, and they would minimize running appliances at the same time. Lu Mingqiang recorded the expense in the family ledger.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help the eldest son with his math homework.
description: Checked eldest son Lu Zixuan's math homework and found he was still a bit confused about several word problems on area units. He dug out LEGO bricks from Zixuan's toy box, used several small pieces to form different shapes, and patiently demonstrated the difference between square centimeters and square meters. Under his guidance, Zixuan finally understood and completed the corrections. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him a few words and helped him pack his schoolbag for the next day.
location: Eldest son's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Before-bed study: review the principles of frequency converters
description: After settling the two children, he walked into the study. Taking out the inverter principle notebook and the mind map sheets he had organized a few days ago, he spent forty minutes sorting out and linking together the content learned from Monday to Wednesday this week, including V/F control, basic concepts of vector control, and main circuit topology, using a mind map. He drew an asterisk next to the three-phase short-circuit calculation and marked it as needing reinforcement, then recopied the screenshots of wrong questions taken during his lunch break into the notebook. Having done all this, he felt a strong sense of fulfillment.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep
description: He turned off the study light and returned to the bedroom. His wife was already half-lying in bed looking at her phone. He took a sip of water and told her that today he had helped Uncle Wang fix the socket and finished his study tasks, so he felt at ease. He turned off the bedside lamp. In the dim light, the sound of rain gradually faded. Thinking about the new tasks waiting tomorrow, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At exactly 6:00, the phone alarm rang on time. Catching the aroma of Hainan rice noodles drifting from the kitchen, and thinking of the sore lower back from last night’s squash game and from working in a damp crawl space in the rain, he did not rush to get up. Instead, he did 5 minutes of supine lower-back stretching in bed—side-lying knee hugs and glute bridges—each movement slow and precise. Only after feeling the stiff muscles gradually loosen did he turn over, get out of bed, and start the new day.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and family conversation.
description: After washing up, he walked into the dining room. On the table, his wife Wang Lijuan had already laid out breakfast for him: Hainan rice noodles with lots of minced pork, and a cup of winter melon and barley water made early that morning to dispel dampness. After sitting down, he ate the noodles while asking his older son Lu Zixuan about his summer vacation homework plan, reminding him to practice calligraphy in the afternoon, and playfully asked his younger son Lu Zihan what game he wanted to play at kindergarten today. That short, warm family time filled him with energy for the day's work.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Took my second son to school and commuted to work
description: After putting the hood of the small raincoat on Zihan, he rode the electric bike and first took him to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road. Only after watching Zihan walk through the school gate, carrying his little schoolbag and greeting the teacher, did he turn the bike around with relief. He then rode along Guomao Road and Haixiu Middle Road, turned onto Haisheng Road, and arrived about 15 minutes later at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Pre-shift preparation and team morning meeting
description: After parking the car, he quickly walked into the company. In the locker room, he changed into clean work clothes that smelled of laundry detergent and his insulating shoes, and checked that the safety helmet buckle was secure. Then he went to the warehouse. Based on that day's cable laying task at Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket, he counted out one roll of 4 mm² and one roll of 6 mm² cable, as well as consumables such as cable trays, bridge connectors, waterproof label paper, and marker pens. He happened to see his apprentice Zhao Qiang had also arrived, so he called him over to help carry the tools onto the company's work pickup truck. At the pre-shift meeting, Team Leader Zhang made it clear that the main task was to complete the cable laying and wire threading in the fresh food area of Zone A of Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket. As the leader of the construction team, he accepted the drawings and the task, and again stressed that the weather was hot and stuffy, so everyone must bring plenty of water to prevent heatstroke. After the meeting, he had Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun get two more rolls of new waterproof insulating tape and stuff them into the tool box.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to the supermarket construction site and morning cable laying.
description: Driving the company's engineering pickup truck, he took Zhao Qiang and Xiao Liu along Haisheng Road and Qiuhai Avenue, then turned onto Yehai Avenue, chatting and laughing along the way. They arrived at the Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket next to Cangxi Market on Yehai Avenue in about 20 minutes. After arriving, he first took out the drawings, checked them against the installed wire duct and cable tray positions, and explained again to Zhao Qiang and Xiao Liu the routing path for the power and lighting cables. He particularly stressed the rule that power and low-current cables must be separated into different troughs, with a horizontal distance of no less than 30 cm. Then they started paying out cable from the cable reel. He was responsible for pulling and straightening, while Zhao Qiang and Xiao Liu were responsible for feeding the cables into the tray. After each bundle was threaded through, he hung a self-made waterproof label on the key ring and clearly wrote "A-01 Freezer Power" and "L-02 Downlight Lighting" with a marker, and taught Zhao Qiang the importance of labels. The entire morning was spent laying power and lighting cables in Area A of the supermarket. He carefully sealed all exposed wire ends with insulating tape.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket, next to Cangxi Market, Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and self-directed study
description: After the morning work ended, he invited Zhao Qiang and Xiao Liu to his regular spot, Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice. The three drove a pickup truck back along Yehai Avenue and Qiuhai Avenue to Haisheng Road, and ate at Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice on the ground floor of Xianghe Jiayuan. He ordered the signature spicy soup rice with pickled cabbage and pork offal, plus a fried egg and Chinese sausage. While eating, they chatted about the drama they had been following the night before, and he told Zhao Qiang several wiring jokes from work, reminding him that you can't be careless in the electrician trade. After the meal, he also bought three large bottles of mineral water and a bottle of Huoxiang Zhengqi liquid at the Bianli Shenghuo convenience store next door. Then the three returned to the company building. He let Zhao Qiang and the others rest for a while, parked the pickup truck, tilted the seat back, put on Bluetooth earphones, and opened a micro-lecture video about VFD PID adjustment saved on his phone. This chapter had always been his weak spot while preparing for the senior technician exam. As he listened to the explanation, he drew a closed-loop feedback control block diagram in the small notebook he carried with him, using a pencil, and labeled the functions of the proportional, integral, and derivative terms. He felt that once it was sorted out, it wasn't that difficult. At 13:10, the three set out again and returned to the supermarket construction site.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (lunch break spot is the parking lot downstairs from the company).

name: Afternoon: finishing the cable laying at the supermarket construction site.
description: In the afternoon, sunlight diffused through the supermarket's dome, making the worksite feel stuffy. He took Zhao Qiang and Xiao Liu into the ceiling void and continued the remaining cable laying and fixing work. Zhao Qiang was not skillful with cable ties, so he patiently demonstrated how to handle the cable curve at 90-degree bends to avoid sharp folds damaging the conductor core. By around 16:00, all wiring tasks in Area A were smoothly completed. He led Zhao Qiang along the cable tray for another inspection, confirmed that all wire ends were sealed with insulating tape and labels were tied tightly, and only then reported to Squad Leader Zhang that the work was ready for signature acceptance.
location: Guoxing Hongfa Supermarket, next to Cangxi Market, Yehai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-work commute and phone call with parents.
description: He took off his sweat-soaked work clothes, got on the electric bike placed in the back of the pickup truck, and set off for home. While waiting at a red light, he called his father. On the other end, his father's voice was hearty. He said he and his mother had taken a stroll around Wanlv Garden today and told him not to worry. Lu Mingqiang asked his parents whether they had finished the kuding tea and calcium tablets bought last time, and said he would bring some more on the weekend. The brief call put his mind at ease. He then continued riding along Yehai Avenue and Guomao Road, and returned to Banshan Garden at 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, about half an hour later.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (route endpoint)

name: Recreational exercise: community table tennis activity
description: After returning to the residential community, he picked up the day's newspaper from the first-floor mailbox. After going upstairs, he took a quick shower, put on a dry athletic T-shirt and shorts, and packed his sports water bottle and beloved table tennis paddle into his backpack. He sent his wife a WeChat message saying he was going to play ball, would not be back for dinner, and that there was food in the fridge. Then he rode his e-bike along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Furong Road, and a few minutes later arrived at the activity room next to the Jinhai Community Neighborhood Committee at No. 11 Furong Road. Pushing the door open, the room was already bustling. After warming up, he began practicing with Wang Hao. Tonight he paid special attention to the backhand push-block technique: lower the center of gravity, use the waist to drive the forearm, and send the ball steadily to the opponent's backhand position. The number of rallies increased noticeably, and Lao Zhou, standing nearby, praised him, saying his backhand had become much more stable. During the break, everyone chatted about the hot weather and the children's summer homework. Lao Zhou brought up the community friendly match at the end of the month again. He signed up, saying that his backhand was just starting to feel right, so it would be good to test the waters. After finishing, he said goodbye to his fellow players and rode home. Once home, he sat in the living room wiping off sweat with a towel, feeling that the soreness in his back and shoulders had disappeared, and his whole body felt great.
location: Community activity room next to the Jinhai Community Neighborhood Committee, No. 11 Furong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening family time: bookkeeping, parent-child interaction, and homework tutoring
description: After resting for a while, he took out his account book and recorded the expenses from yesterday for buying kuding tea for his father and calcium supplements for his mother. Then he checked the message from his wife Wang Lijuan, who said she had already eaten out with the children and asked him to heat up the food in the refrigerator for himself. He heated up the leftovers and ate. Then he called his eldest son Zixuan, who was playing with toys, into the room and took out a box containing an old electric motor, battery box, wires, and a soldering iron, ready for a small father-and-son experiment. He personally taught Zixuan to sand the copper cores of the wires with sandpaper, tin the soldering iron tip, and use solder to firmly connect the wires to the motor and battery box contacts, repeatedly warning that the soldering iron tip was very hot and he must never touch the front. After soldering, they put in the batteries and closed the switch, and the little motor spun rapidly. Zixuan was so happy that he clapped his hands and jumped around. He recorded a video and sent it to his elder brother Lu Minghua to share. After putting away the tools, father and son sat down in the living room and began checking the day's summer homework. They found a math word problem about area, so he took scratch paper, drew a rectangle and a square, and guided Zixuan step by step to write out the calculation. After he got it right, he patted the back of his head and praised him.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Study summary and plan in the study.
description: After his wife and second son came home and settled down to sleep, he went into the study, turned on the desk lamp, and took out this week's review notes and the compiled screenshots of wrong questions. He concluded that his weakness in electrical fundamentals was still magnetic circuit calculation, especially the relationship between magnetomotive force and reluctance. In the inverter section, he still easily confused the parameter group switching logic for multi-step speed and PID control. He neatly recorded these in his planner, then turned to next week's calendar and listed a clear plan of attack: on Monday evening, do 10 magnetic circuit calculation problems; on Wednesday evening, use the tablet to watch case videos on inverter parameter settings. Finally, he wrote the big characters 'increase the amount of practice next week' in the planner and circled it.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation and stretching before bed.
description: Getting up from the study, I did a few simple relaxing movements in the bedroom, stretching my shoulders, neck, and legs that had been exercised during the day. Then I leaned against the headboard, scrolled through my phone for about ten minutes, looked at subscription accounts in the electrical industry, and liked running buddy Chen Bin’s Moments post about arranging a weekend run. At 22:00, I turned off the bedside lamp, slipped into the duvet, and thought about how the supermarket work had wrapped up smoothly today and my son’s motor had also started turning. I felt especially at ease and slept well all night.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning family activity
description: After the alarm rang at 6:05 a.m., Lu Mingqiang got up, drank a glass of warm water, and then did 15 minutes of lower-back rehabilitation stretching on the living room floor (superman stretch, glute bridges, side-lying leg raises), a habit he had developed since the sprain. Then he went to his eldest son Lu Zixuan's room to wake him, saying in a teasing tone, "Hey, little electrician, hurry up. It's Friday today. You can look at your motor again after school." Zixuan got up in response. Then the whole family sat around the dining table; his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: Hainan rice noodles with fried eggs. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang talked about Zixuan soldering the motor last night and reminded his younger son Zihan to behave in kindergarten.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the second son to kindergarten
description: Lu Mingqiang took his second son, Lu Zihan, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on his electric bike, with the child sitting in front. There were many cars during the morning rush, so he avoided them carefully. They arrived at the kindergarten gate around 7:15, and he watched the child run in with his schoolbag on his back before leaving.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work and prepare for starting work
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike west along Binhai Avenue toward the company. At 7:30, passing the Convenient Life convenience store at the Haisheng Road intersection, he went in and bought a 1.5-liter bottle of iced mineral water and a pack of small buns as a worksite snack. At 7:40, he arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, changed into work clothes, fastened his safety belt, and checked tools such as the impact drill, wrench, and multimeter. He attended the morning meeting led by Team Leader Zhang, which assigned the task of installing a new power distribution cabinet at Haikou Longhua Shunhongfa Commercial Store, then called his co-workers to set off.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; on the way passing Convenient Life Convenience Store (80 meters southwest of the intersection of Haixiu Expressway and the Haixiu Expressway entrance)

name: Went to the construction site in the morning and installed the distribution cabinet
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang drove the company pickup truck, carrying his coworkers, tools, and equipment, from the company to the Haikou Longhua Shunhongfa Trading Firm on Guoxing Avenue. Arriving at about 8:20, they immediately began installing the main distribution cabinet. He directed Zhao Qiang to drill holes with an impact drill, while he and Chen Jianguo worked together to lift the heavy sheet-metal distribution cabinet onto the bracket, calibrated it with a level, and secured it. Then, following the circuit diagram, he connected the cables by color code to the main switch and each branch air switch and leakage protector, testing continuity with a multimeter after each connection. Chen Jianguo handed tools, and Zhao Qiang observed and learned. The work continued until 11:30, and sweat soaked the back of his work uniform.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longhua Shunhongfa Commercial Firm (Guoxing Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Construction site lunch
description: In the morning, after a stretch of work came to an end, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang and co-worker Chen Jianguo to a fast-food restaurant near the supermarket for lunch. He ordered a classic spicy soup rice plus a marinated egg, and enjoyed the shop's air conditioning while eating, shedding the fatigue of the morning. While eating, he opened WeChat and saw a notice in the company group about Typhoon Talim, and kept it in mind.
location: Ye Ji Spicy Soup Rice (Guoxing Branch) near Guoxing Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (Provincial Department of Culture and Sports Temporary Training Building)

name: Studied PLC during lunch break
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang did not go back to the store to rest, but found a shady spot next to the Guoxingcheng bus stop and sat on the curb. He opened the PLC simulation app on his phone. He reviewed the motor start-stop ladder diagram and began to study the "timer delayed start" logic, trying to write a program and run a simulation. When he saw the small motor in the animation start successfully after a 3-second delay, he was satisfied and took a screenshot to save it.
location: Beside Guoxingcheng Bus Stop, Guoxing Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After studying PLC, Lu Mingqiang returned to the construction site's electrical distribution room, leaned against the old wooden boards in the corner, closed his eyes, and rested for about twenty minutes to recharge for the high-intensity work in the afternoon.
location: B1 power distribution room, Haikou Longhua Shunhongfa Commercial Firm, Guoxing Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: finish up the distribution cabinet and return to the company to check tools.
description: At one in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang and his coworkers continued working in the electrical distribution room, tidying the wiring inside the cabinets, securing it with cable ties, and labeling it. Then they used a multimeter and a megohmmeter to test insulation resistance on the main circuits, and the values were all safe. At 4:30, after completing the main work and cleaning up the site, he drove his pickup truck back to the company. Once there, he went straight to the warehouse, found the emergency repair tool bag, checked the flashlight, fuses, waterproof tape, insulated gloves, and so on, and asked Old Chen, the warehouse keeper, for two spare AA batteries and a roll of new waterproof tape to add to the bag, ensuring the emergency repair tools would be complete when the typhoon came.
location: Returned from Haikou Longhua Shunhongfa Trading Company, Guoxing Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to the warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang cycled home. Passing the familiar vegetable stall at the gate of Banshan Garden community, he saw fresh local baby bok choy and scallions, stopped to pick a bunch, and also took a piece of firm tofu. In total he spent 5.5 yuan, then carried the vegetables and pushed his bicycle into the community.
location: Vegetable stall at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Community, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Evening family activities and dinner
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang handed the groceries to his wife, who was busy in the kitchen, changed into home clothes, and played with Legos on the floor with his younger son Lu Zihan, who had just been picked up from kindergarten. His older son Lu Zixuan ran over and eagerly asked whether they would go see the rocket the next day. Lu Mingqiang smiled and confirmed they would go to the aerospace science exhibition the next morning. At six-thirty, the family had dinner together. His wife had made braised eggplant, stir-fried baby bok choy, and tofu fish head soup. At the table, Lu Mingqiang announced that the whole family would go to the aerospace exhibition the next day. Zixuan was so excited that he ate an extra bowl of rice, and Zihan clapped along. After dinner, his wife cleaned up the kitchen, while Lu Mingqiang searched on his phone for '2025 Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center Aerospace Science Exhibition' and learned that it was open on weekends, free, and required no reservation. He showed the curious Zixuan photos of rocket models, and Zixuan stared wide-eyed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening homework tutoring and family finances.
description: Night fell. Lu Mingqiang calmed Zixuan down, had him take out his summer homework book, and finish two math word problems. Zixuan got stuck on the third problem (area calculation). Lu Mingqiang drew a diagram on scratch paper and guided him step by step through the relationship between length and width until Zixuan suddenly understood and worked out the answer. After that, he went to his younger son's room to coax the restless Hanhan to sleep, then returned to the master bedroom and reviewed this week's expenses with his wife using the “Daily Bookkeeping” app. They entered items such as groceries, electricity, and stationery one by one, and added today's 5.50 yuan for vegetables, confirming that they had not exceeded the budget this week. They discussed bringing their own water to the exhibition tomorrow so as not to waste money.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (Zixuan's room and the master bedroom)

name: Studying PLC in the study.
description: After the child and his wife had both gone to bed, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, opened the PLC simulation app again, reviewed the timer program from the afternoon, and tried to build more complex logic: using two timers to realize sequential motor start and delayed stop. When he ran into a logic conflict, he consulted the help documentation, adjusted the contact layout, and finally succeeded in the simulation. He closed his phone with satisfaction.
location: Study room in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang changed into his pajamas, set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning, and lay in bed discussing with his wife how the family of four would leave at 7:30 the next day to eat Baoluo rice noodles near the Convention and Exhibition Center and then look around the exhibition. He said softly, "It's been ten years—it's almost here." His wife smiled and did not reply. As the day's fatigue set in, he turned off the light and fell asleep quickly.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning stretching and commuting by bike.
description: The 6 a.m. alarm rang on time. Lu Mingqiang, worried about waking his sleeping wife Wang Lijuan, tiptoed to the living room mat and started 15 minutes of morning stretching, focusing on relaxing his lower back, shoulders, and neck. This was a habit he had developed after his last sprain, and he felt his body gradually warming up. After stretching, he changed into running shoes and sportswear, rode his electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road and Century Bridge all the way north. In the early morning, the air in Haikou carried the fragrance of plants and trees, and the sea breeze blew in his face. He arrived at Baishamen Park in less than 10 minutes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: 6 km LSD jog at Baishamen Park
description: Lu Mingqiang started a 6 km LSD jog along the Baishamen Park trail, deliberately keeping his pace at 6:15 per kilometer, breathing in for three steps and out for three steps. He picked up the pace a bit in the last kilometer. After finishing, he did 15 minutes of core stretching in the shade by the river. His knees and ankles felt fine, and his endurance was much better than last month. He glanced at his phone, checked in, and felt great.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return run and morning family wake-up.
description: After running, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike home. On the way, he bought some scallions and fresh mint from Old Liu's vegetable stall at the entrance of the residential complex, planning to boil them into water to drink. When he got home, he took a quick shower, changed into clean short sleeves and shorts, then went to his two sons' rooms separately. He gently woke up the elder son Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, who was sleeping soundly, using "Let's go see the big rocket today!" as a wake-up call. The little ones immediately perked up. His wife Wang Lijuan was already warming milk in the kitchen.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast at Ahua Baoluo Fen Shop
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike with his younger son Lu Zihan, and Wang Lijuan rode hers with the older son Lu Zixuan. In a few minutes they arrived at A Hua's Baoluo Rice Noodle Shop on Jinmao West Road. Each person in the family ordered a bowl of classic Baoluo rice noodles and added a soft-yolk fried egg. While eating, the older son asked excitedly how big a rocket was. Lu Mingqiang smiled and gestured with his hands, saying there was a model in the exhibition hall as tall as several people stacked together. Wang Lijuan reminded the children to put their sun-protection jackets and hats into the small backpack.
location: A Hua's Baoluo Rice Noodle Shop, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Going home to get ready and driving to Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center.
description: After breakfast they went home. Wang Lijuan put sunscreen on the children, and Lu Mingqiang checked the car—yesterday, Friday, he had made a point of filling up the tank after work. At exactly 9:00, he started the family car, and the family drove west along Binhai Avenue. On the way, Lu Mingqiang told the children that they would soon see a real spacesuit and the tail of a rocket. Lu Zihan asked innocently, "Where does the rocket fly to?" making everyone in the car laugh. At about 9:28, they arrived at the parking lot of Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center.
location: Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center, No. 258 Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Visited the aerospace science exhibition at Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center
description: They waited a few minutes in line at the entrance to the free exhibition. After entering the hall, Lu Zixuan was immediately attracted by the huge model of the Long March 5 carrier rocket, his mouth hanging open. Lu Mingqiang squatted down, pointed at the pipes at the base of the rocket, and explained in the simplest terms: "Our home needs electricity to turn on the lights, and the rocket also needs a powerful electrical system to 'ignite,' 'navigate,' and 'communicate.'" He also opened a photo of a distribution cabinet saved on his phone and compared it with his son, who was fascinated. The family waited in line to experience the VR spacewalk, and the two children were so excited that they screamed. Near the end of the visit, Lu Mingqiang picked out a beautiful set of postcards themed on the Wenchang Space Launch Site for his two sons in the souvenir shop. His younger son, Lu Zihan, clutched a postcard printed with a rocket launch in his little hand and refused to let go. Lu Mingqiang smiled, bent down, and asked him if he wanted to go see a real launch site; he nodded vigorously. Near the exit, they ran into fellow worker Zhang Jianguo, who was also at the exhibition with his wife and daughter. The two chatted briefly. Zhang Jianguo mentioned that he might need to work overtime next week for emergency repairs due to a typhoon, and Lu Mingqiang nodded, saying he had already checked the emergency tool kit.
location: Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center, No. 258 Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch at Old Neighbor Grilled Fish House
description: After visiting the exhibition, it was almost 12 o'clock. Considering that today was their tenth wedding anniversary, Lu Mingqiang suggested eating something nice and found a well-rated restaurant called 'Old Neighbor Grilled Fish House' near the Convention and Exhibition Center. The family ordered the signature grass carp hot pot and added some side dishes. Wang Lijuan smiled and said they were splurging today; Lu Mingqiang chuckled and said he was happy. The two children mixed the fish soup into their rice and ate with great relish. Today's lunch cost 120 yuan, and Lu Mingqiang silently noted it, planning to record it in the ledger when he got home.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, Changliu Town, Laojiefang Grilled Fish Restaurant

name: Expense entry for the drive home and midday rest.
description: After dinner they drove home. In the back seat, the two children chattered about the rocket they'd seen; before long they leaned against the seat and fell asleep. Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan talked quietly, saying the children had really broadened their horizons today. Lu Mingqiang said to Wang Lijuan, "When the eldest is a bit older, let's really make a trip to Wenchang and watch a rocket launch with our own eyes—it's even more awe-inspiring than this exhibition." She nodded in agreement, and they initially agreed to put it on the family's long-term plan. They got home at 13:30. Lu Mingqiang helped Wang Lijuan carry the children to bed for a nap. He also lay down for half an hour, but he still had the small PLC program on his mind. So he took out his phone and entered the day's expenses one by one into the bookkeeping app: breakfast 36 yuan, lunch 120 yuan.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: PLC programming practice in the study.
description: The children's bedroom door was closed. Lu Mingqiang tiptoed to the study, opened the PLC simulation app on his tablet. He specifically practiced combining timers and counters, and wrote a small program for automatic garage door control — set a 5-second delay to open the door, stop when it hits the limit switch, then automatically close after another delay. After several parameter adjustments, the simulation finally succeeded. He took a screenshot and saved it in the Certification Study folder, completing one lunchtime task.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Collaborating with the eldest son to adjust the model car.
description: After the nap, the eldest son Lu Zixuan woke up. Father and son spread out the "battlefield" in the living room and took out the small car model made from bottle caps and wire. Since the motor had been installed last time, the wheels had not been turning smoothly. Together they checked and found that the angle of the wire bend on the bottle cap was wrong, causing too much friction. Lu Mingqiang patiently guided his son to adjust the wire angle with needle-nose pliers, and found a small bottle of sewing machine oil from an old sewing machine part, dripping it onto the connection. Zixuan pushed it hard, and the car's wheels turned smoothly. He happily held up the car and ran a lap around the living room.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time for cooling off, relaxing, and snacking.
description: The weather was really hot, so the whole family rested in the living room with the air conditioning on. Lu Mingqiang turned on the TV and found the cartoon Super Wings; his two sons watched with great interest. Wang Lijuan cut a plate of watermelon and brought it over. The couple sat on the sofa eating watermelon while chatting about the interesting things they had seen at the morning exhibition. Lu Mingqiang suggested not cooking dinner that evening, but ordering takeout grilled fish from Jiamie Food Stall, plus a white cut chicken for the children. Wang Lijuan agreed, saving her the trouble of cooking.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Ordering and receiving takeout for dinner
description: At 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang ordered a signature grilled fish and a serving of white-cut chicken in the WeChat group of Jiamie Food Stall (506 Shimao South Road), noted less spicy in the remarks, and sent a red envelope to pay. Twenty minutes later, the delivery arrived on time, and Lu Mingqiang went downstairs to pick up the food. Wang Lijuan cooked rice in the rice cooker, and Lu Mingqiang helped set out the dishes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner time
description: The family sat around the dining table. The aroma of the grilled fish and the tenderness of the chicken whetted the children's appetites. At the table, Lu Mingqiang asked the older boy, "How was the exhibition today?" Zixuan said excitedly, "It was great! Dad, can we go to Wenchang to watch a real rocket launch later?" Lu Mingqiang turned to look at Wang Lijuan, who smiled and nodded. Lu Mingqiang said, "Deal! Dad promises you, when you're a little bigger, we'll definitely go!"
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Tutoring Lu Zixuan in math homework
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang had Wang Lijuan take the younger son to bathe, while he sat down at the eldest son's desk. There was not much homework that day, mainly two pages of summer vacation math word problems. He noticed that his son was stuck on a problem about area. Lu Mingqiang remembered the method he had taught him the day before yesterday using LEGO bricks to demonstrate, so he brought out a few small cookies and used the idea of piecing them together as an analogy for combining shapes to find area. Zixuan understood immediately and finished the homework quickly.
location: Lu Zixuan's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tucking in the younger son and going over the couple's finances
description: After tutoring the older son, Lu Mingqiang came to the bedroom and saw that his younger son was already almost asleep under Wang Lijuan's soft humming. He gently patted him a few times, and the child soon fell asleep. Leaving the bedroom, the couple sat down in the living room. Lu Mingqiang took out the expense tracking app on his phone and entered all of today's expenses: breakfast 36 yuan, lunch 120 yuan, and takeaway grilled fish and chicken 88 yuan. Wang Lijuan took out her wallet, confirmed that the cash and mobile balance were enough, and sighed, "We spent quite a lot today, but it's worth it as long as the family is happy." Lu Mingqiang nodded, mentally planning next month's budget.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The couple discussed a family travel plan to the Wenchang Space Launch Site.
description: The children had all quieted down, and the couple each brewed a pot of laoba tea. Lu Mingqiang said to Wang Lijuan solemnly, “You saw how excited the kid was at the exhibition today. I've been thinking—we really should make going to Wenchang to watch a rocket launch one of our family goals for the next two or three years.” Wang Lijuan nodded while cracking sunflower seeds. “Okay, just like the kid, your eyes are shining.” Lu Mingqiang opened the map on his phone and checked the route from home to Longlou Town, Wenchang: about 100 kilometers, a one-and-a-half-hour drive. They discussed whether to go during Zixuan's school winter or summer vacation, or wait until he was older, and even thought about taking a short island-driving trip along the way. Finally, Lu Mingqiang slapped his thigh. “Great! That's settled. Write it into our family's five-year plan!” The two talked until 10 o'clock, getting more and more excited.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed washing up, stretching, and message handling
description: After the family meeting, Lu Mingqiang stretched and felt that the day had been so fulfilling. He went to the bathroom, took a hot shower, changed into dry pajamas, and before going to bed insisted on doing a final 10 minutes of stretching to loosen his legs and lower back, which had been standing for a long time. Before turning off the lights, he posted in the family WeChat group the family photo taken today and a picture of Lu Zixuan looking proud in front of the car. Then he sent a voice message to his older brother Lu Minghua: "Brother, today I took my wife and kids to see the space exhibition—it was awesome! I plan to go to Wenchang to see the real thing in the future." He also sent a message to his running buddy Chen Bin, saying they could set up a morning run tomorrow if it didn't rain. Putting down his phone, he turned to look at his wife, who was already asleep beside him, and heard the even breathing from the next room, feeling full and content. He turned off the lights before 23:00, replaying the day's moments in his mind, and with a smile on his lips, soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up, breakfast, and household chores
description: Woke up naturally on Sunday. First checked the condition of his lower back while still in bed, and got up after confirming it was fine. Went to the living room to collect the clothes hung out to dry last night, washed up, then gently woke his wife and two sons. For breakfast, he cooked Hainan noodles, heated up buns, and served them with old man's tea. He listened to his elder son talk about a dream about rockets, and his younger son made everyone laugh by parroting him. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the dishes, wipe the table, and took the clothes out of the washing machine to hang them up.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Interactive reading with children
description: While his wife tidied the room, Lu Mingqiang took over childcare. He played with building blocks with his younger son in the living room, took out the space exhibition postcards to explain Long March 5 to his older son, and also read the picture book story of the little train adventure to his younger son, patiently guiding the children.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Studying PLC step instructions in the study
description: While the children watched cartoons, Lu Mingqiang went back to the study and opened the PLC simulation app, focusing on learning step instructions (STL/RET). Based on the conveyor belt logic he remembered, he wrote a sequence control ladder diagram for 'start, feed, process, stop,' and debugged it repeatedly until the simulation ran smoothly. He also took notes and recorded common mistakes.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch and casual conversation
description: His wife made scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and boiled shrimp. While eating, they talked about the afternoon plans: Lu Mingqiang was going to the Datie Laoba Tea Shop to exchange liquor bottles with a collection friend, and his wife planned to take the children to Baiguoyuan to buy fruit. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang voluntarily washed the dishes to let his wife rest.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and gear organization.
description: At noon, took a half-hour nap on the living room sofa with the electric fan on. After waking up, went to the balcony, wrapped the old Haikou Daqu liquor bottle that was to be exchanged in a soft cloth, carefully placed it in the electric scooter's trunk, checked the battery, put on the helmet and sun-protection gloves, and prepared for the afternoon trip.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went to Datie Laobacha Tea Shop to exchange wine bottles with fellow collectors.
description: At 1:30 pm, I rode an electric bike along Jinmao West Road onto Binya Road, arriving at the agreed Datie Laoba Tea Shop in about 15 minutes. I met fellow collector Chen Jianguo. He took out an old empty bottle of Yedao Deer Turtle Wine with the label intact, exactly what Lu Mingqiang wanted; Lu Mingqiang gave him a bottle of Haikou Daqu in return, and both were satisfied. The two drank black tea and ate fried sesame balls, chatting about technical sharing and new discoveries in the collector group, in a pleasant atmosphere.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bought fruit on the way back.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jianguo, he rode his bike home. Passing by Pagoda Fruits (Landmark Garden store) on Mingzhu Road, he saw that the mangoes and rambutans looked fresh, so he stopped, picked out some, bought them by weight, and hung them on the handlebars to bring home for his family to try.
location: Baiguoyuan (Zhidih Garden Store), No. 2 Mingzhu Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing wine bottles, labeling and organizing them, and posting about it online
description: After returning home, his wife and children were not yet back. Lu Mingqiang sat on the balcony and carefully wiped the newly obtained empty Yedao Deer-Turtle Wine bottle with a soft cloth dipped in clean water, not even missing the gaps around the bottle mouth. After drying it, he stuck a label reading '2025.8.10 exchanged with Chen Jianguo' on the bottom and carefully placed it in the collection cabinet alongside the other bottles. Then he adjusted the lighting with his phone, took two photos, and posted them to the collection forum with the caption: 'The old Yedao bottle I had been longing for — today my wish came true. Thank you, Brother Chen, for parting with it.'
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Purchased a waterproof Bluetooth speaker for the kitchen online.
description: He sat down on the living room sofa, opened Pinduoduo, and searched for 'kitchen waterproof Bluetooth speaker'. After comparing several models, he chose a 99-yuan square wall-mounted speaker, thinking he could listen to technical audio or news while washing dishes or heating up meals in the kitchen. He placed the order and selected express delivery, expecting it to arrive tomorrow.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Spending time with the children and eating dinner with the family
description: His wife brought the children back from Baiguoyuan. The younger son pulled Lu Mingqiang to build blocks, and he helped build a small car with wheels. The elder son was playing with a new water gun nearby, occasionally asking tactical questions; Lu Mingqiang answered patiently while guiding the block-building. For dinner, his wife made sweet-and-sour fish and winter melon and conch soup. The younger son kept talking about the little car, and the elder son asked about the story of the baijiu bottles. The family chatted happily while eating, full of joy.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening family walk
description: After the meal, he took the family downstairs for a walk to aid digestion, strolling slowly along Jinmao Middle Road toward Wanlv Garden. The older son played with his new water gun. Lu Mingqiang and his wife walked side by side chatting, and his wife reminded him not to forget the physical exam on Tuesday the 15th. When they reached the entrance of Wanlv Garden, they didn't go in; instead, they let the two children run around on the open ground, then the family slowly walked back along the same route.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Brewed tea with his wife and talked over the arrangements for next week.
description: After the two children had showered and returned to their room, Lu Mingqiang and his wife brewed a pot of luohanguo tea and sat in the living room. They planned next week in detail: he mentioned that the supermarket job was expected to be finished by Wednesday or Thursday and told his wife not to worry about overtime; his wife confirmed the specific time for Tuesday's physical exam and reminded him to go to Mom and Dad's house for dinner on Wednesday evening. They also calculated next week's expenses and, feeling they had enough money on hand, felt at ease.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and personal review.
description: He checked his work clothes for tomorrow, charged his phone and Bluetooth earbuds. He went to the children's room to take a look: the elder son was still mumbling about rockets in his sleep, and the younger son was also sound asleep. Back in his own room, he briefly noted down today's family accounts on his phone.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: After lying on the bed, he felt a bit of soreness in his lower back. Out of habit, he did five minutes of core stretching in bed, scrolled through the PLC notes on his phone, thought about the next day's progress on the construction site, set the alarm for 6:20, put the phone away from the bed, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning washing and stretching
description: The alarm went off on time. Lu Mingqiang dismissed it and got up briskly. He went to the bathroom, washed his face with cold water, and shaved. Then he unrolled a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 15 minutes of core stretching and lower-back rehabilitation exercises, paying special attention to easing his chronic lumbar muscle strain.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Took the eldest son to school and had breakfast at the entrance of the residential community
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into his work uniform and went out with his eldest son, Lu Zixuan. They sat down at the Awei Hainan Noodle Shop at the entrance of the residential community. He ordered a bowl of Hainan noodles with egg for himself, and a bowl of century egg and lean pork porridge and a boiled egg for Xuanxuan. After eating, he rode an electric bike to take Xuanxuan to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 7:25, telling him to focus in class.
location: Awei Hainan Rice Noodle Shop at the entrance of Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

name: Attend the company morning meeting and receive task assignments.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from the school and arrived at the company in about 15 minutes. After parking, he went to the locker room, changed into work clothes, put on a safety helmet, and went to the tool room to pick up tools such as a multimeter, screwdriver set, and insulating tape. At 8 o'clock sharp, Team Leader Zhang held the morning meeting and assigned the day's tasks: to fully complete the finishing work on the power distribution cabinet of the supermarket on Jinlong Road. He also informed them that apprentice Zhao Qiang had called in sick with a high fever the night before, so only Lu Mingqiang and Liu Xiaojun were available today. Lu Mingqiang nodded, knowing exactly what to do.
location: Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Supermarket distribution cabinet wiring and inspection work
description: Lu Mingqiang and Liu Xiaojun drove for about 15 minutes and arrived at the Carrefour supermarket construction site on Jinlong Road. Because Zhao Qiang was on leave, the workload doubled. Without hesitation, Lu Mingqiang checked every circuit carefully against the drawings, asking Liu Xiaojun to hand him materials and record data. Using crimping pliers and a screwdriver, he connected and fixed the wires one by one. By 10:30, most of the work had been completed, and he started measuring insulation resistance and circuit continuity circuit by circuit with a multimeter to ensure everything was correct. Sweat dripped down the safety helmet straps.
location: Underground power distribution room, Carrefour Supermarket, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Had lunch at a fast-food restaurant near the construction site
description: After finishing work, Lu Mingqiang invited Liu Xiaojun to have lunch at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, diagonally across from the construction site. He ordered a 15-yuan spicy soup rice set meal and added a fried egg, eating heartily to regain his energy. The two discussed the afternoon's finishing work while eating. After finishing the meal in half an hour, Lu Mingqiang asked the shop for a free cup of hot tea and took a few sips.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: During the lunch break, reviewed PLC analog instructions on his phone
description: Lu Mingqiang did not take a nap. He found a quiet staff break room, sat down, took out his phone, put on earphones, and opened the saved instructional video. He concentrated on learning the PLC analog input/output modules (especially 4-20 mA signal processing) and several key comparison instructions. While watching, he traced ladder diagrams on his pant leg with his finger, trying to thoroughly understand the principles.
location: Carrefour supermarket employee break room, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Final inspection and finishing work before powering on the distribution cabinet.
description: Back at the construction site in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang and Liu Xiaojun did the final recheck before energizing. He retightened every terminal screw, removed stray wire ends and debris from the cabinet, and, under Liu Xiaojun's supervision, ran a simulation to test circuit continuity. Only when all detection indicators met the requirements did he breathe a long sigh of relief, sign the work log, and take a photo of the distribution cabinet for the record.
location: Underground power distribution room, Carrefour Supermarket, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Went home after work and contacted family on the way.
description: Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools and returned to the company with Liu Xiaojun to clock out and complete the end-of-shift record. He called his wife Wang Lijuan: "Juanzi, Jianguo and I are going to have grilled fish at Jinmao Night Market tonight, so I won't be home for dinner." His wife grumbled on the phone: "Drinking again! Drink less." He laughed and agreed, then rode his e-bike home.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Completed the final assembly and testing of an eco-friendly power car with my son
description: Pushing open the door, Lu Mingqiang saw his eldest son Xuanxuan gesturing with a toy car model in the living room. Without bothering to change clothes, he washed his hands and crouched down to do the final assembly with his son. He guided Xuanxuan to use a hot glue gun to securely stick the battery box onto the chassis and checked all the wiring connections. Once everything was ready, he took a deep breath and said to Xuanxuan, "Come on, let's make it run!" Xuanxuan pressed the switch, and the car drove smoothly forward across the tile seams. Lu Zixuan jumped up with a "Wow!" Lu Mingqiang laughed heartily and gave him a high-five, then took out his phone to record the successful moment. Little Hanhan, who was playing with building blocks nearby, also ran over and stared at it curiously.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went out for an appointment and headed to the night market.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into a clean polo shirt, washed his face, and grabbed his phone. Before leaving, he sent a WeChat message to his workmate Chen Jianguo: “Jianguo, done yet? Meet at the usual place, Jiamie Food Stall!” The other man promptly replied, “Got it!” He then walked to Jinmao Night Market.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District

name: At the night market with fellow worker Chen Jianguo, ate grilled fish, drank, and chatted.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo sat down at the food stall, ordered a signature grilled fish, a few lamb skewers, and a pitcher of iced beer. He picked up a big piece of fish, chewed contentedly, and eagerly talked about how Xuanxuan's little car had successfully run, his face full of pride. Chen Jianguo complained about his family's nagging about marriage. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang took a sip of beer and said seriously, "Jianguo, I've made up my mind — next month let's both sign up for that PLC and frequency converter skills training class. Classes every Saturday, learning real skills." Chen Jianguo's eyes lit up, clinked glasses, and the two hit it off. Lu Mingqiang noted the registration link he had seen earlier on his phone and sent it to him.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home slightly tipsy.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo chatted until almost 9 o'clock, then split the bill. Because he had been drinking, he felt a little tipsy, but his mind was still fairly clear, so he slowly walked home. After arriving home, his wife Wang Lijuan handed him a cup of warm honey water: "Look at you, reeking of alcohol. Go wash up." He chuckled, took the cup, and drank it all.
location: From Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Washing up and spending time with the children
description: Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower, changed into pajamas, and felt much more comfortable. He went to his son's room, saw Xuanxuan doing homework, checked it, and praised him for writing the characters well. Then he went to soothe little Hanhan, who was already a bit sleepy, patting him to help him fall asleep. His wife was tidying the wardrobe nearby, telling him about some trivial things she had encountered during the day.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Before bed, used PLC simulation to verify a work issue, kept accounts, and stretched.
description: Although he was a bit tipsy, Lu Mingqiang still sat down at his desk and opened the PLC simulation app on his phone. He recalled the actual need for forward and reverse control of the freezer motor in the supermarket distribution cabinet during the day, worked out the logic in his head, entered the ladder diagram in the app, and ran a simulation. Everything was normal, and only then was he satisfied. After that, he took out his expense notebook and recorded the day's personal expenses: 6 yuan for breakfast, 3 yuan for buying Xiaojun a bottle of water, and 50 yuan for sharing the dinner bill. Then he stood on the balcony and did a few minutes of simple core stretching and deep breathing.
location: Study and balcony at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the study light and tiptoed back to the bedroom. His wife was already lying down and asked, 'Are you still going over to the supermarket tomorrow?' He replied, 'I should go straight to the construction site for the handover.' He set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, turned over, and with tomorrow's work arrangements going through his mind, he quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Getting up, washing up, and core stretching
description: After getting up early, he did 15 minutes of core stretching and lower back activities, washed his face with cold water to refresh himself, changed into his dark blue work clothes, checked his work badge, keys, and phone, and clipped the physical examination report into his driver's license booklet. These preparations readied his body and belongings for the day's work.

name: Load commissioning after the supermarket is powered on (morning)
description: Lu Mingqiang rode the company electric bike and arrived at Carrefour on Jinlong Road, Longhua District in 8 minutes. He put on his safety helmet and gloves and began energizing and commissioning the circuits area by area. First, he clamped the clamp meter around the main circuit cable of the freezer cabinets, observed the current readings, confirmed that the three-phase currents were basically balanced (Phase A 5.2A, Phase B 5.0A, Phase C 5.3A), and recorded the data. Then he dealt with the problem of the lighting circuit current being slightly high, as predicted yesterday. He checked the ceiling LED light strips one by one and found that the number of fixtures in some areas was 20% more than on the design drawings. He immediately guided Zhao Qiang on how to use a wrench to split the extra fixture lines into two adjacent circuits, then performed an insulation test. After confirming everything was correct, he closed the switch again, and the measured current returned to normal.
location: Carrefour Supermarket, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and study during the midday break

Lu Mingqiang took out his phone, put on earphones, opened the Learn Circuits app, and started a comprehensive programming simulation exercise. He drew the timing diagrams for the motor's forward/reverse rotation and timed switching on scratch paper, then wrote the ladder diagram, verifying the logic step by step. After several adjustments, the system finally prompted 'Simulation passed.' He looked at the time (1:05 PM) with satisfaction, then leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes.

Between tasks, he used the on-site situation to explain to Zhao Qiang: "Look at this switch. If the neutral wire and the live wire are reversed during installation, the light will still turn on, but the fixture stays live after the switch is off — you can easily get shocked when changing a bulb. In our line, safety is the number one priority. No matter how tight the margin is, we mustn't be careless at critical points." Zhao Qiang nodded repeatedly and used his phone to take photos of the on-site wiring diagrams as notes.
location: Power distribution room and various areas on the underground floor of Carrefour Supermarket, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

How much electricity does it use in 5 hours? The number on our electric meter keeps spinning, and what it records is exactly this amount. 1 kilowatt-hour is 1 unit of electricity. So 2 kilowatts multiplied by 5 hours is 10 kilowatt-hours, which is 10 units. Understand?" Lu Zixuan quickly understood and finished the remaining problems independently.

description: After leaving school, Lu Mingqiang cycled to the company, taking Haifu Road, Longkun South Road, Nanhai Avenue, and then turning onto Haisheng Road. He arrived at the company parking lot about 20 minutes later. He quickly locked his bike, clocked in, and went to the tool room to collect new insulating gloves and a safety helmet. At the morning meeting, Team Leader Zhang assigned the inspection task list for the day and emphasized the key safety points for outdoor work in thundershower weather. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang found the team leader and verbally reported his plan to go to the long-time customer Li Jianguo's shop that morning to handle the remaining inverter problem. The team leader nodded in agreement.
location: Meeting room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park Company, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Completely resolved the variable frequency drive fault and received praise from the customer
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from the company via Haisheng Road, Haixiu Middle Road, and Haifu Road to Li Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop. Boss Li was very happy to see him arrive so early. Following the approach his mentor had guided him over the phone the night before, Lu Mingqiang first connected a homemade simple filter in series at the input terminals of the variable frequency drive, then focused on checking all the grounding screws. When he got to a screw at the terminal block, he found it loose with signs of oxidation. He carefully sanded the terminal and the screw with sandpaper, then retightened them. He also checked the other terminals to make sure everything was foolproof. After closing the switch and applying power, the machine ran smoothly without tripping again, and the fault was completely eliminated. He then advised Boss Li on daily maintenance precautions. Boss Li immediately called Manager Liu of the company's engineering department and highly praised Lu Mingqiang for his multiple visits last night and this morning, solid technical skills, and responsible attitude. After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang filled out the repair service form and asked Boss Li to sign it, reminding him to contact him anytime if there were any problems during subsequent use.
location: Li Jianguo Electrical Repair Shop, No. 120, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning inspection task
description: Lu Mingqiang rode the electric bike from the repair shop, along Haifu Road, Haixiu Middle Road, and Jinlong Road to Carrefour supermarket, arriving in about 10 minutes, and met up with his partner Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang. As planned, they performed the monthly inspection of the supermarket's power distribution room, dividing the work: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for measuring the insulation resistance of the main circuit, Chen Jianguo checked the temperature rise of each switch contact, and Zhao Qiang studied alongside and recorded the data. During the inspection, Lu Mingqiang found that the terminal block of one emergency lighting circuit was slightly hot, immediately tightened it, and explained the situation to the supermarket's electrical supervisor.
location: Electrical Room, Carrefour Supermarket (Jinlong Road Branch), No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: After finishing the inspection, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang walked together to the "Sister's Spicy Soup Rice" fast-food restaurant on Haisheng Road for lunch. Lu Mingqiang ordered the signature spicy soup rice with white-cut chicken, and strictly followed his healthy menu, eating only the greens cooked with less oil. During the meal, he chatted with Jianguo and Xiao Zhao about insights from handling the inverter that morning, and also listened to Jianguo tell an amusing story from his child's class. The atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch break, prepared for and completed the mock test.
description: After walking back to the company break room, Lu Mingqiang didn't rush to take a nap. Instead, he took out his phone and opened the "Electrician Skills Exam" app. To do the test with undivided attention, he first closed his eyes and rested for 10 minutes to clear his mind, then opened his mistake notebook and quickly reviewed the few commonly missed questions he had recorded last week as a "warm-up" before the test. At 13:45 he started the 90-minute comprehensive mock test on schedule, covering 100 questions on electrical theory, fault analysis, and safety regulations. In the quiet environment, he was completely focused and submitted 5 minutes early. When the screen showed an 82% accuracy rate, he was overjoyed, clenched his fist, and muttered "Good." Afterward, he took out a paper notebook, copied down every wrong question the system had flagged, and wrote down the correct reasoning and test points, planning to reinforce them in the evening.
location: Company rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon field maintenance task
description: The afternoon task was to set off with Chen Jianguo from the company on electric bikes, along Haisheng Road, Qiuhai Avenue, and Jinlian Road, arriving at Jinlianyuan Residential Community in about 20 minutes to conduct the semi-annual routine inspection of the electrical distribution shafts of several residential buildings. The two checked floor by floor, cleaned the accumulated dust in the shafts, and used a clamp meter to measure whether the three-phase currents of the main line were balanced. They found a cable conduit with poor sealing that could pose a risk of small animals entering; they re-sealed and reinforced it with fire-resistant putty, and made detailed records.
location: Distribution room of Jinlian Garden Residential Community, No. 8 Jinlian Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuted home after work
description: After completing all maintenance point work, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo signed the residential property maintenance log book. Then Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike home along Jinlian Road, Jinlong Road, and Jinmao Middle Road, cycling for about 25 minutes. After arriving home, he quickly changed out of his work clothes, put on a running vest, shorts, and running shoes, grabbed his sports earphones and a bottle of water, glanced at the sky—the clouds were starting to thicken—and decided to set off immediately for a run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Running exercise and recovery
description: Lu Mingqiang warmed up with a slow jog from home, running along the sidewalk of Jinmao Middle Road all the way to the trail at Haikou Bay Park. As planned, he started a 5K tempo run at a pace of 5:50 per kilometer. His breathing and cadence were well coordinated, and although his thighs felt sore and heavy, his rhythm did not break. He finished the 5K in about 29 minutes. After finishing, he walked slowly and stretched to let his heart rate settle. Back home, he did a few more minutes of stretching and then took a shower to wash off the sweat.
location: Haikou Bay Park, Hongmian West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

At the kindergarten gate, Hanhan happily rushed over as soon as he saw him. Lu Mingqiang picked him up, and the little one said in his ear that he had built a very tall block castle at kindergarten today.
location: At the entrance of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He cut up the golden pompano to be steamed that evening and picked over and washed the spinach. His wife followed the weekly healthy menu and used a salt-control spoon and an oil-control jug to season the dishes. Before dinner, Lu Mingqiang found time to sit beside Xuanxuan and check his math homework. Seeing that he was stuck on a geometry problem, he used the triangle ruler and protractor on the desk to illustrate the decomposition of spatial shapes.
location: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner

location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Video call with a childhood friend and shared it with my wife
description: Just after finishing dinner and clearing the dishes, Lu Mingqiang's phone rang. It was his childhood friend Wang Haiming calling via WeChat video. He went to the balcony and answered. The two chatted in authentic Hainanese. Wang Haiming talked about the recent business conditions for electronic components in Huaqiangbei, while Lu Mingqiang shared the sense of achievement from successfully solving a frequency converter fault that morning. Wang Haiming mentioned that he had decided to return to Haikou for the National Day holiday and planned to first help a relative manage a hardware store. Lu Mingqiang immediately said that when his brother came back, they must have a good gathering and invite Wu Gang and the others. After hanging up and returning to the living room, Lu Mingqiang told his wife, who was telling Hanhan a story, about the call and the idea of getting together on National Day. Li Juan smiled and said yes, and even suggested they could go to that time-honored grilled fish restaurant on Haixiu Road. Lu Mingqiang was very happy to hear that, and they talked more about the prospects of his childhood friend's return. He felt that life was solid and full of hope.
location: Balcony and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening parent-child time: playing together, helping with homework, and settling the children to sleep.

Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang took out a copy of "Dinosaur Encyclopedia" and organized a small quiz for the children, promising that whoever answered correctly would be responsible for the "first flight" when they went to fly kites at Wanlv Park on the weekend. Then he encouraged and reminded Xuanxuan that it was time to finish the five Ohm's law practice problems he had given earlier. He accompanied him to the study, and when Xuanxuan made corrections, he guided him to reread the problems and draw equivalent circuit diagrams instead of directly telling him the answers. Xuanxuan finally got them all right, and Lu Mingqiang took out the points chart and added 5 points. Afterwards, his wife took Hanhan to bathe first, while Lu Mingqiang supervised Xuanxuan brushing his teeth and washing his face by himself. When both children had bathed and changed into pajamas, the couple read storybooks to them, one each, and watched them gradually fall asleep.

For the wrong question "Filtering methods for external interference of the frequency converter", he combined it with this morning's hands-on case and added detailed selection mnemonics for filters and reactors to his notes.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

The 5 km tempo run met the pace target, and he felt good physically and mentally. Finally, he opened the weather app on his phone to check tomorrow's forecast—cloudy with showers, temperature 26-32°C. He thought of tomorrow being his wedding anniversary; if it didn't rain, he could discuss going out for a meal with his wife.

Jianguo explained the exam process and precautions in detail. After lunch, they returned to the company, and Lu Mingqiang lay down on the sofa in the break room to rest for half an hour. After the 13:10 alarm went off, he didn't get up immediately. Instead, he took out his phone, opened the exam prep app, and used the last half hour of the break to review wrong questions, focusing on the parallel operation conditions of transformers.

He directed Zhao Qiang to carry over the spare copper-core cable, made the connections himself, and after crimping, wrapped them in multiple layers of insulating tape. After replacing about 15 meters of new cable, he closed the switch to restore power, and the building's electricity was back on. He cleaned up the discarded cable and garbage on site, wrote a maintenance record, and then called Squad Leader Zhang to report that the emergency repair was complete.
