He patiently used a ruler and pencil to draw a diagram on scratch paper to explain it until Zixuan nodded and said he understood. Afterward, he chatted with Juanzi in the living room. Juanzi mentioned that she had gone to the community health center to get medicine today but still felt a little dizzy. Lu Mingqiang urged her to get a complete blood count over the weekend. The two also discussed buying new stationery and schoolbags for the two children before school started next week, and decided that Lu Mingqiang would look at styles online during tomorrow's lunch break.
location: Living room and second bedroom, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Evening bedtime preparation and rest.
description: Had a comfortable hot shower, hand-scrubbed the collar of the work jacket and threw it into the washing machine. Returning to the bedroom, I skimmed the 'High-Voltage Cabinet Operating Procedures' section in the Reference Series for Senior Electrician Technician Examinations by the bedside, which might be needed tomorrow, and noted down key warning signs. Then I turned off the main light, kept only the bedside lamp, leaned against the headboard, and sent the two rephotographed old photos to my eldest brother Minghua via WeChat with the message: 'Brother, these old photos Mom found. Look, is this Dad's wine?' I chatted with my wife Wang Lijuan about the day's work and fun happenings of Hanhan at kindergarten, feeling the day was solid and peaceful. After saying goodnight to each other, I reached out and turned off the light, falling asleep in the warm night breeze of Haikou.
location: At home, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: The alarm went off at exactly 05:55. Lu Mingqiang immediately turned over and got up, starting planks and core stretches on the bedroom floor. About a minute and a half later, a torrential rain began outside with loud thunder. Worried about waking the family, he hurriedly finished the last few sets and ended the workout, which lasted only 10 minutes. After the rain eased a bit, he quickly took a hot shower and changed into his work clothes. In the kitchen, he used the scallions and carrots his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared the night before, chopped them, mixed them with flour and eggs to make batter, and warmed up milk. Wang Lijuan also got up to help fry egg and vegetable pancakes, and the two chatted while cooking. At 06:40, Lu Mingqiang went to wake up their two sons. Lu Zixuan got up rubbing his eyes, while Lu Zihan wanted to stay in bed, so he picked him up and joked that if he didn't get up, his brother would eat all the pancakes. The family sat around the table to eat breakfast. Lu Zixuan mentioned that he had morning Chinese reading today, and everyone ate warmly but hurriedly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: After breakfast the rain had stopped. Lu Mingqiang put on a raincoat just in case, rode his electric bike with his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way he told his son to listen carefully in class, and only after watching his son put on his schoolbag and walk through the school gate did he leave. Then he turned back home to pick up his younger son Lu Zihan and rode to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. Along the way Lu Zihan pointed at a puddle on the roadside and said, "There are clouds in the water." Lu Mingqiang smiled and agreed. After arriving at the kindergarten, he handed the child to the teacher and only left after watching him play with building blocks with his little friends.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Arrive at post and attend team morning meeting.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the company; the ground was still wet. He parked, went to the changing room to dry his pant legs with a dry towel, changed into spare work trousers, then went to the tool room to put away the multimeter and insulating tape used yesterday and checked the toolbox. At 08:15, Team Leader Zhang led the morning meeting, summarized the finishing work of the Bihai Yuntian project yesterday, praised Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang, then assigned the day's task: go to the Chengjian Garden family quarters near Binhai Avenue to inspect, replace, and register old electric meter boxes as a preliminary survey for the renovation of old residential areas. Team Leader Zhang also especially emphasized safety precautions for working after rain.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inspection of electricity meter boxes at Chengjian Garden (morning).
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang formed a team and took the work vehicle to the Chengjian Garden residential area. Carrying workbooks and toolboxes, they inspected the electric meter boxes building by building and unit by unit. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for opening the box doors and checking whether the wiring was loose or aging and whether the meters were running normally; Zhao Qiang was responsible for recording. They focused on inspecting Buildings 6 and 8 and found 3 spots with slight heating marks on terminals and 1 damaged electric meter box door lock. Lu Mingqiang marked them in detail and took photos for subsequent replacement.
location: Chengjian Garden Family Housing Area, Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang went to "Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant" near Chengjian Garden. He ordered a bowl of spicy soup rice, and the hot soup dispelled the morning dampness. While eating, they talked about the morning inspection. Lu Mingqiang also taught Zhao Qiang how to judge internal circuit abnormalities by the sound of an electricity meter. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang greeted the property staff and rested in an empty duty room. He took out the Advanced Electrician Technician Examination Guidance Series, seriously read the "Electrical Safety Technology" chapter for 30 minutes and took notes, then leaned back in the chair and took a half-hour nap.
location: Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province - Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant (Binhai Branch) and the property duty room of Chengjian Garden family quarters.

name: Afternoon inspection and return to the company to organize
description: In the afternoon they continued working. Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang finished inspecting the remaining buildings and public areas in one go. Around 4 p.m., the two organized their tools and counted the list of materials that needed to be reported for replacement. After returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang found the colleague in charge of materials and gave a detailed account of the abnormalities found in the morning and the spare parts needed as counted in the afternoon (such as new locks for meter box doors and terminal blocks), then filled out the Inspection Problem Registration Form, wrapping up the work smoothly.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Binhai Avenue, Chengjian Garden Residential Compound; Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park

name: Pick up the two children from school.
description: After leaving work on time, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Lu Zihan. The little boy was holding a small red flower given by the teacher as a reward. Then he took Hanhan to the gate of Experimental Primary School to wait for his older brother. When Lu Zixuan came out, the three rode home together. On the way, Lu Zixuan happily said he had got an A on today's math quiz, and Lu Mingqiang felt very pleased.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home to take a shower and help with dinner
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower and changed into loungewear. His wife Wang Lijuan was busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang let the two sons watch cartoons in the living room for a while, then went to the kitchen to help peel garlic and trim vegetables; the couple worked in tacit coordination to prepare dinner.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: Wang Lijuan made stir-fried luffa, blanched shrimp, and tomato egg soup—simple and refreshing. During dinner, Lu Zixuan shared the good news that he got an A on his math quiz, and Lu Zihan, following his older brother's lead, also said he got an 'Excellent' at kindergarten. Lu Mingqiang and his wife exchanged smiles, enjoying this rare, relaxed dinner time.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner walk and buying medicine for his mother
description: On the fresh evening after the rain, Lu Mingqiang suggested that the whole family go downstairs for a walk to aid digestion. The family strolled along Jinmao Middle Road to Jianmin Pharmacy. Lu Mingqiang bought three boxes of joint pain relief plasters for his mother and deliberately took a few extra patches, telling her to apply them promptly whenever her knees hurt on rainy days. The two children stood at the pharmacy entrance, staring in fascination at the goldfish in the aquarium. The family enjoyed a warm evening together.
location: Jianmin Pharmacy, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Resting and preparing gear for playing ball
description: After walking home, Lu Mingqiang asked his wife to keep an eye on the children doing homework, went back to his room and changed into sports shorts and a T-shirt. He packed his squash racket, knee pads, and water bottle into his sports backpack, and checked the racket strings, getting ready for the evening exercise.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Heading to the squash court.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Leyu Squash Club and arrived in a few minutes. He confirmed the booked court at the front desk, did a few stretches in the rest area, and waited for his playing partner Lin Feng to arrive.
location: Leyu Squash Club, Nanhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Playing squash with a friend.
description: Lin Feng arrived on time. The two warmed up with some rallies first, then started a best-of-three match. Lu Mingqiang's lower back injury from last week had fully recovered, and he was in great shape, hitting forehand drives with plenty of power. He lost the second game to Lin Feng due to a drop in stamina, but in the third game he adjusted his rhythm and eventually won 3-2. After playing, the two sat by the court drinking water and chatting, catching up with each other.
location: Leyu Squash Club, Nanhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returned home and took a shower after exercising.
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Feng, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike home. He was sweaty but felt very refreshed. When he got home, he took a hot shower, washed off the sweat, and changed into clean loungewear.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Add the family liquor bottle to the electronic archive.
description: In good spirits, Lu Mingqiang made a cup of tea and turned on the computer and an Excel spreadsheet in his study. He pulled up photos he had taken at his parents' house the day before yesterday and carefully entered the information for four wine bottles one by one: his father's 1988 wedding commemoration bottle, his mother's blue-and-white porcelain dowry bottle, an old Yedao Deer-Turtle Wine bottle from his early collecting days, and an old Haikou Daqu bottle from his aunt's home. For each entry, he filled in the name, source, era, story summary, and attached a photo link. Finally, he solemnly added at the bottom of the sheet: 'Interviewee: Lu Jianguo, Chen Xiuying,' 'Recording date: August 26, 2025.' Looking at the ever-growing family archive, he felt a deep sense of fulfillment.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time before bed and rest preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang returned to the bedroom, and his wife Wang Lijuan was leaning against the headboard looking at her phone. He reminded her that they should go for a routine blood test together on Saturday, and they discussed buying school supplies for their son on the weekend. Then he went to the children's room, covered Lu Zihan, who had kicked off his blanket, and tucked Lu Zixuan's quilt in. Back in bed, he chatted with his wife about the day's work and tomorrow's weather, and soon turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning exercise, family breakfast, and dropping off the kids.
description: The alarm went off right at 06:00. It was raining outside, so the morning run could not proceed. Lu Mingqiang spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did core training, including planks, glute bridges, and side planks. During the training, he woke his eldest son Lu Zixuan and had him join in, correcting his improper posture. Father and son completed a special parent-child morning workout amid laughter. After the workout, Lu Mingqiang took a shower, and his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast (rice porridge, fried eggs, and pickled dried radish). After the family finished breakfast, Lu Mingqiang cleared the dishes. At 07:00, Wang Lijuan helped the two children put on their raincoats, and Lu Mingqiang told Xuanxuan to listen carefully in class. Then he watched his wife ride the electric bicycle, first taking the younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then taking the older son Lu Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School.
location: Living room and kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing materials and study preparation.
description: After the family left, the house became quiet. Lu Mingqiang processed the ingredients for making snacks in the kitchen: he drained the soaked glutinous rice, shredded the white radish and salted it, and prepared shredded coconut and olive oil. Then he went into the study and spent about an hour redoing the wrong questions from the senior technician exam on the APP, and also learned two new fault diagnosis cases, consolidating his knowledge.
location: Kitchen and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Supermarket shopping
description: The rain gradually lightened. Lu Mingqiang walked to Wanghao Supermarket (Sunshine Branch) on Jinlong Road. He bought seasonings such as dark soy sauce, chopped scallions, and cilantro to prepare steamed radish cake, and also bought a pack of seaweed snacks for the children. After leaving the supermarket, he walked home, put away the items, and tidied up the living room to create a clean environment for his mother's visit.
location: Wanghao Supermarket (Sunshine Store), No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Welcomed his mother and made preliminary snack preparations.
description: At 09:35, Lu Mingqiang held an umbrella and walked to the Jinmao Middle Road bus stop at the entrance of the community to pick up his mother, Chen Xiuying, who had come on the No. 9 bus. She brought homegrown green onions and freshly picked coconuts. After returning home, he made tea for her, and the two of them rested briefly. Then the mother and son put on aprons, took out the ingredients for making pastries, and prepared to begin the highlight of the day—making traditional pastries.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Jinmao Middle Road (Bus Stop).

name: Making traditional pastries
description: After sending the children off, Wang Lijuan also came home, and the three gathered in the kitchen. Mother Chen Xiuying served as the head chef, skillfully using hot water and glutinous rice flour. Lu Mingqiang used olive oil instead of lard to mix into the shredded coconut. Although his mother remarked, 'We never watched our oil intake in the past,' she acknowledged the healthy approach. Wang Lijuan seriously learned to make coconut glutinous rice cakes. Lu Mingqiang used a phone stand to record the precious footage of his mother demonstrating. Then they made turnip cake. His mother stir-fried diced cured meat until fragrant, then mixed it into the shredded radish batter, and the whole house was filled with aroma. The steamed coconut glutinous rice cakes and turnip cakes were soft, sticky, and fragrant, where traditional and modern healthy concepts merged.
location: Kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Tasting dim sum for lunch
description: Freshly cooked coconut glutinous rice cakes and radish cakes were served at the table. Lu Mingqiang, Wang Lijuan, and his mother Chen Xiuying sat together to enjoy them. Wang Lijuan chopped the scallions his mother had brought and mixed them into the radish cakes, adding a distinctive flavor. As the three ate and chatted, his mother recalled the funny incident of little Lu Mingqiang stealing a glutinous rice cake and burning his mouth, drawing bursts of laughter. This lunch was pure adult time, exchanging family talk and cooking skills.
location: Dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: See mother off to catch a ride.
description: After lunch, his mother needed to go back to cook for his father. Lu Mingqiang packed up the leftover turnip cake and glutinous rice cakes and walked her to the bus stop on Middle Jinmao Road. When they parted, his mother told him to study hard for the technician certificate and not to worry about things at home. Watching the bus drive away, Lu Mingqiang felt warmth in his heart.
location: Jinmao Middle Road (Bus Stop), No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Noon break
description: After seeing his mother off, Lu Mingqiang felt somewhat exhausted. He went back to the bedroom, lay down on the bed, and rested for half an hour, going over in his mind the steps for drawing the diagram that afternoon. Before long, he fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Drew a historical diagram of the family wine bottles.
description: At 14:00 he woke up on time, and after washing his face he felt refreshed. Lu Mingqiang entered the study, spread out a large sheet of white paper, and drew a timeline (1980s–2025) with a pencil and ruler. Referring to the Excel files on his computer, he used simple line drawings to mark the locations of four family wine bottles: his father’s 1988 wedding wine bottle, his mother’s blue-and-white dowry bottle, his own deer-turtle wine bottle, and the old Haikou Daqu at his aunt’s house, and copied story summaries beside them. Then he switched to a fine black gel pen, retraced the timeline, and adjusted the layout of the wine bottle drawings so that they looked better arranged from old to new, noting the sources and relationships in the corner. A hand-drawn draft carrying family memories came into being.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Study senior technician exercises
description: After drawing, his eyes were a little tired, so Lu Mingqiang turned to studying the Electrical Advanced Technician Examination Guide Series. For the case of abnormal motor starting, he drew three fault trees on draft paper, marking test points and possible open circuits, laying a foundation for next week's review.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Household chores and meal preparation
description: In the afternoon, the rain had stopped. After stretching, Lu Mingqiang started on the housework. He thoroughly scrubbed the kitchen after making snacks and put away the dishes; then he took in the washed clothes from the balcony and folded them neatly. After that, he took out pork ribs from the refrigerator to thaw, preparing for the winter melon and pork rib soup for dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Picked up the child from school and prepared dinner.
description: At 17:00, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his second son Lu Zihan. Hanhan excitedly shared the new song she had learned. He then went to Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road to wait for his eldest son Lu Zixuan to finish school. Around 18:00, after the two brothers got home, the house immediately became lively. Lu Mingqiang helped his wife Wang Lijuan prepare the meal in the kitchen. Wang Lijuan was stir-frying, while he watched the stove and simmered winter melon and spare rib soup. In the living room, Xuanxuan was teaching his younger brother the new song he had learned in kindergarten.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District; Kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was ready, and the family sat around the table. The menu was winter melon pork rib soup, garlic lettuce, and leftover turnip cake from noon. Lu Mingqiang played the video of the snack-making recorded at noon, and the children were excited to see their grandma on screen. Xuanxuan mentioned being a little nervous about tomorrow's class quiz and received encouragement and comfort from his parents.
location: Dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child bonding and homework guidance
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang built LEGO with Zihan in the living room, and Zihan put together a “fire station.” Wang Lijuan checked Xuanxuan's math homework. Afterward, Lu Mingqiang helped Zihan take a bath, then sat down beside Xuanxuan and used line-segment diagrams to help him solve the tree-planting mistakes.
location: Living room and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Concept for digitizing the atlas
description: After the children washed up, his wife told them stories to help them fall asleep. Lu Mingqiang returned to the study, looked at the hand-drawn draft of the atlas, and felt it needed to be saved electronically. He opened a document app on his phone, created a new file, organized the stories of the four liquor bottles in chronological order, marked their corresponding positions on the atlas, and planned to make an electronic version using graphics software later.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Body relaxation and study wrap-up.
description: After sitting for a long time and feeling a bit stiff, Lu Mingqiang walked around the living room and did chest expansion exercises. Then he returned to the study and used a mobile app to randomly answer 15 senior technician multiple-choice questions, scoring 93% correct. He took a screenshot of the mistakes and saved it. He wrapped up his studies, bringing the day to an end.
location: Living room and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Couple's bedtime talk and plans
description: After his wife settled the children down, she returned to the bedroom, and the couple leaned against the headboard chatting. Lu Mingqiang showed her photos of his hand-drawn illustrated catalog. His wife teased that he was really into 'old relics,' and he said it was about passing on heritage. They discussed plans for Saturday: first go to the central hospital for his wife's routine blood test, then take Xuanxuan to the Guomao stationery store to buy school supplies, and also look at cosmetics. His wife reminded him to recharge the electric scooter.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 21:30, Lu Mingqiang got up to wash up and took the opportunity to check on the two children's sleep, covering Xuanxuan, who had kicked off the blanket. Back in the bedroom, he set the alarm for 6:00 the next day, turned off the light, and fell asleep. Although he had not traveled far that day, the family matters filled his heart with contentment, and he slept peacefully.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and children's room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Waking up and morning core training
description: After the alarm went off, he got up immediately and changed into sports shorts in the bedroom. He spread out a yoga mat in the living room and started a 15-minute core workout: 2 sets of planks (60 seconds each), 2 sets of supine leg raises (20 reps each), and 2 sets of side planks (30 seconds each side). Outside the window the sky was gloomy, and muffled thunder could be faintly heard. After the workout, he was slightly sweaty.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wash up, prepare, and wake up the children
description: Took a quick shower and changed into work clothes. In the kitchen, he poured two glasses of warm water, drank one himself, and handed the other to his wife Wang Lijuan, who was already preparing breakfast, reminding her that there would be heavy rain today and that the raincoat had been placed on the shoe cabinet. Then he went into the second bedroom, first gently patting his eldest son Lu Zixuan on the shoulder to wake him, then went to his younger son Lu Zihan's room to help him out of his sleeping bag, telling him it would rain today and that Mom had prepared a little dinosaur raincoat.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and reminding the child about school
description: Breakfast was lean pork porridge and fried eggs made by his wife. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang opened the weather app on his phone and showed the shower warning page to the two children, explaining that a cloud with a lightning symbol meant there would be a thundershower today, so they had to wear their raincoats. Lu Zixuan nodded and said he had brought it, and Lu Zihan also said in a baby voice that his little dinosaur raincoat had a hood. He then reminded his wife to buy toothpicks and shrimp after work, and not to put too much soy sauce in the steamed fish — he would take care of it when he got home.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dropping off kids at school and buying breakfast
description: Lu Zixuan put on his schoolbag by himself. Lu Mingqiang lifted his younger son Lu Zihan into the child seat on the back of the e-bike. It hadn't rained yet, but the sky was overcast. He first rode the e-bike to take Lu Zixuan to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School and reminded him to wait at the school gate after school. Then he turned around and arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten before 8:10, watching Lu Zihan be led into the building by a teacher. After that, he rode along Haisheng Road, ordered a spicy soup rice and a cup of soy milk to go at Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, and arrived at the company at about 8:25.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City. Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, he went successively to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District. He also bought breakfast at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, and finally arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Work (Morning)
description: Punched in at the company on time and finished breakfast in the team rest room. Today's task was to assist colleague Zhao Qiang in updating the wiring drawings for some old distribution cabinets in the park. Lu Mingqiang put on his safety helmet and emphasized to Zhao Qiang again that although these lines were not energized, the drawings must be checked carefully, and not a single connection point could be wrong. The two compared with the actual equipment and spent nearly three hours updating electronic drafts of three electrical wiring diagrams. During this time, shift leader Zhang came over, patted him on the shoulder, and told him that a client had a small job tomorrow so he should be aware.
location: Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: He went to lunch with coworkers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang at Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on the first floor of Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road. They ordered two servings of spicy soup rice and one serving of white-cut chicken. While waiting, Lu Mingqiang took out his phone and looked through the photos of four liquor bottles and the handwritten story draft he had taken yesterday. Chen Jianguo asked about his 'Bottle Genealogy' project. Lu Mingqiang smiled and shared his idea of making it in a timeline format, with bottle photos on top and stories below. The two chatted energetically.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: At work (afternoon work and review)
description: In the afternoon, he returned to the team's rest room and filed the checked drawings and materials. At around 16:00, during a break, Lu Mingqiang took out his phone, opened the electrician review app, and did 15 mock multiple-choice questions on PLC basics. He got two questions about inverter wiring wrong, took screenshots of them, and planned to read the textbook again in the evening if he had time.
location: Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Make phone calls and confirm dinner
description: Before leaving work, he called his wife Wang Lijuan. After she answered, he said calmly that he was off work and was now going to buy toothpicks and shrimp. He asked whether the sea bass had been bought, and suggested that for tonight's steamed fish, they use a little steamed fish soy sauce—just drizzle it around the edge of the pan—to taste the fresh, sweet original flavor. After getting his wife's agreement, he hung up and packed up to leave work.
location: Company office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After work, grocery shopping, and picking up the children.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike, stopping first at the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket at No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District (Hainan Province Dormitory Branch). He went in and spent 2 yuan on a pack of toothpicks, then picked out live shrimp at 35 yuan per jin. Then, timing it well, he arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten at 5:50 to pick up Lu Zihan, then rode to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up Lu Zixuan. Under the seat of the electric bike were two folded raincoats in case of rain.
location: In Haikou City, Hainan Province, starting from No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, passing by the Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Supermarket at No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, then to the Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road in Longhua District and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road in Meilan District, and finally returning to Banshan Garden at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Returned home and helped prepare dinner.
description: After arriving home, his wife Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang poured the shrimp into the sink and started removing the shrimp veins with a toothpick, chatting with his wife while working. They discussed using the weight curve chart and the rocket launch as bait at dinner to get the children to accept a light diet. His wife laughed that his tricks only worked on kids.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and a "persuasion session" for light eating.
description: The whole family of four sat around the dining table. The main dishes tonight were steamed sea bass, boiled shrimp, cucumber salad, and seaweed egg drop soup. Lu Zixuan complained that the soup was too bland and wanted to eat fried chicken, and Lu Zihan also said the food wasn't tasty. Lu Mingqiang didn't get angry. He picked up his phone, opened the health management app, pulled up the family health data curves from the past thirteen days, and showed the kids that Mom's anemia was improving and his own blood lipids were dropping, explaining that the meals had made it happen. He promised that if the kids could stick to a light diet for a month, after the month ended, he would take them to Wenchang over the weekend to watch a rocket launch and also play with sand at the beach. The children's eyes lit up. Lu Zixuan asked if they could really see it, and Lu Mingqiang answered affirmatively, saying they would go once they saved up enough money.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family time (homework and parent-child activities)
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang accompanied his younger son Lu Zihan in building LEGO blocks in the living room, teaching him colors and shapes while they built. At 20:30, the older son Lu Zixuan started his weekend math homework and got stuck on an Olympiad math problem about tree planting. Lu Mingqiang walked over, took the scratch paper, drew a line segment, and explained the relationship between the number of trees and points while drawing. Half an hour later, Lu Zixuan calculated the correct answer on his draft notebook.
location: Home living room and second bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: The electronic version of the family wine bottle history atlas has been finalized
description: After the children washed up and went to sleep, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and turned on the computer. Using the wine bottle archive he had organized in Excel and drawing software, he dragged four photos into the corresponding positions on the timeline: his father's wedding wine, his mother's dowry blue-and-white porcelain wine bottle, an old bottle of Yedao Deer Turtle Wine from his own collection, and an old Haikou Daqu bottle from his aunt's house. He labeled each bottle with its name, date, and a short story in SimSun font. Finally, at the top of the drawing, he added the title 'Lu Family Wine Collection Chart — Not for Sale' in a solemn font and drew a line border. At 22:00, he pressed the print button and watched the A4 color print slowly emerge. He carefully removed it, examined it for a moment, then took out a copy of the Electric Power Engineering Handbook from the bookshelf and slid the chart flat inside.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for tomorrow's tasks
description: After clipping the printed diagrams together and putting them back in the bookcase, he went to the bathroom to wash up. After brushing his teeth, he poured himself a glass of warm water and sat on the edge of the bed. He opened his phone memo and quickly wrote down Saturday's plan: 1. Take his wife to the central hospital for a routine blood test; 2. Take his eldest son to buy school supplies (pens, exercise books); 3. Review the electrician questions he got wrong.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Muttered the next day's schedule to himself, and after feeling reassured, turned off the bedside lamp and said to his wife Wang Lijuan beside him, 'Alright, let's sleep. There's a lot to do tomorrow.' The two chatted a few words about tomorrow's plans, then the room quieted down, with only the low hum of the air conditioner, and they gradually fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning exercise and washing up
description: On Saturday morning, Mingqiang woke up at exactly six o'clock at the call of his biological clock. After a brief wash, he splashed his face with cold water to quickly wake up. He then spread a yoga mat in the living room and completed a 15-minute core workout, including planks, alternating supine leg raises, and bird-dog exercises, keeping up his daily exercise routine.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Accompany his wife to the doctor and buy breakfast on the way
description: Mingqiang drove his wife Wang Lijuan to the Central Hospital of Longhua District, Haikou, for a blood test. After arriving, they registered, had blood drawn, and waited for the results. The doctor finally said that the indicators were basically normal, with only slightly low hemoglobin, and recommended dietary adjustments. On the way back, they bought shrimp dumplings, BBQ pork buns, and soy milk at the Hexinyuan Breakfast Shop on Jinlong Road to take home.
location: Haikou Longhua District Central Hospital, Jinyu East Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family had breakfast together.
description: After returning home, his wife Wang Lijuan heated up the breakfast they had bought, boiled plain rice porridge, and served it with pickled mustard and fried eggs. The whole family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting. Mingqiang conveyed the doctor’s advice and mentioned the plan to buy beef for dinner. The children excitedly discussed the kite-flying activity.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family went to the community swimming pool to swim.
description: After breakfast, Mingqiang packed his swimming gear and a kite. The family then walked to the Jinmao Street Community Swimming Pool near Guomao Road for free swimming practice. Mingqiang completed a 400-meter non-stop swim, his wife also swam a few laps, and the two children played in the shallow water. After swimming, they returned home to shower and change, getting ready to go out for kite flying.
location: Community Swimming Pool, Jinmao Subdistrict, Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the bus to Evergreen Park to fly kites and buy stationery on the way.
description: Lu Mingqiang's family of four took Bus No. 9 from a bus stop near Banshan Garden to Wanlv Garden Park. On the way, they got off at Guomao Road Station, and Mingqiang took his eldest son Lu Zixuan into the M&G Stationery Store, where they bought a document folder and gel pens. After that, they got back on the bus and arrived at the west gate of Wanlv Garden at 10:25, entering the park. On the open lawn, Mingqiang flew the "Mighty Tiger" kite he had improved himself, with extended tail ribbons flapping loudly in the air. He handed the spool to Xuanxuan and taught him how to control the pace of letting out line, and the kite rose to the height of a three-story building. His younger son Hanhan ran around laughing, chasing the kite's shadow, while Wang Lijuan sat on a picnic mat watching. At one point, the kite got tangled in a treetop, and Mingqiang poked it down with a long branch, drawing laughter from the whole family. The activity lasted until 12 noon, before they packed up their gear and prepared to go home.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returned home to prepare lunch and enjoy it with the whole family
description: Returned by bus from Evergreen Park to home at Banshan Garden. His wife Wang Lijuan took out the prepared pickled cabbage fish fillets and water spinach from the fridge. Mingqiang helped rinse the rice, cook it, and mince garlic. The two quickly cooked together. The lunch of pickled cabbage fish fillets was sour and spicy and appetizing, and the garlic water spinach was refreshing and helped cut the grease. After the meal, Mingqiang peeled apples for the children, while Wang Lijuan cleared the dishes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: The whole family took an afternoon nap in their respective bedrooms. Mingqiang set an alarm for 14:20 to reserve energy for tutoring the children in the afternoon and reviewing in the evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutored his eldest son on a comprehensive math and circuits test paper and interacted with his youngest son
description: After the lunch break, Mingqiang tutored his eldest son Lu Zixuan on a comprehensive math test paper incorporating circuit knowledge in the small blackboard area of the living room. He first reviewed concepts such as summing resistances in series circuits, then let Xuanxuan work on the problems independently. When they encountered a difficult problem, Mingqiang guided his thinking by drawing an equivalent circuit diagram, and in the end Xuanxuan scored 86 points, showing obvious progress. After the tutoring session, Mingqiang walked out of the small living room and interacted with his youngest son Hanhan, who was drawing; he praised his artwork and encouraged him to color the kite.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan worked together in the kitchen to prepare dinner. Wang Lijuan had bought fresh beef and spinach in the afternoon and cooked stir-fried beef with celery and spinach egg drop soup. During dinner, the whole family shared interesting moments from the day. Xuanxuan talked about his sense of accomplishment from solving problems, and Mingqiang put food on the children's plates to supplement their nutrition. After the meal, they cleaned up together.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Record two weeks of diet adjustment data and set a health review day
description: After dinner, Mingqiang and his wife used a diet tracking app in the study to export dietary data from August 17 to 30. The analysis found that the average daily salt intake per person dropped from 9 grams to 5.8 grams, oil from 40 ml to 22 ml, his wife's dizziness symptoms lessened, and Mingqiang's own energy improved. The two agreed to set the 8th and 23rd of each month as family health review days.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Review wrong questions from the senior technician exam and mark the exam countdown.
description: In the study, Mingqiang reviewed the wrong questions about PLC programmable logic controllers, conducted an in-depth analysis against the 'Electrical Advanced Technician Assessment Guide Series', and circled the November 12 exam date on his calendar, noting the 74-day countdown to remind himself to step up his exam preparation.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Check the next day's weather and prepare morning run gear.
description: Mingqiang checked the weather forecast on his phone in the living room and confirmed that the next day (August 31) would be sunny turning cloudy, 26-31°C, suitable for running. He then prepared his running shoes, sports shorts, and quick-dry T-shirt and placed them at the entryway, and did 5 minutes of runner-specific stretching to prepare for the 10 km morning run challenge.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and reading a bedtime story to the youngest son.
description: After taking a quick shower, Mingqiang went to the second bedroom and told his youngest son Lu Zihan two stories from the Little Bear Baby picture book. Hanhan listened spellbound. When the stories were finished, Mingqiang lightly kissed his forehead, turned off the light, and left.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening conversation between husband and wife and recording today's notes
description: Mingqiang chatted with his wife Wang Lijuan in the master bedroom, sharing his plan to challenge a 10-kilometer run the next day. His wife said she would take the kids to the park to cheer him on. Afterwards, Mingqiang jotted down important matters of the day in his phone memo, including his wife's check-up results, the kids' academic progress, diet data, and tomorrow's plan.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Mingqiang turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep with his wife, saving energy for the next morning's run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run training and weight record
description: After waking up at 5:50 AM, Lu Mingqiang did a short core warm-up in the bedroom, including planks, squats, and shoulder stretches. He then left home (Banshan Garden Residential Area) at 6:05 and ran at a steady pace along Jinmao Middle Road toward Haikou Bay Park, maintaining a pace of 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. He circled the seaside promenade in the park twice before running back the same way, stopping only once for water. He ultimately completed a continuous 10-kilometer run in about 1 hour and 10 minutes. After finishing, he walked to catch his breath and sent a screenshot of his running record to the running group, earning praise from his running buddy Lin Feng. Back home, he took a shower, then did leg stretches in the living room to cool down, and stepped on the scale to record his weight at 70.4 kg.
location: Along the route from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Bay Park (Hongmian West Road), Longhua District, and at home.

name: Breakfast, next week's menu planning, and post-meal cleanup
description: The whole family sat around the dining table for breakfast, which included white congee, fried eggs, stir-fried greens, and Laoba tea snacks. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan used a phone notes app to jointly plan the next week's (September 1 to 7) low-oil, low-salt shopping list, and persuaded the children to accept healthy dishes such as steamed fish. Juanzi promised to make a low-oil version of cola chicken wings on the weekend as a reward. After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang proactively cleared the dishes and wiped the table, Wang Lijuan put the sheets into the washing machine, and the two cleaned the kitchen together, finishing the household chores.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (dining room, kitchen)

name: Whole-family deep cleaning and afternoon tidying
description: Lu Mingqiang gathered his two sons and assigned tasks for a thorough house cleaning. The family started preparing tools at 8:30, then thoroughly cleaned the living room, children's room, and study. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for moving furniture and cleaning the bookshelves, Wang Lijuan wiped windows and organized the wardrobe, Lu Zixuan tidied the desk and LEGO bricks, and Lu Zihan put away scattered toys. During the process, they found a long-lost Ultraman doll, which made Lu Zihan very happy. After finishing the cleaning, Lu Mingqiang used a vacuum cleaner to clean the whole house, then went into the study to organize the toolbox and exam preparation materials, and finally went to the balcony for a short rest, enjoying a moment of tranquility.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room, children's room, study, balcony).

name: Lunch and a low-oil, low-salt family meeting
description: Lunch was cooked by Wang Lijuan, with Lu Mingqiang assisting, strictly following the low-oil and low-salt principle. They prepared steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, cucumber salad, and winter melon and clam soup. After the family finished eating, they rested briefly. At 1 p.m., Lu Mingqiang held a family meeting in front of the whiteboard in the living room, showed the changes in weight and blood pressure before and after the dietary adjustment in the health management app records, formally established the family rule of 'keep low oil and low salt for the long term,' and agreed that every Sunday evening they would jointly plan the next week's menu. The whole family read it aloud and agreed to abide by it.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area (dining room, living room), No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and free time in the afternoon
description: After the family meeting, everyone arranged their own afternoon time. Lu Mingqiang, feeling tired from his early morning run, took a nap of about an hour on the bedroom bed; Wang Lijuan used a grocery shopping app to browse ingredients nearby; Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan watched cartoons and built with LEGO toys respectively in the living room, enjoying a quiet Sunday afternoon.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (bedroom, living room)

name: Tutor Lu Zixuan on circuit knowledge quiz
description: After the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son Lu Zixuan in reviewing circuit knowledge in the study. Based on the mistakes on last week's test paper, he wrote three variant questions on the spot and printed them out for Lu Zixuan to take as a quiz. After Lu Zixuan finished the quiz, Lu Mingqiang graded it and gave him 85 points. The main issue was careless reading of the questions. To encourage him, Lu Mingqiang wrote a blessing on a treasured "Wenchang Space Launch Center" postcard and gave it to Lu Zixuan, promising to take him to see real rockets during the winter vacation. Lu Zixuan was very excited and ran to his mother with the postcard to share the good news.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Dinner time: parent-child interaction and family meal.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan prepared dinner together in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang washed and cut the vegetables, while Wang Lijuan did the cooking. While waiting, Lu Zixuan played a teacher-and-student game with his younger brother Lu Zihan in the living room, teaching his brother the circuit knowledge he had just learned that afternoon, which made the whole family laugh. Dinner continued to follow the low-oil, low-salt principle, with dishes including stir-fried luffa, tomato and egg stir-fry, and lean pork congee. After the meal, the whole family cleared the table together, and Lu Zixuan took the initiative to wipe the date off the family whiteboard to welcome September.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (kitchen, living room, dining room).

name: Exam preparation sprint: organizing August notes and planning September review.
description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang focused on preparing for the senior technician exam in his study. He spread out the mistake notebook, mock exam papers, and screenshots from the vocational skills app accumulated in August. First, he circled the exam date (November 12) on the calendar and wrote '84-day countdown.' Then, with a red pen, he circled more than a dozen high-frequency error points, such as inverter harmonic suppression, transformer differential protection setting, and PLC communication fault analysis, and reinforced his understanding with the app's explanations. He also drew a knowledge tree on paper, marked his weak areas, and wrote down the key focus points for September on the title page of his notebook.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Family finances: discuss August expenses and September budget
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan checked the family accounts in the bedroom. The two compared August expenses using the bookkeeping app and a paper ledger. They found that because they had eaten out less and cooked at home more, dining expenses had been reduced by about 400 yuan, and they decided to put that money into the emergency fund. They also discussed the September budget. Lu Mingqiang said he hoped that once the year-end performance bonus was sufficient, he could get his parents new air conditioners. Wang Lijuan supported this and planned to work more overtime during her exam preparation to supplement their income.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Bedtime: washing up and couple's late-night talk
description: After the financial discussion, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan washed up one after another. Lu Mingqiang soaked his feet in hot water to relieve fatigue; then the two lay down and chatted. Lu Mingqiang invited his wife to go for a physical checkup together in September, and she agreed. As they talked, they gradually relaxed in the rambling conversation. Before falling asleep, Lu Mingqiang confirmed the next day's alarm. With August having wrapped up successfully and with September on the horizon, he fell asleep peacefully at 22:15.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (bathroom, master bedroom).

name: Morning exercise and washing up
description: Lu Mingqiang got up on time at 5:50 and completed a 15-minute core workout on the old yoga mat in the living room, including planks, superman stretches, and glute bridges, with fluid movements. After the workout, he took a quick shower in the bathroom, changed into clean work clothes, stuffed two folded rain ponchos into his commuter bag, checked and packed the knee patch he had bought for his mother the day before, and finally confirmed his phone and e-bike keys, making full preparations for the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare breakfast and wake up the family
description: Lu Mingqiang walked into the kitchen. His wife Wang Lijuan was already cooking rice porridge and frying eggs. He helped heat up buns, steam the sweet potatoes bought yesterday, and set out bowls and chopsticks. At 6:40, he gently woke his two sons, who were still fast asleep, reminding Zixuan that school started today and about the evening birthday plans. Hanhan also woke up afterward, and the whole family was full of anticipation for the new semester.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: The family of four sat around the dining table having breakfast. While drinking porridge, Lu Mingqiang told his eldest son Zixuan to listen to the teacher on the first day of school and wait for Dad to pick him up after school, and told him that he had ordered his favorite Wenchang chicken for the evening. Zixuan nodded excitedly, and Hanhan also clamored for cake. The breakfast atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, full of anticipation for the new semester.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: At 7:25, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric scooter to first take his eldest son Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road, Meilan District. He watched him enter the school gate with his new schoolbag and loudly told him to wait after school. Then he turned the scooter around and rode about 15 minutes to take his younger son Hanhan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Third Horizontal Road, Longhua District, and handed him over to the teacher.
location: Along the way from Longhua District to Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shopping on the way: medicated patches and a birthday gift
description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang first went to Guang'an Tang Drugstore on Jinmao West Road to buy two boxes of knee hot-compress plasters for his mother and had an electronic invoice issued, ensuring the elderly lady would have enough for the whole month. He then hurried to Kupin Chaowan Toy Store on Longhua Road, carefully selected a tech-savvy programmable electronic building block set, paid 228 yuan at the counter, and asked the clerk to wrap it in a gift box as the eldest son's birthday present.
location: Guang'antang Drug Supermarket, No. 15 West Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Kupin Trendy Toy Store, Longhua Road

name: Commuting to work and checking the payslip.
description: While waiting at a red light on his bike commute to work, Lu Mingqiang called to reserve a small private room for 6:30 p.m. at the time-honored Wenchang Chicken Restaurant on Zhongshan Road, Longhua District, specifically asking for light dishes suitable for children. After arriving at the company on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, he changed into his work clothes, took his September payslip from Squad Leader Zhang in the team rest room, carefully checked the perfect attendance record and social insurance deductions, confirmed the net pay of 3,300 yuan was correct, folded it, and put it into the inner pocket of his work clothes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: electric meter inspection at Siji Huating
description: After attending the team morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang, along with tools and drawings, to Siji Huating Yangguang Huafu Residential Community in Chengxi Town, Longhua District for electricity meter repair. With the cooperation of the property management, he personally taught Zhao Qiang how to use a multimeter to troubleshoot line problems. After more than two hours of patient troubleshooting, they finally found the source of the fault in a hidden distribution box and successfully repaired it.
location: Siji Huating Sunshine Mansion, Chengxi Town, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and midday rest to recharge
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang and his co-workers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang ate at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the company. He ordered the poached chicken set meal and asked for less oil. The three chatted while eating. Chen Jianguo complained that his family was urging him to get married, and Mingqiang smiled and shared the story of his son's birthday. The atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, they walked back to the company break room. He leaned back in a chair and took a 20-minute nap, then used the remaining time to quickly review the frequently missed points for the senior technician exam in the memo on his phone, silently reciting the key points of frequency converter harmonic suppression.
location: First floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and the lounge of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park

name: Afternoon work wrap-up and report.
description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang continued to lead Zhao Qiang to complete the meter maintenance for the remaining households in Siji Huating Residential Community. After finishing the work smoothly, he returned to the company early, carefully organized the maintenance record forms, and reported the day's work progress and the problems found to Team Leader Zhang, demonstrating a rigorous and responsible professional attitude.
location: Siji Huating Yangguang Huafu, Chengxi Town, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Cycled home after work.
description: As soon as it was time to get off work, Lu Mingqiang quickly changed out of his work clothes, got on his electric bike, and hurried home faster along Haisheng Road in Xiuying District and Guomao Road in Longhua District, thinking about the evening celebration.
location: Along the route from Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Picking up his wife and two children after school
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang picked up the wrapped birthday gift and left with his wife Wang Lijuan, who had just arrived back from the community home-care service point. The two first went to the kindergarten on Guomao Third Cross Road to pick up the delighted Hanhan, then hurried to Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road in Meilan District. Zixuan was waiting at the school gate with his backpack, looking around. When he saw his parents and younger brother, a bright smile spread across his face, and the family gathered together.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

name: The whole family celebrates the eldest son's birthday
description: The family of four rode an electric scooter through the old town to the booked time-honored Wenchang chicken restaurant on Zhongshan Road, Longhua District. After arriving at the private room, Lu Mingqiang ordered a table full of dishes, with the light Wenchang chicken as the centerpiece. During the meal, he gave Zixuan a beautifully packaged programmable electronic building-block set as a birthday gift. Zixuan was pleasantly surprised when he opened it and immediately made a wish to grow up to be an engineer like his father. The whole family sang the birthday song, and Mingqiang recorded the warm moment on his phone, bringing the atmosphere to its peak.
location: Wenchang Chicken Restaurant (Zhongshan Road Store), No. 110 Zhongshan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time at home
description: After dinner, they cycled home. Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes, then joined Zixuan in exploring the circuit principles of the new building blocks, patiently explaining the function of each connecting wire to satisfy the child's curiosity about the physical world. Meanwhile, Hanhan quietly played with a newly bought coloring book nearby, and the family enjoyed a peaceful evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Husband and wife discuss family budget and health plan
description: After the two children had a short rest, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan spread the ledger on the living room coffee table. Because his mother's birthday in August had cost quite a lot, they decided to strictly divide the 3,300 yuan salary into 1,500 yuan for daily expenses, 800 yuan for an education fund, and 1,000 yuan for savings, and noted that non-essential expenses needed to be cut this month. At the same time, to support Mingqiang's weight loss plan, they agreed that from this week on, dinner would include more boiled dishes, steamed vegetables, and whole grains, and fewer greasy dishes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He told the boys a bedtime story for a while and returned to the bedroom after they settled down. His wife Wang Lijuan was leaning against the headboard reading. The two quietly exchanged thoughts about Zixuan's behavior today and tomorrow's work arrangements, then went to rest after some small talk.

He reminded himself that starting tomorrow he would need to keep up with diet and exercise to prepare for the senior technician exam at the end of the year. Then he glanced at the calendar—there were still 72 days until the exam on November 12—so he closed his phone, turned off the light, and went to rest.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

The whole family finished breakfast quickly and got ready for school and work.

Troubleshooting found that the capacitor on the drive board had aged. Around 9:00, he received a call from his wife, who told him that the Smart Campus app needed to be installed. He guided Zhao Qiang to replace the capacitor and test the circuit. By 11:45, he confirmed that the elevator had resumed operation.

I felt a bit annoyed, and the lunch break was delayed by more than ten minutes.

name: Went out to troubleshoot and repair the control cabinet fault
description: After the morning meeting, Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang on an electric bicycle to Fortune Plaza. After contacting the property electrician, they entered the power distribution room on the basement level. He first observed the indicator lights and used a multimeter to measure the incoming voltage to confirm three-phase balance, then had Zhao Qiang use a clamp meter to measure the outgoing current of each circuit. He finally determined that an aging main contactor coil was causing heating and intermittent malfunction. He removed the old part, replaced it with a new contactor of the same model, tightened all terminals, and explained his troubleshooting approach while working. The equipment resumed stable operation.
location: Power Distribution Room, Basement Level 1, Fortune Plaza, No. 103 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

While eating, he noticed Zhao Qiang was feeling down, so he put down his chopsticks and asked. He learned that his girlfriend was breaking up with him. Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder, counseled him with his own experience, and encouraged him to first master solid skills and earn a living honestly by his craft. Zhao Qiang nodded silently after hearing this.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China
