He first browsed the photos of Old Chen's liquor bottle collection on his phone, then used different colored pens to draw a time allocation chart for reviewing each chapter of Power System Analysis in the first week against the exam syllabus in his notebook, and made a simple mind map to plan for formal review.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepare tomorrow's supplies and wash up
description: Hang the work clothes, keys, and work badge needed for tomorrow's work and review on the hook by the door in advance, and check the electric bike's charging status. Then he washed up in the bathroom and soaked his feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime talk and lights out.
description: After getting into bed, Lu Zhenghui and his wife chatted about the day's events, including the impromptu trip to Guomao Tower in the afternoon to fix a malfunction and Zhao Qiang's improved work attitude. Wang Lijuan shared that when she picked up Hanhan, the teacher praised his drawing "My Dad" and gave it a little red flower. After catching up on family matters, at 22:10 Lu Zhenghui turned off the lamp and his phone, set the alarm for the next day, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Wake up and core training.
description: At 6:10 the alarm rang. Lu Mingqiang woke up, feeling a bit sluggish because he had gone to bed late reviewing last night, but he had a goal in mind. He put on athletic shorts, spread a non-slip mat on the living room floor, and persisted through a 15-minute core strength workout. The moves included 10 superman exercises, 3 planks (45 seconds each), and 15 glute bridges. After finishing, his lower back felt slightly warm and he felt invigorated. Since time was tight, he did not arrange a morning run today.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and sending the second son to kindergarten.
description: Lu Mingqiang quickly reheated the leftover congee from last night, fried two eggs, and finished breakfast with pickled mustard. Then he woke up his 4-year-old younger son Lu Zihan, helped him get dressed, and washed his face. He took Zihan's small backpack, got on his electric bike, and on the way dropped him off at the gate of Jinmao Center Kindergarten (about 2 km from home, an 8-minute ride). He watched Zihan being led in by the teacher before leaving with peace of mind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike through the cloudy, breezy morning, heading west along Binhai Avenue toward his company in Xiuying District. On the way, he mulled over the work he needed to handle today and thought about how he would tell his wife Juanzi about the money his older brother had remitted once he got to the office.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Report to the company; remittance received.
description: Lu Mingqiang arrived at the company on time, changed into his work clothes in the team rest room, and clocked in. Team leader Zhang briefly assigned the tasks for the day: first go to Xinghua Building on Haixiu Middle Road in the morning to handle a control cabinet tripping fault, and in the afternoon the main crew would go to the new residential area in Upper East District, Mission Hills New City, on Yangshan Avenue, Longhua District, to install electric meter boxes. As soon as he finished, Lu Mingqiang's phone vibrated. A bank text message notified him that Lu Minghua had transferred 5,000.00 yuan to him with the note "for nephew's education." His heart warmed, and he immediately dialed his elder brother's number to thank him.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Called older brother and discussed funds.
description: Lu Mingqiang walked to the corner of the break room and said with gratitude in his voice, "Brother, I got the money. It's really a lifesaver." Lu Minghua on the other end of the phone told him to take more care of Mom and Dad's health, watch his lower back, and not push himself too hard, and they agreed to meet again in Haikou during the National Day holiday. After hanging up, he immediately called Juanzi to tell her the remittance had arrived. Over the phone, they quickly discussed and decided: first use the money to cover the expenses already paid (300 yuan for the eldest son's calligraphy class and 600 yuan for the second son's kindergarten), and set aside the remaining 4,100 yuan as a dedicated education reserve. Juanzi said the money had already been planned out and told him to focus on work.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Handle the transfer and subscribe to the podcast
description: Lu Mingqiang sat in the break room, opened mobile banking, first transferred 900 yuan to his current account to cover the expenses already paid, then transferred 4,100 yuan to the family's education savings account. After that, he recorded the accounts in detail in a small notebook: date, amount, and purpose. When he finished, he opened his podcast app, searched for the 'Parents' Classroom' series, and after browsing the catalog felt the content addressed his struggles with tutoring his child, so he subscribed and planned to listen during his lunch break.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went to work in the morning: handled a fault at a commercial building
description: At 8:40, Lu Mingqiang took Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang and drove a service vehicle to Xinghua Building (about 14 minutes from the company). After arriving, he asked Zhao Qiang to test the circuit with a multimeter first, while he and Chen Jianguo quickly identified an aging contactor in one of the circuits based on fault codes and experience. He gave Zhao Qiang hands-on guidance on how to safely replace and tighten the screws, telling him to 'do one step, verify one step.' At 11:50, the fault was cleared and power was restored. On the way back to the company, he bought a bottle of water, thinking about the tough battle in the afternoon.
location: Power distribution room, Xinghua Building, 51-1 Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break: Listening to Episode 1 of "Parent School"
description: Back at the company, Lu Mingqiang got a meal from the cafeteria, ate it quickly, then slipped into the quiet break room and put on earphones. He opened the podcast app and clicked on the first episode of Parents School, How to Talk So Children Will Listen? As he listened, he reflected on his habit of always interrupting Zixuan when helping him with homework. After listening, he jotted down keywords in his phone memo: active listening, withhold judgment, listen fully before responding.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and team preparation
description: After listening to the podcast, Lu Mingqiang leaned back in his chair and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour. The afternoon installation task was going to be a tough battle, so he had to conserve his energy. At 14:00, he called Jianguo and Zhao Qiang and went to the warehouse together to pick up the meter boxes, circuit breakers, guide rails, cables, and tools needed for the afternoon, carefully counting and checking to ensure the quantities were correct. Zhao Qiang volunteered to carry the heaviest meter box for him. He patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder and said, "Good work."
location: Team rest room and warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon task: install electricity meter boxes in the newly built residential community
description: They drove to the Upper East District of Mission Hills New City (about 27 minutes by car from the company). Lu Mingqiang was in charge of wiring and fixing the electric meter box. His movements were skilled, and he carefully checked each set of wires after connecting it. He deliberately asked Zhao Qiang to watch his operation closely and ask questions at any time. Around 4 p.m., he noticed that Zhao Qiang had handed over the conduit with the wrong amount of force and nearly slipped. He patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder and said, 'Xiao Zhao, if you're tired, take a breather. Safety comes first.' Zhao Qiang replied in a low voice, 'Thank you, Master.' Lu Mingqiang thought to himself that this kid really hasn't been in good shape lately.
location: Floor electrical shaft room, Upper East District, Mission Hills New City, 39 Yangshan Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute home after work
description: At 16:30 he knocked off work. Lu Mingqiang got on his electric bike and headed back along Yangshan Avenue. The evening breeze blew over him with the smell of the countryside, making him relax. He slowed down to avoid the rush-hour traffic and took nearly 50 minutes to get home. While riding, he mulled over which chapter of Power System Analysis to study in the evening.
location: From Shangdong District, Mission Hills New City, No. 39 Yangshan Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Helping with household chores and keeping the eldest son company
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang changed into a casual T-shirt. His wife Wang Lijuan was busy in the kitchen, so he went over to help by picking vegetables and peeling garlic. His 8-year-old son Lu Zixuan came home from school, put down his backpack, and started fiddling with his tablet in the living room. He casually asked, "Do you have a lot of homework?" Zixuan replied without looking up, "Almost done." Remembering the podcast he had listened to at noon, he did not press further, and instead said, "Then let's take a look at your programming game together when you're done." Zixuan looked up in surprise: "Really?"
location: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wang Lijuan served the meal: a plate of steamed fish bought at the market that afternoon; a plate of garlic broccoli; and the stir-fried sweet potato leaves with shrimp paste that Lu Mingqiang loved. The family of four sat around the table together. As they ate, Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about what happened at the construction site that day, and his wife said the money had already been budgeted, which put the whole family at ease. The younger son Zihan chattered about funny things at kindergarten, and the room was filled with the aroma of food and the children's laughter.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Helping eldest son with homework and parent-child bonding.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, where Zixuan was doing math homework. He sat next to his son and, instead of rushing to correct him as he used to, patiently waited for him to finish a problem and then checked it together with him. When Zixuan asked about something he didn't understand, he guided him to think step by step rather than directly giving him the answer. After finishing the homework, he opened the tablet with Zixuan and watched Zixuan teach him the newly downloaded coding starter app. Zixuan looked quite professional as a little teacher.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Studying for the Senior Technician exam
description: At 7:20, Lu Mingqiang sat down in his study on time and closed the door. He spent the first half hour deliberately writing out a review plan in his notebook with a red pen: Stage 1 (September to mid-October) theoretical focus; Stage 2 (October to November) intensive exam practice; Stage 3 (November to before the exam) practical gap-filling and mock tests. Then he opened the first chapter of the thick textbook Electric Power System Analysis, marking key points and making mind maps in his notebook as he read. After 9 o'clock, he opened the question-practice app on his phone and did 20 basic exercises in a row, scoring 75% correct. He silently marked “transformer equivalent circuit” as a weak area.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Listen to music to relax.
description: After finishing a review session, Lu Mingqiang walked out of the study, feeling a little heavy-headed. He leaned back on the living room sofa, put on earphones, and played old songs from his playlist such as Beyond's 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' and 'Glorious Years.' Closing his eyes, he let the familiar melodies flow through his mind, and his tense nerves gradually relaxed. His wife Wang Lijuan poked her head out of the bedroom, saw him relaxed, and did not disturb him.
location: Living room sofa, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and family review.
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the music, got up, and washed his feet. Then he went to the second bedroom to check on his younger son Zihan, who was already sound asleep, and tucked the kicked-off blanket back over him. Then he went to the study to see his elder son Zixuan, who had finished his homework and packed his schoolbag himself. He and his wife lay on the bed. She softly asked how his review was going. He said it was okay and that he just needed to keep at it. They briefly talked about the day's events, did not discuss specific plans for tomorrow, and simply smiled at each other before getting ready to sleep.
location: Rooms at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Recording accounts and going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang took out the ledger and clearly recorded, item by item, the 5,000 yuan remittance received today from his elder brother, as well as the 900 yuan supplementary payment transferred out and the 4,100 yuan education savings, noting the dates and purposes next to each entry. After finishing all this, he felt that everything for the day had settled into place and was very at ease. He turned off the desk lamp and, at around 22:40, fell asleep peacefully with anticipation for tomorrow.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning run and core training
description: At 6 a.m., I set out from home at Banshan Garden and jogged and walked to Wanlv Garden Park, taking about 24 minutes. Then I ran a steady 5 km on the park trail, with the sea breeze on my face and birdsong around me. After the run, I did 15 minutes of core training on the wooden bench in the fitness area, including planks, crunches, and mountain climbers. Sweat soaked through my clothes. While stretching, I checked my recent weight records and felt that my body was in good shape.
location: Park trails and fitness area, Evergreen Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go home, take a shower, and have family breakfast
description: After morning exercise, I walked about 25 minutes back to my home in Banshan Garden and rinsed off the sweat. My wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast, including barbecue pork buns, boiled eggs, and pickled cucumbers. I made myself a cup of oatmeal. My second son Lu Zihan had just woken up and came out rubbing his eyes. During breakfast, I promised Xiaohan that I would tell him a sequel story to The Little Prince in the evening.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organized items for visiting family and prepared to head out.
description: After breakfast, I packed the items to take to my parents' home: knee pain patches, fresh longan, and red-fleshed dragon fruit, and put them into a reusable bag. I checked my portable tool bag and confirmed that the screwdriver, pliers, voltage tester, tape, and other tools were all there. I changed into a clean polo shirt and casual pants, looking neat and energetic, ready to go out.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: He drove to his parents' home and listened to a podcast.
description: At 8:45, he drove from Banshan Garden and headed along Longkun South Road and Guoxing Avenue to his parents' home in Meilan District. On the way, he turned on the car Bluetooth and listened to Episode 3 of the Parents School podcast, learning 'How to Deal with Children's Emotional Outbursts.' He noted the key point: 'empathize first, respond later,' planning to apply it to his eldest son Xuanxuan after returning home. The drive took about 17 minutes, and he arrived downstairs at his parents' home at 9:02.
location: Haikou, Hainan Province: from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, to Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Zone, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District.

name: Visit parents and repair electrical circuits.
description: After arriving at his parents' home, he handed the medicated plasters and fruit to his mother Chen Xiuying, and she was very happy. He sat in the living room with his father Lu Jianguo, chatting about recent events, while his mother told him to take care of his health. Then he took out his tool bag, repaired the loose five-hole socket in the living room, re-tightened the wiring, and replaced the faceplate. He also opened the main distribution box, checked the circuit breakers and wiring, and found that the occasional tripping was caused by the misoperation of the thermal protection of the aging circuit breaker. He took a photo of the model number (DZ47-63 C40) with his phone, told his father he would bring new parts next week to replace it, and planned to fully test the residual current protective device. His father told him to prepare carefully for the senior technician certificate exam.
location: Room 201, Building 3, South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Enjoy the lunch prepared by mother
description: At lunchtime, the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice drifted out of the kitchen. My mother made white-cut Wenchang chicken with chicken-oil rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with minced garlic, and winter melon and white clam soup. My appetite was whetted; I ate two bowls in a row and praised my mother's cooking. After the meal, I took the initiative to clear the dishes, but my mother pushed me out of the kitchen and told me to sit with my father and chat. In the living room, my father taught me how to check the carbon buildup on the car's spark plugs and talked about car maintenance.
location: Dining room, Room 201, Building 3, South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home and take a midday nap.
description: At 13:00, I said goodbye to my parents and drove 14 minutes back home to Banshan Garden. After changing into pajamas, I leaned back on the living room sofa, set a 30-minute alarm, and closed my eyes for a nap. Saturday afternoon was especially quiet; there was occasional birdsong from downstairs, and I soon fell into a light sleep and regained my energy.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time with the kids and gift wrapping.
description: After waking from my nap, I found my eldest son Lu Zixuan doing homework, and my second son Lu Zihan holding building blocks waiting for me. I first checked Xuanxuan's math homework, circled the errors in the word problems, and guided him to discover the confusion between multiplication and division on his own by following the approach of 'observation rather than evaluation.' After he corrected the mistakes, I gave him encouragement. Then I played with building blocks with Hanhan, and he laughed happily. While the two children were playing by themselves, I took out my collectible 2018 Haikou Daqu from the wine cabinet, wiped the bottle with a soft cloth, placed it in a red gift bag, tied it with a gold ribbon, and prepared to give it to my fellow worker Jianguo.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparations before going to KTV
description: Put on a dry polo shirt and casual pants, and tidied up his appearance. Put the wrapped baijiu into a carry bag, and checked his phone, wallet, and car keys. Knowing he would be drinking that evening, he opened the designated driver app to confirm there was enough balance, and placed the tool bag at the entrance so it would be convenient to use tomorrow.
location: Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to KTV and listened to a podcast.
description: At 17:10 he drove off from Banshan Garden, heading along Jinlong Road to Shangbang Baihui City. On the way, he continued playing Episode 2 of the Parents Academy podcast and revisited the Observing Without Evaluating chapter from Nonviolent Communication to reinforce it. There was a bit of traffic, and he arrived at the underground parking garage of Baihui City seven minutes later.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: from No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden, Longhua District to No. 2 Jinlong Road, Shangbang Baihui City, Longhua District

name: Sang karaoke to celebrate fellow worker Jianguo's birthday
description: Took the elevator to the large private room of Mei KTV on the third floor, where the workmates were already in high spirits. I handed the gift to the birthday star Chen Jianguo. After opening it, he beamed and put his arm around my shoulder, saying, "Old Lu, you're a true friend." At first I only drank coconut juice and cracked sunflower seeds while listening to Zhao Qiang belt out songs. Later, after being urged by the crowd to pick a song, I took the microphone and sang the song Friends. I was so off-key that the whole room burst into laughter, and even Team Leader Zhang laughed and slapped his thigh. As the atmosphere grew lively, I made an exception and drank more than half a bottle of beer, clinked glasses with Jianguo, and said, "We're brothers for life." Team Leader Zhang came over, patted me on the shoulder, and said, "Mingqiang, keep working hard. Once you get the senior technician certificate, I'll be the first to treat you to a drink." Everyone cut the birthday cake, sang and chatted, and returned home fully satisfied.
location: Large private room at Mei KTV AI Assisted Singing (Shangbang Baihui City Branch), 3rd Floor, Shangbang Baihui City, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After the gathering, called a designated driver and went home.
description: The gathering ended at 22:00, and he said goodbye to his workmates. Since he had been drinking, he couldn't drive, so he called a designated driver in advance. During the 10 minutes waiting for the driver at the KTV entrance, he savored the joy of the evening in the night breeze — Jianguo's surprise when opening the gift, his own embarrassment when he sang off-key, and Team Leader Zhang's encouragement. The designated driver, Driver Wang, arrived at 22:10. He sat in the passenger seat and rolled down the window; the night breeze brushed his face, coconut shadows receded, and he arrived home at 22:33.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (returned home by designated driver).

name: Returning home, winding down, and going to bed
description: After returning home, my wife Wang Lijuan was still awake. Seeing me back, she made a cup of warm honey water and handed it to me. After drinking it, my stomach felt much warmer. I briefly shared amusing stories from the gathering with her, mentioning how excited Jianguo was when he received the gift and how everyone laughed at my singing off-key; my wife laughed too. I decided to skip the senior technician review tonight and relax completely, and she nodded in agreement. Then I washed up quickly, changed into pajamas, and quietly went to my younger son's room to take a look at little Han asleep. Lying in bed, the slight tipsiness from the alcohol blended with the fullness of the day; the faces of family and coworkers flashed through my mind, and I soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Room 503, Building 2, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run, met a fellow runner
description: The sky was faintly light. Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally before the alarm. After a quick wash, he put on running shoes and quick-dry clothes, and rode his bike to Wanlv Garden Park. Arriving at about 6:45, he warmed up for 5 minutes and started running at 6:50, aiming for 4 kilometers. When he reached the third kilometer, he met his running friend Chen Bin on the seaside path in the park. The two jogged side by side. Chen Bin talked about his son's interest in mathematics and recommended a math enlightenment app called 'Number Sense Planet'. Lu Mingqiang noted the name and planned to try it with Zixuan. After completing the 4 kilometers, they did 15 minutes of core training in the exercise equipment area.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went home, took a shower, and had breakfast
description: Lu Mingqiang returned home; the children had just been woken up by his wife, Wang Lijuan. He went into the bathroom for a quick shower and changed into home clothes. His wife had already cooked plain rice porridge and fried eggs with ham sausages. Lu Mingqiang sat down to eat breakfast and told his wife that he would go swimming in the morning and fly kites in the afternoon. The children cheered excitedly when they heard this.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Lu Mingqiang helped pack the children's swimming gear, including swimsuits, goggles, bath towels, and kickboards, and put his own power bank, phone, and car keys into a waterproof bag. His wife Wang Lijuan also put bottled water and cut-up fruit into the bag. Everything was ready and they were about to leave.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child swimming class
description: The family of four drove to the community swimming pool and got into the water at 8:40. Lu Mingqiang acted as a temporary coach. He first guided his eldest son Lu Zixuan through reviewing the breaststroke kick and breathing, encouraged him to swim 5 meters independently, and offered support. Then he held his second son Lu Zihan while practicing breath-holding and arm strokes; the little one had a great time. Lu Mingqiang also swam a 25-meter lap during a break while his wife shot video in the shallow area.
location: Swimming Pool, Banshan Garden Community Fitness Center, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return home to rest and regroup.
description: After swimming, they went home, and the children took showers and changed clothes. Lu Mingqiang dried his hair, made a cup of hot tea, and sat on the living room sofa to rest, planning to start reviewing at 10 o'clock. After a short rest, he got up and walked to the study.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning focused on tutoring.
description: Lu Mingqiang entered the study in high spirits, opened the textbook "Power System Analysis" and his notebook, and systematically studied the chapter "Transformer Working Principle and Equivalent Circuit." While following the formula derivations, he drew equivalent circuit diagrams on scratch paper and took detailed notes. When he felt tired from studying, he got up and walked around or looked out the window to relax, then continued focusing on his studies.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and sharing
description: His wife made Lu Mingqiang's favorite tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried vegetables, and brought out the pickled cabbage she had brought back from her mother's place yesterday. During the meal, his eldest son Lu Zixuan showed off his swimming performance. Lu Mingqiang smiled and patted his head, and promised to help him find materials for tomorrow's science class in the evening.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes. Feeling drowsy, he set an alarm for 13:40 and lay down on the bed in the master bedroom. After closing his eyes, he reviewed the transformer ratio formula he learned in the morning, and soon fell into a light sleep.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon preparation and household tidying
description: After the alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up and washed his face; his wife would need to go to the community in the afternoon to help with the ledgers. He and the children changed into sun-protection jackets and sneakers, took out the traditional sand-swallow kite and a children's kite from the balcony cabinet, and checked that the bamboo frame and line spool were intact. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, helped carry the tape, and his second son, Lu Zihan, held the water bottle.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family flies kites in the park.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove with his two children to Baishamen Park and arrived at the parking lot at 14:55. They flew kites on the large lawn. Lu Mingqiang skillfully got the swallow kite up into the sky. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, took over the spool and ran, while his younger son, Lu Zihan, stood on tiptoe trying to catch the line. Lu Mingqiang also helped Zihan lift a small kite to try pulling the string. Wang Lijuan called via video during a break from community work. Seeing the kite in the sky and the children's smiling faces, she happily asked them to take photos and post them to Moments.
location: Baishamen Park Great Lawn, Haidian Sixth West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon snacks by the park
description: After an hour of kite flying, the children were hungry and thirsty. Lu Mingqiang took them to the "Granny Noodle Shop" near the west gate of the park and ordered two bowls of Hainan noodles, one bowl of Baoluo noodles, and a few skewers of meatballs. Lu Zixuan wolfed down his food. Lu Zihan ate with a spoon by himself, spilling about half, but he was very happy. Lu Mingqiang drank lemon water and also had a bowl of noodles.
location: Grandma's Rice Noodle Shop near the west gate of Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth West Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return home.
description: After the snack, Lu Mingqiang took the children to browse the stalls at the park entrance. Lu Zixuan bought a flying Superman toy, and Lu Zihan picked out a colorful pinwheel. After the meal, they returned to the work site, and he leaned back against the seat of the work truck, resting with his eyes closed for about 10 minutes.

I was assigned to focus on Building A, which had the most problems. name: Inspection and repair of distribution cabinets in Jinmao Residential Area
description: After arriving at Jinmao Residential Area, I contacted Property Manager Wang. Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang were responsible for Buildings B and C, while I inspected Building A alone. When I opened the distribution cabinet in Building A, I smelled a musty odor and found verdigris on two screws at the bottom. Using a megohmmeter, I tested the line insulation at only 0.2 megohms and confirmed that moisture intrusion due to aged sealing gaskets had caused a damp short circuit. I immediately pulled the main breaker and put up a warning sign. Together with Jianguo, I replaced the gaskets and corroded screws, sanded the verdigris off the terminal bars, retested the insulation to above 5 megohms, and then restored power. Afterwards, I inspected Buildings B and C, confirmed no abnormalities, and suggested to Manager Wang adding moisture-proof boxes and regularly checking the sealing rings. I filled out and signed the maintenance record.
location: Electrical distribution rooms in each building of Jinmao Residential Community, No. 4, Guomao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Team Leader Zhang praised the rapid response during this maintenance and reminded everyone to guard against the upcoming typhoon and heavy rain, keeping communications open.

name: Handle personal matters on the commute home from work
description: After work, he changed into casual clothes and called his squash partner Lin Feng from the company locker room to cancel that evening's squash practice, because the overtime repair work had made it too late. He then called Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store to order two servings of iced coconut milk dessert. Cycling from the company, he took Haisheng Road, turned onto Longkun South Road, stopped by Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store at No. 19 Yusha Road to pick up the dessert, and then rode another 10 minutes back to his home in Banshan Garden.
location: Starting from the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing by the Xiangzhi General Store in the Chengzhongcheng Community at No. 19 Yusha Road, and arriving at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Evening family interaction and dinner.
description: After arriving home, I put the qingbuliang in the fridge, interacted with my second son, and checked the eldest son's homework progress. After changing into loose sportswear, I went into the kitchen to help my wife prepare dinner, including washing vegetables, cutting ingredients, and cooking rice, chatting about my inspection and repair experiences while working. Dinner was my wife's signature sauerkraut fish and stir-fried lettuce. At the table, I used the specific encouragement technique I had just learned to praise Zixuan for his earnest attitude in studying the concept of fractions, and Zihan also shared the painting activity from kindergarten. After dinner, I took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes, while my wife bathed Zihan. Then I went into the study. For the word problem Zixuan was stuck on, I guided him with questions to figure out the solution himself, once again practicing the 'describing behavior' way of encouragement.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening professional study.
description: Alone in my study, I reviewed the textbook "Relay Protection". Taking a damp short-circuit fault I actually handled during the day as a case, I drew circuit diagrams and worked through the setting value calculation when the secondary side of the current transformer is open-circuited. To prevent prolonged sitting from worsening the load on my shoulders and neck, I planned to get up and stretch every 45 minutes. I eventually completed the exercises in the setting value calculation section, closely combining theory with practice.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shoulder and neck relaxation and preparation for bed.
description: After sitting at a desk for a long time, my shoulders and neck were noticeably sore. I ended my study session and went to the living room to rest, playing Beyond's "Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies" to relax. My wife applied a hot towel to my shoulders and neck and massaged with medicated oil to relieve the discomfort. Then I noted down weekend to-dos in my phone's memo app: take my eldest son to the city library to get a library card, and visit my parents on Sunday and check their main circuit breaker. After that, I washed up and got ready for bed.
location: Living room and bathroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After washing up, he changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reading Calm Mind, Slow Life for more than ten minutes to let his thoughts drift away from circuit calculations. At 21:30 he turned off the lights and lay down, reviewing the day's fulfilling schedule: successfully eliminating a safety hazard, applying what he learned to improve parent-child communication, and although the evening review was somewhat uncomfortable, it was very rewarding. He gradually fell asleep feeling grounded and content.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Early-morning run in the rain and targeted stretching
description: At 5:50 in the morning the alarm went off. Hearing the patter of rain outside the window, I still put on quick-dry clothes, took an umbrella, and walked to Wanlv Garden Park. Seeing that the rain was not heavy, I jogged 5 kilometers in the rain at a pace of about 5:50 per kilometer. Sweat mixed with rain, and the air felt especially fresh. After the run, I took shelter under the park corridor, completed 15 minutes of core training, and did targeted stretching for my stiff and sore shoulders and neck. I held each movement for 30 seconds, and the discomfort was noticeably relieved.
location: Walkways and corridors in Evergreen Park at No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home, take a shower, and have breakfast with the family.
description: Returned home to Banshan Garden at 6:50 and immediately took a hot shower. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: white rice porridge, fried sunny-side-up eggs, and water spinach with shrimp paste. During the meal, his wife mentioned that the kindergarten had a Mid-Autumn Festival activity that day, and Zihan needed to bring mooncakes to share. Lu Mingqiang told his second son Lu Zihan to listen to the teacher. Finished eating and tidied up at 7:15, then got ready to leave for work.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son, Lu Zihan, to kindergarten.
description: Put on a raincoat, rode an e-bike carrying his second son Lu Zihan, who was wrapped up warmly, to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. Arrived at the gate at 7:25, and a teacher came out with an umbrella to greet them. Lu Mingqiang took a mooncake box out of the trunk and handed it to Zihan, straightened his raincoat collar for him, and watched him walk into the kindergarten chatting happily with the teacher before turning the bike around with relief.
location: At the entrance of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to company
description: Starting from the kindergarten, he rode west along Binhai Avenue, passed Xiuying Port, and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park about 10 minutes later. He pushed the electric scooter into the canopy, locked it, and walked quickly into the maintenance workshop.

name: Pre-shift meeting, organizing the tool warehouse, and Zhao Qiang's resignation
description: At 8 o’clock, he attended the maintenance workshop pre-shift meeting on time. Team Leader Zhang summarized the previous day’s repairs and emphasized safety during wet, humid working conditions in the rainy season. After the meeting, he went to the tool warehouse with Zhao Qiang and Chen Jianguo to thoroughly organize and inventory it. They sorted the scattered tools by model and purpose, put them on shelves, and marked them with marker pens. During the sorting, he noticed that Zhao Qiang’s movements were odd and his eyes were evasive, and he sensed something was up. At around 10:30, while resting in a corner, Zhao Qiang quietly mentioned resigning, saying that his family was urging him to get married, the woman wanted him to return to the county town of Yongzhou, and his father was not in good health. Lu Mingqiang was silent for a moment, then firmly patted him on the shoulder to show understanding and support, praised him for having completed his apprenticeship, and promised to treat him to a farewell meal. He then gave Zhao Qiang his cherished electrician’s knife and ratchet wrench as a gift. The two continued finishing up, and by 11:30 the warehouse was neat and orderly. He took a photo and posted it to the team group chat, earning praise.
location: Meeting room and tool warehouse of the maintenance workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Handle the repair request for No. 2 Distribution Room in the park
description: Just after finishing tidying the warehouse, a walkie-talkie message came from Squad Leader Zhang saying that a light was out in Distribution Room No. 2 of the park. Lu Mingqiang immediately took his toolbox and went there. After inspection, he found that a rectifier had burned out, quickly replaced it with a new one, and also tightened a few loose screws nearby to ensure the distribution room operated normally.
location: Power Distribution Room No. 2, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and looking for job recruitment information for my apprentice.
description: At noon, I went alone to the usual 'Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant' near the company and ordered a braised pig trotter rice set meal. While waiting, I thought of my apprentice Zhao Qiang. I opened my phone and in the 'Yongzhou Electricians Hometown Group' found two local recruitment notices for electricians. The pay and company scale looked reliable, so I forwarded them directly to Zhao Qiang with an encouraging note. After the meal, I had a bowl of free mung bean soup.
location: ‘Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast-Food Restaurant’ near Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch break and shoulder and neck relaxation exercises
description: Back at the company, take a lunch break on a folding chair in the workshop duty room. Although he did not fall deeply asleep, he rested with his eyes closed and recalled the “communicate with empathy” mentioned in yesterday's Parent School. He felt that his handling of Zhao Qiang today was exactly in line with this. Afterwards, he did a 5-minute shoulder and neck relaxation exercise, and the fatigue in his shoulders and neck was greatly reduced.
location: Workshop duty room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon inspections and equipment maintenance in old residential communities.
description: In the afternoon, partnered with Chen Jianguo, he went to two old residential communities along Binhai Avenue, Electric Power Garden and Haiyun Dormitory, for the regular inspection of power distribution rooms. They carefully checked cable joints, transformer oil temperature, and switchgear operation. At Haiyun Dormitory, they found a corroded grounding wire, immediately recorded it, and took photos to report for repair. The two worked well together and completed the task efficiently.
location: Power distribution rooms of Dianli Garden and Haiyun Dormitory along Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company to report on work and record pending items.
description: Returned to the industrial park and reported the afternoon inspection results in detail to Team Leader Zhang, submitting the record sheet. Then, at the workstation, wrote down two to-dos in a notebook: 1. Saturday evening farewell dinner for Zhao Qiang at "Jiamie Food Stall"; 2. Buy a cervical spine massager on the way home after work.
location: Maintenance Workshop Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After work, pick up the children and buy groceries and medicine on the way
description: After clocking out, I first went to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Zihan. On the way, I stopped at Xiangzhi Daily Necessities Shop in Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, and bought some cookies and two Cantonese mooncakes. After picking up Zihan, I went to a nearby pharmacy on the way and spent 168 yuan on a pulsed cervical spine massager, which Zihan looked at curiously.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Xiangzhi General Merchandise and Daily Necessities Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road; and nearby pharmacy.

name: At home, helped his wife prepare dinner and talked about the apprentice's resignation.
description: Arrived home at about 17:30, changed into home clothes, then washed hands and helped peel garlic and pick vegetables. While working, he told his wife Wang Lijuan about Zhao Qiang resigning and returning to his hometown. His wife sighed that the young man was steady and it was a pity for him to leave; she supported hosting a farewell dinner on the weekend and suggested adding a Wenchang chicken dish. Lu Mingqiang felt warm at heart and smiled in agreement.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family time
description: The family sat around the dining table, which had stir-fried bitter melon with eggs, steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and chicken soup. Lu Mingqiang first asked his eldest son Zixuan about his homework. Learning that the math test was a bit hard, he agreed to review it together after dinner. He then picked out some fish for his younger son Zihan. Zihan happily said he had shared mooncakes with his classmates today and was praised by the teacher. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Zixuan went to the study. Zixuan took out his math test paper, on which several word problems were left blank. Lu Mingqiang used the listening skills he learned from Parents' School to have Zixuan read the problems aloud and guided him to find the key to solving them on his own. Zixuan tried drawing diagrams to analyze, while Lu Mingqiang nodded and encouraged from the side, without directly giving the answers.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal review of 'Relay Protection' and trying out the massager.
description: After finishing homework tutoring, Lu Mingqiang made a cup of tea, took out the textbook "Relay Protection," and planned to review the numerical calculation of transformer differential protection. After half an hour of study, his shoulders and neck became sore, so he stopped and put the massage device around his neck, switched it to pulse mode, closed his eyes, and listened to the song "Friends" to relax for 10 minutes. Then he focused on working through two typical calculation problems until 9 p.m.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and wife assisting with a hot compress on the neck.
description: Feeling a bit dazed after the review, Lu Mingqiang tidied his desk and went to the bathroom to wash up. When he came out, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared a hot water bottle and a towel, and skillfully applied the hot towel to the back of his neck. The soreness gradually eased. The couple then chatted about forwarding the job recruitment information to Zhao Qiang and how moved he had been at the time, and they both sighed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Before bed, listened to music, recorded his mood, and fell asleep
description: After a 15-minute hot compress, his whole body relaxed. Lying in bed, he played the song 'Friends' on his phone again, closed his eyes, and listened quietly. His thoughts drifted from the days when he learned the trade under Master Li to now seeing off his own apprentice, leaving him feeling mixed emotions but also a master's pride. After the song, he wrote in his phone's notepad: 'Today I saw off an apprentice and also found a good massager. My review is going okay; I'll keep at it.' He set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning, turned off the light at 22:45, and slowly fell asleep listening to the rain outside the window.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning exercise and family breakfast
description: At 6:15 a.m., the phone alarm goes off on time. Lu Mingqiang quickly climbs out of bed to avoid waking his sleeping wife and children. After a quick wash, he changes into a tank top and shorts and does 15 minutes of core training on the living room carpet. Because his shoulders and neck were sore yesterday, he deliberately adds cat-cow and neck lateral flexion stretching, which makes him feel much better. After training, he takes a shower and changes into a long-sleeved work uniform. Then he goes to the kitchen to put frozen steamed buns into the steamer and warm up the milk. His wife Wang Lijuan also gets up and takes over frying eggs and cutting fruit. Lu Mingqiang fills the children's water bottles with warm water and puts them in the side pockets of their school bags. Then he goes to wake up his 8-year-old eldest son, Lu Zixuan, urging him to wash up, and helps his 4-year-old younger son, Lu Zihan, put on his kindergarten uniform. The family of four sits around the table eating steamed buns, fried eggs, and drinking milk. Lu Mingqiang tells his wife that today he needs to go to Haisheng Road to replace street lamp cables and may be late, and his wife reminds him to take precautions against heatstroke.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dropping off the child at school and commuting by car.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to take his youngest son Hanhan to the gate of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. After watching him greet a teacher, swipe his card, and enter the kindergarten, he rode back to Banshan Garden with peace of mind. He parked the electric bike, switched to the family car, adjusted the seat, and set the navigation to the company. While driving, he connected to the car's Bluetooth and played Episode 4 of Parents' School, which was about managing impatience when helping with homework. The host's 'deep-breathing pause method' and 'big-task splitting method' resonated with him. While waiting at a red light on Binhai Avenue, he took out his phone and jotted down keywords like 'pause 10 seconds' and 'step-by-step guidance' in his memo.
location: Along the route from Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, to 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Arrive at the company, pick up tools, and attend the morning meeting
description: Arriving at the parking lot of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, Lu Mingqiang walked to the team meeting room. According to the arrangement before the morning meeting, he first went to the tool warehouse to pick up the insulating tape, heat-shrink tubing, wire crimping pliers, and gloves needed for the day's work, and loaded them onto the pickup truck. Then he attended the team morning meeting. Team leader Zhang assigned the key task: a section of streetlight cables on Haisheng Road, which had aged due to typhoon damage, needed to be replaced. Team leader Zhang named Lu Mingqiang and his colleague Chen Jianguo to work together as partners, and reminded them to guard against heatstroke and follow safety operating procedures.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Proceed to the worksite for cable replacement work
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo loaded the tools and materials onto the pickup, and Jianguo drove to the work site on Haisheng Road. After arriving, they set up warning signs and traffic cones. Lu Mingqiang skillfully climbed the insulated ladder, removed the old, aging cables, and checked the wires for wear. The sun was blazing, and his work clothes were soon soaked with sweat. Jianguo assisted below, handing up new cables and tools. Lu Mingqiang carefully insulated each joint to make sure everything was foolproof. During the work, he occasionally turned his neck to relieve the obvious soreness between his shoulder blades, but his hands never stopped.
location: Work site, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned to rest and had lunch with colleagues.
description: The morning work came to an end. Lu Mingqiang returned to the company, washed his face vigorously with hand sanitizer, and drank a big glass of plain boiled water in the break room. Then he went with Jianguo to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and ordered two servings of the signature spicy soup rice and one serving of white-cut Wenchang chicken. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang mentioned that he planned to treat his friend Zhao Qiang, who was about to return to his hometown in Hunan, to a farewell dinner tomorrow evening. Jianguo immediately said he wanted to join. Lu Mingqiang then took out his phone, found the number of the Hainanese restaurant he often went to in his contacts, called and booked a private room for 6:30 tomorrow evening, and sent a message to Zhao Qiang to confirm.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break and preparation before the weekly meeting
description: After the meal, he returned to the company. Lu Mingqiang dozed for 20 minutes on the recliner in the team break room, setting an alarm for 13:20. When the alarm went off, he got up, washed his face, picked up his notebook and pen, and walked into the meeting room five minutes early to prepare for the afternoon weekly meeting.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team weekly meeting and communication with the manager
description: At the start of the weekly meeting, Squad Leader Zhang summarized the week's work and specifically praised Lu Mingqiang for proactively discovering a major moisture-related short-circuit hazard during maintenance of the distribution cabinets in Jinmao Community. Manager Liu from the Engineering Department then asked Lu Mingqiang about his preparation for the senior technician exam and encouraged him to work harder, noting that the company provides subsidies for obtaining certificates. Lu Mingqiang said he had been reviewing all along and had just made some headway with the relay protection section, and would step it up. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang caught up with Manager Liu, gave a brief update on his review progress and the difficulties he had encountered, and Manager Liu encouraged him to make more use of the company's resource database and promised to arrange for key technical staff to answer his questions.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Homework wrap-up and tool return
description: Lu Mingqiang and Jianguo returned to the work site on Haisheng Road and completed the remaining two streetlight cable splices. They tested the insulation of the newly installed lines one by one. After confirming the data were up to standard, they inventoried the tools and waste materials and put away the warning signs. Then they returned to the company, where Lu Mingqiang wiped the used tools clean, returned them to the tool warehouse, and signed off on the requisition record.
location: Work site on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the tool warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: After-work commute and refueling along the way.
description: After packing his personal belongings, Lu Mingqiang drove away from the company. Considering that he had a dinner gathering and needed to pick up the kids the next day, he stopped by the Sinopec Xiuying gas station near Jinmao that he usually went to and filled up with No. 92 gasoline. While refueling, he opened his phone to check the weekend weather forecast and saw it would be cloudy then clear, thinking that on Sunday he could take the kids to Wanlv Garden Park to fly kites. After refueling, he drove home along Haixiu Expressway, and the car steadily entered Banshan Garden Residential Community.
location: Along the route from Sinopec Xiuying Gas Station, No. 107-111 Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Help with household chores and family interaction
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang changed into loungewear. His wife, Wang Lijuan, was already busy in the kitchen. He washed his hands and helped pick vegetables and peel garlic. His 8-year-old elder son, Lu Zixuan, was doing homework in the living room, while his 4-year-old younger son, Lu Zihan, was building blocks nearby, humming a newly learned nursery rhyme. Lu Mingqiang mentioned to his wife that they would treat Zhao Qiang to dinner tomorrow night; she said it was the right thing to do and told him to go without worry.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family sat around the table for dinner. During the meal, Zixuan told funny stories from school that day, while Hanhan boasted that his painting had been put up on the wall by the teacher. Lu Mingqiang listened attentively, occasionally putting food on the children's plates, feeling the warmth of family and the day's fatigue disappear.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping the child with homework and confirming the farewell dinner arrangements.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went to the study to help Zixuan with his math homework. When Zixuan got stuck on a word problem, Lu Mingqiang was about to point out the mistake directly, but remembering the 'deep-breathing pause method' he had learned in the morning, he took a deep breath to suppress his impatience and guided Zixuan to read the problem sentence by sentence, breaking the big problem into smaller ones. In the end, Zixuan wrote down the correct equation. After the tutoring session, he went to the living room and called Zhao Qiang, joking, 'I've booked the spot for tomorrow night—don't stand me up.' Zhao Qiang laughed and promised he'd be there. The two chatted for a bit about Zhao Qiang's preparations for returning to Hunan.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Review preparation and mock test
description: Lu Mingqiang returned to his study, turned on the desk lamp, laid out the "Relay Protection" review materials, calculator, and scratch paper, and set an activity alarm on his phone to ring every 45 minutes. He brewed a cup of strong tea and began concentrating on a comprehensive mock exam. When the alarm went off in between, he stood up, paced around the study, stretched his neck, shoulders, and arms, drank some water, then continued.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Check answers and achieve a score breakthrough
description: After finishing the test questions, Lu Mingqiang took out the answer key and checked and graded each one. When he calculated the total score as 82, he let out a long sigh of relief—this was the first time he had broken 80 since he started reviewing. He carefully analyzed the questions he got wrong, wrote detailed notes in his mistake notebook about the reasons and correct steps, and his confidence grew greatly.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shoulder and neck hot compress and health records.
description: Prolonged desk work worsened the pain in his shoulders and neck. Lu Mingqiang walked out of the study, and his wife Wang Lijuan noticed his expression. She had him lie on the sofa, applied a hot towel to the back of his neck, then poured some liniment and rubbed his shoulders and trapezius muscles for about 10 minutes. Lu Mingqiang opened the memo app on his phone, created a new "Health Management" category, formally recorded "mild shoulder and neck soreness", and set up a care plan.
location: Living room and bedroom of Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wash up and relax
description: Lu Mingqiang washed up, changed into pajamas, tilted his head back to stretch his neck, and felt his muscles were much more relaxed after the hot compress.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family evening interaction and bedtime preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang walked into the children's room, tucked the quilt around Hanhan, who was already lying in bed, and listened to Zixuan recite tomorrow's lesson. Back in the master bedroom, he chatted with his wife about Zixuan's studies. He lay down on the bed, pinned the reminder for tomorrow's dinner gathering to the top of the notification list, checked the shoulder and neck care alarm, then turned off the light and began to drift off to sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep

In his mind, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the day's gains: he received praise at the weekly meeting, made a breakthrough in his review, and found ways to relieve his physical discomfort. His mood was calm and content, his breathing gradually became even and long, and he slipped peacefully into sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: After the alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up, washed up briefly, and changed into quick-drying workout clothes. At 06:00 he walked across Binhai Avenue and entered Wanlv Garden Park. He jogged 4 kilometers on the inner loop of the park in about 25 minutes, then did 15 minutes of core training and shoulder and neck stretches on a bench beside Coconut Grove Plaza, focusing on the cat stretch and lateral neck flexion to relieve the soreness from last night's studying. During the exercise, he felt a bit upset thinking that his apprentice Zhao Qiang would be leaving tonight.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.
