description: After the morning run, Lu Mingqiang returned home, took a quick shower, and changed into his work clothes. His wife, Wang Lijuan, was already preparing breakfast. He walked into the room of his younger son, Lu Zihan, gently woke him up, and helped him put on the T-shirt he would wear to kindergarten. Then he washed up himself. His wife handed him a cup of warm soy milk, which he finished in a few gulps. He took the opportunity to tell her that he would be going out in the evening with Jianguo to give Zhao Qiang a farewell dinner, so she shouldn't wait for him for dinner.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode an e-bike to take the two children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang went downstairs holding his second son Lu Zihan by one hand and the electric bike key in the other. He rode the bike for 5 minutes to take Hanhan to the entrance of Jinmao Center Kindergarten, watched him enter the campus with his teacher; then turned the bike around and arrived at Longfeng Experimental Primary School at 07:20, where his elder son Lu Zixuan was already waiting by the roadside with his schoolbag. He handed Xuanxuan a thermos cup and told him to go home by himself after school at noon. Xuanxuan took the cup and ran into the school gate to attend the Saturday math club activity.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Guomao Third Horizontal Road, Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and Hainan Province, Haikou City, Meilan District, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School.

name: Low-voltage line inspection and worksite lunch
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike along Binhai Avenue and Haixiu Road, arriving at the company at 07:50. He, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang drove a work truck to the old neighborhood in Meilan District to inspect the low-voltage overhead lines along Haifu Road and Heping South Road and trim branches that might interfere with the lines. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of trimming with the pole pruner, Jianguo supervised, and Zhao Qiang recorded and handed over tools. In the hot and stuffy weather, everyone's backs were drenched in sweat, and Zhao Qiang worked especially briskly. After finishing at 12:00, the three drove back near the company and had lunch at "Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant." Lu Mingqiang ordered the braised pork knuckle rice set, Jianguo ordered yimian, and Zhao Qiang ordered the same thing. During the meal, they only talked about work and did not mention saying goodbye. After the meal, Jianguo drove back to the company, and Lu Mingqiang rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes in the front passenger seat.
location: Low-voltage line site along Haifu Road and Heping South Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to the "Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant" near the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District; then returned to the company.

name: Organized tools, said goodbye to Zhao Qiang, and wrapped up the work.
description: Back at the company, the three of them organized and inventoried the instruments and tools in the tool warehouse. Zhao Qiang took the initiative to polish the pole pruner until it shone. Around 14:00, the squad leader announced that there was no field work in the afternoon. Zhao Qiang walked up to Lu Mingqiang, who was taking inventory of multimeters, and solemnly said that he had completed the formalities and wanted to say a formal goodbye. Lu Mingqiang took out an old multimeter that had accompanied him for ten years from his tool bag and gave it to Zhao Qiang as a keepsake, and again reminded him of the safety tips. Zhao Qiang bowed with tears in his eyes to thank him, while Jianguo watched silently. After seeing Zhao Qiang off, Lu Mingqiang and Jianguo organized the patrol inspection records, entered two line hazards into the system, and at 16:00 called the reserved restaurant to change the dinner time from 17:30 to 18:00 and add one serving of grilled fish.
location: Tool warehouse and maintenance workshop, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After work, pick up the children on an electric bike and go home
description: At 16:40, Lu Mingqiang changed into casual clothes, left the company on his electric bike, first picked up his eldest son Lu Zixuan from Longfeng Experimental Primary School, then stopped by Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Lu Zihan. The two children squeezed into the back seat, and they arrived home around 17:25. He told Xuanxuan to take Hanhan to wash their hands and eat fruit, briefly informed his wife Wang Lijuan that he was going out to drop someone off, then changed into a clean collared T-shirt, took his phone and power bank, and got ready to leave.
location: Hainan Elevator Accessories Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, then to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, and finally to Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Farewell dinner and send-off for apprentice Zhao Qiang
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike carrying Chen Jianguo to the company gate to meet Zhao Qiang, who was holding his luggage. The three drove an engineering vehicle to the reserved Yushang Jianglai Xinjiang Restaurant on Jinlong Road (changed at the last minute because the originally booked Hainanese restaurant had a wedding banquet). In the private room on the second floor, he ordered signature dishes such as big plate chicken, roasted lamb chops, and belt noodles, and made an exception by pouring local beer for everyone. During the meal, he raised his glass and said to Zhao Qiang: "In the electrical trade, you can always make a living anywhere. Build solid skills and don't embarrass your master." The three chatted about past emergency repairs, and the atmosphere was sincere and somewhat melancholy. Lu Mingqiang drank the better part of a bottle of beer. After settling the bill of 368 yuan at around 19:00, the three shook hands and said goodbye at the restaurant entrance. Lu Mingqiang watched Zhao Qiang drag his suitcase toward the bus stop.
location: Second-floor private room and entrance of Yushang Jianglai Xinjiang Halal Restaurant (Haikou Jinlong Road Branch), No. 10 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Took a taxi home alone.
description: After saying goodbye, Lu Mingqiang parted with Chen Jianguo. He used his phone to hail a ride-hailing car and sat in the back seat looking out at the night scenery, thinking all the while about Zhao Qiang. At about 20:00, the car stopped at the entrance of Banshan Garden, and he got out and went home.
location: Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talked with his wife and received a massage.
description: After returning home, his wife Wang Lijuan saw that Lu Mingqiang was exhausted and handed him a glass of warm water. He sat on the sofa and poured out his feelings of loss after seeing off his apprentice. His wife held his hand to comfort him. The soreness in his shoulder and neck flared up again. He frowned and rubbed his shoulder. His wife asked him to lie face down on the bed, then took out medicated oil and carefully applied it while massaging his shoulders and back. Her gentle technique gradually smoothed his furrowed brow. Lu Mingqiang didn't review his studies; he just wanted to lie down and rest.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening review of missed questions.
description: After a short rest, Lu Mingqiang sat down at the study desk and opened the textbook "Relay Protection". Though not in the mood to try new problems, he reviewed the solution approaches for several multiple-choice questions he had previously missed. Because he was restless, his accuracy was only around 70 percent, which made him somewhat irritated.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Listening to music to unwind and evening wash-up
description: At 21:20, Lu Mingqiang closed the book, opened the music app on his phone, turned down the volume, and played the song "Friends" on repeat for two rounds. The lyric "friends walk together through life" calmed him down a bit. Afterward, he went to the bathroom to wash up and applied a hot towel to his shoulder to relieve the discomfort.
location: Study and bathroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After applying face cream, Lu Mingqiang returned to the master bedroom, said "going to sleep" to his wife who was leaning against the headboard, then turned off the light and lay down. Because of the alcohol and things on his mind, his sleep was not deep. He turned over unconsciously several times, entered light sleep at about 22:15, and only fell into a deep sleep around 22:50. His weight that day was about 71.2 kg.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning preparation and morning jog
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the morning light coming through the curtain gap woke Lu Mingqiang. He woke up 15 minutes earlier than his alarm, and the soreness in his shoulders and neck seemed lighter than yesterday. After a quick wash, he put on running shoes and sports shorts, and at 6:30 drove to Baishamen Park (about a 15-minute drive). He arrived at 6:45 and jogged 3 kilometers along the seaside path at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. On the way, he happened to meet his running friend Chen Bin (a freight delivery worker) and chatted while running. Chen Bin recommended a workshop in Meilan District that specialized in restoring old objects. After the run, he did two sets of pull-ups and shoulder and neck stretches in the park's fitness area, fully loosening up his body. At 7:10 he drove home and arrived at 7:25.
location: Baishamen Park, Haidian Sixth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and family time.
description: Got home at 7:25, took a warm shower, and changed into dry loungewear. For breakfast, he fried two eggs and had a serving of whole wheat bread with unsweetened soy milk, and quickly browsed several WeChat official account articles from 'Electrician Tool Collection' on his phone. At 7:55, his wife Wang Lijuan and the two children got up one after another. Xuanxuan rubbed his eyes and asked where they would go. Lu Mingqiang announced that the whole family would go to the community swimming pool in the morning, and the two children cheered. His wife suggested going to the supermarket after swimming.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organizing the tool cabinet and discovering a hobby
description: At 8:25, while his wife and children were eating breakfast, Lu Mingqiang fulfilled his morning idea—organizing the balcony tool cabinet. He found a few old wooden-handled screwdrivers and an old wire stripper. Feeling nostalgic, he carefully wiped them with a rag and unexpectedly discovered a rusty but clearly labeled Shanghai "Liya" brand electrician's knife (his father's old working tool). He put it away carefully and took a photo to save in his album. The more he wiped, the more absorbed he became, and the idea of creating a display area came to him.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the swimming pool for parent-child swimming
description: At 9:40, he asked the family to change into swimsuits, took towels and swimming gear, and drove to the World Trade Yayuan Hot Spring Swimming Pool (about an 11-minute drive). Arrived at 10:00, changed into swim trunks and got into the water. He guided Xuanxuan in practicing the frog kick, and held Hanhan's float board to help him get used to the water. While the children played by themselves, he swam a satisfying 350 meters; the buoyancy of the water relaxed his tense neck and shoulder muscles considerably. At 11:00, he sat by the pool to rest and chatted with a retired welder next to him about the brands of old welding machines used to repair bridges in his youth, feeling he had gained more knowledge.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 2 Shimao East Road, Shimao Yayuan Hot Spring Swimming Pool

name: Shopping on the way home and setting up a display area
description: At 11:20, he drove home (about a 6-minute drive). On the way, he stopped at Jiajia Supermarket on Jinmao Middle Road near home. His wife went in to buy some fruit and vegetables, while Lu Mingqiang and the children waited in the car for a few minutes. They arrived home at 11:30. He showered and changed clothes, and his wife began preparing lunch. Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony tool cabinet again and decided to clear the top shelf to use as a display area. After wiping the few old tools he had just found and the electrician's knife with a dry cloth, he spread a clean piece of old cotton cloth on the top shelf, arranged them neatly one by one, then stepped back a few paces and looked at the "small display stand" that seemed to condense the passage of time, feeling a deep sense of steadiness and satisfaction.
location: Jiajia Supermarket, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan; and Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Online learning and family lunch.
description: At 12:10, Lu Mingqiang curled up on the sofa and opened his phone. Instead of browsing short videos as usual, he seriously searched for 'rust removal for old electrician tools' and 'WD-40 usage tips,' saved posts from three electrician collecting forums, and searched for 'old-style instrument transformers' on a second-hand trading platform to check prices. At 12:30, lunch was Hainan rice noodles and winter melon and white clam soup made by his wife, light and tasty. At the dining table, he animatedly shared his newly discovered 'collecting corner' with his wife, and tentatively asked if she wanted to go to the flea market near Xiangrong Road in Xiuying District that afternoon. His wife smiled and agreed, as she also wanted to see if there were any suitable old rattan chairs. Xuanxuan and Hanhan were arranged to take a nap, and his wife would take care of them.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: At 13:30, after lunch, he set a 30-minute alarm. While his wife was putting the children to sleep, he seized the time to close his eyes and rest on the sofa. He usually didn't take a nap, but since he was going out to scout for bargains this afternoon, it was necessary to be fully rested. He woke up right on time when the alarm rang.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Self-study for the exam and preparations for going out.
description: At 14:00, while his wife settled the child down, he took out the Power System Analysis textbook, flipped through yesterday's mistakes on load calculation, and spent 10 minutes quickly reviewing the formulas. Then he took 200 yuan in cash and a reusable shopping bag from the drawer, and also put a small high-intensity flashlight in his waist bag (for reading nameplates on old objects). At 14:20, when his wife was done, the two quietly left the house.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visited the Qiangxing Second-hand Market and picked up a collectible item.
description: At 14:30, he drove his wife to Qiangxing Second-Hand Market in Xiuying District (about an 18-minute drive). On the way, they chatted and laughed about what treasures they might find today. They arrived at 14:48 and scanned the corners of stall after stall for electrical components. In front of a stall piled with yellowed hardware parts, his eyes lit up when he spotted an oil-immersed current transformer covered in oil and dust. Its white enamel nameplate clearly read "Haikou Power Plant 1968." He squatted down and carefully examined the cracks in the porcelain insulator and the condition of the coil with a flashlight. The stall owner asked for 120 yuan. Drawing on years of experience purchasing materials, he argued, "The condition is only average, it's purely for personal research, and I'm helping you get rid of something that takes up space," and finally closed the deal at 80 yuan. His wife helped take photos and posted them on Moments with the caption "Lao Lu's new treasure." At 16:00, satisfied, they drove home with their spoils (about a 20-minute drive).
location: Qiangxing Used Goods Market, No. 11 Xiangrong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Cleaned and put away the newly collected items.
description: He got home at 16:20. Without stopping to rest, he took out a dry rag, an old toothbrush, and WD-40, and carefully wiped away the surface dust and oily grime from the current transformer. He didn't over-polish it, preserving its natural patina. Then he used the toothbrush to scrub the dirt from the corners and placed it in a ventilated spot on the balcony to dry. He planned to do detailed maintenance tomorrow; today he would just let it “breathe.”
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Playing with the children and checking the home's electrical circuits
description: At 16:50, the two sons had already woken up from their nap, and his wife was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang accompanied them playing with building blocks on the living room floor. Xuanxuan used LEGO to build a “high-voltage tower,” and he took the opportunity to explain “how electricity is transmitted through wires.” Halfway through playing, he remembered the flickering light in the living room, so he got his tool bag, stepped onto a chair to check the lamp holder and wire contact points, found that the neutral wire terminal was a bit loose, re-tightened it, and replaced the bulb with a new LED bulb. The living room light immediately became steady and bright.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and after-dinner cleanup
description: At 17:50, he helped his wife cut the cleaned chicken into pieces to prepare white cut chicken. At 18:00, dinner was white cut chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, and seaweed egg drop soup. The family of four ate and chatted. Xuanxuan boasted that in the afternoon he had put on his father's electrician insulating gloves and pretended to be 'Superman.' Lu Mingqiang sternly said, "Those protect Dad's safety; they're not toys. Don't touch them from now on." At 18:40, after dinner, he took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes, then vacuumed the living room floor and put his son's building blocks back in place, while his wife hung out today's hand-washed clothes on the balcony.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Watching cartoons with the children and helping them wash up
description: At 19:00, Hanhan wanted to watch PAW Patrol, and Xuanxuan wanted to watch Cells at Work!. Lu Mingqiang exercised his 'parent's sole voting right' and decided to watch Cells at Work!, because it could teach the kids about the human body. He sat on the sofa with his two sons in his arms, watching how platelets transport nutrients. At 19:40, he let his wife get on with her own things and took the two boys to the bathroom to wash up. He squeezed toothpaste onto their toothbrushes, watched them brush their teeth, wash their faces, and change into pajamas.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening review and associative memory
description: At 20:10, he walked into the study, turned on the desk lamp, opened the textbook Power System Analysis, and reviewed the working principle and error analysis of current transformers. Instead of rote memorization, he took out his phone and pulled up the photo of the 1968 current transformer he had taken in the afternoon, mentally mapping the theoretical knowledge in the textbook (such as magnetic circuit and secondary-side open circuit) to the actual old object one by one. This object-association method made learning especially efficient, and he reviewed two chapters in an hour and a half.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shoulder and neck care and relaxation.
description: At 21:40, I finished studying and still felt some stiffness in my shoulders. I soaked a towel in hot water, wrung it out, and applied it to my neck, then applied medicated oil and slowly massaged with my palm. I put on earphones, opened an audio podcast on my phone called "Classic Old-Style Instruments and Meters," and listened to stories about the era of "analog multimeters" and "megohmmeters," feeling very relaxed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Browsing before bed and turning off the light to go to sleep
description: At 22:10, after washing up, he lay in bed thinking about the instrument transformer he had picked up today. He used his phone to search for the historical background of 1968 Haikou Power Plant equipment, and learned about the development of Haikou's electric power in that era, feeling that what he had collected was not just an object but a story. He also looked at the electrician tools forum he had bookmarked that afternoon, registered an account, and gave himself the username Old Electrician of Coconut City. At 22:45, he turned off his phone, switched off the light, and lay down; his wife was already asleep. Thinking back on the day, exercise, family, a new hobby, and exam preparation had all been fulfilling. He mulled over whether he could find time on next week's day off to visit the old-object restoration workshop recommended by Chen Bin, and soon fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning Wake-up and State Awareness
description: The alarm went off. I sat up in bed and gently moved aside the arm of my second son Hanhan, which was draped over me. I instinctively moved my neck and shoulders, feeling that my right shoulder blade was still sore and swollen, but it was a little better than yesterday morning. I planned to pay extra attention to stretching during my morning run.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and core training
description: Jogged from the residential community to Wanlv Garden Park, completing a 5 km run on the rubber track that had just been moistened by rain, with a pace of 6 minutes 33 seconds per kilometer. Then did 15 minutes of core training and 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching on a seaside bench, applying portable medicated oil to the sore spot on his right shoulder and massaging it until it warmed up, relieving the discomfort.
location: Plastic track on the inner loop of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Called mother, commuted home, and had breakfast
description: After morning exercise, while walking home along Binhai Avenue, called his mother Chen Xiuying, reminding her that the weather was getting colder and to keep her knees warm, and that there were new plasters on the bedside table to remember to apply. After arriving home, took a quick shower, changed into work clothes; his wife Wang Lijuan had already placed the packed soy milk and meat buns on the shoe cabinet. Then he rode the e-bike to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park and quickly finished breakfast in the cafeteria.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, to the company canteen of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Tool inspection and preparation before starting the post independently.
description: Arrived at the industrial park ten minutes early, went into the tool warehouse to recheck the tools in the service vehicle, verified the multimeter and the megohmmeter, and studied the repair orders from the old communities in Xiuying District again, ranking them in his mind by priority to make sure everything was ready on his first day working independently.
location: Tool warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Independently handled repair requests in Xiuying District in the morning.
description: He drove the engineering vehicle around Xiuying District. First, he went to an old residential community on Haixiu West Road to replace the burnt main air switch for an elderly resident and explained the cause of the tripping. Then he went to a fast-food restaurant on Xiuhua Road to tighten the loose socket wiring terminals. When working alone, he slowed down, emphasizing that “haste makes waste.” After each task, he re-tested with a multimeter before restoring power, ensuring zero errors.
location: An old residential community on Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and a fast-food restaurant on Xiuhua Road

name: Lunch and studying online technical posts.
description: He parked the work truck in the shade of a tree near the repair reporting point on Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, and ate the bento his wife had prepared (stir-fried pork with green peppers, fried egg, and rice). At the same time, he browsed an electrician technology forum on his phone, carefully studied the post Exploded View of the Internal Structure of Oil-Immersed Instrument Transformer, mentally compared it with the 1968 instrument transformer he had picked up yesterday, deepened his understanding of windings and insulating materials, and bookmarked the post for review in the evening.
location: Inside the engineering vehicle parked on the roadside of Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Midday rest in the car
description: He reclined the seat back and rested for twenty minutes, quickly recovering his energy, and the soreness in his right shoulder eased somewhat.
location: Inside the engineering vehicle parked on the roadside of Haixiu West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Handle repair requests in the suburbs and urban areas in the afternoon
description: Drove to a wood processing workshop in Yongxing Town to re-lay two runs of conduit, then went on to an old residence on Jintan Road to replace loose, damaged outlets. Around three in the afternoon, he got a call from fellow worker Chen Jianguo inviting him to have old man's tea. He politely declined, saying he had just started working independently and needed to adjust his pace, and they agreed to meet up on the weekend. After finishing several scattered jobs one after another, he checked the repair order list and gradually felt more at ease.
location: A wood processing workshop in Yongxing Town, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and an old residential building on Jintan Road, Xiuying District

name: After-work commute and purchase of medicated oil and plasters
description: After finishing work, he first drove the work truck back to the industrial park to park it, then rode his e-bike home. On the way, he stopped at Yixintang Pharmacy to buy a new bottle of Yunnan Baiyao Huoluo Oil and ten plasters. When paying, he used his phone to record the expenses on the fly.
location: East Yongqing Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Yixintang (Landmark Garden Store), to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: At home, help with household chores and family interaction
description: When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was washing vegetables in the kitchen, his eldest son Lu Zixuan was doing homework, and his younger son Lu Zihan was watching cartoons. After changing into house clothes, he put the new medicated oil in the kitchen and told his wife. Then he helped fold the dried clothes from the balcony. The sound of a spatula stir-frying came from the kitchen, and much of the day's fatigue faded away. Zihan ran over and hugged his leg, so he picked him up and played with him.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: After dinner, he moved a stool to the dining table and sat down. Using the methods he had learned from a parenting podcast, he gently guided Zixuan to analyze a multi-step word problem. By asking him what story this problem told, he helped him break the problem into steps. Zixuan worked it out step by step on scratch paper and finally calculated the answer himself, his excitement written all over his face. The father and son had a very pleasant interaction.
location: Room 203, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (dining table in living room)

name: Researched Haikou's secondhand market online.
description: While his wife was clearing the dishes, he opened his computer in the study and searched for Haikou secondhand markets through local life forums and map apps. He found two targets: Wenming East Secondhand Market and Xingang Flea Market, and noted their weekend opening hours and specific addresses to plan for the weekend treasure hunting.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, Building 5, Room 203, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (study)

name: Reviewing maintenance notes sparked technical associations
description: He took out Master Li's handwritten maintenance notebook from the 1980s from the bookcase and turned to the "Voltage Stabilizer" chapter. When he read that "aging filter capacitors are a common cause of voltage instability," he remembered the scene the day before when he helped his son build electronic building blocks and they replaced a bulging capacitor to solve the LED light flickering. He suddenly understood that circuit principles are interconnected. Then he used a multimeter to check the accuracy of the capacitance setting, accumulating ideas for future troubleshooting.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, Building 5, Room 203, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (study)

name: Evening skills review and shoulder and neck care.
description: Focused on reviewing the "Transformer Differential Protection" chapter of "Relay Protection", standing up every 45 minutes to look into the distance and stretch the neck and shoulders. At nine o'clock, used newly purchased muscle-relief oil to rub warmth into his shoulder and applied a simple hot compress. In the latter half, he was in better spirits and completed over a dozen additional practice problems, with an accuracy rate exceeding expectations.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, Building 5, Room 203, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (study)

name: Listening to music to relax and washing up.
description: After finishing his review, he put on Bluetooth headphones on the living room sofa and played songs such as 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' and 'Friends' on a loop. Closing his eyes, he recalled the day's work, his notes and insights, and his children's smiling faces, and the corners of his mouth lifted involuntarily. After listening for more than ten minutes, he washed up.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Room 203, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area (living room/bathroom)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Lying in bed, briefly browsed a mobile forum; growing drowsy, put down the phone, felt the lingering warmth of the analgesic oil on his shoulders, adjusted his breathing, and gradually fell asleep to the sound of his wife's even breathing, feeling at ease because the day's tasks were all done.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, Bedroom 203, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area.

name: Morning exercise and jogging
description: In the early morning, he unrolled a yoga mat in the bedroom and performed core and shoulder-neck stretching training, including a 5-minute warm-up (shoulder rolls, neck stretches), 15 minutes of core training (plank, glute bridge, prone back extension), and an extra 10 minutes of wall angel exercises. During the session, he used medicated oil to massage the sore spot around his right shoulder blade. Then he walked to Evergreen Park for a 5 km morning run at a pace of about 6:30 per kilometer, taking about 25 minutes. After the run, he stretched in the stretching area and used the fitness equipment to do pull-ups.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Wanlv Garden Park

He found abnormal ripple voltage in the filter capacitor module. He removed the slightly swollen 10000F/63V capacitor and replaced it with a new one. After soldering it firmly, he powered it on for testing. The output was a stable 380V, and it ran for ten uninterrupted minutes without tripping. The repair was successful. Boss Li praised his solid skills and said he would definitely support him when he opened a workshop in the future.

Zhao Qiang listened attentively, and Mingqiang seemed to see himself from years ago.

This is a habit he has kept for years—taking a short nap to recover energy and store up strength for the afternoon's work.
location: Inside the work pickup truck at the parking lot of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Emergency power restoration in an old residential community.
description: At 13:30, a work order came in: the main breaker had tripped in an old residential building on Haixiu Road, cutting power to the whole building. Mingqiang and Jianguo brought their toolkits and materials and drove 10 minutes to get there. A light rain began to fall. Mingqiang climbed into the hallway meter box to inspect, while Jianguo stood guard downstairs. He skillfully used a multimeter and a megger to troubleshoot, and found that the junction box in the hallway had leaked water and become damp, causing internal oxidation and a short circuit. He cleaned the oxide, replaced the terminals, wrapped everything layer by layer with waterproof tape, and added desiccant. After closing the main breaker, power was restored to the entire building, and the residents expressed their thanks.
location: A residential building in an old community on Haixiu Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

After sweating profusely, the fatigue in his shoulders and neck was completely gone.

I was in charge of the main wiring, and Chen Jianguo assisted with cable routing. Sweat soon soaked our work clothes, but our hands remained quick and orderly; we stopped a few times to drink water.
