description: After the morning work came to a stop, he tidied up the site briefly and drove to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road. He ordered a signature spicy soup rice with a fried egg, while Chen Jianguo ordered braised pork trotters rice. They ate quickly to replenish their energy. While eating, he chatted with Chen Jianguo about the new rules learned in yesterday's training, and, based on the morning's cabling, discussed how to fine-tune the routing path in the afternoon to make it more standardized. After the meal, he did not leave immediately but sat inside for a while, enjoying the cool breeze from the fan to rest.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Create a reference table for collecting old items
description: During the lunch break, instead of browsing his phone, he took out his notebook and pen. He opened screenshots of old items saved on his phone, including Republican-era porcelain plug fuses, old-style vacuum-tube multimeters, and several old knife switches from different manufacturers. He began to copy and organize them by category in his notebook, noting what he considered important condition assessment points (such as case integrity, dial clarity, and terminal oxidation) and approximate market reference price ranges. He planned to build his own 'Old Electrician Collection Price Comparison Table,' recording everything meticulously.
location: Parking area near Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Outdoor installation work (afternoon)
description: After the break, I returned to the construction site to continue the afternoon work. The afternoon sun was even harsher, so I moved into the indoor electrical room, where a high-power exhaust fan made it somewhat cooler. I completed the steps of wiring, tightening terminals, checking phase sequence, and debugging parameters. Recalling the grounding protection standards that Master Li taught me yesterday, I paid special attention to checking the grounding wire connections to ensure the crimping was secure. Around 4 p.m., the commissioning of the two power distribution cabinets was complete, with indicator lights on and everything running normally. I cleaned up the site and took stock of the remaining materials.
location: Indoor electrical distribution room at a construction site on the southeast side of the intersection of Yongwan Road and Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Finishing work, returning to the company, and washing up
description: Put away the tools and equipment, then drove back to the industrial park. Chen Jianguo went to return the pickup truck keys, while I went to the tool room to put the borrowed tools back in place and gave the tool cabinet a quick wipe with a mop. Then I went to the restroom downstairs in the company building, washed the dust off my face and arms with soap, and changed into a clean T-shirt and shorts I had brought along. It was Friday; going to pick up the kids feeling fresh made it much more comfortable.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Got on the e-bike and first went to the nearby kindergarten to pick up Hanhan. When the school bell rang, I waited at the gate and saw Hanhan with a small backpack and an excited face. Then I turned around and rode to Meilan District, arriving at the end of the dismissal period to pick up Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan looked a little tired, so I called him to get on the bike. The e-bike carried the two children, one older and one younger, steadily toward home. Hanhan chattered away on the back seat about the new nursery rhyme the teacher taught today.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Small purchases on the way home and a stroll around the neighborhood.
description: After passing the Convenient Life convenience store near home, he parked the car and took the two children inside to buy a bottle of soy sauce and a bag of steamed buns. Xuanxuan picked a carton of yogurt, and Hanhan chose a lollipop. After coming out, he didn't go straight upstairs but took a short walk with the children in the community garden. As they walked, he listened to Xuanxuan talk about school. His sweat had dried, and the evening breeze felt pleasant. Only after the children's excitement had died down a bit did they head upstairs together.
location: Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the nearby Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: Juanzi had already come home from work and prepared the meal. Tonight there was stir-fried water spinach, braised hairtail, and seaweed egg drop soup, all family favorites. They sat around the table eating, and he chatted with Juanzi about today's outdoor installation work; Juanzi complained about a difficult customer she had encountered at the housekeeping service center. After dinner, he took the dishes and chopsticks to the kitchen, turned on the tap, and began washing them briskly. This was the tacit understanding between him and Juanzi: she cooks, and he does the dishes.
location: Room 504, Building 10, Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Creative building-block teaching (younger son)
description: After washing the dishes, he walked into the living room and saw Hanhan frowning at the numbers 1-5 in his homework notebook, almost snapping his pencil from poking it. He had a brainstorm and took out the colorful large building blocks Hanhan usually played with from under the coffee table. 'Hanhan, watch Daddy do a magic trick with the blocks!' He used red blocks to make a big '2' and said, 'The curved little boat is 2.' Then he made a '4' with blue blocks: 'The fluttering little flag is 4.' He also improvised a few rhymes and tweaked the lyrics of the 'Building Block Circuit Song.' Hanhan was captivated, dropped his pencil, and followed along, building the numbers with blocks, then traced them with his finger several times. Xuanxuan was also amused; after finishing his own homework, he came over to watch his little brother 'write' numbers.
location: Living room, Room 504, Building 10, Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help the older son with homework and get washed up.
description: Hanhan had a great time playing, so I told him to put away the building blocks, then went to check Xuanxuan's math homework. I found one calculation error and one missing unit. Instead of criticizing him directly, I had him redo the calculation. After he confirmed the error, I explained it to him. After finishing the homework, I urged the two children to wash up. After they brushed their teeth and washed their faces, I also took a cool shower in the bathroom to wash away the fatigue.
location: Room 504, Building 10, Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Exam review and pre-meeting confirmation.
description: The children were all asleep, and Juanzi was also in the bedroom looking at her phone. I made myself a cup of tea and went to the study. Tonight's focus was to review the section Principles of Transformer Differential Protection, which is a key point for the senior technician exam and also content that might be discussed at Sunday's exchange meeting. I opened my notebook and textbook and began to read closely and note down key points, especially the logical coordination between differential protection, overcurrent protection, and grounding protection. After 2 hours, I closed the book and stretched my neck. Then I picked up my phone, opened the WeChat group "Jinmao Community Technician Exchange Group", and checked the sign-up status for Sunday's exchange meeting. Eighteen people in the group had already clicked "Attend", which made me feel much more reassured. At 23:10, I turned off the light, walked into the bedroom, and lay down to sleep. Although today was tiring, it was steady and unhurried.
location: Study, Room 504, Building 10, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and core training
description: My body clock woke me up right at 6:30. It's Saturday today, so there's no need to rush to take the kids to school; I can be more relaxed. After getting up, I first drank a glass of warm water, then did 15 minutes of core and shoulder-neck stretching on the yoga mat in the living room. My shoulders felt a bit sore, probably because it rained yesterday and I caught a chill, but after loosening up they felt much better.
location: Own living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and activity preparation
description: My wife Juanzi had already made breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and the leftover stir-fried water spinach from last night. While drinking the congee, I went over the agenda for today's exchange meeting one last time in my head and confirmed that my USB drive, business cards, a pack of newly purchased test wire samples, a tape measure, and a folding umbrella were all packed in my carry-on tool bag.
location: Dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to the community activity center.
description: Riding my old electric bike, I headed west along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Shimao East Road, and in about 5 minutes arrived at the Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, Jinmao Subdistrict (No. 2 Shimao East Road, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District). It was drizzling, so I parked under the canopy at the door and locked it.
location: From Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, 2 Shimao East Road, Jinmao Subdistrict, Longhua District

name: Set up the venue for the exchange meeting
description: Old Chen, a fellow worker, and Xiao Zhao, the apprentice, arrived before me. We divided the work clearly: I tuned the projector and sound system and checked the PPT I had prepared on the comparison between old and new distribution boxes and the key points of smart switch installation; Old Chen and Xiao Zhao were responsible for arranging 35 chairs and hanging a red banner at the door that read 'Electric Safety into Communities: A New Smart Home Experience'. I also placed the wire samples, a few old sockets, and smart switch models I had brought on the podium.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinmao Subdistrict, No. 2 Shimao East Road, Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, 2nd Floor Multi-function Hall

name: Pre-meeting reception and preparation
description: Director Wang from the community came over to say hello and confirmed the number of attendees and the tea break. I thanked the community for providing the venue. Director Wang also reminded me that there might be showers in the afternoon and to remember to close the windows after the event. I checked the microphone volume again and set my phone to silent.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinmao Subdistrict, No. 2 Shimao East Road, Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, 2nd Floor Multi-function Hall

name: Hosted the community electrical technology exchange meeting
description: The exchange meeting started on time. As the main speaker, I first welcomed everyone and briefly introduced today's theme, "Smart Home Electrical Retrofit." Drawing on a real case from my own home's wiring upgrade last year, I focused on the "concealed works" standards when adding smart devices in older residential areas—for example, how to choose circuit breakers, how to lay the ground wire, and that the neutral and live wires must not be reversed—correcting the common misconception among workers and residents that "as long as the wires are connected, it's fine." I also compared inferior wires with national-standard wires side by side, and everyone watched very attentively.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinmao Subdistrict, No. 2 Shimao East Road, Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, 2nd Floor Multi-function Hall

name: Interactive exchange and requirement alignment
description: During the open discussion, the residents were very enthusiastic and raised many questions, such as what to do if a wireless switch fails, how to tell which reserved wire is which when wanting to install smart curtains, and why the circuit breaker trips when the oven and microwave in the kitchen are used at the same time. I answered them one by one, and called Lao Chen over to join me in in-depth talks with three residents who clearly wanted renovations. I noted down their apartment layouts and distribution box situations, exchanged phone numbers and added them on WeChat, and agreed to visit their homes for free next week.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, Jinmao Subdistrict, No. 2 Shimao East Road, Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, 2nd Floor Multi-function Hall

name: Wrap-up and lunch at home.
description: After the event, I called everyone to take down the equipment, collect the banner, clean the venue, and returned the community keys. After saying goodbye to Lao Chen and Xiao Zhao at the door, I rode my electric bike home. On the way, I stopped at the Convenient Life Convenience Store at the entrance of the community to buy a bottle of water, and arrived home at 12:10.
location: From the Shimao Community Party-Mass Service Center, via Bianli Life Convenience Store, to Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: Juanzi made steamed golden pompano, garlic water spinach, and pork rib soup, all dishes I love. At the dinner table, I told my wife and kids some amusing things from today's exchange meeting, mentioning that a few elderly men and women were especially interested in smart door locks and asked very detailed questions. After the meal, I leaned back on the sofa for 20 minutes with my eyes closed to rest.
location: Own dining room and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Parent-child consolidation and family leisure
description: After getting enough rest, I played with my younger son Hanhan in the living room. I used the same set of number blocks from last time to teach him to write the numbers 6 to 10. Today he was much better at sitting still. Although the numbers were crooked, he could recognize all ten digits, and Juanzi and I both praised him well. After that, I spent 30 minutes checking my older son Xuanxuan's weekend math homework and corrected two unit conversion errors in his word problems.
location: Own living room and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child outing to the flea market
description: The rain stopped and the weather improved. I decided to take the two kids to the Xingfa Secondhand Goods Market on Daying Road in Meilan District to see if there were any old treasures. I rode an electric bicycle, with Xuanxuan standing in front of me and Hanhan sitting on the small chair on the rear seat. We rode east along Binhai Avenue, passed the Haixiu Expressway, and then turned onto Daying Road. It took about 30 minutes.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area to Xingfa Secondhand Goods Market, No. 58 Daying Road, Meilan District

name: Flea Market Visit
description: When we got to the market, I took the kids around the stalls selling hardware, secondhand goods, and assorted liquor bottles. At one stall I saw several vintage ceramic liquor bottles from the 1950s–60s. I chatted with the vendor; he asked 150 yuan each, and I thought it was expensive, so I didn't buy. The kids were very curious about old telephones and old radios, so I told them these were used for making phone calls and listening to the radio in the past. They listened with great interest.
location: Xingfa Secondhand Goods Market, No. 58 Daying Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return trip and playing in the community park.
description: On the way back, the two sons clamored to go to the park to play on the slide, so I took them along the way to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park on Yanzao Yiheng Road, Longhua District, next to the residential area, and they played for 20 minutes. I sat on a bench under the shade, scrolled on my phone, and saw someone in the local collecting group share a post about the history of the old Haikou distillery, so I saved it while I was at it.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Personal tidying and household chores
description: After getting home, I first took a cool shower and changed into dry clothes. Then I went to the study, took out my work notebook, and made initial notes on the apartment layouts and needs of the three prospective clients from today's exchange meeting. Next, I walked to the balcony, took out my phone, and compared the photos of old wine bottles I had taken at the flea market with my collection by category.
location: Own study and balcony at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner preparation and dining
description: Juanzi was busy in the kitchen preparing dinner, and I voluntarily went to help, responsible for washing and cutting vegetables. Dinner was Hainanese chicken rice and winter melon and white clam soup. The family of four sat around the table together, and the children chattered about the interesting things they had seen at the flea market that afternoon. Xuanxuan even asked whether that old telephone could still make calls, which made me laugh.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Housework and family interaction
description: I was in charge of washing the dishes. Afterward, I urged my two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces. I then sat on the living room sofa, watched local news with Juanzi for a while, and replied to a few messages from Lao Chen and Xiao Zhao on WeChat about today's activity summary.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Focused exam preparation and review
description: After my wife and children went back to their rooms, I turned on the desk lamp in the study, took out the review materials for Principles of Transformer Differential Protection and a calculator. I concentrated for 2 hours, focusing on three major calculation problems related to "discrimination of internal fault types in transformers," and checked the formula derivation process against my notes. I felt my thinking was much smoother today than yesterday.
location: His own study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After finishing my review, I packed up my books. Back in the bedroom, I put on earphones, played Beyond's "Boundless Sea and Sky," and leaned against the headboard with my eyes closed. I went over the day's events in my mind and felt that although I was tired, it was quite fulfilling. At exactly 9 o'clock, I got up, washed my face, set the alarm for 8:00 the next morning (planning to go see my parents), then turned off the lights and went to bed.
location: Own bedroom in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and core stretching
description: At 6 a.m., his phone alarm went off right on time. Lu Mingqiang got up without hesitation, put on his running shorts, laid out a yoga mat on the floor, and began 15 minutes of core, neck, and shoulder stretches. His movements were precise and his breathing steady, focusing on loosening up the stiff neck and shoulders from writing the exchange meeting summary the day before, getting ready for his morning run.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Walk to Wanlv Garden
description: After stretching, Lu Mingqiang changed into running shoes and a quick-dry T-shirt, quietly closed the door, and walked through the familiar paths of the neighborhood to Wanlv Garden. The morning breeze was cool. He took deep breaths of air rich with the scent of plants, flexed his wrists and ankles, and mentally planned the steps for repairing the roof today. After about 24 minutes of walking, he arrived at the main gate of Wanlv Garden.
location: Walking from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Wanlv Garden, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Lu Mingqiang jogged 5 kilometers at a steady pace on the loop track in Evergreen Park, keeping a stable pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. When he reached the third kilometer, sweat dripped down. He adjusted his breathing, glanced across the Haikou Bay skyline, and enjoyed the exhilaration of running. After finishing, he slowed to a walk for one lap to catch his breath.
location: Ring track at Wanlv Garden, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: After the morning run, Lu Mingqiang walked home slowly, took a warm shower, and changed into a clean home T-shirt. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, Hainan pickled mustard, and barbecue pork buns. The two chatted while eating. He told Juanzi about his plan to bring tools to repair the roof of the ancestral house today, and took from her a canvas bag containing herbal tea and sunscreen.
location: At home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare repair tools and load them into the car
description: Lu Mingqiang came to his private parking space downstairs, opened the trunk of the silver car, carefully checked the latch of the telescopic ladder, and neatly arranged the spare tiles, cement, scraper, brush, and gloves. His wife Wang Lijuan ran downstairs, handed him an old straw hat and sunscreen spray, and reminded him not to get sunburned. He smiled and nodded, keeping her kindness in mind.
location: Private parking space downstairs from Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Drive to pick up my father and go to the ancestral house.
description: At 8:25, Lu Mingqiang set off by car, along Jinmao Middle Road, Longkun North Road, and Guoxing Avenue to the CCCC Longqi Yayuan South Area where his parents lived. On the way, he listened to classic old songs on the radio. After arriving, his father Lu Jianguo was already waiting downstairs, wearing old work clothes and carrying a jug of herbal tea. His mother Chen Xiuying brought boiled sweet potatoes and snacks, telling him not to go hungry at noon. Father and son loaded the treated wood planks into the car together, then continued driving via Baiju Avenue to the ancestral house in Dalin Village, Lingshan Town. On the way, they talked about the condition of the old house and the father's memories of working as an electrician in his youth.
location: Lu family ancestral home, Dalin Village, Lingshan Town, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (driving via CCCC Longqi Yayuan South Area)

name: Repairing the ancestral house roof and taking a lunch break
description: After arriving at the ancestral house, the father and son divided the work: the father cleaned the silt out of the courtyard drainage ditch and hosed down the ground; Lu Mingqiang set up the extension ladder, put on his tool belt, wore a straw hat, and went up to the roof to inspect. He found two cracks on the roof ridge of the west wing and three broken tiles. He first used a scraper to clean away the debris, then inserted new tiles according to his father's guidance and filled the gaps in the ridge with cement mortar. The sun was blazing, and he was drenched in sweat, but the work was done meticulously. At 12 noon, the two rested under the longan tree in the courtyard, eating sweet potatoes, drinking herbal tea, and having bread and ham sausages. The father remarked that the old house needs to be kept lively by people, and Lu Mingqiang promised to come back every quarter to check on it, and planned to replace the exposed electrical wires with flame-retardant conduits and install a new electrical box next time. After a short lunch break, Lu Mingqiang went back up on the roof, smoothed and compacted all the ridge gaps, and reinforced the base of the chimney; the father cleared branches and swept the front and back of the house. By 2 p.m., all the repairs and cleaning were finished, and the ancestral house looked completely renewed.
location: Lu Family Ancestral House, Dalin Village, Lingshan Town, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Take his father home.
description: After packing up his tools, Lu Mingqiang drove his father back to his home in Meilan District. On the way, his father took out old photos and told the history of the ancestral house, which was his great-grandfather's craftsmanship. Lu Mingqiang listened attentively and felt even more moved about the heritage.
location: South Area, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (while driving)

name: Said goodbye to his parents and drove home by himself.
description: At the foot of his parents' apartment building, Lu Mingqiang helped his father put away the mud-stained rain shoes on the shoe rack and went inside to greet his mother. His mother, noticing how tanned he had become, insisted that he drink another bowl of iced mung bean soup. Lu Mingqiang sat and chatted with his father for ten minutes, then took his leave. At 3 p.m., he put on his sunglasses, drove back to Banshan Garden in Longhua District along Guoxing Avenue and Longkun North Road, and mulled over customer follow-up visits on the way.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden (driving back from parents' home)

name: Go home to rest and take a shower.
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang unloaded the ladder and other tools from the car and temporarily stored them in the corner of the balcony. He then took a quick cold shower, washing away the dust and fatigue, changed into a clean white T-shirt and gray athletic shorts, and felt much fresher.
location: At home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Follow up with potential customers from the exchange meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang took the three business cards he had received at yesterday's community power technology exchange meeting out of his briefcase and sat down at his desk. He first called Mr. Liu of the World Trade Community, asking in detail about the layout and budget of the old house's circuit renovation, and made a preliminary assessment of the scope and construction period. Then he sent WeChat messages to the other two clients and recorded the communication points, preliminary renovation scope, and agreed on-site survey times (next Wednesday and Thursday) in a dedicated work notebook. After that, he opened the memo app on his phone to confirm tomorrow's work schedule.
location: Home study, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare family dinner.
description: After his follow-up visit with the client, Lu Mingqiang walked into the kitchen to help his wife Wang Lijuan pick vegetables and cut meat. With deft hands, he prepared a sea bass, scoring it a few times and rubbing it with salt and ginger slices to remove the fishy smell, all while chatting with his wife about the amusing story of fixing the roof and his father's relief. His younger son Lu Zihan ran into the kitchen, hugged his leg, and asked to be lifted up, while his eldest son Lu Zixuan was quietly doing homework in the living room. Smoke rose from the kitchen stove, filling the home with the warmth of everyday life.
location: Home kitchen, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Having a family dinner together.
description: The family sat around the dining table, enjoying steamed sea bass, scrambled eggs with bitter melon, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and winter melon and sea snail soup. At the table, Lu Mingqiang asked his two sons what they had done at home that day, praised Xuanxuan for his careful homework, and smiled while listening to Hanhan tell, in a babyish voice, a story learned in kindergarten.
location: Dining room at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Housework and parent-child interaction.
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes. Then he played an interactive puzzle game about electricity with his two sons in the living room. He used cartoon circuit diagrams to help the children understand the simple concepts of series and parallel connections, and also demonstrated with a battery and a light bulb. The two boys were fully absorbed.
location: Living room at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening tutoring and homework checking
description: Lu Mingqiang checked his eldest son Lu Zixuan's math and Chinese homework and found that the approach to one word problem was wrong, so he patiently drew a line-segment diagram to explain. His younger son Hanhan was building a house with blocks on the side, enjoying himself.
location: Home study, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Remind the children to wash up and prepare for bed
description: After finishing the homework tutoring, Lu Mingqiang urged the two children to go wash up. He first helped Hanhan brush her teeth and checked whether Xuanxuan had washed his face and feet properly. His wife Wang Lijuan made the beds and told the children a bedtime story. Lu Mingqiang sat by the bed listening quietly, feeling at ease inside.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Building 3, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Focused review for exam preparation
description: After the children fell asleep, the world quieted down. Although Lu Mingqiang was tired, he still sat down at his desk, opened the textbook "Safety Regulations for Electric Power Work," and focused on reviewing the two chapters "Safety Protection for Work at Heights" and "Maintenance Specifications for Low-Voltage Distribution Cabinets." He marked key points with a pen and silently memorized several key figures with his eyes closed.
location: Home study, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing foot soak and browsing the news
description: After finishing his review, Lu Mingqiang soaked his feet in hot water in the living room to relieve the day's fatigue. His wife Wang Lijuan was scrolling on her phone beside him, and the two chatted. He picked up his phone and quickly browsed a few WeChat public accounts on power technology innovation and industry news to relax.
location: Living room at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: After soaking his feet, Lu Mingqiang got up and went to the bathroom to wash up, put away his tooth cup and toothbrush, and cleaned the sink.
location: Home bathroom, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang lay in bed, reviewing the day: the renovated old house, his father's smile, the progress of the customer follow-up, the children's smiling faces. He felt peaceful and grounded. He set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up and core stretching
description: At exactly 6:00, the phone alarm rang. After washing up briefly, Lu Mingqiang did 15 minutes of core, shoulder, and neck stretches on the living room mat. The soreness from repairing the ancestral house on Sunday had largely disappeared; with his body warmed up, he felt full of energy.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run in the neighborhood
description: Pushing open the door, he found a fine drizzle falling outside. Lu Mingqiang put on his quick-dry clothes and jogged along the walking path inside the residential complex. The rain was not heavy and felt refreshing on his skin. He ran about 5 kilometers in 45 minutes. After the run, he was slightly sweaty and felt recharged for the start of the new week.
location: Community walking path, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and taking the child to school.
description: After the run, he went home, took a hot shower, and changed into his work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: lean pork porridge and fried eggs. After the family finished breakfast, at 7:20 Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike, first taking his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then turning around to take his elder son Lu Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School. The roads were slippery in the rain, so he rode more slowly than usual.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, and then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Commuted to the company by electric bike
description: After dropping off the two children, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to work along the familiar route. The rain had stopped, but the road was still wet. At 7:55, he arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, parked his bike, and walked into the company gate.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning office work: phone coordination and work preparation.
description: Arrived at the company at 7:55, got a cup of water, and tidied up the desk. Started on real work at 8:00 sharp: first called the two neighbors introduced by Boss Li to confirm the on-site survey times, scheduling them for Wednesday evening and Saturday morning respectively; then followed up with three prospective customers from last Sunday's technical exchange meeting, re-confirming the smart home renovation plan details over the phone, and made appointments for visits next Wednesday and Thursday. At 10:30, I took the time to sort out the list of tools and materials needed for next week's on-site surveys, which made me feel much more at ease.
location: Company office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant
description: It was mealtime. He locked the tool cabinet, rode his electric bike to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road. He ordered a signature spicy soup rice with a fried egg. The broth was sour and spicy, whetting the appetite, and he ate until his forehead beaded with sweat. In his mind he planned the afternoon work; only when full would he have the energy to do it.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Company Lunch Break
description: Back at the company, I dozed at my desk for half an hour to refresh myself. I have to get to the food factory before 2 p.m., so I need to make good use of the time to rest.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: high-voltage switch cabinet repair at a food factory
description: At 1:10, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang took their tools and replacement contact assemblies and set off in the pickup truck. According to the navigation, they arrived at Hainan Guiniu No.1 Food Co., Ltd. in Xiuying District before 2:00. The factory electrician had already completed the power outage procedures. The three followed the standardized process: cut off power, verify no voltage, install three-phase short-circuit grounding wires, remove the damaged moving and static contacts, install the new assemblies, adjust contact pressure, and test the circuit resistance. They restored power in less than two hours. The machines roared back to life, and they packed up their tools and cleaned the site.
location: Electrical distribution room at the factory of Hainan Guiniu No. 1 Food Co., Ltd., Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finish work, return to the company, and compile the report
description: After finishing work, the three of them drove back to the company with their tools. Lu Mingqiang first washed his face and hands, which were covered in dust, changed into clean clothes, and then filled in today's work records and maintenance reports at his workstation and filed them.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Picking up the children from school and buying groceries
description: At 17:00, he got off work and cycled first to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Hanhan, then waited at the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School for his older son Xuanxuan to finish school. After picking up both children, he stopped by the nearby Dongmen Market on the way and bought some fresh pork ribs and winter melon. His wife had said last night that she wanted to make soup, so it was just right to bring them home.
location: Starting from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and finally to Dongmen Market, Meilan District

name: Arrived home and spent time with family.
description: When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was already preparing dinner. Lu Mingqiang handed the pork ribs and winter melon to his wife, and she deftly started making soup. He played with building blocks with his younger son Hanhan for a while, then checked his older son Xuanxuan's math homework and pointed out careless mistakes on two calculation problems.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the dinner table. Tonight there was sweet-and-sour pork ribs that Xuanxuan loved, and the light, sweet winter melon and pork rib soup Juanzi had made. Listening to the children talk about amusing things at school, most of the day's fatigue melted away.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening leisure and quality time with the children
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes, then accompanied his two sons in the living room watching TV, a cartoon about ocean exploration. At 8 o'clock, he urged them to brush their teeth and wash their faces. At 8:20, he watched the two children get into bed and lie down.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Define the collection focus and budget list.
description: The children were asleep, and Lu Mingqiang spread open his notebook in the study. Combining the results of his scouting over the past few days at Xingfa Flea Market and Old Chen's place, he formally established “Republic of China-era knife switches” and “vintage multimeters” as his beginner collecting focus. He took out last month's leftover pocket money and planned to set aside 200 yuan from his monthly allowance as a collection fund. In the notebook, he listed the top three target items on his most-wanted list and their ideal condition descriptions, then carefully tucked the page away. This small hobby had officially gotten off the ground.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Reviewing for the exam and checking doors and windows
description: Before reviewing, he got up and went to the balcony to check the windows one by one. The outer edge of the typhoon was coming, and it might rain in the next two days, so the windows had to be closed tightly. Returning to the study, he opened the exam preparation question bank app on his phone and focused on answering 50 multiple-choice questions related to the Electric Power Safety Work Regulations and distribution cabinet maintenance. He took screenshots of the 5 questions he got wrong and reviewed the corresponding sections of the textbook to deepen his understanding.
location: Study and balcony of the home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Browsing and planning before bed.
description: After finishing the practice questions, I dimmed the desk lamp and used my phone to scroll through posts in a forum I had bookmarked, to see if anyone was selling vintage items. I also checked the weather forecast for the next two days, confirmed that there would be peripheral effects from a typhoon, and thought that tomorrow morning's run would have to change to an indoor core workout. At 10:30, I turned off the light and lay down; the day was over.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning core and shoulder-neck stretching
description: He was woken by the pattering rain outside the window and the stiffness in his shoulders and neck. Instead of going out for a run, he spread an old yoga mat on the balcony. He first did 5 minutes of Cat and Child poses to loosen his spine, then endured 10 minutes of targeted shoulder and neck stretches (slowly turning his head, shrugging and relaxing his shoulders), and finally did 2 quick sets of planks to get his body moving.
location: Balcony, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing and waking the children.
description: He took a hot shower and changed into dry work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had already set out white porridge, fried eggs, and char siu bao on the table. He first went to wake up his eldest son Lu Zixuan and reminded him to wear a jacket and rain boots because it was raining today. Then he went to wake up his younger son Lu Zihan. The little guy still wanted to stay in bed, so he coaxed him: "Hanhan, get up quickly. Dad has to go fix a 'big box' that got damaged by the rain today. After I drop you off, I'm going to 'transform' into a superhero too!"
location: Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school in the rain.
description: He put on a dark blue two-piece rain suit and first secured Lu Zihan's child seat on the back. He set off at 06:50; the rain was quite heavy, so the electric bike was slower than usual. At 07:05 he arrived at Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou. He changed Hanhan into small rain boots and handed him to the teacher on duty. Then he turned around and rode to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, arriving at 07:20. He reminded Xuanxuan to tidy his schoolbag under the awning at the school gate and watched him trot into the teaching building.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, first to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Commute and breakfast
description: Starting from the school, I took Changdi Road onto Xiuying Avenue, then drove toward Haisheng Road. At 07:40 I passed Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, located at Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province. Thinking of the hot soup rice, I felt even hungrier. I parked, went in, and ordered a serving of spicy soup with rice. After eating a bowl, the hot and peppery flavor dispelled the damp chill of the rainy day, and my neck and shoulders felt more relaxed. At 07:55, after eating, I rode a few minutes to my company in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.
location: Starting from Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, passing by Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, and finally arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Pre-shift meeting and task assignment.
description: After changing into dry work clothes and safety shoes, Lu Mingqiang went to the office. Team Leader Zhang was already there. He handed Lu Mingqiang the task sheet for today's emergency repair in an old residential community in Longhua District and arranged for Zhao Qiang to go along to the site to learn. The three held a brief meeting. Team Leader Zhang emphasized the waterproofing and insulation issues of working on live equipment in the rain, as well as the details of the spare parts needed.
location: Repair Team Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare tools and materials
description: Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang to the warehouse to pick up materials. While checking the inventory, he taught Zhao Qiang to identify meter box covers, air switches, wiring terminals, and the most important waterproof sealant and insulating tape in different specifications. After confirming that all rain gear, safety belts, and voltage detectors were in place, the two worked together to lift the heavier meter box onto the bed of the company utility vehicle.
location: Tool warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning emergency repair work in the rain
description: With Zhao Qiang driving, the two arrived at Binhai New Village, Longhua District, Haikou at 08:55. The property manager, Lao Li, was waiting anxiously and said that rainwater had seeped through cracks in the exterior wall into the main meter box of Unit 3, causing crackling and sparks, and the whole building had lost power. Lu Mingqiang quickly cut off the upstream power supply and hung up a warning sign. He had Zhao Qiang pass tools and keep watch on the ground, while he put on insulating gloves and dismantled the old burnt-black meter box in the rain. Rainwater dripped from his hat brim into his neck, but his shoulders and neck went numb from the sustained effort. He carefully removed the melted busbars and switches, cleaned the wall, reassembled everything with new parts, and applied waterproof sealant to all the joints. At 10:50, Team Leader Zhang rode over on an electric bike to check on them and brought hot tea. At 11:35, the new meter box was installed and the power-on test succeeded. The hallway lights came back on, and the residents thanked him one after another.
location: Corridor of Building 3, Binhai New Village, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday rest and doing practice questions
description: The rain eased slightly. Lu Mingqiang asked Zhao Qiang to go to a nearby convenience store and buy two packs of instant noodles, ham sausages, and a small bottle of cola, then returned to the work truck. He put down the seat, poured hot water from the thermos to soak the noodles. After eating, he took out his phone, opened the app for practicing senior technician exam questions, and spent 40 minutes working on the 'Lightning Protection and Grounding' chapter. He screenshotted and saved 3 tricky points about earth resistance measurement methods. Zhao Qiang was browsing short videos on the side.
location: Inside a roadside tool truck near Binhai Xincun, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon wrap-up and return to the factory
description: The rain had mostly stopped by 13:10. Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang back to the site and asked him to use a megohmmeter to test the insulation resistance of the new meter box and check all the waterproof seals. After confirming everything was fine, they cleared the old equipment and loose wire ends from the site. At 13:40, they packed up the tools and remaining materials and drove back to the company, arriving at 14:05, where they returned the utility vehicle to the designated spot.
location: Returned from Binhai New Village, Longhua District, Haikou City, to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Return to the company to hand over the shift and complete reports
description: Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang returned to the office. Lu Mingqiang wiped the reclaimed tools with a cloth, then turned on the computer, filled in the emergency repair process and the list of replaced spare parts in detail in the maintenance record system, and uploaded photos taken at the scene. After Squad Leader Zhang reviewed it, he signed the electronic work order to confirm completion. Lu Mingqiang also briefly reported to the squad leader on Zhao Qiang's internship performance that day.
location: Repair Team Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Worked overtime to organize tools and plans.
description: Remembering that tomorrow is Wednesday and he has to visit three clients for on-site surveys, Lu Mingqiang did not rush off. He went to the storeroom, checked and organized the survey toolbox he might need tomorrow (including a clamp meter, a rangefinder, drawing clips, etc.), and put it in his fixed locker. Returning to his desk, he listed the core issues to confirm during tomorrow's survey in his notebook (e.g., distribution cabinet location, cable routing, equipment power, etc.).
location: Tool storage room and office space, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the children after work
description: Left work on time at 15:45 and changed back into casual clothes. He rode first to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, picked up Lu Zihan at 16:05, and the little one asked as soon as he got on whether Dad had fixed the big box. Then at 16:18 he arrived at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, waited about 10 minutes, and picked up Lu Zixuan after school. The two children chattered about school in the back seat while he rode and responded, and he sent a WeChat message to his wife Wang Lijuan in advance: "My neck is stiffer than this morning. Buy some medicated oil or safflower oil tonight."
location: Starting from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, go first to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Family time and helping with housework
description: Arrived home at 16:45, changed into a loose old T-shirt and shorts. The discomfort in his shoulders and neck was obvious. He first went to the balcony to check the pepper seedlings he had planted from cuttings a couple of days ago and loosened the soil in the flowerpots. Then he played LEGO with his younger son Hanhan in the living room, and checked his older son Xuanxuan's math homework, pointing out a careless mistake in a word problem. While the children watched cartoons, he went to the kitchen and started the rice cooker.
location: Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: His wife, Wang Lijuan, came home from work and brought back medicated oil and a piece of old ginger. She stir-fried two dishes: tomato and scrambled eggs and sliced pork with green peppers, along with the leftover pork rib and winter melon soup from yesterday. The family sat around the table. While eating, Lu Mingqiang told his wife about how he almost slipped during today's emergency repair in the rain, and also praised Zhao Qiang for being fairly diligent at work today. After dinner, his wife did the dishes, while he supervised Xuanxuan doing homework and Hanhan reading picture books.
location: Dining room, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening shoulder and neck physiotherapy and foot soaking.
description: Lu Mingqiang asked Wang Lijuan to help massage his neck and shoulders with medicated oil. He moved a small stool and sat down in the living room. Wang Lijuan poured the medicated oil into her palm, rubbed it warm, and pressed it firmly on the back of his neck and trapezius muscles. Lu Mingqiang winced in pain, but felt the stiff muscles gradually loosen. After massaging for more than ten minutes, he went to the kitchen, sliced a few pieces of old ginger, boiled a pot of hot water, and poured it into a foot bath bucket to soak his feet.
location: Living room and bathroom, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Free time and preparation for an early bedtime
description: After soaking his feet, Lu Mingqiang felt much more relaxed. He watched TV with his family for a while; it was a TV drama about a rural electrician, and he found it quite touching. At 21:00, he urged the two children to brush their teeth and wash their faces and go to bed. He had originally wanted to do a few more practice questions, but realizing that tomorrow would be a whole day of surveying, he finally decided to skip studying and let his body fully rest. In the study, he briefly reviewed the addresses and contact information of the clients he would meet tomorrow and confirmed that the batteries for the various meters in his tool bag were sufficient.
location: Living room and study, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Personal washing up and getting ready for bed.
description: Took a hot shower and rinsed his pressed neck with warm water. Changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed, feeling the quilt and pillow were extremely comfortable. His wife did a final check of the children's room and turned off the light.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang silently reviewed today's emergency repair task in his mind, thinking about how to present a more professional image to the client during tomorrow's survey. Drowsiness came over him. He glanced at his phone: 22:00, and turned off the light. He thought to himself: tomorrow is Wednesday, still busy. After this rain, it should clear up, right?
location: Master bedroom, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning shoulder and neck stretches.
description: Got up right after the alarm, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and did targeted shoulder and neck stretches. Completed 3 sets of wall angels and used a resistance band to help release the trapezius muscles. The stiffness in the shoulders and neck was noticeably relieved.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to Wanlv Garden
description: Put on sports gear, ride an e-bike out of the residential community, turn from Jinmao Middle Road onto Haibin Avenue, and head toward Evergreen Park against the sea breeze.

name: Morning run in Wanlv Park
description: Completed a 5 km morning run on the inner plastic track of Wanlv Garden at a 6:25/km pace. It was cloudy and breezy, comfortable to run. After the run, he did thorough leg stretches beside the lawn.
location: The rubber track inside Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned home, showered, and had breakfast
description: After cycling home, he took a shower and changed into work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and side dishes for spicy soup rice. During the meal, he discussed with his wife the plan to go to the new housing development in the afternoon to repair the busway. His wife reminded him to be safe.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take son to school
description: First rode the e-bike to take the second son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, watching him enter the classroom; then took the eldest son Lu Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, urging him to study hard.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Team Leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks, confirmed that in the afternoon they would assist the Engineering Department at a new residential development to repair the power shaft, and arranged for the morning to organize the newly arrived safety tools and equipment and fill out yesterday's emergency repair report.
location: Outside the tool room at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning homework and contacting clients.
description: First, counted and registered the newly arrived insulating gloves and voltage detectors, checking the models and test dates; then filled out the maintenance report for yesterday's emergency repair of the meter box in Binhai New Village at the office; afterwards, called two neighbor customers to schedule times for on-site line surveys on Saturday morning, and recorded their addresses and contact information.
location: Office in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: Finish morning work, stretch, tidy the desk, grab the phone and e-bike keys to go out for lunch.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunchtime
description: At the Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant, he ordered a spicy soup rice with a soft-boiled egg and, while eating, browsed his bookmarked forums on his phone, keeping an eye on Old Wine Bottle's updates.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, Haisheng Road, Xianghe Jiayuan, Building 8, First Floor, No. 56-4, Yangtianhe Pharmacy No. 110, Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant

name: Midday nap
description: After returning to the company, he reclined the seat on the front passenger side of the utility vehicle and rested with his eyes closed to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Tool vehicle inside Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: New residential development strong-current shaft repair.
description: He took the engineering department pickup truck with Zhao Qiang to a newly delivered residential complex in Xiuying District to handle the abnormal noise of the busway in the electrical shaft of Building 9. They checked the joints from floors 8 to 15 floor by floor, tightened two loose bolts, dried three damp insulating gaskets with a heat gun, and tested insulation resistance with a megger. After it passed, normal power supply was restored.
location: Electrical shaft in Building 9 of a newly delivered residential complex near the intersection of Changbin Road and Changtong Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return trip and organizing tools

location: Squash Club, 2nd Floor, Shizi Road Building, Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycling home
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Feng, he rode his electric bike back to Banshan Garden Residential Area. The evening breeze brushed past gently, and he felt completely relaxed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower and family dinner.
description: After arriving home and taking a shower, had dinner with the family. My wife prepared steamed tilapia, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and stir-fried pork slices with celery. At the table, my elder son Lu Zixuan excitedly talked about fun football moments in PE class, and my younger son Lu Zihan hummed a newly learned nursery rhyme. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Met a neighbor while walking around the neighborhood
description: After dinner, he took a walk in the neighborhood to aid digestion and met his neighbor Wang Jianguo in a pavilion, so they sat down to chat. Uncle Wang asked about his recent work situation. After learning that he was preparing for the senior technician certificate, he shared his own experience of leading a graduating class back then, encouraged him to be dedicated to whichever line of work he does and become a specialist in it, and reminded him to take care of his health.
location: Pavilion in Banshan Garden residential area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Efficient evening review
description: In the study, I put on headphones, played white noise, and focused on tackling the last set of mock exercises in the "Principles of Transformers" chapter. After finishing, I checked the answers and analyzed the mistakes with the textbook, scoring 83% correct, and copied the knowledge points from the wrong questions into my notebook.
location: Study, Room 302, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and contacting Old Chen
description: Maintained weight at 71 kg, washed up, then in bed sent Old Chen a WeChat message asking about the lowest price for Republic-era knife switches, set the alarm for 6 the next morning, turned off the light and went to sleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early morning wake-up and body awakening
description: The alarm went off at 6:10. After lying in bed for two minutes to wake up, I went to the balcony, took off my pajamas, and weighed myself: 70.9 kg. Then I laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of core, shoulder, and neck stretches, focusing on relaxing my right shoulder and wrist that were sore from yesterday's squash. At 6:35 I went into the bathroom to wash up, splashing cold water on my face to refresh myself, and felt completely invigorated.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and morning chores.
description: After washing up, I went to the dining room. My wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white congee, fried eggs, and Wenchang chicken mixed with soy sauce. I helped set out the bowls and chopsticks and called the two boys to get up and eat. During the meal I noticed Juanzi's face was pale. She said she hadn't slept well last night and felt a little dizzy, so I told her to drink plenty of warm water. After the meal, I checked both sons' schoolbags and folded the cleaned work clothes into the tool bag.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: On the way to drop off the kids at school and go to work.
description: I rode the e-bike with my two sons and set out. We first went to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At 7:20, I watched as a teacher took Hanhan into the kindergarten, and I waved goodbye. Then we rode along Guomao Road and Haixiu Road to Meilan District. At 7:40, I dropped Xuanxuan off at the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and take his vitamin C. After leaving the school, I rode along Haisheng Road. At 7:55, I ordered spicy soup rice and a fried egg to go from Big Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Shop for lunch, then continued riding for 2 minutes and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at 8:00. I parked the e-bike and walked into the office building.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Attend project sync meeting
description: Manager Liu convened the meeting on schedule about the renovation project for the two substations next month, and I was responsible for recording the key points. The meeting discussed equipment allocation, personnel grouping, and construction progress. I volunteered to be the leader of the transformer replacement team and proposed a detailed plan of 'survey first, then construct' to ensure on-site safety, which was recognized by Manager Liu.
location: Meeting room on the second floor of the office building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Organize meeting minutes, prepare for line inspection, and study at the work station
description: After the meeting, I returned to the work team. I quickly compiled the meeting minutes on the computer, printed them, and handed them to Team Leader Zhang for filing. Then I went with Team Leader Zhang to the tool room to check the safety helmets, insulating shoes, machetes, and binoculars needed for the afternoon line inspection, and told Team Leader Zhang that my wife was unwell and I might leave early in the afternoon, which he understood. Afterward, I returned to my workstation, flipped through the Transformer Maintenance Regulations to prepare for the renovation project, and also worked through 20 review questions from the Electric Power Safety Work Regulations on my phone.
location: Team workstation and tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and communication.
description: At his workstation, he opened the takeaway spicy soup rice. The steaming hot soup rice dispelled the fatigue of the morning. While eating, he sent a WeChat message to Old Chen asking for the lowest price and pictures of the Republic-era knife switch. After finishing, he cleaned up the lunchbox.
location: Team work station, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: He went to the engineering pickup truck in the parking lot, opened the passenger door, adjusted the seat back, lay down with eyes closed and rested for 20 minutes. Although cars occasionally came in and out of the parking lot, he was used to it and didn't find it noisy.
location: Parking lot, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon line inspection.
description: At 12:40, the three of us — Team Leader Zhang, Zhao Qiang, and I — took the work pickup truck along the Haiyu Middle Road to inspect overhead lines. Because the weather was dry, we focused on checking branches that might be broken off by autumn winds and touch the wires. On a section where the trees were too close to the lines, Team Leader Zhang supervised from the ground, I fastened my safety rope and used a machete to clear branches, and Zhao Qiang kept the log. Around 14:30, I got a call from Juanzi saying she felt dizzy and weak. After briefly comforting her, I explained the situation to Team Leader Zhang and got permission to finish early. Zhao Qiang drove me back to the company; we arrived around 14:45, and I got on my own electric bike.
location: Along Haiyu Middle Line, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Bought medicine and returned home to take care of his wife.
description: At 14:50, I set off from the company on my electric bike, heading along Haisheng Road and Haixiu Road to Longhua District. On the way, I bought two boxes of Huoxiang Zhengqi Liquid for my wife at Jingxintang Pharmacy in Longhua District. At 15:10, I arrived downstairs at Banshan Garden Residential Area. When I entered the room, Juanzi, who was half lying in bed, was already covered with a blanket. After asking gently, I poured a cup of warm water, opened a box of Huoxiang Zhengqi Liquid, and gave it to her. I helped her lie down, tucked in the blanket, and told her to rest well and not to worry about dinner.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare dinner in advance and do household chores
description: I went to the kitchen, took out greens, lean meat, and rice from the refrigerator, washed and cut them, and then simmered a lean meat and vegetable congee over low heat in a clay pot, wanting to make something light that suited Juanzi's appetite. While waiting, I went to the balcony to water a few pots of chili seedlings, then returned to the kitchen to scrub the stove and range hood and put the spice bottles back in order.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the child from school
description: Seeing that the porridge was almost done, I turned off the heat, rode the electric bike to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up Lu Zihan, and explained to the teacher that the family had something and I was taking her early. I picked up Hanhan at 16:40; then hurried to Longfeng Experimental Primary School and picked up Xuanxuan at 16:55. On the way home, I told Xuanxuan that his mother was not feeling well, so he should be quiet and do his homework on his own. Xuanxuan nodded understandingly.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Helping with homework and taking care of the children
description: Back home, I had Xuanxuan do his math homework at the dining table, and I pulled up a stool to sit beside him and tutor him; Hanhan was placed on the living room floor mat to play with toy trains and building blocks. While keeping an eye on Xuanxuan's vertical calculations, I also watched Hanhan to keep him from making noise and disturbing Mom's rest. Juanzi lay in bed, occasionally hearing our faint sounds.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner, housework, and getting the children washed up
description: I reheated the vegetable and lean pork congee, warmed up the spicy soup rice and fried eggs from lunch, and sliced some pickled vegetables. I gently woke Juanzi and helped her up to eat. The four of us sat around the table. I filled a bowl of hot congee for Juanzi and told her to drink plenty to help break a sweat; I also put a fried egg on each of my sons' plates. The dinner was simple and light, but the atmosphere was calm and reassuring. After dinner, I let Juanzi lie back down to rest. I quickly cleared and washed the dishes, then prepared bathwater and bathed Xuanxuan and Hanhan one by one, changing them into clean pajamas.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child animation time.
description: After the two children took a bath and were fresh and clean, I turned on the TV and switched to their favorite show, Octonauts, and let them quietly watch half an hour of cartoons on the sofa. I sat in the middle, accompanying them while taking a short rest.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Putting the kids to bed.
description: After the cartoon ended, I urged the two children to brush their teeth and then sent them to bed. I first sat by Hanhan's bed and told the story Guess How Much I Love You until he fell asleep; then I went to Xuanxuan's room, checked the remaining word problems, and only after confirming they were all correct did I turn off the light and let him sleep.
location: The two children's bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Video call with my wife's younger brother.
description: While wiping the table in the living room, the phone rang. It was a video call from Chen Zhiqiang, my wife's younger brother. Juanzi, feeling better, came over to join the conversation. A Qiang excitedly said that he had decided to bring his girlfriend Lin Xue back to Haikou on National Day to formally meet the family. We said yes repeatedly and asked with concern about Lin Xue's tastes and preferences. The call ended after about 20 minutes.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discuss the family dinner and call his mother
description: After hanging up, Juanzi and I perked up and sat at the dining table to discuss the menu for the National Day family dinner. I wrote it down on paper. Juanzi suggested Hainanese chicken rice, garlic steamed grilled fish, Qingbuliang, and Wenchang chicken. I added that we should order some dim sum from "Datie Laoba Tea Shop". After settling on a rough menu, I immediately called my mother Chen Xiuying and asked her to come over on National Day to help in the kitchen. She happily agreed and said she would come in the morning.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Light review and follow-up
description: Entered the study and used a mobile exam app to do a set of 30 multiple-choice questions on Transformer Principles, scoring 88% correct. Then opened WeChat and messaged Lao Chen, asking whether he was free tomorrow Saturday to go see the knife switch he mentioned, and saying he would bring the Yanghe liquor bottle over.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest
description: After taking a shower and changing into pajamas, I weighed myself again before bed and was still 70.9 kg. I poured a glass of warm water and brought it to Juanzi in the bedroom, asked how she was feeling, and she said she was much better. I turned off the living room light, and after getting into bed, chatted with Juanzi for a bit about the idea of going to Dongmen Market to buy fresh ingredients during the National Day holiday. Then I leaned against the headboard and, as usual, scrolled through the electric power collecting forum on my phone for a few minutes. Seeing no interesting updates, I put down my phone, turned off the bedside lamp, said goodnight to Juanzi, and fell into a deep sleep at around 23:10.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning core activation and stretching.
description: At 6:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang got up on time without lingering in bed. He spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of core activation and shoulder-neck stretching exercises. His movements were standard and precise, effectively eliminating the muscle soreness from after work the previous day, leaving his whole body relaxed.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Cycle to Wanlv Garden.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into a quick-dry short-sleeved shirt and running shoes, rode an electric scooter along Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue, and arrived at the gate of Wanlv Park five minutes later. He parked the scooter and prepared for his morning run.
location: Wanlv Garden Park parking lot, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run at Wanlv Garden and post-run stretching
description: After a brief warm-up at the entrance of Wanlv Park, Lu Mingqiang completed a 5 km morning run along the seaside trail, deliberately controlling his cadence and breathing, with a steady pace of 6 minutes 28 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he did full stretches in the fitness area using the high-low bars until his body stopped sweating.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province
