description: Lu Mingqiang rode his bike home, took a quick shower, and changed into the company's dark blue work uniform. His wife Wang Lijuan had already set the table with the multigrain porridge and fried eggs that had been arranged the night before. He ate until 70% full, and cut up the starfruit bought yesterday as an after-meal fruit.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.

After watching him enter the kindergarten, he turned around and rode to Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, dropping Lu Zixuan (Xuanxuan) at the school gate. Xuanxuan turned back and waved goodbye.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District

During the 20-minute ride, he thought through the key steps of the morning emergency repair. At the company gate he met his partner Chen Jianguo. The two went to the tool room together and attended a short pre-shift meeting led by Team Leader Zhang, who stressed that the emergency repair of the main power cable must succeed on the first attempt. After the meeting, they collected materials according to the list, including intermediate joints, waterproof tape, and insulated gloves, and loaded them onto the work pickup truck.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Emergency repair: making an underground cable intermediate joint.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo drove the engineering pickup truck to a construction site near Haisheng Road in Xiuying District to handle an emergency repair caused by an excavator cutting through a buried power cable. The two divided the work: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for stripping the cable and crimping the connectors, handling it skillfully and sanding each layer smooth with sandpaper; Chen Jianguo handled dehumidification and wrapping the waterproof tape. They finished before 11:30, successfully restored power, and politely declined the cigarettes offered by the client's site manager.
location: A construction site near Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned to the company and completed the emergency repair report.
description: After the emergency repair was completed, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company, washed the grease off his hands under a worksite water pipe, then returned to his workstation, opened the computer, filled in the electronic repair report with the complete repair process, materials used, and labor hours, printed it, signed it, and submitted it to Team Leader Zhang.
location: Workstation at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Lunch and chatting with coworkers
description: Lu Mingqiang and his colleague Chen Jianguo drove to Sha County Snacks (Cuiyuyuan Branch) at the entrance of the industrial park for lunch. He ordered chicken leg rice and a stewed soup pot. The two chatted while eating. Chen Jianguo mentioned that his son would have a blind date next month, and Lu Mingqiang jokingly shared his own experience of pursuing his wife Wang Lijuan back in the day. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Shaxian Snacks (Cuiyu Garden Branch), No. 98 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang did not return to the office. Instead, he went directly to the company break room and lay down to rest for half an hour to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Tool maintenance and organization

He wiped metal tools such as the ratchet wrench and crimping pliers with a cotton cloth, applied anti-rust oil, carefully checked the insulating gloves for damage, and finally put the tools neatly back into the tool cabinet according to their numbers.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

The bidding was not yet fierce, and the price was still within budget. He carefully studied the nameplate and knob details uploaded by the seller, judged the condition to be acceptable, and decided to bookmark the post and check the result later.
location: Workstation at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Self-study and self-improvement
description: There was still some time before getting off work, so Lu Mingqiang took out the textbook "Transformer Maintenance and Testing" and, combined with the internal training materials given by Manager Liu the day before, focused on studying the "Differential Protection Principle" chapter, circling key formulas and repeatedly calculating on scratch paper to deepen his understanding.
location: Workstation at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

Wang Lijuan was in charge of bargaining, while Lu Mingqiang carried the goods. They chose a live grouper (for grilled fish), a firm-textured Wenchang chicken, old coconuts, and mung beans, Job's tears, macaroni and other ingredients for qingbuliang. Finally they bought drinks, fruit and seasonings, and returned with a fully loaded shopping cart.

The family had a simple dinner.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time and helping with homework
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang first played with blocks with his younger son Lu Zihan in the living room, while his older son Lu Zixuan did math homework at a desk nearby. When Hanhan went to watch cartoons, he sat down beside Xuanxuan, used a ruler to draw diagrams and explain the method, and patiently tutored him through perimeter calculation problems until he fully mastered them.
location: Living room and study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening focused review and consolidation of wrong answers
description: After the two children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang made a cup of strong tea and went to his study to review past exam questions for electrical fundamentals. He checked the answers, recopied the 3 circuit calculation and 2 transformer principle problems he had gotten wrong the previous evening into his mistake notebook, worked through the correct solution process step by step, and then spent another half hour doing focused practice problems to consolidate.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family meeting and bedtime preparation.
description: After the review session, Lu Mingqiang went to the living room to discuss National Day family dinner details with his wife Wang Lijuan. They decided to have his younger brother Lu Zhiqiang take his girlfriend to visit Wanlv Garden and Qilou Old Street, and finalized that his mother would come at 7:00 a.m. on October 1 to help cook, with the meal starting at 12 noon sharp. After the discussion, Lu Mingqiang washed up and changed clothes, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, confirmed that the tool kit for visiting his parents was in order, and turned off the lights to rest at 23:00.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: At 6:30 on Saturday morning, it was already fully light. Lu Mingqiang sat up gently; his wife and children were still asleep. He did a 15-minute core workout on the living room mat: supermans, glute bridges, and planks. He had slept well last night and his old back injury didn't act up, so he felt full of energy.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run in Wanlv Park
description: After training, Lu Mingqiang changed his gear, rode his electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road, turned right onto Binhai Avenue, and arrived at Wanlv Garden about 8 minutes later. He ran an easy 5 kilometers along the lakeside path, with a steady pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds per kilometer, and felt pleasant as his running stirred up a breeze.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Back home for breakfast
description: After finishing his run, he returned home. His wife Wang Lijuan had just woken up and was busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang took a shower and changed into clean casual clothes. When he sat down at the dining table, his wife brought over steaming hot rice porridge and two fried eggs. He picked up a piece of home-pickled dried radish and ate with great satisfaction. Although he knew Hainan rice noodles were available outside, today he just wanted the taste of home cooking.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang took his tool bag and multimeter and walked to Boss Li's house in the next unit. He had agreed to this last week. He checked several outlets in the master bedroom and living room and found that one circuit had low insulation resistance, judging that the old concealed wiring had aged and become damp. He made a temporary fix in half an hour and advised Boss Li to have a qualified electrician rewire it next time. Boss Li thanked him repeatedly and insisted on giving him a pack of cigarettes; unable to refuse, he accepted.
location: Room 201, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family deep cleaning
description: After returning home, the whole family mobilized for a thorough cleaning. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for taking down and washing the living room curtains and wiping dust and stains off the windows. Following his wife Wang Lijuan's idea, they rearranged the sofa and coffee table, making the living room look spacious and bright. His son Xuanxuan was in charge of tidying the desk and toys, while his daughter Hanhan helped pass rags. Lu Mingqiang went to the guest room specifically to change the sheets, preparing for his wife's younger brother and his girlfriend to return for National Day.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After finishing the big cleaning, everyone was a bit tired. His wife Wang Lijuan made a quick lunch: tomato and egg noodles with leftover Wenchang chicken from last night. The family sat together, eating and discussing the afternoon plans. The children were curious about going out for a treasure hunt in the afternoon, and Lu Mingqiang promised to bring them some new gadgets when he came back. After eating, he leaned back on the sofa and closed his eyes for a while to regain his strength.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Treasure hunting at the Bo'ai Road flea market.
description: After a short rest, Lu Mingqiang set off on his electric bike, turned from Longhua Road onto Changdi Road, and arrived at the Bo'ai Road flea market in about 20 minutes. In front of Old Chen's stall, he spotted the Republic-era knife switch he had long desired. The words Nanyang Electrical Materials Store on the ceramic base were faint, but the item was in good condition. He suppressed his excitement, bargained with Old Chen, and finally closed the deal at 120 yuan. He wrapped it in a handkerchief and placed it on the footboard of his electric bike as if holding a treasure.

name: On the way home
description: On the way back, Lu Mingqiang did not ride fast. He was thinking about how to clean and oil this switch for maintenance when he got home. The maintenance posts from fellow collectors on the forum flashed through his mind. He decided to first clean off the dust with a soft-bristled brush, then apply a thin layer of anti-rust oil, and finally place it on the display shelf next to the moisture-proof cabinet. This genuine piece must be properly cared for.
location: During cycling, from Bo'ai Road, Haikou, Hainan Province to Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Organize new collection items
description: After getting home, Lu Mingqiang carefully placed the switch on the desk. He first gently brushed off the dust with a soft-bristled brush, then dipped a cotton cloth in some WD-40 precision electronics cleaner and wiped the contacts. Then he took out his collection album from the drawer, took a few macro photos with his phone, recorded the inscription details of the Nanyang Electrical Materials Store, and wrote in his notebook: September 27, 2025. Purchased from Old Chen on Bo'ai Road. First physical item, 120 yuan.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tablet browsing history triggers an argument
description: Lu Mingqiang put the new treasure into the wooden display cabinet in the living room; his wife Wang Lijuan was already trimming vegetables in the kitchen. He went over to help chop vegetables and casually said he would use the old tablet to browse the forum. His wife's expression turned a little unnatural, saying that last time Hanyu had played with it and tapped randomly, and might have opened the forum he often visited. Lu Mingqiang's heart tightened. Feeling his privacy had been invaded, he asked in a stiff tone, 'Did you look?' His wife hurriedly explained that it was absolutely not intentional. The atmosphere suddenly became heavy. He put down the kitchen knife and went to the balcony to get some fresh air.
location: Living room and kitchen of Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Dinner and parent-child time.
description: At the dinner table, the atmosphere was still subtly quiet. Lu Mingqiang picked food for his son Xuanxuan, checked his weekend math homework, pointed out several mistakes, and had him correct them. Afterwards, he accompanied his daughter Hanhan in the living room to build a model of the 'Bo'ai Road Flea Market' with building blocks. Hanhan curiously touched the ceramic base and asked him what treasure he had found today. He took out the switch to show her, and she curiously touched it.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Calm communication and mutual trust agreement
description: Once the children had gone to watch cartoons, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to walk to the living room and quietly call his wife out to the bedroom balcony. He candidly said that collecting and exam preparation were his private space, and it felt unpleasant to be seen. His wife reflected on this and admitted that she had taken a few extra looks out of curiosity, promising she had no intention of spying on him. He felt her apology and softened his tone. In the end, they reached an agreement: from then on, each would use their own tablet, phones would remain unlocked, but they promised not to secretly snoop through each other's. After opening up, he felt much more at ease.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening focused review
description: After the communication, he felt more at ease and could concentrate more easily. Lu Mingqiang went to the study, opened the textbook Transformer Overhaul and Testing, and focused on conquering the differential protection principle. He flipped to his mistake notebook and, while reading, drew logic diagrams of protective actions on scratch paper with a red pen. He made up a mnemonic: "Three-side currents calculate the differential current; the balance coefficient is key. Operating conditions depend on the knee point; fast-break and ratio protection must be clear." He repeated it silently to deepen his memory.
location: Study, Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing and washing up
description: After finishing the review, he felt a bit tired both mentally and physically. Lu Mingqiang put on his headphones, played Beyond's 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies,' closed his eyes, leaned back in the chair, and let the melody gradually wash away the trivialities of the day. After the song ended, he felt much more relaxed. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at himself in the mirror, he felt that although the day had some small bumps, it was overall fulfilling.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepare tomorrow's belongings and go to bed
description: Walking out of the bathroom, Lu Mingqiang first checked the tool bag he would take to his parents' home tomorrow: screwdriver, pliers, and voltage tester, confirming everything was complete. Then he took a bottle of honey from the kitchen cabinet that his wife had bought last week, planning to bring it to his mother. Entering the bedroom, his wife was still awake, reading the copy of The Lady of the Camellias on the bedside table. He said softly, "Go to sleep soon," then turned off the main light, left a bedside lamp on, and lay down. Tomorrow would be another fulfilling day.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning exercise and family breakfast.
description: The alarm went off on time in the early morning. After getting up, Lu Mingqiang first weighed in at 70.7 kg, then did 15 minutes of core and neck-shoulder stretches on the balcony to fully wake up his body. After washing up briefly, he changed into quick-dry sportswear, took a couple of gulps of warm water, grabbed his running waist pack and phone, and quietly went downstairs to ride his electric bike to Wanlv Garden. He turned right from Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue. The morning air was fresh, and he arrived at the west gate of Wanlv Garden in less than 10 minutes, parking the bike in the electric bike parking area. After warming up and stretching his legs beside the fitness square, he opened the fitness app at 7:00 on the dot and started a 10K challenge at a pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. He deliberately controlled his pace, focusing on breathing and cadence in the first half. After 5 kilometers, feeling that he still had energy, he picked up the pace slightly and sprinted the final kilometer. He completed his first ever 10K run in 1 hour 8 minutes 17 seconds. After stretching on a bench, he felt a strong sense of achievement. Then, at the gate of Wanlv Garden, he sent a WeChat message to his wife to share the joy, and bought three portions of rice rolls and two cups of soy milk to go from a roadside breakfast shop. On the ride home, he felt lighthearted and in high spirits. When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan and two sons were already up. He took a quick shower and changed into home clothes, and the family sat around the table enjoying rice rolls and soy milk. Lu Mingqiang shared his running experience and the plan to fly kites in the morning, and the room was filled with laughter and cheerful talk.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family kite flying at Wanlv Garden.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang took the handmade Bagua kite and line reel off the balcony, carefully checked the string, and then went downstairs to the storage room to take out the water hose, bucket, car wash liquid, and sponge for washing the car, placing them by the door to prepare for the afternoon car wash. His wife Wang Lijuan cleared the dishes and reminded him that they still had to visit his parents today. The family of four got ready and, taking the kite, water, and snacks, walked along Jinmao Middle Road to Evergreen Park. The two sons chased each other and laughed, full of joy. On the open lawn in the park, Lu Mingqiang personally taught his eldest son Lu Zixuan how to let out and reel in the line against the wind. When the kite first flew steadily high into the sky, Lu Zixuan cheered excitedly, while Lu Mingqiang guided him from the side on feeling the wind direction. His younger son Lu Zihan chased the kite's shadow and giggled, and his wife sat on a picnic mat using her phone to record the warm scene.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Shopping for and enjoying lunch
description: After flying kites, the family of four walked home. Passing the Vegetable Basket Community Supermarket on Guomao Sanheng Road, Lu Mingqiang and his wife went in to buy ingredients for lunch and dinner, including a fresh sea bass, a bunch of water spinach, tomatoes, eggs, and ginger, scallions, and garlic for tomorrow's family dinner. The two sons waited outside the door eating ice cream. After returning home, his wife cooked steamed sea bass and stir-fried water spinach with garlic; Lu Mingqiang helped by cooking rice and frying sunny-side-up eggs for the children. The lunch was simple and tasty, and the family chatted while eating about the fun of flying kites in the morning.
location: Cailanzi Community Supermarket, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, and Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, his wife took their second son for a nap, and the eldest son went back to his room to read extracurricular books. Lu Mingqiang set the alarm, lay down on the living room sofa, and fell into a deep sleep. He woke up about 45 minutes later and rested with his eyes closed, recovering most of his energy.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visiting parents
description: After the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang greeted his wife, took the honey and egg tarts, and rode his electric bike along Longhua Road, Heping Avenue, and Haifu Road to his parents' home in the old residential area on Haifu Road, Meilan District. His mother, Chen Xiuying, was picking vegetables and beamed when she saw her son. Lu Mingqiang chatted with her about family matters, asked about her health, and went over the details of tomorrow's family dinner, confirming that she would come over at 7 a.m. to help cook. He then accompanied his father, Lu Jianguo, on the balcony, chatting and drinking old man's tea while his father repaired an old radio. About 45 minutes later, Lu Mingqiang took his leave and rode his electric bike back along Haifu Road and Longhua Road.
location: Old residential community, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Vehicle cleaning and maintenance
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang changed into an old T-shirt and shorts and went downstairs to wash the car. He first used a high-pressure water gun to rinse off the dust and mud spots on the body, then used a sponge dipped in car wash liquid to carefully wipe the roof and wheel hubs, rinsed them with clean water, and dried them. After washing the car, he opened the storage room, took out the toolbox, cleaned the dust and grease in the gaps, oiled the moving parts, and reorganized and put them away by size and frequency of use. Then he took the dried car floor mats down from the balcony, went back downstairs to lay them in the car, bent down to tuck in the edges, and patted each seat to make sure the mats were smooth and snug.
location: Ground parking space and storage room, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: A surprising parent-child picture book time.
description: After laying out the foot mat and going upstairs home, Lu Mingqiang saw his second son Lu Zihan quietly sitting on the floor mat, flipping through a dinosaur picture book page by page and imitating dinosaur sounds. He watched quietly, warmth rising in his heart, then turned to the kitchen to point this out to his wife who was preparing ingredients; the two smiled at each other. Afterwards, he sat beside his younger son and patiently read the rest of the picture book with him.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help eldest son with his homework
description: The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, took out a few word problems from his weekend math homework that he couldn't solve and asked for help. Lu Mingqiang pulled up a chair and sat at the desk. Instead of giving the answers directly, he guided him step by step to read the problems and draw line-segment diagrams, letting him figure out the solutions on his own. More than ten minutes later, Lu Zixuan suddenly saw the light, calculated the correct answers himself, and wore a proud smile.
location: Eldest son's room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: When the time was about right, Lu Mingqiang put on an apron and took the initiative to cook, slicing tomatoes and scallion segments while his wife prepared the vegetables and cooked the fish. The two chatted about the day's events as they bustled about, working in perfect coordination. In less than an hour, steamed sea bass, tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried water spinach, and seaweed egg drop soup were brought to the table. The family sat together to enjoy the meal, and the two sons recounted the dinosaur picture book to their mother with great earnestness.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Neighborhood walk and package pickup.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang suggested the whole family go downstairs for a walk to aid digestion. The family strolled slowly along the tree-lined path in the community. His two sons ran ahead chasing and playing. He and his wife discussed the final confirmation for tomorrow's family dinner: he was responsible for buying dim sum for morning tea and picking up his wife's younger brother Zhiqiang, while his wife was responsible for receiving her mother and doing the cooking. When they reached the parcel locker, Lu Mingqiang picked up the electrical repair reference book he had ordered two days earlier.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Communication with the children about bedtime and evening study
description: After getting home, Lu Mingqiang bathed the two children and changed them into pajamas. His wife told bedtime stories, while he went to the study to quickly browse the table of contents of the reference books he had just picked up and placed them on the desk for later use. After the children fell asleep, he turned on the desk lamp in the study and began his evening review. He first spent half an hour re-deriving the wrong differential protection calculation problems, then flipped to the chapter on renewable energy grid integration technology, highlighted key points with a fluorescent marker, and wrote a summary in his notebook. After reviewing, he closed the books and went to the bedroom, where he and his wife went over the details of tomorrow's family dinner using a sticky note: his mother would arrive at 7 a.m., Zhiqiang would pick her up at the east bus station at 2 p.m., the order of hot and cold dishes, and putting the cold beer in the fridge in advance. After confirming, Lu Mingqiang stuck the note on the refrigerator door.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: While washing up, he weighed himself at 70.8 kg, 0.1 kg heavier than in the morning, which was normal. Looking in the mirror, he rotated his shoulders and felt the workout volume was just right. After leaving the bathroom, he took out the long-sleeve work clothes and socks for tomorrow and placed them on the bedside table. Lying in bed, he played 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' at low volume on his phone, thinking back on today's running breakthrough, seeing his younger son reading by himself, and the smile on his older son's face after he helped him solve problems—a warmth filled his heart. He turned off the light, closed his eyes, and soon fell asleep, ending a full and satisfying day.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and body activation
description: The phone alarm "Glorious Days" rang on time, and Lu Mingqiang got up immediately. He went to the bathroom and washed his face with cold water to wake up, then spread out a yoga mat in the open space beside the bed in the bedroom and did 15 minutes of morning stretching and core training, focusing on the back of the thighs and hips after yesterday's long run. He did pigeon pose, downward-facing dog, and shoulder-neck circles. After stretching, he stepped on the electronic scale, saw 70.6 kg, and silently noted it.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning jog and electric bicycle cleaning.
description: He changed into running gear, rode his electric bike about 3 minutes to Wanlv Garden, and did a 5-kilometer recovery run at a steady pace of around 6 minutes 26 seconds per kilometer, then stretched in the equipment area. After returning to the residential complex, while still sweaty, he fetched water and used a rag to carefully wipe down the seat, handlebars, and body of his electric bike parked in the covered bike shed downstairs.
location: Wanlv Garden Park and the downstairs parking shed of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast, shower, and getting ready to leave
description: After wiping down his electric bike, Lu Mingqiang went upstairs. His wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked plain rice porridge and fried two sunny-side-up eggs. He took a quick shower, changed into a short-sleeve work shirt, and sat at the dining table. While drinking porridge, he called his mother Chen Xiuying, who lives in Meilan District, to confirm that she would arrive at 7 a.m. the next morning to help. After breakfast, he checked the tool pouch at his waist and confirmed that the screwdriver, voltage tester, and flashlight were all there. Then he put the safety inspection card and pen into his chest pocket.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting to work
description: Wheeled out the e-bike, first took my second son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten and watched him enter the school gate; then turned around to take my eldest son Lu Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him on the way to wait for Grandma to pick him up after school. At 08:28, I rode to the industrial park on time, clocked in, and parked. The total commute took about 33 minutes.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, and Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Special safety inspection ahead of National Day
description: At the pre-shift meeting, Foreman Zhang emphasized the importance of pre-holiday inspections. The team was mainly responsible for re-checking old distribution rooms and outdoor ring main units that could easily be touched by branches. Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang for on-site teaching. In front of an outdoor ring main unit, they found a dead palm branch less than one meter from the high-voltage lead. He directed Zhao Qiang to knock it down with an insulating rod and personally taught him how to judge safe distances and fill out hazard inspection records. In another old distribution room, they checked the rodent-proof mesh in the cable trench and the pressure values of fire extinguishers one by one, and signed after all were qualified.
location: Power distribution rooms and outdoor ring main units near Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, as well as along Jintan Road and the western extension of Binhai Avenue.

name: Pick up the cake and buy a birthday gift.
description: After greeting Boss Zhang, he set off on the electric bike. First, at the bakery at No. 8 Meihua Road, he picked up an 8-inch fresh fruit cake using his phone number, and put it in an insulated bag. Then he rode about 3 minutes to Xiuying Wanda Plaza, went straight to the Chow Tai Fook counter on the first floor, selected a silver four-leaf clover necklace, had the sales assistant check it, put it in a velvet bag, and placed it in the inner layer of his crossbody tool bag.
location: Bakery at No. 8 Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Haikou Xiuying Wanda Plaza, No. 29 Haiyu Middle Line, Xiuying District

name: Lunch and cake arrangements
description: After completing the task, Lu Mingqiang ordered a set meal of spicy soup rice at Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant on Haisheng Road. After eating quickly, he rode back to the industrial park, carefully placed the insulated bag containing the cake in a corner next to his workstation where it wouldn't be in the way, made sure the air conditioning could reach it, and put a thick book against the edge to prevent it from being knocked over.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road.

name: Lunch break at the workstation.
description: During the lunch break, while the other workers were scrolling on their phones or napping at their desks, Lu Mingqiang lowered the back of his chair, put on his earphones, and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes, silently reviewing what might be discussed in the afternoon meeting and thinking through the evening arrangements.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Monthly safety summary and pre-holiday arrangement meeting
description: At the start of the meeting, Manager Liu reported on the September safety situation, then singled out Lu Mingqiang for praise, saying that his previous handling of the main cable fault was accurate in judgment and decisive in execution, and announced that he planned to give special recognition in the quarterly bonus. In the second half of the meeting, he emphasized electrical safety during the National Day holiday and the duty system. Before adjourning, Manager Liu announced that except for personnel on duty, everyone could leave work half an hour early.
location: Large conference room, 3rd Floor, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Left work early and went home to hide a surprise.
description: Left the company by bike at 16:00 and arrived home 15 minutes later. He opened the cake packaging and checked it was intact, then hid the cake and the small velvet pouch containing the silver necklace together in an unused storage box at the very back of the living room cabinet, making sure the children wouldn't find them.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the kids and shop at the vegetable market
description: After leaving home, he first picked up his second son Lu Zihan, who excitedly showed off the little red flag he had made in handwork class; then he picked up his eldest son Lu Zixuan, who asked if he could play all day tomorrow. Lu Mingqiang agreed with a smile. On the way, he stopped at Longhua Vegetable Market to buy fresh water spinach, a few taels of small sea fish, and a piece of winter melon, planning to make a simple dinner.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District; to Longhua Vegetable Market, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Parent-child time and dinner preparation
description: After arriving home, his wife had already come back. She took the vegetables and went into the kitchen to get busy. Lu Mingqiang played with the two children in the living room. Hanhan ran around waving a small red flag, and when Xuanxuan took out his homework notebook, he heard that there was a cake hidden in the house. Lu Mingqiang mysteriously said it was a surprise for Mom the day after tomorrow and that Xuanxuan must not give it away. Then the father and sons built a cake castle with LEGO. The smell of pan-fried small sea fish drifted out of the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang wanted to help but was pushed out by his wife.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Warm dinner and plans for tomorrow
description: Dinner was pan-fried small sea fish, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and pork rib and winter melon soup. The family ate while discussing tomorrow's arrangements for picking up great-uncle and the wife's younger brother: Mother would return home at 7 AM, set off at 8 AM to pick them up at Haikou East Railway Station, and the banquet would begin at 12 PM. The children vied to go, and the wife smiled and said everyone would go, adding that drinks and snacks were already prepared in the living room, and the National Day atmosphere was growing.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Homework guidance and evening review
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang had his wife take the younger child to bathe, while he tutored the older son in the living room on a Chinese test paper and math word problems. At 20:40 he urged him to brush his teeth and wash up. After the child entered the bedroom, he went to the study, turned on the desk lamp, reviewed the last few pages of the Switching Operation Standards chapter, marked key points, and then used a phone quiz app for targeted practice on switching operations. He got 87% correct on 15 multiple-choice questions and screenshotted the wrong answers to look at again tomorrow.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Contacted my master and prepared for tomorrow.
description: After the review, he sent his retired master Li Dehou a WeChat voice message to wish him a happy National Day, and his master replied with a resounding blessing. Then he went to the living room and prepared the items he might need for tomorrow's station pickup — ID card, wallet, folding umbrella — and placed them on the shoe cabinet in the entryway.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up before bed and nighttime chat with wife
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang lay on the bed and discussed the accommodation details for the great-uncle's visit tomorrow with his wife, who had just settled the children. They decided to tidy the guest room for him to stay. He mentioned being praised at the afternoon meeting and the possibility of a bonus. His wife was happy and joked that since his birthday was the day after tomorrow, she would buy him another gift. After turning off the light, he put on earphones, listened to "Boundless Sea and Sky," and fell asleep to the music.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 8, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and deep stretching
description: Your biological clock wakes you at exactly 5:50. You quietly walk out of the bedroom, unroll the yoga mat on the living room floor mat, and do 15 minutes of deep core and full-body stretching. You focus especially on the lower back and backs of the thighs—the 'debt' left from standing for long periods and bending during yesterday's inspection. Every stretch is done properly, and you feel the muscles slowly open up and the joints become more flexible.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and exercise at Wanlv Garden
description: At 6:08, you rode your e-bike and arrived at Evergreen Park in about six minutes. Haikou's early morning breeze was gentle, and the air felt moist. You started today's 5 km jog, with a steady pace around 6:30 per kilometer. Running along the familiar path, watching the Ferris wheel in the distance, you calculated that this month's total running distance had already exceeded the plan. After the run, you did two sets of pull-ups at the pull-up bar area, feeling your back muscles engage. Watching the rising sun, you felt that this September had been truly solid.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and taking the child to school.
description: Got home at 7:05, took a refreshing warm shower, and changed into work clothes. Juanzi had already made breakfast. You ate rice porridge and barbecue pork buns with her and chatted about everyday things. At 7:25, you rode the e-bike, first taking Hanhan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, holding his little hand and walking him into the campus. Then you turned the bike around and at 7:40 dropped Xuanxuan off at the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School, telling him to listen carefully in class and wait at the school gate for Dad after school.
location: The residential area of Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then went to Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District) and Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District)

name: Pre-holiday work wrap-up and team communication
description: You arrived at the company at 8:05. In the morning, you first archived the maintenance reports for the remaining two buildings from yesterday's inspection and filled out the Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Record Form. As expected, Jianguo asked in his loud voice about your National Day plans. You chatted for a bit; he said he planned to take his wife and kids to Sanya for two days, and you said your family was holding a family dinner, so you wouldn't join the festivities. Squad Leader Zhang came over to discuss tomorrow's National Day duty assignment, and you volunteered for the afternoon standby shift. After that, you thoroughly cleaned out the toolbox at your workstation, put the used wrenches and screwdrivers back by model, and wiped off the dust.
location: Maintenance team workstation and workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Had lunch with colleagues
description: At 11:30, you strolled with Jianguo to "Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant" near the company. As usual, you ordered a spicy soup rice and a white cut chicken. The broth was spicy and appetizing, the chicken tender and smooth, and with the restaurant's special sauce, it was a very satisfying meal. You and Jianguo chatted idly; he said he wanted to go sea fishing during the holiday, but since you had to be with your family, you couldn't go together.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bidding online for an antique multimeter at noon.
description: After eating, you returned to the company and saw that your colleagues had started to doze off. You unhurriedly walked out of the office building and climbed into the work pickup truck parked in the back. You closed the car windows and opened the Taobao auction page on your phone. The 1974 pointer multimeter made by Shanghai Qiujing Factory, which you had been watching for nearly a week, was counting down. You held your breath. In the last minute, you decisively entered your target price of 160 yuan and clicked "Bid." Five minutes later, the system showed "Bid successful"! Overjoyed, you immediately took a screenshot and sent it to your "Wine Bottle Collectors Guangdong-Hainan Friends" group with the caption: "Got it! Nice condition." The group soon became lively, and Old Chen even @'d you, saying "Good eye"!
location: Pickup truck cab at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park parking lot project, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrapping up afternoon work and discussing leave
description: You returned to your workstation in a good mood. With no urgent tasks in the afternoon, you updated the team tool requisition ledger that you hadn't finished in the morning and sorted out a few technical drawings that might be needed next week. At 14:00, you walked into Team Leader Zhang's office and told him truthfully: “Boss Zhang, there's a family gathering at home tomorrow. I'd like to take leave tomorrow afternoon and leave about an hour early, so I can pick up the kids earlier and get things ready at home.” Team Leader Zhang readily approved and reminded you to stay safe during the holiday.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare a surprise for his wife: pick up the cake and buy flowers
description: At 14:40, you got on your electric bike and first went to Aili Cake Shop at No. 8 Meihua Road, gave your phone number, and picked up the 8-inch fresh fruit cake you had ordered yesterday; the staff carefully packed it for you. Then you went to the Huazhiyu flower shop on Jinmao Middle Road near home, the one you often visit, and asked the owner to put together a mixed bouquet featuring champagne roses with white baby's breath. At 15:10 you got home; no one was there. You moved quickly: wrapped the cake box in a plastic bag, and together with the necklace box hidden in the cabinet storage box yesterday, transferred them to the deepest part of the wardrobe; then wrapped the bouquet in a black garbage bag and hid it with them, ensuring everything was securely concealed.
location: In Haikou City, Hainan Province, he first went to Aili Cake Shop at 8 Meihua Road, Xiuying District, then to Huazhiyu Flower Shop on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, and finally returned home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road.

name: Pick up the child from school and buy groceries
description: Left at 15:40, first waited at the kindergarten gate for a while, and was the first to pick up Hanhan. The little one happily showed you the national flag sticker handed out at school. Then, taking him with you, you rode slowly to Xuanxuan's school. At 16:10, you picked up Xuanxuan and asked him what he learned today. He said he scored 96 on the math test. You patted his head to encourage him. On the way, you dropped by Jinmao Wenhua Vegetable Market and bought a bunch of water spinach and ingredients for tomorrow's family dinner, spending a few yuan. Arrived home at 17:15, let the two children play by themselves in the living room, and went to the kitchen to take out the meat and vegetables for dinner to thaw.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: from Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, to Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, then to Jinmao Wenhua Market on Wenhua Road, and finally back to Banshan Garden residential area at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Kitchen food preparation and parent-child interaction
description: You put on an apron and start preparing dinner. First you steam the rice, then you pick and wash the water spinach you bought. Xuanxuan is doing homework in the living room, while Hanhan plays with his little toy car at your feet. As you pick the vegetables, you answer his naive question, 'Dad, why do vegetables need to be washed?' You patiently tell him that it is because there is mud and dust on the leaves.
location: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Wife Juanzi got home at 18:00, changed clothes, and came to the kitchen to help. You quickly stir-fried three dishes: garlic stir-fried water spinach, tomato scrambled eggs, and the leftover braised pork from last night. The family sat around the dining table eating. During the meal, you told her that your mother would come over at 7 a.m. tomorrow to help in the kitchen, so she didn't need to go grocery shopping too early. Xuanxuan kept asking for his uncle, and you confirmed the news that your wife's younger brother Zhiqiang would arrive home around 10 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Evening parent-child time and homework tutoring
description: After dinner, you cleared the table. At 19:00, you sat down next to Xuanxuan and helped him correct the wrong answers on his math test paper. You patiently explained the word problems about 'division with remainders' and gave several real-life examples until he fully understood. Hanhan was beside you, under your care, building a lopsided 'castle' out of blocks. At 20:00, your wife urged the children to go wash up.
location: Study and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Exam prep: Working through the error notebook
description: After settling the children, you made yourself a cup of tea and sat down at the desk in the study. You took out the mistake notebook for Switching Operation Procedures and Differential Protection, the last thing to review this month. You opened it and went through it page by page. The problems that had once made you stuck now seemed much clearer. Next to a few questions that still seemed important, you drew another key star mark. You felt that this month's review had been effective, and you were more confident about the exam.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Listening to music to relax
description: Close the book, put on your earphones, and open the music app on your phone. You first play "Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies" by Beyond. The familiar melody and lyrics: "How many times, facing cold eyes and ridicule, have I never given up the ideal in my heart..." remind you of the moments of persevering in training and studying this month. Then you listen to "Friends" by Wakin Chau, thinking of the brothers on the construction site who lent a hand, and your heart feels warm.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Weight measurement and monthly summary
description: You walk out of the study and step onto the scale in the corner of the bedroom. The LED numbers flicker a few times and steadily stop at "70.5." You can't help but grin. You open the notebook full of data on the nightstand and solemnly write on the September 30 line: "Weight: 70.5kg; monthly mileage: done; exam prep: OK. Tomorrow's family dinner, a surprise for Juanzi." Then you record the last weight and total monthly running distance of this September. This September is complete.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After washing up and changing into your pajamas, you lie down in bed and say goodnight to your wife. You set the alarm for 5:55 tomorrow and run through the general plan for tomorrow: picking up people, preparing dishes, and setting things up. Thinking of the surprise hidden in the wardrobe and the lively family dinner tomorrow, you close your eyes with a full sense of contentment. Tomorrow is a new month, a new beginning.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning stretching and family preparations
description: At 7:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang was woken by his phone alarm. He did not linger in bed. First, he did a 10-minute full-body stretch by the bed, focusing on loosening his lower back, shoulders, and neck, a habit he had maintained for a long time. After washing up, he went to the living room and helped his wife Wang Lijuan tidy up the toys and picture books on the dining table, put them into storage bins, and wiped the living room floor mat, preparing for the arrival of his mother and his younger brother's family.
location: Master bedroom and living room of the home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and welcoming my mother.
description: His wife prepared a simple breakfast: rice porridge, fried eggs, pickled mustard, and barbecue pork buns. While eating, Lu Mingqiang told his two sons to behave because there would be guests today. His older son Lu Zixuan nodded sensibly, while his younger son Lu Zihan was a bit naughty. At 7:45, his mother Chen Xiuying called and said she had arrived at the entrance of the residential community. Lu Mingqiang put down his chopsticks and quickly went downstairs to bring his mother home.
location: Home dining room and residential community entrance, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Helping prepare ingredients for the family banquet
description: Mother Chen Xiuying brought over her homemade pickled cabbage, a free-range chicken, and sweet potato leaves. The moment she walked in, she tied on an apron and bustled about the kitchen with her daughter-in-law. She chopped the chicken for Hainanese chicken rice, while Wang Lijuan cleaned pork stomach for a stew. Lu Mingqiang stayed in the living room looking after their two sons, getting them to build with Lego, while he peeled garlic and washed scallions on the side. Occasionally his wife would call him to run downstairs to the convenience store for soy sauce or cooking wine. The kitchen was filled with tempting aromas as the family made careful preparations for the evening reunion dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Running errands for purchases and organizing tools
description: The peppercorns for the soup were not enough, so Lu Mingqiang went downstairs to Xingfa Convenience Store in the community and bought white peppercorns and salt. After returning home, he took them to the kitchen, then went to the balcony, opened the toolbox, and checked the screwdrivers and pliers. He found the screwdriver tips were a bit worn and planned to buy a new set another day.
location: Xingfa Convenience Store in Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the balcony at home.

name: Simple lunch and a short break
description: The midday meal was simple: Wang Lijuan cooked Hainan rice noodles, served with bean sprouts and pickled mustard greens brought by her mother, and the family of five ate quickly. Lu Mingqiang ate his fill. After the meal, his wife cleared the dishes, while he coaxed the two children to get ready for a nap on the sofa. He then sat on the sofa to rest, mentally planning the afternoon reception and the evening phone call.
location: Dining room and living room at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Short afternoon nap and tidying up the house
description: The children were watching cartoons in the living room, and Mother went back to the guest room to rest. Lu Mingqiang was not in the habit of napping, so he turned on the air conditioner in the master bedroom, then tidied the second bedroom for his younger brother Aqiang and his girlfriend Lin Xue, changing the sheets and duvet covers, and organizing the clutter in the wardrobe to make sure they would stay comfortably.
location: Master bedroom and second bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family leisure and waiting to set off
description: After the nap, the children regained their energy. Lu Mingqiang took out the dartboard, hung it on the living room wall, and played darts with his elder son, while his younger son bounced a ball beside them. His mother and wife sat on the sofa, trimming sweet potato leaves while watching the National Day special on TV. Lu Mingqiang occasionally looked at his phone, estimating when his younger brother's family would arrive.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drive to pick up wife's younger brother and his girlfriend
description: At 2:30 p.m., Chen Zhiqiang, his wife's younger brother, sent a WeChat message saying the shuttle bus was about to arrive at Haikou East Bus Station. Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan brought their two children and drove to the station, arriving in about 19 minutes. At the exit, they picked up Chen Zhiqiang, who was carrying big bags, and his slightly shy girlfriend, Lin Xue. Lu Mingqiang smiled and patted Aqiang's shoulder, then took the luggage, while Wang Lijuan warmly took Lin Xue's hand and asked how she was doing. Afterward, the group drove back home.
location: Haikou East Bus Station, 148 Haifu Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family Reception and Afternoon Tea
description: Back home, his mother Chen Xiuying warmly greeted Aqiang and Lin Xue. His wife served Laoba tea snacks—wife cakes, small cakes, and black tea. Everyone sat around drinking tea and chatting. The children felt close to the newly arrived maternal uncle. Lin Xue took out the electronic toys and storybooks she had prepared, and the children were delighted. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Final push in the kitchen and preparation for the family dinner
description: In the evening, his mother and wife returned to the kitchen for the final cooking sprint. Lu Mingqiang was assigned to set up the table and chairs and arrange the bowls and chopsticks. His wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang wanted to help, but Lu Mingqiang stopped him and asked him to keep Lin Xue company and chat. Lu Mingqiang brought out the baijiu his younger brother had brought and several bottles of drinks. At exactly 7:00 pm, a lavish National Day family feast was ready.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: National Day family reunion dinner.
description: The dining room was brightly lit, and the table was full of his mother's and wife's specialty dishes: shiny Hainanese chicken rice, steamed grouper, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, pork belly and chicken soup, braised pork hock, and Wenchang chicken brought by Lin Xue. Everyone raised their glasses to celebrate National Day, eating and chatting about family matters. Chen Zhiqiang talked about his electronics business in Shenzhen, Lin Xue shared funny stories from kindergarten, and the two children competed to perform nursery rhymes. Lu Mingqiang didn't say much, but watching the family enjoying such harmony, he felt deeply at ease.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner chores and weekend gathering invitation.
description: After the meal, his wife and mother cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, while Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony to make phone calls. He first called his kite-flying friend Chen Jie and invited him to go kite-flying at Wanlv Park at 8:30 the day after tomorrow. Chen Jie readily agreed. Then he sent a WeChat voice message to his fellow worker Chen Jianguo, inviting his family to go along. Chen Jianguo replied that it was a good chance to take his daughter out for some sun, and agreed. Lu Mingqiang noted down the two families and planned to bring the newly bought kite with them the day after tomorrow.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family evening relaxation and hospitality
description: After the phone call, Lu Mingqiang returned to the living room, where his wife and mother were chatting with A Qiang and Lin Xue, and the children were playing with new toys on the play mat. Lu Mingqiang sat down, occasionally chiming in with amusing work stories, and checked the weather forecast on his phone, confirming that the wind the day after tomorrow would be suitable for kite flying. Around 10 p.m. the children got sleepy, and Wang Lijuan put them to bed, while Lu Mingqiang chatted a bit longer with A Qiang and Lin Xue, telling them the air conditioner and Wi-Fi password for the guest bedroom before letting them go wash up and rest.
location: Living room and second bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tidying up the guest room and preparing for bed
description: After the house quieted down, Lu Mingqiang first went to the second bedroom to help Aqiang and Lin Xue put away their clothes and luggage and checked the bedding to make sure it was comfortable. Then he returned to the master bedroom, applied a hot towel to his lower back to relieve the day's fatigue, and softly summed up the busy but fulfilling day with his wife. Thinking about taking the children to fly kites the day after tomorrow, he felt warm inside, turned off his phone at 23:00, and fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom and second bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning stretching and buying medicine for my mother
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, I did joint exercises and core stretches on the living room floor to loosen up my muscles and bones. Then I put on a jacket, took the e-bike keys and my mother's medical insurance card, rode the e-bike along Jinmao Middle Road to Jianmin Pharmacy, and bought dog-skin plasters for rheumatism, joint pain relief patches, and vitamin B2 for my mother, paying with the medical insurance card.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Jianmin Pharmacy (Jinmao Middle Road store)

name: Return home for breakfast and help with meal preparation.
description: After buying medicine and returning home, he handed the medicine to his mother and explained how to use it. He then enjoyed the meat-and-egg rice rolls bought from the breakfast stall at the community gate and the homemade soy milk together with his wife Wang Lijuan and his mother. After the meal, he proactively joined the food preparation, cut the free-range chicken into pieces, cleaned the sweet potato leaves, and took out the induction cooker and divided hotpot pot from the storage room to prepare for the noon hotpot lunch.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family food preparation and casual chat
description: Continuing to prepare ingredients with his wife in a division of labor, handling flower crab, sea prawns, enoki mushrooms, tofu and other ingredients. His father also joined in to help prepare the soup base. During the preparation, the family chatted; his mother mentioned that his elder brother Lu Minghua couldn't come home for the holiday because of overtime. After hearing this, Lu Mingqiang planned to send photos in the afternoon to share the family's lively atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up my wife's younger brother and his girlfriend
description: After receiving a call from his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang, Lu Mingqiang went downstairs to the community gate to pick him up along with his girlfriend Lin Xue. The two had returned from their trip and were carrying fruit bought along the way. After brief greetings, they went upstairs together, and the home became more lively.
location: Entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Finishing food preparation and chatting in the living room.
description: The food preparation in the kitchen was basically done, and everyone moved to the living room to drink tea and chat. Chen Zhiqiang talked about his idea of starting an electronics business in Shenzhen and planned to try selling products through Douyin live streaming. His father occasionally interjected to discuss. The two sons were watching cartoons nearby, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: National Day family hotpot lunch.
description: The family sat around the folding round table, enjoying a dual-flavor hot pot with bone broth on one side and a sour-spicy soup made from fermented grain vinegar on the other. As they cooked and chatted, Chen Zhiqiang mentioned that a senior electrician certificate could lead to a salary increase and encouraged Lu Mingqiang to apply for the exam, with Lin Xue echoing the suggestion. Lu Mingqiang said he was interested and planned to ask the company's HR office about the requirements, while his father happily talked about his own experience of being assessed as a technician back in the day.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon tidying up and casual chat with family
description: After the hotpot meal, his wife, his mother, and Lin Xue washed the dishes and cleaned up in the kitchen, while Lu Mingqiang accompanied his father and his wife’s younger brother in the living room, drinking tea and continuing to talk about Chen Zhiqiang’s electronics business in Shenzhen and his Douyin product-sales plan. The younger son, Hanhan, was getting sleepy and was carried by his wife to take an afternoon nap.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Inspect and organize kite equipment.
description: Taking advantage of the break while chatting in the living room, he went to the balcony alone to repair several kites. He used fishing line and 502 glue to reinforce the loose bamboo frame of the swallow-shaped kite, readjusted the barrel kite's bridle to a more stable double bridle, and counted and organized the line spools. Then he packed the kites, gloves, sun hat, mineral water, snacks and other items into a large backpack to prepare for flying them.
location: Balcony, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rain shower break and chat
description: A sudden rain shower interrupted the work on the balcony. He carried the kite backpack back inside and chatted with his mother and wife about Haikou’s rapidly changing weather, remarking that the air would be especially fresh after the rain.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening Parent-Child Running and Cycling
description: After the rain, the air was fresh. Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and took his two sons downstairs for some activity. His younger son Hanhan led the way on a small tricycle, while Lu Mingqiang jogged slowly with his elder son Zixuan around the flower beds in the community, teaching him a breathing rhythm of two steps in, two steps out. Finally, they walked a slow lap hand in hand, and the three of them broke into a light sweat.
location: Inner Ring Road, Banshan Garden Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Took a shower and prepared dinner
description: After the run, he went home, took a shower, and changed into clean loungewear. His wife was in the kitchen reheating leftovers and also stir-fried tomatoes and eggs. Lu Mingqiang poured out the remaining coconut water as a drink, preparing a simple dinner.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Arrangements for dinner and an evening outing with his wife's younger brother.
description: The family had a simple dinner. After dinner, his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang and his girlfriend Lin Xue planned to go to Qilou Old Street to experience Haikou's nightlife. Lu Mingqiang gave them detailed directions on taking Bus 33 to Zhonglou Station, and reminded them to stay safe and return early.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening settling-in and family interaction.
description: He watched a variety show with his mother, massaged her knees, and applied the newly bought medicated patches. His eldest son was drawing a big dragon kite with crayons on the coffee table, and his wife was folding clothes in the bedroom. Lu Mingqiang sent his elder brother Lu Minghua a WeChat message with holiday greetings and shared photos of the family lunch and parent-child activities. His brother replied, telling him to take good care of their parents.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Supervise the children's washing up and electrician study
description: After urging his oldest son to wash up and go to sleep, he took out Examples of Electrical Equipment Installation and Commissioning borrowed from the construction site from the bedside table, leaned against the headboard, focused on reading the chapters on motor wiring and inverter commissioning, underlined the key points with a pen, and prepared for the senior electrician certificate exam.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep wrap-up and rest
description: After lying down, he quietly discussed with his wife the matter of taking the senior technician exam. She supported him, and feeling reassured, he soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: At six in the morning, Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally, thinking about the kite flying. He first went to the balcony to feel the wind, confirmed that a force 2–3 breeze was just right, then did ten minutes of stretching. He checked the eagle kite he had reinforced the day before, confirming that the reel was smooth and the bamboo frame was firm. At 6:45, he woke his wife Wang Lijuan and his two sons Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. As soon as Xuanxuan heard they were going to fly kites, he excitedly put on his Ultraman T-shirt by himself; Hanhan lingered in bed, and Lu Mingqiang coaxed him up with 'Let's go watch the big eagle fly into the sky.' Wang Lijuan put sunscreen jackets on the children, while Lu Mingqiang stuffed the snacks and fruit prepared the night before, a large bottle of cold boiled water, a spare reel, small scissors, and sunscreen into the backpack, and slung the kite reel over his shoulder. Breakfast was Hainan rice noodles cooked by Wang Lijuan. Xuanxuan ate most of a bowl, and Hanhan also fed himself with a spoon. Lu Mingqiang finished first. After eating, he went downstairs, drove the car out of the garage, turned on the air conditioner to cool it down, then went back inside, put on his backpack, checked the water and electricity, and the family of four locked the door and went downstairs.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drive to Evergreen Park
description: Lu Mingqiang drove along Jinmao Middle Road, turned right onto Binhai Avenue, and headed east toward Wanlv Park. Hanhan hummed a nursery rhyme in the rear child seat, while Xuanxuan pressed against the car window looking at the scenery. Since it was the National Day holiday, there was little traffic, and they arrived at the east gate parking lot of Wanlv Park in about 15 minutes.
location: From Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Wanlv Garden East Gate Parking Lot, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City.

name: Meeting friends at Wanlv Park
description: After parking the car, Lu Mingqiang carried the kite and led his family of four toward the east gate of Wanlv Park. In the distance, he saw his friends Chen Jie and Chen Jianguo and their families already sitting on mats spread on the lawn and chatting. Lu Mingqiang smiled and went over to greet them. Jianguo's daughter had brought a little dinosaur kite and soon got to playing with Xuanxuan. Everyone exchanged lively greetings, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Near the East Gate entrance of Wanlv Garden, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organized and guided kite flying.
description: Lu Mingqiang quickly chose a grassy area far from high-voltage lines and with a wide, open wind path, and called everyone to spread out. He was the first to launch the one-meter-long eagle kite. Running against the wind and controlling the line with alternate tugs and tightening, he sent the eagle steadily climbing high into the sky, its tail fluttering. He then became the on-site 'head coach,' personally teaching Chen Jianguo how to tighten or loosen the reel according to the wind. More importantly, he guided his son Xuanxuan in flying the little butterfly kite. He crouched beside Xuanxuan, patiently explaining when to run and when to release the line. After three or four attempts, the little butterfly finally wobbled into the air, and Xuanxuan was so excited that he jumped up and down, his face flushed red. Hanhan, held by his mother, looked up at the kites filling the sky, reaching out his little hands and shouting.
location: Large lawn on the south side of the east gate of Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simple meal and conversation under the shade.
description: The sun rose higher, and everyone tied their kites to chairs and spread out mats in the shade of the trees. Lu Mingqiang's family brought out the prepared Hainan noodles, refreshing dessert soup, and cut fruit, and chatted while eating with Chen Jianguo, Chen Jie, and others. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo talked about the company's work after the holiday. Jianguo mentioned that there might be a capacity-expansion and renovation project for an old substation line after the holiday, and Team Leader Zhang might send their team. Chen Jie excitedly showed the newly improved swallow kite frame drawing on his phone, explaining how to adjust the curvature of the bamboo strips to make the kite fly more steadily. The children shared snacks with each other, while Wang Lijuan and Chen Jianguo's wife talked about the children's interest classes. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, in the shade of trees beside the large lawn on the south side of Wanlv Garden's East Gate

name: Noon free time and career consultation
description: While everyone was chatting warmly and the children were playing nearby, Lu Mingqiang walked to a quieter spot and called Manager Liu of the company's engineering department. After a brief greeting, he asked about the requirements for applying for the Senior Electrical Technician certificate (second-level technician). Manager Liu patiently told him the general process: he needed to have held the senior worker (third-level) qualification for a certain number of years, and also needed to complete a thesis defense and practical assessment. He also told him to come to the company next week to get the detailed list of application materials. The call lasted about ten minutes, which made Lu Mingqiang feel more confident. After hanging up, he returned to the mat and continued chatting with Jianguo and Ajie, while the children chased each other on the lawn. His wife and Jianguo's wife exchanged WeChat contacts and agreed to take the children to the park together next time. Watching Xuanxuan and his little friends run around and play, Lu Mingqiang felt especially relaxed.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, in the shade of trees beside the large lawn on the south side of Wanlv Garden's East Gate

name: Wrap-up cleaning and farewell
description: In the afternoon, as the wind gradually softened, Lu Mingqiang called everyone to start reeling in the lines. He skillfully took down the eagle kite, while Xuanxuan clumsily wound the little butterfly kite back around the spool one turn at a time under his guidance.
