After the kites were put away, Lu Mingqiang took the lead in taking out garbage bags and picking up the snack wrappers and empty water bottles on the lawn. Chen Jianguo, Chen Jie, and the others also cleaned up together with their families. When the lawn was clean again, they said goodbye to one another, agreed to meet up again next time, and then headed to the parking lot separately.
location: The large lawn at the east gate of Wanlv Garden and its vicinity, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving back
description: On the way back, with the car's air conditioner on, Lu Mingqiang drove steadily. Xuanxuan and Hanhan soon fell asleep in the back seats, with smiles still at the corners of their mouths. Lu Mingqiang did not turn on the radio, keeping the cabin quiet, and drove smoothly back to Banshan Garden.
location: From Evergreen Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, to Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Return home to rest and do kite maintenance
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang gently carried Xuanxuan to the small bed, and Wang Lijuan then settled Hanhan down as well. Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower, changed into dry short sleeves and shorts, made a cup of Laoba tea, and curled up on the living room sofa looking at his phone. He saw A Jie had posted photos of today's kite flying in the WeChat group and liked and replied to it. At 4:30 pm, Xuanxuan woke up full of energy, and Lu Mingqiang asked him to help tidy up the kites: Xuanxuan wiped the water stains off the little butterfly kite, while Lu Mingqiang rolled up the eagle kite in a soft cloth and put it into a special canvas bag.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take Xuanxuan to the Rule of Law Theme Park for a stroll
description: Lu Mingqiang walked with Xuanxuan to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park next to the residential community. On the way, Xuanxuan was still excitedly talking about the details of flying kites, and Lu Mingqiang listened patiently. In the park, the father and son strolled along the tree-lined path. When Xuanxuan saw the pigeons on the grass, he shouted excitedly. Lu Mingqiang taught him to recognize several kinds of trees. The two chatted and laughed as they slowly walked home.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: When I got home, Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen, having prepared white cut chicken, stir-fried pickled cabbage, and egg drop soup. Hanhan had also woken up and was sitting on the living room floor mat playing with building blocks. The family sat around the dining table, eating while listening to Xuanxuan excitedly recount today's kite-flying experience. Hanhan also gestured along with 'ah ah', and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening parent-child time and leisure
description: After the meal, Wang Lijuan cleared the table, while Lu Mingqiang played with the two children. Xuanxuan took out photos and asked his mom to send them to the family group to share with grandparents and uncle. Lu Mingqiang then played Transformers with Hanhan. He also made himself a pot of new tea, turned on the TV to watch a nature documentary, and held both sons as they watched together. On screen, flocks of geese were flying. Hanhan pointed at the TV and said, "Dad, just like the big eagle today!"
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening tidying and bedtime
description: At nine in the evening, Lu Mingqiang urged his two sons to take a bath and brush their teeth. Xuanxuan went to wash on his own obediently, while Hanhan acted spoiled and was carried into the bathroom by his mother. Lu Mingqiang used the gap to send a WeChat message to his childhood friend Wang Hai, simply saying, 'Today I took the kids to fly kites at Wanlv Park. Awesome! How are you doing in Shenzhen?' Then he threw the dirty clothes into the washing machine. After his wife had settled the children, Lu Mingqiang lay down, feeling somewhat sore but happy. He turned off the bedside lamp, thinking that tomorrow he could take the family to his parents' house for dinner and drop by the hardware market to look for a multimeter, and gradually fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning stretching and getting ready to go out
description: At 7:10 a.m. he woke up naturally and saw that his wife was still resting. He sat up quietly, stretched and moved his shoulders and neck, then went to the bathroom, washed his face with cold water, and applied a hot towel to his eyes, feeling refreshed. When he came to the living room, his wife was already warming milk. Lu Mingqiang checked his phone to confirm the opening hours and entry requirements of the Hainan Provincial Museum, found the family's ID cards and put them in the inside pocket of his jacket, then took bottled water, biscuits, wet wipes, and other items from the storage cabinet and packed them into a backpack. Finally, he placed his two sons' sun hats on the shoe cabinet, ready to go.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying breakfast and having a meal with the family
description: Lu Mingqiang went downstairs in slippers, went to Sister Li's breakfast stall at the entrance of the community, and bought four servings of Hainan rice noodles with eggs, two scallion buns, and two cups of freshly ground soy milk. After returning home, he woke up his two sons to get up and eat, and his wife set out the breakfast. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang told Xuanxuan that the museum today had a big machine he had never seen before, even more impressive than the ones Dad repairs, which sparked the child's interest. The family of four happily finished breakfast.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and surrounding areas

name: Set off for the Hainan Provincial Museum
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang went downstairs to check the silver Corolla. He walked around the car to check the tires, oil dipstick, and coolant, and confirmed everything was normal. After his wife and two sons were seated, he set the navigation to Hainan Provincial Museum, a distance of 12 km about 22 minutes. The sun was bright along the way, so he lowered the sun visor, while the children chattered in the back seat. After arriving, they queued to enter the parking lot and found a shaded spot near the exit. He reminded the children to wear their hats and stay close to the adults. They queued up at the entrance with their ID cards. Lu Mingqiang took out his neatly kept ID card from the inner pocket and entered the museum smoothly.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, via Guoxing Avenue to the parking lot and entrance plaza of the Hainan Provincial Museum, No. 68 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District.

name: Visit the industrial history exhibition area of the museum
description: After entering the museum, the family of four headed straight for the “Qiongya Past and Present” industrial history exhibition hall on the second floor. Xuanxuan was drawn to the old steam engine and vintage generator model, pressing against the glass to look. Lu Mingqiang pointed at the 1970s water turbine generator model and, combining his own maintenance experience, gestured with his hands to explain the principle of the rotor spinning to generate electricity. Then he pulled the children over to look at the nearby power transmission line diagram, using water flow as an analogy for electric current. Xuanxuan kept asking questions and finally understood. When Hanhan saw the hand-cranked bulb light up, he exclaimed in surprise. Wang Lijuan watched the father-son interaction with a beaming smile. Lu Mingqiang felt proud, sensing that his craft had found a successor.
location: Industrial History Exhibition Hall, 2nd Floor, Hainan Provincial Museum, No. 68 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Experienced the hand-crank generator in the interactive area.
description: After coming down from the industrial exhibition area, Lu Mingqiang took the children to the 'Light of Science and Technology' interactive exhibition hall on the first floor. Xuanxuan spotted a hand-crank generator, and Lu Mingqiang encouraged him to go try it. At first Xuanxuan turned it slowly, and the bulb only glowed faintly. Under his father's guidance, he gritted his teeth and sped up, and the bulb suddenly lit up fully while the needle swung up sharply. He shouted excitedly to his mother. Lu Mingqiang stood beside him, feeling warm inside, and told his son that this was energy conversion, encouraging him to study hard. Afterwards, they also played with a simulated circuit puzzle together.
location: Interactive Exhibition Hall, First Floor, Hainan Provincial Museum, 68 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch at the museum.
description: Around noon, the children got hungry, so Lu Mingqiang decided to eat at the museum's snack bar. He got a bowl of Hainan noodles with an extra egg for Xuanxuan, steamed cake and milk for Hanhan, and a bowl of qingbuliang for himself and his wife each. The family sat by the window, eating and chatting. Lu Mingqiang asked Xuanxuan what it felt like to generate electricity by hand. Xuanxuan said his hand got sore when he turned fast, but it was especially satisfying when the light came on. Everyone laughed and enjoyed a leisurely lunch.
location: Visitor rest area and snack bar on the first floor of Hainan Provincial Museum, No. 68 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to the hardware market and a daily necessities store for shopping, then returned.
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang let Hanhan sleep in the car and took Xuanxuan in the car to Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. They first arrived at Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store at No. 87 Haisheng Road. The shopkeeper recognized him. He bought a bottle of Haitian soy sauce, a bag of iodized salt, two packs of dried noodles, and a pack of chicken bouillon, paying 23.5 yuan via WeChat Pay. Then he went to a small electrician tool shop next door, looked at several digital multimeters, asked about prices, and weighed them in his hand, but didn't buy immediately, planning to compare prices on Monday. Then he drove back, with Hanhan sleeping soundly in his mother's arms all the way.
location: No. 87 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and nearby hardware tool stores, as well as the round trip between Qiongshan District and Xiuying District

name: Returning Home to Rest and Father-Son Reference Book Review
description: After returning home, Wang Lijuan carried the sleeping Hanhan upstairs. Lu Mingqiang parked the car, carried the newly bought items upstairs, and took a short break with a glass of plain boiled water. When his wife asked about the multimeter matter, he said he had a clear idea and would talk about it on Monday. Then he called Xuanxuan over, took "Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering" from the bookshelf, turned to the chapter on motor principles, and, using the generator model he had seen at the museum, pointed at the diagrams of the stator and rotor to explain. He also taught his son the jingle, "A magnet plus a coil, move it and it generates electricity." Xuanxuan lay on the floor, listening and drawing. Amid the laughter of father and son, Lu Mingqiang felt very pleased.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organize the balcony collection.
description: After letting Xuanxuan watch cartoons, Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony alone. He first checked the eagle kite flown the day before yesterday; the frame was still sturdy and the line spool was intact, so he carefully put it back into the storage bin. Then he squatted down and carefully wiped his "bottle museum" with a damp cloth, cleaning and lining up several new collectibles, including the Laobaigan bottle engraved with "craftsmanship" and the Fenjiu blue-and-white porcelain bottle. He examined the glaze colors and bottle shapes and felt very content.
location: Balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Took the sons to stroll around the Rule of Law Park.
description: A little after 3 p.m., the younger son woke up from his nap. The weather had turned cooler. Lu Mingqiang put shoes on both sons, brought the water bottles, and walked less than ten minutes to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park. There were elderly people playing chess in the park. He watched with the kids for a few minutes, then went to the fitness area where he guided Xuanxuan on the horizontal bar to build arm strength, and accompanied Hanhan on the slide. Hanhan giggled, and the three of them enjoyed a relaxing outdoor time.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Yanzao First Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: After returning home from the park, Lu Mingqiang put on an apron and went into the kitchen, asking his wife about the dinner plan. Learning that they were having pickled cabbage fish and stir-fried sweet potato leaves, he volunteered to slice the fish. He quickly sliced the grass carp he had bought that morning into thin pieces while his wife washed the vegetables. Soon, the pickled cabbage fish, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, tomato and egg soup, and the white-cut chicken brought back from his parents' house yesterday were all on the table. The whole family sat around and ate. Lu Mingqiang served food to the boys and asked Xuanxuan if he remembered the nursery rhyme. Xuanxuan recited it while eating, and the family enjoyed dinner in a warm atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening free time and contacting friends.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang cleared the table and washed the dishes, then sat back on the sofa in the living room and browsed his phone. He saw a video about repairing an old DC motor and found the technique very professional, so he watched it for a long time. Remembering that Chen Jie had flown kites at Wanlv Garden the day before yesterday, he sent a WeChat message saying that today he had taken Xuan to the museum to see old generators, and the child kept asking questions. Chen Jie replied with an emoji of laughing and pounding the floor, praising him for training his successor from a young age. The two chatted happily.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Watching cartoons with the children.
description: The two sons were again lounging on the sofa watching cartoons. Xuanxuan wanted to watch "Boonie Bears," and Hanhan wanted to watch "Peppa Pig." Lu Mingqiang acted as referee and ruled that each would watch one episode in turn, with the older brother giving in to the younger brother. He sat in the middle, explaining the images to Hanhan while quizzing Xuanxuan with brain teasers. The living room was filled with the laughter of the father and his two sons.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wash the children and put the younger son to bed
description: After the cartoon ended, Lu Mingqiang called the boys in for a bath. He bathed Hanhan, while his wife bathed Xuanxuan. Hanhan was ticklish and giggled. After the bath, he dried his hair with a hair dryer and changed him into his little pajamas. Lu Mingqiang carried Hanhan to his small bed, gently patted his back, and hummed a tune he had made up called "Little Hammer Ding-Dong." In a little while, the little one fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped his eldest son with homework and chatted with him before bed.
description: After Hanhan fell into a deep sleep, Lu Mingqiang tiptoed into Xuanxuan's room. Xuanxuan was lying on his stomach drawing the generator he had seen in the afternoon. It looked pretty recognizable, but the coils were a bit messy. Lu Mingqiang sat down and guided him in drawing the correct winding method. Xuanxuan erased it and redrew it himself. Lu Mingqiang praised him for being careful and said that in the future he might really be better than his dad. Seeing that he was sleepy, he urged him to brush his teeth and wash his face, straightened the quilt, turned off the light, and said, 'Good night, little engineer.' Xuanxuan replied, 'Good night, Dad.'
location: Second bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wash up before bed, chat with my spouse, and fall asleep
description: After showering, Lu Mingqiang changed into pajamas and returned to the bedroom. After turning off the lights, he chatted with his wife about today's trip to the museum. Wang Lijuan said Xuanxuan was extremely admiring of him today, eyes shining. He then brought up going to see Manager Liu on Monday to get the application materials for Senior Technician, planning to submit before the end of the year. His wife expressed support, telling him to go for it and that she would take care of the family. As they finished talking, drowsiness set in. An image of Xuanxuan's eyes shining at the generator model flashed through his mind, and Lu Mingqiang fell asleep with a sense of stability.
location: Bathroom and master bedroom, Banshan Garden residential area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Early morning Taobao browsing and cycling commute
description: At the first light of dawn, Lu Mingqiang quietly put on his sportswear and wheeled out his old mountain bike. The morning air in Haikou was especially fresh. He rode east along Jinmao Middle Road, passed under the bridge on Longkun North Road, and reached the weekend antique market beside the Rule of Law Theme Park in about 15 minutes. Old Liu's stall was at the very back. He immediately took a liking to that MF47 old multimeter. The casing was a bit scuffed, but the glass on the meter face was intact, and the needle was very responsive. He haggled with Old Liu from 150 yuan down to 90 yuan. He wrapped it in old newspaper, stuffed it into his backpack, turned the bike around, and rode home in another 15 minutes.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to the antique market beside the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park on Longkun North Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then return to Banshan Garden Residential Area.

name: Quietly Hiding Treasures and Morning Preparation
description: He pushed his bicycle into the hallway and opened the door quietly. The living room was still silent, and the bedroom door was closed. Lu Mingqiang quickly slipped into the study and stuffed the newspaper-wrapped multimeter into the bottom of the tool cabinet. He changed into a clean T-shirt and went to the bathroom to wash up briefly. Just after wiping his face, he heard Hanhan calling "Daddy" from the bedroom, and felt happy: today is the birthday, and the main characters are awake.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Warm breakfast and birthday kickoff
description: Hanhan rushed out first and shouted, "Daddy, happy birthday!" Lu Mingqiang smiled and corrected him: "It's Mommy's birthday!" When his wife came out, the whole family burst into laughter. On the table were the Hainan rice noodles his wife loved (made with the beef braised last night and the fried peanuts) and the fried eggs Lu Mingqiang had cooked. As he ate, he made arrangements: "Juan, today you're the boss. Rest this morning; I'll take these two boys to tidy up the house and then cook you a big birthday dinner."
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family collaboration on meal prep and crafts.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang put on an apron and began preparing the beef brisket and chicken for lunch. Xuanxuan took colored pens and paper, saying he wanted to draw the most beautiful greeting card for his mother. He lay on the coffee table in the living room, drawing carefully. Hanhan was given a glorious task: 'Help Dad set the chopsticks!' The little guy, like a little adult, neatly placed six chopsticks, a pair beside each bowl. In the kitchen, the beef brisket soup was simmering, giving off a rich aroma.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Short study and leisure time.
description: His wife took Hanhan to the balcony to water the flowers and plants. Lu Mingqiang made use of the time, called Xuanxuan to the living room, took out the brochure brought back from the museum yesterday, pointed at the lights and switches at home, and explained in the simplest terms what a 'circuit' is and how electricity flows from the switch to the light bulb. Xuanxuan listened with shining eyes and asked questions here and there, which made Lu Mingqiang think this kid might be cut out for electrical work after all.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wife's birthday lunch.
description: Four dishes and a soup were served: white-cut chicken, braised beef brisket, stir-fried choy sum, mapo tofu, and a large bowl of longevity noodles. Lu Mingqiang picked up the largest piece of beef brisket and put it into his wife's bowl: "May you live a hundred years, Juanzi!" Xuanxuan and Hanhan raised their homemade "drinks" (Sprite mixed with water) and shouted: "Happy birthday, Mom!" His wife smiled so hard her eyes narrowed into slits, and she kept adding food to everyone's bowls. Lunch was very satisfying.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Midday Rest and Communication
description: Lu Mingqiang insisted on washing the lunch dishes. His wife and children went to take a nap. He lay on the living room sofa for a while, thought about the afternoon plan, and opened his phone to check the time. Then he walked to the balcony and called his father: "Dad, today is Juan'er's birthday... Yes, we're eating at home. We'll come over to see you tomorrow." After a brief chat, asking if everything was fine at home, he felt at ease.
location: Living room and balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the cake and replenish daily necessities.
description: He told his wife he was going out to pick up the cake, and set off on foot. Lu Mingqiang first went to the Aishang Bakery cake shop along the south gate of the residential complex, and picked up the pre-ordered 8-inch fruit cake, which read "Juanzi, Happy Birthday!" Carrying the cake box, he then turned into the nearby Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Minsheng Branch) and bought a bottle of Blue Moon hand soap, two bags of potato chips, and a small pack of Yakult on the way. The round trip on foot plus the supermarket shopping took exactly one hour.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Minsheng Branch) on Minsheng West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the nearby Aishang Bakery & Cake Shop, then return.

name: Afternoon snack and rest
description: After getting home, he carefully put the cake in the refrigerator. His wife and children gradually woke up. Lu Mingqiang gave each of the two children a bottle from the row of Yakult in the bag, and cut an orange for everyone to share. He rested for twenty minutes and replenished some energy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time: park exploration and treasure hunt.
description: After a good rest, Lu Mingqiang took a water bottle, a rubber ball, and the two boys, and walked to the law-themed park opposite the community. This time he didn't let the children run around wildly, but proposed a "treasure hunt game". "Dad has hidden a little secret in the park (a particularly red bougainvillea). Whoever finds it first gets a lollipop!" The two children immediately perked up and ran all over the lawn. Xuanxuan even directed his younger brother to split up and search. After an hour and a half of playing, everyone had a great time and their energy was spent.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park, Longkun North Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing ingredients and family collaboration
description: When he got home, his wife was in the kitchen preparing the broth for hotpot that evening. Lu Mingqiang took over washing the vegetables, cutting them, and preparing the dipping sauce. The two worked together smoothly in the kitchen, chatting while they worked. His wife said she had received many WeChat greetings today and had kept the cards from the children as treasures. Her tone was full of happiness.
location: Kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Birthday celebration ceremony
description: At six in the evening, before the formal start of the banquet, Lu Mingqiang took the cake out of the fridge, opened the box, and placed it in the center of the dining table. Xuanxuan carefully inserted the "3" and "5" number candles, while Hanhan rushed to hand over the matches. He turned off the living room lights and lit the candles; the warm flames reflected the faces of the whole family. "Happy birthday~" The family sang together. His wife closed her eyes to make a wish and blew out the candles in one breath. Xuanxuan gave her a drawing of four hands holding hands, and Hanhan picked a small lantana flower from the balcony and handed it to her. Lu Mingqiang saw that his wife's eyes were a little red, hugged her tightly, and gave the first piece of cake to the birthday girl.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Post-meal leisure and family time
description: After clearing the dining table, Lu Mingqiang cut two pieces of cake and gave them to the children, then turned on the TV to watch Octonauts with them. His wife leaned against his shoulder, and the children sat on their mother's lap, occasionally giggling at the scenes in the cartoon. When an episode finished, Xuanxuan wanted to play aeroplane chess again, so the family set up the board on the coffee table and played for more than half an hour. Hanhan lost two rounds and pouted, but she was still very happy.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Soothing the baby and taking a shower
description: It was 8 o'clock, and Lu Mingqiang got the 'Bath Battle' going. He let his younger son Hanhan bathe first and filled the tub with water. Hanhan splashed around and got his dad all wet. He wrapped him in a big bath towel and carried him to bed. Then it was Xuanxuan's turn. Since he could wash himself, Lu Mingqiang stood at the door handing him a towel and squeezing toothpaste for him. Only after both boys lay down all clean and fragrant did he let out a long breath.
location: Bathroom and second bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing the multimeter and planning study
description: The children were asleep, and his wife was reading in the living room. Lu Mingqiang walked quietly into the study, closed the door, and took out his treasured multimeter from the bottom of the tool cabinet. He turned on the desk lamp, carefully wiped the case and dial with a soft cloth, and replaced the test leads with new ones. His movements were very skillful. He tried all the ranges, and the needle moved very smoothly. He took out his phone to look up the repair diagram for this multimeter, and in the notebook beside him wrote down the chapter “Instrument Reading and Calibration” that he needed to review next month.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrapping up and preparing for bed.
description: Feeling very pleased, he carefully put the multimeter back in the tool cabinet. He went and took a refreshing hot shower, then changed into pajamas. He weighed himself: 71.5 kg, still in good shape. Back in the bedroom, his wife was already lying down with steady breathing. Lu Mingqiang gently kissed her on the forehead and turned off the light.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Fell asleep.
description: Lying contentedly in the dark, Lu Mingqiang went over the day's events in his mind: he had found a good old watch, given his wife a simple yet grand birthday celebration, spent an afternoon running around wildly with the children, and written down a study plan. Life is like that—plain, but every step feels especially solid. Before long, he fell fast asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Woke up, washed up, and saw off wife's younger brother and his girlfriend.
description: At home in Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, Lu Mingqiang got up because he heard noises in the living room. After a quick wash, he went to the living room. His mother Chen Xiuying had already come to help, stuffing coconut sticky rice cakes into Chen Zhiqiang's and Lin Xue's luggage. His wife Wang Lijuan held Lin Xue's hand and gave quiet reminders. Lu Mingqiang patted Chen Zhiqiang on the shoulder, told him to drive slowly and send a message when they arrived, and helped carry their suitcases downstairs, watching their silver car slowly drive out of the residential area. The elder son Xuanxuan and the younger son Hanhan jumped at the unit entrance, shouting goodbye to their uncle and aunt. The warmth of the family farewell blended with the Mid-Autumn Festival reunion atmosphere, leaving a faint sadness of parting.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode to the company to pick up the application materials for the senior technician certificate
description: After seeing the visitor off, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike from Banshan Garden, heading to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park via Jinmao Middle Road, Binhai Avenue, and Haisheng Road. After arriving at the company, he found Manager Liu in the engineering department office on the second floor. Manager Liu handed him a kraft paper folder containing application materials for the Senior Technician certificate, including copies of credentials, proof of work, and performance sheets, and reminded him to check them. Lu Mingqiang thanked him and left, carefully placing the materials in the electric bike's storage compartment, feeling reassured.
location: Engineering Department Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Called mother on the way back
description: Lu Mingqiang rode back to Banshan Garden and stopped at the lane entrance to the residential area. He called his mother, Chen Xiuying, to tell her that his wife's younger brother had left safely, and they agreed to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival at home that evening by setting out the moon-worship offerings. He had a day off the next day and would bring the whole family to visit his parents. His mother told him to buy a big pomelo, which made Lu Mingqiang feel warm inside.
location: Near Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Purchase ingredients for the Mid-Autumn Festival moon worship
description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang walked to the nearby Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Minsheng Store) to buy supplies for the Mid-Autumn Festival. He picked out large red-fleshed pomelos, two fresh coconuts, a bunch of grapes, and so on, to prepare for that evening's moon worship and qingbuliang. Then he carried the items and walked home.
location: Wangjiawang Fresh Convenience Supermarket (Minsheng Branch), Minsheng West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family time at home: making paper lanterns and painting
description: After returning home and changing into casual clothes, Lu Mingqiang gave his younger son Hanhan the task of drawing the moon, then took his older son Xuanxuan to the Wangjiawang Supermarket downstairs to buy rice paper, bamboo skewers, and LED bulb beads. On the living room floor, he taught Xuanxuan to assemble the frame of a hexagonal lantern. Although the child's hands were unsteady and glue covered his hands, he was in high spirits, and in the end they finished a simple lantern—crooked but glowing with warm light. Hanhan also drew a yellow moon with crayons, and the family created warm, lovely pieces together on the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: The family of four had a simple lunch with last night's leftover hot pot and Lu Mingqiang's fried rice. The children wolfed it down. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes and scrub the pots, letting his wife rest. He set an alarm and took a nap on the living room sofa to store up energy for preparing the Mid-Autumn Festival in the afternoon.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare the moon worship altar and dinner.
description: After waking from an afternoon nap, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan began to prepare the Mid-Autumn moon worship: they brought out a folding table and set it up on the east side of the balcony, placing mooncakes, grapes, pomelos and coconuts on it, and brewed some laobaicha. Xuanxuan hung the lantern he had made that morning on the clothes-drying pole and put small light beads inside, casting a warm yellow glow on the wall, while Hanhan clipped her moon drawing next to the lantern. Then the couple moved into the kitchen to prepare dinner. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to help wash vegetables and cut ingredients, while his wife cooked home-style dishes and boiled qingbuliang for the moon worship. The moon-worship table on the balcony and the aroma of cooking from the kitchen together built up the Mid-Autumn atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner
description: Dinner was served: white-cut Wenchang chicken, stir-fried green beans, pan-fried mackerel, and steaming hot qingbuliang. Lu Mingqiang opened a bottle of his treasured Haikou Daqu liquor, poured a glass for his wife and a glass for himself, drew the curtains, brightened the dining room lights, and the four of them raised their glasses to celebrate family reunion. The children clinked their drinks too, and the room filled with laughter.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Enjoying the moon on the balcony and talking about the future
description: After the meal, the family moved chairs to the balcony, turned off the main light and left only the warm glow of the lantern. On the table were mooncakes, fruit, and dad's tea. The two children pointed at the full moon and cheered. Lu Mingqiang poured tea for his wife, pointed at the moon, and said softly, "You've worked hard these past few years. Once I get my Senior Technician Certificate, I'll drive you around the island to see the moon over the sea, and the first stop will be back to Wenchang to visit your parents." His wife's eyes turned slightly red and she leaned on his shoulder. Xuanxuan shouted, "I want to see the sea!" Lu Mingqiang smiled and pulled his son into his arms, feeling that the future was full of hope.
location: Balcony of Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Tidy up the balcony and have parent-child playtime.
description: After the moon rose higher, Lu Mingqiang and his wife brought the plates and tea set back into the house from the balcony. He went to the kitchen to wash the dishes, while his wife cut mooncakes for the children and reminded them to eat only half a piece. In the living room, the children played with the light and shadows cast by the lantern on the wall, grabbing at them with their little hands. Lu Mingqiang joined in, and the home was filled with relaxed laughter.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Put the children to bed and discussed matters with his wife.
description: Lu Mingqiang and his wife divided the task of helping the children wash up: his wife bathed Hanhan, while he took Xuanxuan to take a shower. Xuanxuan was excited about making lanterns, so Lu Mingqiang told a moon story before he calmed down and fell asleep. Hanhan was also fast asleep, covered with a quilt. Afterwards, the couple sat on the sofa in front of the muted TV in the living room to discuss family matters. Lu Mingqiang proposed that after getting the certificate, he would open an electrical and mechanical repair workshop near the residential community to increase income, and his wife supported getting the certificate first. They also discussed renewing Xuanxuan's math tutoring class and Hanhan's move to the senior kindergarten class. He comforted his wife, saying, "Don't worry, I'm here. Life will get better and better."
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, weighing in, and going to bed
description: After the discussion, Lu Mingqiang went to the bathroom to wash up. He stepped on the electronic scale and confirmed that his weight was still 71.6 kg, glad that he had kept up with his exercise. When he returned to the bedroom, he saw that his wife was already fast asleep. He fiddled with the multimeter in the moonlight, mulling over his review plan for next month's instrument calibration, then blew out the lamp and fell into a deep sleep, resting on clear plans for the future.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and weighing himself
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off, feeling refreshed by the cool autumn air. Went to the bathroom to wash up, splashed his face with cold water, and observed in the mirror that his mental state was good. Returned to the bedroom, stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 71.6 kg, and was satisfied with the stable weight.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepared and enjoyed a simple breakfast
description: On the last day of the holiday, he decided to keep everything simple. He took out some pure milk from the refrigerator and heated it up, toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, and spread them with his wife's homemade orange marmalade. While eating breakfast, he checked tomorrow's weather on his phone and learned it would be sunny turning cloudy, suitable for outdoor work, so he planned the day's arrangements in his mind.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tidying up the room, changing clothes, and preparing to go out
description: After breakfast, he washed the cups and plates, changed into dark blue work trousers and a gray T-shirt. He took out the e-bike key, checked his phone, wallet, and keys, and got ready for the trip to the farmers' market to carry soil and flowerpots.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycled to the Longhua District farmers' market.
description: Pushed the e-bike out from the corridor entrance, rode west along Jinmao Middle Road, then turned onto Bingya Road. The morning breeze was damp and cool, and there were not many pedestrians on the road. Arrived at the Longhua District farmers' market in about twelve minutes.
location: On the way from Banshan Garden to the Longhua District farmers' market

name: Buy supplies for balcony planting.
description: After discussing autumn planting varieties with the stall owner at the seed stand in the farmers' market, I bought three packets of dwarf Red Jade cherry tomato seeds and a bag of bone meal base fertilizer. Then I bought three Yixing clay flowerpots, two bags of all-purpose potting soil, a small trowel, and a thickened watering can at the general store, totaling seventy yuan.
location: Longhua District Farmers' Market, No. 68 Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy fruit on the way.
description: Coming out of the market, I saw the lychees and mangosteens at the fruit stall by the entrance were fresh. Remembering that my mother loves mangosteens, I bought three jin. I hung the soil and flowerpot on the hooks of the electric bike, put the fruit in the basket, and got ready to head to my parents' home.
location: Fruit stall at the entrance of Longhua District Farmers' Market, No. 68 Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to parents’ home.
description: Cycled from Longhua District via Binya Road and Haifu Road, turned onto Dayingshan East First Street, and arrived at his parents' home in Meilan District. The route was smooth all the way. On the way, he pondered how his father would comment on the application materials for Senior Technician.
location: On the way from Longhua District Farmers' Market to Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District

name: Visited his parents and discussed the application materials.
description: Arriving at his parents' home, he carried the fruit and supplies upstairs. When his mother saw the mangosteen, she complained fondly but was all smiles. His father was reading the newspaper in the living room. Lu Mingqiang took out his senior technician application materials and asked his father for advice on the technical work summary section. He got tips on describing key process steps, and his thinking suddenly became clear. Meanwhile, his mother examined the seed pot beside her and rambled that if the kids liked it, they might as well plant and see.
location: Parents' home living room, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rode his bike back home.
description: After saying goodbye to his parents, he put away the application materials and rode the electric bike back the same way. On the way, he was still savoring his father's advice and felt the materials could be written more brilliantly.
location: On the way from parents' home to Banshan Garden.

name: Helped prepare lunch and had lunch with the whole family.
description: When he got home, his wife was already busy in the kitchen. He moved the purchased items to the balcony, then washed his hands and helped serve rice and set out chopsticks. The meal was home-style dishes: stir-fried sweet potato leaves, pan-fried mackerel, and bean sprout soup. Soon after, the younger son was picked up from kindergarten and was thrilled to see the new flowerpots on the balcony. The family sat together for a joyful meal.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: Feeling drowsy after lunch, he told his wife and lay down on the bed with his eyes closed to rest. Although he didn't fall asleep, his energy recovered, storing up strength for the afternoon's work.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pick up the eldest son from school
description: At two in the afternoon, he rode an electric bike to the gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up his eldest son, who was getting out of tutoring class. As soon as his son saw him, he asked about the flowerpot purchase. Lu Mingqiang smiled and indicated that everything was ready, then father and son went home together.
location: At the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lead the boys to tidy the balcony in preparation for planting
description: After getting home, he started the work in earnest, directing his two sons to clear the clutter in the east corner of the balcony and mop the floor. He lined up three clay pots in a row, demonstrating how to place broken tile fragments at the bottom and fill with nutrient soil to 70 percent full. He had the elder son take charge of filling the soil, while he held the pots steady, and the younger son passed a watering can to spray water and moisten the soil. Finally, he opened the seed packet, wrapped the seeds in a damp paper towel, put them into a box, and placed it on the kitchen windowsill for germination. Father and sons arranged the pots neatly, put on a label reading Cherry Tomatoes (Dwarf), and agreed to sow the seeds on the weekend.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Explaining planting knowledge and agreeing on a sowing date.
description: After the cleaning was done, the children were still not satisfied. Lu Mingqiang opened his phone and searched for balcony cherry tomato planting videos. While playing one, he explained the key points of seed germination, watering, and fertilizing. His eldest son took careful notes and drew a flowerpot sketch. Lu Mingqiang circled October 11 on the calendar, wrote 'Sowing Day,' had his two sons sign it, and made a weekend agreement.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Free activity and a brief rest
description: The children were watching cartoons and playing in the living room. Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony to spray water on the flower pots, imagining the weekend seeding scene. His wife handed him a glass of plain boiled water, and the couple chatted casually on the balcony about household matters, agreeing that dinner should be made early after work the next day.
location: Living room and balcony of home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organize tools and prepare for resuming work tomorrow
description: After resting, he started dealing with his actual tasks. He took down the tool bag by the door and checked that tools such as the multimeter and screwdrivers were all there. He took out his work clothes, safety helmet, and insulated shoes and confirmed they were clean. In the study, he charged the electric impact wrench and used his phone to check this week's task list, marking in red pen the inspection task for the mall's power distribution cabinet scheduled for Tuesday.
location: Home entrance hallway and study, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Help prepare dinner and have dinner together with the family
description: After tidying up, he washed his hands and went to the kitchen to help. His wife had already prepared the dishes, and he was in charge of peeling garlic. Dinner was plentiful, including the white cut chicken his wife had bought in the afternoon. The whole family sat around the table; the children talked about germination and their planting wishes, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Playing with the children and helping them with homework
description: After dinner, his wife cleared the dishes. Lu Mingqiang played with blocks with his younger son in the living room, using them to build “Tomato Baby’s Little House”. Then he went to the study to check his older son’s diary, praised him for recording the planting preparations, and suggested making the details of “germination” more specific.
location: Living room and study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening personal hobby: studying vintage multimeters
description: After the children went to wash up, he had some time alone. He took out the MF47 old multimeter he had picked up at the antique market; it was in good condition with a responsive needle. Referring to the meter calibration materials he had printed out, he put on his reading glasses and studied the manual while turning the dial, enjoying the crisp click of the gear changes. He planned to master it thoroughly next month.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, journaling, and late-night conversation with his wife
description: After putting down the multimeter, he took a hot shower to relieve fatigue. When he returned to the bedroom, his wife was already lying down looking at her phone. He picked up his notebook to record the day's expenses and thoughts, then turned off the light. In the dark, he chatted with his wife about visiting his parents during the day and the children's expectations for growing tomatoes. His wife also said Hanhan had been talking about it constantly. After the couple talked, they began to feel sleepy.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Getting ready for bed and falling asleep
description: After the nighttime chat ended, it became quiet. Lu Mingqiang turned on his side and scrolled through industry news for a while. His eyelids grew heavy; he turned off his phone, said goodnight, and soon fell fast asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Wake up, wash up, and get ready
description: His body clock woke him up right on time, and he splashed his face with cold water to fully wake up. It was his day off, so he changed into an old T-shirt and sports shorts, mentally planning the electrical sockets he needed to check in the morning. He first went to wake up his two sons and reminded his older son, Xuanxuan, to put on his school uniform by himself.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Send the two sons to school
description: He rode an electric bike with his two sons on the back. First, he dropped his younger son Hanhan off at Jinmao Center Kindergarten and watched him walk through the gate. Then he turned the bike around and rode along Guomao Road and Haixiu East Road all the way to Meilan District, taking his older son Xuanxuan to the entrance of Longfeng Experimental Primary School. He repeatedly reminded him to wait for Grandma to pick him up after school, and only after watching him enter the school gate did he leave with peace of mind.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, passing Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District.

name: Buying accessories and packing breakfast.
description: After dropping off his son, he didn't go straight home. He first turned to the familiar Wanlilong Hardware Store and told the owner, Old Chen, that he wanted a Bull-brand 10A five-hole socket panel, and also grabbed a roll of waterproof tape, totaling 14.5 yuan. After paying, he rode along the way to the Datie Dad Tea Shop on Binya Road, packed a bowl of Hainan noodles with egg and a cup of hot black tea, planning to take them home for breakfast.
location: Wanlilong Hardware Store, No. 2 Guomao North Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Blacksmith Dad's Tea Shop on Binya Road.

name: Whole-house electrical safety inspection and repair
description: Returning home, his wife Juanzi had already gone out to do housekeeping. Not bothering to eat the rice noodles that had already become a bit sticky, he changed into his work clothes and took a voltage tester, multimeter, and screwdriver from the tool cabinet on the balcony. First he opened the main distribution box at the entrance and checked and tightened the wiring screws on each circuit breaker one by one, then used the multimeter to test the sensitivity of the leakage protection switch; everything was normal. Next he checked the outlets and switches room by room, focusing on the outlet next to the kitchen counter that had been used for five or six years. He found the plastic on the back was slightly yellowed and the terminals had signs of oxidation. Carefully he removed the old outlet, stripped new copper wire, pressed it into the wiring holes of the newly purchased Bull outlet and tightened the screws, then wrapped two layers of new waterproof tape in the recessed box. After mounting the faceplate and switching on the branch circuit breaker, he tested it with a desk lamp and it worked normally. He also tightened the screws on the outlet faceplates in the other rooms, confirming that the whole house's electrical circuit was safe.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simple lunch
description: His wife Wang Lijuan came back after finishing her second housekeeping job, and the two simply made lunch. She made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and reheated last night's leftovers. While eating, he told his wife he had replaced the kitchen socket; she praised him for being thoughtful and casually mentioned she didn't know if her legs would still keep up with the evening ball game.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: After the meal I felt a little drowsy, so I went back to the bedroom, lay down, set an alarm for 13:30, and planned to nap for a while. I was still thinking about the morning inspection results; I felt the home wiring foundation was decent, so I could rest assured.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Checking seeds and parent-child quality time
description: After the alarm went off, I got up and went to the kitchen windowsill to check the tomato seeds I had soaked yesterday. I found that four or five seeds had sprouted small white dots. I carefully rinsed them with clean water, wrapped them in a new damp tissue, and put them back in the small bowl. Just then, my younger son Hanhan was dropped off by his kindergarten teacher (today was a half-day), and my older son Xuanxuan also came home from school. The two kids gathered around and shouted excitedly, "They've sprouted!" I squatted down and showed them the white dots, telling them these were tomato roots and that tomorrow I would teach them to plant the seeds in soil. The little ones clapped their hands.
location: Kitchen windowsill and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon outdoor activities
description: In the afternoon, the rain stopped completely and the air was damp. He took his two sons downstairs to the community garden for some fresh air. There were still shallow puddles on the road; Hanhan deliberately stomped in them twice, giggling as the splash wet his trouser legs. Xuanxuan wanted to go on the slide, but water droplets were still on it, so he held him and swung him on the swing a few times.
location: Community garden, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner preparation and relaxation
description: Back home, my wife Wang Lijuan had already started preparing dinner. I let the two kids watch cartoons, then went to the kitchen to help out, peeled a few garlic cloves, and helped my wife pick a bunch of water spinach. Meanwhile, I took out my phone, opened the squash club's WeChat group, and sent a voice message to my squash buddy Afeng: "Afeng, tonight at the usual time, 7:30. I've rested for seven days, so I'll probably be crushed by you." Afeng quickly replied with a voice message: "I was afraid you wouldn't dare to come!"
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the dining table for dinner. His wife had made stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised chicken wings, and a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup. As they ate, they talked with the children about what had happened at kindergarten and school that day. Hanhan said that tomorrow she would tell her little friends that her dad can grow tomatoes.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Squash training and socializing
description: After eating, he changed into his sports gear and rode his electric bike to the squash club. His playing partner Lin Feng had already arrived and was warming up. After a brief greeting, the two began a 40-minute practice match. After the holiday, he was clearly out of practice; his steps were heavy, and he missed several shots that he could normally have saved easily, breathing heavily. Lin Feng teased him that he must have had a nice National Day, and he smiled wryly, saying he had spent a few days dealing with wires at home. After the game, they drank some water in the courtside rest area and agreed to play again next Wednesday. His whole body ached, and he knew the next few days would be rough.
location: Frontline Squash Club, B1, Times Plaza, No. 13 Guomao North Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home and washing up
description: Riding the electric bike home with sore, weak legs. After entering, my wife was tutoring the eldest son with his homework. I said hello to her and said, "I'm about to fall apart," then went to the bathroom to take a hot shower to help my body relax.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sending holiday greetings to my mentor.
description: After taking a shower, he felt refreshed. Wearing a vest and shorts, he settled into the study chair, picked up his phone, and sent his master, Master Li, a WeChat message to wish him a happy Mid-Autumn Festival. He said he had played ball today and his body was rustier than ever, and asked how Master Li was. Master Li replied by voice message that young people shouldn't slack off; he was still in decent health, but his knee had been a bit uncomfortable since the temperature drop a couple of days ago. He also asked how his studying of the senior technician theory was going. Lu said he had read some but it was fragmentary and he still needed Master Li's guidance. Master Li praised his solid technical skills and said he only lacked the theoretical part, urging him to put more effort into it. They chatted a bit more about everyday things, and after hanging up, he felt warm inside.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and check.
description: Stood up and moved his shoulders, feeling especially sore. Walked over to the scale and stood on it; it read 71.5 kg. After the holiday, he was actually a bit lighter. He told his wife he had enough exercise for the day and felt like his body was falling apart. His wife told him to get some rest. He went to the bedroom to check on his two sons, who were already fast asleep, and tucked them in.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: After lying down in bed, the sore and heavy feeling in his body became more obvious. He turned over and said to his wife, "I really can't get up for work tomorrow," and soon fell into a deep sleep accompanied by the occasional sound of rain falling outside the window and the fatigue in his body.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning run
description: Lu Mingqiang's phone alarm went off right at 6:00. After getting up, he put on running shoes and athletic shorts and rode an e-bike to Wanlv Garden. After a quick stretch, he began a 5 km morning run. Since it was the first run after the holiday, his cardio could not keep up and his pace dropped, but he persisted and finished the whole course in 32 minutes. Sweating profusely after the run, he stretched in the park's exercise equipment area before cycling home.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and family time
description: After Lu Mingqiang arrived home, his wife was already busy in the kitchen, and his youngest son hadn't woken up yet. He took a quick shower and changed into clean work clothes. His wife had prepared Hainan noodles and a cup of instant coffee for breakfast. While eating, he chatted with her about the possibility of heavy work on the first day back after the holiday. After eating, he went to the bedroom and glanced at his youngest son, who was sleeping soundly.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten.
description: Lu Mingqiang gently woke his younger son up from bed and helped him put on his coat; the little guy was a bit grumpy about getting up. He rode his electric bike for 5 minutes to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handed him over to the teacher at the gate, told him to be good and listen to the auntie, watched him go into the kindergarten, then rode to the company.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and morning meeting
description: Lu Mingqiang cycled directly from the kindergarten to the company. There was heavy traffic today, so it took 12 minutes; he arrived before 8 o'clock. After changing into his work clothes, he went to the break room on time for the morning meeting. Team Leader Zhang assigned the key task: installation of distribution cabinets in a newly built factory building in Xiuying District, emphasizing safety. Lu Mingqiang volunteered for the main wiring job. After the meeting, he went with Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang to the warehouse to collect tools and consumables such as manual chain hoists, air hoses, and wire marker tubes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning Work: Distribution Cabinet Installation
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and a rigger rushed to the power distribution room on the first floor of the newly built standard factory building in Xiuying District. Lu Mingqiang was in overall command and worked with the rigger to use a manual chain hoist to lift and secure the heavy busway. Then, together with Chen Jianguo, he connected the wiring according to the drawings and asked Zhao Qiang to watch carefully and pay attention to wiring standards. He used numbered cable markers to label each control wire. Chen Jianguo teased him, and he responded that after the holiday he needed to refocus and follow the standards. Sweat soaked his work clothes.
location: Power distribution room on the first floor of a newly built standard factory building in Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and rest
description: The work wasn't finished, but the three went to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the company for lunch. Each had a 15-yuan boxed meal (two meat dishes and one vegetable, with unlimited rice), and Lu Mingqiang added a fried egg. While eating, he chatted with Chen Jianguo about the electrician question bank, saying theoretical questions should be understood in connection with practical principles. The younger son pointed excitedly at a boat on the sea and shouted, while the older son watched quietly out the window. Lu Mingqiang felt warm and content. They arrived at his parents' residential community about 25 minutes later.

description: After explaining the problem, the master brought out from the inner room a notebook wrapped in kraft paper. It was his notes from 2003 when he was training for the senior technician and technologist exams, containing mental calculation formulas, cable ampacity estimation, and so on. Lu Mingqiang took it with both hands, flipped through it carefully, and was deeply moved. He thanked him repeatedly, then said goodbye and went downstairs.
location: Huajin Mingdu, No. 56 Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying vegetables and fruits on the way home
description: Setting out from his master’s home, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the “Vegetable Basket” community discount supermarket at No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road on the way. He picked fresh water spinach, tomatoes, enoki mushrooms, and mangosteen, which his wife loves, and spent less than 40 yuan. He then drove 5 minutes back to Banshan Garden.
location: 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store)

name: Returned home to put things away and briefly skimmed the master's notes.
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang put the vegetables in the fridge, washed his hands, and carefully took out his master's notebook, flipping through it from the first page. When he saw the section on mental arithmetic formulas, he took photos with his phone to keep them. Xuanxuan ran over curiously. He pointed at the notebook and told his son that this was Grandpa Li's exam secret and that Dad needed to study it hard.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had a video call with his wife and prepared a simple dinner.
description: Lu Mingqiang made a video call to Juanzi at her parents' home. His daughter Hanhan rushed to say she missed her father, and Juanzi smiled and said everything was fine. After chatting for a few minutes, he reheated the leftover spicy soup rice from noon and stir-fried a plate of garlic water spinach as dinner.
location: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Leafed through notes while eating dinner alone
description: Lu Mingqiang sat alone at the dining table, spreading his master's notebook beside the tray, reading while eating. His eyes were drawn by the yellowed pages. He felt that although the meal was simple, his heart was enriched, as if he had grasped a treasure.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Systematically study the master's notes and pay attention to sitting posture
description: After finishing the meal and cleaning up, Lu Mingqiang settled into studying his notes. He supported his lower back with a cushion and propped up the notebook to maintain an upright sitting posture to prevent neck discomfort. Every 45 minutes, an alarm reminded him to get up and move around. He started with the mnemonics and common pitfalls, and, using the textbook, sorted out the key exam points in the first twenty pages, writing his personal understanding in the blank margins with a pencil.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Interact with my son and urge him to get ready for bed.
description: The alarm rang. Lu Mingqiang got up and walked out of the study, and saw Xuanxuan lying on the sofa watching Boonie Bears. He watched with his son for a while, reminded him that tomorrow was Monday and he had school, then squeezed toothpaste onto his brush, watched him brush his teeth and wash his face, and told him the story of the Frog Prince. Only after Xuanxuan fell asleep did he quietly leave the bedroom.
location: Living room and bedroom at Banshan Garden residential area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Wash up and record the day's learning gains.
description: After settling his son in, Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue. Later, in his study, he recorded the day's gains in his small notebook: he figured out the difference between 'phase loss' and 'grounding' in three-phase imbalance, mastered the multimeter calibration method demonstrated by his master, and completed the classification of the exam-point framework for the first 20 pages of his notes.
location: Bathroom and study in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrapping up before bed and confirming the next day's work arrangements
description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang opened the memo app on his phone and confirmed Monday’s work schedule posted by Team Leader Zhang in the group: tomorrow morning they needed to go to the factory building in Haisheng Road Industrial Park to install a new motor. He carefully put his mentor’s notes into his briefcase, planning to continue reading them during tomorrow’s lunch break.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to bed and rest
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone and lay down on the bed. Looking back on the busy but productive day, his shoulders and neck felt good, which showed that paying attention to his posture was effective. Thinking of his master's notes, he felt calm and grateful. He ran through the cable ampacity estimation mnemonic in his mind and slowly fell asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning routine and waking up the eldest son
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm, looked at the clock at 05:58, and lay there for a while longer. After getting up, he first weighed himself: 70.9 kg, the same as yesterday. While washing up, he splashed his face with cold water and felt much more refreshed. He went to the balcony to check the two tomato seedlings, found the soil slightly dry, and used a small spray bottle to water the roots moderately, muttering to himself to control the amount of water. Then he did neck and shoulder stretches to relieve stiffness. After that, he went to his eldest son's room, opened the curtains and woke Lu Zixuan, luring him out of bed with the news that the tomato seedlings had grown. Together they went to the balcony to observe the new leaves, and he reminded him to record the changes in his diary in the evening. Lu Zixuan nodded in agreement, his eyes full of anticipation.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Took his younger son to school and had breakfast during the commute.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan handed him packed bread and milk. Lu Mingqiang changed into his work uniform, took his younger son Lu Zihan downstairs, and rode an electric bike to take him to kindergarten. Lu Zihan sat on the back seat, holding tightly onto his father. They went south along Jinmao Middle Road, turned onto Guomao Third Cross Road, and a few minutes later arrived at the gate of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. After straightening his son's collar and giving instructions, he watched the teacher lead him through the school gate. Then he rode back to the intersection of Jinmao Middle Road and Guomao Third Cross Road, bought rice noodle rolls with an extra egg and extra chili at a breakfast cart, chatted briefly with the vendor about the weather, and took them packaged. Hanging the breakfast on the handlebar, he headed west along Binhai Avenue, turned onto Haisheng Road, and arrived at the company's industrial park at about 7:40.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and along the route

name: Pre-shift morning meeting and heading to the factory.
description: When entering the workshop, Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang were chatting about a ball game, and Lu Mingqiang quickly finished his rice noodle roll. Team leader Zhang issued a work order, saying that Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Factory on Haisheng Road had a power trip last night and needed emergency repair. He arranged for Lu Mingqiang to lead Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the site. The three went to the tool room to prepare tools such as a multimeter, clamp meter, insulating gloves, wrenches, and insulating shoes, then set off in the work van. On the way, Lu Mingqiang was in the passenger seat looking at photos of Master Li's notes on his phone, explaining testing tips for three-phase imbalance to Chen Jianguo, and handed the phone to Zhao Qiang in the back seat to study. They arrived at the factory a little after 8:20.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and on the way to Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Plant

name: Emergency repair of the power distribution system
description: After coordinating with the factory electrician, they entered the distribution room. Zhao Qiang first cut off the upstream power supply. Lu Mingqiang, wearing insulating gloves, opened the distribution cabinet with Chen Jianguo. They noticed hot air and a burning smell, and used a multimeter to test each phase, confirming that one phase's fuse had blown with carbonization traces. The two worked together to remove the old parts, clean the carbonized points, and replace the fuse and wire terminals. While working, Lu Mingqiang explained his reasoning to Zhao Qiang, emphasizing that current measurement must be done under load. Around 11 o'clock, he felt soreness in his back, paused to drink water and stretch his shoulders, then continued after a brief rest, restored power, and tested it successfully.
location: Distribution room at Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Plant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and study notes
description: After the emergency repair, Lu Mingqiang walked alone into Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and ordered a bowl of spicy soup rice with a fried egg. While waiting, he took out his phone and carefully reviewed Master Li's notes, focusing on the detailed steps for multimeter calibration, and pondered the content until the food was served.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Chatted with colleagues during the lunch break
description: After lunch, he returned to the workshop rest room. Lu Mingqiang closed his eyes and rested on a simple camp bed for about half an hour. The sound of Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang chatting woke him up. He sat up, rubbed his neck, and naturally joined the conversation. Chen Jianguo complained that his son scored 70 on the math test. Lu Mingqiang comforted him with his own experience, and they chatted a bit about football. Then he checked the time, got up, and prepared for the afternoon work.
location: Workshop rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Organizing warehouse cables and sudden dizziness
description: In the afternoon, he went to the warehouse of Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Factory to sort newly arrived cable reels. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo first rolled the heavy copper-core cable reels onto the shelves by specification. Around 3 p.m., when Lu Mingqiang was lifting a 50-meter reel to stand up, he suddenly saw black spots and felt dizzy. He immediately squatted down and held onto the shelf. Chen Jianguo quickly handed him water and patted his back, saying he looked pale and should rest for a while. Lu Mingqiang squatted until he recovered, drank water, rested, then slowed down and worked with the others to finish the remaining odd jobs.
location: Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Factory warehouse, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Troubleshooting power distribution faults
description: Just after finishing the warehouse work, Lu Mingqiang received a call from Team Leader Zhang, learning that the repaired system had a monitoring alarm. Although it was not serious, it still needed to be checked.
