The three returned to the electrical distribution room and found that a grounding screw at the previously replaced wiring connection had not been tightened, causing a loose connection. Lu Mingqiang tightened it with a wrench and retested; the alarm cleared. He wiped his sweat and remarked that even small problems cannot be taken lightly.
location: Distribution room at Dongfeng Equipment Manufacturing Plant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy daily necessities after work
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike toward Haisheng Road, turned into Xiangzhi General Store, and bought a bag of salt and a bottle of Haitian soy sauce from the owner, Old Chen. After a brief chat, he hung the items on the handlebars and rode along Binhai Avenue for about twenty minutes back to Banshan Garden.
location: Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Arriving home, changing clothes, and checking the tomatoes.
description: After arriving home, he put down his things, changed out of his work clothes, and took a quick shower. Then he went to the balcony to check the tomato seedlings, confirming that the morning watering had protected them from the scorching sun, and he also straightened a fallen sprout with his hand. At that moment, his younger son Lu Zihan ran over, hugged his leg, and called out daddy. Lu Mingqiang scooped him up and gave him a kiss, a warm father-son moment.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and announcement of new health rules
description: Wife Wang Lijuan served stir-fried water spinach, tomato scrambled eggs, and white cut chicken. The family of four sat around the table. After eating a few bites, Lu Mingqiang put down his chopsticks and announced that from that day on, a new family rule would take effect: after 10 p.m., no one was allowed to use their phone; they could soak their feet, exercise, or go to bed early, with his wife supervising. The eldest son asked curiously, and Wang Lijuan smiled in support.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Accompanying son with homework and checking the Pomodoro journal.
description: After a short rest after the meal, Lu Mingqiang went into his eldest son's room and quietly accompanied Lu Zixuan as he finished his mental arithmetic problems. Then he checked the homework and pointed out two careless mistakes for his son to correct. Next, he took his son to the balcony, pointed at the tomato pot, and asked him to write in his growth diary. Lu Zixuan took out the "Tomato Growth Diary" notebook, drew the little sprout, and recorded the date and changes.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (eldest son's room and balcony)

name: Study electrician notes
description: After the sons went to watch TV, Lu Mingqiang entered the study, turned on the desk lamp, opened Master Li's yellowed notebook, and focused on the sections on three-phase unbalance and multimeter calibration. As he read, he used a red pen to draw circuit diagrams and take notes on scratch paper, and deliberately set an alarm for 20:30 to control his study time and avoid overusing his brain.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family animation time
description: After the alarm rang, he closed his notebook and went to the living room, where his younger son Lu Zihan was watching Octonauts and his elder son was also there. Lu Mingqiang sat between his two sons, put his arms around them, and watched together, laughing at the plot from time to time, enjoying a relaxed parent-child moment.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, Building A, Unit 3, Room 502, Living Room, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Foot soaking and stretching exercise
description: After the cartoon ended, Lu Mingqiang turned off the TV and put his phone on Do Not Disturb, leaving it on the dining table. He went to the bathroom to get warm water, sat on a small stool in the living room, and soaked his feet for more than ten minutes, closing his eyes to relax. After drying his feet, he spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did a few sets of planks and lying leg raises with even breathing. He rested whenever he felt tired, completing a healthy routine.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed preparation and reflection before falling asleep
description: After stretching, he went to the toilet, drank a small glass of warm water, and then got into bed. His wife Wang Lijuan asked how he felt. Lu Mingqiang mentioned the dizziness from carrying cables in the afternoon and his determination to sleep early, remarking that health is the foundation of everything. After turning off the light, he closed his eyes and recalled the circuit diagrams in Master Li's notes. His thoughts gradually scattered, and within half an hour he found a comfortable position and fell asleep. It was the earliest and most restful night's sleep he had had in weeks.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building A, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and morning run.
description: The alarm went off, and I felt more relaxed than yesterday. I put on quick-dry clothes and brought a raincoat (the weather forecast said cloudy turning to showers), then cycled 5 minutes to Wanlv Garden Park. The air in the park had that fresh feeling unique after rain, and the road surface was still damp. I put on earphones and jogged while listening to previously recorded notes on circuit principles, keeping the pace at around 6 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, and ran 5 kilometers in 34 minutes. After running, I stretched for 10 minutes in the pull-up bar area, focusing on my lower back and knees.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: When he got home, his wife Juanzi had already prepared breakfast: egg oatmeal porridge, cucumber salad, and two barbecue pork buns. He took a quick shower, changed into work clothes, and said while eating, "Hanhan seemed to cough a little last night. Keep an eye on her this morning." Juanzi acknowledged. He checked his tool bag to make sure the raincoat, insulated gloves, and voltage tester were all there, and also charged his phone.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to school and commute to work.
description: He set off by bike with his younger son Hanhan, telling him on the way, "Drink more water today, and tell the teacher if you feel unwell." He watched him walk into the classroom of Jinmao Center Kindergarten, then turned the bike around, rode for 15 minutes to the company, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, parked, and arrived just in time for the morning meeting.
location: From Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift meeting and work preparation
description: The team leader, Zhang Tou, assigned the task: in the morning, he and the apprentice Zhao Qiang went to Haiyang Residential Area in Longhua District to replace air switches; in the afternoon, they returned to the company to inspect and repair the power distribution room. He carefully checked the voltage tester to make sure the battery was full, and put his master's notebook into his bag, saying to Zhao Qiang, "Today we'll follow the 'double confirmation method' written in it."
location: Tool room, Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to Haiyang Community and replace the air switch
description: Drove the company's electric tricycle with Zhao Qiang along Yehai Avenue to Haiyang Community at No. 58 Yebo Road, Qiongshan District. The rain had stopped on the way, but everything was wet. After arriving, we stopped in front of the community's distribution room and strictly followed the double-confirmation method: first tested the incoming line side for voltage and confirmed there was no power, then tested a known live switch to confirm the voltage tester itself was normal, and finally tested the part to be operated again. The contacts of the old switch that was replaced were burned black. While working, I explained the principles to Zhao Qiang, and he took notes beside me.
location: Power distribution room, Haiyang Residential Community, No. 58 Yebo Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Work break and reminding mother to take care of her knees
description: As soon as the work was done, it started raining again. He took out his phone and saw a weather alert saying the whole week would be rainy and overcast, so he immediately called his mother: 'Mom, it's raining. Remember to put a hot water bottle on your knee, and change the patch every other day—don't wait until it hurts to take care of it.' His mother agreed on the other end and reminded him to be safe. After hanging up, he set a reminder on his calendar for every Sunday at 8 p.m.: 'Ask Mom about her knee.'
location: Beside the power distribution room, Haiyang Residential Area, No. 58 Yebo Road, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return to the area near the company, have lunch, and handle the insurance renewal.
description: Driving back toward the company with Zhao Qiang, he felt hungry at noon and arrived at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. He met up with his workmate Chen Jianguo, ordered a serving of spicy soup rice with a fried egg, and Jianguo ordered pig trotter rice. While eating, they mentioned that the car insurance expires at the end of the month. Jianguo recommended a platform, and he opened the app to compare prices and chose the same package as last year. He told Jianguo, 'Let Juanzi confirm it tonight, and then I'll pay.'
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Went home for a short rest at noon.
description: Rode home by bike. His wife Juanzi and son Xuanxuan had already eaten lunch. Xuanxuan was doing his midday homework. He asked, “What did you learn this morning?”, then lay on the sofa for half an hour, dozing without really falling asleep, just resting his eyes.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and servicing the power distribution room.
description: Rode a bike for 10 minutes to the company, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. In the afternoon, I inspected the company's distribution room with my partner Chen Jianguo. The work wasn't heavy; mainly checking line connections, tightening screws, and cleaning dust. While working, I was thinking about how to explain the 'truncation method' math problem to Xuanxuan in the evening, and pondered that I could use a cable as an analogy.
location: Electrical distribution room of the company at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up younger son after work and go shopping
description: Work ended early today, so I said hello to squad leader Zhang Tou and left ten minutes early. I rode to Jinmao Center Kindergarten just in time for dismissal and picked up Hanhan. He looked in good spirits and no longer coughing. On the way, I bought him a bottle of strawberry yogurt at the Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store at 19 Yusha Road, and he was thrilled.
location: From Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Arriving home, observing the tomato plants on the balcony, and having a parent-child chat
description: Arrived home. His wife Juanzi was busy in the kitchen, and his eldest son Xuanxuan was doing homework. After changing into slippers, he called to the two boys: “Come on, let's go to the balcony with Dad to look at our tomatoes.” Three heads gathered around the flowerpot, but the soil surface was still flat. Xuanxuan was a bit disappointed, and I said: “It's only the third day; the seeds are working hard in the soil. Hanhan asked if it was sleeping. I said yes, once it wakes up, it will come out. Have Xuanxuan note it down: Day 3, temperature 26 degrees, overcast, no change.”
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner
description: My wife Juanzi made stir-fried choy sum, steamed egg with minced pork, and tomato egg drop soup. The family sat around the table to eat. I told Juanzi about replacing the air switch today, and we also talked about car insurance, saying we would look at plans together in the evening. The older son Xuanxuan asked a few homework questions, and I said I would help after dinner.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: In the study, he tutored his eldest son Xuanxuan. There was a problem using the truncation method: a 60-meter wire, 4 meters per piece—how many pieces can you cut? He picked up a pencil and said, 'Think about it—this afternoon Dad repaired the power distribution room. If the wire is not a full meter, can it still be used?' His son suddenly understood and wrote down '60÷4=15 (pieces).' He made up a few more problems, and his son got them all right.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Played with LEGO with his younger son.
description: My younger son Hanhan pulled me to play with LEGO. We built a “power tower” together, and I taught him to recognize the base and the tower body. He built it lopsided, but he was very earnest. My wife Juanzi brought over some fruit and watched us with a smile.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family meeting and evening parent-child observation
description: The children played on their own while he sat on the sofa with his wife Juanzi to discuss: if the rain stopped on Saturday, they would take the two boys to Xinhua Bookstore on Jiefang West Road. Xuanxuan had recently been asking a lot about where electricity comes from, so they wanted to find a popular science book on electricity, and Hanhan could buy a picture book too. Juanzi nodded in agreement and said they would go on Saturday morning as well and eat something there before coming back. Later, before going to bed, he took the two sons to the balcony to look at the tomato pot. Turning on the flashlight on his phone, he shone it on the pot—the soil was still the same. Xuanxuan wrote in his diary: "On the evening of the third day, I looked again, and it still hadn't sprouted. Dad said to be patient." Hanhan asked what the seeds were doing, and he said they were drinking water and stretching underground, getting ready to push out once they had the strength.
location: Living room and balcony of home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Housework coordination and car insurance renewal
description: Helped my wife Juanzi clear the dishes. She washed the dishes, and I wiped the table. Then we took out our phones together, confirmed the car insurance plan, and paid with her account. After that, I went to get hot water to soak my feet, while Juanzi went to check the kids' washing up.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Bedtime foot soaking, stretching, and shutdown ritual
description: At 9:50, I turned off my phone and left it in the living room. I prepared hot water to soak my feet; the water was slightly hot and relieved fatigue. While soaking my feet, I did 15 minutes of core and shoulder-neck stretches: plank (3 sets, 3 minutes total), supine leg raises (30 reps), and wall angels (30 reps). My whole body felt relaxed.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: When he lay down on the bed, his wife Juanzi had finished tidying up too. Outside the window, rain pattered softly. He told her they would have to wear raincoats again tomorrow, and she murmured in acknowledgment. He ran through the day in his mind: went for a run, safely replaced the switch, reminded his mother, taught his son, and made weekend plans with Juanzi. He felt completely at ease and fell asleep before long.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning family preparation and taking the kids to school
description: After getting up at 6:10, washing up, putting on his blue company work uniform, and doing a final check of the competition toolbox—electrician's knife, wire strippers, crimping pliers, digital multimeter, voltage tester, and so on—Lu Mingqiang silently recited the wiring-speed deduction points from his master's notes. His wife Wang Lijuan helped straighten his collar and encouraged him. Then he woke up the two sons. The eldest, Lu Zixuan, got up and washed up on his own; the youngest, Lu Zihan, stayed in bed and was jolted awake by his father's stubble. His wife had already prepared breakfast: Hainan noodles and fried eggs. After Lu Mingqiang ate quickly, the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, walked to nearby Hongfeng Experimental Primary School by himself, while Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to take the youngest son, Lu Zihan, to Jinmao Center Kindergarten and handed him to the teacher.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Buy breakfast during the commute and ride to the competition center
description: After leaving the kindergarten, he cycled to Datie Laoba Tea House and packed two char siu buns and a cup of hot black tea. He then hung the breakfast on the bike and rode toward the Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center. On the way, he quickly ate his breakfast while waiting at a red light, and finally arrived at the competition center.
location: Datie Laobao Tea Shop, Bingya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: On-site check-in, drawing lots, and tool recheck
description: After arriving at the competition center, I parked the electric bike, checked my identity at the registration desk, received the competition credential and number tag, and drew lot No. 07 for the practical workstation. Then, in the tool verification area, I opened the toolbox for the judges to inspect, confirming that all tools met specifications. The judge took extra notice of the newly replaced wire crimping pliers and nodded in approval.
location: First-floor lobby of Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Theory exam
description: At exactly eight o'clock, the theory exam began. The paper covered three modules: electrical fundamentals, safety regulations, and diagram reading analysis. Lu Mingqiang answered steadily from the first question. When he came across a calculation problem about non-sinusoidal periodic current in a complex circuit diagram, he recalled the formula derivation from his master's notes before writing. After finishing all the questions, he had ten minutes left to check, focusing on true/false questions and units in calculation questions.
location: Theory exam room, 2nd floor, Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rest after the exam and contact family
description: After handing in the exam paper, he bought a bottle of mineral water from a vending machine in the first-floor rest area and sat on a bench in the corner to rest. He then called his mother, Chen Xiuying, to ask how her leg was recovering. She said it had improved after applying medicinal wine. He told her to rest more and avoid cold water, then hung up.
location: Rest area on the first floor of Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At noon, he cycled to the fast-food restaurant on Xiuying Small Street near the competition center and ordered a roast duck rice and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup. While eating, he mentally reviewed the procedure for the afternoon hands-on session on the motor forward and reverse control circuit. After the meal, he did not return immediately; instead, he sat on a bench under a tree in a nearby park with his eyes closed, resting for half an hour.
location: Fast-food restaurant on Xiuying Small Street and nearby park, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Entry preparation and equipment check
description: After returning to the competition center, he went to the preparation area and changed into insulated shoes. Entering workstation 7 in the practical operation hall 40 minutes early, he found contactors, thermal relays, push buttons, terminal blocks, and other components already arranged on the workbench. Lu Mingqiang opened his own toolbox, laid out tools such as an electrician's knife and screwdrivers, and then checked each component one by one to ensure they were intact.
location: Workstation 7, Practical Operation Hall, 1st Floor, Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Practical Skills Competition
description: At 1 p.m., the chief referee blew the whistle to start the hands-on competition. The task was to install a motor forward/reverse control circuit and perform a power-on test. Lu Mingqiang started with the wiring, following the horizontal and vertical standard: main circuit first, then control circuit. Every terminal was tightened, the number tags were tidy, and the cable ties were clean. During the fault simulation and troubleshooting stage, he quickly found a loose connection point with a multimeter. Finally, in the power-on test, the motor ran forward and reverse successfully on the first try. The referee lingered in front of the workstation to check the wiring again and nodded.
location: Workstation 7, Practical Operation Hall, 1st Floor, Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Post-race exchanges, waiting, and the awards ceremony.
description: After the competition ended, everyone waited in the rest area for the results. Lu Mingqiang talked with fellow worker Chen Jianguo, colleague Squad Leader Zhang, and others about the competition, asking each other how they had performed. At 4:30 the results were announced. Lu Mingqiang won third place in the electric power industry skills competition. He went on stage to receive an award and got a certificate of honor and an envelope with a 3,000 yuan prize. Company Manager Liu led the applause, and Squad Leader Zhang, Chen Jianguo, and others gave thumbs up.
location: First-floor lobby and tiered lecture hall, Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Communicate with the customer about shop matters
description: After the event ended, he ran into an old client, Li Jianguo, outside the competition center. Li offered a cigarette and congratulated him on winning the award, then suggested using the empty shop diagonally opposite his own store to open a repair service. The two went together to the shop on Dayingshan East Second Street, Meilan District. Boss Li pulled up the rolling shutter door and let Lu Mingqiang inspect it. Lu Mingqiang took photos of the storefront with his phone and noted the dimensions, saying he needed to get his certificate first before discussing further. After chatting for more than ten minutes, they took their leave.
location: Empty shop diagonally opposite Boss Li's shop, Dayingshan East Second Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the younger son from school and buy yogurt.
description: After saying goodbye to Boss Li, he rode back to Longhua District and arrived at Jinmao Center Kindergarten in the evening, just in time for dismissal. His younger son Lu Zihan ran cheerfully toward Lu Mingqiang and was lifted onto the back seat of the e-bike. On the way home, they passed Xiangzhi Store in Chengzhongcheng Residential Complex, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District; he stopped and bought a bottle of strawberry-flavored yogurt for Hanhan.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Xiangzhi Department Store, Chengzhongcheng Residential Area, No. 19, Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home and play with the children
description: Back home, his wife Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. His two sons held up handmade cards with a trophy drawing and the words “Dad, number one” to welcome their father. Lu Mingqiang put down his toolbox and squatted on the floor with the children to play with LEGO, briefly sharing the news of getting third place, and the children cheered.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Celebration dinner and family time
description: His wife prepared a celebration dinner: steamed grouper, Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, and a fresh cream cake. Lu Mingqiang made an exception and drank half a glass of Lijia beer. He clinked glasses with his wife and announced that he would deposit the 3,000 yuan bonus into the studio fund. The family enjoyed the meal, and Lu Mingqiang took half a bowl more rice than usual. After dinner, he took the initiative to clear the dishes, and then the whole family went downstairs and walked around the neighborhood for about ten minutes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Sharing good news with his parents and supervising the children's studies.
description: After returning home from the walk, Lu Mingqiang called his parents to share the good news. His father, Lu Jianguo, answered and said happily, 'Good lad! You didn't shame your old man!' His mother, Chen Xiuying, also grabbed the phone to praise him. After hanging up, while the children were washing up, he urged his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to finish his math homework and checked it.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family Learning and Initial Planning Studio
description: After washing up, the children went to bed before nine. Lu Mingqiang opened his laptop in the study and searched for homestay information in Wenchang's Dongjiao Coconut Grove and Tongguling to prepare for the weekend family trip. Then he checked second-hand platforms for lift prices, and finally opened his phone's memo app to write down the studio startup plan: focus on technical guidance, no large-scale construction, keep costs within 50,000 yuan, and target customers as community residents and temporary shops. Afterwards, he read a short text with his eldest son and urged him to sleep.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Soaking feet to reinforce professional knowledge.
description: While soaking his feet in hot water, he flipped through his master's notebook, focusing on the fault diagnosis chapter for three-phase asynchronous motors. He wrote his insights in the margins with a red pen and copied complex motor wiring diagrams onto draft paper, studying twenty minutes longer than usual.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, bedtime preparation, and going to sleep
description: After closing the laptop, he took a cold shower to relieve fatigue. Before getting into bed, he created a reminder in his phone memo: pay the car insurance renewal tomorrow morning. After setting the alarm, he turned off the light and lay down; his wife was already asleep. Reviewing the day's competition, awards, and warm family moments, he soon fell asleep, dropping off around 10:40 p.m.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning meditation and stretching
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang first meditated on his bed in the bedroom, reviewing the day's plan: check out shop spaces at noon, buy a water heater after work, and play ball in the evening. At 5:50, he got up, stretched, then washed up, weighed himself (71.6 kg), and prepared for the new day.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family breakfast time
description: At 6:10, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast including Hainan noodles. Lu Mingqiang had breakfast with their two children, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. Xuanxuan asked about yesterday's competition, and Lu Mingqiang shared the good news of the award. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drop off the child at school and commute to work
description: At 6:35, he rode an electric bike to take his younger son Lu Zihan to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. He arrived at 6:40 and watched him enter the kindergarten. Then he continued riding to the company and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:00 on time.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing Jinmao Center Kindergarten, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning work preparation and team morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the team at 7:00, colleagues including Chen Jianguo congratulated Lu Mingqiang on winning an award in yesterday's competition. Lu Mingqiang checked his tool bag to prepare for work. At 7:30, shift leader Zhang presided over the morning meeting, publicly praised Lu Mingqiang for winning third place, and he responded modestly.
location: Installation Team 1 workstation and meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Installed a three-phase electric meter box in the morning.
description: At 7:50, rode with Chen Jianguo to the new commercial street on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, to install a three-phase electric meter box for a 30-square-meter shop. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for overall circuit planning and connections; Chen Jianguo was responsible for wiring and fixing. It was completed at 11:20 and passed the test on the first try.
location: Shop No. 2, a newly built commercial street, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finished work in the morning and returned to the company
description: After putting away the tools, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo washed their faces at the shop's tap, then rode back to the company at 11:30. They returned the tools to their places, refilled their water cups, and prepared to go out at noon.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went out at noon to inspect storefronts
description: After getting off work at 12:00, Lu Mingqiang changed into casual clothes and drove to Meilan District. On the way, he picked up spicy chicken rice from a fast-food restaurant on Meisu Road in Xiuying District and had lunch in the car. At 12:30 he arrived at Li Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop on Haifu Road and inspected the vacant shop next door (about 30 square meters, monthly rent 2,500 yuan, with water and electricity in place). He recorded the details on his phone and exchanged views with Boss Li about the required licenses and Senior Technician certificate. At 13:20 he took his leave and drove back, thinking about start-up funds on the way.
location: Li Jianguo Electric Appliance Repair Shop and the vacant shop next door, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: maintenance of the electrical wiring in the residential building hallway.
description: After returning to the company at 13:40, he and Chen Jianguo took sound-activated switches and wires to an old residential community on Haiken Road, Longhua District. Starting from the 7th floor, they inspected aging wiring floor by floor, replaced damaged parts, and restored the stairwell lights. During the work, thoughts about a storefront kept popping into his head, but he still completed the work with focus, ending at 16:50.
location: Building 7, a certain old residential community on Haiken Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, buy a water heater and go home to uninstall the old one
description: At 17:00, after getting off work, he drove to the Robam appliance store on Qiuhai Avenue in Longhua District and used his 1,200 yuan competition prize plus the price difference to buy a 1,299-yuan 40-liter storage water heater. At 17:30, he brought the new unit home, changed into old clothes, and entered the bathroom. He shut off the main water valve, drained the remaining water, put on insulating gloves, and spent half an hour removing the old water heater that had served for eight years with a wrench and screwdriver, then moved it to the living room. His wife Wang Lijuan assisted him from the side.
location: Robam Appliances (Jinshengda Store), No. 28 Qiuhaidao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province   Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Install a new water heater and educate the household on electrical safety.
description: At 18:10 I began installing the new water heater: drilling holes for expansion bolts, mounting the unit, and connecting the corrugated pipe and power cord. After powering on, I used a multimeter to measure the circuits throughout the house, confirming that the total load was safe and the leakage protector tripped sensitively. After the installation, Lu Mingqiang called the whole family over for on-site instruction, demonstrated the leakage protection test, and explained the functions of the live, ground, and neutral wires to his eldest son Lu Zixuan in easy-to-understand terms. The children said, "Dad is really awesome."
location: At the bathroom and distribution box in Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wang Lijuan made dinner (sweet potato leaves, steamed Spanish mackerel, and pork rib soup), and the whole family sat around the table to eat. Lu Mingqiang showed his wife the photos of the shop front from noon. She thought the location was okay but suggested they should hold off and decide after he obtained the senior technician certificate. Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening squash practice and conversation.
description: At 19:45 he changed into sportswear and drove to Haikou Tiantian Squash Club on Binhai Avenue. At 20:15 he had a make-up training session with his squash partner Lin Feng on Court 4. Having not practiced for weeks, his touch was rusty; after forty minutes of training he was panting. Lin Feng reminded him to strengthen his core. At 21:00 the match ended, and they drank water and chatted in the rest area, swapping amusing stories about the fitness business. At 21:15 he showered, changed, and drove home.
location: Haikou Tiantian Tennis Club (Squash Hall), No. 191 Binhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Discussing business startup and evening relaxation with wife
description: Returned home at 21:30, and the children were already asleep. In the living room, Lu Mingqiang explained in detail to Wang Lijuan the storefront situation and his business plan: first obtain the senior technician certificate, then rent a shop and rely on Boss Li to bring in customers, making steady progress. His wife expressed support. Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone, boiled water to soak his feet for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue, checked the doors and windows, and ended the day.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: He lay down in bed at 22:30 and reviewed the whole day: the water heater had been replaced with a new one, the storefront inspection went smoothly, and his wife supported the plan. Everything was under control, and he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family interaction.
description: Woke up promptly at 6:10 in the morning, feeling refreshed, did 5 minutes of deep breathing and simple stretches in bed. Then washed up and shaved. Went into the kitchen, where his wife Wang Lijuan was preparing breakfast: sweet poached eggs and steamed buns. Mingqiang helped set out the bowls and chopsticks, and the two discussed that Mingqiang would pick up their son Xuanxuan after work, and Lijuan would go to the market to buy groceries. After a quick breakfast, Mingqiang changed into his work clothes, checked his wallet, phone, and work badge, saw the sticky note Lijuan had written on the refrigerator saying "Saturday go to Xinhua Bookstore," and after getting ready, left.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Mingqiang drove his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road first, arriving at 7:08, and told him to listen to the teacher. Then he immediately drove to Meilan District, arriving at Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road at 7:33, to take his elder son Lu Zixuan to school. He urged him to pay attention in math class and said he would teach him a new solving method in the evening. He only left after watching Xuanxuan enter the school gate.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting to work and pre-shift meeting
description: After an 18-minute drive from Longfeng Experimental Primary School, they arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. At 7:50, they reached the parking lot, went into the rest room to make tea, organized their tool bags, and checked the newly crimped test leads. At 8:00, Squad Leader Zhang held a morning meeting. He assigned Mingqiang to take Zhao Qiang to Jinpan Convenience Store in the morning to finish the wiring, and to maintain instruments with Chen Jianguo in the afternoon. He also emphasized that there might be heavy rain on the weekend, and outdoor work should pay attention to waterproofing.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: wrapping up the wiring at Jinpan Convenience Store
description: Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang in a utility vehicle to the Cj Convenience Store at Jinpan Garden, arriving at 8:37. They focused on wiring the cashier area circuits and the outlets near the washbasin. When installing the waterproof outlet, Mingqiang guided Zhao Qiang on paying attention to the sealing rubber ring groove and reserving wiring slack, and corrected his problem of over-tightening screws. The work was meticulous; at 11:30 when they finished, the store owner was very satisfied and handed them bottled water.
location: Cj Convenience Store, Jinpan Garden, Jianshe Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday commute and gathering with coworkers.
description: After finishing work, the two drove back toward the company and arrived at Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road at 11:50. They shared a table with Chen Jianguo and Zhang Jianguo, and ordered spicy soup rice, sliced poached Wenchang chicken, and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. At the table, Zhang Jianguo complained that his daughter refused to go to a tutoring class, and Mingqiang shared his experience of using storytelling to guide Xuanxuan in learning math. The atmosphere was lively.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Went home for a lunch break and returned to the company.
description: After the meal, Mingqiang rode his electric bike back to his home in Banshan Garden, arriving at 12:47. He lay on the sofa and scrolled through the news on his phone for a while, then rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes to aid digestion. He left at 13:10, rode for 5 minutes, and returned to the company warehouse at 13:15.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work: equipment maintenance and calibration.
description: With Chen Jianguo, he maintained the cable tester and insulation resistance meter in the warehouse. Mingqiang first cleaned the equipment surfaces, connected batteries to check the readings, and performed continuity tests on each test lead wire. He deliberately bent the newly crimped test lead wires to confirm reliable contact, and also checked the crank handle of the insulation resistance meter. The two worked in close coordination, with focused and meticulous operation.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon work wrap-up and rainstorm warning.
description: During maintenance, Team Leader Zhang notified that the weather station had issued a rainstorm warning. Mingqiang immediately checked the spare raincoat and, after confirming it was not damaged, folded it and put it back in the tool bag. He and Chen Jianguo reminded each other to be careful on the weekend. Then he washed his hands and face, filled in the work record, signed the checkout card, and left work at 16:20.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home, change clothes, and get ready for exercise.
description: Arrived home at 16:27, changed out of work clothes into a quick-dry sports T-shirt, running shorts, and cushioned running shoes, filled a large glass with warm water and set it aside to cool, getting ready for a jog.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Jogging at Wanlv Park
description: Set off by car at 16:55 and arrived at the Evergreen Park parking lot at 17:05. Jogged 5 kilometers along the inner lake greenway at a pace of about 6:20 per kilometer. While running, I thought about Zhao Qiang's certification and the matter of applying for my own technician certificate. After the run, I did leg stretches and shoulder relaxation exercises seriously by the lake, enjoyed the clouds and sunset glow on the lake, and felt relaxed.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Picking up the child from school and heading home
description: After finishing the jog, he wiped off sweat with a towel, drove away from Evergreen Park at 18:05, and went on the way to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to pick up Lu Zixuan. He arrived at the school gate at 18:20. The father and son chatted about interesting school stories in the car, and at 18:35 returned home at Banshan Garden.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was already stir-frying. After washing his hands, Mingqiang helped set the table and serve rice. The family of four chatted while eating, and the younger son Hanhan shared funny stories from kindergarten. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
description: After dinner, Mingqiang and Xuanxuan went into the study. Their homework included a "meeting problem." Mingqiang used white paper to draw line segments and little figures representing people, guiding Xuanxuan step by step to understand the relationship between speed and distance. After Xuanxuan calculated the answer himself, he was very happy. Mingqiang encouraged him to think things through on his own, as that leaves a deeper impression.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Time with his younger son and family.
description: After helping with homework, Mingqiang played with building blocks with Hanhan in the living room while replying on his phone to coworker group-chat messages about rainstorm precautions. His wife, Wang Lijuan, cleaned up the kitchen and did the laundry.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening self-improvement study
description: After the children were settled, Mingqiang went into the study to review the notebook Master Li had given him, focusing on Transformer Protection Principles and Primary Wiring Diagrams. Combined with the afternoon's equipment maintenance practice, his understanding of current direction and protection logic became smoother. He circled the difficult points and wrote Ask Master Li next to them, preparing to ask for advice when visiting his parents tomorrow.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing up and going to bed
description: At 21:00, he closed his study materials, took a hot shower, soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes, and reviewed the day's work, tutoring, and study content with his eyes closed. Afterward, he dried off, checked the weather on his phone and confirmed rain on the weekend. After chatting with his wife, he set his phone to silent at 22:00 and placed it on the bedside table, then fell into a deep, even-breathing sleep before 23:10.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Weekend early morning and balcony gardening
description: On a weekend morning, Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally and went to the balcony with his two sons to check the cherry tomato seedlings planted last week. He guided the children to gently water them with a small spray bottle and explained chlorophyll and photosynthesis. His older son, Lu Zixuan, carefully observed the leaf veins and asked questions, while his younger son, Lu Zihan, asked in a babyish voice when they could eat the tomatoes, making the whole family laugh.
location: Home balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Middle Jinmao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Warm weekend breakfast.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared a steaming hot breakfast of Hainan rice noodles with pickled vegetables, peanuts, bean sprouts, and a fried egg. The whole family sat together. Lu Mingqiang announced that he would go to Hainan Provincial Library in the morning. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, excitedly asked about robot books; the younger son, Lu Zihan, clamored to find dinosaur picture books; his wife smiled and reminded everyone to bring water bottles and wet wipes.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Set off for Hainan Provincial Library
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang changed into a clean shirt, checked the car, and drove off with his two sons. In the back seat, the children fastened their seat belts and chattered all the way about the fun things at the library. Driving smoothly along Guoxing Avenue, they arrived at the parking lot of Hainan Provincial Library after about 25 minutes.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Hainan Provincial Library, No. 36 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child learning time at Hainan Provincial Library
description: After entering the library, they first went to the children's reading area on the first floor. The older son, Lu Zixuan, found The Mysteries of Electricity and An Illustrated Guide to Mechanical Principles and read them carefully. Pointing at the gear transmission diagram, he said he wanted to be an engineer, and Lu Mingqiang felt very gratified. The younger son, Lu Zihan, was drawn to the fire truck pop-up book and flipped through it quietly. Then Lu Mingqiang went to the general reading area on the second floor, borrowed History of Hainan Industry and 300 Questions on Electrical Fundamentals, and in the electronic reading area used a public computer to quickly browse several introductory articles on PLC.
location: Hainan Provincial Library, 36 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (first-floor Children's Reading Area, second-floor General Reading Area)

name: Group photo in front of the library
description: Before leaving, Lu Mingqiang asked a passerby to take a photo of the father and two sons on the library steps, one arm around each son, with the large characters 'Hainan Provincial Library' in the background. After the photo was sent to the family group, his father Lu Jianguo sent a voice message, cheerfully praising his grandsons for being natural students.
location: Entrance of Hainan Provincial Library, No. 36 Guoxing Avenue, Qiongshan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drove back and packed lunch.
description: Drove back to Longhua District. On the way, he stopped at the Jiami food stall he often went to on Shimao South Road and ordered takeout of a signature grilled fish and a plate of stir-fried river shrimp with chives. When he got home, his wife had already prepared qingbuliang and was waiting.
location: From Hainan Provincial Library, passing Jiamie Food Stall at 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Family lunch and midday nap
description: The whole family sat together for lunch. Lu Mingqiang told them about Xuanxuan's dream, expressed in the library, of becoming an engineer, and his wife encouraged the children to study hard. After the meal, the two children went to the bedroom for a nap, while Lu Mingqiang lay on the living room sofa with his eyes closed, resting up for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Woke up from his midday nap and checked the kite
description: After lying in bed for a while without falling asleep, Lu Mingqiang got up and went to the storage room to find the traditional butterfly kite he had treasured for years. He carefully checked the bamboo frame and bridle line to confirm they were in good condition, and prepared a spare line reel to make sure the kids could fully enjoy themselves in the afternoon.
location: Storage room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Set off for Wanlv Garden
description: At 2:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove the whole family to Wanlv Garden. The children were full of energy. After arriving, he parked in a shady spot, and they walked toward the open lawn with kites and string reels.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Wanlv Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District

name: Parent-child kite flying at Wanlv Garden
description: On the big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, Lu Mingqiang taught Xuanxuan hand by hand to run against the wind and let out the line. After the kite successfully rose into the air, he let the child hold the spool himself; the little guy was nervous and excited. His wife took their younger son Hanhan to chase fallen leaves and butterflies on the grass, using her phone to record the relaxing and pleasant afternoon.
location: The big lawn of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Packed up the gear and returned home.
description: The wind gradually died down, so they packed up the kite. The children were reluctant to leave. Lu Mingqiang asked his wife to take the children to the car first, while he went to a nearby fruit stall and bought two fresh coconuts and some mangosteen. On the way home, his younger son Hanhan fell asleep in the back seat from exhaustion, while his elder son Xuanxuan was still excitedly discussing flying an even bigger kite next time.
location: Returned from Wanlv Park to Banshan Garden residential area, passing by a fruit stall.

name: Helping prepare dinner and playing at home
description: After getting home, Lu Mingqiang let his wife rest and did the cooking himself. He made tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried green beans for the children, and cut up the packaged roast fish. Xuanxuan was building a 'power station' with blocks in the living room, while Hanhan was playfully making trouble and giggling nearby. During dinner, he once again encouraged Xuanxuan to work hard toward his dream of becoming an engineer.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Tutoring homework and personal study
description: After dinner, his wife took the younger son to bathe, while Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son Xuanxuan on math homework—RMB conversion. He directly used real coins and banknotes for demonstration, and the child quickly understood and finished the exercises independently. Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang opened "History of Hainan Industry" borrowed from the library, and reading about the difficult construction of the Haikou Power Plant strengthened his determination to continue pursuing certifications and further study.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation stretching and note organization.
description: After sitting for a long time, Lu Mingqiang felt a sore neck. He stood up and did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and lower back stretches to avoid a relapse of his old problem. Then he returned to his desk and neatly noted down several motor protection key points from 'Three Hundred Questions on Electrical Fundamentals' in his notebook, and marked them to ask Master Li the next day.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Getting ready for bed and soaking feet before sleep.
description: He turned off his phone, boiled water and mixed it to a comfortable warm temperature, and soaked his feet for 20 minutes, which relieved the fatigue from walking and standing all day. While soaking his feet, he discussed with his wife taking the children to his parents' home in Meilan District for lunch the next morning, so the grandparents could enjoy family happiness.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime conversation and turning off the lights to sleep.
description: Lying in bed, chatted with his wife about neighborhood gossip and the boys' growth, feeling the happiness of ordinary life. Listening to the occasional sound of cars from outside the window and feeling the steady breathing of his family beside him, he felt deeply at ease. Turned off the lights and fell asleep before 22:30, ending a fulfilling and wonderful day.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at 7 a.m. Lu Mingqiang turned it off, got up, and went to the balcony to look at the newly grown leaves of the cherry tomatoes, feeling refreshed. His wife Wang Lijuan woke up the two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, in the bedroom. Hanhan, still groggy, asked whether they were going to Grandpa and Grandma's house today.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bedroom and balcony at home)

name: Family breakfast.
description: Breakfast was Hainan rice noodles prepared by his wife Wang Lijuan and the leftover glutinous rice cakes from last night. The family sat around the dining table. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang reminded the children to be polite at their grandfather's house. Xuanxuan said he wanted to play Chinese chess with Grandpa, while Hanhan was thinking about the glutinous rice cakes Grandma makes.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (dining room)

name: Vehicle inspection and travel preparation
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang took his keys and went to the parking lot downstairs. He walked around the vehicle to check the tire pressure, oil, and coolant to make sure everything was normal. The trunk had already been loaded with Tieguanyin tea, a fruit gift box, and the toolbox won from the skills competition, ready to let his father see this honor.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (community parking lot)

name: Drove to parents' home
description: The family of four set off on time to the parents' home. Lu Mingqiang drove; there wasn't much traffic on the road, so he rolled down the window to feel the morning breeze. After about a 17-minute drive, he turned into Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, and parked steadily downstairs at his parents' home.
location: Haikou, Hainan Province: from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, to the South District of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District

name: Family interaction and helping in the kitchen
description: After parking, he carried the things upstairs. His father, Lu Jianguo, was chatting with a neighbor at the door; when he saw his grandchildren, he came over with a smile. His mother, Chen Xiuying, poked her head out of the kitchen and called everyone inside. Lu Mingqiang took over the work in his mother's hands and helped chop the cleaned Wenchang chicken, while his wife, Wang Lijuan, helped out in the kitchen by peeling garlic and washing vegetables. The two children played Chinese checkers with their grandpa in the living room, with laughter all around.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Community, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (parents' home living room and kitchen)

name: Paid the electricity bill online and checked work group messages.
description: While his mother and wife were busy in the kitchen, Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa in the living room and opened the State Grid Online app on his phone. He checked that this month's electricity bill was 327.5 yuan and paid it via Alipay. Then he checked the work team's WeChat group and saw that Team leader Zhang had sent a notice requiring everyone to bring their personal safety operation record card to tomorrow morning's meeting. He immediately replied, "Received."
location: Parents' home living room, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Zone, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Father took out a small cup of medicinal liquor, and the table was filled with dishes prepared by mother and wife: golden and glossy Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with shrimp paste, clear and sweet winter melon and sea snail soup, and pan-fried mackerel. Lu Mingqiang toasted his father, chatted about the amusing incident of changing the electricity meter box in the community, and also shared his experience from a few days earlier of winning third place in a skills competition and rushing to repair cables. His son Xuanxuan kept his head down and ate two bowls of rice, praising grandma's chicken rice as the best in the world.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Meilan District, Dayingshan East First Street, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community (parents' home dining room)

name: A long father-son talk on the balcony
description: After the meal, his mother and wife cleared the dishes. Lu Mingqiang sat down with his father in rattan chairs on the balcony and brewed the Tieguanyin tea he had just brought back. He told his father about the certificate from the skills competition and his idea of opening a repair workshop, and also frankly admitted his worries about the social intricacies and financial pressure beyond technical matters. After listening, his father advised from more than forty years of experience as an electrician: 'Your intention is good, but you need to be steady. Don't be in a hurry to rent a storefront. First pass the senior technician certificate and make a name for yourself. Technical skill and personal connections are both indispensable.' Lu Mingqiang listened carefully and took it to heart.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South District Residential Community, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (parents' home balcony)

name: Accompanying the children in the community garden
description: After chatting with his father, seeing that the children could not stay put at home, Lu Mingqiang took them downstairs to the garden of the residential complex where his parents lived. The garden had a sandpit and a slide. Xuanxuan took his younger brother to dig in the sand and climb the slide. Lu Mingqiang sat on a bench watching them, occasionally taking photos, enjoying the parent-child time in the sunshine.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Community (community garden), Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Saying goodbye to parents
description: Near 3:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang went upstairs to say goodbye to his parents. His mother, as usual, handed him a large bag of freshly steamed yiba and homegrown vegetables, telling him to stay safe at work. His father patted him on the shoulder and said, "Work hard." Lu Mingqiang acknowledged and went downstairs with his family of four.
location: Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan South Zone Community, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province (parents' home)

name: Drive back
description: After leaving his parents' home, Lu Mingqiang drove his family back to his own home. On the way, he remembered his work clothes were still drying on the balcony and reminded his wife Wang Lijuan to bring them in. After about an 18-minute drive, they arrived smoothly at Banshan Garden Community in Longhua District and parked the car in a space.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, from CCCC Longqi Yayuan South Community on Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Organize the items brought back
description: After getting out of the car, Lu Mingqiang opened the trunk and carried up the food and side dishes his mother had given him. As soon as the two sons got home, they ran to the living room to watch cartoons. Lu Mingqiang put the yiba and other items he brought back into the refrigerator and tidied them up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (home)

name: Bring in the clothes from the line
description: After changing into loungewear, Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony, took down the work clothes that had dried during the day, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe, finishing the chores neatly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (balcony)

name: Look up preparation materials for the senior technician certificate exam.
description: After finishing up, Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa, opened the "Electrician Technology Forum" on his phone, and searched for discussion posts and review materials about the "Senior Technician Certificate" exam. He found several highly upvoted exam preparation posts and saved them for later learning.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: Family dinner
description: In the evening, they didn't want anything too complicated. His wife Wang Lijuan cooked a big pot of seafood noodles with the side dishes brought back from her mother's home, some leftovers, and frozen shrimp from the fridge. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting about the day's amusing events, in a relaxed and cozy atmosphere.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (dining room)

name: Homework tutoring and parent-child games
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang cleared the dishes, and his wife went to do laundry. His eldest son Xuanxuan was doing math homework in the living room. When he came across a difficult "time calculation" problem, Lu Mingqiang guided him using the drawing method, and after more than ten minutes Xuanxuan solved it successfully. His younger son Hanhan built a "tower crane" with building blocks and asked his father whether it was taller than a real large tower crane. Lu Mingqiang smiled and replied that it was certainly taller.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: The couple discusses future plans
description: After the children had washed up, read their picture books, and fallen asleep, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan leaned against the headboard and talked about the afternoon conversation with his father. His wife held his hand and said in support, “Dad is right. Let’s take it one step at a time and first get that senior certificate. I’ll take care of the daily household expenses. You just study with peace of mind—I’m not afraid of hard work.” Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved, firmly held his wife’s hand, and felt that life was full of hope.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Personal study and certification plan
description: After his wife fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, turned on the desk lamp, and fleshed out his father's suggestion of 'get certified first, then open the shop' into concrete steps in his notebook. He reviewed the exam syllabus for the senior technician certificate, marked key exam points, and took out Three Hundred Questions on Electrical Fundamentals, taking notes from where he had marked yesterday.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Soaking feet before bed to relax
description: Feeling a little tired, Lu Mingqiang soaked his feet in warm water for 15 minutes. The hot water relieved the fatigue of the day. He closed his eyes and reviewed today's conversation with his father, feeling more at ease.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bathroom)

name: Going to bed
description: At 21:15, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone on time, stopped checking messages in the work group, and lay in bed mentally running through the documents he needed to bring to work the next day. Drowsiness gradually set in, and he fell into a sound sleep before 23:00.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: At 6:10 in the morning, the sound of rain outside the window woke Lu Mingqiang. After getting up, he saw his wife Wang Lijuan already preparing breakfast in front of the stove, with the aroma of fried eggs and Hainanese rice noodles filling the air. He put on a thin jacket, went to the sons' room to wake Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and urged them to wash up, while he quickly brushed his teeth, washed his face, and shaved. The family of four sat around the dining table eating a steaming breakfast. Lu Mingqiang told his sons to be careful because the roads were slippery in the rain and to listen to their teachers at school. He drank congee and ate eggs, thinking that today he would take his apprentice Zhao Qiang to Jinpan Road to replace an electricity meter, and he needed to bring the job record card and notebook. After the meal, he cleared the dishes, checked the toolbox, and confirmed that the raincoat was ready.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking the kids to school in the rain
description: At 7:05, Lu Mingqiang put on his rain poncho, dressed his two sons properly, and set off from Banshan Garden on an electric bicycle. The rain was fine and steady. He first turned onto Guomao Sanheng Road to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, sent his younger son Hanhan through the school gate, and asked the teacher to keep an extra eye on him. Then he rode along Yusha Road and Yinpo Road, took his older son Xuanxuan to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, and only left after watching him walk into the teaching building.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute and pre-shift meeting
description: After dropping off his child, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to the company on Haisheng Road in Xiuying District. The road was slippery in the rain, so he was extra careful; a 20-minute ride took him half an hour. He arrived at 8 o'clock, changed into his work clothes in the locker room, put on his safety helmet, and organized his tool bag. At the pre-shift meeting, Squad Leader Zhang stressed safety precautions for working in the rain and checked each team's tasks. Lu Mingqiang's assignment was to take Zhao Qiang to the Gonglu Residential Community on Jinpan Road to replace smart electricity meters.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Electricity meter upgrade for the old residential community on Jinpan Road
description: After Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang collected the tools and smart meters, they rode for over ten minutes and arrived at the Highway Residential Community at No. 27 Jinpan Road. It was still raining, so they laid non-slip mats in the stairwells and checked the insulation of the wiring. Lu Mingqiang let Zhao Qiang do the hands-on work while he supervised from the side. When replacing the meter for the fourth household, he noticed that Zhao Qiang's wire stripping length exceeded the specification and immediately stopped him. He demonstrated the standard stripping technique and wiring arc on the spot, and warned him that in rainy, humid weather, workmanship mattered even more. Zhao Qiang corrected himself seriously, and the remaining replacements went smoothly; the two worked well together. By 11:15 they had completed replacing 12 household meters. Lu Mingqiang had Zhao Qiang tidy up the tools and old meters while he carefully recorded each household's completion status and meter number. At 11:30 sharp, they wrapped up for the day.
location: Gonglu Residential Community, No. 27 Jinpan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Coworkers catching up over lunch.
description: As the rain gradually eased, Lu Mingqiang, Zhao Qiang, and Chen Jianguo met at Wanning Vermicelli King near Jinpan Road. Chen Jianguo had already ordered braised pork trotter rice for them, and the three ate and chatted. Chen Jianguo mentioned that the old refrigerator at home was no longer cooling and he wanted to buy a new one. Lu Mingqiang suggested waiting another week, saying it would be a better deal when the mall had its end-of-month promotion. Zhao Qiang mentioned that his parents back home were urging him to find a partner in Haikou, and the other two teased him with laughter. The mood was relaxed.
location: Wanning Rice Noodle King, Jinpan Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and self-study.
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike back to the company and lay down for half an hour on the folding bed in the employee rest area. When the 13:00 alarm went off, he got up, washed his face, and before the afternoon shift, took Master Li's notebook from the toolbox, turned to the marked pages on "Transformer Protection Principles," and silently read for twenty minutes, memorizing the key points.
location: Rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: sorting files and checking materials
description: The afternoon task was to organize the maintenance work orders and material requisition records from the past six months. Lu Mingqiang and his team members spread out piles of documents in the office to check dates, equipment models, maintenance content, and requisition lists. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for the final summary and binding. His handwriting was neat, and he checked every page one by one to make sure there was no mistake. When Manager Liu made his rounds, he saw the files on their desks already taking shape, especially the work orders at Lu Mingqiang's side, which were arranged clearly and cleanly. He nodded and praised, 'Mingqiang does things in a way that really reassures people.' Lu Mingqiang felt at ease and had even more energy for work.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shopping after work and picking up the children.
description: At 4 p.m., he got off work on time; the rain had stopped and the air was fresh. Lu Mingqiang first rode to Xiangzhi General Store on Yusha Road. Remembering that his younger son Hanhan had taken a few extra looks at the handmade little kites at the stall, he picked a bird-shaped kite and also bought a bottle of his favorite chili sauce. Then on the way, he went to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Third Horizontal Road to pick up Hanhan, whose eyes lit up at the sight of the kite. Then father and son went to the entrance of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School on Yinpo Road to wait for Xuanxuan. At 5:20 p.m., Xuanxuan excitedly took out his math unit test paper—88 points. The word problems that used to be left blank had all been filled in this time. Lu Mingqiang felt a warmth in his heart, carefully looked over the paper, and praised again and again, 'Good boy!' After getting the two children into the car, the laughter of the family of three drifted all the way home.
location: Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned home to rest and be with the children.
description: After arriving home, his wife Wang Lijuan was trimming vegetables in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang handed the small kite to Hanhan, and the little one ran joyfully around the living room. He sat down on the sofa, called Xuanxuan over, and asked Xuanxuan to explain the reasoning for the calculation problems he had gotten wrong on the test paper. Seeing that Xuanxuan understood correctly, he felt completely relieved.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and education discussion
description: Dinner was Wang Lijuan's poached shrimp, stir-fried choy sum, and a pot of hot soup. At the table, the whole family talked about Xuanxuan's good grades, and Hanhan also held up his little kite to show off. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to go to the kitchen and wash the dishes so his wife could rest. As he washed, he discussed with his wife, who had followed him in, extending the end-of-term math tutoring class. Wang Lijuan begrudged the extra 600 yuan each month, but seeing how much progress Xuanxuan had made, she nodded and agreed, saying, "It's worth it. As long as it works, we'll continue. I'll contact the teacher tomorrow." Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside, feeling that life had more promise.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province
