name: Evening tutoring and family entertainment.
description: After helping Xuanxuan correct the wrong answers on his test paper, Lu Mingqiang used the example of 'getting change when buying groceries' to help him fully understand mixed addition and subtraction. Afterwards, the family snuggled on the sofa watching TV. Hanhan leaned in her mother's arms, still clutching a small kite, and fell asleep without realizing it. Looking at his younger son sleeping soundly on the sofa and his older son watching TV intently, Lu Mingqiang felt the rainy night was especially warm and cozy.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wash up, put the children to bed, and study on my own at night
description: At 20:30, Lu Mingqiang urged his two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces, and he took a shower himself. He coaxed the boys into bed and kissed their cheeks. Then he took out Master Li's notebook, leaned against the headboard, and flipped through it by the lamp, focusing on the "Motor Forward-Reverse Control Circuit Wiring Diagram" chapter, tracing the wiring on the diagram with his finger and silently memorizing the positions of the components.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Soaking feet and preparing for bed
description: At 21:30, Lu Mingqiang drew a large bucket of hot water and sat on a small stool in the living room, soaking his feet while checking the work group on his phone. He confirmed the new task for tomorrow posted by Team Leader Zhang — to inspect and repair the mall's power distribution cabinets in the Guomao area. There were no urgent tasks, so he felt at ease. After soaking his feet, he poured out the water, brushed his teeth, and then lay back in bed.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed on a rainy night
description: At exactly 10 p.m., he set his phone to silent and put it on the nightstand. Outside the window, a light drizzle began to fall again, pattering softly against the glass. Lu Mingqiang lay on his side listening to the rain and ran through the day's events in his mind: the electric meter replacement went smoothly, his file work was praised by the leader, Xuanxuan scored 88 on a test, and he and his wife had agreed to renew the tutoring fee. Every little thing made him feel grounded. He adjusted his sleeping position and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of the rain.
location: Unit X, Building X, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning chores and breakfast.
description: The alarm went off on time. It was overcast outside. Lu Mingqiang remembered today's inspection at Guomao and the possible emergency repair, so he quickly got up to wash up. Then he woke his wife Wang Lijuan and sons Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. He cooked the Hainan noodles that had been soaked last night, adding lean meat and peanuts; the aroma filled the air. Wang Lijuan found Lu Zixuan's school uniform, while Lu Zihan was still groggy and didn't want to get up. Lu Mingqiang scooped him up and joked, "If you don't get up, the electric tiger from Dad's repair today will come bite your butt!" This made the child giggle. The family of four sat around the table for breakfast. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang reminded Wang Lijuan not to forget to transfer 600 yuan in tutoring fees to Lu Zixuan's teacher, and asked Lu Zixuan whether he had solved last night's math word problem using equations. Only after Lu Zixuan nodded was he reassured.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking his son to school and commuting to the company
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang changed into his work clothes, put on his tool bag, and habitually weighed the multimeter and cable cutters in it. Only after confirming the weight did he feel at ease. He also brought the e-bike keys and an old raincoat in case the weather changed. He rode his e-bike to take his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, telling the child along the way to behave at kindergarten and not fight with other children over the slide. When they arrived at the kindergarten gate, Hanhan waved goodbye. Lu Mingqiang turned the bike around and rode west along Binhai Avenue for about twenty minutes, arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.
location: Start at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, pass Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and arrive at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-shift meeting and tool maintenance
description: After changing into work clothes at the company, Team Leader Zhang held a brief morning meeting and assigned the day's tasks. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang used the time before departure to take out an alcohol wipe and carefully clean the test leads and jacks of the multimeter, confirming there was no oxidation. He also dripped lubricating oil onto the moving joint of the cable cutter and opened and closed it repeatedly until the sound was crisp, with a hunch that he might use it in the afternoon.
location: Installation Team 1 Workstation, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to Xinda Business Building for the quarterly safety inspection of the electrical distribution room
description: Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang and a notebook, and rode the company's electric bike to Xinda Business Building on Guomao Avenue. After meeting with the building's property electrician, Engineer Li, the two entered the power distribution room on the first basement level. Lu Mingqiang used an infrared thermometer to check the connector temperatures one by one along the busbar. He found green verdigris on the wiring terminals behind a main switch cabinet and determined it was oxidation, so he sanded the contact surfaces, applied conductive paste, and retightened the bolts. While working, he explained the key inspection points and potential risks to Zhao Qiang, who took careful notes. Afterwards, they tested the current and insulation of all circuits and, after confirming everything was normal, signed the inspection record.
location: Electrical distribution room, Basement 1, Xinda Business Building, 48 Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Emergency repair response
description: After the safety inspection, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang returned to the company cafeteria to eat. Just as they reached the entrance, the phone rang urgently. Director Wang of the Jinmao Middle Road property management called, saying that the main cable in Banshan Garden Community had burned out, several buildings were without power, and hundreds of residents were waiting. Lu Mingqiang immediately gave up eating and, while running to the warehouse, called Chen Jianguo to bring materials such as the cable fault detector, crimping pliers, heat-shrink tubing, and newly arrived intermediate joints, and also asked Zhao Qiang to help. The three quickly loaded the tools and equipment onto the emergency repair van. Chen Jianguo drove, sounding the horn all the way and running two red lights, rushing to the scene.
location: From No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Emergency repair of the Banshan Garden power distribution room and restoration of power supply
description: After arriving at Banshan Garden, Property Manager Wang was already waiting anxiously at the entrance. Lu Mingqiang immediately used a cable fault tester to detect along the cable route. At the edge of the flower bed beside Building 1, the instrument alarmed and scorch marks were found on the surface, confirming that the buried cable had broken down due to aging. He directed Chen Jianguo to set up a warning cordon, and then the two took turns using a jackhammer and shovels to dig through the soil and bricks, exposing the damaged cable. After completing the safety grounding, Lu Mingqiang personally stripped the cable armor and insulation, used a crimping tool to crimp the new cable segment onto the copper core, and then wrapped it layer by layer with semiconductive tape, insulating tape, and waterproof tape. After slipping on heat-shrink tubing, he heated it evenly with a blowtorch so it contracted. After each step, they tested the insulation resistance with a megohmmeter to ensure it met the standard. Zhao Qiang assisted by passing tools and providing safety monitoring. The emergency repair lasted from 13:15 to 20:00, during which Lu Mingqiang sweated profusely and did not rest. After the final joint passed the withstand voltage test, he closed the switch and restored power. The building lights came on and residents cheered. He then carried a multimeter and checked the distribution boxes building by building, confirming that the phase voltages were normal and the phase sequence was correct, and signed the property management logbook to confirm that the repair was complete and power had been restored.
location: Flower bed and main power distribution room beside Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wrap-up work and returning to the company to put things into storage.
description: After the power supply was restored, Lu Mingqiang and his colleagues filled and compacted the excavated ground, checked the remaining materials and tools, and loaded them onto the repair truck. When they returned to the company, they put the repair truck, tools, and materials back in their places and into storage. Lu Mingqiang took off his soaked work clothes, changed into his own clothes, said goodbye to Chen Jianguo and reminded him to go home early and rest, then got on his electric bike and prepared to head home.
location: Warehouse and entrance of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going home for dinner and spending the evening with family
description: Lu Mingqiang pushed open the front door, and his wife Wang Lijuan had already placed steaming braised pork ribs, stir-fried greens, and hot soup on the table. As he ate heartily, Wang Lijuan mentioned that Director Wang from property management had specifically called the house to praise his excellent technical skills. After dinner, he took a hot shower and soaked his feet with a herbal pack to relax his sore body. Then he went to the study to check his son Lu Zixuan's math homework, pointed out several calculation errors and explained them patiently. He also went to look at his younger son Lu Zihan, who was already asleep. Returning to the bedroom, he chatted with Wang Lijuan about the day's emergency repair process and his plan to play squash with old friend Lin Feng tomorrow evening, and they also discussed taking the kids to their grandparents' house for Hainanese chicken rice on the weekend. When drowsiness set in, he turned off the light and went to bed, falling deeply asleep in exhaustion and contentment.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up stretching, breakfast, and housework.
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off, felt in good spirits but with soreness and tightness in the lower back, shoulders, and neck. Did supine leg raises and shoulder circles in bed to activate muscles. Then went to the kitchen, where his wife Wang Lijuan was preparing Hainan noodles for the children. Lu Mingqiang took over cooking the rice noodles, fried a sunny-side-up egg for himself, and cut fruit, while using his phone to check the work group and confirm the equipment was running normally. He also put his work clothes into the washing machine.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the two sons to school and buy newspapers on the way
description: He rode his e-bike to first take his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, watched him enter the school gate and told him to behave; then picked up his elder son Lu Zixuan, who was waiting downstairs at home, and took him to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. After watching Xuanxuan enter the school gate, he bought a copy of Hainan Daily at a newsstand next to the school, planning to read it during the lunch break.
location: Start from home, go to Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; and the newsstand next to the school.

name: Commute to the company, change into work clothes, and check messages
description: Rode an electric bike from the school to the company along Longkun North Road - Haixiu Middle Road - Haisheng Road. His phone vibrated on the way but he did not answer. After arriving at the company, he changed into work clothes in the locker room, checked his phone and saw a WeChat voice message from Chen Jianguo reminding him to bring a jacket, and a commendation letter forwarded by the property management. After replying, he went to his work team.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift meeting, commendation, and preparing inspection tools
description: Lu Mingqiang attended the morning meeting hosted by Squad Leader Zhang. Zhang named and praised yesterday's emergency repair team and read a thank-you letter; Manager Liu verbally announced commendations for Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo as outstanding employees. After the meeting, Squad Leader Zhang arranged a morning inspection of the box transformers on Binhai Avenue and an afternoon task of moving new cables. Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang went with Chen Jianguo to the tool room to pick up an infrared thermometer, a multimeter, wrenches, a notebook, etc. Lu Mingqiang deliberately took an extra offset wrench and kept the key inspection points in mind.
location: Company team meeting room and tool room in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park.

name: Box transformer inspection along Binhai Avenue and return.
description: He set off with Chen Jianguo on the company's electric bike and conducted a detailed inspection of 3 public box-type transformers along Binhai Avenue from the Wanlv Garden section to the western section: using an infrared thermometer to measure the contact temperature, checking the oil level gauge, and observing the color of the silica gel in the desiccant breather. At a box-type transformer on the western section of Binhai Avenue, he found the silica gel had changed from blue to pink, took photos, recorded it, and planned to report it for repair. While inspecting, he used the correct posture—tightening his core and squatting with bent knees—making it much easier. After the inspection, they rode back to the company. On the way, Chen Jianguo mentioned that his son wanted to learn electrical work, and Lu Mingqiang suggested he study systematically at a vocational and technical college, and shared his experience in mentoring apprentices.
location: Public box-type transformers along Binhai Avenue, Longhua District / Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then returned to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park

name: Lunch, midday rest, organizing inspection notes, and reporting repairs.
description: Had lunch at Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant next to Yangtianhe Pharmacy with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, ordering spicy soup rice and white-cut Wenchang chicken. While eating, we shared inspection findings and showed photos of the discolored silicone. After lunch, returned to the company and rested for 25 minutes on a recliner in the changing room. When the 13:10 alarm rang, went to the team office to organize the morning inspection notes, imported the photos into the work log, and submitted a repair request for the equipment with discolored silicone.
location: Yangtianhe Pharmacy No. 110, Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province; then returned to the locker room and team office of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park Company.

name: Moving new cables and sharing lower-back protection tips
description: In the afternoon, a new batch of cables arrived, and the whole team moved them into the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang took on the heaviest lifting and directing work voluntarily. During a break in the moving, he gathered Zhao Qiang and other young workers, and demonstrated on the spot the standard movement of squatting down and standing up using core and leg strength, explaining key points such as tightening the core, keeping the back straight, and driving with the thighs to avoid lower back injury. The older workers also followed along and said it was much easier than using brute force. Lu Mingqiang himself felt his lower back was more flexible than yesterday, and after moving three bundles he did not develop any soreness, which was very gratifying.
location: Company warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park

name: Finish work, change clothes, commute to the squash court
description: After the moving work ended, he went to the changing room, washed his face with cool water, changed into the sports T-shirt and shorts he had brought, switched to sports shoes, and took his squash racket and shoulder bag. He rode the electric bike along Haisheng Road - Haixiu Middle Road - Jinlong Road to the squash court. The sunshine along the way was warm, and he thought about how he should ask Lin Feng for advice on protecting his lower back.
location: From Hainan Elevator Support Industrial Park to Leyu Squash Club, 3rd Floor, Industrial Bank Building, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Squash training and casual socializing
description: After arriving at the squash court, he asked Lin Feng for advice on preventing lower back and shoulder strains when hitting the ball. Lin Feng watched Lu Mingqiang's swing and pointed out that he was overextending his lower back. He taught him core static support exercises and a power generation pattern in which the hips drive the body's rotation. He then practiced backhand wall shots for half an hour, consciously using his hips to generate power, and it felt smooth and crisp. During a break, he thought that this kind of fine body control would also be useful for installing smart home devices. After training, he stretched in the rest area. Lin Feng also taught him two preparatory movements, the dead bug and the bird dog, and suggested doing a few reps before lifting heavy objects to wake up the waist and abdomen. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes and felt he had gained a lot.
location: Leyu Squash Club, 3rd Floor, Industrial Bank Building, Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute home, dinner, and family time.
description: Rode the electric bike home, and on the way stopped at Uncle Wang's fruit stand at the entrance of the community to buy bananas and yogurt. When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had just finished cooking dishes such as braised pork ribs and stir-fried greens. Lu Mingqiang put away the fruit, briefly talked about the experience of hauling cables today and what he had learned in squash, and then the family had dinner together.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping the eldest son with homework and playing with the younger son
description: After the meal, he cleared the dishes and helped his eldest son Xuanxuan with math homework in the living room. Using apples and bananas as props, he explained the equal-sharing division word problems. Once Xuanxuan understood and answered correctly, Lu Mingqiang praised him. Then he played with building blocks with his younger son Hanhan, building a small house, and the father-son interaction was warm.
location: Home, living room

name: Called old classmates and set up a classmate group
description: After receiving a WeChat voice call from junior high school classmate Zhou Wei in Shenzhen, the two chatted on the balcony for nearly half an hour, sharing updates on their lives. Zhou Wei suggested that when he returned to Haikou at the end of the year, they should get Wu Gang together for a gathering. After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang immediately contacted Wu Gang, and the three created a WeChat group called "Youthful Times," in which they shared old graduation photos and short videos. Lu Mingqiang posted a photo of his treasured old liquor, and they agreed that each would bring a wine-bottle story to the gathering. Wu Gang and Zhou Wei responded enthusiastically.
location: Home, balcony

name: Bedtime family time: remind the children to wash up and read, chat and get ready
description: After the call, he urged his two sons to brush their teeth and wash their faces, and he himself took a quick shower. Then he sat by the children's beds and read two bedtime stories until they fell asleep. After the children were asleep, he chatted with his wife on the living room sofa while shelling walnuts. His wife brought out a drawing Hanhan had made, on which was written "Dad," and Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside. Then he went to get hot water to prepare for foot soaking.
location: Home, bathroom, bedroom, living room

name: Bedtime routine and going to bed
description: While soaking his feet in hot water in the master bedroom, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone, closed his eyes, and savored the old photos from his class group chat. He thought of the days playing basketball together in middle school, and the corners of his mouth curled into a smile. He decided to take the two kids back to his parents' house on the weekend to look at old photos. After soaking, he dried his feet and got into bed. His wife was already asleep. Lu Mingqiang turned over gently, felt his waist light and relaxed, and in a happy mood, soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run at Wanlv Park and the marathon promise.
description: At first light, it was cloudy and windless. He rode an electric bike to Evergreen Park and started his morning run. After completing 2 kilometers, he met his friend Chen Bin, who was also out for a run. The two jogged side by side at a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. Chen Bin excitedly said he had signed up for the Wanning Half Marathon in December and urged me to join too. Because I had to prepare for the senior technician certificate exam in November and couldn't spare the time, I declined, but promised to run a half marathon with him in the first half of next year. The two high-fived to seal the agreement, then ran side by side for another 3 kilometers, chatting about recent training experiences.
location: Greenway in Evergreen Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home to take a shower, have breakfast, and weigh in.
description: When I got home, my wife Wang Lijuan was busy preparing breakfast. I stretched briefly on the balcony and weighed myself: 71.4 kg, very stable. Took a warm shower and changed into clean blue work clothes. Breakfast was a large bowl of Hainan rice noodles with pickled vegetables, peanuts, and chili, which left me feeling great. I checked my phone to confirm today's work schedule.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to work and the team morning meeting.
description: I rode my electric bike to work and arrived at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:10. After parking, I went to the tool room and got a multimeter and tool bag. At 7:20, the team held the morning meeting on time. Team Leader Zhang assigned tasks with the work order: Chen Jianguo and I were one group, first go to the food factory in the Hong Kong-Macao Industrial Zone to repair the tripped distribution cabinet, then report back after finishing; in the afternoon, go to the newly opened barbershop on Haixiu Middle Road to install a three-phase electric water heater. I nodded in agreement, and had a clear idea of what to do.
location: Company in Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Depart and arrive at the fault site.
description: After the morning meeting, I checked the tool kit with Jianguo, confirming that the megohmmeter, wrenches, screwdrivers, and spare contactors and heating tubes were all complete. The two of us drove the company's engineering pickup truck along Binhai Avenue toward the Hong Kong-Macau Industrial Zone. On the way, Jianguo talked about taking his grandson to the park last night, and I said with a smile, "Your little guy was a grasshopper in his last life, hopping around energetically enough." At 8:15, we arrived at the gate of Hainan Kangmei Food Co., Ltd. The guard confirmed our identities and let us in, and we drove directly to the electrical distribution room next to the production workshop.
location: Power Distribution Room, Hainan Kangmei Food Co., Ltd., No. 21 Gang'ao Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Troubleshoot and repair the power distribution cabinet fault
description: The factory manager came up anxiously and said the production line had been stopped for more than an hour. Jianguo and I opened the distribution cabinet door, and a burnt smell hit us in the face. Using a megohmmeter, we measured the main circuit and heating tubes in sections, and quickly identified that a 380V heating tube had a short circuit to ground, which burned the contacts of the main contactor. We divided the work clearly: I disconnected the upstream power supply and hung up a 'Do Not Close' tag, while Jianguo disassembled the burnt parts. We deftly replaced the heating tube and contactor, and retightened all the screws on the terminal block. At 10:30, the installation was complete, and the insulation resistance test passed again. At 10:45, we closed the switch and restored power, and the production line resumed operation. The manager shook my hand firmly and thanked me repeatedly.
location: Power Distribution Room, Hainan Kangmei Food Co., Ltd., No. 21 Gang'ao Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tidy up the site and enjoy lunch in the cafeteria.
description: Jianguo and I packed up our tools and wiped our hands. The person in charge warmly invited us to the factory canteen for a work meal. We didn't decline. At the canteen, we ordered two boxed lunches, each with two meat dishes and one vegetable dish, and sat down by the window. As we ate, we chatted about the fault point. I took a bite of food and said, “You see, if we knew PLC this time, we might be able to check the control circuit directly and do it faster.” I took out my phone and, while eating, opened the electrician forum. I read two featured posts about getting started with PLC and became so absorbed that I felt I really should study it systematically.
location: Canteen of Hainan Kangmei Food Co., Ltd., No. 21 Gang'ao Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company and take a lunch break
description: It was almost noon when I returned to the company. I put the tools back in place and rinsed off briefly with water. Then I went into the break room and lay down on my folding bed. I set a 20-minute alarm, closed my eyes, went over the afternoon's water heater installation steps, and silently planned to meet up with my old classmate Wu Gang after work. When the alarm rang, I immediately got up, washed my face, and felt refreshed.
location: Company rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Install a water heater for the barbershop
description: I brought the special tools and materials needed for installing the three-phase electric water heater, rode my e-bike, and followed the navigation to this new shop called 'Trend Cut' on Haixiu Middle Road. The owner was a young man in his early thirties and warmly welcomed me in. In the designated bathroom, I checked the reserved water supply point and power cord. After confirming the specifications were correct, I began the installation skillfully: drilling holes, mounting the unit, connecting pipes, and wiring. Every step was meticulous. An hour later, the water heater was firmly on the wall; I powered it on for a test and it worked normally. The owner was very satisfied and insisted on giving me two trial vouchers for the shop's wash, cut, and blow-dry services, saying with a smile, 'Master, you're really skilled. Bring your family for a haircut sometime!' I thanked him and accepted, thinking I would bring my two sons for haircuts on the weekend.
location: Chaojian Hair Salon, Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned to the company to report completion and made an online invitation.
description: Riding back to the company, he first went to Team Leader Zhang and verbally reported that the installation task was completed. Back at his workstation, he took out the work logbook he planned to sort out in the afternoon, then pulled out his phone and sent a WeChat message to his old classmate Wu Gang: “Gangzi, are you free tonight? Same place, Laobacha at Qunshang Village—should I call a Didi? See you at seven, let's chat.” A few minutes later, Wu Gang replied, “OK.” He smiled, put down his phone, and focused on his work.
location: Office in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Filling out work orders, organizing notes, and reviewing the day
description: I took out the morning's maintenance work order and record book and carefully filled in the fault phenomenon, analysis process, handling method, and the model numbers of replaced parts. Then I opened my notebook and recorded the key points from this fault handling experience, especially the megohmmeter reading characteristics when a heating element is short-circuited to ground. After that, I reviewed the common spare parts list for the shift team and found that the stock of three-phase contactors was running low, so I posted a reminder in the team's work group. During a break, I picked up my phone again, read the PLC learning post I had saved at noon several times carefully, and searched the forum for several online courses with good reviews.
location: Office in the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the younger son from school and handle small family matters.
description: At 4:30, I left work on time and rode my electric bike to Jinmao Center Kindergarten first. My youngest son, Lu Zihan, was already waiting at the gate with his backpack. When he saw his dad coming, he ran over happily. I lifted him onto the back seat of the electric bike and rode home with him. Passing by Xiangzhi General Store at No. 19 Yusha Road, I stopped and bought Hanhan a bottle of his favorite probiotic yogurt, and also picked up a pack of shoe-cleaning sponges for myself.
location: From Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, to Xiangzhi Department Store and General Merchandise Store, No. 19 Yusha Road.

name: Arriving home, dinner, and family communication
description: When I got home, my wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up my eldest son Lu Zixuan from the after-school care center. Juanzi and I were busy in the kitchen together; I helped peel garlic and trim vegetables. Dinner was warm and cozy: a plate of boiled shrimp, a plate of stir-fried choy sum, and a pot of hot tomato and egg soup. The whole family sat around the table. I chatted with Juanzi about today's work: "That job at the food factory — the heating tube was broken again, Jianguo and I fixed it in no time." Juanzi then said the community is offering a free maternity matron training class next month; she wants to go and listen, check the market, and see if she can take on more work in the future. I was very supportive: "That's a good thing. Learning a skill opens more doors." After dinner, I accompanied Hanhan in building a small house with building blocks, while Xuanxuan watched cartoons nearby.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring his eldest son in schoolwork
description: I asked my eldest son Lu Zixuan to take out yesterday's math unit test. The score of 88 made me very pleased. After carefully checking the wrong answers, I found that he could now basically solve the approximation equations and word problems he had repeatedly gotten wrong before. I took out a red pen and worked through the last two problems that had lost points due to carelessness together with my son, and had him copy them into his mistake notebook. Xuanxuan did it carefully. I patted him on the shoulder and said, 'Not bad, you've improved! When the weekend comes, Dad will take you and your little brother to get cool haircuts.'
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Met old friends at Qunshang Village Dad's Tea Shop
description: I greeted my wife and walked seven or eight minutes to that Laobacha tea shop in Qunshang Village, full of the warmth of daily life. My old classmate Wu Gang had already saved a corner seat, with two cups of iced drip coffee and two bowls of qingbuliang on the table. I ordered a plate of peanuts and a baked flatbread. I got straight to the point, laying out my plan to open a repair workshop, look for a storefront, and obtain a senior technician certificate. Wu Gang is a down-to-earth guy; he nodded as he listened, then slapped the table and said, 'Brother Qiang, with your skills, it would be a waste not to open a shop! Don't worry, once it opens, I'll help you advertise in our big community groups. The property manager of the community opposite my place is like a brother to me; I'll introduce you when the time comes!' The two of us hit it off more and more, chatting from business ideas to children's education, and before we knew it, the tea had been refilled twice.
location: Dad tea shop at the street corner of Qunshang Village, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, take a shower, and chat with family.
description: It was almost 9 o'clock when I got home. I took a shower first, washing away the smell of tea. After changing into loose loungewear, I boiled a pot of hot water and set it aside to cool. My wife Wang Lijuan hadn't gone to sleep yet; she was scrolling through her phone on the living room sofa. I sat down next to her and recounted my conversation with Wu Gang, especially mentioning that Wu Gang was willing to help introduce clients. Wang Lijuan smiled and said, "Gangzi is reliable; he will take your matter to heart." The two of us chatted a bit more about household expenses and the children's recent situation, feeling that although life is plain, there is hope.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Foot soaking and pre-sleep planning
description: I started soaking my feet. Out of habit, I opened the notes app on my phone and wrote down tonight's reflection: "Maintaining good relations with property management is the key to future long-term clients." I also browsed the PLC section of the electrician forum and bookmarked those high-quality posts. Then I briefly planned tomorrow's work and recorded it in the phone notes: "Tomorrow morning, go to the company to finish assembling the distribution box; in the afternoon, I may go to a residential community to handle a tripping complaint."
location: Bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Going to bed and falling asleep
description: At 10:10 PM, I turned off the living room light and checked the doors and windows. Back in the bedroom, I lay in bed and ran through the day's events in my mind like a movie: the agreement with Chen Bin in the morning, fixing the food factory fault in the late morning, installing the water heater in the afternoon, and having a good chat with Wu Gang about the studio in the evening. Every one of these made me feel reassured. I set my phone alarm and put it on the bedside table. At 10:50 PM, I closed my eyes on schedule and soon fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning run.
description: The alarm went off at 5:50 a.m. After getting up and washing up, Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and sportswear, and at 6:05 a.m. rode his e-bike to Evergreen Park. After warming up, he started his morning run along the seaside track, aiming for 8 kilometers and controlling the pace at about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After finishing the run, he felt his cardiorespiratory function had improved compared with the previous few days. After stretching, he took a photo of the morning scenery at Evergreen Park and sent it to his running friend Chen Bin, inviting him to join a half marathon together next year.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went home, washed up, and had breakfast
description: After the morning run, he rode back to his home in Banshan Garden and took a cold shower. His wife, Wang Lijuan, had already prepared a breakfast of Hainan rice noodles with peanuts, pickled vegetables, and dried beef. While eating, Lu Mingqiang weighed himself, showing 71.3 kilograms, stable. After eating, he changed into the newly issued denim work uniform from the company, and his wife praised him for looking sharp.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drop the children off at school and head to the office.
description: At 7:15, rode the e-bike and took his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, telling the boy to behave on the way. At the kindergarten gate, Hanhan waved and ran into the campus. Then Lu Mingqiang turned from Guomao Road onto Haisheng Road and arrived at the company in Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:40.
location: From Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Horizontal Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift preparation and pre-shift briefing
description: After arriving at work, he carefully checked the insulating gloves, safety helmet, multimeter, and tool bag needed for the day in the team's tool room and confirmed everything was complete. At 8 o'clock, he attended the team meeting on time. Squad leader Zhang assigned tasks: go to People's Park with Zhao Qiang in the morning to repair two faulty streetlights, and return to the warehouse in the afternoon to sort out old cables. Lu Mingqiang noted down the key safety points in his notebook after receiving the tasks.
location: Team tool room and meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Streetlight maintenance and on-site teaching.
description: At 8:20, Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang in the company pickup truck to People's Park and found the faulty streetlight on the lakeside path. After setting up warning signs and barricades, Lu Mingqiang put on a safety harness and climbed into the aerial work platform, while Zhao Qiang assisted from the ground. Using a multimeter, they found the ballast had burned out. As he replaced it, Lu Mingqiang explained the fault diagnosis logic: if no voltage is measured at the input, it's a wiring problem; if there is voltage but the light doesn't turn on, it's most likely a damaged ballast. He also reminded Zhao Qiang of the correct way to fasten the safety rope when working at height. Zhao Qiang recorded the process with his phone. At 11:20, both streetlights were repaired and lit up.
location: Lakeside trail, Haikou People's Park, No. 3 Gongyuan Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Talked to his wife on the way back.
description: After finishing work and packing up tools, the two drove back to the company. On the way, Lu Mingqiang called his wife Wang Lijuan through the car's Bluetooth and asked about the younger son's performance at kindergarten. His wife smiled and said the teacher praised Hanhan for putting on his own shoes today. Lu Mingqiang was happy and promised to bring the son something delicious when he returned in the evening.
location: On the way from Haikou People's Park back to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park

name: Lunch break
description: After returning to the area near the company, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang walked together to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant for lunch. He ordered a serving of spicy soup rice with a fried egg; the broth was sour and spicy, whetting the appetite. During the meal, he chatted with Chen Jianguo about the streetlight repair experience that morning. Chen Jianguo teased that he had a special way with apprentices. Lu Mingqiang smiled and replied that he had learned it all from veteran masters, and that steady practice was enough to do well.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break at the workstation.
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang returned to his workstation at 12:48. He covered his face with his jacket, lay facedown on the desk, and napped for 20 minutes, reviewing in his mind the morning's streetlight repair steps and the key points he had taught Zhao Qiang. At 13:00, his phone alarm rang. He woke up on time, washed his face with cold water, and felt refreshed.
location: Workstation at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Warehouse organizing work
description: In the afternoon there were no outside tasks, so Team Leader Zhang organized everyone to sort old cables in the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and other workers classified and bundled the cables by cross-section size, dismantled scrap copper wire, and bagged it to be sent to the recycling station. When lifting heavy items, Lu Mingqiang consciously tightened his core muscles and kept his back straight. Chen Jianguo joked that he looked like he was practicing qigong. Lu Mingqiang laughed and said it was a waist-protection method he learned from playing squash, and it was very effective. Everyone worked and chatted.
location: Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying groceries after work
description: At 16:30, Lu Mingqiang left work on time, changed out of his work clothes into casual clothes, and rode his e-bike to the convenience stall area on Yusha Road. He first went to the nearby Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store to buy a bottle of yogurt for his younger son Lu Zihan. Then he bought the garlic and ginger his wife had asked for at the stall area, and at the seafood stall he selected a fresh tilapia and asked the stall owner to clean and dress it. In less than half an hour, he had bought all the ingredients for grilled fish.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Xiangzhi Grocery and Daily Necessities Store, Chengzhongcheng Residential Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Yusha Convenience Stall Area.

name: Family dinner and homework help
description: When he got home at 5:20 p.m., his wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up their older son Lu Zixuan and younger son Lu Zihan. Lu Mingqiang changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen, where his wife had prepared side dishes such as potatoes, onions, and celery. Lu Mingqiang cleaned the tilapia, scored it, marinated it with salt, cooking wine, and ginger slices, prepared a sauce, and put it in the oven. At exactly 6:00 p.m., the roasted fish came out. Served with the garlicky water spinach his wife had stir-fried, the family of four sat around the table for dinner. At dinner, Xuanxuan talked about interesting things at school, and Hanhan danced around performing a nursery rhyme he had just learned. After dinner, his wife cleared the table, and Lu Mingqiang helped Xuanxuan with his math homework. For a word problem about "understanding multiples," he explained it twice using fruit and building blocks, and Xuanxuan finally got it.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time
description: After helping with homework, Lu Mingqiang played with building blocks with his younger son Hanhan on the living room carpet. Hanhan wanted to build a big castle, and Lu Mingqiang handed him blocks and taught him how to make it sturdier. The older son Xuanxuan sat on the sofa nearby, reading One Hundred Thousand Whys with great interest.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Self-studying relay protection in the study
description: At 19:50, Lu Mingqiang let the two children play by themselves, went into the study, and took out Master Li's notebook and the textbook Principles of Relay Protection. He focused on the chapter "Relay Protection Setting Calculation." For the time coordination formula of "three-stage current protection," which had always been a bit fuzzy to him, he compared the schematic diagrams in the notes with the textbook examples and worked through the calculations three times, finally clarifying the logical relationship. He had laid a foundation for the certification training course starting next Monday, and felt very pleased.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation
description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang stood up and stretched, then took a shower. Afterwards, he soaked his feet in hot water while browsing an electrician forum on his phone. He saw a new post about power distribution renovation in old residential communities and replied to a few follow-up comments. After soaking his feet, he closed his eyes and leaned back in the chair, replaying the whole day in his mind like a movie, from the morning jog to finally understanding the formula, and felt his life was full and solid.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and communication.
description: Lu Mingqiang set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning and folded the work clothes he would wear the next day, placing them by the bed. He remembered the certification training next Monday and wrote in his phone memo: "Take leave on Monday afternoon to attend the relay protection class." His wife Wang Lijuan was already lying down. Lu Mingqiang softly told her that today he had figured out a formula that had troubled him for a long time and felt very relieved. His wife smiled and told him to go to sleep quickly.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: At exactly 22:00, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone and lay down. He turned to look at his wife sleeping beside him and felt calm and at peace. With steady breathing, he fell asleep around 22:50, ending an ordinary but fulfilling day.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Early morning preparation and vehicle inspection.
description: At 5:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally. After washing up quietly, he changed into an old T-shirt and sweatpants. At 6:00, he took his car keys and a flashlight to the underground garage, carefully checked the tire pressure and appearance, opened the hood and checked the engine oil, coolant, and windshield washer fluid to make sure everything was normal. Then he loaded into the car in batches the suitcase, backpack, child safety seat, and a storage bin filled with snacks, bottled water, and a kite that his wife Wang Lijuan had packed the night before. At 6:45, he returned to the door, ready to push it open and enter.
location: Underground garage and entrance of Banshan Huayuan Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Waking up the family and preparing breakfast
description: After pushing open the door and entering the house, Lu Mingqiang first went to check on his two sons and tucked the quilt back in for his younger son Hanhan. Then he went to the master bedroom and gently woke his wife Wang Lijuan. He went into the kitchen alone and got busy. He took thawed Hainan rice noodles, lean pork, and pickled cabbage out of the refrigerator. At 7:00, the two sons woke up, and Juanzi took them to wash up. Lu Mingqiang quickly heated oil in a wok, stir-fried the pickled cabbage and lean pork until fragrant, added broth and brought it to a boil, then put in the rice noodles and sprinkled on chopped scallions and peanuts. The family of four sat at the table eating steaming hot Hainan rice noodle soup. Lu Mingqiang told his sons to listen to their mother on the way, and Xuanxuan nodded eagerly.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Final check and group photo before departure
description: After breakfast, Wang Lijuan checked everyone's small backpack. Lu Mingqiang crouched by the door and stuffed power banks, sunscreen, mosquito repellent, band-aids, tissues, and hats into the side pockets of the couple's backpacks. Before leaving, he had the family of four stand by the shoe cabinet at the door and took a group selfie with his phone. In the photo, everyone was smiling happily, with the wall covered with the children's drawings as the background. Lu Mingqiang said, "Okay, let's go! First stop, Wenchang!"
location: Entrance foyer of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Self-driving to Wenchang and taking a rest at Longqiao Service Area
description: At exactly 8:00, Lu Mingqiang started the family car and drove steadily out of the residential compound. After getting on the expressway, he kept a speed of 100 km/h. His elder son, Xuanxuan, leaned against the window counting wind turbines in the distance, while his younger son, Hanhan, fell asleep in his car seat shortly after getting in. Juanzi played old songs on a small speaker, and Lu Mingqiang hummed along cheerfully. They arrived at Longqiao Service Area at 8:30. After parking, they went to the restroom, and he bought four fresh young coconuts at a fruit stand and asked the vendor to open them. The family of four stood by the car drinking coconut water to quench their thirst. After a quick check of the car, Lu Mingqiang continued on the road at 8:45.
location: Longqiao Service Area, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Driving to Longlou Town and taking a brief rest on the street
description: Departed from Longqiao Service Area at 8:45, exited the expressway via the Wenchang Interchange, and drove along a straight road toward Longlou Town, with farmland gradually giving way to small-town streets. At 9:45, Lu Mingqiang stopped at a mobile fruit stand at the town entrance with a sign reading "Local Jackfruit and Wax Apples" and had Juanzi take Xuanxuan out to pick a bunch of red bananas and two wax apples. The children cheered happily in the car. After paying, they got back on the road at 9:50 and arrived at the Tongguling Scenic Area parking lot at 10:10.
location: Mobile fruit stall on Xinxing Street, Longlou Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Hiking and watching the sea at Tongguling Nature Reserve
description: After parking at 10:10, Lu Mingqiang bought family tickets (70 yuan in total), put on his backpack, and started climbing up from the hiking trail. The vegetation along the way was dense and the air was fresh. He carried Hanhan up most of the steps, while Juanzi held Xuanxuan's hand. At 11:00 they arrived at the Lanyue Terrace viewing platform, with a panoramic view of Moon Bay's curved coastline and the blue sea. Lu Mingqiang put Hanhan down, lifted Xuanxuan high to let him see the sea, and Xuanxuan shouted excitedly. A tourist took a family photo for the four of them in front of the big stone inscribed with “Tongguling”. At the top of the mountain, they bought four bottles of mineral water and a bowl of qingbuliang to share. At 12:00 they began to slowly descend.
location: Tongguling National Nature Reserve, Wentong West Road, Longlou Town, Wenchang, Hainan

name: Lunch in Longlou Town
description: After coming down the mountain, drove 5 minutes to Xinxing Street in Longlou Town, and at 12:15 parked at a bustling snack shop. Lu Mingqiang ordered a portion of Wenchang chicken rice, a portion of fried noodles, a bowl of conch soup, and a few barbecue skewers. The children ate happily. While removing chicken bones for Hanhan, he discussed with Juanzi going to Stone Park to catch seafood in the afternoon. The lunch was simple and affordable, costing less than 80 yuan.
location: A snack shop near Guming (Wenchang Longlou Town Store) on Xinxing Street, Longlou Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Beachcombing for shells at Stone Park
description: At 13:15, they drove 5 minutes to Stone Park. After low tide, the rocky area was exposed. Lu Mingqiang rolled up his trouser legs and first explored the shallow water area, then called the family to go into the sea. He took Xuanxuan to look for small crabs and hermit crabs in the shallow puddles, while Juanzi accompanied Hanhan on the beach collecting white coral stones and shells. Xuanxuan dug up a hermit crab about half the size of a palm with his small shovel and excitedly held it up for the family to see. At 14:15, Lu Mingqiang called everyone ashore.
location: Stone Park, Longlou Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province.

name: Drove to the hotel and checked in.
description: At 14:30, left Stone Park, and Lu Mingqiang navigated directly to Wenchang Coconut Grove Seaview Hotel. He arrived at the hotel at 15:00, parked, and checked in at the front desk, paying 600 yuan as a prepaid room fee. The room was on the 3rd floor facing south, with a view of the sea in the distance. After entering the room, the children jumped on the bed, and Lu Mingqiang took out the water bottles and made them drink water.
location: Wenchang Coconut Grove Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang, Hainan Province

name: Hotel rest and balcony relaxation
description: At 15:45, the children were tired from playing, and Wang Lijuan took them for a short rest on the bed. Lu Mingqiang brewed a cup of hotel instant coffee, sat on the balcony, opened the electrician forum on his phone, read technical posts about smart circuit breakers for half an hour, and noted in his memo the plan to visit Dongjiao Coconut Grove and the mangrove forest tomorrow. At 16:30 he gently woke the family and got ready to go to the swimming pool.
location: Hainan Province, Wenchang City, Dongjiao Town, No. 8 Yelin Road, Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, 3rd floor guest room balcony.

name: Family time at the hotel swimming pool.
description: At 16:30, Lu Mingqiang changed his two sons into swim trunks and took them to the children's wading pool downstairs at the hotel. Hanhan wore a swim ring while Lu Mingqiang supported his back from behind as he paddled slowly; Xuanxuan had a water gun and had a water fight with him. Wang Lijuan sat on a lounger by the pool, drinking coconut juice and watching them with a smile. At 17:00, the children were tired from playing, and Lu Mingqiang took them back to the room to rinse off and change clothes.
location: Garden and swimming pool area, Wenchang Coconut Grove Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Walk around the hotel and take a break
description: After changing clothes at 17:30, Lu Mingqiang pushed the stroller borrowed from the hotel. Hanhan sat inside, while Xuanxuan hopped alongside. Behind the hotel was a large coconut grove, with bougainvillea on both sides of the path. The father and his two sons strolled along the seaside trail, the sea breeze brushing their faces. Lu Mingqiang pointed to a tall coconut tree and explained to his sons how coconuts grow. At the gate of a farmhouse courtyard, he bought another large green coconut for Hanhan to hold and drink. At 18:00, they slowly walked back to the hotel. He dried the shells and coral stones he had picked up today and put them on the windowsill.
location: Coconut groves around Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner at the hotel restaurant
description: At 18:15, the family of four went to the Chinese restaurant on the second floor. Lu Mingqiang ordered a Wenchang white-cut chicken, a plate of stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, a sea snail and winter melon soup, and a glass of freshly squeezed coconut juice for each child. After the dishes arrived, he raised his teacup to toast Wang Lijuan and thanked her for taking care of the family, and encouraged his sons by saying that this was the first stop of their round-island trip and that he would take them all over Hainan Island in the future. During the meal, he also told the children the story of the Wenchang Space Launch Center.
location: Chinese Restaurant, 2nd Floor, Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang, Hainan Province

name: Flying a kite on the hotel's private beach
description: After dinner, the sea breeze was just right. Lu Mingqiang took a traditional butterfly kite out of the trunk and led his two sons to the beach behind the hotel. He taught Xuanxuan to run against the wind and let out the line. The kite swayed and rose in the evening breeze. Although it didn't fly high, Xuanxuan was so happy that he ran wildly all over the beach, with Hanhan chasing behind his older brother. Wang Lijuan sat in a beach chair recording with her phone. They played until the sky grew dark, and only then did Lu Mingqiang reel in the kite and take the children back to the room.
location: Private beach area of Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and organizing family photos
description: Back in the room, Lu Mingqiang bathed his two sons and changed them into pajamas, and coaxed Hanhan to drink half a glass of warm water. While Wang Lijuan was taking a shower, he transferred the photos on his phone to the tablet and looked through them with Xuanxuan. Xuanxuan pointed at a photo of a hermit crab they'd caught and asked if they could go again the next day. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said there were even better beaches ahead. At 21:00 Juanzi finished showering, and he urged the two sons to go to bed.
location: Guest room on the 3rd floor, Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Soaking feet to relax and planning tomorrow's itinerary
description: After the children fell asleep at 21:30, Lu Mingqiang took out the foldable foot bath bucket he had brought from home, filled it with hot water, sprinkled in mugwort packets, and sat on the balcony soaking his feet. Wang Lijuan moved a chair over and sat beside him, and the two chatted softly. Lu Mingqiang mentioned that tomorrow they could go to Dongjiao Coconut Grove and try coconut milk chicken. Juanzi added that, according to the travel guide, the nearby mangrove forest offered boating. The two watched the distant lights of fishing boats and enjoyed their time alone together. Lu Mingqiang noted down the alternative destinations in his phone memo app. At 22:30, he poured out the foot bath water and urged Juanzi to get some rest early.
location: Balcony and bathroom of a guest room on the 3rd floor of Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep inspection and falling asleep peacefully
description: At 22:45, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone and put it on the nightstand, got up to check the door lock and the location of tomorrow's breakfast vouchers, and tucked the blanket corners around his two sleeping sons. Back in bed, he whispered goodnight to Wang Lijuan and turned off the bedside lamp. At 23:00, listening to the waves outside the window and the children's even breathing, he felt grounded and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the guest room on the 3rd floor of Wenchang Yelin Seaview Hotel, No. 8 Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Morning jog, buying breakfast, and returning to the guesthouse.
description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove from his guesthouse in Longlou Town, Wenchang, to the Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area. He jogged about 5 kilometers along the coastline on Yelin Bay Road, enjoying the sea breeze and coconut trees. After the run, he bought three portions of shredded coconut cakes at a stall by the scenic area entrance, then drove back to Longlou Town, buying four cups of freshly squeezed coconut milk on the way. Back at the guesthouse, he parked, greeted the owner on duty, and returned to his room.
location: No. 33 Yelin Bay Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province, Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area; Wenchang Mengyue Homestay, Longhai Road, Longlou Town

name: The whole family gets up, washes up, and has breakfast
description: Lu Mingqiang brought breakfast back to the homestay room and woke up his wife Wang Lijuan and their two children, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. The family of four enjoyed coconut shred cakes and coconut milk for breakfast on the homestay balcony, savoring the fresh morning air. The children were very happy.
location: Wenchang Mengyue Homestay, Longhai Road, Longlou Town, Wenchang, Hainan Province

name: Check out and shop at Longlou Town market.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang packed his luggage and checked out, then led his family on foot to the nearby Longlou Market. At the market, Wang Lijuan chose handmade coconut cakes, and Lu Mingqiang bought two jin of dried shrimp to bring to his parents. The two children were fascinated by the small conch shells and each bought one as a souvenir.
location: Longlou Market, Longlou Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Drove to the Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area
description: After shopping, the family loaded the luggage into the car. Lu Mingqiang drove along the county road toward the Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area. Coconut palms lined the road and the scent of the sea grew stronger; the children excitedly watched the scenery outside the window.
location: County road from Longlou Town to Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province

name: Visited Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area.
description: After arriving at the Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area, the family strolled through the grove, admiring the tall coconut trees. Lu Mingqiang explained to his sons how coconuts grow. The elder son tried to climb a tree and was stopped in time to ensure safety, while the younger son picked up coconut shells to play with. Wang Lijuan took photos with her phone to remember the occasion and shared them in the family group chat.
location: Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area, No. 33 Yelinwan Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang, Hainan Province

name: Lunch: sampling Wenchang specialties
description: After the tour, the family went to Grandma Coconut Restaurant near the scenic area for a meal. Lu Mingqiang ordered the signature coconut boat rice, Wenchang white-cut chicken, and stir-fried winged beans. The children especially liked the coconut rice and even ate quite a bit of the vegetables they usually disliked. Wang Lijuan praised the chicken as authentic. The meal cost 128 yuan and felt well worth it.
location: Apo Coconut Restaurant, Yelin Road, Dongjiao Town, Wenchang City, Hainan Province.

name: Drove back to Haikou
description: After lunch, the family set off on the return trip. Lu Mingqiang drove along the Haiwen Expressway toward Haikou, keeping the speed at about 100 km/h. On the way, the two children played with toys in the back seat and then fell asleep, and Wang Lijuan also dozed off. Lu Mingqiang stayed focused on driving the whole way to ensure safety.
location: Hainan Province Haiwen Expressway (Wenchang to Haikou direction) section

name: Rest at the service area.
description: After driving for about an hour, Lu Mingqiang pulled into the Meirenpo Service Area on the Haiwen Expressway to avoid fatigue driving and to meet the family's needs. He got hot water at the convenience store, used the restroom, and stretched his body, and checked the car's tires and dashboard. Wang Lijuan also woke up, washed her face, and refreshed herself. After resting for 15 minutes, they set off again.
location: Meirenpo Service Area, Haiwen Expressway, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Arrived home safely and sorted out luggage
description: At 3:10 p.m., the vehicle arrived safely at home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City. Lu Mingqiang woke the sleeping children, and the family carried luggage, local specialties, and other items upstairs. Lu Mingqiang sorted the dirty clothes and put them into the washing machine, Wang Lijuan organized the purchased items, and the children eagerly started playing with the newly bought small conch horn.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Record travel expenses and insights.
description: Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa and used his phone's memo app to record the detailed expenses of this trip to Wenchang (about 800 yuan for gas, accommodation, meals, etc.) and travel reflections. He commented that spots like Tongguling and Stone Park were unforgettable, and looked forward to next year's trip to Boao, Qionghai, checking the map to plan a route.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Check the eldest son's weekend homework.
description: Lu Mingqiang called his eldest son Lu Zixuan into the living room to check his weekend math homework. Finding one multiplication word problem left blank, he used oranges as props to patiently explain the concept of multiplication, guiding his son to write the equation and complete the variant problem. After Lu Zixuan solved it successfully, Lu Mingqiang praised him.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepared a simple dinner of plain congee and side dishes.
description: Wang Lijuan was preparing dinner in the kitchen, with Lu Mingqiang assisting. They used the baby bok choy and pumpkin from the fridge to simmer a pot of white porridge, and made side dishes such as garlic baby bok choy and pickled radish. The children ran into the kitchen when they smelled the porridge, and the family looked forward to a light dinner.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the table enjoying plain congee with simple dishes to ease the greasiness from the trip. The younger son Lu Zihan finished a bowl and took another half bowl. Lu Mingqiang asked the children if they wanted to travel somewhere farther next time, and they nodded excitedly. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Walking around the neighborhood and chatting with neighbors.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took his two sons for a walk around the residential community to help them digest, and the children chased each other around. At the central garden, they met their neighbor Uncle Wang, who was walking his dog. Lu Mingqiang shared funny stories from the Wenchang trip with Uncle Wang, such as the magnificent Tongguling and their time beachcombing at Stone Park. After chatting for over ten minutes, they continued their walk.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Supervising the children washing up and going to bed
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang urged the two children to brush their teeth and wash their faces. The older son did it on his own, while the younger son needed help. Lu Mingqiang put toothpaste on the brush for him and wiped his face and feet with a warm towel. Then he put the children to bed, tucked them in, dimmed the lights, and told them to go to sleep quietly.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal relaxation and study
description: After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang brewed a cup of tea in the living room, browsed local news and an electrical technology forum on his phone, and bookmarked a useful post about 'three-stage current protection setting calculation' in preparation for the next day's training class. Wang Lijuan sat nearby watching TV, enjoying a moment of quiet.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Soaking his feet to relax and chatting with his wife.
description: Lu Mingqiang ran hot water to soak his feet and sat with Wang Lijuan to chat. They discussed the reactions to Wang Lijuan's travel photos on WeChat Moments, planned a farther family trip in the future, and discussed whether to sign up their eldest son for a weekend math tutoring class. At the same time, Lu Mingqiang set an alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning on his phone.
