Then he silently planned the next day's work and study priorities: if he had time, he would go to the hardware store to buy two new screwdriver bits, and in the evening he could review the grounding wire section learned today.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at the Banshan Garden home, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to bed on time
description: At 22:00, Lu Qiang turned off his phone on time. Lying in bed, images of his son's excited smile when launching the water rocket and the work tasks successfully completed that day flashed through his mind, filling him with pride and fulfillment. He closed his eyes and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After waking up naturally, he weighed himself on the digital scale in the bedroom, which showed 71.2 kg. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up and shave, and changed into his blue-gray Hainan Electric Power work uniform to get ready for the day's work.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Family breakfast.
description: Had breakfast with family; his wife prepared lean pork congee, fried eggs, and homemade pickled vegetables. At the table, he reminded his elder son to bring his science class materials and urged his younger son to eat faster. He quickly finished two bowls of congee and a fried egg.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take the younger son to kindergarten.
description: Rode an electric bike with my younger son to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. At the gate, I helped him straighten his backpack and water bottle, told him to wait for Dad to pick him up after school, and left only after watching him walk through the gate.
location: Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Commute and tool inspection
description: Riding an electric bike from the kindergarten to the company, he traveled along Haisheng Road for about ten minutes and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. After entering the changing room in the warehouse area and putting on insulating shoes, he carefully checked the tool bag needed for the day, including an electrician's knife, wire crimping pliers, insulating tape, a voltage tester, and a two-way radio. After confirming everything was complete, he placed it in the trunk of the work vehicle.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Team morning meeting and technical confirmation
description: Attended the morning meeting in the team meeting room. Team Leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks: to support the municipal road renovation project, relocate the cables of 12 streetlight poles on the RT-Mart section of Guoxing Avenue, and stressed that digging into other pipelines was strictly prohibited. He was designated as the on-site safety officer and technical advisor, rechecked the drawings, and marked key points in his notebook.
location: Team meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Heading to the construction site.
description: Took an engineering vehicle with Zhao Qiang and another worker to the construction section of Guoxing Avenue. On the way, confirmed by phone with the municipal on-site person in charge that the meeting point was the east side of the intersection of Guoxing Avenue and Xingdan Road.
location: Construction section near RT-Mart (Guoxing Store) on Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cable relocation operation
description: After arriving at the construction site, he reviewed the construction scope and cable routing drawings with the municipal official in charge, and directed Zhao Qiang to dig a test pit along the line marked on the drawings. Sweating profusely under the scorching sun, he determined the original cable route and marked the path with red spray paint. He personally performed the intermediate joint operation, which included stripping wires, crimping, filling, and wrapping insulating tape, while explaining the key points to Zhao Qiang. After finishing, he had Zhao Qiang test the insulation resistance with a megohmmeter. The data passed, and they finished half an hour earlier than expected.

participant.name: Person in charge of municipal works.

location: Inside the municipal construction fencing near RT-Mart (Guoxing Store), Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Project wrap-up and tool organization.
description: After completing the key work, organized everyone to backfill a small portion of the test pits, clean up scrap material ends on site, and put away all tools. Arranged for Zhao Qiang to record in the Construction Log: 2 cable intermediate joints, tests passed.
location: Construction site near RT-Mart (Guoxing Store) on Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and collection exchange.
description: He rode bikes with fellow workers Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and others to a nearby small restaurant and ordered spicy soup rice. During the meal, Chen Jianguo showed a photo of a Maotai Town liquor bottle with a unique glaze and remarked how rare it was. Lu Mingqiang then suggested going to the second-hand market on Bo’ai South Road together on the weekend to try their luck, and Chen Jianguo gladly agreed. After the meal, he sent his wife a WeChat message saying he would go home early in the afternoon.
location: Wu's Spicy Soup Rice, No. 13 Shuixiangkou, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: On-site wrap-up and record filling.
description: In the afternoon, he returned to the construction site. After checking the intermediate joint temperatures one by one and finding no abnormalities, he directed the excavator to backfill the test pit and level the road surface. Then he filled out the Work Record Card in the work truck, recording in detail the construction location, time, work content, cable model, number of joints, and personnel involved. At around 15:00, Team Leader Zhang called to confirm the work was complete and agreed to wrap up.
location: Construction section near RT-Mart (Guoxing Store) on Guoxing Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and inside the construction vehicle

name: Finished work early and bought groceries on the way home
description: He asked Zhao Qiang to drive the work truck back to the company while he rode his electric bike home. Passing by Daying Farmers' Market, he stopped to buy a bunch of water spinach and half a red-fleshed papaya, then rode back to his home in Banshan Garden.
location: Daying Farmers' Market, Daying Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family time: playing chess and gardening.
description: After arriving home, he played with blocks with his younger son and picked him up and spun him around. After the eldest son came home from school, the three of them played Gomoku together, and he taught them techniques for setting up formations and blocking the opponent. Then they went to the balcony to observe the growth of the cherry tomato seedlings, and he taught his sons to identify and remove the side shoots.
location: Living room and balcony of home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Assisting with dinner and supervising homework.
description: He tied on an apron and went into the kitchen to help his wife prepare dinner. He washed the water spinach and cut it into sections, and cut the papaya into chunks. He didn't forget to remind his elder son, who was doing homework in the living room, to sit up straight.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner included Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and steamed tilapia. The family sat around the table, sharing funny stories from the day's work and talking about the cable transfer process. The younger son curiously asked whether cables can bite, and everyone laughed. The wife kept adding food to everyone's bowls.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tidying up and putting things away after the meal
description: After the meal, helped his wife clear the dishes, wipe the table, and take out the trash. Put the toys and schoolbags in the living room back in their places, and set up the electronic scale to be used the next day in advance. His wife, meanwhile, went to prepare bathwater for the children.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Study advanced PLC knowledge
description: In the study, he opened the tablet and attended the online intensive course for senior electrician technician, studying "PLC Advanced Applications: Timers and Counters (T/C)". While listening, he drew ladder diagrams in his notebook and took notes. He encountered a complex case about combining timers and counters to achieve long delays that he did not fully understand, so he marked it with a red pen and wrote a note to ask Master Li this weekend. After the session, he felt a bit tired but fulfilled.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organizing the liquor bottle collection and sharing and exchanging online.
description: He spread a white cloth on the dining table and used a desk lamp for lighting. He took out three distinctive wine bottles: a blue-and-white porcelain bottle themed on Danzhou Tiaosheng, a sauce-flavor liquor bottle with Li ethnic totems, and an antique bronze-style wine vessel. He first washed and dried them, then photographed them from different angles. Afterward, in the Excel collection album on his computer, he entered the place of origin, acquisition date, and material characteristics of each bottle, along with a note about the photography. From more than 40 photos, he chose 9 and posted them to the "Qiong Island Wine Bottle Collectors" forum. The post soon received likes and replies. A forum friend from Danzhou really liked the Li totem bottle and offered to exchange it for his coconut-carved wine bottle. He gladly agreed and arranged to meet in person at Wanlv Garden on the weekend.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing foot soak before bed and going to sleep
description: His wife brought the foot-soaking bucket into the bedroom. As he soaked his feet to relax, he looked through his phone and checked the new replies on the forum. Seeing everyone's compliments on his collection, he felt content. He shared the matter of forum members exchanging liquor bottles with his wife, who was wearing a face mask. After soaking his feet, he washed up, turned off the light, lay in bed recalling the day's fulfilling experiences, and soon fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Early morning family time and taking the children to school
description: You woke up naturally in the early morning and saw from your phone that it was only 5:55. After getting up, you weighed 71.2 kg; your weight was stable, which was satisfying. After washing up, you changed into long-sleeved work clothes. Your wife had already prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and steamed sweet potato. As you ate, you reminded your younger son to behave in kindergarten, and your wife said she would pick him up in the afternoon. After breakfast, you rode your electric bike to take your younger son to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, and you only left after watching him run into the classroom.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten.

name: Commute and pre-shift preparation.
description: Riding an electric bike from the kindergarten, you turned from Jinmao Middle Road onto Haisheng Road and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park 15 minutes later. After parking, you changed into work clothes, checked tools one by one in the tool room, including a multimeter and voltage test pens, added a pair of spare insulating gloves, then filled your thermos with hot water and got ready for the end-of-month morning meeting.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: End-of-month safety summary meeting.
description: Team Leader Zhang presided over the month-end safety summary meeting, affirmed the team's performance this month, and specifically praised you by name for your thorough safety briefing and the lowest fault rate in last month's cable relocation on Guoxing Avenue. After the meeting, colleagues praised your energy, and you felt very pleased.
location: Conference Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Re-inspection of the commercial complex's power distribution room
description: You and Chen Jianguo went to the distribution room on the 6th floor of Friendship Sunshine City as planned for a recheck, testing the operating data of the capacitor cabinets and the temperature of the busbar joints point by point. Everything was normal. Chen Jianguo asked you for the secret to going to bed early and waking up early. You suggested he start by going to bed half an hour earlier each night. After finishing the work, the two rode back to the company.
location: Electrical distribution room, 6th floor, Friendship Sunshine City, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and midday leisure
description: After returning to the company, you first file the follow-up inspection records, then go to the Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant near the company for lunch. You order spicy soup rice with a fried egg and browse the Hainan Island Wine Bottle Collectors forum while eating. Seeing many new replies to last night's post puts you in a good mood. You reply to the forum friend who wanted to trade a coconut-carved wine bottle for a Li totem bottle, and the two of you agree to meet tomorrow afternoon at the flea market.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Systematically organized notes at noon.
description: In the staff break room, colleagues were resting or chatting. You took out the PLC and high-standard notebooks, sorted the key points from the past four days of online courses into a knowledge tree, and wrote a difficult point about the PLC timer separately on a sticky note to ask Master Li about it tomorrow afternoon. After finishing your notes, you felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Staff Rest Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon maintenance task
description: In the afternoon, you and Zhao Qiang went to an old residential building on Shimao East Road and a residential building on Guomao Road, replacing leakage switches for two households. At the first home, you patiently explained the cause of the tripping and operated skillfully. At the second, Zhao Qiang completed it independently under your guidance. After inspection, you reminded the residents to pay attention to electrical safety.
location: Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, at the homes of residents of Shimao East Road Community and Guomao Road Community in succession.

name: Finishing work early and handing over
description: The repair was completed ahead of schedule. You and Zhao Qiang cycled back to the company and just made it in time for the month-end inventory, so you could leave work an hour early. You quickly filled out the work record card, put the tools back in place, patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder to encourage him, and then packed up your personal belongings.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buying an Air Fryer and Going Home
description: After leaving work early, you drove to the Suning.com Wangfujing Haiken Plaza store on Haixiu Middle Road. On the way, you sent a WeChat message to your wife to confirm the specific model of the Philips air fryer. At the store, you found that off-white small-capacity air fryer, paid for it, picked it up, and left. On the way, you bought fresh grapes, then drove back home to Banshan Garden.
location: No. 71 Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Suning.com Wangfujing Haiken Plaza Store, and Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Parent-child interaction and preparing dinner
description: As soon as they entered, the two children curiously gathered around to look at the air fryer. You asked them to help unpack it. The older son grabbed the manual and started reading it, while the younger son couldn't put down the grill rack. You washed the grapes, and the whole family ate and discussed what dishes to make with the new pot tomorrow. Then you and your wife prepared dinner together. You helped wash and cut vegetables, and she put the marinated chicken wings and potato wedges into the frying basket and set the timer. The younger son brought a stool and stood on tiptoe to watch. With a “ding,” the garlic-flavored fried chicken wings and golden fries came out, fragrant and tempting.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and parent-child time after dinner.
description: Dinner was abundant: air-fried garlic chicken wings and baked fries from the air fryer, water spinach you stir-fried, and tomato egg soup made by your wife. The two children were full of praise for the air fryer dishes, and your wife also felt the money was well spent. After dinner, you cleared the table and your wife washed the dishes. Then you played with your two sons in the living room. The older son showed off his Lego spaceship, and the younger son wanted to play horsie; you got down on the floor on all fours, filling the living room with laughter.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and month-end summary
description: At 8 p.m., after the children went back to their rooms, you reviewed the high-voltage safety regulations in the study, wrote out key clauses from memory, and marked mistakes and omissions with a red pen. Then you opened the desk calendar and circled the date of the November senior technician practical pre-exam. After that, you went through all of this month's study notes and marked the PLC difficulties and high-voltage mistakes again. Looking at a month's worth of accumulation, you felt reassured, and in your phone memo you noted down tomorrow's plans to exchange wine bottles at the flea market and ask Master Li for advice.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation and reflection before bed
description: You fill half a basin with hot water to soak your feet, close your eyes, and reflect on the past month: from the Wenchang site visit to hands-on PLC practice, your weight dropped from 72.5 to 71.2, and the air fryer added new enjoyment. Everything is steadily moving toward your goals, and you feel content. Then you set the alarm for 5:55 tomorrow morning, say goodnight to your wife, and soon fall asleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: At 6:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally and felt refreshed. After getting up, he drank a glass of warm water, changed into a quick-dry short-sleeved shirt and running shorts, and did some simple warm-up exercises in the living room, such as forward lunges, shoulder circles, and jumping jacks, to get ready for his morning run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run in Wanlv Park
description: Lu Mingqiang drove to Evergreen Park and ran on the park's rubberized track. At about the 1-kilometer mark, he ran into his running buddy Chen Bin. With the same cadence, they ran and chatted about marathon preparation and insights from the senior technician exam. They ran 5 kilometers together at a pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. After the run, they helped each other stretch their legs and backs in the fitness area.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home for a shower and a simple breakfast.
description: After his morning run, Lu Mingqiang drove home. He took a warm shower, changed into a clean casual T-shirt, then took whole wheat bread from the fridge, toasted two slices, heated a glass of milk, and boiled two eggs. He enjoyed a simple and nutritious breakfast that quickly restored his energy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy medicine for mother
description: Lu Mingqiang walked to the Yangtianhe Pharmacy (Jinmao Branch) near his community. He bought three boxes of Yunnan Baiyao medicated plasters for his mother and two bottles of Caltrate calcium tablets for his father. At checkout, he deliberately called his mother to remind her to keep her knees warm as the temperature had dropped.
location: Yangtianhe Pharmacy (Jinmao Branch), Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Visit parents and deliver medicine
description: Lu Mingqiang drove to the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, where his parents lived, and gave the pain relief patches and calcium tablets he had bought to his mother, Chen Xiuying. Although she said he was wasting money, her face was full of smiles. He also checked the safety of the living room sockets for his father, Lu Jianguo, chatted with his parents about how life had been lately, and reminded his mother to apply the patches on time.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Book a banquet for parents' wedding anniversary
description: Lu Mingqiang drove to the Juxianlou Restaurant on Bo'ai South Road to book a banquet for his parents' wedding anniversary on November 15. He discussed with the manager, reserved the 'Hongyunge' private room, kept it within a budget of 1,500 yuan, and chose dishes his parents liked, such as Wenchang chicken and braised grouper. He paid a deposit and received a receipt.
location: Juxianlou Restaurant (Bo'ai South Road Main Branch), Bo'ai South Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to the flea market as planned to exchange collectibles with forum friends
description: Lu Mingqiang met his workmate Chen Jianguo at the intersection of Bo'ai South Road, and they browsed the flea market together. Chen Jianguo was very interested in a few old electrician meters, and Lu Mingqiang helped him evaluate them. Around 11:00, they met a forum friend from Danzhou as arranged. Lu Mingqiang traded his collection of an archaistic bronze wine vessel for the other's Li ethnic totem sauce-flavor liquor bottle, and both sides were very satisfied. The three also exchanged collecting tips at the Datie Laoba Tea Shop beside the market.
location: Bo'ai Road Used Goods Market, South Bo'ai Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy traditional pastries on the way
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jianguo and the forum friends, Lu Mingqiang passed an old-established pastry shop, remembered the children wanted snacks, so he bought two jin of freshly baked coconut crisps and triangular crisps. The shopkeeper carefully wrapped them in oil paper. Imagining the children's happy smiles, he carried the pastries home.
location: XX Ji Traditional Pastry Shop, Bo'ai South Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and call with family
description: Lu Mingqiang drove home. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared a simple lunch—tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. The two sat at the table, and as he ate, he told her about how smoothly the banquet booking had gone that morning and showed off the newly acquired Li ethnic totem wine bottle. His wife also thought the bottle was unique and very suitable for display in the living room cabinet.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon review of PLC.
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang brewed a pot of Tieguanyin tea and focused on reviewing PLC technology in his study. He consulted the textbook and the online course replay, repeatedly worked through the logic of the ladder diagrams, and used a red pen to organize the scan cycle and intermediate relay usage on scratch paper. After more than an hour of focused study, he had a clearer understanding of the difficult points, wrote down the unresolved questions, and planned to ask Master Li for advice.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Short rest and activities
description: After the study session came to an end, Lu Mingqiang stood up and stretched his stiff neck and shoulders. He walked to the living room balcony, used a small spray bottle to water several pots of pothos and money trees, and looked out at the distant buildings to give his eyes and brain a brief rest.
location: Balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organizing collectibles and online exchanges
description: After resting, Lu Mingqiang took out the Li ethnic totem liquor bottle he had acquired today and the bottles he had previously found. He carefully wiped them with a soft cloth and rinsed them with clean water. He took a photo of the new bottle and posted it to the Hainan Island Liquor Bottle Collection Enthusiasts WeChat group with a caption introducing it, happily chatting with the group members. Afterward, he also wiped and rearranged the old electric meters in the glass cabinet in his study, immersed in the sense of solidity these old objects gave him.
location: Study and balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child interaction time
description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang took out the air fryer manual and called his two sons over. Using the circuit schematic diagram, he briefly explained to his 8-year-old eldest son Lu Zixuan how the heating tube works, and answered Zixuan's questions about the thermostat. Meanwhile, his 4-year-old youngest son Lu Zihan was building a "power station" with building blocks next to them, from time to time pulling his father over to admire his work. The living room was filled with the laughter of the father and his two sons.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Wife Wang Lijuan used the newly bought air fryer to make her signature fried chicken wings and crispy fries, and also stir-fried a plate of Hainan-style vegetarian clay pot dish. Lu Mingqiang helped cut fruit and set the table. The family sat around together; the two sons praised the chicken wings endlessly. Lu Mingqiang complimented his wife's cooking and suggested making salt-baked chicken with the new pot next time.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Housework and evening rest
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy up the kitchen. His wife was in the living room helping the younger son with his kindergarten handicraft homework, while the older son watched cartoons. After cleaning up, Lu Mingqiang also sat down on the sofa to watch TV with his family and enjoy a leisurely Saturday evening.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening core training and foot soaking
description: The children were getting ready to wash up and go to bed. Lu Mingqiang laid out a yoga mat in the living room, did 15 minutes of abdominal core training and shoulder-neck stretches, and broke a light sweat. Then he boiled water, added cold water to bring it to a comfortable warmth, and enjoyed a 20-minute foot soak while browsing a tech forum on his phone.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and browsing forums
description: After soaking his feet, Lu Mingqiang changed into his pajamas and leaned against the headboard, browsing posts about disassembly and maintenance on the 'Old Electric Meter DIY' forum. He liked and commented on posts that interested him. He also checked in his phone memo the few PLC questions he wanted to ask Master Li the next day.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Talk with wife
description: After his wife also finished her work and lay down, Lu Mingqiang turned off the main light, leaving only a bedside lamp. The two chatted about the children's recent situation. His wife told him that the kindergarten would hold a parent-child sports day next week and hoped he would be sure to attend. Lu Mingqiang also mentioned his plan to go back to his parents' house next week to fix the faucet. As they chatted, drowsiness gradually set in.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Going to bed
description: After the chat, Lu Mingqiang habitually turned off the desk lamp. The moonlight outside the window was hazy. Lying in bed, he reviewed the fulfilling day and felt content. He closed his eyes, his breathing gradually steadied, and he soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning run at Wanlv Garden.
description: Woke up on time at 6 a.m., weighed 71.3 kg, and felt great. Changed into running gear, walked about 25 minutes to the west gate of Wanlv Garden, and met up with running buddy Chen Bin at 6:25. The two ran 6 km along the seaside trail at a pace of 6:35 per kilometer, chatting while running. Lu Mingqiang shared the difficulties of learning PLC and his plan to start a studio after the exam; Chen Bin encouraged him to keep going and told some interesting stories about marathon running. Finished at 7:00, felt refreshed, and the timing was just right.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returned home, washed up, and had breakfast
description: After finishing the run, he said goodbye to Chen Bin, walked about 25 minutes, and arrived home at 7:30. He took a comfortable hot shower and changed into loungewear. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared breakfast: a large serving of Baoluo rice noodles, a plate of fried eggs, and two cups of soy milk. As he ate, Lu Mingqiang told his wife about his plans for the morning to go to Bo'ai Road and attend the sports meet. She nodded in agreement and told him to be sure to come back half an hour before going to the kindergarten.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Hunted for old electric meters and porcelain insulators at the flea market.

What you learned for the technician exam wasn't in vain. This job is beautifully done—it can be a model example!" Lao Lu felt reassured and smiled modestly.

name: Troubleshoot the control cabinet fault at Xinmei Food Processing Factory.
description: After entering the electrical distribution room of the production workshop at Xinmei Food Processing Factory, Lu Mingqiang smelled a distinct burning odor. He told Chen Jianguo to pull the main switch and tag it out and lock it out. Then he used a multimeter to check the main circuit and found it to be normal. He then used a clamp meter to measure the load current of each branch circuit and found that the current in a conveyor belt motor circuit suddenly surged to nearly 40 A, far exceeding the thermal relay setpoint. Lu Mingqiang asked Zhao Qiang to remove the motor terminal box and tested it with a megger; the insulation resistance was almost zero, so he determined that moisture inside the motor had caused a short circuit, melting the contactor contacts. The three then replaced the damaged contactor and thermal relay, and coordinated with the factory to replace it with a spare motor. After the new parts were installed, they tightened the screws, cleaned off the accumulated dust, and repeatedly verified the phase sequence before restoring power. The control cabinet worked normally, and the production line resumed operation. They observed for 20 minutes, and the current was stable with the contactor closing normally. The duty officer from the equipment department expressed his gratitude.
location: Electrical distribution room, production workshop, Xinmei Food Processing Factory, Xiuli Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

Next, he walked over to the menu board and checked again the menu that had been discussed with the family the day before yesterday: Wenchang chicken, steamed grouper, boiled prawns, vegetarian clay pot stew... These were all the hearty dishes his mother loved most. He also asked the manager to confirm the tea and ordered a pot of fine Tieguanyin. Finally, he carefully arranged the 12 sets of bowls and chopsticks in a circle again, making sure they were neatly positioned.
location: Jufu Tower Seafood Restaurant, No. 16 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, "Hongyun Pavilion" private room

name: Relatives and friends arrive one after another and talk in depth with eldest brother Minghua.
description: Just after 10 o'clock, my elder brother Minghua and his wife arrived. I hurried up to greet them. My brother patted me on the shoulder and said, "Mingqiang, you've set things up nicely today; Mom and Dad will definitely be happy!" After sitting down, I poured him a cup of tea and, before everyone else arrived, got straight to what was on my mind: "Brother, I'm preparing for the senior technician exam and hope to open my own repair studio in the future. What do you think? I'd like your advice." My brother asked in detail about the certification process, startup capital, and customer sources, and finally advised: "Play it safe and steady. Getting the certificate is the stepping stone. On weekends, start by taking small private jobs from acquaintances and build up your reputation gradually; don't spread yourself too thin." I nodded repeatedly, took out my phone memo, and wrote down the key points.
location: Jufu Tower Seafood Restaurant, No. 16 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, "Hongyun Pavilion" private room

name: Parents' Ruby Wedding Anniversary Dinner
description: At 11:25, everyone was here. Twelve relatives sat noisily around a large table. Father stood up first and raised his glass, his voice loud: "Today is a good day. Forty years ago, your mother and I got our marriage certificate in Haikou..." When it was Lu Mingqiang's turn, he stood up with his glass, walked between his parents, and handed the photo album to his mother: "Dad, Mom, this was put together by me, Lijuan, Xuanxuan, and Hanhan as a ruby wedding gift for you both." Mother opened the album, looking at the family photos from yellowed to present, tears welling up in her eyes. She stroked the black-and-white wedding photo on the cover and kept saying, "Good, good." The atmosphere at the table was very harmonious. Everyone chatted while eating and drank a few extra cups of Haikou Daqu with the eldest brother.
location: Jufu Tower Seafood Restaurant, No. 16 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, "Hongyun Pavilion" private room

name: Dinner ends and seeing guests off
description: Go home to prepare and eat dinner
location: Entrance of Jufu Building Seafood Restaurant, No. 16 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Walked back home
description: Walking home with Lijuan, I yawned on the way. I had been busy all morning and was indeed a little tired.
location: Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (the section from Jufu Tower Seafood Restaurant back to Banshan Garden Residential Area)

name: Returning home to organize and take inventory
description: After arriving home, I emptied the canvas bag and, together with Wang Lijuan, recorded the cash red envelopes received (1,000 yuan in total, given by my aunt's and uncle's families) in the gift register. Then I put the family portrait album back on the most prominent shelf of the bookcase, alongside the old electricity meters and wine bottles. These are the most important things in life.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time: taking the sons to fly kites
description: He glanced out the window; the sun was just right and a gentle breeze was blowing — a perfect time to fly kites. He quickly urged the two sons, "Is your homework finished? Once it's done, Dad will take you to fly kites!" Xuanxuan and Hanhan cheered and jumped. He dug out the eagle kite that his friend Chen Jie had helped repair, got on the electric bike with the two sons, and reached Wanlv Park in 10 minutes. There were few people in the park today and the lawn was wide open. He taught Xuanxuan how to run against the wind and how to let out and reel in the line. Watching the "eagle" fly steadily into the blue sky, with Hanhan clapping and laughing beside him, he felt especially cheerful.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home and rest briefly
description: After playing for over an hour, the children were sweating all over. We packed up the kite and rode bikes home with them. Once home, I took a cool shower, changed into loose shorts and a vest, and lay on the sofa to rest my legs, feeling that today's physical work had finally come to an end.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Help wife prepare dinner and interact with family
description: Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen, so I went in to help pick vegetables and wash them. Lunch had been greasy, and she said she would cook something light for dinner: a vegetarian pot and sweet potato porridge. In the living room, while picking vegetables, I also tutored Xuanxuan on his math homework and helped him correct two word problems. Hanhan was building blocks nearby, every now and then bringing over a little 'house' he had built to show.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Simple family dinner
description: Dinner started on time. On the table were a steaming hot vegetarian clay pot stew, a plate of stir-fried sweet potato leaves, a dish of pan-fried mackerel, and a bowl of sweet potato porridge for each person. The family ate and chatted. The children chattered about how their kites had flown highest in the afternoon, while he and Wang Lijuan discussed going back to their parents' house next Sunday to see them.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening organizing and personal development
description: After dinner, helped clear the dishes. Then went to the study and turned on the desk lamp. First took out a notebook and neatly copied down the several business suggestions Big Brother gave this morning, writing his own thoughts after each one. Then turned on his phone and watched a section of an online technical course video, reviewing the PLC interrupt handling program to be covered next week. At 20:30, called his parents. His father answered and said his mother was especially happy today and had looked through the photo album several times. Hearing this, he felt a warmth in his heart.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Foot soaking, relaxation, and pre-sleep preparation.
description: At 21:15, I prepared a basin of hot water and put in a few mugwort foot-soak packets. While soaking my feet, I browsed posts on the liquor bottle collection forum. I saw a well-salt bottle that looked quite distinctive and saved it. After soaking my feet, I felt comfortable all over. Then I did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches and stepped on the scale: 71.6 kg, heavier than in the morning, but I was happy today, so it was worth it.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: At 22:10, I turned off my phone and lay in bed. I went over the day's events in my mind, feeling full of happiness and peace. I thought about Sunday tomorrow: I would take the kids to my parents' home and play a game of Chinese chess with the old man. At 23:00, I fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and breakfast.
description: Woke up naturally at 6 a.m., quickly washed up, changed into running gear, and drove to Wanlv Park. Completed a 7 km morning run in the cool morning breeze at a pace of 6:45 per kilometer, followed by 5 minutes of static stretching. Then packed Hainan rice noodles and extra-strong soy milk from the Laoba tea stall at the park entrance, and drove back to Banshan Garden home. After a shower and changing into home clothes, ate breakfast at the table while browsing industry news on his phone, getting in the mood for the morning study session.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then return.

name: Pre-exam review
description: In the study, he immersed himself in reviewing for the motor control circuit exam, focusing on core circuits such as star-delta starting and inverter control. He went through his mentor's yellowed old notes, hand-copied and drew circuit diagrams on large sheets of paper, and simulated current paths and fault diagnosis. During breaks, he checked the exam preparation group, noted a complex fault analysis problem, and filled in the knowledge points he had previously missed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home study room)

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: His wife took the younger son back to her parents' home, while he stayed home with the elder son. He made a simple egg fried rice and cleared away last night's leftovers. After the meal, he let the elder son arrange his own activities, and he took a 20-minute nap on the sofa to recharge for the afternoon of childcare and practice.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (home dining room and living room)

name: Pre-fire drill preparations
description: After his lunch break, he went downstairs to the notice board at the community entrance to check the fire drill notice and confirmed that it would be held at 2:30 p.m. in the central square. He returned home and woke up his eldest son Xuanxuan, who was taking an afternoon nap, and told him he could learn to use a fire extinguisher. Xuanxuan excitedly got out of bed at once. Then he briefly explained the basic points of fire escape and the safety rules of the drill site, emphasizing that they must obey the command.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (community entrance bulletin board and home)

name: Participated in the community fire drill and helped others.
description: Took Xuanxuan to the central square of the residential complex on time for the fire drill. The firefighters explained household fire safety and the 'lift, pull, grip, press' method for using a fire extinguisher. Under their guidance, he and Xuanxuan operated a dry powder fire extinguisher together and successfully put out the fire. Xuanxuan was extremely excited after operating it himself. During a break in the drill, he noticed that the charging power strip cable of Uncle Li's electric tricycle had exposed wires. He immediately pointed out the risk and, after obtaining Uncle Li's consent, went home to get wire strippers and insulating tape, then reconnected and wrapped the wires on the spot. Property manager Wang Jianguo witnessed the whole process, praised him to his face for his excellent skills and community spirit, and invited him to give a safety talk to the residents another day. He sincerely agreed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area (central community square), No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Home electrical safety self-check
description: After the drill ended and he got home, he immediately took a screwdriver and a voltage tester, led Xuanxuan to the meter box at the door, and explained in simple language how the main switch and the residual current device work: "This is the main breaker — all the electricity in the house flows through here; this is the leakage protector — if there is a leak, it will trip, keeping us safe." Then he tested the leakage protector switches in every room with Xuanxuan and let him press the test button himself. When the breaker tripped, Xuanxuan found it truly amazing.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (home electrical meter box and various rooms).

name: Dinner and helping with homework.
description: His wife Juanzi brought the younger son Hanhan home and made a home-cooked meal. At the dinner table, Xuanxuan excitedly described to his mother his experience of putting out a fire with his own hands that afternoon. After dinner, he checked Xuanxuan's math and Chinese homework, found two careless mistakes, and patiently guided him to discover and correct them himself.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (home dining room and living room)

name: Played with the younger son.
description: After finishing tutoring his older son, his younger son Hanhan dragged him over to play with building blocks. Sitting together on the living room floor mat, he helped Hanhan assemble a simple 'fire station' while telling the story of his older brother putting out a fire. Hanhan was fascinated and mimicked his brother's movements, making the whole family laugh.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan (home living room)

name: Evening personal time
description: After the two children took baths and got into bed, my wife put them to sleep. I washed up, changed into pajamas, and lay half-propped in bed scrolling on my phone for about ten minutes. I checked the construction site work group to confirm that Monday's arrangements had not changed, quickly skimmed a few technical articles from power industry WeChat public accounts, and then rested moderately.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, Banshan Garden Residential Area (bathroom and bedroom at home)

name: Core stretching
description: Put down the phone and do the daily 15-minute core stretching routine on the bedroom mat, focusing on relaxing the lower back and hips to relieve the physical tension from a full day of studying and standing while accompanying others.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home bedroom)

name: Pre-sleep review and falling asleep
description: After stretching, he lay in bed and briefly reviewed the day: morning run to burn fat and recover, review that captured the key points, drills to spread safety knowledge, helping neighbor Uncle Li, and teaching his son about safe electricity use. He felt grounded and content. At 22:30 he turned off the light and fell asleep with the small blessings of life and a calm mindset toward future challenges.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home bedroom)

name: Morning routine and community fire safety inspection.
description: Woke up at 5:50 a.m. The sky outside was faintly bright, and his body still felt sore from yesterday's fire drill. While washing up, he weighed himself: 71.5 kg. His thoughts drifted to Director Wang's invitation to give a safety lecture. At 6:10, he took his tools to inspect the fire emergency lights and evacuation signs on floors 1–6 and tested that the backup power supply was normal. On the second floor, he met Director Wang, who was patrolling. Director Wang thanked him again for eliminating the neighbor's charging hazard the day before, and they settled on the lecture date. Lu Mingqiang agreed to prepare an outline soon. At 6:35, he returned home. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white congee, egg pancakes, and dried radish. His elder son Zixuan and younger son Hanhan were already at the table. His wife reminded him to pick up the children a bit earlier in the afternoon. The family finished breakfast quickly but warmly.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Commute and pre-shift morning meeting
description: He rode an electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road to Qiuhai Avenue, then turned onto Haisheng Road, arriving at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park in about 15 minutes. In the locker room, he changed shoes and filled his water bottle. He chatted with colleague Chen Jianguo about the charging power strip hazard discovered during yesterday's fire drill in the residential area, and Chen Jianguo said he would remind his father-in-law. At 7:25, Team Leader Zhang held the morning meeting and assigned the day's key task: install the power distribution cabinet for the new factory building and complete the secondary circuit wiring and commissioning. He designated Lu Mingqiang to take charge of the critical wiring and lead assistant Zhao Qiang in hands-on practice, and Lu Mingqiang readily agreed.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Distribution box installation and wiring instruction
description: In the power distribution room of the newly built factory, Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang in wiring, stripping wires, crimping terminals, and numbering each core according to the drawings. While working, he explained circuit principles and standards. When he saw that Zhao Qiang was about to connect the A/B phase sequence wrong, he stopped him in time and explained the risk of reversing the phase sequence, ensuring every connection was neat and straight. Team Leader Zhang praised the clean wiring quality in the cabinet during his inspection. The main circuit connections were basically completed by noon.
location: Electrical distribution room, new factory building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Lunch and a short rest in the work shed
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang walked to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant at the entrance of the industrial park. Lu Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with stir-fried greens. During the meal, the three continued discussing household electrical safety, from aging sockets to electric vehicle charging; Zhao Qiang listened attentively. After eating, they returned to the work shed. Lu Mingqiang drank some tea, smoked a cigarette, and sat leaning back on a simple stool for a short nap of more than ten minutes. Seeing the sky clear up, he felt refreshed for the afternoon work.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Distribution box finishing and insulation testing.
description: The afternoon was quite productive. Lu Mingqiang had Zhao Qiang connect and fix all the remaining main lines from the morning. Around 3 p.m., he had Zhao Qiang set up the 500V megohmmeter and personally ran insulation resistance tests on each circuit. All data passed, with the needle steadily pointing to infinity. Facing the neatly arranged, clearly labeled terminal blocks and the instrument panel about to be energized, Lu Mingqiang felt a sense of accomplishment.
location: Electrical distribution room, new factory building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, China

name: Picked up his eldest son from school and returned home.
description: Lu Mingqiang had informed his team leader in advance, packed up his tools and changed into casual clothes, then set off from the industrial park on his e-bike, deliberately detouring to Longfeng Experimental Primary School in Meilan District to pick up his eldest son Zixuan. When he reached the school gate, Zixuan was already waiting by the security booth. After getting on the bike, he chattered all the way about funny things at school, and the father and son rode from Meilan District back to Banshan Garden in Longhua District.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China

name: Home circuit safety upgrade practical class
description: After arriving home, he changed into old clothes and laid out screwdrivers, a test pen, new-standard socket panels, and LED bulbs. Lu Mingqiang first took his son Zixuan to replace bulbs in the bathroom and bedroom, explaining the function of the sealing ring of waterproof LEDs and how a 9-watt LED saves more electricity than old-style bulbs. Then he cut power and replaced the aged, yellowed socket in the kitchen, cut off the oxidized wire ends, rewired it, and installed it strictly according to the left-neutral, right-live, top-ground standard, testing it on the spot with an induction cooker. After cleaning up, he took Zixuan to the meter box and explained the functions of the main circuit breaker and residual current device, demonstrating the monthly test button, and Zixuan listened carefully. When they finished, the younger son Hanhan ran out of the room and clapped at the bright new panels. Lu Mingqiang put away the old materials and locked up the tools.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Wife came home, and they had a warm dinner.
description: Wang Lijuan, the wife, walked in after work and immediately felt that the lights in the house were warm and bright. She noticed that the kitchen outlet and the bathroom light bulb were brand new, and smilingly praised her husband for being quick. Dinner included pork ribs stewed with lotus root, stir-fried choy sum, and scrambled eggs with scallions. The family of four sat together, and Lu Mingqiang shared about the day's electrical installation in the factory building and teaching Zixuan how to wire; the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Accompanying two sons and helping with homework
description: After dinner, his younger son Hanhan pulled Dad to play with LEGO. Lu Mingqiang sat on the floor mat with him and built a small castle, teaching him colors and shapes while playing. Then he went to the study to check Zixuan's math workbook, found two word problems wrong because of carelessness, and had him reread the questions and quickly correct them. Lu Mingqiang told him to stay focused and calm when doing homework, and Zixuan nodded and took note.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Use hands-on practice to reinforce theoretical review.
description: Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa, opened his phone to review the star-delta starter exam question discussed in the exam preparation group, and combined it with his daytime experience of personally wiring the circuits in the power distribution room. This gave him a more intuitive understanding of the operating logic of the components in the circuit. The textbook knowledge became completely clear, and he felt especially at ease.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Stretching, relaxing, and preparing for bed
description: After finishing his study, Lu Mingqiang did 15 minutes of core stretching on the living room mat, focusing on relaxing his lower back and shoulders to relieve the soreness from a day of bending over. He then took a shower, changed into cotton pajamas, and lay in bed checking the work crew group chat. Looking back on the day — the fire safety inspection, wrapping up at the construction site, upgrading the home electrical circuits, and tutoring his son — he felt everything had been done solidly. Before bedtime, an idea came to him, and he listed an outline for a community safety talk in his phone notes: common household electrical hazards, the dangers of substandard sockets and dangling-wire charging, and the importance of residual current protection devices and how to test them. He planned to write it up during the next day's lunch break. As the sound of traffic outside gradually faded, he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Getting up and morning preparation.
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up when the alarm went off at 6:00. He felt his knee joints reacting noticeably to the drop in temperature, so he decided to wear thick thermal pants. The scale showed 71.4 kg. After washing up, he changed into a thick cotton thermal top and the blue work cotton jacket issued by the company. In the kitchen, his wife Wang Lijuan was heating up porridge. He reminded her that it was windy today and to take the bus to work instead of riding the electric bike. His wife also reminded him not to forget to wear his knee pads and full-face helmet.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and taking the child to school
description: Lu Mingqiang drank hot congee alongside meat buns and put on his tool bag. At 6:30 he took his eldest son Lu Zixuan downstairs, put on his hat and gloves before riding the e-bike, and let him snuggle behind the windproof blanket. At 6:45 they arrived at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. He reminded Zixuan to put on his jacket quickly after PE class in the cold weather, watched him enter the school gate, then rode away.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute to the Industrial Park
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike west along Binhai Avenue against the wind, and the backs of his hands were blown numb. He arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park at 7:00, parked the e-bike in the shed, and walked toward the workshop.
location: From Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-shift morning meeting and taking orders
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into his work clothes and drank hot water to warm himself up. At the morning meeting, Squad Leader Zhang assigned him a task: to go to an old residential building on Yilong West Road in Longhua District for emergency repair of the main corridor line that had been gnawed through by rats. Lu Mingqiang took the repair order, checked the material list, and planned to prepare anti-rodent sleeves.
location: Workshop pre-shift meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Material preparation and emergency repair of rat-damaged lines.
description: Lu Mingqiang and his apprentice Zhao Qiang went to the tool room together to count tools and materials, including wire strippers, a multimeter, BV wire, corrugated conduit, and stainless steel anti-rodent sleeves. At 7:40 Zhao Qiang drove the pickup truck, and the two headed to Longhua District. At 7:55 they arrived at the residential building at No. 72, Yilong West Road. After verifying the scope of the power outage, they pulled down the main switch and hung a tag. Lu Mingqiang put on a headlamp and opened the access panel in the corridor ceiling, finding three places where wires had been bitten by rats, with serious damage to the insulation. He cleaned up the rat droppings, cut out the damaged sections, stripped the wires, connected new wires, wrapped them with insulating tape, fitted corrugated anti-rodent conduit, and secured it with cable ties. Zhao Qiang assisted from below. At 11:00 they used a multimeter to test continuity and insulation resistance. After passing, at 11:15 they closed the switch and restored power, then checked each floor to confirm all three households had electricity. After politely declining the residents' offer of hot tea, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang cleaned up the construction debris and took it downstairs.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to the residential building at No. 72 Yilong West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Return trip wrap-up and lunch
description: On the ride back, Lu Mingqiang photographed the completed work and sent the photos to the crew group chat, recording the details of the anti-rodent sleeve. He returned to the company at 12:00, put the remaining materials back in the warehouse, and washed his hands. Then he walked to the 'Old Haikou Fried Rice Noodles Shop' on Haisheng Road, ordered a plate of wet-fried beef chow fun with an egg, and ate while looking at screenshots of circuit diagrams saved on his phone. He finished at 12:40 and went back to the company.
location: On the return trip from Yilong West Road, he went to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and then to Old Haikou Fried Rice Noodle Shop on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Midday organizing and review.
description: Lu Mingqiang poured hot water in the workshop rest room, opened the "Motor Control Circuits" notebook, marked with a red pen the questions he had about calculating the time relay setting value for star-delta step-down starting, worked through example problems on scratch paper, and added supplementary notes.
location: Workshop rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Repairing a faulty welding machine in the workshop.
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo put on arc-protective gloves and a protective face shield and moved the old welding machine to the maintenance area. After opening the casing and blowing out the dust, they used a multimeter to measure the DC resistance of the primary coil of the main transformer and found the value was too low, identifying it as the problem. Next, they checked the contacts of the AC contactor and found slight burning and oxidation. He polished the contacts with fine sandpaper and cleaned the armature. At 16:00 they reassembled the machine; the no-load power-on test was normal, and Chen Jianguo was satisfied after a test weld.
location: Production workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuted home from work and changed clothes
description: Lu Mingqiang washed the oil and grease off his hands, changed back into casual clothes (a thick sweatshirt and windbreaker), put his notebook and review materials into his backpack, and rode his electric bike out of the industrial park, arriving home at 16:55. He quickly took off his work clothes, put on tight exercise pants, a quick-dry T-shirt, and running shoes, threw on a windbreaker, put on sports earphones, filled a bottle with warm water, and got ready to go out for exercise.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Brisk walking and jogging in the park.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike for 3 minutes to the north gate of Wanlv Garden, parked, and warmed up. He first briskly walked two laps around the lake for about 15 minutes, then jogged about 3.2 km at a pace of about 6 min 30 sec/km. He finished at 17:45 and stretched out in the equipment area.
location: Rubber running track, Wanlv Park, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home and bathe.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his bike home, zipping up his jacket against the night wind, and arrived home at 18:00. He went straight to the bathroom and enjoyed a hot shower. He turned the water temperature up and deliberately let the hot water run on his lower back and knees for five minutes, feeling warm all over. Afterward, he changed into dry cotton loungewear and went downstairs to help his wife serve dinner.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: The family sat around the table eating. Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son Lu Zixuan whether it was cold at school and about his composition; when he learned that he had scored 85 on a math quiz, he encouraged him to correct the wrong answers together in the evening. The younger son Lu Zihan squirmed in his chair and recited a nursery rhyme about keeping warm, making the whole family laugh.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Help eldest son with his homework
description: After clearing the dishes, Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room and looked at his eldest son's math test paper. He found that the mistakes came from carelessness in writing vertical calculations. He asked Zixuan to reread the problems and calculate step by step, erasing the errors until he got them right. Finally, he reminded him to write carefully and distinguish between 2 and 7.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening review and phone consultation
description: Lu Mingqiang spread open his notebook under the desk lamp in his study and spent 20 minutes drawing the motor forward-reverse interlocking circuit diagram three times in a row, clearly labeling the wiring terminals. At 20:00 he made a WeChat voice call to Master Li to ask about difficult issues such as the setting values of the star-delta time relay. Master Li readily agreed to provide on-site guidance. Lu Mingqiang verbally shared his approach to estimating the delay range, listening and taking notes as he went, and felt suddenly enlightened.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went out to consult Master Li in person and returned.
description: Lu Mingqiang brought his notebook and a list of questions and set off on his e-bike, arriving at Master Li's home in the South District of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District at 20:45. Master Li served tea. Lu Mingqiang humbly asked for advice on three questions: the selection of auxiliary normally closed contacts for forward-reverse interlock, the empirical formula for setting time relays in star-delta starting, and the impact of switching under load on contact life. Master Li explained in a simple and clear way, and Lu Mingqiang noted the key points in red pen, feeling completely enlightened. He took his leave at 21:35, rode home, and arrived at 21:50, feeling that the cold wind was no longer biting.
location: From No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Master Li's home in the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and back to No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Parent-child time and bedtime preparation
description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang tiptoed into the second bedroom and found that his second son, Lu Zihan, was already asleep. He tucked the quilt corners in for Hanhan, turned off the main light, and left the night light on. Back in the living room, he shared the insights he had gained from seeking advice with his wife, Wang Lijuan. She urged him to go to bed early.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Lu Mingqiang did 10 minutes of core stretching on the anti-slip mat to loosen his iliotibial band, while soaking his feet in a 42-degree electric foot bath for 15 minutes, until his back was slightly sweaty, warding off the day's chill. After drying his feet, he set the alarm for 5:50 the next morning, discussed with Juanzi the plan to visit Master Li again tomorrow evening, turned off the light and went to sleep at 22:30, listening to the fading wind and savoring what he had learned that night.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up, weight management, preparation, and breakfast.
description: Lu Mingqiang woke up naturally before the alarm went off. He weighed 71.4 kg and felt reassured. After washing up, he changed into his work clothes and reminded his son Lu Zixuan, who was eating breakfast, that the temperature would drop today and that he must wear the blue fleece jacket. His wife Wang Lijuan had already packed sticky rice cakes and coconut cakes in an insulated bag, and she reminded him not to forget to go to Master Li's house tonight. Lu Mingqiang ate two fried eggs, a bowl of white porridge, and a meat bun, and felt full of energy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to school
description: At 6:50, Lu Mingqiang took Lu Zixuan downstairs, and his son obediently put on his fleece jacket. The two got on the electric bike. On the way, they talked about yesterday's emergency repair. His son asked, "Does it hurt when a mouse bites an electric wire?" He said, "It doesn't hurt the wire, but if a person touches a wire bitten by a mouse, it hurts so much they'd scream for help." His son seemed to half understand. At the school gate, after watching him enter the school, Lu Mingqiang turned the bike around and headed to the industrial park.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuted to the industrial park and attended the pre-shift morning meeting.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode from the school along Haifu Road, turned onto Haixiu Road, then onto Haisheng Road, and reached Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park after a 15-minute ride. He parked the e-bike, took out an insulated bag and a tool kit from the rear storage compartment. At 7:25 he attended the morning meeting presided over by Team Leader Zhang, who reminded everyone to watch for the temperature drop and assigned the main tasks for the day: Lu Mingqiang would take Zhao Qiang to a government office building on Changxin Road, Xiuying District, for the monthly routine inspection, tightening the distribution cabinet terminals and blowing dust off the transformer, while Chen Jianguo and others went to another factory area for minor repairs. After receiving the task sheet, Lu Mingqiang recalled the key points about star-delta starting that Master Li had explained the night before.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning electrical inspection and return trip
description: After the morning meeting ended, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang drove the company pickup truck, brought the tool box and a multimeter, and headed to Changxin Road. They arrived at the distribution room of the government office building in about 10 minutes. Starting at 8:05, the two checked the low-voltage distribution cabinets floor by floor. Lu Mingqiang used a ring spanner to tighten the incoming and outgoing line terminals of each main switch, while Zhao Qiang provided lighting and took notes. When they tightened the air-conditioning main unit's air switch on the third floor, they found slight heat marks on the C-phase terminal; the temperature measured 47°C. Although it was not above the limit, they still cleaned the contact surface and re-tightened it. Then they climbed onto the rooftop transformer platform and used compressed air to blow the dust off the heat sink fins. During a break, Lu Mingqiang explained to Zhao Qiang the star-delta starting sequence diagram that Master Li had drawn in red pen the night before. At 11:45 the inspection ended. They packed up the tools, filled out the inspection record sheet, and drove back to the industrial park. After returning to the workshop, Lu Mingqiang washed his hands with clean water and took photos of the terminals before and after tightening for the records.
location: Power distribution room of a government office building on Changxin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break, with some note review in between
description: At 12:10, Lu Mingqiang walked to the Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant at the entrance of the industrial park and ordered a spicy soup rice with a fried egg. The soup had generous portions of pork tripe and pickled vegetables, and eating it warmed him all over. While waiting and eating, he took out a hardcover notebook from his tool bag and reviewed the star-delta starting time relay setting value conversion method that Master Li had marked in red pen, memorizing it silently. He finished eating at 12:50 and returned to the workshop rest room, lying on the folding cot for 20 minutes while his mind kept turning over the afternoon inspection points and the PLC programming approach he wanted to ask Master Li about in the evening. At 13:10 he got up, washed his face with cold water, and felt refreshed.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon inspection and workshop wrap-up
description: At 1:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang drove again to the office building to continue the inspection, focusing on the power supply cabinet in the elevator machine room and the emergency lighting distribution box, confirming that all indicator lights were normal and the dual power transfer switch operated reliably. At 3:00 p.m., they completed all scheduled inspection items and returned to the industrial park. In the workshop, he organized his tools, oiled the wire strippers and crimping pliers needed for the next day, wrote up the terminal overheating found during today’s inspection in the work log, and gave a verbal report to Team Leader Zhang.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commuting after work and buying fruit to thank teachers
description: He got off work at 4:05 p.m. Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike home. Passing by Jinmao Middle Road, he stopped at the entrance of the Daily Fresh Fruit Store, went inside, carefully selected six Red Fuji apples, asked the proprietress to put them in a red gift bag, paid, and left.
location: Rixian Fruit Shop at Jinmao Middle Road Intersection, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Arrived home, received the teacher-appreciation gift, and talked with family.
description: Arrived home at 4:25. His wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up his younger son Lu Zihan from kindergarten. Lu Mingqiang put the apples on the table. Wang Lijuan took out the yiba cakes and coconut cakes she had made that morning from the insulated bag, put them into a clean basket, and tied it with red string, saying that giving something to Master required care. Lu Mingqiang picked up Hanhan and asked what he had learned today; Hanhan recited a Tang poem. He then asked Juanzi who would pick up Xuanxuan from school and learned that Grandpa had gone to pick him up, so they could go to Meilan District with peace of mind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Set off for Master Li's home.
description: Lu Mingqiang carefully placed the pastry basket and fruit on the footboard of his electric bike and stuffed a bottle of homemade lemon water into the insulated bag. After putting on his helmet, he set off from home, heading east along Jinmao Middle Road. He passed several traffic lights and rode for about 20 minutes before arriving at the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan in Meilan District. After registering at the guard booth, he rode to the building where Master Li lives.
