location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Visiting Master Li to seek advice and learn PLC programming and electrical circuit knowledge.
description: Master Li opened the door and was taken aback for a moment when he saw Lu Mingqiang, then smiled and praised him for being punctual. Lu Mingqiang handed over the basket and apples, saying that the missus liked cakes and Master Li liked apples. Master Li's wife made tea and invited him to sit down. After some small talk, Master Li led Lu Mingqiang into the small study, opened his cowhide-covered work notebook, and, regarding the PLC programming he had asked about last time, selected several typical case problems for a closed material conveying system. He drew ladder diagrams on paper while explaining the principles, circling key points with a red pen. Lu Mingqiang wrote down every word with a black gel pen. Drawing on today's inspection of the distribution cabinets, Master Li asked about the causes and diagnosis of loose terminals, and Lu Mingqiang answered correctly every time. Master Li nodded and said, "Find the evidence in the current and temperature. It's the same in the exam; practical experience is your confidence!" When he left, Master Li's wife gave him a bag of home-dried mango slices.
location: Master Li's home, a building in the South District of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home
description: At 8:35 PM, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to Master Li, and the master and apprentice agreed to come again next Wednesday. He got on his electric bike. The evening wind against his back was a bit chilly, but his heart was warm. He felt that the few hours tonight were more useful than reading for a week. He rode all the way back to his home in Longhua District.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reviewing, consolidating, and reflecting on notes
description: After arriving home and washing his hands, Lu Mingqiang went straight into the study and switched on the desk lamp. While his memory was still fresh, he copied out one by one the PLC programming logic and the motor-control circuit question-solving tips Master Li had explained that evening into his dedicated exam-preparation notebook, and with a red pen heavily circled his master's words: handle things step by step and cling to the steps to score points. Closing the notebook, he felt that most of his pre-exam unease had dissipated.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family communication and routine body maintenance
description: Wang Lijuan finished soothing the younger son and came out, then asked about his studies. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said that a few pointers from the master were worth a week of review, and he felt much more confident. Afterwards he went to the kitchen to boil water, mixed in cold water, and soaked his feet for 15 minutes. While soaking, he told his wife that Xuanxuan had been stumbling over math word problems lately, and asked her to keep an eye on it over the weekend. After soaking his feet, he did core stretching on the living room carpet for 15 minutes, including planks and glute bridges, and his body loosened up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime preparations
description: After stretching, Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower, lay down on the bed, and set his phone alarm for 5:50 the next morning. Before turning off the light, he closed his eyes and went over the tools he needed to bring the next day and the procedure framework his master taught tonight, feeling peaceful. At 22:45, his consciousness blurred and he fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning wake-up, weighing, and washing up
description: At 5:50 in the morning, he was awakened right on time by his biological clock. He first did two minutes of stretching in bed, then got up and weighed himself; his weight was 71.5 kg, remaining stable. Then he brushed his teeth and washed his face, splashing cold water on it to wake himself up, went to the kitchen to turn off the power to the congee cooker that had been set the night before, and then began to change clothes to get ready for morning exercise.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning core stretching and tidying up
description: He spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a 15-minute morning core stretching routine, focusing on 3 sets of planks (60 seconds each) and 4 sets of glute bridges (15 reps each), fully engaging the lower back, abdomen, and hamstrings. After finishing, he changed into long-sleeved cotton work clothes and checked his phone battery, work badge, keys, and other personal items to make sure everything was in order.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and encouraging Zixuan
description: Wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, homemade pickled cabbage, and small steamed buns. The family of three sat around the table. As they ate, Mingqiang reminded his eldest son Lu Zixuan, who was about to leave for school, that midterm exam results would be announced today. He encouraged him to read questions carefully during the exam, get everything he knew right, and if he had trouble with word problems, read the question twice and use diagrams. Zixuan was a bit nervous but full of anticipation. Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder to show his trust.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Took Zixuan to school and did grocery shopping on the way.
description: Mingqiang put on his helmet and rode the electric bike, carrying Lu Zixuan who had his schoolbag on his back. On the way, he stopped at Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store at the community gate and bought a pack of cigarettes and two lollipops that Zixuan loves. Then he turned out of Yusha Road and arrived at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School at about 7:08. After watching Zixuan trot into the school, he turned the bike around and headed for the company.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, via Xiangzhi General Merchandise Store, Chengzhongcheng Residential Community, No. 19 Yusha Road, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Commute and pre-shift preparation.
description: Starting from the school, he traveled along Haifu Road and Longkun South Road, turned onto Haisheng Road, and weaved through the morning rush-hour flow of electric bikes for about 15 minutes, arriving at the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 7:30 sharp. After parking, he entered the workshop, changed into insulating shoes, put on a safety helmet, and took his tool bag, getting ready for work.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Accept tasks at the pre-shift morning meeting
description: Squad Leader Zhang called a morning meeting and assigned the day's tasks: Mingqiang was responsible for material statistics and had to submit the report before leaving work; warehouse manager Sister Wang was off, so anyone needing materials had to get the key from Chen Jianguo; Zhao Qiang would follow Mingqiang to learn inventory counting. Mingqiang listened carefully and noted down the key points.
location: Workshop office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Warehouse inventory and material accounting.
description: After the morning meeting, Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang into the material warehouse and checked the inventory ledger against last month's material requisition forms. They counted the physical items one by one: 5 rolls of 10 mm² BV wire, 3 boxes of 3/4-inch conduit, 2 large bags of plum washers, and so on. They found that the inventory counts of several consumables did not match the ledger, so he asked Zhao Qiang to record the details. During this period, there were two temporary material requisition requests, so he took Zhao Qiang to find Chen Jianguo to open the warehouse door.
location: Materials warehouse of the company at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Data verification and report compilation.
description: Returned from the warehouse to the workshop, sat down at the workbench, and carefully compared the inventory data with the electronic ledger. A total of three discrepancies were found: two small errors in last month's material requisition records, and one roll of tape consumed during the beginning-of-month inspection that had not been written off. While checking, he asked Zhao Qiang to mark them prominently with a red pen on the draft paper, and finally entered them all into the "Monthly Material Consumption Statistics Table".
location: Workbench in the workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and pre-exam mock practice.
description: He walked with Zhao Qiang for 13 minutes to Zhenjie Hong Kong-Style Roast Meat Fast Food (Xiangrong Store) and ordered a takeout double-roast goose rice. Back in the workshop rest room, while waiting for the food, he took out the Senior Technician Theory Exam Mock Test Collection and completed the multiple-choice and true-false questions of the last mock test, which took 20 minutes. When he checked the answers, he found he had missed only two questions about PLC interrupt programs and marked them with a red pen. Then he ate lunch with peace of mind.
location: First, at Zhenjie Hong Kong-style Roast Meats Fast Food (Xiangrong Branch), No. 17, Keji Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; later returned to the workshop rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch break and consolidation of wrong questions
description: Prepared for a nap on the recliner in the lounge. Before sleeping, opened the phone gallery and looked again at the photos of notes taken last night, focusing on consolidating the two PLC interrupt programming questions he got wrong at noon, silently memorizing the knowledge points. After the 13:00 alarm went off, he got up and splashed cold water on his face to refresh himself.
location: Workshop rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tool maintenance and filling in the work log
description: In the afternoon, work was relatively light. Mingqiang used the free time to carefully wipe down a complete set of hex wrenches, screwdrivers, a multimeter, and other common tools with cotton yarn, sprayed them with WD-40 rust-prevention oil for maintenance, and put them back into the tool bag. Then he took out his work log and recorded in detail the morning's material inventory results, the problems found, and plans for the next couple of days, such as maintaining the old winding machine. Zhao Qiang watched from the side and asked about the maintenance points, and Mingqiang patiently answered.
location: Workshop tool corner and workbench, Hainan Elevator Accessories Industrial Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Work wrap-up and reporting to the shift leader.
description: He printed and signed the compiled Monthly Material Consumption Statistics Form and delivered it to Squad Leader Zhang's office. The squad leader looked through it carefully and asked about each discrepancy marked in red; Mingqiang explained each one clearly. The squad leader nodded with satisfaction, and then asked with concern about his preparation for the technician exam, encouraging him to do well and promising to treat him to a drink after he passed.
location: Workshop office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Leaving work early to buy dinner ingredients on the way
description: Considering that Zixuan's results came out today and they wanted to celebrate properly, he clocked out at 15:00. First he rode his e-bike to Pagoda (Haikou Yongwan Road store) to buy 2 jin of mangosteen and 3 jin of large green jujubes, then stopped by the neighboring vegetable market on the way to buy 2 jin of pork ribs, preparing to make braised pork ribs in the evening. He arrived home around 15:30.
location: Starting from Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan, passing via Baiguoyuan (Haikou Yongwan Road Store) on Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan, and the nearby vegetable market, and returning to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Tidying up at home and spending time with second son
description: When he got home, his second son, Lu Zihan, had already been brought back by his grandparents and was watching cartoons. Mingqiang played with blocks with him for a while. Then he went into the kitchen, cooked rice in the rice cooker, blanched the pork ribs to remove any gamey smell, and washed the strawberries he had bought, ready for Zixuan to enjoy when he got home from school.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Welcome Zixuan as he receives his exam results.
description: When his wife Wang Lijuan came home from work and saw the washed strawberries, she teased that the sun must be rising from the west. As soon as she said that, Zixuan came home from school and excitedly reported scoring 90 on the math test, the highest in the class. Mingqiang took the test paper and saw the 90 written in red pen. Overjoyed, he picked Zixuan up and spun him around. His wife also came over and kissed him. The whole family was delighted by Zixuan's excellent result.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: A hearty dinner to celebrate and honor a promise.
description: Mingqiang put on an apron and cooked: braised pork ribs, stir-fried choy sum, and seaweed egg-drop soup. The atmosphere at the table was lively. He picked ribs for Zixuan and promised on the spot that after the exam next weekend he would take the whole family to the toy store in Yixin City to buy the electronic building blocks Zixuan had been wanting. Zixuan jumped with joy and said he would work even harder. The family chatted and laughed and ate with great enjoyment.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening family entertainment time
description: After dinner, Mingqiang took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes, letting his wife rest. Then he watched an episode of their favorite animated film "Kung Fu Panda" with the two children. Hanhan snuggled in his arms, while Zixuan leaned beside him, occasionally discussing the plot. The warm family atmosphere made Mingqiang's fatigue of the day vanish.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Final review and gap-filling before the exam
description: After settling the two children, Mingqiang went into the study for the final systematic review before the exam. Instead of doing new problems, he quickly flipped through all his notes, the key points Master Li had marked, and the wrong answers in the problem book. He used a marker to copy easily confused formulas and electrical parameters onto large sheets of paper and taped them in front of his desk. Finally, he put his exam admission ticket and ID card in a transparent document folder and hung it on the coat hook by the door to make sure everything was ready for the next day.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: At 21:00, I finished reviewing. I first got hot water to soak my feet and did 10 minutes of stretching on the floor to relax my waist, neck, and shoulders. Then I changed into pajamas, chatted with my wife about everyday matters, and discussed the weekend plans. I set my phone alarm for 5:50, turned off Wi-Fi and mobile data, lay in bed recalling tomorrow's exam precautions, and felt fully prepared and at peace. Then I turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning stretching and breakfast.
description: He woke up naturally at 5:50 a.m., got up quietly so as not to wake his wife. After using the bathroom, he weighed himself at 71.3 kg, then did 15 minutes of core stretching in the living room, including superman exercise, glute bridge, plank, etc. For breakfast, he heated steamed buns and milk in the microwave with pickled mustard. Afterward, he took the stuffed buns to bring for the next day's exam out of the freezer to thaw, and checked the e-bike keys and charger.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuting by electric bike
description: He changed into his dark blue work uniform, took his commuting bag and water bottle, and rode his e-bike from home along Jinmao Middle Road, Haixiu Middle Road, and Haisheng Road. At 6:48 he arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, where his company is located, and parked the bike in the dedicated shed.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-shift preparation and work arrangements.
description: After entering the company, change into work clothes and get hot water. At 7:15, Shift Leader Zhang arrived, specifically encouraged exam preparation, and arranged today's work as leading apprentice Zhao Qiang to organize the warehouse's Q3 ledger, allowing himself to focus on exam prep without field assignments.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organizing and checking warehouse ledgers.
description: In the tool and materials warehouse, he and Zhao Qiang checked the third-quarter ledger item by item, focusing on consumption records such as the World Trade Building transformer fault and the Jianshe New Village cable repair. They found that the actual cable used in last month's cable repair was 12 meters more than what was on the material requisition form, and he made detailed notes. While Zhao Qiang sorted the documents, he closed his eyes and reviewed PLC ladder diagram knowledge.
location: Tool and Material Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and conversation between master and apprentice.
description: Took Zhao Qiang to the 'Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant' near the company for a meal. He ordered spicy soup rice with a fried egg, and Zhao Qiang ordered pig trotters rice. During the meal, he encouraged Zhao Qiang to build a solid foundation and get his certification as soon as possible, emphasizing that technical skill is the foundation of one's career.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After returning to the company, he lay down on the folding bed in the workshop lounge, covered his eyes with a hat, completely emptied his mind, and took a 45-minute deep nap to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Workshop rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Warehouse wrap-up and spare parts list organization
description: After the midday break, he continued to lead Zhao Qiang in checking low-value consumables, handwriting a list of spare parts that needed to be replenished, including 5 100A AC contactors, 10 thermal relay bases, one roll of 2.5 mm² red solid copper wire, and so on. Then he stapled the checking records together for handover.
location: Tool and Material Warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Reporting work and leaving early.
description: Reported the ledger reconciliation to Squad Leader Zhang, explaining the cable usage discrepancy and on-site loss judgment. The squad leader was satisfied and approved leaving work early to prepare for the exam. Later, he organized the next day's exam tools, putting a screwdriver, a multimeter, and a pen into a clean tool bag, and placed it in the cabinet.
location: Workshop office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Refueling and buying fruit
description: He left the company by bike and first went to the Sinopec Xiuying gas station to fill up with No. 95 gasoline. During the trip, he called his wife to ask what fruit she wanted, then went to Baiguoyuan to buy a Hami melon, red-cheek strawberries, and Shine Muscat grapes, spending more than 80 yuan.
location: Sinopec Xiuying Gas Station, 107-111 Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; Baiguoyuan (Zhidi Garden Store), No. 2 Mingzhu Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child interaction time
description: After returning home, he played LEGO with his younger son building an aircraft carrier. After the elder son came home from school, he taught him to use electronic building blocks to build a planetary engine model, explained positive and negative poles, and lit up a small bulb. The children were very excited.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: His wife made Wenchang white-cut chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the table, they listened to the eldest son tell funny stories about school, and he also shared an embarrassing childhood story about falling out of a tree while picking coconuts. The whole family was relaxed and happy.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-dinner chores and games.
description: Cleared the dishes and put them into the dishwasher, then played the ride-a-horse game with the children and told a simplified version of The Three Musketeers, changing the character names to those of his workmates to amuse the children.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-exam supply check
description: Checked tomorrow's exam supplies together with his wife, including ID card, admission ticket, black pens, spare pen refills, calculator, and screwdriver. After finding the calculator battery low, he replaced the button cell. All items were put in a transparent document bag and placed on the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped with household chores and put the children to sleep
description: Helped his wife bathe the two sons, told the younger son to be obedient at kindergarten, then sat by the elder son's bed listening to him read the Father and Son comic, turned off the light, and gently patted him until he fell asleep.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Soaking feet to relax and stretching.
description: He boiled water and used the electric foot bath basin to soak his feet, adding mugwort. While soaking, he scrolled through local news and chatted with his wife about the next day's plans. After 20 minutes of soaking, he did 15 minutes of stretching to ease his lower back and shoulders.
location: Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After washing his face and changing into pajamas, he lay down, dimmed the bedside lamp, and had a brief exchange with his wife about the next day's wake-up time. After turning off the light, he closed his eyes and calmed his mind, recalling his master's advice: 'Stay steady and solve problems step by step.' Before long, he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Main bedroom, Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The sky was just beginning to lighten, and his biological clock woke him up on time. He got out of bed quietly, weighed himself on the scale, and recorded today's weight as 71.4 kg. Then he washed up in the bathroom, and in front of the mirror silently recited the exam formula he had prepared last night: “Easy first, then difficult; take it step by step; don't dwell.” He was building up his mental readiness one last time.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Core activation stretching
description: Unroll the yoga mat and do a 15-minute core stretch in the living room. Last night's sleep quality was good, and my body felt awakened. I focused on several sets of planks and glute bridges to loosen up the calves and lower back that had become stiff from sitting for long periods, preparing for today's long sitting and hands-on work.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and item verification
description: I took out the barbecue pork buns my wife Juanzi had prepared last night from the fridge, heated them up, and quickly finished them with a glass of hot milk. Then I went to the entranceway, took out my ID card, admission ticket, calculator (I deliberately pressed a button to confirm it had power), and black pen one by one from the transparent document folder on the shoe cabinet. After verifying everything was correct again, I carefully put them back and zipped it closed.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to the exam
description: He put on his jacket and carefully placed the document folder into the under-seat storage compartment of his electric bike. As he rode the electric bike, a gentle breeze brushed his face and the sunshine was just right. On the way, he replayed in his mind, like a movie, the key points of the PLC programming ladder diagram that his master had emphasized on Wednesday, especially the key steps of the closed material conveying system. The ride took about 20 minutes.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, along the route from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, to Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skills Appraisal Station, No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District

name: Arrival at the exam center and final sprint before the exam
description: Arrived early at the test site of Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skills Appraisal Station. Finding a quiet corner on the flowerbed steps beside the exam room, he took out his homemade 'quick-memory cards for easily confused formulas' and read them in a low voice. Seeing some candidates around him still buried in their books and others chatting, he took a deep breath and steadied his nerves.
location: Outside the examination site of Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skill Appraisal Station, No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan.

name: Theory exam
description: After the proctor handed out the exam papers, he quickly scanned the entire paper and, sure enough, there were a few unfamiliar tricky questions. He frowned slightly but immediately executed his established strategy: first do the questions he was confident about to secure the basic score. When encountering complex calculation and analysis questions, even though he found them difficult, he strictly followed his mentor's 'step-by-step' strategy and neatly wrote down every formula and step he could think of, never leaving a question blank.
location: Inside the examination room of Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skills Appraisal Station, No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Mid-exam break and transfer
description: After handing in the theory exam paper and walking out of the examination room, he let out a long sigh of relief, feeling that the theory section was indeed difficult. According to the original plan, he rode his electric bike to Changlong Hotel about 2 kilometers away, where there was a quiet tea restaurant for a rest and lunch. The ride took about 10 minutes.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, along the route from Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skills Appraisal Station, No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, to Changlong Hotel, Meilan District.

name: A simple lunch and a mental reset.
description: At the tea restaurant on the first floor of Changlong Hotel, he ordered a Hainanese chicken rice and a glass of iced lemon tea. While eating, he mentally encouraged himself: "The theory is what it is. This afternoon is my home turf—no problem!" At the same time, he sent a message to his wife Juanzi on his phone to let her know he was safe: "Finished the theory exam, felt so-so, preparing for the practical test this afternoon."
location: Tea restaurant on the first floor of Changlong Hotel, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch break and final preparations
description: After the meal, he found a corner on the leather sofa in the lobby of Changlong Hotel, sat down, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour to let his mind relax. When he was clear-headed, he carefully rehearsed the afternoon practical procedure in his mind: motor wiring, PLC program entry, and troubleshooting steps, going through every detail. The environment here was quiet and suitable for organizing his thoughts.
location: Lobby lounge area of Changlong Hotel, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province, China.

name: Return to the test center.
description: When the time was about right, he got on his electric bike and rode from Changlong Hotel back to Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skills Appraisal Station at 52 Longhua Road. The ride took about 10 minutes.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, along the route from Changlong Hotel in Meilan District to Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skill Appraisal Station at No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District.

name: Practical skills assessment
description: The afternoon was a home-ground battle! The task was to design and install a motor forward-reverse circuit with PLC control and troubleshoot faults. His movements were steady, the wiring was neat and straight, the crimping was firm, and the work station was clean and orderly. In the troubleshooting stage, relying on years of experience, he listened to sounds and inspected contacts, quickly pinpointing a loosely connected normally closed contact. He finished all tasks 15 minutes ahead of schedule and earned an approving look from the examiner. Leaving the workshop, he let out a long sigh of relief.
location: Practical assessment workshop, Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skill Appraisal Station, 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Triumphant Return After Exam and Family Communication
description: He got on the e-bike, feeling utterly delighted. He immediately called his wife Juanzi: "It's over! I've been through the wringer, but it should be fine!" The children's cheers came through the phone. Smiling, he twisted the throttle and headed home into the sunset.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, along the route from Haikou No. 1 Vocational Skill Assessment Station at No. 52 Longhua Road, Longhua District, to Banshan Garden Residential Community at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: A short stay at home to rest and catch up with family.
description: After arriving home, Xuanxuan and Hanhan immediately crowded around asking all kinds of questions. He picked up his younger son and said to his wife with a smile, "The theory section almost stumped me, but I was quite confident in the practical." The family celebrated briefly, and the little ones were excited and wanted to go fly kites right away.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying ingredients for tomorrow's family visit on the way
description: Before heading to Wanlv Garden, he rode his bike to Huixin Farmers' Market at No. 68 Haiken Road. Remembering that he would be visiting his parents tomorrow, Sunday, he bought three fresh sweet sugarcane stalks, a small bag of fresh peanuts, and a few bananas, which he hung on the handlebars.
location: Huixin Farmers' Market, No. 68 Haiken Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Flying kites at Wanlv Garden
description: The family of four arrived at Evergreen Park. He took out his treasured "traditional eagle" kite. Under his guidance, Xuanxuan tried to fly it on his own. The kite fell several times and then took off again, finally soaring into the sky. Hanhan chased the kite across the lawn, clapping and laughing, while Juanzi stood by, using her phone to record the happy moments of the father and sons. Watching the kite soar in the blue sky, the stress of these past months finally drifted away with the wind.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: On the way home
description: As it grew dark, the family of four rode electric bikes home along Binhai Avenue. Passing by the Jiamie food stall downstairs from their building (No. 506, Shimao South Road), they saw Old Chen smoking at the entrance. He loudly called out a greeting, pointed at the two children on the back seats, and signaled that they were not stopping today.
location: Along the route from Wanlv Garden Park, 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Home celebration banquet
description: He pushed open the door, and the room was filled with aroma. Juanzi had prepared a table of dishes: tender grilled fish, coconut-scented qingbuliang, and the fried chicken wings that Xuanxuan loved. The family sat around the table; he recounted the day's exam experience—the nervousness during the theory test and the pride during the practical test. The children shared fun stories about flying kites, and everyone was happy and warm.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Coaxing the kids to sleep and helping with homework.
description: After eating and drinking his fill, he helped his wife bathe the two little ones, who were still full of energy, and change them into pajamas. He then told them a short bedtime story and watched them fall into a deep sleep. During that time, he also checked Xuanxuan's math homework, found a wrong equation in a word problem, and patiently explained it until he understood.
location: Children's room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Late-night deep talk and future planning
description: After the children fell asleep, the couple sat in the living room drinking tea and eating the leftover qingbuliang, enjoying a rare moment alone together. He carefully reviewed the details of today's exam, and his wife shared the new requirements from recent housekeeping clients. They talked about the plan to buy new clothes for the whole family at the end of the year, and the arrangement to go to Danzhou, to her parents' home, for the Spring Festival. Finally, he brought up the idea of opening a repair workshop again. His wife expressed full support and reminded him to refine the budget and location together after the results came out. They would work out this 'long-term plan' together.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Recovery and summary before bedtime
description: Feeling the day's fatigue and excitement slowly settle, he laid out his yoga mat and did a 15-minute core stretch, focusing on relaxing his shoulders, neck, and wrists, which had become tense from holding the pen and operating equipment for a long time that day. After washing up, he took out his phone and jotted down in his notes app a few unfamiliar knowledge points from today's theory exam, so he could consult his father, an old electrician, when he visited him the next day. Then he dimmed the lights, closed his eyes, and recalled the day—nerve-wracking, fulfilling, satisfying. Carrying hope for the future, he quickly fell asleep.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Getting up, morning preparations, and heading to Wanlv Garden
description: Woke up at 6:00 a.m. by the phone alarm, weighed 71.4 kg in the bedroom, washed up, changed into quick-dry sports T-shirt and shorts, and did 15 minutes of core stretching (plank, glute bridge, superman). Then put on the sports watch and Bluetooth earphones, took the e-bike keys, set off from Banshan Garden Residential Area, rode along Jinmao Middle Road and Binhai Avenue for about 12 minutes, and arrived at the West Gate parking lot of Wanlv Garden Park.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and kite flying
description: At 6:35, he met up with his running buddy Chen Bin under the sculpture at the Coconut Grove Corridor in Wanlv Garden, jogged 5 km along the seaside running track at a pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds per kilometer, and chatted about yesterday's exam while running. After the run, he finished stretching, took the swallow kite from the trunk of his electric scooter, checked and arranged the bridle line, and flew the kite on the small lawn, enjoying the relaxation in the morning breeze. He packed up the kite at 8:00.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home for a shower and family breakfast
description: At 8:00, he rode his electric bike from Wanlv Garden back to his home in Banshan Garden Residential Area. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing breakfast. After taking a shower and changing into loungewear, the whole family enjoyed a breakfast of Baoluo rice noodles and fried eggs. During the meal, he asked his eldest son Lu Zixuan about last night's math homework and playfully got his younger son Lu Zihan to talk about the fun of flying kites the day before.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family financial review and planning.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan opened the account book on the sofa in the living room and checked the month's major expenses item by item, especially reviewing the 10,000 yuan lent to fellow worker Chen Jianguo in March (with an agreement to repay it at the end of the year). After calculating, they confirmed that even if that money was not repaid, they could still get through the New Year smoothly. Then Wang Lijuan shared good news: she had taken on a new regular client in Longhua District, cleaning twice a week, with a monthly income increase of 600 yuan, and the client was satisfied. The couple decided to save the extra income as a special fund for a round-island trip.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy fruit and visit parents to seek advice.
description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to Huixin Farmers' Market in Longhua District and picked out fruits such as bananas, mangosteen, and green jujubes. Then he went to his parents' home at No. 42 Haifu Road, Meilan District. His parents were very happy. He helped his mother pick vegetables and asked his father about the obscure knowledge point in yesterday's exam regarding the grounding types of low-voltage distribution systems in substations. His father gave some suggestions, which he recorded in his small notebook with a red pen. After declining his mother's invitation to stay for a meal, he left at 11:30.
location: Huixin Farmers' Market, No. 68 Haiken Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and his parents' home at No. 42 Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After returning from his parents' home, his wife and children had already eaten. Lu Mingqiang reheated last night's vegetarian clay pot and served it with white rice for lunch. After eating, he lay down in the bedroom, scrolled through the 'Slam Dunk Workers' Squash Club' WeChat group and technical analysis posts for the senior technician exam, then napped for about 40 minutes.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child activities and family time
description: After waking up from his nap, Lu Mingqiang joined his two sons playing with building blocks in the living room. He taught his younger son to build a house and played with the remote-controlled car with his elder son. He noticed the living room ceiling light was not working, got the toolbox, replaced it with a new LED bulb, and briefly explained the principle of circuit on/off to his curious elder son. His wife was in the study making household records.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal relaxation and community activities.
description: Lu Mingqiang went downstairs to the fitness equipment area in the central garden of the residential complex to stretch his muscles and chatted with his neighbor Uncle Wang, who was practicing on the horizontal bar, about the exam the day before. Afterward, at the bulletin board, he saw a notice for the Safe Electricity Use for Every Home public awareness campaign posted by community workers, thought it was meaningful, and said he would be willing to help.
location: Community Park of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family dinner
description: After going upstairs, Lu Mingqiang prepared dinner with his wife. He helped wash and chop vegetables. Wang Lijuan made blanched shrimp, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and garlic oysters. The family of four sat around the table for dinner. Lu Mingqiang shared about changing the light bulb that afternoon and the activity notice, and his son excitedly showed off his building block creation.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Homework tutoring and family interaction
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang cleared the table and washed the dishes while his wife watched cartoons with their younger son. Then he went to the study to help his older son check his math homework, tutoring him through an arithmetic word problem until he understood it. He then spent 15 minutes doing a puzzle game with his younger son.
location: Study and living room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Contacted a colleague to confirm work
description: Lu Mingqiang goes to the study and calls his apprentice Zhao Qiang to ask about the day's situation. He tells him that tomorrow is Monday and work will be as usual, with the task of inspecting and repairing the public lighting lines in the old residential community on Yilong Road. He reminds him to bring his tools and familiarize himself with the wiring diagram.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening stretching, foot soaking, and bedtime preparation
description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang boiled water with a mugwort pack to soak his feet, while reading the chapter on grounding types in 'Advanced Practical Electrical Technology.' After soaking his feet for 20 minutes, he did 15 minutes of core stretching and lower back relaxation on the yoga mat in the bedroom. Then he went into the bedroom, kissed his sleeping son's forehead, and chatted with his wife Wang Lijuan about the next day's work schedule and inviting Chen Jianguo next week to discuss repayment matters. He set the alarm, turned off the lights at 21:30, and went to sleep.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning run
description: After the alarm went off at 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang got up immediately, weighed himself confirming 71.5 kg, then did 15 minutes of core stretching to warm up. At 6:25 he rode his e-bike to Evergreen Park, met up with running buddy Chen Bin, and jogged 5 km along Binhai Avenue at a pace of about 6:35/km. This was a recovery run on the first workday after the exam, so he deliberately controlled the pace. After the run, he did static stretching beside Binhai Avenue, felt his body recovering, and agreed with Chen Bin to run again on Wednesday.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went home, took a shower, and had breakfast
description: At 7:15 he returned home in Banshan Garden. His wife, Wang Lijuan, was preparing breakfast while their two sons were still sleeping. Lu Mingqiang took a quick hot shower and changed into his work clothes. For breakfast he had pineapple buns, boiled eggs, and instant coffee. As he ate, he told his wife that after work he would buy electronic building blocks for Xuanxuan, and said she didn't need to wait for him too late for dinner.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Riding an e-bike to work
description: At 7:45, Lu Mingqiang put on his helmet, grabbed his work bag, and set off by electric bike from Jinmao Middle Road. Riding west along Haixiu Road for about ten-plus minutes, he arrived at the company on Haisheng Road in Xiuying District before 8:00 and parked his bike in the shed.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning crew tasks: cable laying and commissioning
description: Attended the pre-shift meeting at 8:00. Shift Leader Zhang assigned the day's tasks: lay the main power cable for the newly settled food processing factory and complete wiring and commissioning of two power distribution boxes. Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang to collect the cable and tools. From 9:00 to 11:30, they laid YJV cable in the cable trench and on the cable tray. Lu Mingqiang directed the work and stripped and cut the cable terminations, teaching Zhao Qiang hand-over-hand to crimp copper lugs with hydraulic pliers and emphasizing quality checks. At 11:30, the cable termination for the first incoming line cabinet was completed, and the insulation test data met the requirements.
location: Distribution room and workshop, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: After getting off work at noon, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang walked about 8 minutes to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice fast-food restaurant. Lu Mingqiang ordered the signature spicy soup rice and a marinated egg, sweating heavily while eating. During the meal, he reminded Zhao Qiang to bring a headlamp and a multimeter when going to inspect the streetlights in the old residential community after work the next day. At 12:35, after eating, he scrolled on his phone on a plastic chair outside the restaurant and read two technical posts about troubleshooting star-delta reduced-voltage starting faults.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap
description: At 12:50 he returned to the company rest room, pulled down the blackout curtain, leaned back in the folding chair, and closed his eyes for a 15-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon team task: distribution box wiring and wrap-up.
description: Work started at 1 p.m. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang to connect the incoming and outgoing wires of two power distribution boxes in the workshop, explaining the electrical schematic diagram as he operated and helping Zhao Qiang check circuit numbers. Around 3 p.m., all the wiring was completed. Lu Mingqiang used a megohmmeter to measure the insulation resistance of each circuit, and the values were normal. They then energized for commissioning. Under his guidance, Zhao Qiang closed the switch, and the motor's no-load test run went smoothly. At 4:50 p.m., Lu Mingqiang filled out the construction records and inspection forms, reported the completion of the work to Team Leader Zhang, and confirmed the plan to repair the street lights in the old residential area after work tomorrow.
location: New factory building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, shopped for electronic building blocks.
description: At exactly 17:00, Lu Mingqiang left work and rode his electric bike to Jinlong Road, Longhua District. On the way he called his son Xuanxuan to ask if he wanted electronic building blocks and got an excited response. At the Lezhi Toy Store, he went straight to the electronic building blocks section. Following the clerk's recommendation, he chose an intermediate engineering set that included a motor, gears, and a windmill model. After carefully inspecting the parts and the manual, he paid, hung the box carefully on the handlebars, and was full of anticipation for his son's happy face.
location: Lezhi Toy Store, Buildings 1-2, Liheng Garden Commercial Street, No. 68 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go home and claim the reward.
description: Arrived home at 17:40. The 8-year-old Xuanxuan rushed over excitedly. Lu Mingqiang handed him the electronic building blocks and encouraged him to keep working hard for the final exams. Xuanxuan hugged the box, ran into the living room, and opened it; his younger brother Hanhan also came over to look. Lu Mingqiang took off his jacket, sat by the sofa, and helped them go through the instruction manual, briefly explaining the functions of the motor and gears. The father and sons were joyfully together.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner for the family of four
description: At 6:30 PM, Wang Lijuan brought out blanched shrimp, stir-fried pork with green peppers, and tomato and egg soup. During the meal, she announced the good news: the housekeeping client in Longhua District had been settled, with three hours of work on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, earning 600 yuan a month. Added to other odd jobs, her monthly income could exceed 1,000 yuan. Lu Mingqiang said happily that the family would be much better off now, and they wouldn't have to pinch pennies buying new clothes for the children at the end of the year. Xuanxuan and Hanhan joined in the fun, and the dinner atmosphere was lively.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Father and son work together to build a windmill model.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes, then kept his promise to Xuanxuan. Father and son spread all the parts out on the living room coffee table; one read the instructions while the other assembled them. Lu Mingqiang guided the wiring connections, Xuanxuan carefully used a screwdriver to install the gears and windmill blades, and Hanhan watched fascinated from the side. After about 40 minutes, the motor drove the three-blade windmill model successfully spinning. Xuanxuan jumped for joy and held up the model to show off to his mother and younger brother. Lu Mingqiang felt deeply gratified watching his son's excitement.

He changed into quick-dry clothes, went downstairs, and started the morning's 5-kilometer recovery run. At the halfway point, he stopped at the edge of the Rule-of-Law Theme Park and drank a few mouthfuls of water. After running back to the community building, he did another 5 minutes of stretching. When he got home, he was still steaming; Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen and brought to the table a piping-hot bowl of Hainan rice noodles. His younger son, Zihan, clumsily pushed at the noodles with a small spoon, while his elder son, Zixuan, kept saying that he needed to draw an observation diary today. name: Go to Donghu Antique Market to hunt for treasures and organize the collection
description: He put on his helmet, rode his electric bike along Longkun South Road, passed through the underpass of the Haifu Overpass, and headed north. On the way, he stuffed the spare raincoat into the seat compartment. After a little over twenty minutes, he reached Donghu Road and parked in the paid parking lot on the nearby old street. The Sunday street-stall area was lively. He strolled slowly in from the entrance, sweeping his gaze over various old hardware and miscellaneous items. He squatted down in front of a stall that specialized in old odds and ends and rummaged through a cardboard box full of old screwdrivers and iron locks. After more than twenty minutes of searching, his hand touched something cold — a palm-sized copper terminal block. The brass had a natural patina, the two terminal screws still turned smoothly, and the connection end had a dark red old oxidation layer. It looked like an old piece from a Republic of China factory. Secretly delighted, he also discovered an old wooden electrician's toolbox in a pile of tools by the stall owner's feet. It was made of joined solid wood, with iron sheets wrapping the corners; the leather buckle rivets were a bit loose, but the frame was solid overall. Suppressing his excitement, he asked the stall owner the price. The owner asked for 180 yuan. He kept his cool and haggled back and forth for several rounds, finally settling at 130 yuan. He left contentedly carrying the two items. He rode the electric bike back the same way and got home at 10:50, parking the bike in the dedicated bike shed in the open ground-floor area downstairs. Once home, he did not rest. He took out a clean cotton cloth and a small bottle of wood wax oil from the cabinet. He spread old newspapers on the desk, carefully wiped the dust and rust off the terminal block, turned the screws, and confirmed it was in good working condition. Then he carefully scrubbed away the old grime on the wooden toolbox, dipped a soft cloth into the wood wax oil, and evenly wiped every board, restoring the dried wood to an oily luster. He thought to himself that the box was just right for holding his usual set of electrician's tools, and the terminal block could be placed on the bookshelf as an ornament.
location: Donghu Antique Market street-stall area, Donghu Road, Bo'ai Subdistrict, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Take the boys to the Rule of Law Theme Park to fly kites and buy groceries on the way home.
description: Everything was ready. Lu Mingqiang got on his electric bike, with his younger son Zihan standing on the front and his elder son Zixuan riding on the back, and the three of them set off happily. In a few minutes, they arrived at the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park on Yanzao Yiheng Road. The park was nicely landscaped, with large lawns and walking paths. They found an open grassy slope, had Zixuan hold the kite three meters away, and ran backward into the wind while paying out the line and shouting 'Let go!' The eagle kite wobbled up into the sky and soon flew steadily in the wind. The two boys clapped and cheered excitedly, vying for the string reel. Lu Mingqiang handed the reel to Zixuan and taught him to control the height by pulling and releasing the line. When they got tired, the three of them sat on the grass to rest and drink water, and shared some small buns. The afternoon sun felt warm on them. Meanwhile, the wind weakened and the kite came down once, and the three of them worked together to send it back up. It was almost 4 p.m. and the wind had also died down, so Lu Mingqiang packed away the kite and took the two children home. He deliberately made a detour to the food market on Jinmao Middle Road and bought 500 grams of fresh clams and a small bunch of scallions, planning to make stir-fried clams with scallions for the kids in the evening, along with a tomato and egg soup. At 16:25, they returned to Banshan Garden. Once home, he first had the two children wash their hands and faces. Lu Mingqiang put the kite back on the balcony, then poured the clams into a basin in the kitchen, sprinkled some salt on them to let them spit out the sand.

name: Checked and repaired an electrical circuit fault for Uncle Wang, the neighbor.
description: Just after settling the children down, he remembered Uncle Wang mentioning yesterday that the circuit breaker in his house kept tripping. Lu Mingqiang picked up his toolbox and walked to the door of Uncle Wang's unit next door, just as Uncle Wang was about to go downstairs to take out the trash. He took the initiative: "Uncle Wang, I heard you say yesterday that the breaker at your place keeps tripping. Is it convenient now? Let me take a look." Uncle Wang was very grateful and immediately led him inside. The ceiling light in Uncle Wang's living room was on. Lu Mingqiang first asked him to turn off the air conditioner and other high-power appliances. He opened the distribution box and used a multimeter to measure the voltage of the main incoming line; it was normal. He determined that there was a problem with one branch circuit, so he disconnected the branch breakers one by one and watched the air switch. When he disconnected the kitchen circuit, the breaker no longer tripped frequently. After locking onto the target, he initially judged that the kitchen wiring might be aging or an appliance was leaking electricity. He asked Uncle Wang to unplug the refrigerator and microwave in the kitchen, but when he flipped the breaker back on, it still tripped. He borrowed Uncle Wang's telescoping ladder, climbed up to inspect the junction box on the ceiling, and indeed found a tiny crack in the insulation of a wire near the corner. It had probably been scratched by a screw during the original renovation and was leaking due to moisture. He skillfully cut out the damaged section with wire strippers, reconnected the wire, wrapped it with waterproof tape, and carefully wound on insulating tape. Then he closed all the breakers and turned on the kitchen light and outlets; all were normal. After the circuit was fixed, Uncle Wang excitedly shook his hand and insisted on pressing 200 yuan into his hand as a token of appreciation. Lu Mingqiang smiled and pushed it away: "Uncle Wang, it's just a small favor between neighbors, how can I take your money? Next time, just treat me to a cup of laoba tea!" Seeing that he could not persuade him, Uncle Wang kept exclaiming: "Xiao Lu, you have good skills and you're dependable. There really aren't many warm-hearted young people like you these days." The two stood in the hallway for a while longer and chatted about the community switching to smart meters. Then Lu Mingqiang went downstairs and headed home.
location: Uncle Wang's home, the next unit in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Then he washed and drained the clams bought that morning and took two eggs out of the fridge. The couple worked in sync in the kitchen: he minced garlic and chopped scallions, while she beat eggs and cut tomatoes for the evening soup. Dinner was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, stir-fried clams with scallions, and tomato and egg soup. The family chatted about their day's amusing moments while eating. Zixuan excitedly said his kite flew the highest, and Zihan said in a baby voice that she had found a beautiful fallen leaf. Lu Mingqiang sipped his soup and looked at his happy family, feeling full of steadiness and contentment.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Then he made a plan with him about what to wear to school the next day (Monday was a special day, so the school uniform was required). After finishing the homework, he took the two boys to the living room, and the three of them played a block-building game called 'Who Can Build the Tallest Tower.'

After drinking tea for a while, he got up, went into the bedroom, opened the wardrobe, and checked the work clothes he would need for work the next day, confirming that the flashlight, walkie-talkie, and tool bag were all in their proper places. Thinking about Monday's tasks, he felt he had everything under control.

He found the chapter on the traditional dyeing and weaving crafts of the local Li ethnic group very interesting.

date: For each pot, take 3-5 granules (about 0.5 g) each time, dissolve them in 500 ml of water, and water the roots. Apply once every 7-10 days. The day after fertilizing, water again to promote absorption. For lettuce seedlings, halve the dosage to avoid leggy growth.

description: Lu Mingqiang had his annual physical examination at the hospital health examination center. He paid out of pocket for an additional four-item blood lipid test. After all items were completed, the immediate results were printed: weight 71kg, BMI 23.9, blood pressure normal. Hungry after fasting, he went to the staff cafeteria on the first floor and used his staff card to buy white congee, tea eggs, and steamed buns, spending 5 yuan to regain energy. While eating, he checked the electronic report on his mobile app and learned that it would be available to view tomorrow afternoon. Overall, he felt in good health.

Before bed, he set the alarm for 6:40 the next morning, said goodnight to his wife, who was still memorizing English, and after turning off the lights, thinking about the smooth medical checkup and harmonious family, he fell asleep peacefully around 22:30.

name: Early morning run and discussion of physical exam reports with running friends
description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang left his home at Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, and walked about 20 minutes to Wanlv Garden Park for a morning run. Lu Mingqiang took out his phone and showed Chen Bin the electronic medical check-up report that the hospital's WeChat official account had pushed last night, pointing out that his total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein were high. Chen Bin patted his shoulder and reminded him to pay attention to his health. The two discussed how to adjust his diet and stick to exercise for more than ten minutes. Chen Bin also suggested going swimming together on the weekend. At 7:20 they said goodbye, and Lu Mingqiang walked home.

Wang Lijuan agreed without hesitation and offered to make steamed sea bass that evening, adding that she would buy fewer colas and planned to go to the supermarket to pick out some good Laobaicha tea leaves.
