Because of the reminders from his physical examination report, Lu Mingqiang deliberately ordered only a portion of skinless white cut chicken, a serving of green vegetables, and a small bowl of rice—different from his usual meal. Chen Jianguo teased him for eating too plainly, so Lu Mingqiang briefly shared the physical exam report and reminded his colleagues to watch their blood lipids too. The meal was paid for by Lu Mingqiang, 22 yuan in total.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company break room and lay down on a folding bed to rest for about 30 minutes. Before dozing off, he set an alarm on his phone for 2:30 pm to go to the bank, so he wouldn't forget to open an account for his son.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon inspection and installation work
description: Right after work started in the afternoon, Shift Leader Zhang sent Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang to a resettlement housing community under construction near Yehai Avenue, Chengxi Town, Longhua District, to assist the developer in installing corridor distribution boxes. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang through on-site measurement and positioning, and guided the installation of guide rails and air switches, explaining operating procedures and safety precautions at every step. At 2:10 p.m., the work came to a temporary halt. Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools and prepared to go to the bank.
location: An under-construction resettlement community near Yehai Avenue, Chengxi Town, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: He took leave and went to the bank to open an education savings account for his son.
description: Lu Mingqiang asked Squad Leader Zhang for one and a half hours of leave and rode an electric bike from the community in Chengxi Town straight to the Bank of China Haikou Longhua Sub-branch on Longhua Road, Longhua District. He confirmed that the household register, ID card, and 500 yuan in cash in the inner pocket of his work clothes were all there. After arriving at the bank, he took a number and waited about 8 minutes before his turn. He told the teller he wanted to open an education savings account for his son Lu Zixuan, filled out the forms, and deposited an initial 500 yuan. About 15 minutes later, he received a brand-new passbook, put it away carefully, rode back to the company, and returned to his workstation at exactly 16:00.
location: Bank of China Haikou Longhua Sub-branch, Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned to the company to compile the work attendance records.
description: After returning to the office at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, Lu Mingqiang completed the afternoon's inspection and installation work records and checked the tools and materials needed for the next day. In his phone memo, he listed the healthy ingredients to buy in the evening: sea bass, lettuce, broccoli, mixed grain premix rice, and sugar-free Laoba tea. Before leaving work, he used the team's landline to call his wife Wang Lijuan, told her that the bank matter was handled, and asked her not to buy groceries because he would pick them up on his way home after work.
location: Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: After work, buy healthy ingredients and clear out the snacks at home.
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang cycled directly to the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket near Banshan Garden (No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road). Following his memo, he picked two live sea bass in the seafood section (25 yuan), bought a catty of lettuce, a head of broccoli, and a bag of mixed grain rice in the vegetable section (15 yuan), and half a catty of sugar-free Laobaicha tea leaves in the dried goods section (35 yuan). After returning home, he put all the high-calorie snacks on the coffee table—peanuts, potato chips, crackers, and so on—into the top cabinet in the kitchen, determined to help the whole family develop healthy eating habits by adopting an out of sight, out of mind approach.
location: Vegetable Basket Community Affordable Supermarket, No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner on the first day of the low-fat diet.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan, following Lu Mingqiang's earlier request, prepared a light and delicious dinner: steamed sea bass (with only shredded ginger, scallion sections, and a little steamed fish soy sauce), blanched lettuce and broccoli, and multigrain rice. Lu Mingqiang voluntarily ate only fish and vegetables, and only a small half bowl of rice. The children noticed their father's change. Lu Zixuan asked why he didn't pick up meat, and Lu Mingqiang smiled and said he wanted to become stronger and healthier. At the dinner table, Lu Mingqiang showed Lu Zixuan the bankbook he had processed that afternoon, telling him that this was money saved for his future college education. Zixuan curiously looked through it several times.
location: At home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family evening time: homework tutoring, parent-child reading, and tea tasting
description: After resting for 20 minutes after dinner, at about 19:50 Lu Mingqiang sat down next to Lu Zixuan to check his math homework. He found a division word problem with an error and patiently guided Zixuan to work out the correct answer himself. At 20:30, Lu Zihan came over carrying "Guess How Much I Love You". Lu Mingqiang sat him on his lap and read it aloud word by word, and Zixuan also came over to listen. At 21:00, his wife Wang Lijuan coaxed the two children to wash up and go to bed, while Lu Mingqiang boiled water in the living room and made himself a cup of tea with the newly bought sugar-free Laobaicha tea leaves. The tea tasted crisp and refreshing, and he felt very comfortable.
location: At home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Squash
description: At 21:00, Lu Mingqiang changed into his sportswear, drove from Banshan Garden to a squash court in a commercial building on Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, a drive of about 12 minutes. At 21:10 he started a squash match with his friend Lin Feng, three games in total. Although his stamina lagged a little in the early stages, his core strength and touch stayed solid. After the match, Lin Feng took him to the venue's yoga area for an additional 20 minutes of core training, including planks, crunches and lying leg raises, and suggested he also practice HIIT at home. Lu Mingqiang recorded the evening's workout data with his fitness app, packed up his gear at 21:50, and drove home.
location: A squash court inside a commercial building on Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: After exercising, Lu Mingqiang returned home, took a quiet shower, and changed into pajamas. He brewed another cup of sugar-free Laobaicha and carried it to the study, but instead of drinking it right away, he sat down at his desk, opened his diary, and wrote about how he felt today: the first day of the low-fat diet, his body felt light; the bank passbook was done, a major task completed; his evening workout went well. He encouraged himself to keep going. After writing, he drank half a cup of tea and felt completely refreshed. Then he set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning, checked the work clothes he would wear and the lunchbox he would take at noon. At around 10:40 p.m., he lay down on the bed, and his wife was already sound asleep. Recalling how all of the day’s plans had been carried out, he felt especially at ease and soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning school drop-off and family preparations
description: At 06:30 Lu Mingqiang got up, washed up, and noticed the sky outside was gloomy, so he deliberately brought an extra waterproof jacket. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared a lunchbox (mixed grain rice, blanched broccoli, chicken breast, and an apple). At 06:45 he rode his e-bike to take his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School. On the way, he asked about the math homework and comforted his son, telling him to ask the teacher more questions in class. At 07:00 he returned to pick up his younger son Lu Zihan and headed to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. The little boy was throwing a tantrum, so Lu Mingqiang asked the teacher to help calm him down. After dropping off the children, he used a 0.5-yuan coin to buy a bag of cookies at the Xiangzhi General Store next to the kindergarten, planning to have a snack during his work break.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District

name: Commuting to work and pre-work preparation
description: At 07:20, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike from Banshan Garden and headed to the company along Jinmao Middle Road, Longkun North Road, and Haisheng Road, arriving at about 07:40. After arriving, he changed into work clothes and checked the tools needed for cable laying (grinder, heat-shrink tubing, insulating tape, etc.), confirming they were complete and fully charged. Then he held a brief morning meeting with his partner Chen Jianguo and apprentice Zhao Qiang. Team leader Zhang called to assign today's tasks and safety precautions for the extension section of Binhai West Road.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning cable trench laying and return trip
description: At 08:00, the three arrived at the construction site at No. 3, Binhai West Road Extension, Xiuying District, in an engineering vehicle. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for cable uncoiling, pulling, and positioning in the trench, working in close coordination with Chen Jianguo, while Zhao Qiang learned cable binding alongside. After about 45 minutes, they took a break to hydrate. At 10:30 during the work break, Lu Mingqiang ate the biscuits and boiled chicken breast he had brought, and Chen Jianguo shared a banana, chatting about healthy eating tips. At 10:45 they resumed work, completed the remaining cable laying, and Lu Mingqiang checked that the bending radius was acceptable. At 11:45 they finished, packed up the tools, took the engineering vehicle back to the company, and arrived at 12:00.
location: Construction site at No. 3, Extension Section of Binhai West Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (near cable well No. 11)

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At 12:00, Lu Mingqiang ate the lunch his wife had prepared in the company break area: mixed grain rice, blanched broccoli, and chicken breast. After eating, he took a photo and sent it to the family group chat, praising his wife's cooking. After the meal, he walked back and forth to aid digestion, stretched his arms and legs, then leaned back in his chair and browsed photos of old Coconut Palm brand wine bottles from the 1970s in the collector friends group. At 13:00 he closed his eyes for a nap.
location: Rest area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon: cable joint making and testing.
description: At 13:00, he returned to the construction site to make cable joints and restore the insulation layer. Lu Mingqiang personally stripped the cable outer sheath and guided Zhao Qiang in using a heat gun to heat the heat-shrink tubing. Each joint was strictly operated according to process standards. At 15:30, all work was completed, and the insulation test passed smoothly.
location: Construction site No. 3, Binhai West Road Extension, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon cleanup and record-keeping
description: Starting at 15:30, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang cleaned up construction waste and packaged the scrap materials. At 16:00, they returned to the company office. Lu Mingqiang filled out the work attendance record, construction log, and material requisition form, recorded the insulation test data, and signed to confirm.
location: Construction site No. 3, Binhai West Road Extension, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; and Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road.

name: After-work shopping and returning home
description: Got off work at 16:30. Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike to RT-Mart Guomao Store and picked low-fat ingredients: broccoli, lettuce, chicken breast, carrots, and apples. At 17:00 he walked home, picked up the dishwashing liquid his wife bought from the parcel locker at the community gate, arrived home at 17:15, and put away the tool bag.
location: No. 8 Mingzhu Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, RT-Mart (Guomao Store) to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Evening family time
description: After getting home at 17:20, Lu Mingqiang changed into loungewear and played with his younger son Lu Zihan with take-apart toys, teaching him how to tighten screws and build frames. His wife Wang Lijuan was in the kitchen preparing dinner (steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, blanched broccoli, and mixed-grain rice). At 18:00, the eldest son Lu Zixuan came home from school, and the family of four had dinner together, talking about the construction site and the sons' homework. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang continued playing with Hanhan while keeping an eye on the weather, glad he had brought a jacket in the morning.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Night emergency repair and return
description: At 19:00, customer Li Jianguo called, saying that his electrical appliance repair shop on Haifu Road, Meilan District had lost all power and the circuit breaker would not close. Lu Mingqiang judged that the main line had burned out, reassured him, and immediately contacted his partner Chen Jianguo. The two took their tools and drove over. They arrived at 19:35 and used a multimeter to test, finding that the main circuit was burned. The two divided the work: Lu Mingqiang cut off the burnt wire ends, re-stripped and crimped the wires, while Chen Jianguo secured the cables and wrapped them with insulating tape. It took half an hour to complete the replacement. At 20:05, they closed the circuit breaker and restored power, testing all equipment and finding it normal. Boss Li settled the bill at 90 yuan and gave them iced black tea. At 20:15, they headed back, first dropping Chen Jianguo off at home, and Lu Mingqiang arrived home at 20:45.
location: Li Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Haifu Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening rest at home and bedtime
description: After arriving home at 20:45, Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower to relax. Then he brewed a cup of sugar-free laoba tea, sat on the sofa, and recorded the day's diet and his weight of 70.9 kg. At 21:15, he discussed the next day's grocery shopping plan with his wife Wang Lijuan and thanked her for preparing the bento. At 21:45, he went to bed, browsed the image of a 1970s ship-shaped old baijiu bottle in the collector group, set his alarm, and turned off the light at 22:15. He fell asleep peacefully at 22:30.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning school drop-off and commute preparation.
description: He woke up naturally in the morning and first stepped on the scale, which showed 71.0 kg. He reminded himself to strictly follow the health plan starting today and continue with a low-fat diet. After washing up, he had breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan in the kitchen: Hainan rice noodles with boiled eggs, fresh and savory. He reminded his eldest son Lu Zixuan about the math quiz — read the questions carefully first and finish the ones he could do. Then he rode the electric bike, first taking Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, watching him enter the school gate, then turning back to take his younger son Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten. He coaxed the little one at the gate for a bit; today the little guy didn't dawdle in bed. After dropping off the kids, he rode straight to the company and bought two hot steamed buns from the breakfast stall at the entrance of the industrial park for his partner Chen Jianguo. At the office he changed into work clothes, checked his tool bag to confirm the multimeter, screwdrivers and other tools were all there, and sent his wife a WeChat message to meet at the bank at 3:30 in the afternoon.
location: Longhua District and Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province: starting from Half Mountain Garden residential area at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, passing Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road and Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Team morning meeting
description: Attended the team morning meeting on time. Team Leader Zhang assigned today's task: go to Huandao Tower on Haidian Island to troubleshoot the main tripping fault of distribution boxes on multiple floors. Lu Mingqiang was designated to lead, with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang as team members. The team leader stressed that safety measures in the high-rise office building must be in place. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang mentioned to the team leader his request for leave in the afternoon, and the team leader said he could leave directly after finishing the job.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Fault inspection and repair of the distribution box at Huandao Building
description: The team drove a small pickup truck to Huandao Building on Haidian Island, taking Binhai Avenue and turning onto Renmin Avenue. The traffic was a bit congested, and they arrived in about 28 minutes. After coordinating with the property electrician, they learned that the main distribution boxes on the 15th and 16th floors of Block B kept tripping frequently. Lu Mingqiang led Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to start from the control cabinet, measuring the circuits section by section with a multimeter, and determined that the main switch had aged and the branch circuits were damp. The three worked together to remove the old switch, clean the rust on the terminal block, replace it with a new 160A air switch, and crimp the main cable again. Zhao Qiang handed them tools and recorded data nearby. Near noon, they closed the switch for testing, everything was normal, and the task was successfully completed.
location: Huandao Building, No. 1 Haidian Fourth East Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After work, on the way with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, Lu Mingqiang went to the “Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant” on Haisheng Road for lunch. To follow his health plan, he ordered skinless chicken leg rice and asked for less oil and salt, and also talked Chen Jianguo out of ordering braised pork, reminding him to pay attention to his physical exam report. After the meal, he rested with his eyes closed on a chair in the restaurant for about twenty minutes to restore his energy.
location: Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Xianghe Jiayuan, No. 8 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon wrap-up and request for compensatory time off.
description: After returning to the company, he carefully filled in the day's field work records and construction log, cleaned the borrowed tools, and put them back in place. Seeing it was almost 2:30, Lu Mingqiang went to Team Leader Zhang's office and successfully asked for leave. Then he changed into a clean jacket, took out from the cabinet a document folder containing cash and documents (household register, the couple's ID cards), carefully put it into his inner pocket, got on his electric bike, and navigated to the Bank of China on Longhua Road.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cycling to the bank
description: Heading east along the Haixiu Expressway and then turning onto Longkun North Road, the afternoon traffic was not heavy, and it felt slightly cool. Lu Mingqiang was thinking about meeting his wife to take care of the bankbook matter, and at the thought of being able to talk to his eldest son about this education fund in the evening, he felt reassured and expectant.
location: In Haikou City, Hainan Province, from Haisheng Road in Xiuying District to Bank of China, No. 48 Longhua Road, Longhua District.

name: Open an education savings account for the eldest son.
description: At the bank entrance, he met his wife Wang Lijuan, who was holding their second son, Lu Zihan, and together they entered the Bank of China Haikou Longhua Sub-branch. Guided by the teller, using their son Lu Zixuan’s household register information, they opened an education savings account in Lu Mingqiang’s name. His wife took an envelope containing 500 yuan in cash out of her bag and deposited it, and on the spot filled out an authorization agreement for a monthly automatic transfer of 200 yuan. After it was done, the teller handed over a brand-new passbook printed with Zixuan’s name. Lu Mingqiang looked through it, carefully tucked it into his document folder, and said to his wife, “No matter how our income changes, this money will be put aside every month without fail. In ten years it will be enough for our Xuanxuan to go to college.” His wife smiled and nodded.
location: Bank of China Haikou Longhua Sub-branch, No. 48 Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Buy groceries, go home, and put away the bankbook.
description: After leaving the bank, he had his wife take Zihan home first on the electric bike. Lu Mingqiang himself stopped by Daying Farmers' Market on the way. Considering that the next day was the weekend and he didn't need to pack a lunchbox, he bought fresh sea bass, water spinach, shrimp, and ginger, scallions, garlic, and other ingredients, preparing to cook a nice meal for the family. After arriving home, he put the groceries in the kitchen, took off his coat, carried the bankbook and document folder into the bedroom, locked them in the nightstand drawer together with the family's important documents, and felt a great sense of relief.
location: From Daying Farmers' Market, Daying Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District

name: Dinner and family time.
description: His wife was preparing dinner in the kitchen, while Lu Mingqiang tutored his eldest son Zixuan in math homework and checked the day's quiz paper. Before dinner, he took the brand-new bankbook from the bedroom and placed it on the dining table, explaining to Zixuan the meaning and agreement of education savings. Zixuan listened very seriously and finally nodded firmly. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang played with his younger son Zihan with a magnetic puzzle, and then helped his wife clear the tableware. The family of four enjoyed a warm time together.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Junior high school classmates' year-end gathering
description: Before leaving, Lu Mingqiang changed into a clean dark polo shirt, brought his own sugar-free oolong tea, said goodbye to his wife, and rode his electric bike west along Binhai Avenue, arriving at the Haowei Food Stall Old Pier branch over ten minutes later. The gathering organizer Wu Gang had already booked a large round table, and Zhou Wei and several other old classmates arrived one after another. Everyone ordered the signature grilled fish and local stir-fries. Lu Mingqiang only drank his own tea and clinked glasses with old friends while catching up. Topics ranged from their jobs and children's studies to the changes in Haikou city. The group, who had grown up in the industrial area, lamented the demolition and renovation of old factory buildings and the fading of childhood memories. Lu Mingqiang took a sip of tea and suggested that during the Spring Festival several families should take their kids to the cultural and creative park converted from the old Xiuying industrial area to look for traces of the past. The gathering was lively and lasted until 10:30 p.m. before breaking up.
location: Haowei Food Stall Old Wharf Branch, near Gangwan Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home, wash up, and go to bed
description: After the gathering ended, Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to his classmates and rode his electric bike home. The night breeze was cool and refreshing. All the important matters had been taken care of, and catching up with old friends made him feel even more grounded. When he got home, he opened the door quietly, took a hot shower, and felt relaxed all over. Lying in bed, he glanced at his phone and replied to a few messages in the class group. Reflecting on the whole day—work went smoothly, family matters were settled, and friends had gathered—although he went to bed later than usual, he felt especially fulfilled. He turned off the light, closed his eyes, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and weight measurement
description: On Saturday morning, the sun was warm, and his body clock woke Lu Mingqiang right at 7 a.m. Returning late from the class reunion the night before had not affected his good sleep. After getting up, he first went to the bathroom, then stepped on the electronic scale and saw that his weight remained stable at 70.9 kg, same as yesterday, which gave him, who had been sticking to a low-fat diet, a bit of comfort. Then he washed up briefly and started a new day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast and discussion of the day’s arrangements
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang walked into the kitchen, where his wife Wang Lijuan was cooking noodles. The elder son Lu Zixuan was already sitting at the dining table drinking milk, while the younger son Lu Zihan excitedly shouted, 'Today is my birthday!' Lu Mingqiang took the plain porridge and side dishes his wife handed him, and while eating, discussed the day's plan with the family: first go buy building blocks and a cake, have a simple lunch, and then decorate the living room in the afternoon to celebrate Hanhan's 4th birthday in advance. The brief breakfast time was filled with family warmth.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went out to buy a birthday gift and cake and then returned home
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang quickly cleaned up the dishes, went downstairs to check the electric scooter, wiped off the dew, and made sure the battery was sufficiently charged. Then he rode the electric scooter with his wife Wang Lijuan eastward along Jinmao Middle Road, arriving at Toys "R" Us (Haikou N Power Park Store) 5 minutes later. Inside the store, following the staff's recommendation, they picked out an electric building block set that could assemble a small car and a helicopter for their younger son, and paid for it. Next, they walked about 3 minutes across Yusha Road to Xixi Pastry (Guomao City Store), ordered a 6-inch fresh milk fruit cake, agreed to pick it up at 3 p.m., and also bought a pack of colorful balloons and a string of small colorful lights. On the way back, they walked about 8 minutes to Banshan Garden. Along the way, Lu Mingqiang remembered his high cholesterol, so he picked out a few bananas and some Red Fuji apples at the fruit stall by the community gate. The whole shopping trip was compact and smooth, making material preparations for the birthday celebration.
location: Toys 'R' Us (Haikou N Power Park Store), No. 5 Jinmao East Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Xi Xi Dim Sum (Guomao City Store), No. 21 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Rested at home, spent time with the children, and studied the building block instruction manual.
description: After getting home, his younger son Hanhan saw the bag of toys and immediately ran over excitedly. Lu Mingqiang told him to wash his hands first, then sat down on the sofa, took out the instruction manual for the newly bought electric building blocks, and studied it carefully, focusing on the key steps of motor installation and gear meshing. He felt confident about the assembly. His older son Xuanxuan also came over curiously, asking all kinds of questions, and his father patiently answered. During this time, Lu Mingqiang rested while enjoying close interaction with his two children, making good preparations for the afternoon assembly activity.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helped his wife prepare lunch and the whole family had a simple meal together.
description: Around noon, his wife Wang Lijuan began preparing lunch. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to help in the kitchen by picking and washing vegetables, and specifically reminded his wife that since his physical exam showed high cholesterol, lunch should be low in oil and salt. Lunch was Hainan noodles, a specialty of Juanzi, served with blanched greens, simple and tasty. The whole family sat together to eat. Lu Mingqiang only had a small bowl to control his diet, while his younger son Hanhan was distracted, constantly turning to look at the building block box on the coffee table, eagerly anticipating the birthday celebration.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family midday rest
description: After the meal, his wife Juanzi took the younger son Hanhan to the bedroom for a nap. Lu Mingqiang asked the elder son Xuanxuan to turn down the TV volume, then leaned back on the living room sofa with his eyes closed and took a half-hour nap. Xuanxuan was full of energy and quietly played with a jigsaw puzzle nearby. The short nap restored Lu Mingqiang's energy and recharged him for the afternoon activities.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went alone to Wanlv Park for a relaxing walk
description: After waking from his nap, the weather was fine, so Lu Mingqiang decided to go to Wanlv Park alone to get some fresh air. He changed into his sneakers and walked 10 minutes to Wanlv Park. He strolled about 40 minutes on the park paths, admiring the sailboats and seagulls in the distance while feeling the sea breeze on his face, which made him feel open-minded and relaxed. After leaving the park, he bought a copy of Hainan Daily at a newsstand, then walked home and rested for a while. This walk refreshed his body and mind.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the cake shop to pick up the cake and pick up a package along the way.
description: At 1:40 p.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bicycle to Xixi Bakery to pick up a cake. He arrived five minutes later. His wife had already sent the pickup code to his phone; he gave the number to the clerk, who took a beautifully packaged 6-inch fresh cream fruit cake out of the refrigerator. He carefully hung the cake on the bike's hook, stopped by the parcel station at the community gate to pick up a package that had arrived the day before, and then returned home to prepare for the upcoming setup.
location: Xixi Dim Sum (Guomao City Store), No. 21 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The whole family worked together to set up the birthday ambiance in the living room
description: After bringing the cake home, the whole family began the big project of decorating the living room. His wife Juanzi was in charge of blowing up balloons. Lu Mingqiang brought a stool and fixed the string lights along the edge of the TV cabinet. The eldest son Xuanxuan volunteered as the transporter, handing balloons to his mother to stick on the wall. The youngest son Hanhan ran around excitedly in the pile of balloons. After more than half an hour, the living room was transformed; the wall was covered with balloons spelling "Happy Birthday", the string lights twinkled, and it felt very warm. The birthday celebration atmosphere was fully set.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the whole family to the Rule of Law Theme Park to fly kites.
description: After the living room was decorated, there was still some time before the evening celebration. Lu Mingqiang suggested taking the whole family to the park to fly kites, and his wife thought it was a good idea. He brought out a colorful eagle kite he had made himself from the storage room, and the family walked about 15 minutes to the Hainan Free Trade Port Rule of Law Theme Park. Lu Mingqiang skillfully let out the line and ran, and the eagle kite soon soared high. Hanhan and Xuanxuan clapped and jumped with joy, while Juanzi took many photos with her phone. The family enjoyed the outdoor sunshine and parent-child time, full of joy and harmony.
location: Hainan Free Trade Port Rule-of-Law Theme Park, at the intersection of Longkun North Road and Yanzao No. 1 Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: On the way back, buy drinks and go home to wash up and prepare for the celebration
description: After playing for nearly an hour, Lu Mingqiang, worried that the children might be tired, packed up the kites and walked home. Passing the small shop at the entrance of the residential community, he bought a bottle of yogurt for Xuanxuan and Hanhan each, and a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea for himself. Back home, the whole family simply washed their hands and faces. Lu Mingqiang took the cake out of the box, placed it in the center of the coffee table, and inserted 4 candle-shaped colored lights. His wife went to the kitchen to wash and cut fruit and arrange it on a plate. Everything was ready, just waiting for the celebration to begin.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Warm family birthday celebration
description: Once everything was ready, Lu Mingqiang turned off the main living room light, and the colored lights softly illuminated the whole space. The whole family sat around, clapping and singing the birthday song. The birthday child Hanhan looked at the flickering candlelight, his little face flushed. Encouraged by everyone, he puffed out his cheeks and blew out all the candles. When cutting the cake, Lu Mingqiang cut only a small piece for himself to control calories. The family shared the sweet cake, and the room was filled with laughter and blessings. Although Hanhan's 4th birthday was celebrated early, it was just as warm and unforgettable.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child electric building block assembly interaction
description: After the celebration, Lu Mingqiang opened the building block box and poured the pieces onto the carpet. He took out the instructions and patiently guided his younger son Hanhan in installing the motor and gears, demonstrating how to align the red gear with the groove and press it down firmly. With his father's help, a small motorized car began to take shape after half an hour. Once the batteries were installed, the car ran across the floor with a buzz. Hanhan joyfully chased the car around the living room, and his older brother Xuanxuan joined in too. The laughter of the two brothers filled the whole home. The fun of hands-on parent-child activity made the evening even more heartwarming.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Clean the living room and bathe the children
description: After the playtime, the living room was a mess. Lu Mingqiang and his wife split the work: Juanzi cleaned up the cake plates and fruit scraps from the coffee table, while Lu Mingqiang put away the building blocks. Then he took the two children to the bathroom to bathe. He first helped his older son Xuanxuan take a shower, then focused on washing the younger son Hanhan's hair, making sure both children were thoroughly clean. After that, the children changed into clean pajamas and felt refreshed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tuck the children in and have evening chats with your spouse
description: After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang and his wife each took one child and told bedtime stories for a while. Hanhan and Xuanxuan, tired from playing, soon fell into a deep sleep. The couple tiptoed to the living room. Lu Mingqiang made two cups of unsweetened Laoba tea, turned on the TV, and chatted about everyday matters while watching the news. In the quiet space, the two enjoyed rare time together as a couple, sharing their feelings about the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, weigh in, and record the day's routine.
description: After chatting with his wife, Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. After coming out, he stepped on the scale again. The reading was still 70.9kg, so his weight was well controlled. He returned to the bedroom, picked up his phone, and simply jotted down a life diary entry: “November 29, Saturday, sunny. Had an early birthday celebration for Hanhan, bought building blocks and a cake. Flew kites at Fazhi Park in the afternoon, and the whole family celebrated in the evening. Happy. Weight 70.9, no abnormalities.” This has become his little daily habit of health management.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Prepare clothes for tomorrow and bedtime reading.
description: After finishing the record, Lu Mingqiang took out a clean work uniform and jacket from the wardrobe, folded them and placed them on the chair by the head of the bed, preparing for the next day's day off. Then he lay down on the bed, picked up Hainan Local Records from beside his pillow and flipped through a few pages, but drowsiness soon came over him. Reading had been his bedtime ritual for years; even just a few pages could calm his mind.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Turned off the light and went to sleep, ending a fulfilling day.
description: Lu Mingqiang closed the book and turned off the bedside lamp. In the darkness, his mind replayed today's smiling face of Hanhan and the laughter at home, and he felt grounded and content. In less than a quarter of an hour, he fell into a deep sleep, bringing this warm and busy Saturday to a perfect close.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and stretching
description: As soon as the 6:00 phone alarm went off, I turned over and sat right up—today I was going to run to my heart's content. I put on the short-sleeved sportswear and running shoes that had been washed the day before yesterday, and washed up quietly without waking Juanzi and the kids. At 6:15 I went downstairs, got on the electric bike, and arrived at the main gate of Evergreen Park right at 6:25. Chen Bin was already stretching his legs. We started running along the seaside path; the first 2 kilometers at a 6:30 pace counted as a warm-up, and we chatted about his blind date last week while running. After that, the following 6 kilometers gradually increased to a 6:10 pace, and after the run I felt comfortable in my heart and lungs, not as out of breath as before. After finishing, I did 15 minutes of static stretching on the east lawn, focusing on the back of my thighs, and felt completely invigorated. Chen Bin said that I've been in good shape lately, all thanks to persisting with wall sits and core training—my lower body is much more stable.
location: Evergreen Park (Seaside Promenade and East Lawn), No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going home, taking a shower, and preparing.
description: After finishing the run, he said goodbye to Chen Bin and rode his electric bike home, arriving at 7:50. He heard noises in the kitchen and realized Juanzi was already awake. Through the door he reported the results of the 8 km morning run; she acknowledged and told him to go take a quick shower. He enjoyed a hot shower in the bathroom, then put on a clean light-gray T-shirt and dark-blue casual shorts. When he came out, Juanzi had already served two steaming bowls of Hainan rice noodles on the table, along with a plate of peeled pomelo and a glass of warm water. He finished the noodles in a few quick bites, and while eating he checked the picnic basket and kite by the door, running his hand over the kite’s bamboo frame and bridle line; only after confirming everything was fine did he feel at ease.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pack belongings and wake the children.
description: After breakfast, Juanzi went to the kitchen to prepare the picnic food and took charge of packing things up. She put the picnic mat, the kite, a thermos filled with warm water (a full 1.5 liters), sunscreen, wet wipes, a few children's picture books, and a pack of grilled chicken breast jerky for herself into the trunk and the picnic basket. At 8:40, she went upstairs to wake up the two boys. She patted Xuanxuan and said, “Son, get up! Today we're taking you to fly the eagle kite!” As soon as he heard this, he scrambled out of bed and picked out his own clothes. Hanhan was still a bit drowsy and muttered “fly a kite.” She picked him up and said, “That's right, we're going to Wanlv Garden to fly a kite. Did Hanhan bring his little water bottle?” He answered in a baby voice, “Brought it,” and hugged his water bottle tightly without letting go.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family drove to Evergreen Park to fly kites
description: We set off at 9:00 sharp, drove from Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue. There were few cars on the road, and we arrived at Evergreen Park in 15 minutes. Inside the park, we chose a spot on the large lawn near the east side with a wide view and sheltered from the wind, and spread out the ground mat. I took out the homemade eagle kite and patiently taught Xuanxuan how to adjust the tying angle and length of the bridle line, telling him that this is how the kite can fly steadily. Then I handed the string reel to Xuanxuan and let him run against the light wind. The kite indeed rose steadily and flew higher and higher, while Hanhan below looked up, clapped, and cheered. I took back the reel, adjusted the kite's posture, and explained to the two kids: "See, the wind comes from this side, so the kite goes up—the same principle as an airplane wing!" Juanzi sat nearby recording with her phone, grinning from ear to ear.
location: East side of the central lawn, Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family picnic on the lawn
description: After flying kites for over an hour, the children were tired and returned to the picnic mat to rest. Juanzi laid out the prepared Hainanese chicken rice (specially brought an extra white-cut chicken leg), Qingbuliang, cut mangoes, and washed cherry tomatoes. Eating outdoors is just so delicious! I picked up a piece of chicken rice and stuffed it into my mouth, then took out some roasted chicken breast jerky from the bag and chewed it. The two children ate with their mouths full of oil. After Hanhan finished the Qingbuliang, she lay on the mat contentedly, her little hand still pointing at the clouds drifting across the sky. I also lay down like them; the sunlight sprinkled on my face through the leaves, warm and cozy, and both my body and mind were completely relaxed.
location: Wanlv Garden Park (Central Lawn), No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing on the lawn and buying fruit.
description: The sun was getting a bit strong, and the children lying on the mat were starting to feel drowsy. I said to Juanzi, "I'll go buy two coconuts." Then I got up and walked to a fruit cart not far away, picked out two big green-skinned coconuts and a box of cut jackfruit. While paying, I chatted a little with the vendor: "Boss, these coconuts were picked this morning, right?" He smiled and said, "Of course, they were just brought over from Wenchang." Feeling pleased, I bought two more to take home for soup that evening.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (mobile fruit stall)

name: More kite flying and free time
description: It was past 4 p.m., the sun was not so harsh, and the little ones were full of energy again. Xuanxuan wanted to fly the kite again, so I took it out and taught him how to reel in the line and control the descent speed. This time he operated independently and successfully kept the kite steady in the air for quite a while, giving him a strong sense of accomplishment. Hanhan, on the other hand, became interested in a small beetle on the lawn, squatting on the ground and poking at it with a twig for a long time. I sat side by side with Juanzi on the mat, watching the two kids play, and casually said to Juanzi, "We should go see Mom and Dad next weekend." She nodded and said yes.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (central lawn and surrounding area)

name: Packed up for the return trip and put things away.
description: At 16:00, the sun began to move westward, and he said it was time to leave. He carefully wound up the kite line, checked it for damage, rolled it up, and put it into the cloth bag. He shook the ground mat clean and put all the trash into a bag to take away. At 16:20, the family drove home. On the way back, Xuanxuan was still in the back seat, waving his arms as he told his mother about flying the kite. After getting home, he first brought the kite inside, carefully hung it on the balcony hook to dry in the shade with good ventilation. Then he urged the two children to wash their hands and faces, and took a quick shower himself.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family rest and dinner preparation
description: After taking a shower, he felt refreshed. Walking into the kitchen, he saw Juanzi preparing dinner ingredients and took the initiative to wash and chop the vegetables. He said to her, "The coconuts we bought at noon are nice. Let's scoop out the coconut meat and stew chicken soup with it tonight." She smiled and said yes, asking him to handle the coconuts. Meanwhile, the two children were playing on the living room mat with the toys they had brought out.
location: Kitchen, Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and sharing fun stories
description: Dinner was home-style coconut chicken soup, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and pan-fried Spanish mackerel. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting. Xuanxuan was especially excited today, and with a chicken leg stuffed in his mouth he said: 'Dad! I feel like a little pilot—I can control the kite to draw circles in the sky!' Hanhan then said in her baby voice: 'Hanhan likes the wind blowing the kite high up, to fly to the moon and find the little rabbit.' He and Juanzi were both amused by the two children and laughed heartily, and the home was filled with a warm and happy atmosphere.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area (restaurant), No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Check the tool kit and plan next week's work.
description: The children were playing with building blocks nearby. He stood up, walked to the door, and habitually opened his tool bag to check it: screwdrivers, wrenches, pliers, multimeter... He looked through each one, then took a few common-sized screws and a new roll of insulating tape from the drawer and put them in. He opened his phone and saw the work schedule for next Monday (December 1) posted by Squad Leader Zhang in the team group. He needed to go to a newly built resettlement housing community in Changliu Town, Xiuying District to install electricity meter boxes. He took a screenshot to save the address and contact phone number, and now had a clear idea.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: Discuss December family plans and evening personal time
description: After the children showered and lay in bed listening to Juanzi tell stories, he leaned on the sofa, took out his phone, and went over the family's December to-do list with Juanzi. She said, 'Xuanxuan's shoes are pinching again; next weekend we need to get him a new pair.' He noted it down and set a reminder on his phone. Then he called her mother, asked how her parents were doing, and said he planned to take the kids to visit on Saturday. After hanging up, he picked up the copy of Hainan Local Gazetteer from the coffee table, which he had read a few pages of, and leaned back on the sofa to enjoy the rare quiet of the day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: At 22:00, went to the bathroom to wash up and soaked his feet in hot water to ease the fatigue of a day of walking. At 22:20, returned to the bedroom, lay in bed, and reviewed the day: morning run, kite flying, picnic, and the whole family enjoying themselves... What a great day! Felt confident about the upcoming December. Work had a plan, family had a schedule, and life was becoming more and more solid. Set the phone alarm, turned off the lights at 22:30, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (bedroom)

name: Morning run and medicine pickup
description: At 5:55 in the morning, the alarm went off. He put on his running shoes and jogged along the perimeter of Banshan Garden at a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer, feeling easier than yesterday. After running 3 kilometers, he stretched for ten minutes at the roadside fitness area on Jinmao Middle Road to loosen up. After the jog, he stopped by the Baoshoutang Pharmacy at the intersection on the way and bought a one-month supply of three boxes of rheumatism plasters and a bottle of medicated oil, for his mother and father respectively. He paid and hurried home carrying the medicine.
location: Roads around Banshan Garden Residential Community, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Baoshoutang Pharmacy.

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: When I got home, my wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared Hainan rice noodles and added a fried egg. After showering, I changed into work clothes. While eating the noodles, I listened to my wife mention that our second son Hanhan kicked off his blanket at night, and I told her to keep an eye on it. I planned to buy a fish on the way home after work.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take the children to school.
description: He rode his e-bike to take his elder son, Lu Zixuan, to Longfeng Experimental Primary School first. On the way, he reminded him that there would be a dictation in Chinese class, and he did not leave until he watched him run through the school gate. Then he rode to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handed his younger son, Lu Zihan, to the teacher. The little guy did not cry or fuss; he just waved and said bye-bye to Dad.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province, from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, to Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, and then to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District.

name: Commuting to work
description: Starting from the kindergarten, I rode the e-bike along Guomao Sanheng Road, turned onto Binhai Avenue, and headed west. With little traffic, I rode at a steady speed for 15 minutes and arrived at the company compound at 57 Haisheng Road.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, from Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Morning work: electric meter installation
description: After arriving at the company, he attended the pre-shift meeting. Squad leader Zhang assigned him to go to the newly built resettlement housing community in Changliu Town to install electric meter boxes. He rode to the location in a work vehicle with co-worker Chen Jianguo and intern Zhao Qiang. He was responsible for positioning and wiring; Jianguo drilled holes and fastened; Zhao Qiang handed tools. He worked carefully, tightening every screw properly and keeping the wires neat and straight.
location: South Second Ring Road Resettlement Community, Changliu Town, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: After finishing work at noon, he ate at a fast-food restaurant near the residential community. He ordered stir-fried pork with bitter melon and green vegetables, while Jianguo ordered braised pork. While eating, they chatted, and he agreed to help Jianguo check and repair the electric bike's starting problem. After lunch, he rested in a shaded area of the construction site. While drinking water, he browsed a local electric power forum and bookmarked a post about reactive power compensation, planning to read it carefully in the evening.
location: Fast food restaurant near the resettlement community on South Second Ring Road, Changliu Town, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the construction site rest area

name: Afternoon work: electric meter installation
description: Work continued in the afternoon. The sky turned cloudy, and it was neither cold nor hot. He gave Zhao Qiang hands-on training, teaching him to use a multimeter to test circuit continuity and distinguish the live wire from the neutral wire. Around 4 p.m., the electric meter boxes for all three buildings were fully installed. He and Jianguo tested each one by powering it on one by one, and after confirming normal operation, they cleaned up the site and packed up the tools.
location: South Second Ring Road Resettlement Community, Changliu Town, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Go home after work and buy groceries
description: Finished work early, drove back to the company with colleagues, clocked out, and then rode an electric bike home. On the way, he went to the farmers' market near Banshan Garden, picked a live tilapia, and bought tofu, cilantro, and two tomatoes, planning to make fish soup and tomato scrambled eggs.
location: Haikou City, Hainan Province: from the resettlement community in Changliu Town, Xiuying District, via No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, to the farmer’s market near Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

name: Rest and help a coworker repair the car.
description: After getting home, he put the groceries in the kitchen and told his wife that Jianguo would come to repair the car. After changing into home clothes, he rested briefly, drank water, and checked the class group notifications for his son. At 6:30, Jianguo pushed the electric bicycle over. In the shed, he used a multimeter to check it and found that the wiring harness from the starter to the motor was loose. He plugged it back in firmly and wrapped it with insulation tape. The bike started smoothly, and Jianguo was very pleased.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home and community e-bike shed)

name: Family dinner
description: After seeing Jianguo off, Lu Mingqiang washed his hands and went back inside. His wife had already prepared clear-simmered tilapia, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried choy sum, and white cut chicken. As the family ate, the eldest son Lu Zixuan mentioned wanting to buy a transforming dinosaur eraser. Taking the opportunity, Lu Mingqiang taught him that pocket money should be spent on useful things; the boy nodded, half understanding.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time and a walk around the neighborhood
description: After dinner, he checked his eldest son's math homework and patiently guided him to correct several addition and subtraction mistakes. Then he played with building blocks with his second son and built him a small castle; the child was delighted and kept saying, "Daddy is so awesome!" At 8:40 the whole family went downstairs for a walk, pushing the ride-on toy car. The moon was bright and the weather was cool. The family of four strolled slowly along the tree-lined path in the community, feeling content, and planned to go back to the grandparents' home on the weekend.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study and getting ready for bed
description: After walking home, his wife took the children to bathe, while he sat on the sofa reading saved posts from an electrical power forum, learning about troubleshooting cases for reactive power compensation devices in old residential communities, and found it very rewarding. At 9:30 he took a shower, then lay in bed browsing photos of old liquor bottles he had collected, thinking about going to the secondhand market on Bo'ai Road on the weekend to hunt for treasures. At 22:30 he turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Night rest
date: Lu Mingqiang returned to Room 203, Building 6 in his residential compound. His wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared the water bottles and small snacks for their two sons to take out, and his younger son Lu Zihan was playing with the kite string reel. He changed into a clean T-shirt, took the carton of milk prepared for his parents, and announced to everyone that they were setting off to see Grandma and Grandpa.
description: Soon fell into a deep sleep, regained his strength, and prepared for the new day of work and life.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: At 6 a.m., the phone alarm went off. After getting up, he went to the bathroom for a health check. Stepping on the scale, he found his weight steady at 72.5 kg. He used his phone to calculate a BMI of 24.8, felt stressed, and resolved to start losing weight. Then he brushed his teeth and washed up.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had breakfast and chatted with family.
description: After washing up, his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared Hainan rice noodles, and the family ate breakfast. Lu Mingqiang brought up his weight problem with his wife, saying he could no longer let it go. His wife replied that it should have been dealt with long ago, and they agreed not to eat late-night snacks. He also reminded his eldest son Lu Zixuan to be careful with dictation and his younger son Lu Zihan to behave at kindergarten.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Taking the children to school and commuting to work.
description: At 7:10 he left on his electric bike. He first took his older son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him on the way to bring all his Chinese textbooks. After dropping him off at the school gate, he turned around and took his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten; the child ran into the kindergarten by himself. Then he took Binhai Avenue and arrived at the company at 7:50.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-Work Preparation and Pre-Shift Meeting
description: After parking the car, he went into the tool room to check the multimeter and insulating shoes, then attended the pre-shift meeting in the conference room. Squad leader Zhang assigned tasks: Lu Mingqiang would take Zhao Qiang to the food factory on Yongwan Road to repair the motor, and Chen Jianguo would follow up on the warehouse inventory. After the meeting, the two prepared tools and materials and loaded them onto the electric tricycle.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Motor maintenance and apprentice instruction.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove a three-wheeled vehicle carrying Zhao Qiang to Hainan Yongfeng Food Co., Ltd. on Yongwan Road. After handing over with the factory electrician, he de-energized and tagged out the noisy conveyor belt motor. He opened the end cover and guided Zhao Qiang to diagnose the fault by sound. When he noticed Zhao Qiang almost stripped the anchor bolt while tightening it, he immediately corrected him and taught him the operating technique hand-over-hand, emphasizing steadiness and evenness.
location: Hainan Yongfeng Food Co., Ltd., Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and the collecting hobby.
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang went alone to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant on Haisheng Road for lunch, ordering the signature spicy soup rice with white cut chicken. While eating, he browsed the collector friends' WeChat group and saw someone selling a set of bottles from a 1990s Hainan old distillery for 500 yuan. He was tempted, but considering his weight loss and family expenses, he only replied in the group that he would go see the items in person on the weekend.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan)

name: Lunch break and health reflection.
description: After the meal, he returned to the team rest room at the company, leaned back in a chair, and closed his eyes to rest. He kept thinking about the number BMI 24.8 and last night's social engagement, and decided that from that day on, health management had to be made a top priority for the family. After work, he would discuss the new plan with his wife.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

Lu Mingqiang put the vegetables into the sink and told her he had bought shrimp and broccoli, intending to blanch them. His wife had already stewed pork rib soup for the children. After changing into loungewear, Lu Mingqiang went to the living room to watch his younger son play with building blocks, while his older son did homework beside him.

He broke the broccoli into small florets, rinsed the shrimp, and suggested to his wife that they stir-fry the shrimp, make smashed cucumber, and blanch the broccoli with less oil and salt for dinner. His wife agreed and asked him to cut corn and add it to the pork rib soup. The aroma of food gradually filled the kitchen.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner

The older son talked about the funny story of his deskmate borrowing an eraser, and the younger son clumsily scooped soup with a spoon. Lu Mingqiang looked at his family and increasingly felt he needed to take good care of his health.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discuss health plan
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang solemnly emphasized to his wife again his weight of 72.5 kg and the health risks found in the physical exam, and then made three health agreements: absolutely no late-night snacks, more blanched vegetables at dinner, and a 30-minute walk outside together after every meal. His wife slapped the table in full agreement, saying she would get up early starting tomorrow to buy more broccoli and bitter melon, and alternate between stir-fried and blanched dishes at night.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening stroll
description: Feeling pleased after reaching an agreement, Lu Mingqiang and his wife changed their shoes and went out for a relaxing half-hour walk along the sidewalk on Jinmao Middle Road, which was cool in the Haikou winter night. As they walked, they chatted about motor repair stories and his bottle collection, while his wife talked about the children's breakfast for the next day. After working up a light sweat, they turned around and headed home.

name: Child care and household chores.

After the children went back to their room, Lu Mingqiang took a shower and sat on the edge of the bed in a vest and shorts, scrolling through cases on the power engineering forum and messages in the collector friends group.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

description: After his wife finished tidying up, Lu Mingqiang recorded his weight of 72.5 kg that day in his phone memo, noting that the health plan agreed with his wife would take effect immediately, with a goal of dropping to 71 kg by the end of the month. Then he checked the tools he needed for work the next day and confirmed everything was in order.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: At 10 p.m., his wife turned off the main light and left the night light on. Lu Mingqiang lay down and reviewed the day: although his weight was still a concern, his goal was clear and his wife supported him, so he felt at ease. Listening to his wife's even breathing, he slowly fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He weighed 72.3 kg, 0.2 jin lighter than yesterday, and was satisfied with the health plan he had been doing together with his wife Wang Lijuan. Then he prepared breakfast with his wife in the kitchen, eating multigrain porridge, green vegetables, and fish. He helped his younger son Lu Zihan put on a jacket and change into rain boots. After the family finished breakfast, they checked the children's schoolbags and rain gear.
location: Room 306, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

He then turned around and took his younger son, Lu Zihan, to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, where he explained to the teacher that the child had coughed the night before. After dropping off both children, the rain had eased, and he hurried to his company in Xiuying District.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing by Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, and then arriving at Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City.

Using a test pen, they found that the wiring terminals in the control box were corroded. The two replaced them with waterproof connectors and restored the lighting. Director Wang Jianguo brought them hot tea in thanks. Afterward, they continued handling other repair tasks in the surrounding older residential areas.

To stick to his low-fat plan, he ordered skinless white cut chicken, blanched choy sum, and multigrain rice, chatting with his co-workers about the morning's work while eating.

Then he went to the office to pick up the drawings and notebooks needed for the afternoon survey, and checked the addresses and arrangements.

After talking with the manager, he learned that the newly added air-conditioning and lighting equipment required a capacity increase. He carefully inspected the main distribution box and each load circuit, recorded wire gauges, switch models, and load conditions, and hand-drew a sketch marking the areas that needed modification.
location: Leyu Squash Club, Nanhai Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

At home, his wife Wang Lijuan cooked him a vegetable and egg drop soup. After drinking it, he felt his strength return and changed into his sportswear, ready to go play ball.

Lin Feng again recommended that a smart home company called "Zhijia Technology" was recruiting electricians, with good pay and the opportunity to learn new skills. Lu Mingqiang said he still wanted to accumulate a few more years in the electrical industry before considering it.

Then he sat on the living room sofa and began reviewing Advanced Electrician Skills and Automation Control, focusing on PLC basics, and thought about the new equipment he had seen at the club in the afternoon. Later, feeling sleepy, he jotted down the key points in his phone memo and planned to study them systematically on the weekend.
location: Room 306, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

Then he played with LEGO for a while with his younger son and listened to him sing nursery rhymes. At 9:45 pm, he and his wife Wang Lijuan took a walk in the fresh-smelling neighborhood after the rain, sharing what had happened in their respective days and enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (child's room and the community's tree-lined path)

At 22:15 he got into bed; his wife was already asleep. He turned off the lamp, reflected on a fulfilling day, and fell asleep peacefully around 22:30.
location: Room 306, Building 7, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

While washing up, he looked in the mirror and moved his waist, which was a bit sore from yesterday's squash, doing a few simple side stretches to loosen his muscles.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family breakfast.

The family of four sat around the dining table. While eating, Lu Mingqiang reminded his elder son Xuanxuan to bring an umbrella and not to play in the rain, and also told his younger son Hanhan to put on more layers to avoid catching a cold. He first rode to Longfeng Experimental Primary School to drop off Xuanxuan, telling him to walk slowly. Then he turned around and headed to Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handing Hanhan to the teacher. location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area at No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, passing Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, and Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, finally arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

He met with his partner Chen Jianguo, then took apprentice Zhao Qiang to the warehouse to pick up new sealing gaskets, oil-resistant rubber pads, hydraulic oil, wrenches, and climbing safety harnesses, carefully counting them twice to ensure everything was ready.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

After eating, the three walked directly back to the industrial park.

Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo didn't hang around outside; they went back to the company rest room, leaned back in their chairs with their eyes closed, and made the most of the time to regain their strength for the afternoon emergency repairs.
location: Break room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Emergency repair of transformer oil leak
description: Work started in the afternoon. Squad Leader Zhang directed. Lu Mingqiang put on his safety belt and climbed up the scaffolding next to the transformer. He carefully inspected the leaking oil conservator, directed Zhao Qiang to hand him a wrench, and carefully removed the bolts at one end of the conservator. Chen Jianguo stood by below. He removed the old sealing gasket, cleaned the joint surface, and replaced it with a new gasket—the whole process was meticulous. After nearly four hours of intense work, hydraulic oil was refilled and the power-on test passed. It was already dark when they finished, and Lu Mingqiang felt soreness in his lower back.
location: Power distribution room of an enterprise in the industrial park, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (near the company)

name: Packed up and left work.
description: After putting away his tools, Lu Mingqiang rode back to the company, went to the workshop to wash the oil and grease off his hands, and then carefully filled out the maintenance work order in the duty room. Afterward, he rode his electric bike home along Haixiu Road and then Jinmao Road. Passing the vegetable market, he remembered his wife saying she would cook kelp soup in the evening, so he stopped and bought a bunch of spring onions to use for cooking noodles the next morning.
location: From the Xiuying District Industrial Park, return to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, then ride the electric bike back to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner

His wife, Wang Lijuan, served a steaming hot kelp and pork rib soup, along with stir-fried water spinach with garlic and steamed mackerel. He ladled himself a bowl of soup and said to his wife, "Thanks for your hard work." At the dinner table, he asked his eldest son, Xuanxuan, whether he had been caught in the rain today, and picked a piece of fish for his younger son, Hanhan. Though exhausted all over, he felt warm inside.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

His brother said business in Shenzhen was good at the end of the year and he had booked a train ticket back to Haikou for the 28th day of the twelfth lunar month, and asked whether he should bring some New Year goods. Lu Mingqiang also talked about his physical exam and weight loss. His brother urged him not to push himself too hard and to take care of his health.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

He called Wang Lijuan, and the two each held an umbrella, walking along Jinmao Middle Road toward Longhua Road. He deliberately quickened his pace, his back slightly sweating, while thinking that the results of tomorrow's senior technician exam would probably be released. He felt that walking with his wife on this quiet rainy night was very reassuring.
location: Set out from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, walked along Jinmao Middle Road to Longhua Road, and then turned back.
