description: After walking home, Lu Mingqiang helped his eldest son Xuanxuan with math homework, using simple examples to explain how to solve word problems. His younger son Hanhan pulled him to play with LEGO. After tutoring the children, he boiled water to soak his feet and, at the same time, opened the electric power forum on his phone to browse cases on dealing with transformer oil leakage. After soaking his feet, he felt a wave of exhaustion wash over him, and his waist was sore, so he decided not to do core training tonight. After taking a shower and changing into dry pajamas, he felt much more relaxed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Before-bed conversation and tidying up
description: After lying down in bed, Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about plans for the next day and told her there was no need to prepare a complicated breakfast tomorrow morning; just cooking some rice noodles would be fine. He glanced at his phone, thought of his brother coming home for the Chinese New Year, felt warm inside, and reached over to turn off the bedside lamp.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: As soon as his head hit the pillow, drowsiness washed over him. The day's fatigue melted away as he fell into sleep, and Lu Mingqiang soon sank into a deep sleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting up early, washing up, and family interaction.
description: At first light, Lu Mingqiang woke up on time, feeling nervous and expectant. He washed up quietly, straightened his collar in the mirror, and seeing the partly cloudy good weather outside the window, silently encouraged himself. The lower back soreness from last night's emergency repair work was still quite noticeable, so he rubbed his lower back. Walking out of the bathroom, he saw his wife Wang Lijuan already busy in the kitchen. He poured a glass of warm water, remembered the encouragement from last night's video call with his elder brother Minghua, and took a deep breath.
location: Room 603, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Warm breakfast and family interaction
description: His wife Wang Lijuan prepared steaming hot Hainan rice noodles and soy milk. Lu Mingqiang ate heartily. While packing the schoolbag for her younger son Lu Zihan, Wang Lijuan asked softly, "You get your results today, right? Don't be too nervous. Just do your best." Lu Mingqiang looked up, smiled, and held her hand: "Don't worry, I'm confident." The older son Lu Zixuan was humming a tune nearby, while the younger son ate his noodles slowly. The family was happy and harmonious, and the new day began in warmth.
location: Dining room, Room 603, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Taking the kids to school and commuting
description: The family of four set off on time. Lu Mingqiang drove. First, on the way, he took his younger son Lu Zihan to Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou; the drive took about 7 minutes, and Wang Lijuan got out to walk him to the school gate. Then, with his wife and elder son Lu Zixuan in the car, he drove to Longfeng Experimental Primary School at No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, a drive of about 22 minutes. On the way, he reminded Zixuan to go home and do his homework first after school, and told him there might be a business dinner in the evening. After arriving at the school, he watched his son walk through the school gate, then turned the car around and headed to the company.

He put down his bag, turned on the computer, took a deep breath, picked up his cup to get some hot water, and mentally prepared himself to check the results of the senior technician exam.

name: Checking results and sharing the good news
description: Just after 8 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang held his breath and logged on to the Electric Power Skills Certification Center website on his phone, entered his admission ticket number and ID card number to check his senior technician exam results. The page showed theory 82, practical 85 — passed! A wave of joy instantly swept away the tension. He immediately called his wife Wang Lijuan: "Juanzi, I passed! Both theory and practical!" On the other end, after a two-second pause, his wife choked up and said, "That's great, Aqiang, the last few months weren't wasted!" After hanging up, he called his master, Master Li: "Master, I passed! Thank you for being so strict back then!" Master Li laughed heartily: "Good lad! I knew you could do it! You didn't let me down!"

The meeting room erupted in warm applause and cheers. Chen Jianguo gave a thumbs-up, and Zhao Qiang was full of admiration. After Team Leader Zhang emphasized the day's safety matters, he specifically added: "Qiangzi has brought glory to our team this time. Everyone should learn from him from now on!" Lu Mingqiang's excitement took a long time to calm down.

He led Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to the industrial area near the company to perform routine maintenance and cleaning on an old transformer. He operated the tools skillfully, humming while working. Zhao Qiang teased, "Brother Qiang, today you're singing even sweeter than usual!" Lu Mingqiang smiled and replied, "Kid, study hard, and you'll have your day too!" During this time, he received a WeChat message from Manager Liu: "Mingqiang, congratulations! I've saved you a spot as technical instructor for the new project. Keep up the good work!" Lu Mingqiang looked at his phone and stood even straighter.

At the table, he said quietly to Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang that he was happy today, dinner was on him, and they would go to Jiamie Food Stall for grilled fish at the usual place; they should help notify Squad Leader Zhang and the other brothers. Chen Jianguo's eyes lit up and he said he definitely had to go.

He checked the time and sent his wife a WeChat message to confirm: 'Juanzi, my team colleagues are celebrating with me tonight, so I won't come home for dinner. After arriving home, he took a quick shower and changed into clean clothes, feeling that he was in good shape.

description: After his rest, Lu Mingqiang drove to the previously reserved Jiamie food stall, about 9 minutes from home. He deliberately played a Hainanese song he liked and was in a great mood.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area to Jiamei Food Stall, address: No. 506, Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Celebration meal at the grilled fish restaurant
description: Lu Mingqiang drove to the food stall and met up with the others. The mood was lively. He ordered two grilled fish with extra spice and opened a case of beer. Chen Jianguo said with emotion as he ate, “Brother Qiang, you’ve really brought honor to us technical workers—great skills and great character!” Zhao Qiang raised his glass and said seriously, “Brother Qiang, from now on I’m your apprentice; you’ll have to teach me well!” Even the usually stern Team Leader Zhang made an exception and drank a glass, patting him on the shoulder and saying, “Kid, you’re promising. From now on, take on more responsibilities in the projects.” As they ate grilled fish, drank beer, and chatted about interesting things at work and in life, Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside. He noticed he was a bit tired and his waist was beginning to ache faintly, so he controlled his beer intake.
location: Jiamie Food Stall, No. 506 Shimao South Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Ride home with a designated driver and the night breeze on his face
description: At 9 p.m., the celebration banquet was drawing to a close. Lu Mingqiang called a designated driver and said goodbye to his brothers one by one. As he got into the car, the night wind blew in through the half-open window, making him shiver a little and feel a stuffy nose. He remembered his wife's advice and figured he should drink some hot water as soon as he got home.
location: Returned from Jiamie Food Stall to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returning home and family warmth
description: After he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was waiting for him in the living room. She caught a faint smell of alcohol but said nothing; she just went to the kitchen and poured him a cup of warm honey water: 'Drink it quickly to warm your stomach. Tomorrow is the weekend and we're still taking the kids out to play.' Lu Mingqiang took the cup and drank it all in one go. Smiling, he told her about the lively celebration banquet tonight and the blessings from his colleagues, and Wang Lijuan was happy to hear it.
location: Room 603, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal care and body care
description: Lu Mingqiang washed up briefly and felt some soreness in his lower back, so he took out a piece of the pain-relief patch he kept on hand and applied it to the sore spot. Also, because his nose was stuffy, he deliberately made a cup of cold medicine and drank it. Seeing this, his wife said with concern, “Take a good rest tomorrow, don't push yourself.”
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 603, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-bed communication and falling asleep with peace of mind
description: Lu Mingqiang lay down on the bed. He felt a little tired, but his heart was filled with a deep sense of peace and pride. He chatted with Wang Lijuan for a while about the preliminary plan to go kite flying at Wanlv Garden tomorrow for the weekend. His younger son had been talking recently about wanting that eagle kite. As they chatted, drowsiness crept in. Holding his wife's hand, he fell into a deep sleep, feeling fulfilled and proud.
location: Master bedroom, Room 603, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Early rising and family breakfast
description: After the 06:50 alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up and stretched. He felt that his nasal congestion was slightly better, but his throat was still dry. After washing up, he rinsed his mouth with warm water, then went to the dining room, where his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared Hainan noodles and soy milk. His 8-year-old son Lu Zixuan was doing morning reading, while his 4-year-old son Lu Zihan was still staying in bed. Lu Mingqiang drank the soy milk and told Zixuan that they would go to Grandpa's house in the afternoon for a math quiz. Zixuan was very happy.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the laoba tea shop for morning tea and take some to go.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang put on a windbreaker and walked about 15 minutes to the Datie Dad's Tea House on Binya Road. He ordered a cup of black tea and a BBQ pork bun, and chatted with Uncle Wang at the next table. Uncle Wang congratulated him on passing the technician exam. After eating, he packed a pineapple bun and a cup of coffee milk to take away.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: E-bike commute to Bo'ai Road
description: Lu Mingqiang got on his electric bike at the tea shop and headed east along Longkun North Road and Changdi Road, then turned into Bo'ai North Road. It was about a 20-minute ride; he put on his helmet and enjoyed the cool breeze.
location: Bo'ai North Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Treasure hunting at the Bo'ai Road secondhand market.
description: Lu Mingqiang arrived at Old Liang's secondhand warehouse and started rummaging through the items himself. In a corner he found a set of old-fashioned porcelain wire clamps in excellent condition and a set of brass-buckle fuse boxes, which happened to be the exact model he was missing. Old Liang asked for 120 yuan. Lu Mingqiang was so happy that he didn't bargain and paid by scanning the QR code. Afterwards he chatted with Old Liang about the old days at the power supply bureau, and Old Liang congratulated him again on passing the technician exam.
location: Lao Liang's Used Goods Warehouse, at the intersection of Bo'ai North Road and Wenming West Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home and preparing at home
description: At 10:30, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike back the same way. On the way, he picked up a package at the Cainiao Station at the community entrance; it was 'Mathematical Thinking Training' bought for Zixuan. He arrived home around 10:55. His wife and two sons were ready, and Hanhan called out 'Daddy' at the door. Lu Mingqiang carefully put away the treasures he had picked up, washed his face, and rested. Then he chatted with his family and decided to go to the supermarket to buy fruit and milk to take to his parents' home. Hanhan wanted a lollipop, and Lu Mingqiang agreed that he could have one if he behaved well.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Supermarket shopping
description: The family of four drove to Wanghao Supermarket. Wang Lijuan bought calcium tablets and discounted fruit. Lu Mingqiang took Zixuan to pick out large mangoes and dragon fruit and also carried two boxes of milk. Hanhan sat in the shopping cart and wanted to buy snacks. Lu Mingqiang teased him, saying he could only have them if he behaved well. After checkout, they loaded everything into the car.
location: Wanghao Supermarket, B1, Friendship Sunshine City, No. 2 Jinlong Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove to parents' home
description: Starting from the supermarket, they drove east along Guoxing Avenue and arrived at the parents' home in about 20 minutes. Hanhan was playing with sticker books in the back seat, while Zixuan and Lu Mingqiang discussed a new book, making the car lively.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family reunion and celebration dinner at the parents' home
description: Arrived at 12:45. His mother Chen Xiuying came forward, hugged Hanhan, and kissed him, while his father Lu Jianguo was reading the newspaper in the living room. Zixuan ran over to rummage through Grandpa's old parts. When his mother heard Lu Mingqiang's nasal voice, she turned and went to the kitchen to boil ginger tea. At 14:00, Lu Mingqiang brewed Tieguanyin tea and chatted with his father on the second-floor balcony. His father happily praised him for passing the technician exam and talked about Grandpa bringing Father into the trade and the emergency line repairs in the 1980s. At 14:45, they returned to the living room. Lu Mingqiang helped Zixuan with long division, while Hanhan imitated repairing things with an old screwdriver and a wooden block, and Lu Mingqiang took photos. At 15:30, his mother brought out brown sugar ginger tea. After he drank it, Lu Mingqiang felt his nose clear, and his mother urged him to sleep early. At 16:15, Wang Lijuan and his mother were preparing dinner in the kitchen, and the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice wafted out. His father was playing Chinese chess on the computer in the living room, with Zixuan and Hanhan watching. Lu Mingqiang peeled garlic and picked vegetables. At 18:00, the table was full of dishes: white-cut chicken, braised pork, steamed grouper, and more. His father took out a treasured bottle of Moutai, raised his glass, and said the electrician craft had been passed down through three generations, congratulating Lu Mingqiang on becoming a technician. Lu Mingqiang was moved, and his mother put food on his plate. The meal was warm and lively.
location: South Zone, Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Said goodbye to his parents and drove home
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang talked with his father about tomorrow's kite-flying plan. At 20:00 they said goodbye to his parents. Hanhan fell asleep in the car. Lu Mingqiang drove steadily, chatting with his wife about how happy his parents were, and arrived home 20 minutes later.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening wind-down and final family chores.
description: After getting home, Wang Lijuan arranged for the children to wash up and go to bed, while Lu Mingqiang took out the fuse box and wiped off the copper rust, appreciating its vintage charm. Then he soaked his feet in hot water to relieve fatigue. His wife handed him hot water, and the two leaned on the sofa, chatting about going to Wanlv Garden to fly kites the next day and planning to bring the newly bought Eagle kite.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Record and rest
description: Lu Mingqiang briefly noted the happy moments of the day: finding a great deal, passing the technician exam, and his father's words. He checked the weather on his phone—cloudy turning clear, perfect for flying kites—set his alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, turned off the light, and went to bed. His stuffy nose had mostly cleared, and he fell asleep with a warm feeling.
location: Master bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang was awakened by his biological clock. He got up quietly to avoid waking his sleeping wife Wang Lijuan and the two children. In the bedroom he put on his dark blue tracksuit and running shoes, and weighed himself on the scale: 72.2 kg. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, picked up his keys and phone, and got ready to go out for his morning run.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and inspirational exchange about insurance
description: Lu Mingqiang drove about 5 minutes to the parking lot at the entrance of Wanlv Garden Park and met up with his running buddy Chen Bin. The two jogged 5 kilometers along the coastal path to warm up. During a break, Lu Mingqiang handed Chen Bin a bottle of water. Chen Bin mentioned that he had sprained his ankle while running last month and had reimbursed more than 800 yuan in physical therapy costs through commercial accident insurance. Lu Mingqiang asked carefully about the insurance details, and Chen Bin suggested that he get insurance for the whole family. The two agreed to run together next Sunday.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home to discuss insurance matters
description: After the morning run, Lu Mingqiang drove 6 minutes home. His wife Wang Lijuan was making breakfast in the kitchen. He changed out of his sweaty clothes, washed his face, went to the kitchen, and told his wife in detail Chen Bin's suggestions about accident insurance claims and buying insurance, emphasizing the risks of his electrician job and saying that the whole family needed protection. His wife listened carefully and agreed that he could research insurance products.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family had breakfast together
description: Breakfast included the lean pork congee his wife had made, boiled eggs, and steamed buns. The whole family sat around the dining table. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, asked whether they could go fly kites, and the younger son, Lu Zihan, also shouted excitedly that he wanted to fly the biggest kite. Lu Mingqiang agreed that the whole family would go, asked his wife to prepare fruit and water, and checked the handmade oil-paper kite himself.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family flew kites at Wanlv Garden.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove the family to the Evergreen Park parking lot in 6 minutes. Quite a few kites were already up on the big lawn. After checking the kite frame and reel, he first let Zixuan try to launch it, then taught his younger son Hanhan hand over hand to slowly let out the line. The kite rose steadily into the sky. His wife Wang Lijuan was off to the side taking photos with her phone, capturing the joy of the father and his two sons. After playing for over an hour, the children were sweating all over.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time at the Qingbuliang stall
description: After putting away the kite, the family of four walked to the old Haikou Qingbuliang stall beside the east gate of Wanlv Garden and ordered four bowls of coconut-milk Qingbuliang with taro, pearl barley, and shredded coconut. The children ate with small spoons, their mouths full of coconut flavor, and Zixuan asked for an extra serving of coconut cake. Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat nearby, drinking the sweet soup and chatting, enjoying a leisurely time.
location: Old Haikou Qingbuliang stall, near No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home for lunch break and tidy up belongings.
description: The family walked about 5 minutes from the qingbuliang stall back to the parking lot, then drove 6 minutes home. Lu Mingqiang put the kite away on the balcony. The children washed their hands and faces and each went to their own room for a nap, and his wife also went to rest. Lu Mingqiang closed his eyes and rested on the living room sofa for a while.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Research insurance products and contact classmates.
description: While his wife and children were taking a nap, Lu Mingqiang sat down at the computer in the study and searched for and compared the coverage amounts and premiums of family accident insurance and high-risk occupation insurance, writing the most cost-effective product information on sticky notes. Then he contacted his junior high school classmate Wu Gang, who works in an insurance company, via WeChat and made an appointment for a phone consultation about family insurance tomorrow, receiving an affirmative reply.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Parent-child time and checking homework
description: After the children woke up from their nap, Lu Mingqiang played with LEGO on the living room floor with his younger son Hanhan, teaching him to build a small house. Then he went to the study in the second bedroom and checked his older son Zixuan's weekend math workbook. He found two mental arithmetic problems wrong due to carelessness, so he patiently explained them and had Zixuan recalculate.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Called his parents to let them know he was safe.
description: Lu Mingqiang walked to the balcony and called his father. He asked about his parents' health, told him he had a great time taking the kids to Wanlv Park to fly kites today, and mentioned the copper-knob fuse box he had found at the flea market yesterday. His father enthusiastically analyzed the box's age and manufacturer. The call lasted about ten minutes; his father's voice was loud and clear, and he seemed in good spirits.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing dinner
description: After hanging up the phone, Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen to help. He was in charge of preparing the fresh Hainan pomfret for steaming; his wife cut tomatoes and potatoes to make tomato and egg soup. The kitchen filled with the aroma of the ingredients as the two prepared a simple home-cooked dinner together.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The whole family has dinner together
description: As the food is served, Zixuan tells the story of how the kite string almost got tangled around someone while flying the kite. His wife reminds him to pay attention to his surroundings. Lu Mingqiang picks the best piece of steamed pomfret and gives it to his wife and two children. The family eats and chats, filled with joy and harmony.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Cleared the dining table and watched local news.
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the dishes and wipe the table. He then turned on the TV and switched to the local news channel, listening to content about Haikou's urban construction while sitting with his wife on the sofa.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping children with homework and playing with them
description: Zixuan began his Chinese homework. Lu Mingqiang sat beside him, watching him read the text and write new characters, and corrected the stroke order of one character. Zihan flipped through an Ultraman picture book. After the homework was done, Lu Mingqiang checked it and signed it, then played hopscotch with the two children in the living room. The home was filled with laughter.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for tomorrow's tasks.
description: Lu Mingqiang urged the two children to wash up, then took a hot shower himself. After changing into pajamas, he took out his phone and photographed the insurance notes he had made during the day, saving them to his memo app for easier communication tomorrow. He also took out the work clothes and work badge he would wear on Monday from the wardrobe and placed them on the bedside table.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard and browsed posts on an electrical engineering forum on his phone, learning about troubleshooting ideas for new types of electrical cabinets. Then he closed his eyes and recalled the day's experiences, feeling peaceful and content.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: The couple chatted and made arrangements for tomorrow.
description: His wife Wang Lijuan also lay down. The two quietly talked about plans for the next day: the wife would get up early to take the child to school, and Lu Mingqiang would call Wu Gang during a work break after arriving at work. Lu Mingqiang remarked that the day had felt very fulfilling, and his wife softly agreed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Fall asleep on time
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the desk lamp, closed his eyes, reviewed how the weekend plans had been completed, felt that everything was perfect, and prepared to welcome the new week.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning washing up, taking the son to school, and returning
description: I woke up naturally in the early morning and felt energetic. After some light stretching, I got up quietly so as not to wake my wife and Xuanxuan, then went to the bathroom to wash up and rinse my face with cold water. Afterwards I helped my younger son Zihan get up, tidied his clothes, and put on his little schoolbag. Holding Zihan's hand, we went downstairs, left through the east gate of the community, walked east along Jinmao Middle Road, turned right into Guomao Sanheng Road, and after about a 12-minute walk took him to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten. We said goodbye at the kindergarten gate, and I promised to take him kite-flying again next time I was off. After watching him enter the kindergarten, I walked back along the same route to Banshan Garden Residential Community and went straight to the underground garage to get the car.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou

name: Breakfast
description: After driving out of the neighborhood, he had breakfast at the Morning Flavor Laoba Tea shop across from the west gate. The shop was filled with the aroma of tea and dim sum. He ordered a cup of strong Hainan green tea, a pineapple bun, and a serving of pan-fried turnip cake. While eating, he checked his phone and reviewed the work arrangements sent last night by Squad Leader Zhang. The breakfast was cheap and filling, costing 8 yuan.
location: "Zaowei Laobacha" shop, opposite the west gate of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to company
description: After breakfast, he returned to the underground garage and drove the family car out. Turning left from Jinmao Middle Road onto Binhai Avenue, he headed west all the way, passed Xiuying Port Terminal, and turned onto Haisheng Road. With light morning traffic, he arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park in less than 15 minutes.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Changing and getting ready.
description: After arriving at the industrial park, he parked the car and went straight to the engineering department changing room. He changed into his work clothes, put on a safety helmet, and carefully checked and organized the tools in his tool bag, including wrenches, screwdrivers, a multimeter, and insulated gloves. The young apprentice Zhao Qiang had also arrived, so he called him over to check the meter box accessories needed for the day.
location: Engineering Department Changing Room and Tool Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift meeting.
description: Team leader Zhang presided over the pre-shift meeting and announced the main tasks of the day: in the morning, maintain the wiring of the park's distribution room; in the afternoon, an urgent job to replace a faulty electric meter box in an old residential community on Huahai Road, Longhua District, assigned to Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang. Lu Mingqiang noted the tasks and secretly planned to go to the bank on the way in the afternoon.
location: Engineering Department Meeting Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: line maintenance in the park's power distribution room.
description: Working with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, he inspected the distribution cabinets in Plant No. 3 of the industrial park and tightened the screws on a routine basis. The two of them worked well together and quickly fixed several loose connections. Meanwhile, Lu Mingqiang brought up the debt to Jianguo, and Jianguo indicated that he had brought cash. Around 10 a.m., a bank text message on his phone showed that the year-end bonus of 8,000 yuan had arrived. He was pleased and felt even more motivated at work.
location: Power distribution rooms of each factory building, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Collect the debt owed by Chen Jianguo.
description: After a period of work, he rested and drank water in the engineering department lounge. Chen Jianguo took a kraft paper envelope from his toolbox and returned the 10,000 yuan he had borrowed earlier. Lu Mingqiang put it directly into his inner pocket without counting, remarking that at year-end the accounts were clear, and with the year-end bonus he had just enough to make 18,000 yuan.
location: Engineering Department Break Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: Walking with Jianguo and Zhao Qiang for about 8 minutes to the “Sister's Spicy Soup Rice” fast-food restaurant outside the park. Lu Mingqiang ordered the signature spicy soup rice set meal, with a fried egg and pickled cabbage, sour and spicy to whet the appetite. While eating, they chatted casually. Zhao Qiang mentioned winter bamboo shoots from his hometown, and Lu Mingqiang said to bring some back after the New Year for them to try.
location: "Big Sister Spicy Soup Rice" fast-food restaurant, first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break and insurance consultation
description: After the meal, they returned to the break room; some coworkers took a nap and some scrolled on their phones. Lu Mingqiang walked to a corner and called his middle school classmate Wu Gang, who works in insurance. In his hometown dialect, he explained in detail his idea of purchasing accident insurance for the whole family, emphasizing that he was in a high-risk occupation. Wu Gang enthusiastically introduced suitable family plans, promised to try for the best option, and suggested comparing several alternatives. They agreed to talk further on the weekend, and he then sent a detailed plan via WeChat. After the call, Lu Mingqiang closed his eyes and rested in a recliner in the break room for about half an hour to conserve energy for the afternoon work.
location: Engineering Department Break Room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Went out in the afternoon to inspect and repair the electric meter box.
description: At 1:15 p.m., he drove the company work vehicle with Zhao Qiang to an old residential community on Huahai Road, Longhua District. After arriving at the reported unit building, they found that the incoming terminals of the electric meter box were aged and burned, and the porcelain plug-in fuse base was cracked. Lu Mingqiang had Zhao Qiang handle the power cutoff and monitoring while he put on insulating gloves and skillfully replaced the meter box and fuse base, then reconnected the wiring. The whole process was clean and efficient, completed in less than an hour and a half. After restoring normal power, he signed the maintenance confirmation form with the owner in the community gatehouse. He then asked Zhao Qiang to drive back to the company first, while he planned to walk to the bank for personal matters.
location: Unit entrance, Building 5, an old residential complex on Huahai Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Bank deposits and opening an around-island account.
description: He walked seven or eight minutes to the Bank of China Longhua Sub-branch outlet on Longhua Road. He took a number and waited in line. At the counter, he took out 10,000 yuan in cash and his salary card, and combined the 8,000 yuan in the card with the 10,000 yuan cash for a total of 18,000 yuan. He then arranged a one-year fixed deposit of 10,000 yuan (with automatic renewal). Using the remaining 8,000 yuan, he opened an installment savings account under the account name "The Whole Family Watching the Sea," and set up an automatic transfer of 500 yuan from his salary card on the 1st of each month. The teller was curious about the account name, and Lu Mingqiang explained that it was his dream to take his children on an island tour next summer. He was full of joy when he got the passbook and the fixed deposit certificate.
location: Bank of China Longhua Sub-branch Business Department, Longhua Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return to the company
description: After leaving the bank, he hailed a taxi on the roadside and returned in about ten minutes to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Organized the tools and submitted the report.
description: After returning to the engineering department, I filled out the Maintenance Report for replacing the electric meter box in the afternoon and submitted it to Team Leader Zhang. Then I cleaned up and organized the tools used in the afternoon and returned them to their places. I checked the list of tools that might be needed the next day with Zhao Qiang.
location: Tool room and office, Engineering Department, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying groceries on the way home from work
description: He changed out of his work clothes and drove the family car to Longkun South Vegetable Market. He bought one fresh sea bass (to be steamed), tender green lettuce, tomatoes, and scallions, spending 35 yuan in total, planning to cook his signature dish at home in the evening.
location: Longkun South Road Market, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving home from work.
description: After the shopping was done, he hummed a tune and drove back along the road to Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Dinner preparation and family meal
description: When she got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked rice. Lu Mingqiang handed her the ingredients he bought and started to prepare the sea bass, adding it to the menu for steaming. While preparing the dishes, he told his wife in detail about Jianguo paying back the money, the year-end bonus arriving, and how he had gone to the bank to open a "Family Sea View" installment savings account, and took out the passbook to show her. Wang Lijuan was pleasantly surprised. The two chatted about next year's island tour while cooking. Dinner was served: oyster sauce lettuce, tomato egg drop soup, steamed sea bass, and homemade pickled radish. The family of four sat around the table. The two sons were excited to hear about the travel savings and agreed to visit the Dongjiao Coconut Grove and Tianya Haijiao during the summer vacation. The atmosphere was warm and joyful.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 203, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Homework tutoring and parent-child entertainment

He took off his jacket, briefly explained the theory with the PPT, and then began the hands-on operation: cutting off the simulated power supply, using an insulating rod to move the wire away, assessing the victim's consciousness, calling for help, performing chest compressions, opening the airway, and giving rescue breaths. Each step was standard, powerful, and accompanied by clear explanations. After the demonstration, he received warm applause from the whole audience. Manager Liu came on stage to praise the demonstration as very professional and suggested he consider recording it as a video to serve as safety training material for new employees.
