description: Coming out of the study, he first helped his eldest son Lu Zixuan check his math homework and corrected two wrong problems. Then he read two picture books to his younger son Lu Zihan and watched him slowly begin to yawn. At exactly 21:00, he walked into the children's room, tucked the quilt around his sleeping eldest son, lightly kissed his younger son's cheek, then turned off the light and left.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, living room and children's room

name: Evening relaxation and stretching
description: After settling the children, he did some simple stretching in the living room to relieve the lower back muscle tension caused by the day's standing demonstrations and physical labor. Then he walked to the balcony, watched the night rain still drizzling outside the window, took a few deep breaths of the moist air, and felt the stress of the whole day gradually release.
location: Living room and balcony, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: After a quick rinse, he returned to the bedroom, took out his phone, and wrote in his memo that he must contact Wu Gang tomorrow to follow up on the insurance matter. Then he stepped on the scale and recorded his weight as 72.1 kg. Turning off the light and lying down, he reviewed the day's achievements: the first aid demonstration was a great success, he had won his wife's understanding about insurance, and he had made a retirement gift for his master with his own hands. His heart was full of contentment and fulfillment, and with that peace he gradually fell asleep.
location: Master bedroom and bathroom in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off at 06:20. Lu Mingqiang got up and stepped barefoot onto the scale. Seeing his weight was 72.0 kg, a bit lighter than yesterday, he felt in a good mood. Then he washed up, put on the company's Haidian blue work uniform, and carefully placed the wooden box bearing "Tribute to Craftsmanship" that he had mounted last night at the very bottom of his backpack, planning to give it to his master today.
location: Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Taking the two children to school.
description: Lu Mingqiang called his two sons to head out, got into the silver-gray family sedan, and first took his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, reminding him on the way to focus in class. Arrived at the school gate at 07:05, watched his son enter the school, then drove to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, handed his younger son Lu Zihan to the teacher, and watched him skip happily into the classroom.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; first to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy breakfast on the commute
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Lu Mingqiang drove directly to the company. On the way, when passing Haisheng Road intersection, he stopped at Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store and bought two pork buns and a bottle of soy milk as breakfast. Then at 7:40 he parked his car on time in a parking space at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park.
location: From Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, passing the Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store at the Haisheng Road intersection, Xiuying District, Haikou, and finally arriving at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Pre-shift meeting and work deployment.
description: Lu Mingqiang put on his safety helmet and work safety shoes and entered the company’s pre-shift meeting room. Team Leader Zhang was assigning tasks in front of the whiteboard, telling a group to follow Lu Mingqiang to Cuizhuyuan Residential Community to finish the metering box work left incomplete yesterday and inspect the building distribution cabinets. Lu Mingqiang nodded and noted the tasks.
location: Pre-shift meeting room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Completed comprehensive accident insurance for the whole family
description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang returned to his workstation and called his middle school classmate Wu Gang on WeChat voice, telling him that he had transferred the insurance premium. With Wu Gang's guidance, he quickly completed the transfer and filled in the health declaration. Within five minutes, the electronic policy was sent to his phone. He then went to a corner of the warehouse, printed the policy using a dot-matrix printer, folded it, and put it in the inside pocket of his work uniform.
location: Workstation and warehouse at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Schedule the annual physical exam and request compensatory leave.
description: After completing the insurance purchase, Lu Mingqiang booked a routine physical exam for the afternoon of December 15 (next Monday) through the official account of Haikou People's Hospital. He then walked to the team leader's office, knocked, and applied to Team Leader Zhang for a half-day compensatory leave that afternoon. Team Leader Zhang readily signed and approved it.
location: Workstation and team leader's office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finishing work for metering box installation at the construction site
description: After finishing personal matters, Lu Mingqiang called Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, took the tool bag and equipment, and drove to Cuizhuyuan Residential Area. He worked with Chen Jianguo to install the last few metering boxes, while Zhao Qiang organized the wiring on the side. The three were busy until nearly noon before finishing.
location: Electrical shaft, Building 1, Cuizhuyuan Residential Community, No. 88 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and chatting with coworkers
description: After a stint of work, the three walked to the Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant they often went to. Lu Mingqiang ordered a serving of spicy soup rice with a fried egg. During the meal, Chen Jianguo asked about the insurance. Lu Mingqiang swallowed his food and replied that he had asked Wu Gang to handle it, paying 2,600 yuan per year, a worry off his mind. Zhao Qiang listened quietly beside them.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, No. 56-4, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday nap in the tool room.
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company but didn't go back to his desk. Instead, he went directly to the quiet tool room. He put his safety helmet under his head, leaned against the wall, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour to store up energy for the afternoon's physical work.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Routine inspection of the community power distribution room
description: After the break, Lu Mingqiang took Chen Jianguo to the power distribution room of Cuizhuyuan Residential Community. He opened the distribution cabinet door, used a test pen to check the current and voltage of each circuit, and used an infrared thermometer gun to measure the temperature of key contacts. Everything was normal, and he recorded the data in the work log.
location: Distribution room of Cuizhuyuan Residential Community, No. 88 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discovered an abnormal electricity bill at home.
description: When packing up his tools after the inspection, Lu Mingqiang passed by the community notice board and saw the electricity bill notice posted by the property management. He found his own unit number and was stunned—600 yuan, more than double the usual amount. Feeling uneasy, he photographed the electricity bill with his phone, then walked to his own meter box and stared at the rapidly spinning disk for a long time. He decided to note down the number first and check it later.
location: At the bulletin board and electricity meter box of Cuizhu Garden Community, 88 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Leave work early to pick up the child and buy groceries
description: After returning to the company and organizing his tools, Lu Mingqiang saw that it was still early. With the electricity bill on his mind, he decided to leave work early. He drove first to Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Lu Zihan, then stopped by the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket on the way and bought tomatoes, scallions, and two pieces of soft tofu, planning to make a light soup for dinner.
location: Starting from Hainan Elevator Accessory Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; first to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province; then to Cailanzi Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store), No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Arrived home, stored the insurance policy, and told his wife.
description: The father and son returned home. Lu Mingqiang entered the bedroom first, took the paper insurance policy out of the inside pocket of his work clothes, opened the safe in the bedside cabinet, put it together with the property ownership certificate, and locked it. He then walked to the kitchen door and told his wife Wang Lijuan that the insurance had been purchased, the policy was locked in the safe, and informed her of its storage location. Wang Lijuan showed a relieved smile.
location: Bedroom and kitchen, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner and discussion about the abnormal electricity bill
description: His wife Wang Lijuan served white-cut chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and tomato tofu soup. The family sat around the table for dinner. While eating, Lu Minghu brought up the community's electricity bill notice — last month the household electricity bill was as high as 600 yuan, much more than usual. Wang Lijuan was puzzled because no large appliances had been added. Lu Mingqiang comforted her, saying he would check after dinner and told her not to worry.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Thoroughly inspect household electrical appliances
description: After dinner, Wang Lijuan tutored the eldest son on his homework while Lu Mingqiang started checking the electrical appliances. He inspected the air conditioner, refrigerator, and water heater, unplugged all idle chargers, and measured the main circuit current with an ammeter. After nearly an hour, he still found no problem. Finally he stood in the middle of the living room, spread his hands to his wife, and said he couldn't find the cause.
location: Living room, kitchen, and balcony of Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Discuss family deep cleaning before New Year's Day
description: The troubleshooting came up empty, and the couple, somewhat tired, slumped onto the sofa together. Lu Mingqiang suggested checking the outside wiring again during the day on Saturday, and also setting the previously discussed spring cleaning for Sunday so that both sons could help, starting with the storage room and the balcony. Wang Lijuan nodded in agreement.
location: On the sofa in the living room, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helped the kids with homework and played with them.
description: After discussing the thorough cleaning, Lu Mingqiang went to his son's room to check Lu Zixuan's math homework, found two mental arithmetic problems wrong, and had him correct them on the spot. Then he accompanied his younger son Lu Zihan to play with a newly bought excavator building blocks on the living room mat for a while.
location: Children's room and living room, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Calling Master to confirm tomorrow's farewell banquet.
description: After settling the two children, Lu Mingqiang picked up his phone and called his mentor, Master Li, reminding him that the private room for tomorrow noon's farewell banquet at the seafood restaurant in Xiuying District had been booked, and asked about his health. Master Li said cheerfully that he was in good health and would definitely arrive on time tomorrow. Only then did Lu Mingqiang feel relieved.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Soak feet to relax and rest early
description: After a busy day and troubleshooting electrical appliances in the evening, Lu Mingqiang felt exhausted, so he canceled his running plan for the night. He went to the bathroom, filled a basin with hot water, and soaked his feet comfortably for twenty minutes, feeling much more relaxed. After drying his feet and changing into pajamas, he went into the bedroom and sent a voice message to his wife saying he was too sleepy and going to bed first.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the bedside lamp, and the whole room grew quiet. Outside the window, there was the faint sound of cars. He turned over and ran through the day's events one last time in his mind: the insurance was bought, the physical exam was booked, and the electricity bill could wait until tomorrow. As he thought, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bed in the bedroom, Room 302, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast preparation
description: Lu Mingqiang got up after the alarm went off, washed up briefly, put on his old work clothes, and heated up the steamed buns his wife had left for him, eating them with milk. Considering he would be investigating the electricity bill issue today, he went to the balcony and carried over an aluminum alloy ladder. Then he went to the Laoba Tea Shop at the community entrance and packed several portions of barbecued pork buns and hot milk tea as breakfast for the family, bringing them home.
location: At home in Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and the breakfast stall at the residential area entrance

name: Resolved abnormal electricity bill issues caused by misconnected wires between neighbors
description: Lu Mingqiang carried the tool ladder to the central electric meter box downstairs. Drawing on years of experience as an electrician, he carefully checked the wiring of his own unit and that of the new neighbor downstairs, Mr. Wang, and found that Mr. Wang had mistakenly connected the air-conditioner outdoor unit wire during renovation, causing his own electricity bill to be abnormal. He took photos as evidence, called the property maintenance electrician Lao Zhang, and then explained the situation to Mr. Wang. Mr. Wang apologized and promised to pay the extra electricity charges. When the property electrician Lao Zhang arrived, he reconnected the wiring under Mingqiang's guidance, and Mingqiang confirmed it was correct with a multimeter. The problem was completely solved.
location: At the centralized meter box downstairs of Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and in front of Mr. Wang's door

name: Get ready to go out and head to the restaurant.
description: After resolving the electricity bill issue, Lu Mingqiang went home, took a shower, and changed into a clean polo shirt and casual pants. He checked the USB drive containing the photos of him and his mentor, wiped the framed old-fashioned fuse box toolbox prepared as a gift for his mentor with a soft cloth, and put it in his handbag. Then he drove out, stopped by Jiulong Pharmacy on Haixiu Middle Road in Longhua District to buy rheumatism medicated patches for his mother, and then drove along Binhai Avenue for about ten minutes to reach Haobainian Seaview Restaurant on Changxin Road, Xiuying District.
location: Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (departure); Jiulong Pharmacy, Haixiu Middle Road, Longhua District (buying medicine on the way); Haobainian Seaview Restaurant, Changxin Road, Xiuying District (destination)

name: Set up the venue for his mentor's retirement farewell banquet in advance
description: Lu Mingqiang arrived early at the restaurant's sea-view private room. After communicating with the restaurant manager, he skillfully connected the projector and audio equipment, imported the photo slideshow from the USB drive, and repeatedly adjusted the transition effects and background music. He placed the tote bag containing the tool kit beside the seat of honor, a convenient spot for giving the gift, making thorough preparations for the upcoming retirement banquet.
location: Sea-view private room, Haobainian Seafood Restaurant (Guanhaitai No. 1 Branch), Changxin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Attended the retirement banquet for his mentor, Master Li.
description: His fellow apprentices and Master Li arrived one after another, and the large screen played a slideshow of master-apprentice group photos that Lu Mingqiang had carefully collected. As the apprentice representative, Lu Mingqiang gave a speech; his voice trembled as he recalled how the master had taught him hand in hand in 2007, and he presented a framed tool kit as a gift to the master. Deeply moved, Master Li gave him in return a set of treasured German-brand electrician tools and several work notebooks, telling Mingqiang to accomplish great things in the future. The banquet was filled with warmth, and everyone parted with reluctance.
location: Sea-view private room, Haobainian Seafood Restaurant (Guanhaitai No. 1 Branch), Changxin Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned home and organized photos from the farewell dinner to share gratitude.
description: After the banquet, Lu Mingqiang and his fellow apprentices saw off their master, then carried the toolbox the master had given him and drove home. Once home, he sat on the living room sofa drinking water, used his phone to edit photos and videos from the farewell banquet, compiled them into an album and sent it to the master-apprentice WeChat group. He also sent a separate photo of the two of them holding the toolbox to Master Li, along with a message of thanks and a promise to carry on his master's teachings.
location: Home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (on the way home and in the living room)

name: Tutor eldest son's homework and play with younger son
description: After safely storing the toolbox his master had given him, Lu Mingqiang saw his elder son Xuanxuan doing homework and helped him solve a difficult math problem. Then he played with his younger son Hanhan building dinosaur blocks, imitating dinosaur roars to amuse the child, enjoying quality family time.
location: Living room, home in Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Take the two sons out for a walk and buy snacks.
description: Seeing that the children were well-behaved, Lu Mingqiang took them downstairs, first strolled through the central garden of the community to enjoy the sunset, then walked to Xiangzhi Daily Necessities Store in Chengzhongcheng Community on Yusha Road and bought a box of strawberry yogurt and some cookies for Xuanxuan and Hanhan each. The children were very happy.
location: Xiangzhi General Store, Chengzhongcheng Community, 19 Yusha Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparing dinner together with his wife and sharing it with the whole family
description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen to help his wife Wang Lijuan wash vegetables and assist with cooking. As they worked, they talked about resolving the electricity bill problem and the master's retirement banquet. During dinner, the family sat around together, and Mingqiang proudly mentioned that his master had given him tools, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Soaked his feet in the evening for relaxation and confirmed the next day's house-cleaning plan with his wife.
description: After dinner, the children watched cartoons. Lu Mingqiang helped his wife clear the table, then suggested soaking their feet. The two sat on the sofa soaking their feet and watching TV, talking about next week's physical exam and New Year's Day plans, and confirming once again tomorrow afternoon's house cleaning arrangement. Lu Mingqiang felt the day had been busy but felt grounded and warm inside.
location: Living room, home in Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Guide the eldest son in washing up
description: Lu Mingqiang urged his eldest son Xuanxuan to brush his teeth, wash his face, and wash his feet by himself, standing by and guiding him seriously, reminding him to brush every corner thoroughly, just as his master had taught him with the same meticulousness.
location: Home bathroom, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Personal time: organize tools and document life
description: After the boys fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, carefully wiped the German electrician tools given by his master with a soft cloth, and placed them neatly in the bookcase compartment. He took out paper and pen to write a list of items needed for the next day’s thorough cleaning, and recorded his weight of 71.9 kg in his phone memo.
location: Home study, Banshan Garden, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing up and going to sleep.
description: Lu Mingqiang went to wash up, rinsing away the day's fatigue. He set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, turned off the living room light, and lay down in the bedroom. Reviewing the day, he felt fulfilled and content, and soon fell asleep peacefully with gratitude.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Early morning exercise and family breakfast.
description: At 7:10 in the morning, the phone alarm rang. Lu Mingqiang turned it off and stretched in bed. Outside the window it was cloudy with soft light. He went to the living room and stepped on the scale, which showed 71.7 kg, 0.2 kg lighter than yesterday, and he felt pleased. Considering there was a big cleanup today, he didn't go out for a run; instead he did 10 minutes of stretching and 30 squats in the living room. At 7:40, his wife Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang went over to help, reheating the leftover Hainanese chicken from the day before, frying sunny-side-up eggs, and pouring four glasses of milk. The family sat around the table, and while eating, Lu Mingqiang announced that the whole family would do a big cleanup this morning. The two children, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, were excited, and Zihan shouted that he wanted to wipe the table himself.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drank tea with neighbor to reconcile and obtained business information.
description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang changed into a clean polo shirt, said hello to his wife, and walked downstairs for about 3 minutes to the café in the residential complex to meet his neighbor, Mr. Wang. Mr. Wang had already ordered Tieguanyin tea and chicken feet. He apologized again for the earlier renovation mistake that caused the Lu family's high electricity bill, and transferred 400 yuan via WeChat as compensation. Lu Mingqiang accepted it and said the matter was settled. The conversation was pleasant. Mr. Wang mentioned that the circuit wiring in the new office area of his advertising company, which he co-owned, was messy and asked Lu Mingqiang to help redesign it on the weekend. Lu Mingqiang thought it was a good opportunity, agreed at once, and they agreed to meet at the site to look at the drawings next Saturday morning. After finishing the tea, Lu Mingqiang walked home, mulling over this job.
location: Ground-floor shop (tea restaurant) of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Family deep cleaning
description: Lu Mingqiang returned home, changed into old clothes, put on rubber gloves, and assigned tasks to the whole family: he was responsible for the living room light fixtures, dusting the bookcase, and cleaning the bathroom and balcony; his wife was responsible for the kitchen and bedroom; his eldest son Lu Zixuan wiped the surfaces of the furniture with a wet cloth; his younger son Lu Zihan swept the living room floor with a small broom. Lu Mingqiang wiped the dust off the living room chandelier, took the books out of the bookcase one by one, dusted them, and rearranged them by height. When cleaning the study, he was especially careful to wipe the toolbox his master had given him the day before, and used a dry cloth to clean his collection of baijiu bottles. The family worked for nearly two and a half hours, and the home was bright and clean.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: After the big cleaning came to an end, Lu Mingqiang washed his face and prepared lunch with his wife. He stir-fried a plate of water spinach and heated up the leftover Hainanese chicken, while Wang Lijuan made seaweed egg drop soup. The family of four sat at the clean dining table and enjoyed the meal. Lu Mingqiang praised the children for actively helping with the chores, and Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan both puffed out their chests, looking very proud.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang cleared away the dishes. Feeling sleepy, he walked into the bedroom, drew the curtains, and lay down on the bed. The room was quiet, and he soon fell asleep. About forty minutes later, he woke up feeling much refreshed.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Download, preview, and purchase the PLC course
description: After his lunch break, Lu Mingqiang sat down in his study room and searched on his phone for a well-reviewed electrician continuing education app, then downloaded it. After installing it, he found a course titled PLC Automation Control Basics priced at 99 yuan. He watched a sample lesson on PLC working principles and basic structure; the video explanations were clear and, combined with animation demonstrations, very practical. He thought the course quality was good and bought it for 99 yuan via WeChat Pay. After paying, he felt reassured and planned to spend one hour every evening starting tomorrow night to study systematically, laying a foundation for opening a studio and taking on smart home projects.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Organize annual work log and technical notes.
description: Lu Mingqiang took a thick stack of this year's work logs from the bookshelf and carefully took out the yellowed work notebook his mentor had given him the day before. He compared the classic circuit diagrams recorded by his mentor with his own typical fault cases, circled the key troubleshooting approaches in red pen, and wrote notes beside them. He sorted the cases onto several sheets of white paper by major categories such as Residential Tripping, Industrial Control, and Line Installation, preparing to compile a handbook titled Compilation of Common Electrical Fault Troubleshooting Cases at the end of the year. His wife Wang Lijuan was knitting sweaters in the living room, occasionally coming over to refill his water and asking if he needed help. Lu Mingqiang smiled and waved his hand, saying these were all his cherished treasures.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Accompany children in study and play
description: After organizing his notes, Lu Mingqiang stood up and moved around. His younger son Lu Zihan was playing with toy cars in the living room, and his older son Lu Zixuan was doing his weekend homework in the study. Lu Mingqiang sat next to Zixuan and helped him with multiplication and division word problems, using the example of sharing apples to explain the principle of division. Zixuan nodded in sudden understanding. Then he played with building blocks with Zihan, building a little house and sticking chopsticks in as utility poles, making Zihan giggle.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepare dinner and have a family dinner.
description: The wife took mackerel out of the fridge. Lu Mingqiang skillfully scaled it, removed the innards, and marinated it with salt and ginger slices; Wang Lijuan washed the bean sprouts. Lu Mingqiang was the main cook, frying the mackerel until both sides were golden, and also stir-fried a plate of garlic bean sprouts, while Wang Lijuan cooked rice in the rice cooker. At 6:15 PM the dishes were served, and the family sat around the table. Lu Mingqiang served fish to the two children and warned them to mind the bones. During the meal, they talked about the results of the spring cleaning and other interesting things. Lu Mingqiang and his wife also discussed their son's Wednesday math quiz and the electrical rewiring work arranged with Mr. Wang.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take a walk with his wife
description: After cleaning up the dishes, Lu Mingqiang changed into his running shoes, took his wife by the hand and went downstairs, strolling slowly along the shaded sidewalk of Jinmao Middle Road. With the gentle evening breeze, he told her in detail about having tea with the neighbor that morning and the business opportunity for office circuit renovation. He also mentioned buying a PLC course that afternoon, his eyes shining as he said that once he learned it, he would feel more confident taking on his own jobs. His wife held his arm and listened attentively. The two walked for about 40 minutes.
location: The section along Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go home to rest and help the eldest son with homework.
description: After returning home from the walk, Lu Mingqiang sat down on the sofa and casually flipped through a few TV channels to relax, while his wife went to the balcony to collect the clothes. At 8 p.m., he called his eldest son Lu Zixuan to the study to check his math homework and found that several vertical multiplication problems of two-digit by one-digit numbers were wrong. He did not directly give the answers, but patiently guided Zixuan to reread the problems and set out the vertical calculations step by step, helping his son find the mistake of forgetting to add the carry. Seeing his son correct it himself, he smiled and patted Zixuan on the shoulder.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and pre-sleep study warm-up
description: After making sure the two children took their baths, Lu Mingqiang went into the bathroom and took a warm shower, washing away the day's fatigue while running through the general outline of the PLC course in his mind. After showering, he changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, took out his phone again and opened the electrician refresher app, familiarized himself with the interface layout, and browsed the intro to the first official lesson. His wife was applying a face mask beside him.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Late-night talk between husband and wife, then falling asleep.
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone and put it on the bedside table. He turned sideways to his wife and said he would take compensatory leave tomorrow afternoon to go for a physical examination at Haikou People's Hospital, and asked her to remind him in the morning to bring his ID card and medical insurance card. His wife acknowledged and told him to sleep early. He glanced at the time—it was exactly ten o'clock—so he reached out and turned off the lamp, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep. This Sunday had been busy but fulfilling, and he felt increasingly clear about his future direction.
location: Room 704, Building 3, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run and family care
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. At home, he weighed himself barefoot: 71.5 kg, slightly lighter than yesterday, and felt pleased. He then changed into running shoes and sportswear, left quietly at 6:20, and walked to Wanlv Garden. The sky was overcast and the air was humid, perfect for running. He completed a 5-kilometer run in Wanlv Garden with a pace of 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he did deep breathing and muscle relaxation in the stretching area. While stretching, he saw a rainy forecast on his phone and immediately called his mother to remind her that the weather was turning cold and she should apply a hot towel to her knees and put on a medicated plaster. His mother laughed and agreed, and told him not to forget to eat breakfast.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Breakfast and taking the child to school
description: At 7:05 he got home, took a hot shower, and changed into clean work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared breakfast: steaming Hainan noodles and freshly ground soy milk. While eating, he listened to his eldest son Lu Zixuan talk about today’s math quiz, and helped his younger son Lu Zihan peel a boiled egg. At 7:30 he drove Zixuan to Longfeng Experimental Primary School first, telling him at the school gate not to be nervous. Then he turned the corner and arrived at Jinmao Center Kindergarten at 7:47. Watching Zihan and the teacher walk into the classroom, he turned back, waved, and said, "Goodbye, Daddy!"
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning work: preparing for fieldwork and mentoring the replacement of switch cabinet indicator lights.
description: Arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park at 8:00 on time, parked, entered the engineering department changing room, put on the full work uniform and safety helmet, and checked the tool bag for wrenches, screwdrivers, multimeter, indicator light spare parts, etc. At 8:10, took the apprentice Zhao Qiang and drove to the old residential area on Meihua Road. On the way, he quizzed Zhao Qiang on safety steps such as testing for voltage, discharging, and installing grounding wires; Zhao Qiang answered correctly. At 8:20, arrived at the site and supervised him in strictly implementing the measures of shutting off power, testing for voltage, and hanging warning signs. Then, referring to the drawings, he taught him hands-on how to remove old wires and connect new ones, emphasizing the technique of crimping connections firmly to prevent overheating. Completed all replacements at 10:45, energized and tested at 11:00, and all indicator lights came on normally. After packing up the tools, he drove back to the industrial park at 11:15.
location: Electrical distribution room of an old residential community on Meihua Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Returned to the company to handle internal matters.
description: After returning to the industrial park from Meihua Road, he let Zhao Qiang go rest first, then went to the tool room, wiped down and counted the used tools, and put each one back in place. Afterward, he took the comp time form signed by Team Leader Zhang to the office for filing. Colleague Xiao Lin asked if he was going to the afternoon physical exam, and he smiled and replied that it was once a year, just for peace of mind.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: In order to make the afternoon physical exam indicators better, he deliberately got light dishes in the cafeteria: stir-fried choy sum, tomato and scrambled eggs, and only a small half bowl of rice as the staple food. After the meal, he did not go back to the office and walked straight to the parking lot.
location: Canteen, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midday break
description: After lunch, he got into the car, reclined the driver's seat, and rested with his eyes closed for half an hour to build up energy for the afternoon physical exam. At 12:45 he adjusted the seat, started the car, and drove out of the industrial park.
location: Parking lot, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Drive to the hospital for a physical examination.
description: Driving along Haisheng Road, Binhai Avenue, and Renmin Avenue to Haikou People's Hospital. Traffic was moderate, arriving in about 20-plus minutes, and he parked in the hospital's multi-story parking garage.
location: Haikou People's Hospital, No. 43 Renmin Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Annual physical examination and waiting for the report
description: At 13:10, checked in at the reception desk of the physical examination center, swiped the card, and received the examination form. Following the instructions, completed blood draw, blood pressure, ECG, chest X-ray, abdominal ultrasound, and other items in sequence. The process was compact and orderly, and all items were finished around 15:00. The instant results showed that major organs such as the heart and lungs were functioning normally, but my weight at 71.5 kg was still on the heavy side. The doctor advised me to stick to “watch what you eat and keep moving” and told me to pick up the full report in one week. Then I queued for payment and other procedures; by the time I went downstairs to get the car, it was already nearly 17:00.
location: Physical Examination Center, Haikou People's Hospital, No. 43 Renmin Avenue, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Return trip, with shopping on the way home.
description: On the way home from the hospital, he made a detour to the Cailanzi Community Discount Supermarket near Banshan Garden. He picked fresh pomfret, spinach, tomatoes, scallions, and ginger, planning to make steamed pomfret, garlic spinach, and tomato egg drop soup for the family in the evening. After shopping, he drove 5 minutes home.
location: 10 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (Hainan Province Dormitory Store)

name: Prepare dinner, family gathering, and post-meal cleanup.
description: After getting home, he put on an apron and started washing vegetables, cutting vegetables, and preparing the fish. At around 18:00, his wife Wang Lijuan brought the younger son Zihan back home, and the older son Zixuan also arrived downstairs on the school bus; the whole family gradually gathered. He quickly prepared a meal of three dishes and one soup: steamed pomfret, garlic spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, he told the family that the physical exam results were not serious. His wife sighed with relief and suggested using less oil when cooking in the future. The two children ate the fish with gusto, and the house was full of laughter. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the table, wipe it down, and wash the dishes. Then he returned to the study and filed the day's physical exam invoice and medical records into a folder.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening study of PLC automation control course
description: He made a cup of hot tea, sat down at his desk, opened his laptop, put on earphones, and began studying the PLC automation control basics course he had purchased the night before. He watched the videos for the first and second lessons with full concentration, carefully drawing the PLC input/output wiring diagram in his kraft notebook and labeling the key ports. Midway through studying, his younger son Zihan ran into the study and looked on curiously, so he picked him up and sat him on his lap. Pointing at the diagram, he said this was the secret weapon for opening a personal repair shop in the future; once he learned it, he could fix even more powerful machines. Zihan nodded as if he half understood.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family time and a walk around the neighborhood.
description: After closing the notebook, he felt a bit mentally overtaxed. His wife Wang Lijuan had also finished the housework, so they both changed into sneakers, went downstairs, and strolled slowly around the neighborhood for half an hour. They chatted about daily life as they walked and also discussed what gifts to bring to his mother-in-law's home next week.
location: Inside Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening core training and stretching
description: After walking home, he laid out the yoga mat in the living room and did a 15-minute abdominal core workout and full-body stretching, then used a foam roller to carefully relax his calf muscles that were tight from running.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: He filled a basin with hot water and soaked his feet comfortably, relaxing all over. While soaking his feet, he picked up his phone and replied to a few messages in the coworker group and the junior high school classmates group. At 22:00, he finished washing up, checked tomorrow's alarm, and laid out the clothes he would wear.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Lying in bed, he picked up the Electrician's Practical Handbook from the bedside and flipped through a dozen or so pages, pondering the new techniques in the book. At 11:00 PM on the dot, he turned off the lights and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and confidence in the future.
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Morning washing and weigh-in.
description: After the alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up and went to the bathroom to weigh himself. The digital scale showed 71.5 kg, and he was satisfied with his stable weight. He then quickly brushed his teeth and washed his face, changed into a short-sleeved workout set and running shoes, and got ready to go out for his morning run.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning run in Wanlv Park
description: Lu Mingqiang walked about 15 minutes from home to Wanlv Garden, where he did a 5-minute dynamic warm-up at the entrance, including high knees and jumping jacks. He then started a 5 km morning run along the seaside path, keeping a comfortable pace and focusing on his breathing and stride. After the run, he did 10 minutes of static stretching, focusing on relaxing his calf muscles.
location: Wanlv Garden, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Return home, take a shower, and have breakfast
description: Lu Mingqiang walked home, took a quick cold shower, and changed into clean work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had breakfast ready. He quickly ate a bowl of Hainan rice noodles and drank a glass of plain water. Then he took his work badge and phone, said goodbye to his family, and left.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drive to the company
description: Lu Mingqiang drove his family car along Jinmao Middle Road and Qiuhai Avenue, and arrived at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park about 15 minutes later. He parked in the parking lot and prepared to start the day's work.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift meeting.
description: After changing into his work clothes, Lu Mingqiang attended the Engineering Department’s pre-shift meeting on time. Team Leader Zhang assigned the key task for the day: go to Youyi Nanhai City to perform routine maintenance and testing on two transformers. He designated Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo as partners and emphasized safety precautions. Lu Mingqiang listened attentively and mentally went through the operating procedures.
location: Engineering Department Office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Transformer maintenance and repair
description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo drove to Friendship Nanhai City with toolboxes and testing instruments. After arriving, they liaised with the mall's property electrician and confirmed the power outage scope and operating procedures. The two divided the work: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for the high-voltage side inspection, and Chen Jianguo was responsible for the low-voltage side maintenance. They inspected the transformer oil level, appearance, and tightness of wiring terminals one by one, used an infrared thermometer to measure the temperature of key contacts, and cleaned dust from the radiator. During a break, the two also chatted about their children's studies.
location: Power Transformer and Distribution Room, Youyi Nanhai City, No. 115 Nanhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drove back to the office.
description: The morning maintenance work ended smoothly. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo packed up their tools, drove the company vehicle from Youyi Nanhai City back to the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, and planned to have lunch near the company.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and rest with fellow workers
description: Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and other co-workers walked about 5 minutes to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. He ordered a signature spicy soup rice and an iced lemon tea. While eating, he remembered he had a video call with his childhood friend Wang Hai in the evening and thought about discussing year-end work arrangements and funny stories about his sons. After the meal, everyone sat in the restaurant and rested for about 20 minutes.
location: Elder Sister's Spicy Soup Rice, No. 56-4, First Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Garden, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Afternoon maintenance wrap-up and paperwork
description: At 1 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo drove again to Youyi Nanhai City to complete the insulation resistance test and withstand voltage test on the transformer. After confirming all data were normal, they filled out the Maintenance Record Sheet and Chen Jianguo reviewed and signed it. The two tidied up the site, handed over to the property electrician, and returned to the company at 3 p.m. Back at the office, Lu Mingqiang entered today's work records into the computer system and went to the tool room to take inventory of consumables that needed to be replenished.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Driving home from work.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed out of his work clothes, tidied his desk, said goodbye to his colleagues, and drove home. Since it was rush hour, the roads were a bit congested. He tuned the car radio to the local traffic channel, listened to traffic reports and songs, and arrived at Banshan Garden about 25 minutes later.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Arriving home and interacting with family
description: As soon as Lu Mingqiang entered, his two sons came up to greet him. He put down his bag, picked up his younger son Hanhan and gave him a kiss, then ruffled the hair of his older son Xuanxuan. His wife Wang Lijuan was preparing dinner in the kitchen, so he went in to help set out the bowls and chopsticks and asked how the two children had done at school today.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the dining table, on which were the Hainanese chicken rice, blanched shrimp, and stir-fried sweet potato leaves that his wife had carefully prepared. While eating, Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife about the day's maintenance work and the video call with his childhood friend Wang Hai that evening. They also finalized the plan to go to his maternal grandmother's home for the Winter Solstice (December 21) dinner, and Lu Mingqiang reminded his wife to prepare the gifts in advance.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Tutor and accompany the children.
description: After dinner, his wife cleared the tableware. Lu Mingqiang first accompanied his elder son Xuanxuan at the desk to check math homework, corrected two vertical calculation errors, and encouraged him to write neatly. Then he went to the living room, sat with his younger son Hanhan on the floor mat, and built a "castle" with building blocks. Hanhan happily installed little plastic windows on the "castle".
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Had a video call with a childhood friend.
description: Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa and used his wife's phone to send a WeChat video invitation to Wang Hai, his childhood friend far away in Shenzhen. Wang Hai answered quickly. The two sons first crowded in front of the camera and said hello to Uncle Wang Hai. Then Lu Mingqiang excitedly told Wang Hai that he had earned his senior technician certificate this year. Wang Hai congratulated him repeatedly over the video. The two then talked about their recent lives and children, and agreed that Wang Hai must definitely get together with them when he came back to Haikou for the Spring Festival.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Discussed Spring Festival arrangements with wife
description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang was in a great mood and enthusiastically told his wife about his conversation with Wang Hai, especially the plan to meet during the Spring Festival. His wife Wang Lijuan was also pleased, and the two discussed how to host Wang Hai during the Spring Festival, such as going to Jiamie Dapaidang or the newly opened coconut chicken restaurant near their home, and whether to invite other friends who were around.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Record a memo for the Spring Festival gathering.
description: Lu Mingqiang took out his phone, opened the memo feature, and noted down the rough time, location ideas, and reminders from the discussion he had just had with his wife about Wang Hai coming back to Haikou for a Spring Festival gathering, so he wouldn't forget.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Study the PLC course.
description: After the children washed up and went back to their rooms, Lu Mingqiang made a cup of tea, sat at his desk, and opened the PLC automation control basic course he had bought on his phone. He put on his earphones and studied Lessons 3 and 4 about input/output interfaces. As he listened to the instructor, he carefully drew various wiring diagrams in his notebook, marked key points with different colored pens, and replayed anything he didn't understand.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Evening washing up
description: After finishing his study, Lu Mingqiang stood up and stretched his limbs, then went to the bathroom to brush his teeth, wash his face, and soak his feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue. He checked his phone to make sure tomorrow's alarm was set (06:20).
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang turned off the bedroom light and lay in bed, thinking back over the day: work had gone smoothly, the family was healthy, he had caught up with an old friend, and he had kept up with his studies. He felt very grounded and content. He closed his eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake-up and weight record
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm went off and felt in good spirits. After getting up, went to the bathroom to weigh himself; the electronic scale showed 71.4 kg, down 0.1 kg from yesterday. He felt satisfied and recorded the weight in his phone notes.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning preparation and leaving home
description: He quickly washed up, changed into running gear (quick-dry T-shirt, shorts, running shoes), checked his phone and keys, and brought a small towel to wipe off sweat. After softly saying goodbye to his wife and children, who were still sleeping, he tiptoed out of the house, ready to go for a morning run at Wanlv Park.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Morning run with running partner Chen Bin
description: After a seven-minute walk, he arrived at the west gate of Evergreen Park and met up with Chen Bin. After a five-minute warm-up, they started a 5-kilometer run. The pace stayed around 6:30 per kilometer, and the last two kilometers were picked up to 6:25. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes at the lakeside railing, exchanged half-marathon training tips with Chen Bin, and agreed to run together again next Wednesday.
location: Rubber track inside the west gate of Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower and simple breakfast
description: After running home, he took a hot shower and changed into clean work clothes. His wife Wang Lijuan had already taken the younger son to kindergarten and prepared breakfast: a glass of hot milk, two boiled eggs, and two slices of whole wheat bread. While eating, he shared a running check-in photo in the family WeChat group.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Take his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to school
description: Drove the eldest son Lu Zixuan to school. On the way, the child complained that the math problems were difficult; he patiently encouraged him and promised to tutor him in the evening. Arrived at the school gate at 8:15, told him to listen carefully in class, watched him enter the school, then drove to the company.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pre-shift meeting and emergency task confirmation
description: Arrived at the company at 8:35 and attended the pre-shift meeting. Shift Leader Zhang reported that the cable at the intersection of Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road had been cut by construction, causing a power outage, and assigned Lu Qiang and Chen Jianguo to take apprentice Zhao Qiang to the scene immediately for emergency repairs. Received the task order and clarified the division of labor.
location: Meeting room of the Engineering Department, Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Preparation and tool check before departure.
description: After the meeting, they went to the tool room to check safety belts, insulating shoes, safety helmets, and voltage testers. Chen Jianguo picked up high-voltage cable cold-shrink joints and insulating tape. Lu Qiang re-checked the safety rope on the truck, and after confirming all equipment was in order, the three set off in the work pickup truck.
location: Tool room and parking lot of the Engineering Department, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Emergency cable repair on Haisheng Road
description: Arrived at the site at 9:25. After the power supply bureau dispatcher confirmed the power outage, he and Chen Jianguo dug open the damaged cable trench and found the fault point. Lu Qiang cut off the damaged section and stripped the cable, Chen Jianguo prepared a new cold-shrink joint, and Zhao Qiang handed tools and kept records. At 12:00 noon, they had a simple meal of crackers and water by the vehicle, rested for 15 minutes, and then continued. At 13:10, the new joint was installed and passed the insulation test, and power was restored.
location: Inside the construction enclosure at the southeast side of the intersection of Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break
description: After the emergency repair was completed, the three went to the nearby Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant. Lu Qiang ordered the signature Hainan noodles with pickled mustard, Chen Jianguo ordered pig trotter rice, and Zhao Qiang ordered stir-fried noodles. While eating, they discussed the details of the repair and joked about the construction crew driver. After the meal, they planned the next task location.
location: Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go to the power supply station and complete the line inspection wrap-up
description: After the meal, they drove for 10 minutes to the Xiuying Power Supply Station, where they checked the emergency repair records and cable test data with the duty officer. Zhao Qiang entered the repair work orders and parts consumption details into the management system. Around 15:00, all procedures were completed, and the three of them finished work early.
location: Second-floor office, Xiuying Power Supply Station, Haikou Power Supply Bureau, No. 39 Xiuying Avenue, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Pick up younger son Lu Zihan from school
description: Drove directly from the power supply station to the kindergarten, arriving at the gate of Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten at 16:50, just in time for pickup. The younger son ran out happily and said the teacher praised his drawing today. On the way, he asked the children what they wanted for dinner; the child wanted the pancakes Dad made, and then they all went home together.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Homework tutoring and parent-child interaction
description: After arriving home, the eldest son was already doing homework. Lu Qiang changed into loungewear, then checked the math homework, found a flaw in the approach to an application problem, and patiently explained it by drawing line segments. The younger son was playing with toy building blocks nearby, occasionally coming over to watch his older brother study.
location: Living room and study, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Have dinner with the family
description: When his wife came home from work and started cooking, Lu Qiang put on an apron and helped make scallion oil pancakes, specially frying one in the shape of a little dinosaur for his younger son. Dinner included pancakes, stir-fried baby bok choy, stir-fried pork with peppers, and fish soup. During the meal, they shared the funny story of the excavator operator being scolded by the foreman during the emergency repair that day, and the whole family laughed.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province
