His wife reminded him to watch his lower back. He then drove 10 minutes to the squash club parking lot.
location: Haikou Tiantian Squash Club, Yujingfeng, Fuli Garden, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Regular squash training
description: Arrived at Court 3 in the gym and changed into the right gear. After a 5-minute warm-up with badminton partner Lin Feng, we started practicing. Focused on backhand volleys. Despite being tired from work during the day, I concentrated well and had a good feel. After three games, my backhand success rate improved significantly. The practice ended at 20:15, and I did 10 minutes of stretching.
location: Court 3, Haikou Tiantian Squash Club, Yujingfeng, Fuli Garden, Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Going home and taking a shower.
description: After exercising, Lu Qiang drove home. By the time he arrived, his two sons had already washed up, and his wife was reading them a bedtime story. Lu Qiang took a quick shower, changed into his pajamas, and got ready to relax.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Midnight snack and chat with wife
description: After he finished showering, the child was already asleep. His wife took some Qingbuliang out of the fridge and gave Lu Qiang a small bowl. The two sat on the sofa, sipping and chatting about the day's amusing emergency repair stories. Lu Qiang stopped after just a few bites, explaining that it was high in calories and he didn't want to eat too much; his wife smiled and finished the rest.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Relaxation and preparation before bed
description: Lying in bed, he set the next day's alarm on his phone. Feeling tired, he put aside the planned PLC study for the time being. Remembering that he needed to schedule a physical exam next week, he wrote a reminder in his memo. He discussed tomorrow's dinner plan with his wife and decided to make a light winter melon and clam soup.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Going to bed
description: After turning off the light, he exchanged goodnights with his wife. Recalling that today's work had gone smoothly and that he had kept up his exercise, he felt at ease and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 12, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Morning wash-up, breakfast, and preparing to take the child to school
description: At 06:30, the phone alarm went off. Lu Mingqiang got up and, while still lying in bed, moved his left knee to confirm that the soreness from playing squash was still there but not a problem. In the bathroom he washed up with cold water and checked the air quality on his phone. At 06:50, his wife Wang Lijuan had breakfast ready: rice porridge, fried eggs, and two coconut-flavored steamed buns. The two ate and chatted about the day's work arrangements. Lu Mingqiang mentioned that he would spend the morning taking stock of old tools in the warehouse and planned to organize repair orders in the afternoon. After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang checked his work badge, keys, and phone, reminded his two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, to check their schoolbags and water bottles, helped Lu Zihan zip up his jacket, and confirmed that the electric scooter was charged.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Drove the two children to school
description: Lu Mingqiang drove out of the residential area and turned left from Jinmao Middle Road onto Longkun North Road. He first took his elder son, Lu Zixuan, to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District), telling him to listen carefully in class and not to run around wildly. After watching Lu Zixuan enter the school gate, he turned around and headed back to Longhua District, taking his younger son, Lu Zihan, to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District). On the way, Lu Zihan recited "Ode to the Goose," and Lu Mingqiang praised him: "You recited that really well!" Only after seeing his son led into the kindergarten by the teacher did he leave with peace of mind.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, then going to Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District) and Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten (Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District)

name: Commute to the company and attend the pre-shift meeting
description: After leaving the kindergarten, Lu Mingqiang drove along Guomao No.3 Cross Road, Binhai Avenue, and Haisheng Road for about 15 minutes to reach the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park. He swiped his work card and parked his car in the staff parking shed. At 08:00, he changed into his work clothes in the team office and attended the pre-shift meeting hosted by Team Leader Zhang. Team Leader Zhang arranged for the morning to assist the warehouse with the annual tool inventory, and instructed Lu Mingqiang to check in the afternoon whether an old impact drill could be repaired. Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement.
location: Team office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Morning warehouse tool inventory and handover
description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang, warehouse administrator Lao Li, and colleague Zhao Qiang went to the company warehouse for the annual tool inventory. He was grouped with Lao Li, carefully checking off the crimping pliers, multimeters, insulating boots, safety ropes, and so on from the list one by one. In a corner they found an old impact drill that had been reported for repair, with a blurred nameplate and a stuck switch, so they moved it and another scrapped drill to the scrap area, and wrote in the remarks column of the list: "Model unknown, decommissioned, recommended for scrapping." After the inventory, Lu Mingqiang helped Lao Li check the spreadsheet data, signed after confirming it was correct, and agreed on the subsequent scrapping process.
location: Company warehouse in Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch
description: After work, Lu Mingqiang walked with his workmate Chen Jianguo to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant at the entrance of the industrial park (first floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road). They ordered the signature spicy soup rice set meal and chatted about the afternoon plans while eating. Lu Mingqiang said he had no outside tasks in the afternoon and planned to organize the whole year's maintenance work orders in the break room. After the meal, he stopped at the Bianli Shenghuo Convenience Store next door and bought a bottle of water.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang returned to the team rest room at the company, lay down on the folding bed, folded his work jacket into a pillow, set a 30-minute alarm, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Organizing maintenance work orders and drafting a case framework
description: After the lunch-break alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang stretched and sat up, washed his face with cold water to wake himself up, took a notebook and pen from the locker, and sat down at the desk nearby. He took out the whole year's work order receipts and maintenance record sheets from the file cabinet, arranged them by month, and carefully went through them, noting frequent faults in red pen, such as 'The overload protection of an XX-model transformer in the Haisheng Road area tripped frequently, 7 times in total' and 'Air switches in the distribution boxes of an old residential area on Longkun South Road aged and burned out, 5 replacements.' As he reviewed, he recalled the handling process in his mind and thought these cases were useful for training new employees and for improving his own skills. At about 16:30, after finishing, he photographed the records, then wrote an outline for a case compilation in his notebook, dividing it into categories such as 'transformer faults', 'aging wiring', and 'user-related causes', and planned to add specific steps and diagrams the next day.
location: Office desk in the team rest room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Go to the squash court after work
description: After tidying up the documents and notes on the desk, Lu Mingqiang changed into his own T-shirt and sports shorts, sent a message to his friend Lin Feng in the group chat saying "I'm leaving, see you at the usual place," and then rode his e-bike out of the industrial park, along Haisheng Road and Binhai Avenue to the Guomao Squash Club on Guomao Avenue.
location: From Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Guomao Squash Club, Guomao Avenue, Longhua District.

name: Ankle sprain during squash training and ice pack treatment
date: Kitchen and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province
description: After arriving at Guomao Squash Club, Lu Mingqiang changed into his sport shoes, greeted Lin Feng, who was already warming up, and then did lunge stretches, high knees, and torso twists on the sideline, loosening up his joints and paying special attention to his left ankle. As the weather was damp and overcast, he also asked whether the court was slippery. The two began a rally and drop-shot practice match on Court 2. After about 20 minutes, when Lu Mingqiang made a big sideways lunge to save a ball in the left rear court, his left foot landed unsteadily, his ankle rolled outward with a light "crack" and sharp pain, and he immediately crouched down. Lin Feng hurried over to ask what happened, helped him to the rest area, and ran to the front desk to get an ice pack and a towel. Lu Mingqiang put his left foot up on a chair, and Lin Feng applied the ice pack to the most painful spot on the outside of his ankle. Feeling the cool and stinging sensation, Lu Mingqiang admitted that he hadn't been paying attention to the floor. After about 20 minutes of icing, the swelling and pain had eased.
location: Court 2 and rest area, Guomao Squash Club, Guomao Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buying medicine and food ingredients on the way home.
description: After the ice pack, the swelling and pain subsided. Lu Mingqiang thanked Lin Feng and rode his electric bike home with a limp. Passing the pharmacy at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Community, he stopped to buy Yunnan Baiyao aerosol and a roll of elastic bandage. Then he went to the nearby Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket (No. 10 Jinmao Middle Road) to buy crucian carp and tofu, planning to have his wife make soup.
location: The pharmacy at the entrance of Banshan Garden Residential Community on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan, and the Vegetable Basket Community Discount Supermarket at 10 Jinmao Middle Road (Hainan Province Dormitory Branch).

name: Wife bandaged the injured area and prepared dinner.
description: After arriving home, his wife Wang Lijuan saw Lu Mingqiang limping and quickly put down her work to ask what had happened. Learning that he had sprained his ankle playing squash, she helped him take off his dirty socks, revealing that the outside of his left ankle was visibly swollen and slightly red. Wang Lijuan first continued applying an ice pack, then took out the bandage and Yunnan Baiyao aerosol spray she had just bought, and skillfully bandaged and fixed the injured area using the figure-eight method. After treatment, she told Lu Mingqiang not to move around, and went to the kitchen to make soup with crucian carp and tofu.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: The whole family sat around the dining table. Dinner included crucian carp and tofu soup, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and fried eggs. Because his left foot was uncomfortable, Lu Mingqiang had some difficulty picking up food with his left hand. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, proactively put some fish in his bowl, and his younger son, Lu Zihan, also scooped some soup with a spoon and handed it to him, saying, "Dad, have some soup, and the pain will go away." Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside and reassured the family that it was just a minor injury and would heal in two days.
location: Living room and dining room, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Tutoring eldest son in math homework
description: After a short rest after dinner, Lu Mingqiang went to his son Lu Zixuan's room to check his homework. He found that a math word problem about multiples had an incorrect equation. Instead of directly telling him the answer, he used building blocks to demonstrate the difference between "one times" and "two times", letting Lu Zixuan understand it himself through hands-on demonstration. Lu Zixuan soon corrected the mistake and excitedly said, "I understand!" Lu Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder and encouraged him to draw a picture first when he was stuck in the future.
location: Lu Zixuan's room, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Upper body and core strength training
description: Because his ankle injury made it hard to stand, Lu Mingqiang laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did exercises that did not involve his ankle. He completed 4 sets of dumbbell curls (12 kg), 3 sets of bent-over rows, 3 sets of planks (holding each for 45 seconds), and 3 sets of lying leg raises. After the workout he was lightly sweaty all over and felt a bit more at ease.
location: Living room, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Study the PLC course.
description: After a quick wash, Lu Mingqiang went to the study, put the PLC course CD he bought last week into the computer's optical drive, installed the accompanying software as prompted, and then opened Lesson One to study the two sections "Introduction to the Programming Software Interface" and "Creating Your First Small Program." Since he had previewed the material, the content was not difficult to follow.
location: Study, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Record the injury and adjust the training plan
description: After finishing the course, Lu Mingqiang took out his notebook and wrote: 'Ankle sprained, ice-pack applied and bandaged. Today's upper-body and core training completed. Plan: rest tomorrow, apply ice again Friday evening, and decide Saturday whether to switch to upper-body training. Suspend the running plan next week.' After writing, he gently moved his left ankle and felt the swelling pain was lighter than right after the injury.
location: Study, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang sat on the edge of the bed while his wife helped him undo the elastic bandage and change into loose pajama pants. Then he went to the bathroom to wash his face with warm water and brush his teeth briefly. Back in the bedroom, he told his wife that his foot probably wasn't a big deal and that resting for a couple of days would be enough; his wife reminded him not to get it wet tomorrow. After turning off the bedside lamp, Lu Mingqiang felt a faint pain in his ankle in the dark. Reviewing the day, he saw that work, family, and self-improvement had all been taken care of, and he soon fell asleep in the evening breeze.
location: Bedroom, Room 203, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Community, 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake-up and upper-body strength training
description: When he woke up in the morning, he found that the swelling on his left ankle had clearly reduced, and he felt much more at ease. The sky outside the window was gray, carrying the dampness after the rain. He wrapped his left ankle firmly with an elastic bandage to avoid discomfort during movement. Then he completed a 20-minute upper-body strength workout on the balcony: 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each, core engaged, avoiding body sway), 3 sets of resistance band rows (12 reps each, focusing on back engagement), and 3 sets of planks (40 seconds each).
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning washing, waking the eldest son, and having breakfast with the family.
description: After training, he went back to the bathroom to wash up. At 7:15, he pushed open the door of his eldest son Xuanxuan's room, drew the curtains, and played the audio story of 'Journey to the West' to wake him. Then he took a quick shower and changed into his work uniform. His wife Juanzi had already laid out breakfast: white porridge, fried eggs, pickled mustard tuber, and steamed sweet potato. Xuanxuan complained that the rain affected his morning exercises. Juanzi said she would take the younger son Hanhan to kindergarten, and Lu Mingqiang would take Xuanxuan to school. When they mentioned that his ankle was recovering well, Juanzi felt relieved.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 6, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Take eldest son to school
description: Wearing a raincoat and helmet, he took Xuanxuan on the e-bike to school in the drizzling rain. After riding to the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School and watching Xuanxuan sling on his backpack and go inside, he turned around and headed toward the company.
location: Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School, No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commute and pre-shift meeting
description: It took 12 minutes to ride the e-bike from the school to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park. After parking and changing into work clothes, he attended the team pre-shift meeting at exactly 8 o'clock. Team leader Zhang assigned the year-end safety and cleaning tasks, and Lu Mingqiang was assigned to the tool cabinet organizing and cleaning group.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Morning housecleaning.
description: Carried out a thorough cleaning in the tool room of Electric Installation Class 2. He was in charge of organizing the tool cabinet. First, he took out all the wrenches, screwdrivers, multimeters, pliers, etc., and wiped each one with metal cleaner until shiny. Then he re-planned the layout, printed new labels with the label maker, and stuck them on. Chen Jianguo, after finishing his own workstation, came over to help carry old spare parts from the corner.
location: Tool Room, Power Installation Team 2, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Canteen lunch and year-end summary meeting notice
description: After finishing the big cleaning, he went to the cafeteria with Chen Jianguo. While waiting in line, squad leader Zhang Tou came over carrying a tray and said, 'Qiangzi, the team year-end summary meeting is next Monday. Get ready and share with everyone the outline of the case compilation you put together this year.' Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement. Lunch was braised pork belly, stir-fried bean sprouts with vermicelli, and seaweed egg drop soup.
location: Company canteen at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan

name: Lunch break and foot relaxation.
description: After the meal, he returned to his workstation, moved a low stool over to elevate his left foot to help reduce swelling. The rain outside gradually stopped, and he closed his eyes and rested for half an hour.
location: Workstation of Electric Installation Team 2, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Afternoon cleaning wrap-up and handling team affairs
description: Continued wrapping up in the afternoon, tidied the spare parts warehouse, and sorted the newly arrived guide rails and terminal blocks by model onto storage racks. Colleague Zhao Qiang helped pass tools and chatted. He found that the carbon brushes on two old electric drills were nearly worn out and recorded them as scrapped. Then he and Chen Jianguo checked the warehouse drainage pipes to prevent water accumulation during the rainy season, and returned to the tool room to enter the morning tool list into the computer for archiving.
location: Tool room and warehouse, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: After-work chat and preparing to go out
description: 10 minutes before getting off work, went downstairs with Chen Jianguo to smoke. After calculating the time, decided to go directly to pick up the child and buy some things on the way.
location: Downstairs at Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Purchase assembly materials.
description: Ride the e-bike out of the industrial park, go to Chuangyi Stationery Store across the road, and buy two packs of heavyweight A4 printing paper, a transparent cover, and two 30-page folders.
location: Chuangyi Stationery Store, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Go to Longhua District to get dad's tea snacks to go
description: After buying the materials, he hung the bags on the bicycle handlebars, turned around and rode toward Longhua District. About ten minutes later, he arrived at Datie Dad's Tea Shop on Binya Road. He asked the owner to pack four coconut-shred buns, six egg tarts, and two iced lemon teas.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Picked up my sons from school and went home.
description: He timed his ride to arrive at the gate of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School just as Xuanxuan was leaving school. After picking him up, the father and son chatted and laughed all the way back home at Banshan Garden.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Go home and share weekend snacks
description: When he got home, his wife Juanzi was watching TV in the living room with their younger son Hanhan. Lu Mingqiang opened the packed pastries. Xuanxuan and Hanhan each took an egg tart and ate happily. Lu Mingqiang asked them about interesting things at school and kindergarten, and handed the iced lemon black tea to Juanzi.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Homework guidance and parent-child time.
description: After the snack, he had Xuanxuan go to his room to do homework. He sat beside him while Xuanxuan did math mental arithmetic and Chinese character exercises. When encountering a word problem about line graphs, he patiently guided him to understand the data and read the chart. Hanhan was playing with a Lego fire truck nearby and occasionally handed over pieces to ask for help.
location: Home study and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Dinner and casual chat about weekend plans
description: Juanzi prepared a rich dinner: blanched shrimp, stir-fried choy sum, crucian carp and tofu soup, and soy sauce chicken. The whole family chatted while eating. Xuanxuan said he would perform a poetry recitation at next week's New Year's party, and Hanhan said tomorrow there would be a winter garden party at the kindergarten. Everyone discussed going to Evergreen Park on Saturday morning to fly kites, and Juanzi reminded them to watch their ankles and not run too hard.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Clearing the dishes and replying to coworkers' messages.
description: After dinner, Juanzi cleared the table while Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the sofa replying to WeChat messages. His workmate Chen Bin sent a voice message: "Old Lu, are you free this weekend? Want to go fishing by the sea?" Lu Mingqiang smiled and replied: "I sprained my ankle so I can't run, but fishing's fine. You set the time."
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Studied PLC and organized and printed documents.
description: After the children played on their own, he went into the study and rested his injured left foot on a low stool. He turned on the laptop to study PLC course lessons 5 and 6 (timer and counter instructions), watched the video tutorial, and used a red pen to highlight key points and draw flowcharts. After finishing, he organized the annual technical case compilation, entered the tool scrapping records and high-frequency fault data found during the day into electronic documents, selected the sections to be printed (high-frequency fault analysis and typical emergency repair cases), loaded the newly purchased thick printing paper, and printed them.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After printing, he stretched and went to the bathroom to wash up. Juanzi was already making the bed. Lu Mingqiang chatted with her briefly about tomorrow's plans, and together they checked weekend items such as umbrellas and kites.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Apply an ice pack before bed
description: Checked the swollen and painful ankle one last time; it was clearly better than in the morning. Took an ice pack out of the fridge, wrapped it in a towel, and applied it to the front and outer side of the left ankle for about 10 minutes.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Going to bed
description: After the ice pack, the light was turned off. Juanzi asked softly how the foot felt, and I answered that it was much better and would definitely be fully recovered by tomorrow. After saying goodnight to each other, we fell asleep peacefully, with the occasional chirping of insects outside the window.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning stretching and ankle assessment.
description: Master Lu was awakened by his phone alarm, and sunlight streamed into the bedroom through the gaps in the curtains. Lying in bed, he first moved his left ankle slowly and repeatedly, rotating it clockwise and counterclockwise, and pulled his toes back to gauge the soreness, which was noticeably lighter than yesterday. Then he sat up, held the wall, and did 5 minutes of dynamic lower-body warm-up. Confirming that putting weight on his left foot caused no stabbing pain, he decided to try a light jog as planned.
location: Main bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Jog and stretch on the community trail.
description: Lu Mingqiang changed into a sports T-shirt and running shoes, wrapped his left ankle with an elastic bandage for support, and went downstairs to try running on the flat path in the community at a pace slightly faster than brisk walking. He focused on feeling the response of his ankle with each step. After about 1.5 kilometers, there was only slight soreness, so he ran another 500 meters before stopping, covering about 2 kilometers in about 23 minutes. Then he did a 10-minute full-body stretch by a bench in the community, focusing on the rear calves and Achilles tendons, and felt his muscles were in good condition and his ankle was fine.
location: Internal walkways and living room of Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Upper body and core supplementary training.
description: After returning home, Master Lu drank a few sips of warm water and, while his body was still warm, started training on the yoga mat in the living room. He first did 15 minutes of upper-body strength training, including 4 sets each of 10 kg dumbbell curls, lateral raises, and bent-over rows. Then he did 10 minutes of core training, including planks, lying leg raises, and Russian twists. Throughout, he kept his upper body stable to avoid putting extra strain on his left ankle.
location: Living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family breakfast and morning relaxation.
description: Wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked white congee. Master Lu reheated the coconut buns and egg tarts packed from Datie Laoba Tea Shop last night. The two chatted over breakfast at the table. Wang Lijuan reminded him to take their younger son Hanhan to the art interest class in the morning and asked Master Lu not to forget to tutor their elder son Xuanxuan's programming homework. Master Lu responded and said his ankle felt almost fully recovered.
location: Restaurant, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Learning PLC programming (Lessons 7-9)
description: After breakfast and clearing the dishes, Master Lu, full of energy, made a cup of instant Hainan coffee to refresh himself, sat down at his desk, and opened a PLC programming instructional video. Today's goal was lessons 7 through 9, which involved more complex ladder logic and the use of function instructions. He drew circuit diagrams and logic diagrams in his notebook while watching, marking key points and difficult parts with red and blue pens. When his eyes became sore halfway through, he stood up to drink coffee and walked around the study to relax. By around 11:40, he had basically mastered the core content of the three lessons.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: The house was quiet. Wang Lijuan took Hanhan to an interest class. Master Lu cooked himself a bowl of vegetable and egg noodles for a simple lunch. After eating, he leaned against the living room sofa and scrolled through mobile news for a while, watched a few short videos about maintenance techniques for old electrical equipment, then rested with his eyes closed for about 20 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and living room, Banshan Garden Residential Community, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Getting the old tools ready and commuting to the tea shop.
description: Master Lu entered the study, opened the storage box, carefully took out several old electric repair tools — a 1960s oil-immersed switch and a few pairs of old wire connectors — wiped them clean with a soft cloth, and put them into an old canvas tool bag. At 12:45 he shouldered the bag, put on his jacket, and rode his electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road onto Binya Road, arriving at Datie Laoba Tea Shop about 15 minutes later.
location: From Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road, Longhua District

name: Researched old tools with co-worker Chen Jianguo and agreed to fly kites
description: Master Lu parked his car and went into the shop. His co-worker Chen Jianguo was already waiting in a booth near the back, with two cups of Laoba tea and a plate of peanuts on the table. After exchanging pleasantries, Master Lu took out the oil-immersed switch and carefully disassembled it while drinking tea, analyzing the internal mechanical linkage principle and the sealing design. Chen Jianguo also used his phone to show old equipment photos taken at their former factory. The two looked at the photos and recalled the days when they had learned skills from the old master, chatting with great concentration. When they were about to leave, they agreed to go to Baishamen Park to fly kites after the weather turned nice after New Year’s Day. Chen Jianguo said he would bring the newly made giant centipede kite. They said goodbye at the door and finalized the arrangement.
location: Datie Laoba Tea House, Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Commuted home and helped his eldest son with programming homework.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Jianguo, Master Lu rode his electric bike home along Binyan Road and Jinmao Middle Road, taking about 15 minutes. When he got home, he saw his eldest son Lu Zixuan frowning at the children's programming homework on the computer. He put down his toolbox, moved a stool and sat beside him. Master Lu did not directly help with the code. Instead, he drew a simple relay self-locking circuit diagram on paper, explaining that the loop instructions in programming are similar to the principle of a circuit repeatedly turning on and off. After Xuanxuan understood, he spent half an hour sorting out the stuck code and finished the homework successfully.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family leisure and evening preparation
description: After finishing homework tutoring, the atmosphere at home relaxed. Soon Wang Lijuan and the second son, Lu Zihan, came back from their interest class, and the house became lively. Master Lu played with LEGO with Hanhan on the living room carpet, while Xuanxuan watched cartoons nearby, and his wife went into the kitchen to prepare dinner. A little while later, Master Lu took the initiative to go to the kitchen to help trim water spinach and peel garlic. The family chatted and enjoyed a leisurely weekend together.

Juanzi expressed support, and Lu Mingqiang gratefully kissed her forehead. Then he changed into his squash jersey and got ready to head to the squash court.

location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

When he read the first batch of mentoring assignments which included "Lu Mingqiang", he was greatly encouraged and carefully took notes on the key points. By 4 p.m., he completed the unified formatting, generated a PDF named "2025 Annual Case Compilation - Final Draft", and saved it to the desktop.

He took the tea, took a sip, then took out one of the 1980s Lugui wine bottles, carefully wiping it with a soft cloth under the desk lamp while examining the glaze and the inscription. After turning off the light, Lu Mingqiang reflected on the day's experiences, full of anticipation for the apprenticeship plan and the workshop. His breathing gradually steadied in contentment, and he fell into a deep sleep at 22:40.

While operating, he explained the principle to Zhao Qiang and guided him to adjust the acceleration time from 5 seconds to 8 seconds. After restarting, the motor ran smoothly, the noise returned to normal, and the equipment supervisor thanked them again and again.

I went over the sensor and actuator wiring diagrams in my mind, marked key sections of the textbook with sticky notes, and summarized in my notebook the differences between three-wire and four-wire sensor connections and the polarity precautions for the power supply.
