location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Longhua District, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Banshan Garden Residential Area, home bedroom

name: Morning: getting up, washing up, weighing, stretching, and going for a morning run to buy breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 7:30 in the morning, washed my face with cold water in the bathroom, then stepped on the scale, which showed 71.4 kg. The recent fat-loss results were satisfying. Facing the mirror, I moved my shoulders and neck to prepare for the morning run. I left at about 8:00 in short-sleeve sportswear and jogged east along Jinmao Middle Road at a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Running along Binhai Avenue to the edge of Evergreen Park, I saw elderly people practicing tai chi and people walking dogs. After completing the 4 km run, I stretched for ten minutes on a roadside stone bench. On the way home, I bought fresh soy milk and three just-fried youtiao at 'Aqiang Breakfast Stall' at the community gate, planning to bring them to my family.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and the route along Jinmao Middle Road to Wanlv Park on Binhai Avenue

name: Breakfast and a short family gathering
description: When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan was serving porridge to their two sons. Lu Mingqiang put youtiao and soy milk on the table. The younger son, Lu Zihan, reached for a youtiao and had his hand gently patted by his wife. The family sat together to eat. Lu Mingqiang drank the home-made lean meat porridge while listening to the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, talk about interesting moments from the school science and technology club; the teacher had praised him for improving his programming homework. Lu Mingqiang felt a stir, thinking the PLC knowledge he had learned last night might give him more to share with his son.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Complete the last lesson of the PLC course and practice hands-on.
description: After clearing away the dishes, Lu Mingqiang went into the study, put on his headphones, and followed the PLC course Lesson 12, "Comprehensive Case: Motor Forward and Reverse Control," listening and taking notes. After finishing the theory, he moved the old relays, a small transformer, wires, and a small motor that he had picked up from the flea market a few days earlier onto the desk and wired them according to the logic he had learned. When he closed the switch, the small motor turned smoothly, and he felt very gratified. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, heard the noise, pushed open the door, and curiously watched. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to explain the connection between relay control and "conditional judgment" in programming. The child did not fully understand, but he watched very attentively.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cooking fish soup and lunchtime family interaction
description: After closing the toolbox, Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen and put on an apron. He scraped the scales off the white crucian carp he had bought the day before and removed the innards. He rubbed the pan with ginger slices to prevent sticking, heated the oil, fried the fish on both sides until golden, poured in boiling water, added ginger slices and a scallion knot, and let it boil vigorously until the soup turned milky white, then turned the heat down to low and simmered slowly. He also chopped some scallions for later. At 12:30 the fish soup was served. His wife had stir-fried vegetables and steamed pork patty with salted fish, and he served soup for everyone. The younger son kept saying it was delicious, and the older son drank two bowls. Lu Mingqiang thought the soup was a little light in flavor, but seeing the family eat happily made him satisfied. His wife said she would take the younger son to an art trial class in the afternoon.
location: Home kitchen and dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Noon break
description: After helping clear the dishes from the meal, Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the living room sofa for a half-hour nap. The sunlight shining through the curtains fell on his face, and he felt relaxed all over.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Draw a sketch of the tool wall with friend Chen Jianguo
description: At two in the afternoon, Chen Jianguo came by with a bag of homemade pickled cabbage. The two spread out a large sheet of paper in the study. Lu Mingqiang took out a tape measure and a 2B pencil and explained his tool wall idea in detail: tools would be hung on a galvanized steel perforated panel, divided into zones for commonly used tools, measuring instruments, and specialty tools. Chen Jianguo suggested using 2.5×2.5 square steel tubes as the frame and proposed designing a foldable wooden workbench. As they drew, they drank tea-stem tea bought from the 'Datie Laoba Tea Shop,' and in nearly two hours they completed a rough outline and a full page of material list.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Rode an electric bike to the squash court and trained
description: After seeing Jianguo off, Lu Mingqiang changed into his sportswear, took clean clothes and a towel, and rode his electric bike along Jinmao Middle Road, Binhai Avenue, and Jinmao West Road, arriving at Jinshan Plaza in about fifteen minutes. After checking his ticket at the front desk of the Haikou Squash Hall in the plaza, he booked Court 3 and warmed up alone, focusing on doubles serving and the stability of receiving baseline shots while on the move. A Wei, a coach at the hall, passed by and voluntarily fed him several tricky balls to help him adapt to the pace. After an hour of training he was dripping with sweat and his feel for the ball was hot, which boosted his confidence for the next day's year-end match.
location: Jinshan Square (Haikou Squash Court), No. 6 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shopping at Carrefour and returning home to prepare dinner
description: After training, Lu Mingqiang showered and changed clothes, then walked to the nearby Carrefour Jinlong store. In the sports drink section he bought two bottles of Gatorade, and in the towel section he picked a light blue pure cotton sweat towel, preparing for the next day's competition. After checking out, he walked back to the foot of Jinshan Plaza to get his electric bike and rode ten minutes home. When he arrived, his wife had just returned from taking the child to an art class. He first organized his sports bag for the next day's competition and placed it on the shoe cabinet by the door, then helped pick vegetables and assisted with preparing dinner.
location: Carrefour (Jinlong Store) on Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, and home in the Banshan Garden residential area

name: Family dinner and parent-child LEGO building time
description: Dinner was braised pork ribs and garlic lettuce cooked by his wife, and Lu Mingqiang heated up the leftover fish soup from lunch. During the meal, the eldest son said he had already finished his homework at school and wanted to build a LEGO airplane model with his father after dinner. Lu Mingqiang gladly agreed. After the meal, he took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy up, then spread the LEGO pieces out on the living room carpet. The eldest son was responsible for finding parts and reading the instructions, while he assembled the main structure. When he came across a loose connection, he took the opportunity to teach the principle that 'a stable structure needs a solid base.' The younger son played with a toy train nearby. The father and son completed most of the model assembly.
location: Dining room and living room at home: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Washing up, browsing forums, preparing the next day's clothes, and having a late-night chat with his wife.
description: After urging the children to wash up, Lu Mingqiang took a shower himself. Leaning against the headboard, he opened the forums he had bookmarked on his phone and found that the old 1980s deer-turtle wine bottle he had been following had dropped again to 700 yuan. He hesitated and then decided not to buy it. Next, he set an alarm for the match the next afternoon and took out his knee pads, headband, and sports bag, placing them together. After his wife finished her tasks and got into bed, she listened to him talk about his progress in learning PLC that day and Jianguo's suggestion for the workshop, while massaging his sore arms, and shared the good news that their eldest son had scored full marks on his math quiz again. The two agreed that if he won the match, the whole family would go out for a seafood dinner the following week. After checking the weather forecast (cloudy, 23°C), they turned off the lights and went to sleep at 9:30.
location: Bathroom, bedroom, and master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Getting up, stretching, and a nutritious breakfast.
description: At 7 o'clock sharp, Lu Mingqiang was woken by his phone alarm. After getting up, he stretched his whole body on the balcony, focusing on his knees and ankles to ease the soreness from yesterday's warm-up. He then weighed himself and came in at 71.3 kg, steady. Afterwards, he had breakfast with his wife Wang Lijuan and their two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan. His wife had prepared egg noodle soup and pickled cabbage. Lu Mingqiang had a good appetite and told his sons while eating that they should aim for the runner-up medal in this afternoon's competition.
location: Home at Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom, balcony, and dining room)

name: Check equipment and confirm departure
description: Lu Mingqiang checked his sports bag in the living room and confirmed that all the gear was there: the newly bought light blue sports towel, squash racket, spare wristband, and a change of clothes. Then he called his friend Lin Feng to confirm the match time and meeting point. The two agreed to set off at ten and meet around 10:20 in the parking lot of Jinshan Plaza. Lin Feng said on the phone that he had dreamed of winning the match last night.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drive to visit his mother and aunt.
description: Lu Mingqiang took the coconut crisps and wife cakes that his wife Wang Lijuan had prepared in advance, and drove his car from home along Jinmao Middle Road, Jinlong Road, and Longkun North Road, then via Nanda Overpass and Haixiu Expressway to his mother Chen Xiuying's home. About 17 minutes later, he arrived at the South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan on Dayingshan East First Street, Meilan District. In his mother's living room, he chatted happily with his mother and his aunt Wang Xiuying, talked about learning PLC, and reminded them to wear more clothes as it was getting cold. At around 9:25, he got up to say goodbye and headed to the sports hall.
location: Mother's home, South Zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan, Dayingshan East 1st Street, Meilan District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Drove to the squash court.
description: Lu Mingqiang drove from his mother's home, turned from Dayingshan East First Street onto Nansha Road, passed through Qiaozhong Tunnel back into Longhua District, and arrived at the ground parking lot of Jinshan Square about 15 minutes later. He parked, shouldered his sports bag, met his friend Lin Feng, who had been waiting in the parking lot, and the two patted each other on the shoulder and walked to the court together.
location: Parking lot, Jinshan Plaza, No. 6 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Year-end friendly tournament doubles match
description: Lu Mingqiang and Lin Feng changed into their gear and started warming up on Court 3 of the Jinshan Plaza Squash Court. At 10:30, the match officially began. The two cooperated well, with one attacking and one defending. Lu Mingqiang was steady on defense and saved many difficult shots. Both the semifinal and final went to three full games. On the final point of the championship match, Lu Mingqiang slipped while chasing a deep court ball, but he steadied himself and hit a great shot, drawing applause from the whole crowd. In the end, the pair won second place.
location: No. 3 Court, Jinshan Plaza Squash Hall, No. 6 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Post-match exchange and gift swap
description: After the match, Lu Mingqiang, drenched in sweat, came to the rest area and enthusiastically discussed the highlights of the match with his teammates. He took out several light-blue sports towels he had prepared and gave them to his teammates as gifts, and in return received a "Healthy Eating Handbook" and a jar of handmade honey. Lin Feng put his arm around his shoulder, praised their increasingly seamless cooperation, and suggested organizing a 10-kilometer outdoor run after the New Year. Lu Mingqiang gladly agreed. The two also took a photo together with their phones in front of the runner-up medal standings.
location: Rest area of Jinshan Plaza Squash Court, No. 6 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Shower, lunch, and shopping on the way back.
description: Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower in the gym locker room and changed into a dry T-shirt and casual pants. He then drove out of Jinshan Plaza and stopped by the nearby Carrefour Jinlong store. In the supermarket, he bought two packs of toilet paper, a bottle of dishwashing liquid, two jin of wax apples, and one jin of Tainong mangoes.
location: Shower room of the squash court at Jinshan Plaza, No. 6 Jinmao West Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, and Carrefour Jinlong Store, No. 98 Jinlong Road.

name: Returned home and cleaned equipment
description: Lu Mingqiang came out of Carrefour, drove along Jinlong Road, turned right onto Jinmao Middle Road, and got home in about ten minutes. Once home, he put the fruit in the fridge, put the daily necessities back in their places, then threw his sweaty sports clothes and towel from the competition into the washing machine, added detergent, and pressed the quick wash button.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family sharing and leisure time
description: While the washing machine ran, Lu Mingqiang sat on the living room sofa drinking iced cola. His wife Wang Lijuan came over after hanging clothes on the balcony, and Lu Mingqiang vividly recounted the thrilling moments of the match, especially the sliding save. The two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, ran out at the sound, and immediately spotted the runner-up medal on the coffee table. Xuanxuan grabbed it and hung it around his neck, while Hanhan tugged at the other end trying to snatch it. The two tumbled onto the sofa, laughing and wrestling.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Playing LEGO with his second son
description: Lu Mingqiang had his elder son Lu Zixuan go to the study to do homework, while he played with LEGO bricks with his younger son Lu Zihan on the living room balcony. He patiently taught Zihan how to snap the connectors tight to make the truck sturdier. After Zihan successfully attached the wheels, he happily ran around the balcony holding up the truck.
location: Living room balcony, home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Preparing Dinner and Helping with Homework
description: His wife, Wang Lijuan, was in the kitchen preparing braised pork ribs and lettuce with minced garlic. Lu Mingqiang went into the kitchen to help her peel garlic, then washed the wax apples he had bought, put them in a crystal fruit platter, and carried it to the study. In the study, he accompanied his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, doing homework, explaining a complex math word problem to Zixuan by drawing a diagram to help him understand.
location: Kitchen and study, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Family dinner
description: The family of four sat around the dining table under warm lighting. Lu Mingqiang picked up a piece of braised spare ribs and recounted the highlight moment of the match again. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, listened with shining eyes and, with his mouth full of rice, said he wanted to learn squash when he grew up. Lu Mingqiang smiled and agreed.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: The whole family watched old Hong Kong movies.
description: After finishing dinner and clearing away the dishes, the family snuggled up on the sofa to watch the classic Stephen Chow movie “Fight Back to School” playing on the movie channel. Lu Mingqiang put his arm around his wife, with their two sons sitting in the middle, and the whole family laughed heartily, filling the living room with a relaxed and pleasant weekend atmosphere.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Supervise the children getting washed and wash himself
description: After the movie ended, Lu Mingqiang urged his two sons to go brush their teeth and wash their faces. His younger son Lu Zihan was lounging on the sofa and didn't want to move, so Lu Mingqiang imitated Zhou Xingxing's lines from "Fight Back to School," making Zihan laugh and run to the bathroom. After the children washed up and got into bed, Lu Mingqiang took a shower and changed into pajamas.
location: Bathroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Bedtime talk and planning for the next week
description: Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard and looked through the Healthy Eating Handbook he had received today, discussing with his wife Wang Lijuan, who was doing skincare at the dressing table, the plan to take the children out for seafood next week, at the old restaurant on Shuixiangkou. They also talked about the spring outdoor running plan proposed by Lin Feng, intending to take the whole family to Wanlv Garden for a run one weekend. His wife smiled and agreed.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.

name: Checked equipment and went to bed
description: Lu Mingqiang remembered that he had to work the next day, so he got out of bed and went to the balcony to check the electric bike parked downstairs with a flashlight. After confirming the battery was full, he unplugged the charger. Back in bed, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, picked up the runner-up medal, wiped it with his thumb, and, satisfied, turned off the light and went to sleep, soon falling into a dream.
location: Master bedroom and balcony at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Getting up, weighing, and washing up
description: After his phone alarm went off, Lu Mingqiang got up, went to weigh himself, and was satisfied to see the 71.2 kg reading. While washing up, he felt some tightness on the outside of his left knee from yesterday's competition.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (bedroom and bathroom at home).

name: Breakfast and shift handover
description: His wife Wang Lijuan had prepared white congee, fried eggs, and Hainan pickled vegetables. While eating, Lu Mingqiang told his wife that he would take the bus today instead of riding a bike to give his knees a rest, and that he would pick up Xuanxuan in the afternoon.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (home dining room)

name: Commuting by bus.
description: Lu Mingqiang walked from Banshan Garden Residential Area to the Jinmao Middle Road bus stop, swiped his bus card, and got on. There were not many people on the bus, so he found a window seat and put on earphones to listen to traffic radio. After checking the route on his phone map, he got off early at the 'Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road Intersection' stop, walked about 8 minutes, and arrived at the company at 08:50.
location: Starting from Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, walk to Jinmao Middle Road bus stop, take a bus to near the intersection of Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road, then walk to Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Changing clothes and attending the morning meeting
description: After arriving at the company, Lu Mingqiang went to the locker room to change into work clothes and ran into his old partner Chen Jianguo, chatting about yesterday's squash match. He then attended the team's Monday morning meeting, where team leader Zhang Tou emphasized pre-holiday safety and assigned the pre-New Year inspection task for all 12 streetlight control boxes along Haisheng Road.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (changing room and meeting room)

name: Inspection of streetlight control boxes on Haisheng Road
description: Lu Mingqiang drove a work vehicle with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang along Haisheng Road for inspection. In the morning, they checked six control boxes on the eastern section. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for opening the boxes and checking the wiring and relay contacts, Chen Jianguo used a multimeter to test, and Zhao Qiang recorded and took photos. In the afternoon, they continued to check six boxes on the western section. In one western-section box, they found slightly oxidized wire ends. He immediately polished them with sandpaper and retightened them, while explaining moisture-proofing details to Zhao Qiang.
location: Along Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Midday lunch gathering with colleagues and rest
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang went to the Qiong Cai Ren Jia restaurant near the company with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang for lunch. They ordered Wenchang chicken, vegetarian clay pot, and Lingao roast suckling pig. Chen Jianguo excitedly showed pictures of a Sanya hotel and planned a New Year's Day trip. After lunch, returning to the company, Lu Mingqiang leaned back in a chair in the lounge and quickly browsed several repair videos about automatic roller shutter door control circuits.
location: Hainan Cuisine House (100 meters west of the intersection of Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province) and the rest room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park

name: Wrote the inspection report.
description: Back at the company, Lu Mingqiang turned on the computer and entered the data from his notebook and phone photos into the system. He described the operating status of the 12 boxes in detail, specially noted the oxidation treatment process of the wire ends, and after checking, submitted and archived it.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (team meeting room)

name: Rest break and organizing materials
description: After filing the report, Lu Mingqiang went to get some water and received a draft of the year-end summary from Zhao Qiang; he agreed to look at it in the evening. Then he counted and organized spare relays and wire strippers that might be used for tomorrow's inspection, placing them in specific spots in the toolbox.
location: Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province (rest room and work station)

name: Evening commute home and a short rest at a tea shop
description: Lu Mingqiang left the company on his electric bike and, on the way, stopped at the Datie Laoba Tea Shop on Binya Road, Longhua District. He ordered a cup of lemon black tea, sat for 10 minutes to rest, and browsed the Healthy Eating Handbook on his phone.
location: Datie Laoba Tea Shop (Binya Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Pick up eldest son Lu Zixuan from school
description: Lu Mingqiang arrived on time at the main gate of Longfeng Experimental Primary School and found his son Lu Zixuan in the crowd. Zixuan ran over happily and said he had gotten the last bonus question right in today's math test. Lu Mingqiang smiled, patted his head in praise, and said he would reward him.
location: Main Entrance of Haikou Longfeng Experimental Primary School (No. 8 Yinpo Road, Meilan District, Haikou, Hainan Province)

name: Supermarket shopping and returning home.
description: Lu Mingqiang took Zixuan on the way to the supermarket under the Binhai International Financial Center, bought the light soy sauce and oyster sauce his wife had asked for, and also picked up two boxes of qingbuliang ingredients (coconut milk, red beans, and barley). On the way home, Zixuan sat in the back seat and talked about how his group won first place in the relay race in PE class.
location: Supermarket near Binhai International Financial Center to Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Dinner and family time.
description: When he got home, his wife Wang Lijuan had already picked up Hanhan and was cooking. Dinner included garlic lettuce, tomato scrambled eggs, and qingbuliang made by Lu Mingqiang with the newly purchased ingredients. At the dinner table, he shared the experience of discovering the oxidized wire end and reminded the children to be careful. Zixuan reported his math scores again. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the table.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan (home dining room and kitchen)

name: Parent-child activities and homework check
description: After tidying up the kitchen, Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room and checked Zixuan's math homework. He found a calculation error in a word problem and patiently guided him to redo it. Hanhan was playing with building blocks nearby, occasionally showing the little house she had made to her father.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: Startup plan research and document writing
description: While the children were watching TV, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and opened the document “Mingqiang Studio Preparation Plan V2.0.” Combining his PLC notebook and his friend’s suggestions, he integrated recent knowledge points such as PLC control principles and sensor selection with business directions such as intelligent repair of automatic rolling shutters and energy-saving renovation of secondary water supply systems. He added a new chapter, “Intelligent Control Services,” and initially listed plans for 5 small projects that could be undertaken.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Wiped down the collected wine bottles.
description: After finishing work, Lu Mingqiang took out his treasured old bottle of Yedao Deer Tortoise Wine and a nostalgic bottle of Haikou Daqu from the cabinet, carefully wiped off the dust with a dry cloth, and admired the glaze and shape of the bottles, enjoying a peaceful moment.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (study room)

name: Agreed with his wife on the New Year's Eve menu.
description: After wiping the wine bottles, he walked into the living room, where his wife was putting away the New Year goods. Lu Mingqiang discussed the New Year’s Eve menu with her, and they finally settled on white-cut chicken, grilled fish, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fried ribs. They also decided to buy flowers and qingbuliang ingredients tomorrow to add to the atmosphere.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province (living room)

name: Evening relaxation and leisure.
description: After finalizing the menu, Lu Mingqiang chatted with his wife for a while, covering topics like the children's final exam review and Spring Festival plans. Then they washed up and got ready for bed.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom and bathroom)

name: Reading and bedtime
description: Lu Mingqiang picked up the 'Healthy Eating Handbook' and flipped through it for about ten minutes, focusing on the chapter about post-exercise protein supplementation. Then he turned off the light and quickly fell asleep.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province (master bedroom)

name: Morning run.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the sky was overcast and the ground was slightly damp. Lu Mingqiang arrived at Wanlv Garden on time and began his 8-kilometer long run. The air was humid and felt comfortable; he maintained a steady pace of 6:18 per kilometer. After the run, he stretched carefully for 10 minutes along the path, paying attention to relaxing his left knee, gazing at the distant high-rises looming faintly in the mist, and mentally planning the day's arrangements.
location: Wanlv Garden Park, No. 38 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Returning home for a shower and a simple breakfast
description: Got home at 7:40, took off his slightly damp workout clothes, and quickly took a hot shower. He took out the taro buns his wife Juanzi had steamed last night and a glass of hot milk from the fridge, ate them with olive vegetable, and finished in 10 minutes. After changing into clean work clothes, he checked the e-bike keys and put his running shoes on the shoe cabinet to dry.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Commute to work by bicycle
description: At 8:10, he rode his electric bike from Banshan Garden, turned right from Jinmao Middle Road onto Yusha Road, then turned onto Haixiu Middle Road and headed west. After the rain, the road was clean, the air was fresh, and traffic was smooth. He arrived at the gate of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park in about 15 minutes.
location: Along the route from No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province to No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District

name: Workshop deep cleaning and waste disposal.
description: After changing into work clothes, team leader Zhang assigned tasks. Lu Mingqiang, Jianguo, and Xiao Zhao were in charge of the tool area on the west side. He dumped out all the wrenches, screwdrivers, multimeters, etc. from the iron tool cabinet, wiped them with cotton yarn dipped in rust remover, applied anti-rust oil, and cleaned up the waste copper wire ends and old relay parts that had piled up over nearly half a year. Then he called Jianguo, and the two carried two burlap bags of scrap to the guard room. Old Li contacted a scrap buyer, who weighed it and gave 38 yuan. Lu Mingqiang turned the money over to the team and recorded it in the team's small account.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, workshop and guard room

name: Annual production safety summary meeting
description: At 10 o'clock the meeting started on time. On the screen, Manager Liu summarized the year's safety situation, confirmed there were no major accidents, and specifically praised Lu Mingqiang's team. When it was time for remarks, Team Leader Zhang nudged him. He stood up, faced the camera, and shared an example from this morning: before starting work, he wiped his tools and checked his insulating gloves. He stressed, "People who work with electricity must engrave the word 'fear' in their hearts. If you fear accidents, accidents won't happen." His brief speech was powerful and won applause.
location: Large conference room, 2nd floor, office area, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Finishing the big cleanup and collecting the New Year welfare package
description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang and his partners wiped the equipment surfaces again, hung the tools back on the tool wall according to specification, Xiao Zhao cleaned the oil stains on the floor, and several people worked together to push the backup motor back to its original position. Zhang Tou nodded approvingly and praised the place for being clean and tidy. Then Manager Liu came to the workshop carrying a red paper bag printed with the company logo and asked Lu Mingqiang to sign for two 500-yuan supermarket shopping cards as an extra benefit for the advanced team. Lu Mingqiang took a photo and sent it to his wife with a note saying to add an extra dish tonight.
location: Workshop and office, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Company cafeteria lunch
description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang went to the cafeteria with Jianguo and Little Zhao. He got a serving of stir-fried pork, a piece of steamed fish, and a portion of greens, costing 15 yuan. While eating and chatting, Jianguo asked about the money from scrap materials. Learning that it had been turned over to the team, Little Zhao complained that the drawer hadn't been tidied up, and Lu Mingqiang promised to help after the meal.
location: Canteen, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Lunch break at the workstation.
description: After the meal, he strolled around the office building a couple of times to aid digestion, returned to his workstation, set the alarm for 13:20, draped his work jacket over the chair back, and rested with his eyes closed on the desk.
location: Hainan Province, Haikou City, Xiuying District, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industry Park, office area, first floor

name: Afternoon pre-holiday inspection and work wrap-up.
description: When the afternoon work bell rang, Foreman Zhang assigned Lu Mingqiang to take Xiao Zhao to the west-side power distribution room for the final pre-holiday inspection. Lu Mingqiang held a multimeter and a flashlight, checking one by one the indicator lights of the distribution cabinets, the voltage and current values, and the operation of the cooling fans, and recorded the data. After the inspection, he returned to the workshop and helped Xiao Zhao thoroughly tidy up his workstation.
location: The workshop and power distribution room of Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Left work early and cycled to pick up the child
description: At 16:00 sharp, Lu Mingqiang told Foreman Zhang he was leaving half an hour early, got on his e-bike, and set off from the industrial park, heading straight for the kindergarten on Guomao Sanheng Road via Haixiu Middle Road, the Rainbow Overpass, and Jinlong Road, arriving at 16:17. As soon as his younger son Lu Zihan saw his father, he rushed over and excitedly told him about the little turtle at a classmate's house that could do flips. Lu Mingqiang chuckled in response, and they agreed on ground rules for keeping a turtle.
location: No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Sanheng Road, Longhua District

name: After buying flowers and qingbuliang ingredients, return home.
description: Holding Hanhan's hand, he walked about 18 minutes from the kindergarten to C-FLORAL Creative Flower Shop on Guomao North Road. Following his wife Juanzi's WeChat request, he selected a bouquet of white daisies and yellow lilies, paid 48 yuan, and Hanhan held it obediently. Then he rode the e-bike with the child along Guomao Road to Pobo Market on Nansha Road and bought ingredients for qingbuliang according to Juanzi's list: one jin of red beans, half a jin of mung beans, one pack of sago, one pack of shredded coconut, and one jin of brown sugar, for a total of 22 yuan. Finally, he rode back to Banshan Garden.
location: C-FLORAL Creative Flower Shop, North Guomao Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province; Pobo Market, Nansha Road; Banshan Garden, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road

name: Help wife prepare dinner
description: When he got home, Juanzi was already chopping chicken in the kitchen, and the aroma of white-cut chicken wafted from the stew pot. Lu Mingqiang put the flowers in a vase and placed them on the dining table, then washed and soaked the Qingbuliang ingredients. Hanhan ran off to show off to her older brother, who was doing homework. After washing his hands, Lu Mingqiang took over the work from Juanzi and began peeling garlic and trimming cilantro roots, and he told his wife about the shopping card, planning to take the whole family to the supermarket for New Year's Eve shopping the next day.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was served on time at 18:20, with white-cut chicken, steamed red fish, stir-fried greens, and pork rib and lotus root soup. Lu Mingqiang served food to his two sons, and the family of four chatted. Hanhan again brought up raising a turtle, and Xuanxuan asked about plans for New Year's Day tomorrow. Lu Mingqiang said they would first go to Grandpa's house tomorrow to deliver New Year goods, and take them to Wanlv Garden to fly kites in the afternoon. The children cheered in unison.
location: Restaurant in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Annual family financial summary and starting a new ledger.
description: After dinner, his wife cleared the dishes, Lu Mingqiang brewed a pot of oolong tea, and the two sat at the dining table. They took out mobile payment records, pay slips, and Juanzi's small ledger and checked them item by item. Total annual income was about 52,000 yuan, total expenditure about 43,000 yuan, with a surplus of 9,000 yuan. Juanzi said they had saved more than last year. Lu Mingqiang proposed putting 5,000 yuan into the "Family Sea Trip" dedicated account and keeping 4,000 yuan for Spring Festival spending. Then Juanzi took out a light blue new notebook, and Lu Mingqiang neatly wrote "2026 Family Income and Expenditure Book" and the first entry on the flyleaf.
location: Dining table in the living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Helping eldest son with homework and parent-child bonding.
description: Lu Mingqiang went to the study to check his older son Lu Zixuan's winter vacation homework. He found a math word problem that was wrong, so he took out scrap paper, drew a line segment diagram, and explained it patiently. His younger son Lu Zihan also ran over, climbed onto his father's lap, and scribbled in the notebook with his brother's pencil. Lu Mingqiang taught the older one while soothing the younger one, until 9 p.m. when the two brothers went to wash up and go to bed.
location: Study room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Selecting photos for the New Year's Eve Moments post
description: Juanzi coaxed Hanhan to sleep. Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard, opened his phone's photo album, and carefully looked through the day's photos: the reflection on the lake at Wanlv Garden, the shiny tool cabinet in the workshop, Hanhan grinning while holding a bouquet, and the steaming dinner table. He finally picked four photos and captioned them, '2025, steady and solid, a safe finish. 2026, keep working and look ahead.'
location: No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province, bedroom at Banshan Garden Residential Area

name: Washing up, finalizing tomorrow's plan, and preparing for bed
description: After washing up, Lu Mingqiang changed into his pajamas and lay in bed, reconfirming the New Year's Eve plans with Juanzi: bring fruit and shopping cards for his parents, buy two coconuts, and fly kites at Wanlu Garden in the afternoon; the kite string had already been checked and was long enough. He then did a 5-minute leg stretch on the floor in front of the bed to relax his muscles, turned off the main light at 10:10 PM, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Wake up early, weigh in, morning run, wash up, and have breakfast
description: At 6:20 in the morning, his biological clock woke him up. He weighed himself on the scale in the bathroom; it showed 70.5 kg, lighter than yesterday again, and he felt reassured. He changed into sports shorts and a T-shirt, went downstairs, and jogged 3 kilometers along the circular path inside the residential complex. When he got home after the run, his wife Wang Lijuan was already busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of white porridge wafted from the rice cooker. After a hot shower, he changed into clean work clothes, pinned on his work badge, and hurriedly ate the fried eggs, white porridge, and pickled mustard prepared by his wife.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Biking to work
description: He rode his electric bike to work, starting from the west gate of the residential complex, following Jinmao Middle Road onto the auxiliary road of Haixiu Expressway, then turning onto Haisheng Road. The whole trip took about 15 minutes. Along the way, he hummed a passage from the Hainan opera Red Leaves Inscribed with a Poem and parked steadily in the company bike shed.
location: Along the route from Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province, to No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District.

name: Morning work and year-end team photo
description: When they reached the team tool room, Chen Jianguo was already organizing the electric wrenches, and the two exchanged 'See you next year.' In the morning, they cleaned the workshop and counted the unreturned spare parts. At 9 o'clock, Squad Leader Zhang announced an early dismissal at 2 p.m., and everyone cheered. As they gathered at the tool room entrance chatting, Lu Mingqiang suggested using Zhao Qiang's phone to take the last team group photo of the year, with the 'Safe Production' slogan as the background, preserving the work memories of 2025.
location: Tool room and workshop of Haikou Electric Power Engineering Service Co., Ltd., within the Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: Walked 8 minutes with Chen Jianguo to Big Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant near the company. The restaurant was lively, and the owner gave them a small bottle of coconut juice to send off the old year and welcome the new. Lu Mingqiang ordered spicy soup rice with Chinese sausage. Chen Jianguo joked that he had lost weight recently, and Lu Mingqiang proudly shook his wrist to show his weight had stabilized.
location: Sister's Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Building 8, Xianghe Jiayuan, Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Wrap up afternoon work
description: After lunch, walked back to the company with Jianguo and continued working for half an hour, wiping the used toolboxes clean and putting them back on the shelf. Zhao Qiang came over to ask about reading circuit diagrams. Lu Mingqiang took out his work notebook and patiently explained how to read the star-delta starting diagram for a three-phase asynchronous motor. At 2 p.m., Team Leader Zhang clapped his hands, announced the end of work, and wished everyone a happy New Year.
location: Tool room, Hainan Elevator Supporting Industrial Park, No. 57 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Leave work early to buy ingredients and Chinese New Year goods
description: Rode an electric bike to Shangao Farmers' Market. As planned, I first bought the ingredients for qingbuliang: coconut milk, mung beans, coix seeds, and winter melon barley. Then I picked a lively tilapia and had the vendor gut it. Seeing fresh wax apples, I bought five jin on impulse, thinking the kids would love them.
location: Shangao Farmers' Market, Shangao Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Buy flowers.
description: After leaving the farmers' market, he drove along Nanhai Avenue and turned onto Binhai Avenue. Remembering that there was a flower shop downstairs at Binhai Sunshine, he headed over. He picked a bouquet of warm-toned flowers wrapped in kraft paper, with yellow sunflowers and orange spray roses, thinking that his wife would surely love them in a vase.
location: Flower shop near Binhai Sunshine, No. 22-5 Binhai Avenue, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province.

name: Returned home and organized the purchased items.
description: Put the fish in the refrigerator to chill, and portion out the Qingbuliang ingredients. Find the glass vase at home, trim the flowers, arrange them in the vase, and place it on the living room coffee table. Then change out of work clothes into a comfortable old T-shirt and lounge pants.
location: Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and preparing dinner
description: Walking into the kitchen, his wife Wang Lijuan was preparing a dressed chicken to make white-cut chicken. Lu Mingqiang put on an apron and helped pick over the greens, wash the scallions and ginger, then dealt with the tilapia: he scraped off the remaining scales, cleaned the innards, and marinated the fish with ginger slices and cooking wine, preparing for the evening's grilled fish.
location: Kitchen at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Pick up the second son from school
description: Walked 12 minutes to Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten to pick up his younger son Hanhan. Hanhan came out with a small schoolbag on his back, called out to Dad in a sweet, childish voice, and chattered all the way home about what he had eaten that day and what new nursery rhymes he had learned.
location: Haikou Jinmao Center Kindergarten, Guomao Third Cross Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Making dinner and the eldest son coming home
description: When he brought Hanhan back, his eldest son, Xuanxuan, had already come home, let himself in, and was doing homework. His wife was in the kitchen cooking braised fish and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, while Lu Mingqiang helped by handing her seasonings and flipping the pan. The marinated tilapia in the oven, with onion and potato chunks, slowly released a fragrant aroma.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: A sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner
description: The family of four sat around the dining table, which was spread with grilled fish, white-cut chicken, stir-fried choy sum, and wax apples. Lu Mingqiang poured himself a small half glass of Laoba tea and poured coconut juice for the two children. He raised his glass and said, "Come on, our family has worked hard this year, especially your mom. In 2026, let's all be well! At the end of the year, we'll go see the sea together!" Everyone clinked glasses, and the room was filled with warmth.
location: Home dining room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Cleaned up and rested after the meal.
description: The wife cleared the dishes, and Lu Mingqiang helped wrap the leftovers in plastic wrap, put them in the fridge, and then wiped the table. Afterward, the two sat together on the sofa watching the New Year's Eve gala. He talked about buying flowers that afternoon and said that seeing flowers reminded him of her.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Family cultural heritage and support from his wife
description: Xuanxuan was drawn to the gleaming wine bottles in the cabinet. Lu Mingqiang became animated, so he brought several distinctive bottles over to the coffee table and talked about everything from "Haikou Daqu" to "Shanlan Yuye," explaining the craft of making wine jars from Hainan red clay and the Li ethnic tradition of brewing wine from Shanlan rice. Xuanxuan and Hanhan listened, utterly absorbed. His wife, sitting nearby, was also learning for the first time about the expertise behind these bottles and jars. Then she said softly, "I used to think you were just picking up junk. Hearing you talk about it today, I can feel these things really have age and stories. From now on, I'll help polish them, so you don't have to get all dusty yourself." Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside.
location: Home living room, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Prepared, posted a year-end summary on Moments, and interacted with friends
description: To prepare the Moments post, he went to the study and photographed the "Senior Technician Certificate" he had received and the cover of his handwritten "Notes on Bottle Culture." Then he had Xuanxuan hold up the "Star of Progress" certificate for a photo. Finally, he called his wife and children together for a warm family photo by the flowers in the living room. Back at the desk, he arranged the four photos in order and typed the caption: "This year, besides professional progress, I also picked up some forgotten memories. In 2026, I'll keep recording, and I'll take the whole family to see the sea." After checking, he clicked publish. More than ten minutes later, comments came in one after another — from his colleague Chen Jianguo ("Nice one, brother!") and his co-worker Wang Hai — and he replied to each. His wife saw the forwarded screenshot in the parents' group and laughingly said he had "become a celebrity." His mother also called to say she had seen the Moments post and was very happy for him.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Write down New Year's goals
description: After the family went to wash up and get ready for bed, Lu Mingqiang took out the notebook he had used for more than half a year, turned to a blank page, and neatly wrote three lines: 1. Steadily lose weight to below 70 kg. 2. Take the whole family on a road trip around the island. 3. Finish drawing origin maps for all the collected wine bottles. Signed 2026.1.1.
location: Study at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for New Year's Eve
description: Closed the laptop, took a shower, and changed into pajamas. Went to the second bedroom and, by the faint light from outside the window, tucked in the sleeping Xuanxuan and Hanhan.
location: Home in Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou, Hainan Province

name: Welcoming the New Year at midnight and going to sleep
description: Back in the master bedroom, his wife was already lying down. Faint sounds of fireworks and firecrackers could be heard in the distance. Lu Mingqiang walked softly to the bedside, bent down to kiss his wife and children on the foreheads, and whispered, "Happy New Year, 2026." Then he turned off the lamp, and the whole family fell into peaceful stillness.
location: Master bedroom at home, Banshan Garden Residential Area, No. 1 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City, Hainan Province.
